qa: Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Ten Hoopen (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat winkeliers veel minder aangifte doen van winkeldiefstallen omdat de politie niet of

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether falling willingness of shopkeepers to report shoplifting, due to slow or inadequate police response, reflects police understaffing and how this fits with pledges that budget cuts would not harm police work. The minister denied staffing as the cause, cited police strength above agreed levels and rising case disposals, and said an expert group would advise on improving reporting intake, including a national form and online reporting.
The reduced willingness to report is not explained by insufficient manpower, since police strength has increased in recent years and stood at 53,348 full-time equivalents on 31 December last.
De verminderde aangiftebereidheid is niet te verklaren door onvoldoende mankracht, immers de politiesterkte is de afgelopen jaren toegenomen en bedroeg op 31 december jongsleden 53.348 fte.

Vragen van de leden Vietsch, Ten Hoopen en Van Bochove (allen CDA) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie, van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de Wet kraken en leegstand (ingezon

CDA MPs asked ministers whether Utrecht's refusal to enforce the new squatting ban and the Public Prosecution Service's reluctance to prosecute squatters were acceptable, and how enforcement would be ensured. The minister replied that prosecution is reserved for the Public Prosecution Service under the opportunity principle and available capacity, that enforcement will proceed from 1 October with priority given to cases involving owner obstruction, nuisance or damage, and that there is no reason to think the ban will not be enforced.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp, Ferrier en Ten Hoopen (allen CDA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de immer verslechterende situatie in de Indiase deelstaat Manipur (ingezonden 27 mei

CDA MPs asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the deteriorating situation in India's Manipur state, including religious tensions, Dutch economic interests, and the effect on civil society and NGOs. The foreign minister answered that Naga independence demands and an economic blockade cause the unrest, that no Dutch firms or investments are present, and that the Netherlands and EU will raise the matter with Indian authorities if needed.
The Netherlands and the EU are following this process and will, where necessary, raise the situation in contacts with the Indian authorities.
Nederland en de EU volgen dit proces en zullen zonodig de situatie aan de orde stellen in contacten met de Indiase autoriteiten.

The Minister answered that repairs are ongoing with the housing corporation, that residents have adequate legal protection, and that the Wkb quality-assurance reform will strengthen construction oversight.
I do not consider extending or amending legislation on this point necessary.
Ik acht uitbreiding of aanpassing van wet- en regelgeving op dit punt dan ook niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Schonis, Bruins en Van der Graaf over de jaarcijfers 2020 van de Nederlandse Spoorwegen gepresenteerd op 25 februari 2021

MPs from D66 and the ChristenUnie asked the Finance Minister about NS's 2020 losses, planned cost cuts, state support and the public-transport concession. The Minister answered that talks with NS on financial support are ongoing, that the availability fee has been extended to end-2021, and that he will inform parliament once concrete results exist.
As indicated in the answer to question 11, the talks are still ongoing. If these have produced concrete results, I will inform your House of them as already promised.
Zoals aangegeven bij het antwoord op vraag 11 lopen de gesprekken nog. Als deze concrete resultaten hebben opgeleverd zal ik uw Kamer zoals reeds toegezegd daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Ook in coronatijd ernstige incidenten, zoals bijna-botsingen, op Schiphol. Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid: ‘Ernst onvoldoende duidelijk’

An MP asked the minister about rising runway incursions and aborted take-offs at Schiphol in 2020 despite lower traffic, and about the safety warnings from the Dutch Safety Board. The minister said the high incursion count was largely one January 2020 event, reported that the wider OvV recommendations are being followed up with an evaluation planned later this year, and committed to informing parliament of the OvV investigation outcome.
I will inform you about the outcomes of the OvV investigation.
Over de uitkomsten van het OvV onderzoek zal ik u informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht 'KLM maakt werk van pakketreizen, touroperators boos: ‘Dit mag de overheid nooit toelaten’'

An MP asked whether the state, as a 6% shareholder and creditor-supported rescue provider of KLM, should accept KLM's acquisition of a majority stake in AirTrade while it depends on state aid, and about the moral and state-aid implications including possible double support via BCD Group. The minister answered that acquisitions are a matter for KLM's board under Dutch corporate law, that Finance was only informed in outline as the aid conditions required, that the state agent was not informed, and that acquisition costs are for the parties to disclose.
The state agent was not informed by KLM and not involved in the decision-making on this acquisition.
De staatsagent is door KLM niet geïnformeerd en betrokken bij de besluitvorming over deze acquisitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht 'Proef met sneltesten voor studenten in Groningen op Zernike'

An MP asked the education minister about a COVID-19 rapid-test pilot for students at Groningen's Zernike campus, including test type, daily capacity, false-positive and false-negative rates, consequences for exam participation and safety measures. The minister answered in detail on test type (Abbott PANBIO antigen test, about 450 tests per day), its sensitivity and specificity, expected error counts, referral to GGD and PCR confirmation, and committed to informing the House by the second quarter.
As indicated in the letter of 23 February, all pilot regions are asked to deliver results by 1 May.
Zoals aangegeven in de brief van 23 februari worden alle pilotregio's gevraagd om op 1 mei resultaten op te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Bruins over de relatie tussen het programma Luchtruimherziening en de routes voor luchthaven Lelystad

An MP asks whether the minister's earlier commitments that existing routes, including Lelystad Airport's connecting routes and IJsselmeer routes, are not a starting point in the airspace redesign still hold, and whether alternatives must be examined in the environmental impact assessment. The minister confirms the commitments but states that the B+ routes are not a starting point, that current routes remain the basis for the MER update, and that alternatives will be assessed in the later planning phase if effects warrant.
In the airspace redesign, the local departure and approach routes (B+) and the connecting routes are not a starting point for the design.
In de luchtruimherziening zijn de lokale vertrek- en naderingsroutes (B+) en de aansluitroutes namelijk geen uitgangspunt voor het ontwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bruins over mensen die hun woning moeten verlaten respectievelijk kwijtraken als ze hun zorgindicatie verliezen of worden opgenomen in een GGZ-instelling

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the government about people losing their homes when care indications end or when they are admitted to mental health institutions, and about the gaps in housing and support, the reduction of support hours, the household-sharing norm, and municipal responsibilities. The state secretary answered that no central figures exist on homelessness caused by expiring care indications, pointed to municipal responsibility, planned expert support and the Wvggz/Participatiewet frameworks, and said action is being taken through working agreements and a new plan.
At central level there is no insight into the amount of support that municipalities provide under the Wmo 2015.
Op centraal niveau bestaat geen inzicht in de omvang van de begeleiding die gemeenten op basis van de Wmo 2015 verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het artikel ‘Monique kreeg coronasteun en moet nu fors terugbetalen’

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that entrepreneurs must repay part of their NOW corona wage subsidy advances, sometimes without fraud, and about how UWV calculates repayments. The minister explains the calculation logic, defends not reversing the system, rejects sanctions without fraud, and offers extended repayment terms and an open window for final assessments, while refusing to pause final assessments.
It is incorrect that entrepreneurs must pay a sanction if the wage bill has fallen for a reason outside their control or if turnover proves higher than estimated in advance.
Het is onjuist dat ondernemers een sanctie moeten betalen als de loonsom is gedaald door een reden die buiten hun invloedssfeer ligt of als de omzet hoger blijkt te zijn dan vooraf ingeschat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de evaluatie van de Gids proportionaliteit

An MP asks the state secretary about the external evaluation of the Gids Proportionaliteit amendment procedure, its scope, the stakeholders involved, and the role of the ministry as lead drafter compared with the period before 2017. The state secretary confirms the evaluation by KWINK groep covers the whole amendment procedure, will share findings and any policy plans with parliament, sends the commissioning brief, but declines to reconsider the advisory committee's statutory status for now.
The outcomes of this research will be shared with your House together with my possible policy intentions.
De uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zullen tezamen met mijn eventuele beleidsvoornemens met uw Kamer gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Palland en Bruins over signalen vanuit de Industriecoalitie m.b.t. de regelingen Leven Lang Ontwikkelen (LLO)

MPs Tielen, Palland and Bruins asked whether the government is aware of the Industriecoalitie's signals that LLO schemes are fragmented, favour surplus sectors over shortage sectors, and are hard to scale or combine with modular training. The minister acknowledged the consultations and defended the existing complementary schemes, promising evaluation and sector-led plans without committing to a structural redesign.
The starting point is that people can receive support depending on their position and needs.
Het uitgangspunt is dat mensen, afhankelijk van hun positie en behoefte, ondersteuning kunnen krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de subsidieregeling Specifieke uitkering ventilatie in scholen

An MP asks the Dutch government about the SIVUS subsidy scheme for school ventilation, including whether school boards or municipalities bear primary responsibility for funding building ventilation and whether the investment ban for school boards is compatible with the required substantial works. The minister replies that school boards and municipalities share responsibility, that a bill to ease investment rules and an interdepartmental review are underway, and that funds have already been made available.
As communicated earlier before the summer, a bill is being prepared to improve the planning of housing investments.
Zoals eerder voor de zomer gecommuniceerd, is een wetsvoorstel in voorbereiding om de planvorming voor investeringen in huisvesting te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de stikstofberekeningen voor Lelystad Airport

The ChristenUnie MP Bruins asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about errors in the nitrogen deposition calculations for road traffic in the Lelystad Airport environmental impact assessments (MER 2014 and 2018) and the PAS notification of May 2019, including omitted road connections, wrong emission inputs and whether the notification was lawful. The minister acknowledges the calculation errors (1 MW heat content, NO2 instead of NOx, very low emission inputs), argues they had no consequences for the procedure because the PAS already reserved room for road traffic, and states the notification was made in good faith and will be legalised under the regular procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Dik-Faber over de plaatsing van windmolens binnen een gebied in de gemeente Haarlem dat gereguleerd is door het Luchthavenindelingsbesluit

MPs Bruins and Dik-Faber asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why wind turbines near Schiphol in Haarlem are restricted under the airport zoning decree, while a taller KPN mast stands nearby, and urged a waiver. The minister answered that aviation safety rules (ICAO, LIB Schiphol) limit turbine heights, the ILT gave a negative advice, and the height restrictions will be maintained.
No, the current height restriction rules in the LIB Schiphol will be maintained.
Nee, de huidige regels voor hoogtebeperkingen in het LIB Schiphol worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht waarin wordt gewaarschuwd voor interferentie van de nieuwe 5G frequentieband met de frequentieband voor altimeters in de burgerluchtvaart

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported interference between US 5G bands and aviation radio altimeters, including whether more research and extra measures are needed. The minister replied that the Dutch 3.5 GHz band is further from the altimeter band than in the US, that no evidence of a safety risk exists, and that the government follows international research and European rollouts closely.
I have no indication that there is a potential danger to aviation safety.
Concluderend heb ik geen aanwijzingen dat er een potentieel gevaar is voor de vliegveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat de kledingbank is gesloten tot 19 januari

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary whether clothing banks had been closed nationwide until 19 January, whether they could be treated as welfare services and reopened on humanitarian grounds. The minister confirmed closures as public places under COVID rules, declined to grant an exception, and offered home delivery of clothing for people in acute need instead.
Unfortunately, I cannot grant the permission you requested under the current rules.
Helaas kan ik de door u verzochte toestemming op basis van de huidige regels niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Gijs van Dijk en Bruins over geweld en agressie tegenover arbeidsmigranten en vakbondsmedewerkers

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a violent assault on a FNV union employee at a bungalow park housing migrant workers, whether the incident would be investigated, and how union and inspection access to such housing can be guaranteed. The minister condemned the violence, said the police handle the criminal complaint, stated that the Labour Inspectorate has access to migrant housing and can be threatened or refused access in isolated cases, and pointed to ongoing government programmes on migrant worker protection.
I cannot comment on this specific case. It is up to the police to investigate this matter following the complaint of assault.
Over dit specifieke geval kan ik geen uitspraken doen. Het is aan de politie om deze zaak, naar aanleiding van de aangifte van mishandeling, te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Van der Molen over het CPB-onderzoek naar het niet-gebruik van de aanvullende beurs door studenten

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education about a CPB study showing a quarter of eligible first-year students do not claim the supplementary grant, many of whom still borrow. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to DUO's proactive mailing experiment and planned website and MijnDUO changes, said automatic payment would need a law change and privacy review, and noted retroactive claims are possible until the start of the study year.
Therefore DUO will next year point all students more emphatically to the supplementary grant in this way.
Daarom gaat DUO volgend jaar alle studenten op deze manier nadrukkelijker op de aanvullende beurs wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over de mogelijkheid tot sneltesten op Schiphol

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the government about testing at Schiphol airport, including implementing the motion on comprehensive airport testing, discouraging air travel to risk areas, introducing rapid tests and a Dutch-style mandatory testing model, and charging travellers for tests. The minister answered that mandatory negative tests for necessary travel from risk areas are planned, that testing on day 5 after arrival is being examined, and that rapid tests cannot yet be validated for asymptomatic testing, while the Israeli gargle test is still under evaluation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Nederlands kabinet vindt eisen Europees coronafonds lastig’

An MP asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs why the cabinet would not submit a national recovery plan in the first EU window and whether Dutch firms would lose EU coronavirus recovery funds as a result. The minister replied that the final decision is left to the incoming cabinet, that Dutch funds are not lost because later submission windows remain open, and that the government is taking other steps to protect the level playing field.
The cabinet deliberately chooses to leave the final decision on the reforms and investments to be included in the Recovery and Resilience Plan to the new cabinet.

Het kabinet kiest er bewust voor om het definitieve besluit over de hervormingen en investeringen die in het Recovery and Resilience Plan ( RRP) worden opgenomen door het nieuwe kabinet te laten nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Bruins over schijnconstructies en wanpresterende uitzendbureaus

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about sham subcontracting schemes at Veka Shipyard and underpaid Romanian workers, the slow enforcement, weak remedies, and the role of employment agencies. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained existing liability and inspection tools, pointed to proposals under consideration and to ongoing exploration, but committed to no concrete new legal change now.
Under Article 3:305a of the Civil Code, trade unions have the possibility to bring a collective action on behalf of employees.
Op grond van artikel 3:305a BW hebben vakbonden de mogelijkheid om een collectieve actie in te zetten voor werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat Euronext flitshandelaren een onzichtbare voorsprong geeft

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Euronext gives high-frequency traders an early information advantage through its private order-confirmation channel, whether this amounts to insider trading, and what measures will be taken. The minister answered that all market parties involved in a trade receive confirmation microseconds earlier via the private channel regardless of HFT use, that whether insider trading occurred is for the AFM or courts to judge, and that the AFM will be involved in Euronext's consultation on adjusting the system.
Whether a specific case involves (trading on) inside information is for the supervisor or, where applicable, the court to establish.
Of in een specifieke casus sprake is van (handel met) voorwetenschap is aan de toezichthouder of in voorkomend geval aan de rechter om vast te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Bruins over "tempo maken bij aanpak jeugdwerkloosheid"

MPs Van Dijk and Bruins asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the slow pace of tackling youth unemployment during the coronavirus crisis, including stages, apprenticeships, municipal job-search waiting periods and youth organisations' involvement. The minister answered that extra funds and regional approaches are in place, that the four-week waiting period is relaxed and extended to July 2021 with exemptions, and that municipalities have discretion over individual cases.
No information is available on that.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Dik-Faber en Bruins over het bericht ‘Verbreden snelwegen kan ondanks stikstofverbindingen doorgaan dankzij ‘rekentruc’ kabinet’

Three ChristenUnie MPs asked whether the 2019 national speed reduction to 100 km/h was modelled without a 5 km cut-off while the 2011 speed increase to 130 km/h used a 3 km cut-off, calling this an accounting trick. The minister answered that the models differ for justified reasons, that the freed nitrogen space is not a saving, and that backdating speed changes to manufacture headroom is neither legally nor ecologically an option.
Raising speed on sections where 130 km/h did not yet apply, but was eventually foreseen, was treated under the PAS as an autonomous development.

Het verhogen van de snelheid op trajecten waar destijds nog geen 130 km/uur gold als maximumsnelheid, maar waar dit (uiteindelijk) wel was voorzien, werd in het PAS beschouwd als een autonome ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Dik-Faber en Bruins over het bericht ‘Verbreden snelwegen kan ondanks stikstofverbindingen doorgaan dankzij ‘rekentruc’ kabinet’

Three ChristenUnie MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management when decisions on seven MIRT road projects would be taken, how much nitrogen space they need under the Hordijk commission's advice, and whether decisions can be postponed until parliament debates that advice. The minister gave the planning status of the seven projects, said AERIUS remains the basis for permitting, and committed to informing parliament on AERIUS development by next summer, while stating the government aims to realise the projects quickly under a motion.
On the further development of AERIUS, the House will be informed before next summer.
Over de doorontwikkeling van AERIUS wordt de Kamer voor de zomer van volgend jaar geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het tekort aan luchtverkeersleiders op Eindhoven Airport en Groningen Eelde Airport

MPs Paternotte and Bruins asked the minister about air traffic controller shortages at Eindhoven, Groningen Eelde and Maastricht airports, and about accelerating integration of military and civilian air traffic control. The minister acknowledged staffing shortages and outlined recruitment and harmonisation steps, but declined to speed up integration and said reassignment of controllers to other airports is not currently feasible.
Accelerating the full integration, planned for the third quarter of 2023, is not possible given the scale and necessary care of the integration process.
Een versnelling van de volledige integratie, die voorzien is in het derde kwartaal van 2023, is niet mogelijk gegeven de omvang en noodzakelijke zorgvuldigheid van het integratie proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Kröger en Paternotte over de stikstofberekeningen 2014 Lelystad Airport

MPs Bruins, Kröger and Paternotte asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the 2014 nitrogen deposition calculations for Lelystad Airport's environmental impact report (MER) were corrected, covering routes, study area, time units, deposition summation and software. The minister answered in detail, attributing the discrepancies to a units error, an enlarged study area, a summation error on a computer system, and stating that the corrected deposition is at most 0.4 mol/ha/year and that the result files have been made public under the Wob.
This correction led to an increase in emissions by a factor of 5 (rounded).
Dit herstel heeft geleid tot een toename van de emissies met een factor 5 (afgerond).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Wiersma, Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht 'NWO lijkt haar jonge onderzoekers te zijn vergeten'

Four MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the government will protect Rubicon fellows researching abroad whose projects were delayed by the COVID-19 crisis and who fall outside Dutch institutions' support measures. The minister answered that a limited earmarked amount of up to 20 million euros will be allocated to NWO via a policy rule for researchers in the final phase of temporary contracts, while declining to commit additional funds from her own budget and noting the number of affected fellows is not yet known.
However, I will give NWO a general directive in the form of a policy rule of up to 20 million euros, to be deducted from the next funding round of the National Science Agenda.
Wel zal ik NWO een [algemene] aanwijzing geven in de vorm van een beleidsregel van maximaal € 20 miljoen, in mindering te brengen op de volgende financieringsronde van de Nationale Wetenschapsagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Onderwijs is failliet’

ChristenUnie MPs asked whether planned education cuts on Curaçao (a further 18% for special education on top of 12.5% wage cuts) follow from Dutch crisis-support conditions, and whether a proper impact analysis, equal funding and governance improvements are in place. The State Secretary replied that no cuts have been decided, the 12.5% wage reduction is a Curaçao-determined measure rather than a specific education demand, and a joint review of education governance and financing will precede any reforms.
The reforms in education proposed by the Netherlands will start with a thorough, joint review of the current state of education, which will also examine governance and financing.

De door Nederland voorgestelde hervormingen in het onderwijs starten met een gedegen, gezamenlijke doorlichting van de huidige staat van het onderwijs, waarbij ook gekeken zal worden naar de governance en de financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Omtzigt, van Weyenberg en Bruins over het bericht ‘Storing Belastingdienst: ondernemers krijgen week extra voor btw-aangifte’

MPs asked whether the Tax Authority's portal outage on 31 July 2020 justified a general extension and no fines for late VAT returns and payments. The state secretary confirmed the outage and the extension to 7 August, with fines waived under existing policy and the Covid emergency measures.
That is correct; between 30 July 23:35 and 31 July 14:15 it was not possible to submit VAT returns online because the MijnBelastingdienst/Zakelijk portal was unavailable.
Dat klopt, tussen 30 juli 23:35 uur en 31 juli 14:15 uur was het niet mogelijk btw-aangiften in te dienen via internet omdat het betreffende portaal MijnBelastingdienst/Zakelijk onbereikbaar was.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bruins over de berichten 'Nederland moet haast maken met groen economisch herstel na de coronacrisis' en 'We staan op een kantelpunt voor het klimaatbeleid'

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the government about green economic recovery after the COVID-19 crisis, including investment advice from the PBL, IEA, DNB and SER, hydrogen competitiveness, the CO2 levy, KLM sustainability conditions, and workforce retraining for the energy transition. The minister responded that the Klimaatakkoord forms the basis for green recovery, that additional investments via the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility and accelerated projects (about EUR 2 billion) are being prepared, and that the CO2 levy for industry proceeds from 1 January 2021 without delay.
The cabinet wants to make room for additional investments via the European Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF).
Het kabinet wil ruimte maken voor aanvullende investeringen via de Europese Recovery and Resilience Facility (RFF).
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk, Van Raan, Öztürk, Bruins, Amhaouch, Laçin, Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Brenk en Stoffer over de teststraat op Schiphol

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Schiphol COVID-19 test facility should be scaled up and extended to match arrivals from orange-code countries such as Spain and France, and whether all travellers from those areas could be tested on arrival at Dutch airports. The answer, sent via a letter from Minister De Jonge, refers to the broader testing and tracing letter and does not address the specific questions.

The written questions from the eleven MPs to the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, submitted 27 August 2020, have been answered by a letter titled 'Testing and tracing: together strategically combating the Corona pandemic'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kröger (GroenLinks), Paternotte (D66), Gijs van Dijk (PvdA), Van Raan (PvdD), Öztürk (Denk), Bruins (ChristenUnie), Amhaouch (CDA), Laçin (SP), Van Kooten-Arissen (Van Kooten-Arissen), Van Brenk (50PLUS) en Stoffer (SGP) aan de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat ingezonden 27 augustus 2020, zijn beantwoord middels brief «Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat het Pax Christi College in Druten voornemens is om de huidige techniekprofielen vanaf het schooljaar 2021 te laten vervallen

An MP asks whether the Minister will protect technical vocational (vmbo) profiles at Pax Christi College in Druten, which plans to replace them with a single profile, and how this fits the government's funding for technical education. The Minister answers that the school's plan is a local and regional choice, that technical electives can remain, that regional Sterk Techniekonderwijs plans cover the area, and that a reverse-efficiency test was considered but a stronger accountability duty for school boards needs further study.
The Mondial College in Nijmegen offers the PIE and BWI profiles.
Het Mondial College in Nijmegen biedt de profielen PIE en BWI aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over het bericht ’Groningen Airport Eelde soms dicht door tekort luchtverkeersleiders’

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the minister whether Groningen Airport Eelde is sometimes closed due to a shortage of air traffic controllers, whether a medical flight was cancelled, and how controller capacity is distributed across airports. The minister denies closures and cancellations on the ground, acknowledges tight staffing at GAE and Maastricht, and says LVNL has adequate staff during official opening hours and will keep monitoring the situation.
That is not correct. Air Traffic Control Netherlands (LVNL) makes agreements with Groningen Airport Eelde (GAE) and other parties concerned about the services provided at the airport.
Dat klopt niet. Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland (LVNL) maakt samen met Groningen Airport Eelde (GAE) en andere betrokken partijen afspraken over de dienstverlening op de luchthaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld,Kwint, Gijs van Dijk, Bruins en Postma over het bericht 'Grootste Nederlandse kinderopvangbedrijf zit fiscaal op de Kaaimaneilanden'

MPs from five parties asked whether the largest Dutch childcare company, owned via investment funds in the Cayman Islands, is permissible, whether public money leaks to tax havens, and whether ownership rules should change. The Secretary of State answered that childcare quality rules apply regardless of ownership, cited existing anti-avoidance measures, declined to confirm specific dividend flows citing tax secrecy, and rejected extra ownership restrictions.
To the extent information is known to the Tax Authority, the cabinet cannot, under the statutory tax confidentiality duty, confirm or deny which payments an individual taxpayer makes and to whom.

Voor zover hierover informatie bij de Belastingdienst bekend is, kan het kabinet op grond van de wettelijke fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht bevestigen noch ontkennen welke betalingen door een individuele belastingplichtige worden gedaan en aan wie dat gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Bruins over veilige evenementen

MPs Schonis and Bruins asked why event organisers cannot obtain permits for safe events such as drive-in venues under the general ban, and why Dutch rules differ from Germany and Denmark. The minister replied that the ban was lifted from 1 July, that local authorities now decide case by case, and that economic support schemes exist, but declined to give a detailed rationale for why safe events were not permitted earlier.
It is up to the local authorities to determine whether organisers can adequately arrange their activity at 1.5 metres and meet the other applicable measures.

Het is aan de lokale autoriteiten om te bepalen of organisatoren hun activiteit voldoende op anderhalve meter in kunnen richten en tevens aan andere van toepassing zijnde maatregelen kan worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Paternotte en Kröger over het rapport Evaluatie stikstofberekeningen Lelystad Airport (advies 3456) van de Commissie voor de m.e.r. d.d. 31 maart 2020

Three MPs asked the ministers whether AERIUS applies SRM2 to road traffic deposition and OPS to other sectors, and why SRM2 is cut off at 5 km, given the Commission's evaluation and TNO's 2015 audit. The minister confirmed the SRM2/OPS split and defended the 5 km cut-off as consistent with the NSL tool and past Raad van State acceptance, while promising a broader cabinet response after the summer.

The cabinet will come after the summer with a more extensive substantive cabinet response to both the final advice of the Nitrogen Problem Advisory Committee and the final report of the Nitrogen Measurement and Calculation Advisory Committee.

Het kabinet komt na de zomer met een uitgebreidere inhoudelijke kabinetsreactie op zowel het eindadvies van het Adviescollege Stikstofproblematiek als het eindrapport van het Adviescollege Meten en Berekenen Stikstof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over veiligheidsmaatregelen voor vliegtuigpassagiers en -personeel

MPs Paternotte, Diertens and Bruins asked about aircraft transmission risks of COVID-19 (drawing on SARS-1 evidence), EASA/ECDC guidance, and whether the OMT should advise on flying. Minister De Jonge answered that protocols were drafted by the sector based on RIVM advice, measures are indefinite, evidence on in-flight transmission is limited, and the OMT has not been asked but RIVM has advised twice.
On the basis of existing literature, no sound comparison can be made between transmission of SARS-CoV-1 and SARS-CoV-2 on aircraft.
Er kan op basis van bestaande literatuur geen goed vergelijk worden gemaakt tussen overdracht van SARS-CoV-1 en SARS-CoV-2 in vliegtuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Bruins over een mogelijke Europese ‘NASA’ waarin onderzoekinstituten op het gebied van luchtvaart nauwer samenwerken

MPs Amhaouch and Bruins asked the minister about a proposed European 'NASA' for aviation research institutes and related funding, decarbonisation and hydrogen engines. The minister answered that existing cooperation (ACARE, EREA, Horizon programmes) suffices, sees no need for a merged European institute, and outlined funding and innovation expectations without concrete new commitments.
I currently see no reason to pursue within Europe a merger of all those research institutes into one organisation.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om binnen Europa in te zetten op een samenvoeging van al die onderzoekinstituten in één organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Bruins en Van Raan over het basisjaar van CORSIA

Four MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether moving CORSIA's baseline year to 2019, possibly delaying offsetting obligations until 2023, is desirable given climate goals, and what the Dutch position is. The Minister answered that Netherlands prefers keeping the current baseline, treats baseline change as a fallback, that the Council decision is only a negotiating mandate, and that the 2019 baseline would be evaluated in 2022.
The starting point for the Netherlands is preserving the current ambition.
Het uitgangspunt voor Nederland is behoud van de huidige ambitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Bruins, Van Raan en Stoffer over het basisjaar voor CORSIA

MPs from GroenLinks, D66, ChristenUnie, PvdD and SGP asked whether the Netherlands agreed to move the CORSIA baseline to 2019, how that fits earlier ambitious commitments, and why the government did not follow a motion requiring coordination with the House. The minister denied agreeing to a baseline change, saying the EU instruction only allows adjustment if needed to preserve global support, and promised to inform the House of further developments.
Of course I will keep the House continuously informed about new developments.
Uiteraard zal ik de Kamer blijvend informeren over nieuwe ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Snels en Bruins over de maatregelen om handelsstromen op gang te houden

MPs Sneller, Snels and Bruins asked how the COVID-19 export credit insurance (ekv) relaxation measures were designed, including their composition of the Rijkscommissie, links to debt relief, green transition, and fossil-fuel financing, and whether France's approach should be followed. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered substantively on most points, stating the measures are temporary, open to all sectors, additional to the private market, and that the government will pursue greening of ekv internationally without committing to a fossil-fuel phase-out scenario.
The cabinet will study with interest the French report focusing on scenarios for a full stop of ekv coverage for fossil-fuel-related projects.

Het kabinet zal het Franse rapport dat zich concentreert op scenario's voor volledige stopzetting van dekkingsmogelijkheden vanuit de ekv voor fossiel-gerelateerde projecten met belangstelling bestuderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Bruins over religie en seksualiteit in een online lesmethode voor burgerschapsonderwijs in het mbo

MPs Van den Berge and Bruins asked the Minister of Education about stereotyping questions on religion and sexuality in an online civic education method for MBO, and about oversight and development of such materials. The Minister said civic education should foster critical thinking, that schools choose their own methods within legal requirements, that the Inspectorate checks quality of civic education but not materials in general, and that no ministry role in developing materials is planned.
It is up to the school itself to decide how civic education is shaped and which teaching method is used.
Het is daarnaast aan de school zelf om te beslissen hoe het burgerschapsonderwijs wordt vormgegeven en welke lesmethode hierbij wordt gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Bruins over het bericht dat arbeidsmigranten met hun baan ook hun bed kwijt raken

MPs Van Dijk and Bruins asked the ministers whether the government would prevent employers from evicting migrant workers who lose their jobs and charge excessive rent for housing. The minister answered that the NOW scheme encourages keeping staff employed, that housing charges are capped by law, that a task force on migrant worker protection has been set up, and that no data exists on how many workers lost housing.
There is currently no data available on the basis of which I can make concrete statements about the number of migrant workers affected by the crisis.
Er zijn echter op dit moment geen data beschikbaar op basis waarvan ik concrete uitspraken kan doen over de aantallen arbeidsmigranten die zijn getroffen door de crisis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk en Bruins over het bericht in The Guardian ‘Heathrow third runway ruled illegal over climate change’

Three MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the UK Court of Appeal ruling that Heathrow's third runway plan was unlawful under climate commitments affects Dutch aviation policy, including CO2 assessment in environmental impact reports for Schiphol and Lelystad Airport and progress on the sector's emissions targets. The minister answered that the Netherlands is bound by the Paris Agreement, that the UK ruling concerns UK law and is not for the Dutch government to judge, that CO2 from landing and take-off cycles is assessed in the Lelystad and Schiphol reports, and that the sector's targets and the Sustainable Aviation Roundtable process are still being developed.
It is not for me to form a judgement on the ruling of the British judge and on whether it is appropriate and desirable.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te vormen over de uitspraak van de Britse rechter en in hoeverre deze al dan niet passend en wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Van der Graaf over het weigeren door Knab van religieuze organisaties als zakelijke klant

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked whether Knab's policy of refusing religious organisations as business clients complies with Dutch and European anti-discrimination and anti-money-laundering rules, and what can be done for those affected. The government answered that the Wwft does not allow refusing a whole category of clients without an individual risk assessment, that assessing discrimination is not for the cabinet, and that affected organisations can use the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, anti-discrimination bodies, courts or Kifid.
Under the Wwft, banks are not permitted to refuse an entire type of organisation as a client across the board.
Het is banken op grond van de Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme (Wwft) niet toegestaan om een bepaald type organisatie integraal als klant te weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Bruins over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

MPs Van der Graaf and Bruins asked about the effects of the coronavirus crisis on sex workers, including exit programmes, income support, closure rules, online advertising, and shelter. The government answered that exit demand is being monitored, that municipalities bear responsibility for shelter and most support, and that it advises against forcing websites to block physical-service advertising.
In parallel, I have asked the RUPS organisations about the requests for help they have received since the start of the coronavirus crisis and the nature of these requests.
Parallel daaraan heb ik bij de Rups-organisaties een uitvraag gedaan naar de hulpvragen die zij sinds het begin van de coronacrisis ontvangen en wat de aard is van deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Deventer sluit 'monsterdeal' voor bouw XXL-distributiecentrum'

MPs Bruins and Amhaouch asked about the planned XXL distribution centre in Deventer, covering jobs, housing for migrant workers, infrastructure, landscape impact, vacancy risk and the status of a motion on logistics sprawl. The state secretary answered that the buyer is also the user, that 300-350 jobs are expected, and that the national spatial vision will address warehouse sprawl, with the motion response to follow in spring.
The cabinet will return to this in the Spring Letter regarding the further choices in the National Environment and Planning Vision.
Het kabinet komt hier op terug in de Voorjaarsbrief met betrekking tot de nadere keuzes in de Nationale Omgevingsvisie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palland, Amhaouch, Wiersma, Verhoeven, Bruins, Gijs van Dijk, Van Kent en Stoffer over het aangekondigde massaontslag bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs asked the government about the announced loss of 750 jobs at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, a new Hungarian plant that received subsidies, and whether EU state aid rules were breached, and whether the government would press the Commission or the company. The minister replied that the Commission judged the Hungarian aid compatible with the internal market, saw no reason to contact the Commission or Hungary, said there were no prior warnings of reorganisation in contacts with the owner and the Enschede management, and left the social plan to the company while pointing to a regional deal.
Should further study of the case give cause for it, I will bring this to the attention of the Commission and my colleagues involved.
Mocht er na verdere bestudering van de casus aanleiding toe zijn dan zal ik dat bij de Commissie en mijn collega's die hierbij zijn betrokken onder de aandacht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Bruins over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

MPs Van der Graaf and Bruins asked about the impact of the COVID-19 crisis on people in prostitution, including which guidelines apply to various sex work sectors, income support, exit programmes and housing. The State Secretary answered that emergency ordinances close brothels, window prostitution, sex clubs and sex theatres while street work, escort, home prostitution and porn are not covered, that self-employed sex workers may qualify for a temporary income scheme run by municipalities, and that exit-programme capacity will be reviewed after the crisis.

I am willing, after the peak of the coronavirus crisis, to examine whether there is a significantly higher inflow of clients into the exit programmes, and whether more funds are needed and can become available.
Ik ben bereid na de piek van de coronacrisis te bezien of er significant hogere toestroom van cliënten bij de uitstapprogramma's is, en of er meer middelen nodig zijn en beschikbaar kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins en Voordewind over het bericht ‘F-35 mag straks laagvliegen over oostelijk Fryslân’

MPs Bruins and Voordewind asked whether the government will reopen the Linkroute-10A low-flying route over eastern Friesland for F-35s, whether Friesland was involved, whether a nature permit is needed and whether alternatives were studied. The State Secretary for Defence answered that there is currently no reason to reopen the route, that a permit and ecological analysis are still being prepared, that alternatives abroad are being examined, and promised a decision by 1 June 2020.
At the consultation on 18 February I promised the House to provide clarity on the future of Linkroute-10A by 1 June 2020.
Tijdens het VAO op 18 februari heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd om voor 1 juni 2020 duidelijkheid te bieden over de toekomst van de Linkroute-10A.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch en Bruins over ongewenste effecten van de werking van historische rechten op slots in relatie tot de disruptie veroorzaakt door het coronavirus (IATA r

MPs asked whether the minister would press the European Commission to suspend slot 'use-it-or-lose-it' rules for 2020 at the request of IATA, given coronavirus disruption to air travel and the risk of empty flights. The minister agreed in principle, said the Commission would be asked to extend the existing waiver for the summer season and widen it to all severely affected countries, but declined to provide load-factor data citing commercial confidentiality.

I have asked the European Commission to extend its current waiver of the slot rules for preserving historic rights for the IATA winter season 2019/2020 in connection with the coronavirus into the upcoming IATA summer season

Ik heb de Europese Commissie verzocht om haar huidige ontheffing van de slotregels ten behoeve van het behoud van historische rechten voor het IATA winterseizoen 2019/2020 in verband met het coronavirus te verlengen voor het aankomend IATA zomerseizoen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Laçin en Kröger over Emissieregistratie

MPs Bruins, Laçin and Kröger asked whether aviation emissions above 3,000 feet must be reported as a memo item under the NEC Directive, and whether the Netherlands has reported them. The minister answered that such emissions fall outside the Directive's scope and need not be reported, so the Netherlands has complied.
The Netherlands has not reported aviation emissions above 3,000 feet, which the Directive also does not require.
Nederland heeft de emissies van de luchtvaart boven de 3.000 voet niet gerapporteerd, hetgeen op grond van de richtlijn ook niet verplicht is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de vindbaarheid van artikel 2.82 aanbestedingen op TenderNed

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether reserved public contracts under Article 2.82 of the Aanbestedingswet are hard to find on TenderNed and whether a search filter or notifications should be added. The government says search terms and notifications already work, that a dedicated filter is not useful because private platforms are not visible to TenderNed, and it will promote social procurement via PIANOo and other channels.
A search filter specific to reserved contracts would therefore only show reserved contracts created on TenderNed and would thus miss its purpose.
Een zoekfilter specifiek voor voorbehouden opdrachten zal daarom alleen de voorbehouden opdrachten die op TenderNed worden aangemaakt weergeven en daarom zijn doel missen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins, Sienot en Lodders over het bericht dat de prijs van elektriciteit van snelladers wordt verhoogd naar 79 cent/kWH voor passanten

MPs asked whether the government will investigate market power and cartel formation among fast-charger operators after Ionity raised guest charging prices to 79 cent/kWh, and whether a maximum price should be set. The government answered that ACM is independent and has heightened attention for the sector, that the market is open and competitive, and that a maximum price is not currently under consideration.
The Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is an independent regulator.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Omtzigt over eHerkenning

Two MPs (Bruins and Omtzigt) asked the government about eHerkenning, the electronic login required for tax filing by legal entities, including whether foreign organisations, churches and small entities are excluded and whether the rollout is legally and availability-wise sound. The State Secretary answered at length, largely defending the scheme, outlining workarounds for excluded groups and promising a study on availability and interim reports before summer, while not answering all questions one by one.
Due to the care required in answering, and the need for further coordination with the Minister of BZK, it proved not feasible to answer these questions one by one and by 31 January 2020.

In verband met de zorgvuldigheid van de beantwoording, waarvoor ook nadere afstemming met de Minister van BZK noodzakelijk was, is het niet haalbaar gebleken om deze vragen één voor één en voor 31 januari 2020 te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het op te stellen milieueffectrapport voor Schiphol

MP Bruins asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the environmental impact report (MER) for Schiphol at 500,000 flight movements is being prepared and which reference situation and date should apply, given the last formally adopted LVB dates from 2002. The minister confirms work is ongoing, points to pending additional deposition research and an open enforcement request to LNV on the reference year, and refers to the NRD for scope without committing to the reference date the MP proposes.

In this regard, as also stated above, the reference year to be used for this calculation is the subject of the enforcement request regarding Schiphol that the Ministry of LNV, as competent authority under the Nature Conservation Act, has received.

Hierbij geldt, zoals hierboven ook staat aangegeven, dat het te hanteren referentiejaar voor deze berekening onderwerp is van het handhavingsverzoek met betrekking tot Schiphol dat het Ministerie van LNV, als bevoegd gezag voor de Wet natuurbescherming, heeft gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Rog en Bisschop over het bericht “Bijzonder onderwijs furieus over intieme vragen bij inspectiebezoek”

MPs Bruins, Rog and Bisschop asked the minister about inspectors allegedly asking intimate questions of pupils during unannounced visits to about eighty schools for a thematic study of teaching materials. The minister replied that the Inspectorate acts independently, that the study is thematic stelseltoezicht with a broad sample, that unannounced visits are a legitimate instrument, and that the Inspectorate denies that intimate or personal questions were asked, with no complaints received.
The Inspectorate does not recognise the picture painted in the article you cite.
De inspectie herkent het beeld dat wordt geschetst in het door u aangehaalde artikel niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over de correctiebrief op de brief Luchtvaart van 15 oktober

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the minister, after a correction letter on Lelystad Airport noise calculations, whether the noise appendices underlying the MER were externally validated, and how atmospheric attenuation and screening were handled. The minister answered that the appendices were not based on the original unvalidated 1990s versions, that external validation was done for Lelystad inputs by To70 and Adecs and a counter-expertise by dBvision, and refused to commission further independent validation of the appendices on attenuation and screening.
Findings are fed back by the validating firm to the NLR, which incorporates them into a definitive version of the (amended) appendices.
Bevindingen worden door het bureau dat de validatie uitvoert teruggekoppeld aan het NLR, dat de bevindingen vervolgens verwerkt in een definitieve versie van (de wijziging van) de appendices.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte en Bruins over het artikel 'Vliegveld Lelystad onveiliger door komst luchtverkeersleiding'

MPs Kröger, Paternotte and Bruins asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of two near-collisions at Lelystad Airport after air traffic control arrived, and whether aviation safety has worsened. The minister answered that the incidents are being investigated, that monitoring is ongoing, that the route design meets international standards, and that the airport will only open to commercial traffic once the break-in period is complete, without committing to new independent investigation.
There is no reason for additional investigation.
Er is dus geen aanleiding voor aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Kröger en Paternotte over het bericht 'Vliegers Lelystad slaan alarm'

MPs Bruins, Kröger and Paternotte asked about reports that general aviation firms at Lelystad Airport face job losses and forced flight cuts, and whether the cost-benefit analysis accounts for them. The minister denies that 300 jobs are at risk or that flights will be halved, says at most 30 jobs could move, and states the MKBA was done from a national perspective with job figures of about 2,000 direct jobs at the airport.
There is no question of halving the number of aircraft movements or of 300 jobs being at risk.
Van de halvering van het aantal vliegtuigbewegingen of 300 banen die op de tocht zouden staan is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht 'Kleine winkeliers moeten gedwongen verhuizen voor uitbreiding Sterrenburg'

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that small shopkeepers in Sterrenburg must relocate for a shopping centre expansion, raising rent, contract and Sunday-opening rights. The State Secretary says the landlord must offer reasonable alternative premises, rent is subject to negotiation and courts decide disputes, and announces a bill giving shopkeepers consent rights over changed opening hours.
I am currently preparing a bill that protects shopkeepers against being confronted with changes to opening hours they have not explicitly agreed to.

Ik bereid op dit moment een wetsvoorstel voor dat winkeliers beschermt tegen situaties waarbij ze geconfronteerd worden met een wijziging van openingstijden waarmee ze niet nadrukkelijk hebben ingestemd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Bosman, Kerstens, Bruins, Voordewind en Stoffer over de berichtgeving ‘Nieuwe onderzeeboten: Nederlandse marine-industrie dreigt alleen kruimels te krijgen’

MPs from several parties asked the Defence, Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about press reports that the Dutch naval shipbuilding industry risks getting only scraps from the new submarine order, and about risks to knowledge retention, intellectual property, competition and the Defence Industry Strategy. The government answered at length, largely restating its procurement approach: competitive selection under Article 346 TFEU, IP and maintenance guarantees to be negotiated in the next phase, and no decision yet on a single preferred bidder.
As I stated in the B-letter, I will implement the Bruins Slot et al. motion.
Zoals ik in de B-brief heb vermeld zal ik uitvoering geven aan de motie Bruins Slot c.s.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Schiphol is niet de enige: ook 5 andere Nederlandse vliegvelden missen natuurvergunning’

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the minister, after reports that five other Dutch airports lack nature permits, how use permits relate to other required permits such as nature permits, and about the permitting history of Rotterdam, Lelystad and Maastricht airports. The minister answered that operators bear responsibility for obtaining other permits, that the ministry does not verify them, and that the Ministry of LNV is the competent authority for nature permits and handhavingsverzoeken, while promising to inform parliament further on the motion on high-altitude nitrogen emissions.
It is the responsibility of the operator to apply for these.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de exploitant om deze aan te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht ‘Qatar Airways operates 9-minute flights between Maastricht and Liège’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported 9-minute Qatar Airways cargo flights between Maastricht and Liège and whether such short cargo flights should be banned. The minister confirmed the flights, said there are no other comparable cases, said the route choice is commercial, and stated that short cargo flights are undesirable from an environmental view but that no legal instrument to ban them exists, so the government will only encourage rail/road alternatives where realistic.
The Cabinet is working to encourage the use of ground transport as an alternative to air travel on routes where that is realistic.
Het Kabinet zet zich in om het gebruik van grondvervoer als alternatief voor luchtvaart te stimuleren op routes waarvoor dat reëel is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Bruins over uitbuiting van arbeidsmigranten

MPs Van Dijk and Bruins asked the Minister of Social Affairs about exploitation of labour migrants, including whether Polish-registered firms bring non-EU workers to the Netherlands and whether cross-border posting rules should be tightened. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to the Wab, the Europese Arbeidsautoriteit and planned regulatory reviews, but said the free movement of services limits restrictions on work permits.
I share Mr Elzinga's view that avoiding taxes and social premiums, through sham constructions or otherwise, must be tackled.
Ik deel de mening van de heer Elzinga dat het ontwijken van belastingen en sociale premies – via schijnconstructies of anderszins – moet worden aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Bruins over leegloop en braindrain in Oost-Europa

MPs Van Dijk and Bruins asked the Minister of Social Affairs about labour emigration and brain drain from Eastern Europe, citing a World Bank warning, and whether rich countries should refrain from recruiting workers and what the EU is doing about it. The minister acknowledged the World Bank's concerns but defended free movement as a fundamental right, said member states should improve conditions at home and that the EU has no coordinated response yet, promising to raise the issue within the European Semester.

At present there is no coordinated European effort in this area, but it is clear that if brain drain is seen as a serious problem in a growing number of member states, it must also be explored at European level how to address this challenge.

Op dit moment bestaat er geen gecoördineerde Europese inzet op dit gebied, maar duidelijk is wel dat als braindrain in een groeiend aantal lidstaten als een ernstig probleem wordt gezien, ook op Europees niveau verkend moet worden hoe aan deze uitdaging het hoofd geboden kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht ‘Schiphol heeft al jaren geen natuurvergunning: '100.000 vluchten illegaal'’

MPs Paternotte and Bruins asked whether Schiphol lacks a nature permit under the Wet natuurbescherming, how NOx from flights is calculated, which Natura 2000 areas are unaffected, and whether a 2008 growth decision and flight increases required an appropriate assessment under the Habitats Directive. The minister answers that Schiphol has no Wnb permit because the framework predates the 2004 reference date, that a new nitrogen recalculation and MER are pending, and that the LVB procedure is ongoing, with the enforcement question referred to LNV.

The Ministry of LNV, as the competent authority under the Wet natuurbescherming, received an enforcement request concerning Schiphol and the question of whether, and to what extent, Schiphol must hold a Wnb permit.

Het Ministerie van LNV heeft, als bevoegd gezag voor de Wet natuurbescherming, een handhavingsverzoek gekregen met betrekking tot Schiphol en de vraag of, en zo ja, in hoeverre Schiphol over een Wnb-vergunning dient te beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Amhaouch en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Schiphol is niet de enige: ook 5 andere Nederlandse vliegvelden missen natuurvergunning’

MPs Bruins, Amhaouch and Paternotte asked whether five regional Dutch airports lack the nature permit (natuurvergunning) for their activities, and what that means for their operation. The minister answered that four of the airports have no Wnb permit while Groningen Eelde has a 2009 permit, that enforcement requests are pending at the Ministry of LNV, and that she will not anticipate those outcomes, referring to the environmental impact assessments and prior decisions for each airport.
These enforcement requests have been taken up by the Minister of LNV, the competent authority under the Wnb, and are being handled under the usual procedure.
Deze handhavingsverzoeken zijn door de Minister van LNV, het bevoegd gezag voor de Wnb, in behandeling genomen en worden volgens de gebruikelijke procedure afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Paternotte, Amhaouch en Remco Dijkstra over het gestaakte overleg tussen het ministerie en Noord-Veluwse gemeenten over vliegroutevarianten

MPs asked why the Noord-Veluwe municipalities stopped consultation on Lelystad Airport flight-route variants, and whether any variant avoids overflying the largest towns. The minister rejects the claim of a stopped consultation, says the variants do reduce overflown residents, and states a preference for route variant N for runway 23, though the document is cut off before its final answers are complete.
There is therefore no question of a halt to the consultation.
Van het staken van overleg is dan ook geen sprake.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Raan, Laçin, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Bruins, Stoffer en Van Brenk over  het  bericht 'L’UE refuse d’abandonner sa souveraineté sur  les émissions de CO2 de l’aviation'.

Eight MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a report that the EU refuses to give up sovereignty over aviation CO2 emissions, and about the Dutch position and a draft ICAO resolution making CORSIA the only permitted global aviation emissions system. The minister confirmed Dutch support for the EU line, said the Netherlands will enter a reservation if the text could limit EU climate measures (including via the EU ETS), and said a kerosene excise is a fiscal measure outside the resolution's scope.

At the same time, the Netherlands will make a reservation against texts in the final resolution if they could politically limit the freedom in Europe to take the measures needed to achieve the climate goals.

Tegelijkertijd zal Nederland een voorbehoud maken tegen teksten in de uiteindelijke resolutie, wanneer die politiek gezien een beperking zouden kunnen betekenen van de vrijheid om in Europa de maatregelen te nemen die nodig zijn om de klimaatdoelstellingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Uber verhuist van Bermuda naar Nederland om winstbelasting’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Uber is moving its intellectual property from Bermuda to the Netherlands for tax reasons, including whether a ruling guarantees annual tax deductions and how this fits the coalition agreement. The State Secretary declined to discuss Uber's individual tax position under AWR article 67, explained the general arm's-length and ruling framework, and pointed to planned anti-avoidance measures without committing to any new action on this case.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot comment on the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 AWR kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Omtzigt over het bericht dat er geen deal is tussen Belastingdienst en Uber over een aftrekpost

MPs Bruins and Omtzigt asked whether the Tax Authority had communicated with the press about whether a ruling on a deduction exists with Uber, and asked for a reply within a week. The State Secretary declined to confirm or deny the existence of any ruling, citing the tax confidentiality duty in article 67 AWR, and said he had no reason to think that duty was breached.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act, it is not permitted to disclose information about the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op basis van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake Rijksbelastingen is het niet toegestaan informatie over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over het rapport Actualisatie AEOLUS 2018 en geactualiseerde luchtvaartprognoses

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the minister about the Lelystad Airport MER update, including the use of Doc29 versus the Dutch NRM noise model, noise-table conditions, and whether the MER is conservative enough. The minister answered each question, arguing that NRM is the statutory method for regional airports, that Doc29 is not yet implemented there, and that the MER uses realistic assumptions with sensitivity and worst-case analyses, without committing to changes.
The ANP database contains noise data for a large number of aircraft, including most of the Boeing and Airbus fleet.
De ANP-database bevat geluidsgegevens voor een groot aantal toestellen, waaronder het grootste deel van de vloot van Boeing en Airbus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Özdil over het bericht ‘RIVM en CBS: psychische gezondheid jongeren achteruit in afgelopen tien jaar’

MPs Bruins and Özdil asked the ministers about a RIVM/CBS report showing declining mental health among young people, and about student stress, the leenstelsel link, waiting times for student psychologists and prevention. The minister acknowledged the concern, announced a large-scale RIVM follow-up study expected by late 2020, and said the ministries will coordinate, while several questions on causes, waiting times and the leenstelsel link were answered only in outline.
I am aware of the results of the research.
Ik ben bekend met de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over het rapport Actualisatie AEOLUS 2018 en geactualiseerde luchtvaartprognoses

Two opposition MPs (Bruins and Paternotte) asked the minister whether the Lelystad Airport noise assessments used an outdated calculation model (NRM rather than Doc29), questioning the commitment to the most current insights. The minister answered that the calculations used the legally prescribed method, that Doc29 is not yet legally available for regional airports, and that no new noise maps are required for Lelystad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Tien jaar Bel-me-niet Register, het werkt voor geen meter.’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the failure of the Bel-me-niet register, the ACM's enforcement against telemarketers, and protection of self-employed people, and asks whether an opt-in register should be introduced. The State Secretary responds that register numbers are high, that the system will move to opt-in with the register disappearing, that enforcement difficulties are acknowledged with new rules planned, and that an opt-in regime makes a separate Bel-me-wel register unnecessary.
I intend to ensure better enforcement possibilities in the new regulations, which are now being prepared.
Ik ben voornemens om in de nieuwe regelgeving, die nu in voorbereiding is te zorgen voor betere handhavingsmogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins en Lodders over de doorrekeningen van de subsidie op elektrische auto’s

MPs Omtzigt, Bruins and Lodders asked why PBL's expert reviewers of the Klimaatakkoord analysis could not see the mobility and electricity background documents, why the Revnext calculations were not shared sooner, and how national costs per tonne of CO2 saved differ from the government-perspective costs used by the Algemene Rekenkamer. The state secretary answered that PBL published all background documents after the reviews, that the government will send Revnext calculations and later its own positioning analyses once the Klimaatakkoord is final, and that national costs for electric driving are roughly zero by 2030 while transfers like subsidies are excluded.
It is desirable that background documents become available as soon as possible.
Het is wenselijk dat achtergronddocumenten zo snel mogelijk beschikbaar komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Dik-Faber over de berichten ‘NBA bezorgd over daling aantal oob-kantoren’ en ‘Woningcorporaties worden al streng genoeg gecontroleerd’

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Finance and Interior ministers about NBA concerns that the number of accountancy firms licensed to audit public-interest entities (oob) is falling, and about extending that status to large housing corporations. The minister answers that the decline is regrettable but not yet a shortage, rejects tailored rules for small oob firms, and says the oob status for housing corporations above 5,000 units will go ahead, while promising to await the CTA recommendations on the audit market.
Applying tailored treatment for smaller oob accountancy organisations does not seem desirable to me from that point of view.
Het toepassen van maatwerk voor kleinere oob-accountantsorganisaties lijkt mij vanuit dat oogpunt niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het rapport Actualisatie AEOLUS 2018 en geactualiseerde luchtvaartprognoses

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, in 17 questions, when and how noise calculations for Dutch aviation moved from the NRM model to ECAC Doc29, how the models differ, and what the effects are for Schiphol and Lelystad. The minister answered that Doc29 is used for the Schiphol MER, is not yet available for regional airports, that most questions are answered together, and that a corrected AEOLUS report is attached.
Once the Doc29 calculation model for Schiphol is legally implemented, it will be decided whether this calculation method will also be introduced for noise calculations for other civil airports.
Zodra het Doc29 rekenmodel voor Schiphol wettelijk is geïmplementeerd, zal worden besloten of dit rekenvoorschrift ook wordt ingevoerd voor geluidberekeningen voor andere burgerluchthavens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over vliegveiligheid en vogelaanvaringen

An MP asks the minister to justify why the De Bilt weather radar, with a 5–25 km range, can be treated as representative of broadfront bird migration around Lelystad Airport's connecting routes, and to share the KLu's assessment of the analysis. The minister maintains the radar is representative because broadfront migration is roughly even across Dutch territory, cites the 2012–2017 dataset and KLu validation, and says the KLu's assessment was not put in writing but is described in the report.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Kwint over de fusie van Partou en KidsFoundation

MPs Bruins and Kwint asked about the merger of childcare providers Partou and KidsFoundation, their takeover by investment firms Onex and Waterland, and whether private equity harms public interests in childcare. The State Secretary answered that all providers must meet the Childcare Act, that the competition authority ACM reviews such mergers, that sector margins are modest, and that studies show no quality decline.
In 2017 parents reported €3.5 billion in gross childcare costs to the Tax Administration.
In 2017 hebben ouders voor € 3,5 mld aan bruto kosten voor hun kinderopvang doorgegeven aan de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Actiegroepen tegen laagvliegen willen wel, maar kunnen niet naar de rechter’

An MP asked whether the government deliberately blocked court appeals against regional airport decisions such as Lelystad Airport, and whether this breaches EU EIA rules. The minister answers that appeal to the administrative court is excluded for Lelystad but civil courts remain open, that the EIA directive does not require administrative appeal, and that the Commission correspondence will be shared confidentially.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over kindgebonden budget voor co-ouders

An MP asks the government about co-parents' access to the child-related budget (kindgebonden budget), following an Ombudsman report that the scheme does not adequately reach co-parents and that payments cannot be split like child benefit. The minister acknowledges the problems, promises a broader exploration of post-divorce allocation and information improvements, but rejects splitting the benefit between co-parents.

The cabinet response indicated that this complex implementation situation requires a solution, and that I also want to look more broadly at the design to improve the allocation of the child-related budget after a divorce.

In de kabinetsreactie is aangegeven dat deze complexe uitvoeringssituatie om een oplossing vraagt, waarbij ik ook breder naar de vormgeving wil kijken om de toekenning van het kindgebonden budget na een echtscheiding te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht ‘Aantal klachten over Eindhoven Airport stijgt sterk’

MPs Paternotte and Bruins asked about the sharp rise in noise complaints about Eindhoven Airport, whether the environmental impact assessment's runway split was breached, how the government will reduce complaints and enforce the MER, and how complaints feed into the Eindhoven Airport pilot case. The State Secretary answered that complaints rose to about 45,000 in 2018, that the MER contains no enforceable norms (the enforceable standard is the 35 Ke noise contour in the airport decree), that 63 percent of departures went south in 2018 due to wind conditions, and that route adjustments and a pilot case are underway.
The percentage of 65 to 75 percent used is therefore not a legal norm, and there is accordingly no obligation to have aircraft take off and land according to this percentage from the MER.
Het gebruikte percentage van 65 à 75 procent is dus geen wettelijke norm en er bestaat dan ook geen verplichting om vliegtuigen te laten opstijgen en landen volgens dit percentage uit de m.e.r.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels, Sneller, Bruins en Nijboer over de ING-witwasaffaire

Four MPs asked the Finance Minister whether his ministry suggested wording to DNB on its letter about the ING money-laundering case, whether it steered answers, and how ministerial responsibility for DNB is exercised. The minister answered that his officials only asked clarifying questions, that DNB decides its own wording, that he holds only system responsibility for DNB, and that he was first informed of the case on 31 August 2018.
DNB is independent in carrying out the tasks assigned to it as an independent administrative body: it judges individual cases autonomously and is not subordinate to the Minister of Finance.

DNB is onafhankelijk in de uitvoering van de taken die haar als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan zijn opgedragen: zij oordeelt zelfstandig over individuele gevallen en is niet ondergeschikt aan de Minister van Financiën.
