Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Snels en Nijboer over ING als huisbankier van de Staat

MPs Bruins, Snels and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister when he learned of legal options to terminate state contracts with ING after the money-laundering settlement, why the September letter did not explain them, and when the Chamber would be informed. The minister answered that legal options were mapped from September 2018, advice was finalised in late September, the Chamber received the analysis in earlier answers, and a further letter on additional exclusion and termination grounds was sent with this answer.

Simultaneously with answering these questions, I am informing your Chamber by letter about the possibilities of including additional exclusion grounds in new tender procedures for payment services and about additional termination grounds in contracts.

Gelijktijdig met de beantwoording van deze vragen informeer ik uw Kamer per brief over de mogelijkheden voor het opnemen van aanvullende uitsluitingsgronden bij nieuwe aanbestedingsprocedures betalingsverkeer en over aanvullende opzeggingsgronden in overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat een leerkracht van het Hoofdvaart College geschorst is wegens ’belediging profeet’

A ChristenUnie MP asked the minister about reports that a technology teacher at Hoofdvaart College was suspended after students said he insulted the prophet Mohammed, and questioned the proportionality and treatment of teachers. The minister replied that it is a time-out rather than a suspension, that the inspectorate found it a personnel matter and not a case for ministerial judgment, and that schools' boards are responsible for such decisions.
Imposing a time-out or a suspension is a matter between employer and employee.
Het opleggen van een time-out of een schorsing is een kwestie tussen werkgever en werknemer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht 'Hoge winst voor banken, extreem lage spaarrente: kan dat niet anders?'

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Finance about banks' high profits and very low savings rates, including whether banks' conduct and the ECB's negative deposit rate are consistent with capital buffers, competition and consumer choice. The Minister answered all 13 questions, arguing that low savings rates reflect market conditions, that banks' role in lending is their core task, that competition authority ACM oversees the market, and that the government will respond later to a WRR report on money and debt.
The cabinet attaches importance to competition and a diverse banking landscape.
Het kabinet hecht aan concurrentie en een divers bankenlandschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Amhaouch en Paternotte over ‘het verleggen van de laagvliegroute bij Hattemerbroek’

MPs asked the minister about a proposed rerouting of the low-flying departure route for Lelystad Airport near Hattemerbroek and Wezep, including its status, effects on the MER, affected municipalities and residents, and whether new housing was accounted for. The minister answered that no routing decision has been taken yet, that a limited route change would not affect the legal noise contours, that consultation with municipalities and residents' groups is ongoing, and that quantitative effects are still being assessed.
There is therefore no decision yet on a change of route.
Er is derhalve nog geen besluit tot een routewijziging.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Van Meenen en Rog over brieven waarin schoolleiders gewezen worden op de wettelijke verplichting om gegevens van leraren aan te leveren voor het Lerarenregister

MPs Bruins, Van Meenen and Rog asked whether letters pressing school leaders to supply teacher data for the teacher register, threatening inspection consequences, were unnecessary and whether the Inspectorate would enforce the obligation. The minister admitted the letter was incomplete and should not have been sent, promised corrective letters, and said he is discussing inspection oversight of professional development with the Inspectorate and will embed HRM policy in the law.
This letter should not have been sent in this form: the information it contains is incomplete.
Deze brief had niet in deze vorm verstuurd moeten worden: de informatie die er in staat is onvolledig.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Linde, Bruins, Stoffer, Tony van Dijck, Leijten, Baudet en Van Rooijen over de brief van de Minister van Financiën d.d. 5 februari 2019 over het op handen zijnde akkoord b

MPs asked the Finance Minister when the PEPP pension regulation would be finalised, what delegated acts it contains, whether Dutch pension rules could be affected without Dutch influence, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The minister said the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text because of the number of delegated-act powers and the EIOPA role, though the second-pillar pension system and tax rules are unaffected, and that the Chamber's view will be weighed in the vote.

As I announced in my letter of 5 February, I informed the Romanian presidency yesterday that the Netherlands cannot agree to the negotiated text of the PEPP regulation at Coreper this coming Wednesday.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 5 februari jl. heb aangekondigd, heb ik gisteren aan het Roemeense voorzitterschap kenbaar gemaakt dat Nederland op Coreper aanstaande woensdag niet kan instemmen met het onderhandelaarsakkoord inzake de PEPP-verordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Alkaya, Snels en Bruins over het bericht dat banken financiering van fossiele energie niet hebben teruggebracht

MPs from D66, SP, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the Finance Minister about reports that banks and insurers still invest far more in fossil energy than in renewables, and about the transparency and comparability of financial institutions' climate investments. The minister acknowledged the findings, pointed to DNB monitoring, the sector's climate commitment within the Klimaatakkoord, and EU sustainability disclosure work, without committing to new mandatory reporting rules.
At the request of a motion by MPs Snels and Sneller, I have asked DNB to continue monitoring the Dutch financial sector's exposures to CO2-intensive sectors.
Ik heb DNB, mede naar aanleiding van een motie van de leden Snels en Sneller 3 , gevraagd de uitzettingen van de Nederlandse financiële sector op CO 2 -intensieve sectoren te blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst gebruik gaat maken van externe inhuur voor bezwaarbehandeling bij de inkomensheffing

An MP asked whether the Tax Authority's outsourcing of objection handling for income tax to an external agency is lawful, and how independence, confidentiality and tender rules are secured. The State Secretary confirmed the temporary external hiring, said it stays under the inspector's responsibility and supervision, and listed contractual safeguards (no representation of clients against the State, confidentiality declarations, Rijks tender rules).
These staff will operate fully under the responsibility of the inspector and under the supervision of the Tax Authority.
Deze medewerkers zullen volledig onder verantwoordelijkheid van de inspecteur en onder toezicht van de Belastingdienst gaan opereren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de positie van een naast geassocieerde/zakelijk relatie van een PEP in samenhang met de wijziging van de UBO-regeling

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether under the Wwft co-owners and board members of an entity with a PEP are treated as close associates, and how far that extends to various board and ownership cases and to debtors or creditors of a PEP. The Minister confirmed that other UBOs of a PEP-linked entity are classed as known close associates, said the EU directive leaves no room to narrow this, and said the status of creditors or debtors depends on the circumstances, with institutions applying risk-based enhanced due diligence.
The directive leaves no room to narrow the scope on this point.
De richtlijn biedt geen ruimte om de reikwijdte op dit punt te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer en Snels over de ING als huisbankier van de staat

MPs Bruins, Nijboer and Snels asked the Finance Minister whether ING, the state's house bank, remained eligible in tender procedures after a recent OM transaction under article 74 of the Criminal Code, and whether this should affect future tenders. The minister answered that the transaction is not a final conviction, so no mandatory exclusion ground applies, ING may still bid, and stricter anti-money-laundering criteria will be considered in upcoming tenders, including the credit card contract and a planned reassessment before any 2020 extension.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat kinderen hun lunch soms niet op krijgen omdat er op school maar 15 minuten de tijd voor is

Bruins (ChristenUnie) asked whether short 15-minute lunch breaks under continuous-day schedules are acceptable and whether rules should change. Minister Slob replied that schools and parents decide the schedule, that schools should allow enough time to eat calmly, and that the Inspectorate provides guidance without new rules.
Schools decide, in consultation with parents, how they organise the teaching time and which school hours go with it.
Scholen bepalen, in samenspraak met de ouders, hoe zij de onderwijstijd indelen en welke schooltijden daarbij horen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘In de zoveelste onderwijsfraudezaak blijft de inspectie opvallend stil’

MP Bruins asked whether the supervisory board toetsingskader of Hanzehogeschool Groningen, which frames the board's role as a sounding board rather than supervision, adequately guarantees checks and balances, and whether the inspectorate should reopen its review. The minister defends the framework as consistent with the WHW, says the inspectorate now has full information from the reporter and will conclude within weeks, and states that further investigation may follow if warranted.
Should the information give cause for it, the inspectorate may decide to conduct further investigation.
Mocht de informatie daartoe aanleiding geven, dan kan de inspectie besluiten nader onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer en Snels over de ING als huisbankier van de staat

MPs Bruins, Nijboer and Snels asked the Finance Minister how ING's admission of structural anti-money-laundering violations fits with its role as the state's house bank, whether it meets the sustainability criteria, whether contracts can be terminated, and whether evaluation moments exist. The minister replied that the tenders were carefully drafted, ING still meets the criteria, the contract allows termination for specified breaches, and periodic review occurs, while stating a transaction under the Criminal Code offers no basis for terminating the contract.
The requirements and wishes in the tender were at the time carefully and adequately formulated.
De eisen en wensen in de aanbesteding zijn destijds zorgvuldig en adequaat geformuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het benutten van sociale ondernemingen via de Aanbestedingswet voor het creëren van banenkansen voor mensen met achterstand op de arbeidsmarkt

An MP asked the State Secretaries whether Article 2.82 of the Public Procurement Act is meant to increase employment for people far from the labour market, whether reserved contracts should be attractive to authorities, and whether seconded workers count toward the 30% threshold for reserved tenders. The government answered that Article 2.82 does aim to increase such employment, that reserved contracts are supported, and that whether seconded workers count depends on interpreting 'werknemer' and is ultimately for the courts to decide.
Whether seconded workers can be classed as employees under this article is a question of interpreting the law.
Of gedetacheerde werknemers aangemerkt kunnen worden als werknemers binnen dit artikel is een vraag naar de interpretatie van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘In de zoveelste onderwijsfraudezaak blijft de inspectie opvallend stil’

MP Bruins asked the Minister of Education about press reports that the inspectorate stayed silent on a fraud case at Hanzehogeschool Groningen, including whether the supervisory board treated its role as advisory rather than supervisory, and how a whistleblower report was handled and protected. The Minister answered that the board analysed the report and found insufficient grounds for investigation, the inspectorate agreed, a whistleblower's submission was misplaced internally and is being examined, and the inspectorate keeps whistleblower identities confidential.
The inspectorate is currently examining what went wrong when the whistleblower's submission was received and will take measures if necessary to prevent this from happening again.

De inspectie onderzoekt momenteel wat er verkeerd is gegaan bij de ontvangst van de zending van de melder en zal zo nodig maatregelen nemen om te voorkomen dat dit in de toekomst nogmaals verkeerd gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de risico’s van de sterk dalende koers van de Turkse lira

An MP asked the Finance Minister about direct and indirect credit risks for Dutch systemic banks from a collapse of Turkey's financial system, ING's and Rabobank's Turkish exposures, and lessons from Greece 2008. The minister replied that Dutch banks carry credit risk on Turkish exposures covered by capital requirements, that ING's Turkish subsidiary's exposure is about 1.8 billion euro and Rabobank's about 1.3 billion, and that EU risk-reduction measures and supervision by the ECB, DNB and SRB apply.
It is up to the supervisor to ensure that these rules are complied with.
Het is aan de toezichthouder om ervoor te zorgen dat deze regels worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Bruins over hogere reiskosten voor leerlingen door aanpassing van de scholierenlijn naar Gouda

MPs Van der Graaf and Bruins asked whether the government is aware that shortening school bus line 646/647 to Woerden would more than double travel costs for about 150 pupils travelling to Driestar College in Gouda, and whether it considers this unreasonable and will press for fare integration. The State Secretary said the matter is a regional responsibility of the province of Utrecht, that fare integration is not desirable, and that the concept transport plan will be decided by provincial executives on 11 September.
However, it is not for me to judge the reasonableness.
Het is echter niet aan mij om te oordelen over de redelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de verantwoording over het profileringsfonds door hogescholen en universiteiten

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the education minister whether combining funds for students with disabilities and student board members in one profileringsfonds is unclear, whether institutions should better communicate the fund, and why institutions do not publish required fund data. The minister defended the single fund, agreed to raise awareness and consult institutions, acknowledged non-compliant reporting, and promised to address it in a forthcoming monitor.
I find it undesirable that institutions do not publish profileringsfonds data in accordance with the Rjo.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat instellingen niet conform de Rjo gegevens rondom het profileringsfonds publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer, Snels, Van Weyenberg, Omtzigt, Lodders en Leijten over een nieuw datalek bij Mossack Fonseca

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a new Mossack Fonseca data leak, how the Tax Authority will use the data, the yield and cost of Panama Papers work, the promised business case on strengthening its information position, and staffing outflow. The State Secretary confirmed awareness, said analysis will start once the data is public, and stated that costs and yields cannot be separately tracked or directly linked, promising a broader assessment and information to parliament on Prinsjesdag 2018.

I will inform the House on Prinsjesdag 2018 to what extent additional investment in strengthening the Tax Authority's information position and enforcement capacity could benefit tax revenues and its enforcement strategy.

Ik informeer uw Kamer op Prinsjesdag 2018 in hoeverre een extra investering op het terrein van de versterking van de informatiepositie en de opsporingscapaciteit van de Belastingdienst de belastingopbrengsten en ook de handhavingstrategie van de Belastingdienst ten goede kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins, Van Weyenberg en Lodders over rulings over de dividendbelasting

MPs Omtzigt, Bruins, Van Weyenberg and Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about the full dividend-tax ruling policy of the past fifteen years, whether companies can pay dividends to zero-dividend-tax jurisdictions, how many dividend-tax rulings exist, whether they comply with law, and whether the commission examined pre-2015 rulings. The State Secretary answered that no separate ruling policy exists beyond the Verzamelbesluit, that counts of rulings were not systematically kept, that rulings are checked on procedure, and that the independent commission examined a random sample of 2017 APA/ATR rulings including some dividend-tax ones.
The number of cases in which advance certainty was given on the application of the Dividend Tax Act 1965 has not been systematically recorded over the past 15 years.
Het aantal gevallen waarin zekerheid vooraf is gegeven over de toepassing van de Wet op de dividendbelasting 1965 is niet systematisch bijgehouden in de afgelopen 15 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Financiële administratie voor velen een worsteling’

MPs Bruins and Raemakers asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a Nibud study showing many people struggle with financial administration, especially due to automatic direct debits and digital post, and asked about measures on hidden direct debits, youth support, free paper post and the debt collection register. The State Secretary answered that the findings are concerning, pointed to Nibud recommendations, existing financial literacy initiatives, and said the scope of a debt collection register is still being investigated with a further letter to follow.
I am not aware of figures on how often these direct debits lead to payment problems, accumulation of (collection) costs and debt problems.
Er zijn mij geen cijfers bekend over hoe vaak deze incasso's leiden tot betalingsproblemen, stapeling van (incasso)kosten en schuldenproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het onderzoek van het CPB “Eenverdieners onder druk”

An MP asks the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the CPB finding that the tax burden gap between single-earner and dual-earner households is widening, and about its fairness, efficiency and international position. The government answers that the individual tax system and progressivity cause the gap, that it is taking measures to lower single-earner burdens, and that it will report annually on the gap in the 2019 budget.
The cabinet will continue to pay attention to the position of single-earner households and will monitor the development of their tax burden and purchasing power.
Het kabinet blijft aandacht houden voor de positie van de eenverdiener en zal daarbij de ontwikkeling van de belastingdruk en de koopkracht van eenverdieners in het oog houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Bruins, Ziengs, Van Aalst, Baudet en Von Martels over het gebruik van werkbakken aan hijskranen bij asbestsanering

MPs asked whether the government will allow cranes with work baskets for asbestos roof removal in exceptional cases, given a sector decision system and an Aboma report criticising stricter Dutch rules. The State Secretary said a независимый study will report before summer 2018 and that a decision on any regulatory change will follow, without committing to temporary relief now.
As promised to the House, I will commission an independent study into the problems the asbestos removal contractors describe.
Ik laat, zoals aan uw Kamer is toegezegd, een onafhankelijk onderzoek uitvoeren naar de problematiek die de asbestsaneerders aangeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Pand Groningse fietsenmaker in beslag genomen om koopzondagenruzie’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary about the seizure of a Groningen bicycle shop's premises by a homeowners' association over a shop-opening dispute, questioning proportionality and the shopkeeper's legal protection. The state secretary answered that the courts decide, that the Civil Code provides enforcement tools and appeal/suspension routes, and that the planned Winkeltijdenwet amendment will strengthen the shopkeeper's position.
Our legal system contains sufficient safeguards for both parties and therefore also for the small shopkeeper.
Ons rechtssysteem bevat voldoende waarborgen voor beide partijen en dus ook voor de kleine winkelier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Bruins over het bericht ‘Verhoging geluidswal langs A20 bij Maassluis in zicht’

MPs Van der Graaf and Bruins asked about persistent noise nuisance from the A20 near Maassluis, whether Rijkswaterstaat's compliance calculations account for the 130 km/h limit, and why no mitigation has been taken. The minister answers that noise stays within the statutory production ceilings based on prescribed calculations validated by RIVM, that the municipality owns the noise wall and must initiate raising it, and that Rijkswaterstaat will then cooperate.
If the municipality takes the initiative to raise the noise wall, Rijkswaterstaat will cooperate with it.
Indien de gemeente het initiatief neemt om de geluidswal op te hogen zal Rijkswaterstaat medewerking hieraan verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Departementen blokkeren fusie van ZonMW en NWO’

MP Bruins asks why the planned merger of ZonMW into NWO was reportedly blocked by the ministries, and whether cultural differences justify stopping it. The ministers answer that the statutory integration was dropped as the wrong instrument, that the aims remain via an updated cooperation agreement from 2019, and that the transition has cost about EUR 6 million to 2017.
During the transition process we concluded that a change of law is not the right instrument to achieve this objective.
Gedurende het transitieproces zijn wij tot de conclusie gekomen dat een wetswijziging niet het juiste instrument is om deze doelstelling te realiseren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het stopzetten van de service van Octrooicentrum Nederland om oriënterende octrooiliteratuuronderzoeken uit te voeren voor de Nederlandse universiteiten en hogescholen

An MP asked why Octrooicentrum Nederland stopped offering preliminary patent literature searches to universities and universities of applied sciences, and whether this forces them to hire costly external bureaus. The minister confirmed the service was scaled back under earlier budget cuts, said institutions should build the expertise in-house, and only offered to consider whether the agency could help in the upcoming policy evaluation.

No. As part of the further professionalisation of the TTOs of universities and universities of applied sciences, I consider it important that the expertise required to carry out preliminary searches is available within the TTOs themselves.

Nee. In het kader van de verdere professionalisering van TTO's van universiteiten en hogescholen vind ik het belangrijk dat de voor het uitvoeren van oriënterende onderzoeken vereiste expertise binnen de TTO's zelf beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert en Bruins over de balansen in Target2 en de daarmee verbonden risico’s

Three MPs (Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert, Bruins) asked the Finance Minister about TARGET2 balances, financial fragmentation, possible capital flight, deposit discouragement, and whether TARGET2 should be an EU policy indicator. The minister replied that fragmentation persists but is declining, that the current balances stem from ECB asset purchases rather than capital flight, that discouraging deposits is undesirable, and that the government works on EU reforms to reduce the underlying imbalances.
As I also indicated in my answer to question 2, the current rise in TARGET2 balances differs fundamentally in origin from the rise during the crisis.
Zoals ik ook in de beantwoording van vraag 2 heb aangegeven, verschilt de huidige oploop van TARGET2-saldi wezenlijk in oorsprong van de oploop ten tijden van de crisis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert, Bruins en Sneller over de rechtsgrondslag van het voorgestelde Europees Monetair Fonds (EMF)

MPs asked whether the Commission's proposal for a European Monetary Fund, based on the flexibility clause Article 352 TFEU, is legally sound, given a German Bundestag opinion that found the basis inadequate, and whether the government has legal advice. The minister acknowledged the Commission's choice and said the government finds it insufficiently clear why an EMF is needed, will request a Council legal service opinion, and favours keeping the ESM's intergovernmental character.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert en Bruins over de balansen in TARGET2 en de daarmee verbonden risico’s

MPs Omtzigt, Hennis-Plasschaert and Bruins asked the Finance Minister about TARGET2 imbalances across euro countries, whether they are better balanced than in 2012, whether mitigation is desirable, and how the risks (including exit scenarios and accounting) are assessed. The minister answered with the country balances, explained the post-2015 rise as driven by QE, stated that the euro-exit scenario is speculative and that TARGET2 balances are not a government-debt indicator, and noted no EU plans to rebalance TARGET2.
There are no plans on the European agenda to rebalance the TARGET2 system.
Er zijn geen plannen op de Europese agenda om het TARGET2-systeem meer in balans te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Geurts en Dijkgraaf over het bericht van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek over het Living Planet Report

MPs Bruins, Geurts and Dijkgraaf asked about a CBS Living Planet Report claim that bottom trawling is a major cause of decline in North Sea benthic fauna, which Wageningen Marine Research said could not be concluded from its data, and about CBS's paid work for interest groups. The minister confirms the data sources, says CBS corrected the claim to attribute the finding to Wageningen research, and states that CBS's paid-work terms preserve its independence, while declining to go further on rectification or apology.
CBS concluded that its original report of 30 October required adjustments on some points and published a revised version on 3 November.
Het CBS is tot de conclusie gekomen dat het oorspronkelijke bericht van 30 oktober jl. op enkele punten aanpassing behoefde en heeft op 3 november jl. een aangepaste versie gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Paternotte, Remco Dijkstra, Bruins en Kröger over Lelystad

Five MPs asked the minister about press reports that former state secretary Dijksma criticised the ministry's capacity to handle the complex Lelystad Airport dossier, including the environmental impact assessment (MER). The minister acknowledged the reports, said the ministry has capable staff but needs extra expertise, and said the remarks do not affect the planned new MER assessment.
The ministry has competent and committed staff.
Het ministerie beschikt over kundige en betrokken medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Van Helvert over uitstel van verbreding van de ‘dodenweg’ N50 bij Kampen

MPs Bruins and Van Helvert asked the minister why widening the N50 near Kampen may be delayed to 2023 despite safety and congestion concerns, and whether the start decision and the motion on the N50 are being implemented. The minister answered that the N50 is not a bottleneck in the national market and capacity analysis, that personnel capacity is reserved for the existing MIRT programme, that EUR 5 million has been reserved and a start decision is expected soon.
The N50 Kampen–Kampen Zuid does not emerge as a bottleneck in the NMCA (National Market and Capacity Analysis).
De N50 Kampen–Kampen Zuid komt niet als knelpunt naar voren in de NMCA
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Visser, Jetten en Bruins over de vluchtroutes naar Lelystad

Five MPs from CDA, VVD, D66 and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about the Lelystad airport flight routes, including the Alderstafel advisory process, consultation records, airspace safety and feasibility, environmental costs and the Helios second opinion. The state secretary answered most questions on substance, stating that no minutes or attendance lists were kept, that routes were designed within existing airspace structure, and that the Helios opinion would be sent before the committee meeting.
No minutes are made of the meetings of the Alderstafel Lelystad, nor is an attendance list kept.
Van de vergaderingen van de Alderstafel Lelystad worden geen verslagen gemaakt, noch een presentielijst bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, Bruins en Van Meenen over het bericht dat de Onderwijsinspectie uitleg wil over fouten in het vwo-eindexamen Frans

MPs asked the Minister about teacher complaints over errors in the VWO French final exam and whether the College voor Toetsen en Examens (CvTE) fixed them via correction-guideline additions and normering. The State Secretary answered that CvTE handled 95 signals, issued a correction-guideline addition changing three questions, and that the Inspectie found the handling correct, while declining to judge the signals substantively.
I myself do not enter into the substantive assessment or evaluation of signals about central examinations.
Zelf treed ik niet in de inhoudelijke beoordeling of waardering van signalen over centrale examens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Visser over het bericht 'Opzeggen vissersakkoord door Britten kan ramp zijn voor Nederland'

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about the UK's notice to terminate the London Fisheries Convention and its consequences for Dutch fishers, including the 6-12 mile zone and the Brexit negotiations. The government confirmed the termination was filed on 3 July 2017, said Dutch-flagged vessels barely fish that zone, and noted the issue will be part of the wider EU-UK relationship talks.
The Convention has a two-year notice period and ceases to apply to the United Kingdom on 3 July 2019.
Het Verdrag heeft een opzegtermijn van twee jaar en verliest zijn werking jegens het Verenigd Koninkrijk op 3 juli 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘zorg over toekomst van aangepaste leermiddelen voor leerlingen met dyslexie’

MP Bruins asked the state secretary whether the lack of a new tender for adapted learning materials for dyslexic pupils will make the supply unavailable and outdated, and why no tender has been issued. The state secretary answered that Dedicon will keep supplying adapted books, that the collection is not quickly outdated, and that no new tender has yet been issued because alternative, cheaper production methods are being explored, with more clarity expected in autumn.
No new tender procedure has yet been issued, because we are currently still in discussion with other parties in light of current technological developments.
Er is nog geen nieuwe aanbestedingsprocedure uitgeschreven, omdat wij op dit moment (in het licht van de huidige technologische ontwikkelingen) nog in gesprek zijn met andere partijen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de toekomstige beschikbaarheid van IC-prototypes voor het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven en wetenschappelijk onderzoek

MP Bruins asked the minister whether the EU's decision not to continue funding Europractice, which provides chip prototyping services to universities and industry, would harm Dutch science and industry, and whether alternative, more continuous funding could be sought. The minister answered that Europractice-PLUS failed the minimum quality threshold in the EU evaluation, that the Netherlands has raised the issue with the Commission and other member states, and that a follow-up proposal may be submitted to a call expected in October 2017.
The Netherlands raised this issue at a meeting of this Committee on 18 May.
Nederland heeft deze kwestie tijdens een zitting van dit Committee aan de orde gesteld op 18 mei jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht ‘Unilever is straks misschien niet meer Nederlands'

MPs Paternotte and Bruins asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Unilever possibly ceasing to be Dutch, the protection mechanisms other countries use against foreign takeovers, the tax benefits Unilever receives, and the AkzoNobel takeover dispute. The government replied that it keeps an open stance on takeovers, outlined protection mechanisms in other countries and the Netherlands, said it is talking to Unilever, refused to disclose individual tax benefits citing tax secrecy, and said the AkzoNobel dispute is a private matter for the courts.
Under the tax secrecy provision of article 67 of the General Tax Act, no statements can be made about the tax position of an individual taxpayer.

Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingsbepaling van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kunnen immers geen mededelingen worden gedaan over de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de toekomstige functie van toegepast onderzoek

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about a proposal by the TU Eindhoven rector to move applied research organisations (TO2) under universities, and how it relates to a pending evaluation and AWTI advice. The minister values the debate, defers the substantive response to a later cabinet reaction, and says collaboration among knowledge partners is important.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat illegaal oesters rapen tot oneerlijke concurrentie leidt

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether illegal oyster raking that exceeds the 10 kg personal-use limit, and is sold, distorts competition for the professional sector, and how it will be enforced. The government replies that enforcement lies with the province of Zeeland, which is working with the sector and ministries on stronger measures.
Primary responsibility for shellfish raking lies with the provinces under the Nature Conservation Act.
De primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor het rapen van schelpdieren ligt op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat de christelijke studentenvereniging Navigators niet in aanmerking komt voor een bestuursbeurs bij de Haagse Hogeschool

An MP asked the minister whether it was right that the Haagse Hogeschool denied a board grant and student-association recognition to the Christian student association Navigators, and whether this amounted to unequal treatment on religious grounds. The minister replied that Navigators fails the institution's conditions (open access to all students and alignment with the institution's emancipation-oriented basis, given its evangelising statutes), that religion is not the basis of the decision, and that the College voor de Rechten van de Mens could be consulted.
I do not see that the Haagse Hogeschool makes a distinction on the basis of religion.
Ik zie niet dat de Haagse Hogeschool onderscheid maakt naar godsdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Bruins over de mogelijkheden om grenswerkers als expats te behandelen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether cross-border workers (grenswerkers) suffer financial disadvantage, such as missing child benefit or sick pay, and whether tax advantages could stimulate cross-border work. The State Secretary answered that financial effects depend on personal circumstances, that information provision via grensinfo.nl and a cross-border tax team is being strengthened, that existing tax compensation schemes and EU coordination rules largely avoid disadvantage, and that no extra fiscal stimulus is planned.
That is why the Cross-Border Economy and Labour Action Team formulated, as an action in its report, making the financial consequences of cross-border work transparent.

Daarom heeft het Actieteam Grensoverschrijdende Economie en Arbeid in het rapport Grenzen slechten, regio’s verbinden, mensen bewegen 2 als actie geformuleerd het inzichtelijk maken van de financiële gevolgen van werken over de grens.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Navigators Studentenvereniging Amsterdam op basis van de christelijke identiteit wordt geweerd door een leverancier van pinapparaten

MPs Bruins and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether refusing a card payment terminal to a Christian student association on religious grounds is lawful under the equal treatment act, and how it relates to that act. The minister answered that the equal treatment act generally prohibits religious distinctions in offering services, but whether unlawful discrimination occurred can only be determined through investigation, and the association could file a complaint with the College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Whether unlawful distinction exists in the case in question can only be established on the basis of investigation.
Of er in het genoemde geval sprake is van verboden onderscheid kan alleen op basis van onderzoek worden vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Gesthuizen, Oosenbrug en Agnes Mulder over de locatie Zeewolde voor de middengolfzender

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Zeewolde medium-wave mast is a non-duplicable monopoly, whether the owner NOVEC must provide sharing under the Telecommunications Act, and whether the government should help find an alternative site for Groot Nieuws Radio before its lease ends. The minister answered that finding a suitable site is the licence holder's responsibility, that the government will help assess alternatives, and that the access dispute is pending before the ACM, so he cannot comment on the substance.
During ongoing legal proceedings I cannot make substantive statements about the matter in question.
Gedurende lopende juridische procedures kan ik geen inhoudelijke uitspraken over de desbetreffende zaak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins inzake de aanpak van geluidhinder langs het spoor

An ChristenUnie MP asked how the roughly four million euro estimate for tackling booggeluid (curve noise) near the rail was calculated and how the most urgent locations would be addressed. The State Secretary explained the cost is based on existing SSCS installations, that ProRail has been asked to proceed but a formal tender is required, and that installation is expected in 2018.
ProRail expects the SSCS units can be installed in 2018.
ProRail verwacht dat de SSCS-sen in 2018 kunnen worden geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Bisschop inzake het bericht dat de gemeente Utrecht niet in lijn handelt met de Leerplichtwet en het wettelijk vastgestelde model

MPs Bruins and Bisschop asked whether Utrecht's extra conditions on home-schooling exemptions under the Leerplichtwet, and its strict prosecution practice, conflict with the state secretary's 2016 letter to municipalities. The state secretary declined to judge the pending case, said all municipalities must act within the law, and noted that jurisprudence will clarify exemption requirements over time.
The case you refer to is before the court. It is not for me to judge this at this stage.
De zaak waar u naar verwijst is onder de rechter. Het is niet aan mij om daar in dit stadium over te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Rog over het bericht dat de TU Eindhoven religieuze studentenverenigingen weert

MPs Bruins and Rog asked the minister whether TU Eindhoven had excluded the religious student association Ichthus Eindhoven from a board grant on religious grounds, in conflict with equal-treatment law. The minister answered that the TU/e has reconsidered its initial plan, that Ichthus may apply for a grant assessed under the existing criteria, and that religious identity is not a ground for exclusion but also not a reason for support.
I am of the view that the criteria in the TU/e policy framework ensure equal treatment.
Ik ben van mening dat de criteria in het beleidskader van de TU/e een gelijke behandeling borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de aankondiging door de minister van ‘handelsakkoorden nieuwe stijl’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about 'new style' trade agreements, including how to increase negotiation transparency, address social and sustainability impacts, and apply this to CETA and TTIP, and how product production methods can be treated under WTO rules. The minister replied that the government will publish quarterly overviews of EU trade negotiations, create a Breed Handelsberaad with business, unions and civil society, commission impact studies, and pursue transparency and sustainability provisions, while explaining that WTO non-discrimination rules limit excluding products based on production methods.
To increase transparency in the Netherlands, the cabinet sends the House of Representatives a quarterly overview of all ongoing EU trade agreement negotiations with third countries.
Om de transparantie in Nederland te vergroten stuurt het kabinet de Tweede Kamer elk kwartaal een overzicht van alle lopende onderhandelingen over handelsakkoorden van de EU met derde landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de sluiting van de Merwedebrug A27 voor vrachtverkeer

An MP asked why the Merwede bridge on the A27 was closed to freight without consulting Noord-Brabant, nearby municipalities or transport operators, whether other large bridges are safe, and whether a speed limit could have avoided closure. The minister answered that action was taken immediately for safety, dynamic loading rather than weight was the main concern, and repairs aim to allow heavier traffic again by late November or early December.
To guarantee the safety of (waterway) road users, action was taken immediately.
Om de veiligheid voor (vaar)weggebruikers te waarborgen is direct tot actie overgegaan.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bruins over de nieuwe veerboot Texelstroom van TESO

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport has not yet decided TESO's over one-year-old request to bunker CNG for the new Texel ferry, and when a decision will come. The minister replied that the assessment is ongoing because technical information is still missing from the company, that the Amsterdam sightseeing boats are not comparable, and that a decision will follow as soon as the information is supplied.
The assessment of the application is still ongoing because the ILT has not yet received all the necessary technical information to assess the application fully.
De beoordeling van de aanvraag loopt nog doordat de ILT nog niet alle benodigde technische informatie heeft ontvangen om de aanvraag volledig te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Dijkgraaf, Visser, Geurts, Graus, Bruins, Van Klaveren en Van Vliet over het bericht dat een groot deel van de Noordzee nauwelijks bevist wordt

MPs asked the minister whether the finding that nearly 40% of the North Sea is barely fished changes the government's commitment to closing 10% of Dutch waters to bottom-trawling and the proposed extra closures on the Friese Front and Centrale Oestergronden. The minister answered that the study does not address protected ecological areas, which is the focus of the Dutch ambition, that the proposal remains a valid implementation of the 10-15% goal, and that she will inform parliament on how the Bisschop motion is executed, but could not answer before the committee meeting.
Soon I will, on behalf of the State Secretary for Economic Affairs as well, inform your House how I have executed the Bisschop motion.
Binnenkort zal ik, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, uw Kamer informeren hoe ik de motie Bisschop heb uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf, Bruins en Gesthuizen over de toegezegde evaluatie van de Winkeltijdenwet

Three MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the status of the promised evaluation of the Shop Opening Hours Act, including whether workers' interests, Sunday rest and small retailers are considered, whether municipalities copy neighbouring municipalities' policy, and when the report will be sent. The Minister answered that an external evaluation is underway covering these interests and neighbouring-municipality effects, that he will not anticipate its outcome, and that the results and a policy letter will be sent before year-end.
So as not to anticipate matters, I first await the outcomes of the evaluation.
Om niet op de zaken vooruit te lopen, wacht ik eerst de uitkomsten van de evaluatie af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Bruins over het opleggen van boetes aan een winkelier die op zondag zijn winkel niet openstelt

MPs Dijkgraaf and Bruins asked whether landlords may fine shop tenants who keep their shops closed on Sundays, despite municipal freedom and earlier ROZ commitments. Minister Kamp answered that municipalities cannot oblige shops to open, that the contractual landlord-tenant arrangements fall under contract freedom, and that he will await the evaluation of the Winkeltijdenwet before committing to further measures.
I would like to await this evaluation before making statements on whether sufficient measures have been taken to prevent shopkeepers from receiving a fine if they do not want to open on Sunday.

Ik wil graag wachten op deze evaluatie alvorens uitspraken te doen of er voldoende maatregelen zijn genomen om te voorkomen dat winkeliers een boete krijgen indien zij op zondag niet open willen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Schouten en het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat weinig Nederlanders werk vinden in Duitsland

MPs from ChristenUnie and CDA asked about a report that few Dutch people seek work in Germany, and about the Actieteam grensoverschrijdende economie en arbeid, INTERREG funding and cross-border information points. The minister acknowledges untapped cross-border job potential, describes ongoing Actieteam work with results promised in Q1 2017, and notes that border information point funding is temporary with an SZW evaluation planned for 2018.
As far as can now be seen, the cabinet will inform you of the results of the Actieteam by the first quarter of 2017 at the latest.
Naar het zich nu laat aanzien, wordt u uiterlijk in het eerste kwartaal 2017 door het kabinet geïnformeerd over de resultaten van het Actieteam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Van Veldhoven, Van Helvert en Madlener over het bericht dat Rover vindt dat het Ministerie de verkeerde prioriteiten stelt

MPs from ChristenUnie, D66, CDA and PVV asked the State Secretary about ROVER's claim that the ministry sets the wrong priorities in its ProRail repositioning, including concerns about rushed decisions, missing baselines, and the handling of parliamentary motions. The State Secretary answered that a public-law form for ProRail is already chosen, that an analysis with stakeholder input will be sent to Parliament before year-end, and that no irreversible steps will be taken before debate.
Until I have discussed this analysis with your House, no irreversible steps will be taken regarding the positioning of ProRail.
Totdat ik deze analyse met uw Kamer heb besproken, zullen er geen onomkeerbare stappen ten aanzien van de positionering van ProRail worden gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Jasper van Dijk en Rog over het bericht dat er grote verschillen zijn in de financiële steun aan studenten met een beperking

MPs Bruins, Van Dijk and Rog asked the Minister of Education about reports of large differences in support for students with disabilities, including poor information provision and differences in municipal individual study allowances. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to information duties and a forthcoming letter to parliament, and said that municipal allowance differences reflect local policy freedom while deferring the allowance question to the state secretary of Social Affairs.
This autumn I will send a letter to the House in response to the motion by member Van Meenen et al.
Dit najaar stuur ik een brief aan de Kamer in reactie op de motie van het lid Van Meenen c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Bruins over zorgen om privacy in het onderwijs

MPs Van Meenen and Bruins asked the State Secretary for Education about psychologists' and pedagogues' concerns over careless handling of sensitive pupil data, and what has been done to improve it. The State Secretary acknowledged the signals, listed sector-wide privacy measures, planned a repeat monitor, and pointed to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and Inspectie as supervisors while leaving much responsibility with schools.
I intend to have this monitor repeated still this calendar year and will inform your House of the results.
Ik ben voornemens deze monitor nog dit kalenderjaar te laten herhalen en zal uw Kamer over de resultaten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Visser en Bruins over het bericht ‘Drenthe naar Tweede Kamer om borden TT en Wildlands’

MPs asked why Rijkswaterstaat enforced a 1.5 million visitor threshold to deny signposting to the TT circuit and Wildlands, despite exceptions elsewhere and public investment in the access road. The minister answered that the rule is uniform for verkeersveiligheid reasons, kept the southern sign, ordered the others removed, and rejected renewed talks.
An exception is therefore made for the signpost coming from the south on the A28; that sign may remain.
Voor het verwijsbord komend uit zuidelijke richting op de A28 wordt daarom een uitzondering gemaakt; dat bord mag blijven staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Schouten over "over het ontbreken van het beroep ‘leraar basisonderwijs’ op de kansberoepenlijst van het UWV "

MPs Bruins and Schouten asked why primary-school teacher is not on UWV's list of opportunity occupations despite projected shortages from 2016 and 2020, and whether the government will consult stakeholders and answer quickly. The minister replied that current supply is sufficient (about 7,800 unemployed in primary education in 2015), so the occupation is excluded, that the list is updated twice yearly and could be revised, and that he will inform parliament in November.
I will inform your House in November about the latest state of affairs on the education labour market.
Ik zal uw Kamer in november informeren over de laatste stand van zaken op de onderwijsarbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Rog over het bericht dat de Technische Universiteit (TU) Eindhoven religieuze studentenverenigingen weert

MPs Bruins and Rog asked whether TU Eindhoven withdrew support from the Christian student association Ichthus and whether this breaches equal treatment law. The minister replied that support criteria are based on a policy note with no religious criterion, that the university reconsidered after talks, and that equal treatment questions should go to the College voor de rechten van de mens.
It is for the TU Eindhoven to shape the policy for supporting student associations.
Het is aan de TUe om vorm te geven aan het beleid voor ondersteuning van studentenverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Schouten over het ontbreken van het beroep ‘leraar basisonderwijs’ op de kansberoepenlijst van het UWV

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why the profession of primary school teacher is absent from UWV's list of opportunity occupations, despite expected shortages in 2017-2019. The minister answered that teacher shortages are expected mainly in the four big cities, that current job losses and available unemployed teachers mean enough qualified candidates exist, and that UWV will reassess the list twice yearly.
If it turns out that the profession of primary school teacher meets the criteria, it will be included on the list of opportunity occupations.
Indien daarbij blijkt dat het beroep «leraar basisonderwijs» aan de criteria voldoet, zal dit op de lijst met kansberoepen worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Dijkgraaf, Jasper van Dijk, Bruins, De Roon en Grashoff over de voorlopige toepassing van het vrijhandelsverdrag met Canada (CETA)

MPs asked whether Netherlands had an effective veto over provisional application of the Ukraine association agreement and would have one over provisional application of CETA, and requested legal advice on provisional application. The minister confirmed unanimity applied for the association agreement, said CETA's voting rule depends on the legal basis not yet determined, and stated the government knows of no written legal advice received on provisional application.
Whether decision-making on signature and provisional application of CETA will be by unanimity or qualified majority depends on the legal basis.
Of besluitvorming over ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing van CETA zal geschieden met unanimiteit of gekwalificeerde meerderheid is afhankelijk van de rechtsgrondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Jasper van Dijk, Dijkgraaf, Grashoff, De Roon, Jan Vos en Agnes Mulder over de voorlopige inwerkingtreding van het handelsakkoord tussen de EU en Canada (CETA)

Seven MPs asked the trade minister whether the Commission's plan to provisionally apply the EU-Canada CETA would be put to parliament, how the parliamentary reservation demanded by an earlier motion would be implemented, and whether CETA will be a mixed agreement. The minister answered that the Commissioner's commitment to consult the European Parliament is noted, that the government will formally register a parliamentary reservation in the Council once a proposal is tabled and inform the Tweede Kamer promptly, and that which parts would apply provisionally is not yet known.

If the Commission has submitted a proposal for a Council decision on signature and provisional application, the cabinet will formally implement the motion by stating in the Council that the Netherlands cannot agree to the proposal before it has been discussed with the House of Representatives.

Als de Commissie een voorstel heeft gedaan voor een Raadsbesluit voor ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing, zal het kabinet formeel uitvoering geven aan de motie door in de Raad kenbaar te maken dat Nederland niet kan instemmen met het voorstel voordat het voorstel is besproken met de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de geplande toegangspoorten op station Amsterdam Zuid

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary whether requiring bus-to-tram transfers at Amsterdam Zuid to check in and out four times, and whether a gate-free passage could be provided. The State Secretary answered that the gates are a safety measure, that gate-free passage via Minerva exists, that widening Britten would cost over 10 million euro without budget, and that the public-transport interest is small.
However, the number of passengers transferring from bus to tram is a very small percentage of the total number of passengers at the station.
Het aantal overstappers van bus naar tram betreft echter een zeer klein percentage van het totale aantal reizigers op het station.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de handhaving van de aanlandplicht door inspectiediensten in de visserijsector

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about enforcement of the landing obligation by inspection services in the fishing sector, including perceived distrust, equal enforcement with other countries, efficiency of the electronic logbook, inspection frequency, discard registration, warnings, and inspector conduct. The State Secretary replied that inspections in the first half of 2016 are informative, that enforcement is comparable across member states, that no sanctions or formal warnings have been issued, and that inspection intensity is not disproportionate, while refusing to cut inspections or relax daily discard registration.
The informative character consists of the NVWA entering into discussion with the individual fisher when an infringement is found.
Het informerend karakter bestaat er uit dat de NVWA bij constatering van een overtreding het gesprek aangaat met de individuele visser.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins inzake het bericht 'Techniek in de knel door verandering binnen onderwijs'

MP Bruins asked the State Secretary whether the move to broader vmbo profiles and simplified funding would cut technical vmbo education, and whether schools can keep technical equipment up to date. The State Secretary answers that funding for technical education stays at the same level, that schools can use reserves for one-off costs, a sample survey is underway, and a consultation with school boards is planned, though full substantive answers on guaranteed funding and a higher per-pupil amount are deferred.

I am therefore organising a consultation round with school boards, in which I, in cooperation with the VO-raad, will discuss with boards and school leaders the questions that exist about the planned simplification.

Ik organiseer daarom een consultatieronde met besturen, waarin ik, in samenwerking met de VO-raad, in gesprek treed met besturen en schoolleiders over de vragen die bestaan over de voorgenomen vereenvoudiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de positie van leveranciers bij het faillissement van V&D

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the position of suppliers in the V&D bankruptcy, including curators' duties to all creditors, fees for access to stores, deadlines for suppliers, and possible support for suppliers. The minister answered that curators primarily serve the estate's collective interest, that suppliers' recovery options are negotiable, that bankruptcy claims are difficult and for courts to judge, and that suppliers can use existing credit guarantee schemes like the BMKB.
In any case, the assessment of the facts is for the court, should creditors wish to bring this case before it.
De beoordeling van de feiten is hoe dan ook aan de rechter, in het geval dat crediteuren deze zaak aanhangig willen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de uitbreiding van het treinaanbod Leiden-Utrecht en Alphen aan den Rijn-Gouda

An ChristenUnie MP asked about delays to rail upgrades on Leiden–Utrecht and Alphen aan den Rijn–Gouda, including NS's refusal to guarantee service at new stations and the postponed frequency increases. The State Secretary answered that the project is a provincial responsibility, that options are being studied with NS and ProRail, and that no Rijk intervention is planned at this stage.
It is not a national government project but a provincial project.
Het is geen Rijksproject, maar een project van de provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de intercity Dordrecht-Breda

MP Bruins asks the State Secretary about the Dordrecht–Breda intercity, the regional costs of its loss, and whether NS and the regions were given feasibility analyses of alternatives. The State Secretary answers that a two-year intercity was decided, that several alternatives were examined with NS, that NS cannot be obliged to carry the operating deficit, and that she is willing to look broadly for a structural solution.
I am willing to realise an intercity connection Dordrecht-Breda for a period of two years.
Ik ben bereid om voor een periode van twee jaar een intercityverbinding Dordrecht-Breda te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het evacueren van reizigers uit gestrande treinen

MP Bruins (ChristenUnie) asked about long delays evacuating passengers from stranded trains on the main rail network and the HSL, and whether promised procedures and quick-win measures were followed. Staatssecretaris Dijksma acknowledged procedures were not followed in several incidents, promised a joint NS/ProRail evaluation and an ILT investigation, but gave no full overview of stranded-train evaluations.
I do not receive a report on every stranded train and therefore cannot send them to your House.
Ik ontvang niet over elke gestrande trein een rapport en kan dat dus niet naar uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Hoogland, Smaling en Van Helvert over het sluiten van overwegen door ProRail

MPs from four parties asked the State Secretary about ProRail's closure of level crossings, including the Laantje van Alverna private crossing, the status of a QuickScan on 100 unsupervised crossings, and how recreational interests are weighed. The State Secretary answered that ProRail follows the agreed procedure with the Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking, that recreational interests are weighed in the Omgevingswet process, and that clarification on definitions will follow in spring 2016.
Nevertheless, I note that there is uncertainty between ProRail and the other members of the Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking about some definitions in the procedure.
Niettemin constateer ik dat er tussen ProRail en de overige leden van de Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking over sommige definities uit de procedure onduidelijkheid bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de benoeming van de voorzitter van Raad van Toezicht van de NPO

MP Bruins asked whether the new NPO supervisory board chair's role as chair of the UWV executive board was considered and whether it complies with Mediawet incompatibility rules, and whether the appointment fits the profile. The State Secretary answered that the role was considered, that a statutory incompatibility does not apply to independent administrative bodies, and that the appointment follows the advisory committee's nominations and the profile.
I will shortly explore how the role of the Minister in this can be limited.
Ik ga op korte termijn verkennen hoe de rol van de Minister daarin kan worden beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Bruins over de zienswijze en opstelling van de gemeente Rotterdam inzake leerplicht en kinderbescherming

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a Rotterdam municipal position, treating parents' use of the Leerplichtwet exemption as grounds for a Raad voor de Kinderbescherming investigation, is acceptable and consistent with legal certainty. The minister answered that children need education under the IVRK, that municipalities may file a verzoek tot onderzoek when development is threatened, that parents have no legal remedy to stop such an investigation, and that the filing is not an administrative decision.
Parents have no legal remedies available to prevent an investigation by the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming into whether a child's development is threatened.
Ouders staan geen rechtsmiddelen ter beschikking om een onderzoek door de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming om te zien of de ontwikkeling van een kind wordt bedreigd af te wenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Merkies en Grashoff over de belastingontwijking door wapenproducenten

MPs Bruins, Merkies and Grashoff asked whether seven of the ten largest arms producers use Dutch tax structures, whether they have rulings, and whether their substance is adequate. The State Secretary declined to give information on individual taxpayers under confidentiality rules, explained the substance test and risk-based supervision, and said public country-by-country reporting awaits an EU impact assessment.
Based on the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), I cannot provide information about individual taxpayers.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik geen informatie verstrekken over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins inzake de benoeming van de voorzitter van de Raad van Toezicht van de NPO

An MP asked whether the newly appointed chair of the NPO supervisory board creates an appearance of political partisanship, and how the appointment procedure safeguarded independence. The Secretary of State defended the open, externally run procedure and independent advisory committee, but agreed the appearance of partisanship should be avoided and promised a review of appointment procedures across public media bodies.
I will carry out a serious review of the appointment procedures in the media sector in which the Minister is involved.
Ik zal daarvoor een serieuze verkenning doen naar de procedures voor benoemingen in de mediasector waarbij de Minister betrokken is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de rol van private equity in de ondergang van V&D

An MP asks ministers about the role of private equity firm Sun Capital in the bankruptcy and possible restart of V&D, and whether bankruptcy law protects against abuse. The government answers that the curator leads any restart under judicial supervision, that existing rules guard against abuse, and that the private equity role will be examined in a separate study.
Because of competitive sensitivity, the curators do not disclose the identity of the selected parties.
De curatoren maken vanwege de concurrentiegevoeligheid de identiteit van de geselecteerde partijen niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over achterstallig onderhoud aan de openbare verlichting op meerdere locaties langs de A15

An MP asked the minister why street lighting along the A15 motorway has been broken for months, why earlier repair orders were delayed, and what standards apply to repair times. The minister confirmed the problems, attributed delays to a costlier structural overhaul and budget reallocation, said the work is now scheduled for 2016-2017, and stated there are no fixed repair-time norms beyond traffic safety.
This approach is now planned for 2016/2017 (start 2016).
Deze aanpak is nu gepland in 2016/2017 (start 2016).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat veel eindexamenkandidaten onvoldoende kennis hebben over het leenstelsel en het aangaan van schulden

MP Bruins asked the Minister of Education whether she shares concern that exam candidates lack knowledge about student loans and debt, and what DUO and the government will do to improve information. The minister rejects the concern as overstated, points to ongoing information campaigns, a new budgeting tool and cooperation with Nibud, and commits to improving flexible repayment facilities.
I do not share the concern.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over de overweg Laantje van Alverna

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about the Council of State ruling that the Laantje van Alverna level crossing became public through prescription, and about the implications for other unsecured crossings and ProRail's fencing and closure practice. The state secretary said the crossing stays closed until 1 April 2016 pending alternatives, explained that the ruling is case-specific, defended ProRail's enforcement and project costs, and declined to commit to pausing closures or to a national inventory.
This ruling therefore relates specifically to the case of the Laantje van Alverna.
Deze uitspraak heeft dan ook specifiek betrekking op de casus van het Laantje van Alverna.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de stremming van het treinverkeer tussen Bad Nieuweschans en Leer

An MP asked the state secretary about the rail bridge damage near Weener that halted train traffic between Bad Nieuweschans and Leer, including a temporary bridge, freight rerouting, shorter bus journeys, and speeding up the line upgrade with ETCS. The secretary answered that DB Netz's study is still pending, that a letter to the German counterpart will follow, that the 2018–2020 speed-up plan is in planning, and that she cannot yet decide on the signalling system.
Yes, see also the answer to question 2. The DB Netz study into improving the temporary situation is still ongoing.
Ja, zie hiervoor ook de beantwoording van vraag 2. Het onderzoek van DB Netz naar een verbetering van de tijdelijke situatie loopt nog.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vroonhoven en Idsinga over het behoud en exploitatie van de bruine vloot

MPs Van Vroonhoven and Idsinga asked about the preservation and commercial viability of the historic brown fleet (bruine vloot), including support for safety and sustainability upgrades and recognition as heritage. The minister acknowledged the sector's value and its safety and environmental pressures, but said the government supports it only through the Regio Deal, declined to revive the NBTC storylines or involve provinces and municipalities further, and found further exploration of UNESCO heritage status unnecessary.
No. The storylines are no longer applied.
Nee. De verhaallijnen worden niet langer toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked how dependent Dutch government organisations are on US cloud providers, whether migrations will be reconsidered, and what the consequences of losing access or of US surveillance laws would be. The state secretary answered that cloud policy is being revised, that some migrations have been reconsidered and that a sovereign government cloud is being pursued, but gave no full overview of planned migrations and largely described consequences only in general terms.
The cabinet agrees with the submitters that careful considerations regarding cloud migrations are of great importance.
Het kabinet is het met de indieners eens dat zorgvuldige afwegingen bij cloudmigraties van groot belang zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse universiteiten houden politiek buiten de deur tijdens de introductieweken’

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that Amsterdam universities exclude political youth organisations from introduction weeks, and whether dialogue on campus should be promoted. The Minister answers that the design of introduction weeks is for institutions to decide, notes existing access rules, and declines to engage with universities or youth organisations.
The design of the introduction weeks is entirely up to the institution itself.
De vormgeving van de introductieweken is volledig aan de instelling zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.
De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) en de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) zijn beide onafhankelijke controleurs die toezien op rechtmatig en doelmatig gebruik van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘student encampment for Palestine’ op de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA)

MPs Rajkowski and Michon-Derkzen asked about Samidoun's role in a June 2025 student encampment at the University of Amsterdam, whether such organisations should be banned, how the planned terrorism-glorification offence applies to campus protests, and whether universities have guidelines and suspension powers. The minister answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, that banning organisations is for the courts on a prosecutor's request, that the new offences will depend on circumstances, that universities have a joint protest guideline and can suspend students under the WHW, and that a further letter on organisation bans will follow in autumn 2025.

As you will understand, individual cases cannot be discussed, nor the specific involvement of organisations in demonstrations, because this would encroach on the powers of the local triangle, namely the mayor, the police and the Public Prosecution Service.

Zoals u begrijpt kan er niet op individuele casuïstiek in worden gegaan, zo ook niet waar het gaat over de specifieke betrokkenheid van organisaties bij demonstraties, omdat hiermee in de bevoegdheid van de lokale driehoek, te weten de burgemeester, de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie, wordt getreden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over de berichten 'Joodse studenten voelen zich onveilig en buitengesloten op UvA en VU: "De universiteit adviseerde me niet meer te komen"' en 'Antisemitisme drijft leerli

Christian Union MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the education minister how the government responds to reports that Jewish students feel unsafe at Dutch universities and that antisemitism drives pupils to Jewish schools, and what measures exist. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing measures (Strategy Against Antisemitism, guidance, planned security duty, monitoring plans) and said further steps would be considered after a task force reports in early 2026, while declining to register religion or monitor the handbook's use.
Institutions do not register religion for privacy reasons.
Instellingen registreren religie wegens privacy redenen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Patijn over interim-salarissen in de publieke sector

MPs Mohandis and Patijn asked how interim executives in the public sector can combine several assignments to evade the WNT pay cap, and whether the rules should change. The minister says the WNT is not being circumvented, commits to investigating whether the situation recurs and, if so, to proposing an extension of the anti-cumulation rule to interim managers, and explains the enforcement roles of the Tax Authority and supervisory bodies.
Following this case, the Minister of BZK will have it investigated whether the situation described occurs or has occurred more often.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus zal de Minister van BZK laten onderzoeken of de beschreven situatie zich vaker voordoet of heeft voorgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het opzeggen van de Culturele Overeenkomst met Israël n.a.v. moord journalisten

MP Teunissen asked the government whether it would suspend the cultural agreement with Israel after the killing of journalists in Gaza, and whether it would press Israel on press freedom, war crimes, genocide prevention and the EU-Israel Association Agreement. The minister answered that the government is concerned about civilian and journalist deaths, urges both sides to respect international humanitarian law, and pursues pressure and dialogue, but declined to suspend the cultural agreement, leaving cultural cooperation decisions to institutions and pointing to EU measures already being pursued.
Severing cultural ties does not form part of that.
Het doorsnijden van culturele banden maakt daarvan geen deel uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Piri over de dood van Al Jazeera-journalist Anas al-Sharif in Gaza

MPs Paternotte and Piri asked the government about the killing of Al Jazeera journalist Anas al-Sharif in Gaza, Israel's claim he was a Hamas member, and press freedom and journalist access to Gaza. The minister said Israel has not substantiated its allegations, that Nederland calls for evidence to be shared and for independent investigations, and listed diplomatic steps and support for press freedom.

For this reason the Netherlands wants Israel to share evidence with the international community in cases where attacks on journalists are justified by claims of membership of a terrorist organisation.

Nederland wil daarom dat Israël bewijs deelt met de internationale gemeenschap in het geval dat aanvallen op journalisten worden onderbouwd met claims van lidmaatschap van een terroristische organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel 'Negen Nederlandse universiteiten doen gezamenlijk onderzoek met defensie-industrie van Israël'

MP Dassen asked ministers about reports that Dutch universities collaborate on dual-use research with Israeli defence industry partners under Horizon Europe, and whether the government would act or stop such funding. The government answered that universities decide on partnerships within their autonomy, that it cannot fully assess the scope of dual-use research, and that it supports the Commission's proposal to suspend Israel's participation in the European Innovation Council.
The cabinet cannot, however, independently determine the scope of that.
Het kabinet kan de reikwijdte daarvan echter niet eigenstandig vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de voorgenomen stelselherziening van lokale publieke omroepen

MP Mohandis asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the status of the reform of local public broadcasting, the budget and distribution key, public-private cooperation, the 80 regional broadcasting areas, and the boundary with regional broadcasting. The Minister answered that the bill is with the Council of State, aims for entry into force in 2026 and start in 2028 with gemeenten retaining an advisory role and a budget distribution key still under development, while committing to publish budget figures later.
The intention is that as soon as possible afterwards two things become known: first, the intended total budget available from 2028 for all local broadcasters.
Het is de bedoeling dat zo snel mogelijk daarna twee zaken bekend worden: ten eerste het voorgenomen totaalbudget dat met ingang van 2028 beschikbaar is voor alle lokale omroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kahraman over een tweede streekomroep voor regio Twente

An MP asked the minister whether Twente, with over 600,000 residents, should be split into two regional broadcasting areas after four municipal councils passed a motion to do so, and why a request by five local broadcasters for a separate South-West Twente area was rejected. The minister answered that the NLPO-led process found Twente to be one natural habitat, that the Change Board advised keeping the current division under legal criteria, and that talks with the municipalities and broadcasters will take place in the region.
For Twente, it was concluded on that basis that there is insufficient reason to grant the requested division.
