Voor Twente is op grond daarvan geconcludeerd dat er onvoldoende aanleiding is om de gevraagde opdeling te honoreren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosterbrink over het artikel Commissie kiest niet tussen Landbouwmuseum en 'Hindeloopen' van de Leeuwarder Courant

An MP asked the Minister of OCW about the advisory committee's failure to choose between the Fries Landbouwmuseum and Museum Hindeloopen for provincial culture subsidy, and whether the Ministry would intervene or provide structural funding. The Minister replied that provincial subsidy allocation is the province's responsibility, that the BIS subsidy for Friesland went to Fries Museum, and that structural funding is reserved for museums managing national collections, so no action was committed.
It is up to the province of Fryslân to decide how it deploys its funds within provincial culture policy.
Het is aan de provincie Fryslân om te bepalen hoe zij haar middelen inzet binnen het provinciale cultuurbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paternotte over het bericht “Jongvolwassen Oekraïners tussen wal en schip: geen recht op onderwijs, geen toekomstperspectief”

MPs Podt and Paternotte (D66) asked ministers about reports that young adult Ukrainians lack access to education and prospects, including tuition and student finance parity with EU/EEA students, lower institutional tuition, Piri motion follow-up, Dutch language provision and support for vulnerable newcomers. The government replied that temporary protection runs to 4 March 2027, that tuition-level decisions rest with institutions, and that details of a return programme and transition document will be sent to parliament in September 2025, without changing current rules in the meantime.
Pending final decision-making on this temporary national status for displaced persons from Ukraine, I do not intend to amend current laws and regulations in advance.
In afwachting van finale besluitvorming over deze tijdelijke nationale status voor ontheemden uit Oekraïne ben ik niet voornemens om vooruitlopend daarop de huidige wet- en regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over de positie van Oekraïense jongeren en jongvolwassenen in het Nederlandse onderwijs

MP Stultiens asks the Minister of Education whether Ukrainian young adults risk becoming a lost generation, and whether the government will set up a financial arrangement such as student finance or a lower tuition fee for Ukrainian students rather than leaving it to institutions. The minister says tuition reduction remains up to institutions, gives counts and cost estimates for student finance and funding, and says the cabinet is exploring a transition document and skills policy without committing to a specific new financial scheme.
The ministry does not have information on how many young adults would want and be able to study, because this depends on several factors.
Het ministerie beschikt niet over informatie over hoeveel jongvolwassenen zouden willen en kunnen studeren, omdat dit afhankelijk is van meerdere factoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Haage over het besluit van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs judolessen niet langer te erkennen als volwaardige invulling van het bewegingsonderwijs

MPs Mohandis and Haage asked whether the Inspectorate's decision that judo lessons at a Dalton school no longer count as full physical education, despite a qualified teacher, is justified, and whether the ministries will talk to the Judo Bond and what the end of the physical-education subsidy means. The state secretary defended the Inspectorate's position that structural judo cannot meet the core goals alone, declined a direct meeting with one provider, and said ending the subsidy will not reduce physical-education hours.
By structurally offering judo lessons as part of physical education, a school cannot meet the implementation of the core goals.
Met het structureel aanbieden van judolessen als onderdeel van het bewegingsonderwijs kan een school niet voldoen aan de uitvoering van de kerndoelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het onderzoek van BOOS en Follow the Money naar Stichting Durf te Dromen en mogelijke misleiding van scholen

An MP asked the education minister about reports that schools paid a commercial company linked to charity Stichting Durf te Dromen, whether this occurred elsewhere, and what safeguards exist against mixing public and private money. The state secretary said schools choose their own suppliers, the ministry keeps no overview, there are no signals of similar cases, and schools are only urged to be transparent and report suspected subsidy fraud to DUS-I.
No, the Ministry of OCW does not keep an overview of the services purchased by schools.
Nee, het Ministerie van OCW houdt geen overzicht bij van de diensten die door scholen worden afgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'UvA verhaalt schade bezettingen mei 2024 niet op demonstranten'

MPs Martens-America and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked why the University of Amsterdam did not recover about 1.5 million euros of damage from the May 2024 occupations from the protesters, and what legal and practical obstacles exist to recovering such damage from rioters. The Minister answers that identifying perpetrators in chaotic group situations is often practically impossible, that group liability has conditions, that most damage was covered by insurance, and that institutions decide themselves whether to claim as injured parties, without providing case counts.
Furthermore, as Minister I do not collect data on whether group liability is applicable in riots in higher education.
Voorts verzamel ik als Minister geen gegevens over het wel of niet toepasbaar zijn van groepsaansprakelijkheid bij rellen in het hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Martens-America over het bericht ‘Radicalen vrijuit op universiteiten: gedragscodes blijken vooral papieren tijgers’

MPs Ceder and Martens-America asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how he views reports that university codes of conduct are toothless against intimidating radical behaviour, and what he will do about recurring intimidation and disruption on campuses. The Minister says institutions are responsible for enforcing their own rules and safety, that he is strengthening supervision through a planned statutory duty of care for safety and a review of complaint procedures, but gives no concrete new enforcement sanctions beyond existing instruments.
I expect institutions to take their responsibility for a safe learning and working environment for students and staff and to use the regular instruments available to them for this purpose.

Ik verwacht dat instellingen hun verantwoordelijkheid nemen in de zorg voor een veilige leer- en werkomgeving voor studenten en medewerkers en hierbij het reguliere instrumentarium inzetten dat zij hiervoor beschikbaar hebben
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Van der Hoeff over herhaalde antisemitisme en oproepen tot geweld door Radboud-docent Harry Pettit

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she judges a Radboud University lecturer's statements comparing Zionists to Nazis and calling for eradicating Zionism, whether this warrants criminal reporting, and why the university has not dismissed him. The Minister called the statements abject, said criminality is not for her to determine, left employment and conduct measures to the university as employer, described the inspectorate's and Raad van Toezicht's roles, and rejected the claim that the university lacks moral authority.
It is for Radboud University, as employer, to take measures towards its staff where necessary.
Het is aan de Radboud Universiteit om, als werkgever, zo nodig maatregelen te nemen richting haar medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over het schrappen van 80 tot 100 banen door Universiteit Utrecht

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Utrecht University cutting 80 to 100 jobs and reducing services due to government budget cuts, and about degree programme closures and knowledge loss. The minister replied that universities have broad autonomy over budget and programme decisions, cited multiple causes including falling student numbers and expiring temporary funds, and declined to intervene or commit to new consultations.
Institutions have autonomy over starting, stopping and shaping their education and research.
Instellingen hebben autonomie over het starten, stoppen en het vormgeven van hun onderwijs en onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de Nederlandse audiovisuele sector

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the status of an independent sector-wide study of the Dutch audiovisual sector, the lessons from Belgium's Tax Shelter, the PPMC report on fair pay costs, and steps to advance fair pay. The minister answered that the study starts in Q3 2025 with a first edition expected in Q2 2026, that a comparative country analysis including the Belgian Tax Shelter will be commissioned, and that fair pay is a shared responsibility supported by existing funding and practice instruments.
I will share the research report with your House in due course.
Ik zal het onderzoeksrapport te zijner tijd met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat sportmedium Sport Knowhow XL wordt overgenomen door Golazo Media

MP Van Nispen asks the government about the takeover of sports media outlet Sport Knowhow XL by Golazo Media, which also publishes other sports titles and runs sports events, and the risks to independence and diversity of sports reporting. Minister Bruins replies that the takeover is between private parties, was not notifiable to the ACM, and that other independent media still cover sports policy, without describing concrete steps.
The takeover concerns an agreement between private media parties.
De overname betreft een overeenkomst tussen private mediapartijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikkers over het aantal mannen in de kinderopvang

An MP asked the state secretary whether the falling number of male childcare workers is caused by parental distrust, and what is being done to attract men. The state secretary replied that men's share has risen from 4.5 percent in 2010 to 6.4 percent in 2024, that existing safeguards protect children, and that no new specific action is planned beyond the existing recruitment campaign.
First, I want to point out that there is no decline in the number of men in childcare, but rather an increase.
Allereerst wil ik benoemen dat er geen sprake is van een teruglopend aantal mannen in de kinderopvang, maar juist een stijgend aantal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de subsidie uitkeringen tijdens het Herdenkingsjaar Slavernijverleden en het slavernijverledenfonds

The MP Eerdmans asks about subsidies from the Herdenkingsjaar Slavernijverleden, including a dance project featuring a Rwandan king, how subsidy payments were checked given Finance Ministry warnings, a full list of subsidies, and whether any underspending of the 200 million euro slavery fund should return to the treasury. The ministers answer that the project fits the scheme's aims, that the funds' annual reports and standard procedures provide verification and accountability, that no underspending is currently foreseen, and that any underspending would be redistributed to the fund's goals rather than returned.
The spending of the subsidy funds has been fully accounted for through the public annual reports of the Mondriaan Fund and the Fund for Cultural Participation.
De bestedingen van de subsidiegelden zijn volledig verantwoord via de openbare jaarverslagen van het Mondriaan Fonds en het Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Van der Burg over de reportage ‘Voelbare kunst, hoorbare grafieken en dobbelstenen met braille op een bijeenkomst in Amsterdam over visueel beperkten’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how accessible museums and the cultural sector are for people with visual impairments, following a newspaper report on a conference about tactile reading methods. The minister acknowledged the report, agreed culture should be accessible to all, described existing museum initiatives and subsidies, and said a subsidy scheme and a knowledge point on accessible culture are being developed, without a count of museums with tactile art.
The exact number of museums that already offer tactile art and other initiatives to make museums more accessible for people with disabilities is not known.
Het exacte aantal musea waarin al sprake is van voelbare kunst en andere initiatieven om musea toegankelijker te maken voor mensen met een beperking is niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mohandis, Eerdmans, Kostić en Oostenbrink over ledenwerving van ledenomroep WNL op het VVD-congres

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, JA21, PvdD and BBB asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether it is acceptable that broadcaster WNL recruited members at the VVD party congress while wearing press badges, and how this squares with the integrity code and WNL's statutes. The Minister says such recruitment is undesirable, that broadcasters must be careful to distinguish membership drives from journalism, that the Commissariaat voor de Media is the supervisor of the binding parts of the code, and that the membership criterion will be abolished in the planned reform of the public broadcasting system.
I attach great value to the independence of the media.
Ik hecht zeer grote waarde aan de onafhankelijkheid van de media.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens ver het schrappen van 130 tot 180 banen bij Wageningen Universiteit

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Wageningen University's plan to cut about €80 million, including 130 to 180 jobs, and whether this harms teaching and research quality. The Minister said the university is autonomous, cited falling student numbers and reduced funding as causes, and declined to assess the specific impacts, while pointing to the budget decisions already made.
It is not possible for the ministry to make statements about the consequences of the cuts specifically on the Wageningen education and research climate and the local and regional economy.
Het is voor het ministerie niet mogelijk om uitspraken te doen over de gevolgen van specifiek de bezuinigingen op het Wageningse onderwijs- en onderzoekklimaat en de lokale en regionale economie.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Beckerman en Gabriëls over het bericht 'Uitvoering reorganisatie Aardwetenschappen halfjaar uitgesteld'

MPs Beckerman and Gabriëls asked whether the VU's planned reorganisation of its Earth sciences department, and the national budget cuts behind it, endanger national knowledge capacity, and asked the minister to intervene. The minister answered that the reorganisation stems from several factors besides cuts, that institutions are autonomous, and that he will not intervene or pause the decision-making, while noting the VU is consulting and commissioning an external study.
Institutions have autonomy over starting, stopping and shaping their teaching and research.
Instellingen hebben autonomie over het starten, stoppen en het vormgeven van hun onderwijs en onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief en Paternotte over het tekort aan studentenhuisvesting in Delft en elders

MPs Vijlbrief and Paternotte asked about a shortage of student housing in Delft and elsewhere, including the threatened loss of student rooms, the effect of the rent freeze, the exclusion of students from the rent allowance (huurtoeslag), falling student purchasing power and rent-regulation rules. The minister responds by pointing to the national student housing action plan, a 25% rise in the WWSO point price, planned temporary contracts and hospitality rental incentives, a new subsidy scheme, and reasons why rent allowance extension is not currently feasible, while deferring several items to future reports.
The current cabinet is continuing this approach.
Het huidige kabinet zet deze aanpak voort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boon en Van der Hoeff over antisemitisme en oproep tot ingrijpen wegens wanbeheer

Two PVV MPs asked the education minister whether recent occupations at the University of Amsterdam and Radboud University endangered students and staff, whether students should be expelled, and whether the minister would order an inspection and a formal instruction for alleged mismanagement by the boards. The minister answered that institutions handle disciplinary measures themselves, that the Inspectorate acts independently and a formal instruction is not currently warranted, and that the sector is being engaged on antisemitism and safety.

If the Inspectorate of Education, after investigation, concludes there is mismanagement within the meaning of the WHW, i.e. a serious degree of neglect of social safety, I can as a last resort issue a formal instruction to the Supervisory Board.

Wanneer de Inspectie van het Onderwijs na onderzoek tot de conclusie komt dat er sprake is van wanbeheer in de zin van de WHW, dus van ernstige mate van verwaarlozen van de sociale veiligheid, kan ik als ultimum remedium overgaan tot het geven van een aanwijzing aan de RvT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP from JA21 asked ministers across many departments how much money, which diversity, gender and inclusion policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and consultants their implementing agencies use. The government answered that spending is mostly embedded in general HR policy, lists the agencies' trainings and monitoring tools, and provided the requested figures per organisation where available.
There is a large number of implementing and sui generis organisations.
Er is sprake van een groot aantal uitvoerings- en sui generis organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Velde over het bericht 'AVROTROS en NPO willen gesprek met EBU over 'basisprincipes' Songfestival'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Israel's Eurovision delegation complied with EBU rules and whether its participation in 2026 should be opposed or boycotted. The Minister repeatedly declined to judge compliance, saying this is for the EBU and public broadcasters, and said the Netherlands would not rule out a boycott, as the decision lies with the broadcasters.
It is not for me as Minister to determine whether the Israeli delegation complied with the EBU rules during the Eurovision Song Contest.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om vast te stellen of de Israëlische delegatie zich aan de EBU-regels heeft gehouden tijdens het Eurovisie Songfestival.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Krul over het bericht 'Werkgevers lokken jonge werknemer met studieschuldregeling' in het FD van 11 mei 2025

MPs Inge van Dijk and Krul asked whether tax-advantaged employer repayment of student debt should be broadened, given high debts and write-offs of residual debt. The Staatssecretaris answered that the existing workplace expenses scheme and free allowance already allow it, that a specific exemption does not fit the scheme's purpose, and that budgetary effects of broadening it would need to be financed and are being evaluated.
The ongoing evaluation of the workplace expenses scheme will also consider whether employers should be fiscally incentivised to let employees repay student debt at favourable terms.

Bij de op dit moment lopende evaluatie van de werkkostenregeling wordt ook meegenomen of werkgevers fiscaal gestimuleerd moeten worden voor het voordelig laten aflossen van studieschulden door werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over Pro-Palestijnse rellen op universiteiten en de Raden van Toezicht van Nederlandse onderwijsinstellingen

An MP asked the Minister of Education about pro-Palestinian disruptions at Dutch universities and whether the minister appoints Supervisory Board members, and how those members are selected and held to account for safety. The minister answered that he contacted institutions, that boards bear primary responsibility for safety, that he appoints members of public universities' supervisory boards via a profile-based procedure, and that a safety duty bill and an inspectorate study are underway.
I do not report on or evaluate this.
Ik rapporteer of evalueer dit niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Rooderkerk over onverwachte bezuinigingen van een half miljard euro extra op onderwijs in de Voorjaarsnota.

Two D66 MPs asked the education minister why nearly half a billion euros in extra cuts to education were introduced in the spring budget memorandum, given pressure on basic skills, and asked about the effects on pupils losing the education opportunities scheme, higher education funding, vocational practical training, and consistency with earlier parliamentary deals. The minister answered that the net budget rises structurally by about 2 billion euros, that the cuts are offsets within the OCW budget, that the education opportunities scheme is abolished (about 177 million per year) with the government pointing to other basic-skills programmes, and that institutions can absorb the higher education and practical-training reductions.
With this spring budget memorandum, the OCW budget is structurally increased by a net of about 2 billion euros, largely as a result of the fully paid-out wage adjustment.
Met deze Voorjaarsnota wordt er per saldo structureel circa € 2 miljard toegevoegd aan de OCW-begroting, grotendeels als gevolg van de loonbijstelling die volledig wordt uitgekeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het Nationaal Burgerberaad Klimaat

MP Vermeer asked ministers about a children's climate summit run under the National Citizens' Climate Assembly, questioning the factual accuracy and one-sidedness of its video and materials, the role of government, costs, and whether climate education for children should be regulated. The minister responded that the independent chair commissioned and reviewed the summit, acknowledged that the video needed nuance and a fact-check was added, stated government does not produce school materials given freedom of education, and gave a cost of about 61,000 euro.
The chair acknowledged that as commissioner she should have been sharper about the examples and facts presented.
De voorzitter heeft erkend dat zij als opdrachtgever scherper had moeten zijn op de gepresenteerde voorbeelden en feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Universiteit Maastricht verbiedt lezing van Joodse student; pro-Palestijnse activiteiten gaan wel door'

An MP from JA21 asked the Education minister whether a university's cancellation of a lecture by a Jewish student, while pro-Palestinian events went ahead, undermines academic freedom and safety for Jewish students. The minister answered that institutions are responsible for weighing safety and debate, that the university is being very restrictive about political events on Gaza/Israel pending an external investigation, and that a broader safety and anti-antisemitism programme is under way.
It is the responsibility of the institutions to weigh whether or not to let an event go ahead.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de instellingen om af te wegen of zij een bijeenkomst wel of niet door laten gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vroonhoven over de klaarblijkelijk norm-overschrijdende bezoldiging van NOS topfunctionarissen

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the NOS director-general was paid as an interim director during her first months in a permanent post, and whether the supervisory board, the Commissariaat voor de Media or the Belastingdienst should examine the employment relationship. The minister answers that the NOS followed WNT rules, that the accountant's audit confirmed compliance, that the Commissariaat will prioritise a legality check of the 2024 accounts, and that reviewing the supervisory board's functioning and governance is under consideration, but declines to ask the Belastingdienst or Commissariaat to examine the employment relationship beforehand.
Following the reports, the Commissariaat voor de Media has indicated it will carry out the legality review of the NOS's 2024 annual accounts as a priority.
Het Commissariaat voor de Media heeft naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving aangegeven de rechtmatigheidstoetsing van de jaarverantwoording van de NOS over 2024 met prioriteit uit te zullen voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Stultiens en Heite over een vragenlijst van de Amerikaanse overheid

MPs Paternotte, Stultiens and Heite asked the Dutch government about a US federal questionnaire sent to Dutch researchers, probing cooperation with communist or totalitarian parties, gender ideology and benefits to American industry, and about possible US influence on academic freedom. The minister expressed concern, said Dutch institutions must protect academic freedom and that the government would raise the matter with the US and inform parliament before summer, but gave no detail on how many researchers were affected.
Before the summer I will inform your House by letter about academic freedom.
Voor de zomer zal ik uw Kamer informeren middels een brief over academische vrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het bericht 'Fransen willen Amerikanen 'wetenschappelijk asiel' verlenen'

Two Volt MPs asked the Dutch education minister about the French plan to grant US scientists 'scientific asylum' and what the Netherlands would do to attract American researchers. The minister declined to judge French policy, stressed academic freedom and pointed to EU and national measures such as a EUR 25 million NWO instrument, without giving figures on US researchers arriving.
I currently have no specific information on appointments of scientists broken down by where they come from or what their intentions are.
Ik heb op dit moment geen specifieke informatie over de aanstellingen van wetenschappers in combinatie met waar ze vandaan komen of wat hun voornemens zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oostenbrink en Rikkers-Oosterkamp over het bericht ‘Kabinet zet streep door nieuwe tandartsopleiding in Rotterdam, Zeeland teleur gesteld; Absoluut onwenselijke situatie

MPs Oostenbrink and Rikkers-Oosterkamp asked why the cabinet dropped a new dental training programme in Rotterdam and kept the six-year dental course, despite the shortage of dentists in Zeeland. The ministers answered that the decision concerns keeping the six-year duration, that starting a new programme is up to institutions and the field under a fixed procedure, that 31 places are being realised now with a new capacity forecast expected at year end, and that shortening the course would only free funds from 2033.
At the end of 2025 the next integral forecast of the Capacity Body is expected.
Eind 2025 wordt de eerstvolgende integrale raming van het Capaciteitsorgaan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk, Pijpelink en Beckerman over het bericht 'Nationaal Onderwijsmuseum in Dordrecht dreigt te verdwijnen vanwege geldgebrek'

MPs asked why the Minister is ending funding for the National Education Museum in Dordrecht, whether alternatives were explored, and whether the decision will be reconsidered. The Staatssecretaris replied that budget cuts forced choices favouring core education tasks, that alternatives would require a substantial subsidy increase deemed unavailable, that the collection belongs to the museum foundation, and that no reconsideration is planned.
I informed the Education Museum as early as possible to give it the chance to seek alternative funding or, if it sees no options, to achieve a careful wind-down.

Ik heb het Onderwijsmuseum zo vroeg mogelijk geïnformeerd om de kans te bieden op zoek te gaan naar alternatieve financiering of, als zij hier geen mogelijkheden voor zien, een zorgvuldige afbouw te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over de verplichte rekentoets in het mbo

An MP asked the Minister of Education about concerns that mbo students with diagnosed arithmetic problems such as dyscalculia may fail to obtain their diploma because of the compulsory maths test, and about options for schools to apply tailored support and flexibility. The Minister acknowledged the concerns, said schools have a responsibility to offer support such as extra time or oral examination, but rejected giving schools more room to award diplomas without a passed maths test and saw no need for further differentiation yet.
I do not consider it desirable that students without the correct result in arithmetic be eligible for a diploma.
Ik acht het niet wenselijk dat studenten zonder het juiste resultaat op rekenen in aanmerking komen voor een diploma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat de helft van de fiscale hoogleraren belastingrecht een commerciële baan erbij heeft

MP Stultiens asked the ministers about research showing 71 percent of tax law professors hold commercial side jobs, the reasons for variation across universities, whether a side-job freeze should apply, and gender imbalance. Minister Bruins replied that side jobs are not inherently undesirable, that universities and the national integrity code govern them, that a register and an updated code are being prepared, and that setting percentages is for universities.
Professors with side positions are not per se undesirable.
Hoogleraren met nevenfuncties zijn niet per definitie onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heite over het screenen van wetenschappers en studenten door hogeronderwijsinstellingen omwille van de nationale veiligheid en wie dit moet bekostigen

An MP asked several ministers whether universities should bear the costs of the proposed screening of researchers and students for national security reasons, and whether this is a shared national responsibility. The minister answered that knowledge security is a cabinet-wide shared responsibility, that funding is partly shifted from Justice and Security to OCW, and that the screening law is a national policy choice, while stating that the government will not provide further legal grounding beyond the existing funding framework.
Yes, universities and colleges are responsible for keeping security in order and mitigating these risks.
Ja, hogescholen en universiteiten dragen verantwoordelijkheid voor het op orde hebben van beveiliging en het mitigeren van deze risico’s.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon, Van der Hoef en Uppelschoten over het bericht 'Lezing pro-Israëlische activiste op Radboud Universiteit ruw verstoord, aangifte tegen gemaskerde docent: ’Hij leidde de bende’ en anti

MPs from the PVV asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a disrupted lecture at Radboud University, lecturers linked to Scholars for Palestine, alleged antisemitic slogans at demonstrations, and the awarding of a contract for antisemitism-prevention lessons in schools. The Minister said universities must report offences and take measures proportionate to the situation, that the TU Delft and UM handle their own assessments, and that the Fawaka contract was awarded on multiple criteria with the award documents withheld as confidential.
The associated award and assessment documents cannot be sent to the House, because they contain commercially sensitive and confidential information.
De bijbehorende gunnings- en beoordelingsdocumenten kunnen we niet aan de Kamer toesturen, omdat deze bedrijfsgevoelige en vertrouwelijke informatie bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de onrust op Nederlandse universiteiten nadat een pro-Israelische spreker een lezing heeft gehouden

Eerdmans (JA21) asks the Ministers of Education and of Justice about disruption at Radboud and Maastricht universities during a lecture by a pro-Israeli speaker, including risk assessments, security measures, handling of disruptors, and protection of Jewish and Israeli students. Minister Bruins answers that the institutions bear primary responsibility for risk assessment and security, that the ministry has been in contact with them, that the minister has no central data on sanctions or students who stay away, and that the minister will inform parliament before the summer recess on follow-up discussions with the sector.
Assessing the risks of lectures and taking security measures, and involving the competent parties where necessary, is the responsibility of the institution in consultation with the local triangle.

Het beoordelen van de risico's van lezingen en het nemen van veiligheidsmaatregelen en het daarbij waar nodig inschakelen van daartoe bevoegde partijen, is de verantwoordelijkheid van de instelling in samenspraak met de lokale driehoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Martens-America over het bericht ‘Lezing pro-Israëlische activiste op Radboud Universiteit ruw verstoord, aangifte tegen gemaskerde docent: ’Hij leidde de bende’’

MPs Stoffer and Martens-America asked the government about disruptions of pro-Israel lectures at Radboud University and Maastricht University, the role of a masked lecturer, risk assessments, and whether institutions take action against staff and students. The minister condemns illegal disruption, describes the universities' risk measures and says institutions should report suspected crimes, while refusing to share confidential information on staff measures and noting that such measures against students are not centrally recorded.
However, I have asked these institutions about this.
Antwoord 4 Ik heb dit nagevraagd bij deze instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het lot van de witoorpenseelapen in het apenproefdiercentrum

An MP asked whether the BPRC primate centre will rehome its roughly 50 white-eared pied colobus monkeys to a foreign research institute rather than a sanctuary, and why the government supports this. The minister confirmed the transfer abroad, stated that the destination is not yet known, argued that the monkeys remain needed for research on serious infectious disease, and declined to ask the BPRC to choose a sanctuary instead.

The BPRC has been asked to inform me, in compliance with applicable regulations such as the GDPR, as soon as it has reached an agreement with an organisation or institution and the monkeys have been moved there.

Het BPRC is gevraagd mij, met in achtneming van geldende regelgeving zoals de AVG, te informeren zodra het BPRC tot een overeenkomst met een organisatie of instelling is gekomen en de apen daar naartoe zijn verplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Hoeff over het artikel ‘VU laat pro-Palestina demonstratie toe tijdens belangrijk tentamen: ‘Neem koptelefoon mee’'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Education whether the VU's decision to allow a pro-Palestinian demonstration during an important exam was proportionate, and whether recent talks with universities were improving outcomes. The Minister replied that the VU did not formally permit the disturbance, that it rescheduled activities and took crowd-control measures, and that he had spoken with the VU but saw no reason for further talks.
I have discussed this with the VU and obtained information about the incident in question.
Ik ben hierover met de VU in gesprek gegaan en heb informatie ingewonnen over het genoemde voorval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over Gratis bibliotheeklidmaatschap

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Rotterdam's free library membership for all residents and whether financial barriers to libraries should be removed, and asked whether the initiative could be rolled out more widely. The minister welcomed the Rotterdam measure, pointed to existing access-widening efforts and a study on free or automatic membership due by year-end, and noted library membership fees amount to about 10% of operating costs.
I will certainly take the experiences of libraries with free membership into account in the study described in the answer to question 3.
Ik zal de ervaringen van bibliotheken met een gratis lidmaatschap zeker betrekken bij het onderzoek beschreven in het antwoord op vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mohandis over artiesten en concert-/festivalgangers met een beperking

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Health, Welfare and Sport about the accessibility of concerts, festivals and theatre for artists and audiences with disabilities, referring to a manifesto, the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and shortages of accessible seating and sign-language interpreters. The minister acknowledges remaining gaps but states that the cultural sector itself is primarily responsible, that the ministry sets frameworks and funds initiatives such as the Routekaart Toegankelijke Festivals and a planned Kennispunt Toegankelijke Cultuur, and that a work agenda on the UN Convention will be sent to Parliament.
The ministry takes its responsibility by setting preconditions and creating frameworks.
Het ministerie neemt zijn verantwoordelijkheid door randvoorwaarden te stellen en kaders te scheppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Stultiens over hulp aan studenten met een functiebeperking

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Education about uneven support for students with disabilities, the DUO prestatiebeurs scheme, and medical debt forgiveness refusals. The Minister acknowledges growing application numbers, says the decentralised process causes variation, promises research with results by summer 2026, and explains that medical debt forgiveness is reserved for exceptional cases and rejections often stem from missing medical information.
I will therefore investigate this as part of a broader study into tailored provisions for students with support needs.
Dit ga ik daarom onderzoeken als onderdeel van een breder onderzoek naar maatwerkvoorzieningen voor studenten met een ondersteuningsbehoefte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over een onderzoek naar misstanden bij NPO

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the NPO supervisory board acted in time and adequately on reports of intimidation and an unsafe work climate at the NPO, and what lessons and steps should follow. The minister said the board had talked with the works council, pointed the board chair to his responsibility, received assurances of closer oversight and an interim chair, and declined to judge the board's handling beyond saying social safety is primarily the employer's matter; he noted the Commissariaat voor de Media or the board itself could order an investigation.
That is always in the first instance a matter for the employer, and as Minister I should exercise restraint there.
Dat is altijd in eerste instantie een zaak van de werkgever en daar past mij als Minister terughoudendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heite over het artikel ‘UM werft toch weer buitenlandse studenten’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a newspaper report that Maastricht University was again recruiting international students despite a recruitment freeze and uncertain programme continuity. The Minister replied that the freeze still applies, that the university's limited outreach was in the Euregio and in shortage sectors, and that the government will pursue a stabler funding and macro-efficient programme offering.
The self-steering plans of UNL also state that institutions will not actively recruit at international fairs and exhibitions.
Ook in de zelfregieplannen van UNL staat dat instellingen niet actief gaan werven op internationale beurzen en fairs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked multiple ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy, budgets, training, quotas and evaluation within implementing agencies. The answers, given for RVO and TNO, describe small budgets, existing training programmes, targets for gender and cultural diversity and no external consultants.
No external organisations or consultants have been hired.
Er zijn geen externe organisaties of consultants ingehuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

MP Eerdmans asked ministers about the budget, content, training, monitoring and external advisers of diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The government answered for the NVWA, estimating about €70,000 for 2025, listing planned priorities and training, and stating it has no external consultants and no removal of artworks; it also said it would answer per agency separately.
Question 8: Could you provide the answers per implementing agency separately? Answer 8: Yes.
Vraag 8 Zou u de beantwoording per uitvoeringsinstantie afzonderlijk kunnen aanleveren? Antwoord 8 Ja.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Paternotte over de gevolgen van bezuinigingen op onderwijsinstellingen en de gevolgen van de aanpak internationalisering

MPs Jetten and Paternotte asked about layoffs and department closures at Dutch universities (Twente, UCR, Open Universiteit, UvA) linked to budget cuts, the effects on regional functions and technical labour shortages, and the rules on English-language programmes. The minister answers that the layoffs are not directly tied to the cuts, that institutions have autonomy over their choices, that the cuts will not be reconsidered, and that a regional criterion in the internationalisation law and a broader approach to student numbers are planned.
The cabinet stands behind the choices made and considers the budget cuts realistic and feasible.
Het kabinet staat achter de gemaakte keuzes en beschouwt de bezuinigingen als realistisch en uitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over doorgeslagen marktwerking van studentenfaciliteiten

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the revised 'publiek-privaat' policy rule on investing public funds in private student facilities such as sports centres and canteens reduces access and increases marktwerking. The minister answered that the rule forces no institution to act, that student facility policy is unchanged, and declined to provide a full list of affected centres because institutions do not report at that level of detail.
Dit overzicht kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Wal over Nederlandse oorlogsmusea

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the value of Dutch war museums, their state subsidies, inclusion in the cultural basic infrastructure, Rijkscultuurfonds support, financial health, and Holocaust education. The Minister answered that museums 40-45 receive no structural Rijk subsidy but get project and digitisation support, that they are not in the BIS because provinces did not nominate them, and that a Holocaust education plan and a school-visit cost study are underway.
I have no insight into the financial situation of the war museums specifically.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de financiële situatie van specifiek de oorlogsmusea.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het verdwijnen van Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty

An MP asked the government about the US decision to stop funding Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty and its consequences for independent media and disinformation. The minister acknowledged the loss as a setback, said Russia-controlled media may gain room, and pointed to joint EU and Czech efforts to find alternative funding, without committing to a specific Dutch funding step.
The cabinet is working with other EU member states and like-minded countries to find financial resources that enable RFE/RL and other free media to continue their important work.

Het kabinet zet zich, in samenwerking met andere EU-lidstaten en gelijkgezinde landen, in voor het vinden van financiële middelen die RFE/RL en andere vrije media in staat stellen hun belangrijke werk voort te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over het bericht 'Omroepen gebruiken gratis peperdure zendtijd in strijd tegen bezuiniging op NPO: 'Niet correct''

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why public broadcasters used their identification slots to campaign against planned cuts to the NPO, and whether this compromised their independence. The minister answered that the slots were a fixed, non-commercial segment, staff acted outside working hours, and that the government would not comment on media content given broadcaster independence.
I do not decide on the content of the media offering.
Ik ga niet over de inhoud van het media-aanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het artikel 'Hongarije neemt wet aan die Pride-mars verbiedt'

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked whether the government shares concern about Hungary's law banning Pride marches, its fines and facial recognition, what message the Netherlands conveys to Hungary, and whether the minister will join the Budapest Pride. The government calls the Hungarian laws very worrying, says the Commission must assess EU law compliance and urges action, reports a BeNeLux statement at the Council of Europe and conveyed concerns to the ambassador, and says the minister will not attend Pride though participation is still being considered.
The Netherlands will call on the Commission to do this expeditiously and take action if it finds that Union law has been breached.
Nederland zal de Commissie oproepen om dit voortvarend te doen en actie te ondernemen indien zij constateert dat het Unierecht is geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Hoeff over de evaluatie van de meiprotesten 2024 op de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA)

An MP asks the minister how she views the Berenschot evaluation of the May 2024 protests at the University of Amsterdam, including whether university boards can keep order, whether boards should resign, and whether the UvA should be placed under enhanced supervision. The minister says the evaluation is welcome and the UvA will act on its lessons, rejects the claim that boards act above the law, declines to provide disciplinary figures (a matter for the UvA), and rules out enhanced supervision since no mismanagement has been established by the Inspectorate.
Placing the UvA under enhanced supervision is not an option.
Het plaatsen van de UvA onder verscherpt toezicht is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht 'Nederlandse universiteiten bieden onderdak aan bange onderzoekers en bedreigde gegevens uit de VS'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Netherlands and Europe should offer safe haven to US researchers and protect data at risk, including funds to attract them and storage for climate models. The minister said Europe and the Netherlands should be a safe haven for science, is in talks with European colleagues and universities, and will work on a targeted funding instrument with NWO and UNL, without a concrete national action plan.
I informed your House on 20 March about the establishment of a targeted and focused funding instrument to attract international scientific talent.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 20 maart jongstleden geïnformeerd over de oprichting van een afgebakend en gericht financieringsinstrument voor het aantrekken van internationaal wetenschappelijk talent

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Krul en Vedder over het bericht 'Zie de mens, niet het getal'; Senioren lopen aan tegen 'discriminatie op basis van leeftijd', ouderenorganisatie luidt noodklok'

MPs Inge van Dijk, Krul and Vedder (CDA) asked the government to respond to reports and a survey by ANBO-PCOB showing widespread age discrimination against seniors, and to set out measures across finance, labour, vehicle rental and volunteering. The minister answered that age discrimination is serious, that the government will discuss the survey with ANBO-PCOB, and that existing policies such as the Offensief Gelijke Kansen apply, but that no specific action plans exist for finance and no concrete new measures were announced beyond a planned study on vehicle rental insurance.
The fact that so many older people experience age discrimination is a reason for me to discuss the results of this research further with ANBO-PCOB.
Het gegeven dat zoveel ouderen leeftijdsdiscriminatie ervaren is voor mij aanleiding om met ANBO-PCOB verder te spreken over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Kent en Beckerman over stagiairs van Transavia die in 2023 als personeel werden ingezet

An SP MP asks ministers how interns placed as employees at Transavia, who can only recover wages through the civil courts, are helped by school complaint procedures, SBB and the Inspectorate, and whether a complaints point or lower court threshold is needed. The minister answers that schools, SBB and the Inspectorate have no power to enforce wages, that legal aid and the regelrechter experiment exist, that the Arbeidsinspectie fined Transavia and later accepted its adjusted internship practice, and that additional measures are premature.

Educational institutions, SBB and the Inspectorate of Education have no legal authority to enforce wage payments or settle wage disputes, because this falls under civil employment law and not their tasks.

Onderwijsinstellingen, de SBB en de Inspectie van het Onderwijs hebben geen juridische bevoegdheid om loonbetalingen af te dwingen of geschillen over loon te beslechten, omdat dit valt onder het (civiele) arbeidsrecht en niet onder hun taken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over één- of tweevakkigheid van de tweedegraads lerarenopleidingen

An MP asked the minister about the history of two-subject teacher training in the Netherlands, comparison with other European countries, and whether dual qualifications for shortage subjects like German should be supported, including in a plan to address teacher shortages. The minister explained that two-subject training was abolished in 1989 for quality reasons, that dual qualifications remain possible at institutions' discretion, and that a Herstelplan Kwaliteit Onderwijs focuses on staffing quality.
The current two-qualification system offers possibilities for training towards a dual qualification.
Het huidige tweebevoegdhedenstelsel biedt mogelijkheden voor het opleiden tot een dubbele bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Verdachte van UvA-rellen voor rechter: 'Politie was goed beschermd, ik ben onschuldig'

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked whether the government would revoke the residence permit of a Chinese student convicted for riot-related violence at the University of Amsterdam, and how it views such conduct. The minister condemned the violence, said individual cases are for the courts, and explained the IND's general framework for revoking student permits on public-order grounds, without committing to a timeline for this case.
However, I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan echter niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in executive agencies; this answer from the Education minister covers DUO and NWO. The minister says there are no plans to intensify or scale back the policy, explains the budget and training offered, and states that the set of questions concerns internal personnel policy rather than checks on executive power.
OCW has no specific diversity or gender policy.
OCW heeft geen specifiek diversiteits- of genderbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over het bericht "Aantal mbo’ers loopt komende jaren verder terug ‘Niet meer alles verwachten van de zorg’'

An MP asks the Minister of Education about reports that the number of mbo students will keep falling, and about measures on dropout, late entrants, internship allowances, and funding after the shrinkage grants end in 2027. The minister acknowledges demographic decline, outlines existing action plans and a planned overhaul of the funding system, and answers each question without addressing parliamentary oversight of the executive.
That is why work is under way on changing the funding system.
Daarom wordt er gewerkt aan een wijziging van de bekostigingssystematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid White over de zorgwekkende staat van het funderend onderwijs op Curaçao

MP White asked the minister how the Curaçao education inspectorate's alarming report on primary education should be explained, whether the situation was discussed at the 2024 M4LO meeting, what the Caribbean countries and the Netherlands can do, and how the BES islands are included. The minister replies that education is a matter for the autonomous Caribbean countries, that the issue was not specifically tabled at M4LO 2024, that cooperation runs through voluntary programmes such as Kibrahacha and SEA, and that Caribbean Netherlands is represented by the Netherlands with separate island education agendas.
For this reason it is not for the Ministry of OCW to make statements about reports on education in Curaçao prepared by the Curaçao Education Inspectorate or one of the other countries.

Het is hierdoor niet aan het Ministerie van OCW om uitspraken te doen over rapporten over het onderwijs in Curaçao die zijn opgesteld door de Inspectie van het Onderwijs van Curaçao of één van de andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er op een derde van de mbo’s sport- en beweeglessen geen structureel onderdeel van het curriculum zijn

MP Van Nispen asked about a report finding that sport and movement lessons are not a structural part of the curriculum at a third of mbo schools, and about barriers such as accommodation, timetables and funding. The state secretary replied that vocational schools themselves decide how to organise movement education, pointed to voluntary tools and programmes such as TestJeLeefstijl, the Gezonde School approach and quality funds, and said there is no statutory hours norm in vocational education.
It is up to the vocational schools themselves whether and how they organise movement education.
Het is aan mbo-instellingen zelf of en hoe zij bewegingsonderwijs vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker over mogelijke beïnvloeding van Nederlandse media, NGO’s en onderzoeksinstituten

An MP from FVD asked the Education, Culture and Science Minister and the Foreign Affairs Minister about possible USAID and EU (EIB) financing of Dutch media, NGOs and research institutions, and the risk of foreign influence on opinion-making and elections. The government answered that it has no insight into USAID funding or its conditions, that media independence is governed by self-regulation and press freedom, and that it sees no reason for a study of foreign financing, while noting a broader concern about state interference in knowledge institutions.
There is currently no insight from the government into funding from USAID to Dutch, or Netherlands-oriented, media companies or NGOs.
Er is momenteel vanuit de overheid geen zicht op financiering vanuit USAID aan Nederlandse, c.q. op Nederland gerichte mediabedrijven of NGO’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het verbod op gebedsrituelen op het Cobbenhagenlyceum

An MP asked the government whether a Tilburg secondary school's refusal to allow prayer during breaks violates religious freedom and equal treatment law. The State Secretary answered that the school denies any prayer ban, that a special school may require adherence to its denominational principles under the Awgb, and that the Inspectorate and courts, not the government, would assess compliance, so no new measures are planned.
These bodies will assess case by case whether the school's policy is indeed in line with the law.
Deze instanties zullen van geval tot geval beoordelen of het beleid van de school inderdaad in overeenstemming is met de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked the ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removal, quotas, success metrics and consultants. The government answered for the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, saying the spending is about EUR 60,000 within normal operations, no artworks were removed, the statutory disability quota applies, and no external consultants were hired.
External organisations or consultants are not hired to advise on the above-mentioned themes.
Externe organisaties of consultants worden niet ingehuurd voor advisering op het gebied van bovengenoemde thema’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Pijpelink over het bericht dat criminele ronselaars hun slag slaan op scholen

MPs Mutluer and Pijpelink asked the ministers of Justice and Education about reports that criminal recruiters increasingly target pupils at schools, and what the government knows, trains, and does about it. The minister answers that no figures on school recruitment are recorded, points to a study requested from the Centre for Child and Human Trafficking, existing school safety duties, a planned notification duty for serious incidents, and the Preventie met Gezag programme, and says he will consult the VNG on youth workers at schools.
There are no figures available on the number of young people approached by criminals.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal jongeren dat wordt benaderd door criminelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The Minister of Health answered for RIVM: a €50,000 budget for 2025, continuation of existing policy, a 2.76% quota plus government-wide targets, and a hired project leader costing €24,000.
RIVM currently has a Diversity & Inclusion policy budget of €50,000 reserved for 2025.
Het RIVM heeft momenteel een Diversiteit & Inclusie (D&I) beleidsbudget van € 50.000,– euro gereserveerd voor 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over het artikel 'EO-directeur Arjan Lock kan dankzij nieuw statuut onbeperkt aanblijven voor jaarsalaris van ruim 200.000 euro'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a recent EO statute change, reported to let the EO director stay indefinitely, was timed and framed appropriately given planned public broadcasting reforms and term limits. The minister answered that statutes are the broadcasters' own matter, that the change followed a 2021 Media Authority request on the mission wording and did not concern terms, and that term limits will be set in the reform law while broadcasters are already aligning their statutes to two five-year terms.
I have no role in assessing the statutes of broadcasting associations.
Ik heb geen rol ten aanzien van de beoordeling van de statuten van omroepverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Pijpelink over dreigende ontslagen bij University College Roosevelt in Middelburg

MPs Stultiens and Pijpelink asked the Minister of Education about job cuts at University College Roosevelt in Middelburg caused by budget reductions, and whether the government would reconsider its cuts and grant Zeeland an exemption from the Wet internationalisering in balans. The minister acknowledged the cuts and personnel effects, stated the institution has spending freedom and is accountable to its works council and supervisory board, declined a general exemption for regions while offering a regional criterion in the law.
Institutions have spending freedom over the funds they receive through funding and are responsible for implementing the cuts carefully.
Instellingen hebben bestedingsvrijheid over de middelen die zij via de bekostiging ontvangen en zijn verantwoordelijk om de bezuinigingen op zorgvuldige wijze vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Wal, Stoffer en Eerdmans over het bericht 'Nederland geeft roofkunst terug aan Nigeria: Herstel van historisch onrecht'

Three MPs (Van der Wal, Stoffer, Eerdmans) asked why the Dutch government returned 113 looted Benin objects to Nigeria without conditions, when their destination is unknown and Nigeria ranks poorly on corruption, and whether restitution was coordinated with parliament. The minister replied that unconditional return is the policy for looted objects, that the receiving government decides where objects go, that no conservation guarantees were required, and that parliament is informed of policy changes but not of individual restitution decisions.
I do not intend to inform the House of intended restitutions when handling specific cases.
Ik heb niet het voornemen de Kamer te informeren over voornemens tot restitutie bij de behandeling van specifieke casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Van der Hoeff over hakenkruizen en antisemitisme op het United World College (UWC) in Maastricht

MPs Boon and Van der Hoeff asked the Minister of Education about swastikas and antisemitism at UWC Maastricht, including a reported incident involving a six-year-old Israeli girl and whether the school handled antisemitism adequately. The State Secretary answered that the school handled six reported swastika incidents with internal investigations, sanctions in one case, and extra measures, that the inspectorate sees no reason for further steps, and that the school is urged to use the antisemitism guidance.
The inspectorate currently sees no reason for follow-up steps.
De inspectie ziet op dit moment geen reden voor vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over het bericht ‘Het bindend studieadvies verdwijnt langzaam van de hogeschool’

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the government still supports the binding study advice (bsa) in higher education, given that several universities of applied sciences are loosening it. The minister replied that the government has no plans to change the rules, that institutions keep the legal power to decide on the bsa in consultation with their works councils, and that it will not intervene with individual institutions.
Since it is the institutions' own competence, which bsa norms are applied is not centrally registered.
Aangezien het de bevoegdheid van de instellingen zelf is, wordt niet centraal geregistreerd welke bsa-normen er worden gehanteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Lahlah over onderwijs in justitiële jeugdinrichtingen

MPs Westerveld and Lahlah asked the government about education in youth detention institutions (JJI's), citing Education Council and Inspectorate reports on lack of guaranteed schooling, staffing shortages, examination barriers and detained youths in adult prisons. The government acknowledges the concerns, lists funding increases and a mbo-coordinator, and promises further reactions and letters before the summer recess, though it refers many structural questions to later responses.
That there are ongoing concerns about education in the JJIs we take extremely seriously.
Dat er aanhoudende zorgen zijn over het onderwijs in de JJI's nemen wij uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Shit, kan ik nog terug?' Chemiestudent Marieke werd twee keer geronseld voor drugslab'

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Education about reports of chemistry students being recruited by drug criminals, including signals known to universities and police, protection measures, criminal liability and prevention campaigns. The government answered that recruitment of people with specific skills occurs but its frequency is unknown, pointed to existing prevention programmes, anonymous reporting channels and the criminal law provision, and declined to set up a dedicated information point for students.
How often this exactly occurs is not known.
Hoe vaak dit precies is, is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Tseggai over de gevolgen van een langdurig ernstig verstoorde verhouding tussen studenten en hun ouders voor de hoogte van de aanvullende studiebeurs

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education whether the Centrale Raad van Beroep interprets too strictly the exemption letting students with unreachable or refusing parents obtain the full supplementary grant, and what support exists for minors. The Minister says he is studying the article and jurisprudence, will inform parliament before summer 2025, notes that about half of loskoppeling requests are granted, and refers to courts' independence.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Nordkamp over tientallen ontslagen en opheffing van meerdere vakgroepen na reorganisatie bij Universiteit Twente

MPs Stultiens and Nordkamp asked the Minister of Education about dismissals and closure of departments at the University of Twente's Faculty of Technical Natural Sciences due to budget cuts, and whether the cuts should be reconsidered. The minister confirmed the reorganisation, said the government considers the cuts realistic and feasible, stated that institutions are responsible for their own choices and accountable to works councils and internal supervision, and mentioned planned changes to funding stability and the WIB law without committing to halt the cuts.
I do not have an exhaustive overview of the intentions of educational institutions regarding dismissal of staff or closure of departments/faculties.
Ik heb geen uitputtend overzicht van de voornemens van de onderwijsinstellingen met betrekking tot ontslag van personeel of opheffing van vakgroepen/faculteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel Van Dijk, Van der Velde en Wilders over het bericht ‘Ongehoord Nederland zoekt man of vrouw, ’geen X’, OM doet onderzoek naar discriminatie’

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Education ministers why the Public Prosecution Service is investigating a broadcaster's job ad requiring 'man or woman, not X' while other cases get less attention, and whether the government recognizes only two biological sexes. The minister replied that prosecutors act on their own authority, that there is sexual diversity, that broadcasters set their own hiring within equal-treatment rules, and that no measures will be taken.
The Public Prosecution Service initiates criminal investigations on its own authority and on the basis of known principles.
Het Openbaar Ministerie stelt op eigen gezag en op basis van kenbare uitgangspunten strafrechtelijke onderzoeken in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeer en Van Zanten over het bericht 'Vernietiging Armeens erfgoed in Nagorno-Karabach: 'Doelbewust uitwissen geschiedenis''

Two BBB MPs asked whether the government would summon the Azerbaijani ambassador, urge Azerbaijan to stop destroying Armenian heritage in Nagorno-Karabakh, prosecute perpetrators, protect remaining Armenians and compensate displaced people, and add the conflict to Dutch education. The government answered that it is concerned, urged compliance with Hague conventions and peace talks, but did not commit to summoning the ambassador and deferred prosecution and compensation to the two states.
It is up to Armenia and Azerbaijan to ensure investigation and prosecution of crimes within this framework.
Het is aan Armenië en Azerbeidzjan om binnen dit kader zorg te dragen voor opsporing en vervolging van misdrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Zanten over Samidoun

An MP asked whether the government would ban a Samidoun teach-in at the University of Amsterdam, after Samidoun's Europe coordinator had earlier been barred, and what the status is of a motion to list Samidoun on the Dutch terrorist sanctions list. The minister replied that universities decide on events under academic freedom, that the UvA says the event was not officially registered and Samidoun is not welcome, and that no sufficient grounds currently exist for a court ban or sanctions listing, with a broader EU inventory and possible further measures to be reported in spring.

The conversation that has since taken place confirmed that the Public Prosecution Service currently has no information that could contribute to a request for a court ban or listing on the sanctions list.

Het gesprek dat inmiddels heeft plaatsgevonden heeft bevestigd dat het Openbaar Ministerie op dit moment geen informatie heeft die kan bijdragen aan een verzoek om verbodenverklaring bij de rechter of plaatsing op de sanctielijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked eight ministers how much money, which policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and external consultants their implementing agencies use for diversity, gender and inclusion policy. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management refers to the answers already sent on 14 January 2025 for the whole ministry, including Rijkswaterstaat, as no other information is available.
As no other information is available, reference is made to the information already shared with the House on 14 January.
Aangezien er geen andere informatie beschikbaar is, wordt daarom verwezen naar de informatie die op 14 januari al met de Kamer is gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked several ministers how much is spent on diversity, gender and inclusion policy at executive agencies, how it is shaped, whether artworks were removed, and how success is measured. The Minister of Finance answered with budget figures, the continuation of current policy, quota and ambition targets, and confirmed separate answers per agency.
In the coming years the current diversity, gender and inclusion policy will be continued in its current form.
De komende jaren wordt het huidige diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid voortgezet zoals huidig vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Aukje de Vries over het bericht «Minister scheldt FINEB-schulden Bonaire kwijt»

MPs Martens-America and Aukje de Vries asked why the minister forgave outstanding FINEB student debts owed by Bonaire students, why this was not in the recent letter on student finance, and about the loan terms and total amounts. The minister answered fully: he forgave 373 remaining debts totaling $4.378 million from 1 January 2025, citing outdated loan terms, and acknowledged the forgiveness was decided separately from the pending review of the WSF BES and WSF 2000 student finance schemes.
I have decided to forgive the still outstanding FINEB student debts as of 1 January 2025, because the way FINEB student loans were provided is outdated and no longer fits the current era.

Ik heb het besluit genomen om de nog openstaande FINEB-studieschulden per 1 januari 2025 kwijt te schelden, omdat de wijze waarop FINEB-studieleningen zijn verstrekt verouderd is en niet meer bij deze tijd past.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht 'Als er niet meer geld komt, verdwijnen onze molens'

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that windmill preservation needs more funding and about volunteer support, subsidies and encroaching buildings threatening windmills. The Minister acknowledges the funding pressure, notes that around 80 to 120 mills need major maintenance each year, reports a provincial matching arrangement of 20 million euros, and says he will raise the wind-shadow issue with IPO and VNG.
I have committed to inform the House before the summer about the further steps I intend to take regarding the funding problems of (large) monuments.
Ik heb toegezegd uw Kamer voor de zomer te informeren over de verdere stappen die ik wil zetten met betrekking tot de financieringsproblematiek van (grote) monumenten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Diederik van Dijk, Van den Hil, Krul, Ceder, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Slagt-Tichelman, Kostić en Eerdmans over een solide toekomstplan voor Kamp Westerbork naar aanleiding van 80 jaar

MPs asked the government to respond to Kamp Westerbork memorial's financial shortfalls, deferred maintenance and the need for a sustainable future plan, and to say what it will do about the memorial's proposed plan and the Moluccan history. The state secretary answers that a solid future plan will be developed with the memorial centres, one-off 2025 funds have been reserved, the memorial's financing plan is under study, and an OHW letter on progress is expected around summer 2025.
I am studying this plan and looking at what role the central government can play in it.
Ik ben dit plan aan het bestuderen en bekijken welke rol de Rijksoverheid daarin kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Hoeff over het artikel 'Ambtenaren op ministeries moeten opstaan tegen een Wilders, Trump en Musk'

A PVV MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about remarks by the ministry's secretary-general and other civil servants, reported as calling for resistance against politicians, at a Reuring!Café event. The minister defended the civil servants' duty of neutrality and constitutional loyalty, declined to comment on individual remarks, and said discrimination will be addressed as a matter of good employership.
From their professional civil-service role, they bring all relevant aspects into well-considered political decision-making.
Vanuit hun ambtelijke professionaliteit brengen zij alle relevante aspecten in ten behoeve van goed afgewogen politieke besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removals and targets. The government answered per agency, stating UWV spends about €320,000 in 2025 and SVB about €340,967, with targets and training described and no external consultants hired.
UWV intends to continue monitoring this policy in the coming years.
UWV is voornemens dit beleid de komende jaren te blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de uitzending van het NOS journaal over vrouwelijke genitale verminking in Nederland

MP Dobbe asked the ministers of Health and Education about a NOS broadcast on rising female genital mutilation in the Netherlands, prevalence estimates, new research, prevention measures, school and asylum-centre information, mandatory reporting, community engagement, victim support, and the deductible for reconstructive surgery. The government answered that it is researching prevalence (results expected end 2025), examining protective orders and foreign measures, running existing campaigns and training, and studying a reporting duty and deductible exemption, mostly describing ongoing work without firm new commitments.
The cabinet considers female genital mutilation (FGM) a barbaric and unacceptable practice against which girls and women must be protected.
Het kabinet vindt vrouwelijke genitale verminking (vgv) een barbaarse en onaanvaardbare praktijk waartegen meisjes en vrouwen beschermd moeten worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van der Wal over uitvoering van de motie Van der Wal en Mohandis en eerder onbeantwoorde schriftelijke vragen over de bevrijdingsfestivals in het kader van 80 jaar vrijheid

MPs Mohandis and Van der Wal asked whether the government would fund Bevrijdingsfestivals in 2025 through a guarantee scheme, given a Chamber-adopted motion. The state secretary replied that interdepartmental talks ended with a one-off, final contribution of EUR 700,000 for 2025 but explained that a guarantee scheme would imply a structural relationship the government does not intend.
The cabinet, however, sees the contribution as incidental.
Het kabinet ziet de bijdrage echter als incidenteel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over het ledencriterium voor omroepen

MP Martens-America asks the minister about uncertainty over the membership criterion for broadcasters, a peildatum of 28 February 2026, and whether broadcasters should recruit members before reforms are clear. The minister confirms the earlier statements, sets out that a bill extending the current concession period by two years is pending, and says that without it a new membership count would be needed and the peildatum would be adjusted once the law passes.
Once the bill extending the period becomes law, I will adjust the peildatum and the other applicable deadlines, depending on whether the membership criterion is maintained at all.

Zodra het wetsvoorstel tot verlenging tot wet is verheven, zal ik de peildatum en de overige termijnen die van toepassing zijn aanpassen, afhankelijk van de vraag of het ledencriterium überhaupt gehandhaafd blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Loonkloof tussen mannen en vrouwen begint al in de schoolbanken'

An SP MP asked the education and social affairs ministers about a survey showing women interns receive fewer and lower internship allowances and contracts, and about sexual harassment during internships. The minister answered that the gap largely reflects field of study, pointed to existing agreements (Stagepact, anti-discrimination programme, WEB contract rules), and declined to commission new research or announce extra measures.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Van der Velde over de weigering van de Joods-Israëlische comedian Yohay Sponder door Amsterdamse club Boom Chicago en de toenemende onveiligheid voor Joodse artiesten in Nederland

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Boom Chicago should have reported threats and cooperated with police instead of cancelling Yohay Sponder's shows, whether the venue's antisemitic remark was shocking, and how the government will keep the cultural sector safe for Jewish artists. The minister agreed cancelling was regrettable, called the remark an unfortunate utterance, pointed to a VSCD incident protocol and inter-ministerial talks, and noted a Kunsten '92 project against antisemitism.

Further talks have been held between the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, the Ministry of Justice and Security and the Association of Dutch Municipalities to guarantee access to the local triangle.

Er zijn verder gesprekken gevoerd tussen het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten om de toegang tot de lokale driehoek te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder, Van Zanten, Eerdmans en Ellian over het weigeren van een Israëlische comedian door theaters in Amsterdam

MPs from five parties asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she views Amsterdam theatres declining to host Israeli comedian Yohay Sponder after threats and reactions, whether local police and municipal bodies were consulted, and what follow-up is planned.
