The minister condemns the intimidation, says cultural institutions must be free to programme, notes Boom Chicago did not follow the sector protocol, and reports ongoing talks with the alderman and Kunsten '92 to find an alternative venue.
It is intolerable that a cultural institution receives such reactions or is threatened to such an extent that a performance is cancelled.
Het is onverteerbaar dat een culturele instelling zodanige reacties krijgt of zodanig wordt bedreigd dat een voorstelling wordt geannuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de berichten dat criminelen op grote schaal actief zijn in de zorg

The SP's Dobbe asked the Ministers of VWS, OCW and Justice about reports that criminals operate on a large scale in healthcare, including fraudulent vocational certificates, unprosecuted DUO and KvK fraud reports, and whether the sector's underfunding enables abuse. The minister answered that the government is pursuing a broad integrated approach with concrete measures (stricter EVC handling, licensing extension, Wibz bill, DBA enforcement) while declining to address the underfunding claim directly and deferring follow-up info.
In line with the commitment made in earlier letters to your House, you will be informed shortly about follow-up actions by the relevant ministries to jointly curb the described abuses in healthcare.

Conform de in eerdergenoemde Kamerbrieven aan uw Kamer gedane toezegging, wordt u op korte termijn nader geïnformeerd over vervolgacties van onder andere de betrokken ministeries om gezamenlijk paal en perk te stellen aan de geschetste misstanden in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Criminelen vroegen studiefinanciering aan op naam van Helmondse vrouw: rechter geeft minister veeg uit de pan’

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked how the ministry and DUO respond to a court finding that inadequate checks let student finance be fraudulently claimed in a victim's name, and about compensation, DigiD safeguards and legal access. The minister acknowledged a 2018 control gap that has been fixed, said the debt of the victim will be written off and DUO will try to recover from perpetrators, and committed to reviewing the court's ruling on advance payments without a legal basis.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Dijk over de artikelen 'Er zijn genoeg leraren, maar ze staan niet voor de klas', 'The hidden reserve of nurses and teachers in the Netherlands' en 'Increasing the working hou

MPs Beckerman and Dijk (SP) asked why the hidden reserve of qualified teachers and nurses exceeds current shortages and what measures the government will take to activate it, including flexible working hours and reducing workload. The Staatssecretaris answered that taking up work is an individual choice, that the government pursues broader labour market policy (salaries, workload funding, a teacher campaign, admin reduction in care), and that several measures such as strategic personnel policy and a Monitor Zeggenschap are underway, but did not commit to a specific plan for the reserve.
Directly approaching or writing to the hidden reserve is technically not possible under the GDPR.
Het direct benaderen en/of aanschrijven van de stille reserve is AVG technisch niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Wal, Diederik van Dijk en Mohandis over de digitale openbaarmaking van het Centraal Archief Bijzondere Rechtspleging

MPs from D66, VVD, SGP and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science when and how the Central Archive of Special Jurisdiction (CABR) can be searched online by name of war victims and suspected collaborators, and why only names but not the underlying dossiers were published. The Minister answers that a temporary searchable facility at the National Archives is being prepared, a bill creating a legal basis for balancing privacy against access will go to consultation by end of March, and that the name index must be public as the only way to request dossiers, despite Data Protection Authority concerns.

I intend to put a draft bill out for consultation before the end of March that will create the legal basis, missed by the Data Protection Authority, for access to archives containing ordinary, special and criminal personal data.

Ik wil vóór eind maart een conceptwetsvoorstel in consultatie brengen die de door de Autoriteit persoonsgegevens (AP) gemiste grondslag zal creëren voor toegang tot archieven met gewone, bijzondere en strafrechtelijke persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pijpelink en Stultiens over de gevolgen van het wetsvoorstel Wet Internationalisering in Balans op de regio Zeeland

MPs Pijpelink and Stultiens asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the Internationalisation in Balance Act will affect University College Roosevelt and HZ in Zeeland, and how the government will prevent loss of programmes and international students. The Minister says the answers depend on an amendment-Bontenbal that requires a nota van wijziging and a letter to parliament in January, promises regional tailoring via the regional-circumstances criterion, and defends the Act as steering rather than restricting international student flows.

I am currently considering whether and how this criterion should be adjusted, in line with the Bontenbal et al. amendment, to give sufficient room for English-language teaching in regions with specific circumstances such as Zeeland.

Ik bezie op dit moment of en hoe dit criterium moet worden aangepast om – conform het amendement Bontenbal c.s. – voldoende ruimte te geven voor anderstalig onderwijs aan regio's met specifieke omstandigheden, zoals Zeeland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de tegemoetkoming studievoucher voor leenstelstelstudenten

An MP asks why university students with only a bachelor's degree under the loan system are excluded from the roughly 2,000 euro study voucher compensation while HBO students are not, and whether this is fair. The minister replies that the master's-degree requirement was set in 2015 and confirmed in 2023, that widening it would cost about 44 million euros and need legislation, and rejects changing it for policy stability reasons.
Reweighing the target group definition (for a third time) I consider undesirable in the context of stable government policy.
Het opnieuw wegen van de afbakening van de doelgroep (voor een derde keer) vind ik in het kader van stabiel overheidsbeleid onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over dreigende incidenten bij een islamitische basisschool in Nijmegen

An MP from DENK asked the Education Minister whether threatening incidents at an Islamic primary school in Nijmegen, and a possible pattern of anti-Muslim hostility toward Islamic schools, warrant concern, and how the state safeguards such schools. The State Secretary said there are no concrete signals of danger, that safety rules apply equally to all schools, and that the police handle the investigation and the schools cooperate with partners, without acknowledging a pattern.
OCW has no knowledge of the perpetrators and their motives because investigating this incident is a task of the police.
OCW heeft geen kennis omtrent de daders en hun motieven omdat het onderzoeken van dit incident een taak is van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over ‘Waarom wordt studenten aan de Erasmus Universiteit verteld dat porno een vorm van kunst is?’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a publicly funded university's Studium Generale event presenting porn-related research was appropriate for student welfare, given negative effects of sexualised media. The minister answered that the event discussed research on pornographic stereotypes, that universities decide their own welfare and event policy under academic freedom, and that the event was lawfully funded.
The aim of this event was therefore not to promote pornography, but to encourage a discussion on this theme based on research results.
Het doel van dit evenement was daarom niet het promoten van pornografie, maar het bevorderen van een discussie over dit thema aan de hand van onderzoeksresultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het verbod op bidden tijdens pauzes bij Zadkine

An MP asked ministers about the Zadkine school's ban on prayer during breaks and its compliance with equal-treatment law. The minister says the institution's email was withdrawn, pauses are free time, and the school is revising its student statute and discussing quiet rooms, with no further national measures planned.
The Zadkine board states that the wording of the email was unfortunate and gave rise to misunderstandings.
Het bestuur van Zadkine geeft aan dat de formulering van de betreffende e-mail ongelukkig gekozen is en aanleiding geeft tot misverstanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over het bericht ‘MBO Westland zet in op minder schoolverlaters: oriëntatieperiode van zes maanden’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about MBO Westland's plan for a six-month orientation period to reduce early school leaving and about loopbaanoriëntatie funding. The minister said the orientation programmes will be piloted and monitored, that investments in career guidance are being tracked with reports due in 2026 and 2028, and that a Pact Opleiden is planned, without a decision on steering study choices nationally.
I am enthusiastic about the potential of orientation programmes to guide students who at entry to MBO cannot yet make a targeted study choice towards a suitable choice.
Ik ben enthousiast over de potentie van oriëntatieprogramma's, om studenten die bij instroom in het mbo nog geen gerichte studiekeuze kunnen maken te begeleiden naar een passende keuze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over de beantwoording van vragen over het bericht over gedoe rond vergadering van pro-Palestinastudenten

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked whether universities and universities of applied sciences must keep security measures within fundamental rights, including photographing protesting students, covert listening and guards at meetings. Minister Bruins answered that institutions bear primary responsibility, that the minister has a stelselverantwoordelijkheid, that existing law and the joint protest guidelines suffice, and that complaints should go to the institution or the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
As the minister responsible for the system, I have no involvement in the institution-specific considerations institutions make when developing and implementing their security policy.
Als stelselverantwoordelijk Minister heb ik geen bemoeienis met de instellingsspecifieke afwegingen die instellingen maken bij het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van hun veiligheidsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over het bezuinigingsultimatum van de werknemers in het hoger onderwijs

MP Stultiens asks the Minister of Education whether she knows of the unions' ultimatum threatening collective action over the 1.2 billion euro higher-education cuts, and how the Minister will address the resulting workload pressure and rebuild union trust. The Minister confirms awareness, points to a 78 million euro annual workload-relief contribution through 2031, and says she is willing to talk with the unions and will share her reply with the House.
I am willing to enter into discussion with the unions about the causes of and measures against workload pressure.
Ik ben bereid om met de vakbonden in gesprek te gaan over oorzaken van en maatregelen tegen werkdruk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over Sociale veiligheid NPO

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why EUR 3.6 million in one-off funds was allocated to the NPO for social safety, given that the NPO had not made sufficient progress after the OGCO report. The minister answered that the NPO is responsible for structural costs, that the funds were withdrawn following a parliamentary motion, and that the NPO had been asked to cover costs from its regular funding.
Your House adopted a motion on 5 December requesting the government to withdraw the allocation of one-off funds for social safety at the NPO.
Uw Kamer heeft op 5 december een motie aangenomen die de regering verzoekt om de toekenning van incidentele middelen ten behoeve van sociale veiligheid bij de NPO in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Slagt- Tichelman over de financiering van de bevrijdingsfestivals

MPs Mohandis and Slagt-Tichelman asked whether the government will keep financially supporting the Dutch liberation festivals, which are at risk, and about the status of a broad future vision for 5 May. State Secretary Karremans answers that the national committee receives structural funding, that one-off direct aid was given in 2024 and no structural state guarantee is provided, and that talks with other ministries on a final one-off contribution are ongoing.
I have at least reserved budgetary space for a one-off contribution from VWS in 2025.
Ik heb in ieder geval budgettaire ruimte gereserveerd voor een incidentele bijdrage vanuit VWS in 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Bikker over het bericht dat de Campagne van Platform Zorg voor Leven geweerd is vanwege “te veel negatief commentaar”

MPs Van Dijk and Bikker asked whether the government considers it acceptable that schools and education bodies refused an anti-abortion campaign from Platform Zorg voor Leven that was not in conflict with advertising rules, and how students are informed about alternatives to abortion. The State Secretary said schools decide their own advertising and curricula under constitutional autonomy, pointed to existing sexual education, counselling and information services, and did not commit to any new action.
Schools and educational institutions themselves determine how they shape their education.
Scholen en onderwijsinstellingen bepalen zelf hoe zij hun onderwijs vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Van Zanten en Hertzberger over het bericht ‘Niet-rendabele talenstudies verdwijnen, want studenten doen liever een brede bachelor’

MPs Stoffer, Van Zanten and Hertzberger asked the Minister of Education about reports that small language programmes such as French and German are being closed at Leiden and Utrecht, and what the government will do to keep a national offering. The minister acknowledges the concern, points to the sector plan Talen & Culturen, says institutions decide on closures under an existing advisory procedure, and commits to talks with the sector and a DLG action plan, while declining to set minimum norms or a numerus fixus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Van der Burg over het bericht ‘China intimideert Nederlandse media en correspondenten’

MPs Martens-America and Van der Burg asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Foreign Affairs about reports of Chinese intimidation of Dutch media and correspondents, and what the government will do about it. The minister answers that the government will evaluate its intensified foreign interference approach in 2025, supports PersVeilig, raises concerns with Chinese authorities, and will study the China Knowledge Network report's recommendations, without committing to specific new measures.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Bikker over het rapport ‘Hamas in Europe’ en het bericht 'Buurlanden komt hij niet in, tóch mag omstreden kopstuk van pro-Palestinaclub spreken op universiteit in Nijmegen'

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the government would investigate persons and organisations linked to Hamas in a report, and whether it would act against the Samidoun coordinator invited to speak at Radboud University. The government replied that the AIVD investigation continues, that the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution, that the speaker has been flagged for entry refusal, and that talks with the Public Prosecution Service and AIVD on Samidoun-type organisations took place without indications for criminal suspicion.
Naturally, no public statement can be made about whether intelligence and security services are conducting investigations into persons or organisations.
Vanzelfsprekend kan in de openbaarheid geen uitspraak worden gedaan over al dan niet lopende onderzoeken van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten naar personen of organisaties
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Krul en Stoffer over het onderzoek ‘De herstelopdracht doorgelicht: Een verkenning naar de rechtmatigheid van herstelopdrachten in het funderend onderwijs’

MPs Ceder, Krul and Stoffer asked the Minister of Education about Professor Van Schoonhoven's study questioning whether Inspectorate remediation orders (herstelopdrachten) rest on legal grounds, and how the Inspectorate avoids overreach, distinguishes its supervisory from its stimulating role, justifies orders, and informs school boards of their rights. The Minister replies that the Inspectorate found its orders lawful, tied to statutory adequacy standards, will refine justification and frameworks, and will not withdraw any orders, while describing existing safeguards such as complaint procedures and board responses.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Gabriëls over de uitspraken van de minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat in het wetgevingsoverleg Water van 18 november 2024

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the minister's remarks on the Valencia floods in a November 2024 water committee meeting, which questioned the link to climate change, amounted to climate disinformation and undermined government commitments. The government answered that it does not know the Valencia situation, denies sowing doubt on climate change, affirms support for science, and says it will provide reliable information via independent institutions.
No. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management states that he does not know the situation in Valencia and makes no specific statements about the situation and possible explanations.
Nee. De Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat geeft aan de situatie in Valencia niet te kennen en doet geen specifieke uitspraken over de situatie en de mogelijke verklaringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Opleiding die huisartsentekort had kunnen oplossen alweer weg uit Zeeland'

MPs Tielen and Van den Hil asked why a Physician Assistant training pilot in Zeeland is ending early and students must travel to Nijmegen, and how quality of distance education was assessed. The minister said the places were temporary, responsibility for quality lies with the hogeschool, and national PA training places are being expanded as advised by the capacity body.
Responsibility for the implementation and monitoring of the quality of this programme lies with the Hogeschool van Arnhem en Nijmegen.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering en bewaking van de kwaliteit van deze opleiding ligt bij de Hogeschool van Arnhem en Nijmegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de uitspraken van minister Klever over Ongehoord Nederland

An MP asked the education minister whether the remarks by Minister Klever calling the Ongehoord Nederland situation a 'coup' and saying its programmes suffered substantively are cabinet positions, and whether ministers should comment on public broadcasters' content. The minister answered that the cabinet takes no position on the programmes, that the Commissariaat voor de Media is responsible for oversight, and that ministers should keep distance from public broadcasters' editorial independence.
It is up to the Commissariaat to supervise the public broadcasters. As Minister I have no role in this specific case and therefore cannot and will not make statements about it.
Het is aan het commissariaat om toezicht te houden op de publieke omroepen. Ik heb als Minister geen rol in deze specifieke casus en kan en wil daarom geen uitspraken doen hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Van Vroonhoven en Omtzigt over een plan om het verhuren van een kamer aan studenten veel gemakkelijker te maken

MPs Welzijn, Van Vroonhoven and Omtzigt asked the government about making it easier to rent rooms to students through hospita arrangements, covering housing shortages, mortgage and bank consent, the WWSO rent rules, the kostendelersnorm, huurtoeslag and the income-dependent rent increase. The minister answered that the rent-rule and hospita exception is already in place, that a bill to end hospita contracts on sale is being prepared, that banks' consent is being pursued, and that several questions (MKBA, huurtoeslag, exemption thresholds) are under study or not feasible now.
At present I am preparing a legislative amendment that should allow the rental contract to be terminated upon sale, only in the case of hospita rental.
Op dit moment bereid ik een wetswijziging voor die er toe moet leiden dat het huurcontract – alleen in het geval van hospitaverhuur – bij verkoop kan worden beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de studie naar de ervaringen van Joodse en Israëlische studenten en medewerkers tijdens de protesten na 7 oktober

MP Stoffer asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a study finding that Jewish and Israeli students and staff faced intimidation and hostility during post-7 October protests, and whether institutions can guarantee their safety and detect such incidents. The Minister acknowledges the concerns, notes there is no reporting obligation for institutions on student safety, points to ongoing monitoring, a complaints-system study, a planned registration duty in a forthcoming safety bill, and an antisemitism taskforce.
There is no reporting obligation for institutions to provide my ministry with information about student safety.
Er is geen rapportageverplichting voor instellingen om informatie aan mijn ministerie te leveren over de veiligheid van studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Martens-America over het bericht 'Experts waarschuwen: Chinese spionage escaleert en Westen krijgt er geen grip op'

MPs Martens-America and Hertzberger asked the Minister of Education about reports that Chinese espionage in Dutch knowledge institutions is escalating, including CSC scholarship PhD students, study-switching by Chinese students, and a Wageningen collaboration with Tencent. The Minister responded that knowledge security is a priority, pointed to a planned screening obligation and an expanded espionage offence bill, said study-switching is very limited, and that partnership decisions lie with institutions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer en Krul over het schrappen van de subsidie op het godsdienstig onderwijs of levensbeschouwelijk vormingsonderwijs

MPs Ceder, Stoffer and Krul asked why the government plans to end the subsidy for religious and life-stance formation education and whether this conflicts with the statutory basis and with pupils' access to such education. The State Secretary answered that about 50,000 pupils receive it, that the subsidy ends from 2027 via a legislative proposal, and that schools' civic and worldview curriculum will cover the needs, but did not expect equal access and gave only partial answers on consultation with parents.
For the termination of the subsidy, a proposal for a legislative amendment will be made.
Voor de beëindiging van de subsidie wordt een voorstel tot wetswijziging gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel 'Steeds meer studenten met een beperking krijgen extra studietoeslag'

MP Dassen asked the ministers about a news report that more students with disabilities receive the individual study allowance (IST), and why not all eligible students use it, whether the allowance should move to the Study Finance Act and DUO, and how municipal administration causes unequal amounts. The government welcomed the rise, said non-take-up is unknown because data on medical conditions cannot lawfully be collected, defended keeping administration with municipalities, and pointed to information campaigns and possible harmonisation of amounts.
This is not known. For that, the government would need insight into how many students are eligible for the study allowance.
Dit is niet bekend. Daarvoor zou de overheid zicht moeten hebben op hoeveel studenten voor de studietoeslag in aanmerking komen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over de capaciteitsfixus op trajecten binnen een opleiding

MP Martens-America asked the minister whether the amendment allowing a capacity-based numerus fixus at track level is in force for 2025–2026 and how implementation is progressing. The minister answered that the legal possibility took effect on 1 September, that Studielink will implement track-level fixus for 2026–2027 (enrolment opens 1 October 2025), and that institutions are responsible for implementation and for deciding on any fixus.
The amendment has indeed entered into force as of 1 September.
Het amendement is inderdaad in werking getreden per 1 september jongstleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over antwoorden op eerdere schriftelijke vragen over studiefinanciering voor internationale studenten

An MP asks the Minister of Education how many international students receive supplementary grants, broken down by nationality, legal grounds and parental income assessment. The Minister declines to provide most figures for now, citing missing data, DUO's non-registration of nationality, and privacy rules on data linkage, promising to report in a spring monitor.
I do not yet have all the necessary data at this time to give a complete picture
Ik beschik op dit moment nog niet over alle benodigde gegevens om een compleet beeld te geven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht «Mbo-instelling verbiedt telefoongebruik in de klas»

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether a Dutch vocational college's ban on phones in class is supported, whether national rules, support or research on phone-free lessons are planned. The minister welcomed the initiative but declined national rules, research or dedicated support, leaving the matter to institutions and pointing to the lumpsum budget.
I am not considering introducing a national guideline for all vocational education institutions.
Ik overweeg niet om een landelijke richtlijn voor alle mbo-instellingen in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Wal en Michon-Derkzen over het artikel 'Rijksmuseum kan niet open: demonstranten Extinction Rebellion blokkeren ingang'

MPs Van der Wal and Michon-Derkzen asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Justice and Security about the blockade of the Rijksmuseum entrance by Extinction Rebellion, including arrests, police capacity, damage claims and sponsor reactions. The government answered that demonstrations are governed locally by the mayor under the Wet openbare manifestaties, reported 33 arrests with one person identified and about 250 police hours, and said the museum decides on damage claims while a WODC study on demonstration law is due in summer 2025.
The mayor is responsible for public order and can set conditions for a demonstration under the Public Manifestations Act.
De burgemeester is verantwoordelijk voor de openbare orde en kan voorwaarden stellen aan een demonstratie op basis van de Wet openbare manifestaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over 59 grote en kleine podiumgroepen en festivals die op het omvallen staan, ondanks een positief advies van het Fonds Podiumkunsten

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why 59 performing arts groups and festivals with positive Fonds Podiumkunsten advice are at risk of closure, requesting a list, funding of about 10.9 million euros, and an explanation of why youth choirs received support while these did not. The minister confirmed the list (now 57 institutions after two were funded), said there is no room for the 10 million euro without harming other priorities except a one-off transition payment and funding for classical youth talent development, and said the impact of fiscal measures will be monitored.
I see no room to find another 10 million euros in the culture budget without this coming at the expense of other priorities shared by the House.
Ik zie geen ruimte om op de cultuurbegroting nog eens ruim € 10 miljoen te vinden, zonder dat dit ten koste gaat van andere door de Kamer gedeelde prioriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Beckerman over stagiairs van Transavia die in 2023 als personeel werden ingezet

MPs Van Kent and Beckerman asked about Transavia trainees deployed as regular staff in 2023 and what the government would do about it. The minister says trainees must not replace regular workers, that the Labour Inspectorate fined the airline and withdrew its preventive shutdown warning after adequate changes, and points to complaint routes but declines to rule on individual cases.
However, it is not for the cabinet to make statements about this in individual cases.
Het is echter niet aan het kabinet om hier in individuele gevallen uitspraken over te doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over journalistieke integriteit en onpartijdigheid van door de overheid gefinancierde media n.a.v. de berichten 'BBC ‘breached guidelines 1,500 times’ over Israel- Hamas war', 'V

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how complaints about biased public broadcaster coverage of Israel and the Middle East are handled, whether the regulator will investigate, and how the government will protect journalistic integrity and combat biased information. The minister answered that complaints go first to the broadcaster and the Ombudsman, that the Media Regulator handles signals on a risk-based basis, and that direct government oversight of media content would amount to censorship, so the government declines to ask the regulator for investigations.
I am not willing to ask the regulator to conduct such an investigation.
Ik ben niet bereid het commissariaat te vragen een dergelijk onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ‘Gedoe rond vergadering van pro-Palestinastudenten: zij voelen zich bespied, wat was er aan de hand?’

MPs Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister of Education about reports that Radboud University security staff monitored a pro-Palestinian student meeting, and whether such preventive security, including plainclothes officers, is appropriate and how academic freedom is protected. The Minister answered that universities are responsible for their own security policy and that he lacks knowledge of individual situations, pointed to the academic freedom provisions in the WHW and to complaint routes, and committed only to continued dialogue with student groups.
As Minister I have no knowledge of all security situations that occur at the institutions.
Als Minister heb ik geen kennis van alle situaties op het gebied van veiligheid die zich op de instellingen voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over het bericht 'Stage, studie, bijbaan en thuis: mbo-student ervaart stress door opeenstapeling'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a report on vocational students (mbo) experiencing stress from accumulating obligations such as internships, studies, part-time jobs and family, including questions on unpaid internships, discrimination, guidance and assessment. The minister answered that the issues are concerning, pointed to the Stagepact, the planned study on a statutory minimum internship allowance due December 2024, anti-discrimination measures, and a forthcoming policy response and progress letters.
I find it a worrying finding that vocational students experience performance pressure and stress because they have many different responsibilities.
Ik vind het een zorgelijke constatering dat mbo-studenten prestatiedruk en stress ervaren doordat zij veel verschillende verantwoordelijkheden hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pijpelink en Tseggai over ‘Opnieuw meer jongeren van middelbare school of mbo af zonder diploma’

MPs Pijpelink and Tseggai asked the Minister of Education about a report that early school leaving without diploma rose again, including causes such as mental health and the need for income, and what the government will do to reduce it. The Minister acknowledges the rise, states the government keeps the action plan and 18,000 target for 2026 (calling it ambitious), points to planned legislation on support toward sustainable work, mental health measures, and an ongoing study into a statutory minimum internship allowance.
The cabinet adheres to the early school leaving action plan and the target agreed in the Werkagenda mbo of 18,000 new early school leavers in 2026.
Het kabinet houdt vast aan het actieplan vsv en de in de Werkagenda mbo afgesproken doelstelling van 18.000 nieuwe voortijdig schoolverlaters in 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht dat de cultuursector een kaalslag vreest

MP Mohandis asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a report warning of a 'kaalslag' in the culture sector from planned cuts and the VAT increase, asking about impact analyses, fair pay and local culture. The minister acknowledged the impact, defended the VAT decision as based on a prior evaluation and an ambtelijke verkenning, said no further impact analysis was planned before a 2028 evaluation, and offered continued dialogue but declined to reconsider the VAT measure.
No specific impact analysis has further been carried out for the planned VAT increase.
Voor de voorgenomen btw-verhoging is verder geen specifieke impactanalyse verricht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America, Becker, Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht 'Omstreden Samidoun-kopstuk Mohammed Khatib komt naar Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen: ’Extremistische haatprediker’'

MPs from the VVD asked ministers whether they would refuse or flag a visa for Mohammed Khatib of Samidoun, whether universities should host such speakers, and what the government will do about foreign influence and the organisation's banning. The ministers answered that Khatib has been flagged in the national alert system and refused entry, that the Radboud University cancelled the lecture, that the government is supporting an EU listing of Samidoun and talking with Germany and the public prosecutor, and that a national antisemitism strategy will follow in autumn.
These conclusions led the Minister for Asylum and Migration, in consultation with the Minister of Justice and Security, to flag the person in E&S.
Deze conclusies hebben ertoe geleid dat de Minister van Asiel en Migratie, in samenspraak met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, betrokkene heeft gesignaleerd in E&S.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Omstreden Samidoun-kopstuk Mohammed Khatib komt naar Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen: ’Extremistische haatprediker’

Two MPs from the SGP asked whether the government will act against the planned lecture by Samidoun figure Mohammed Khatib at Radboud University, including through a national terror listing, a travel ban, or a ban on Samidoun. The ministers answered that entry has been refused and the university cancelled the lecture, that they will not intervene in academic debate, that Khatib has been flagged in E&S but the Twbmt cannot bar him from the country, and that they will talk with Germany and the Public Prosecution Service about Samidoun and support an EU listing.
With regard to the organisation Samidoun, other countries have established links with terrorist organisations.
Ten aanzien van de organisatie Samidoun geldt dat andere landen banden met terroristische organisaties hebben vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Paternotte over de niet ingevulde bezuiniging op het basis- en voortgezet onderwijs en het mbo

D66 MPs Rooderkerk and Paternotte asked why the education subsidy cut (subsidietaakstelling) was booked on primary, secondary and vocational education budgets without concrete measures, which initiatives are affected, and why the cut was not allocated in detail. Minister Bruins explained the provisional booking was a deliberate technical choice, confirmed that several named organisations and internship funding are not cut in substance, but declined to give some details, deferring them to a forthcoming letter and amendment note.
The fact that subsidy budgets in the draft budget were reduced by such large amounts, ahead of an amendment note with the structural allocation of the cut, raises many questions.

Het feit dat subsidiebudgetten in de Ontwerpbegroting met dergelijke grote bedragen zijn verlaagd, vooruitlopend op een nota van wijziging met structurele invulling van de taakstelling, roept veel vragen op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht «Einde aan diensttijd voor de maatschappij»

MP Krul (CDA) asked the government to confirm reports that the Maatschappelijke Diensttijd programme is being ended, contesting its cost versus its value to youth, and asked about consultation, budget phasing, and participation figures. The state secretary confirmed the OCW subsidy of 200 million euros is being cut as part of budget savings, said a careful phase-out with partners is planned, and supplied participation numbers for 2024 and 2025.
In the run-up to the OCW budget debate, I will inform your House further on how we are organising the process for safeguarding and sustaining MDT.
In aanloop naar de begrotingsbehandeling van OCW zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren over hoe we het proces rondom de borging en verduurzaming van MDT inrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Krul, Stultiens, Kostić en Beckerman over het bericht 'Juristen: regeerprogramma op meerdere punten niet rechtsstatelijk'

Five MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how he views a legal commission's finding that cutting higher-education funding agreements unilaterally breaches the rule-of-law principle of a reliable government, and whether he would share the internal advice and memos behind the coalition programme before a committee debate. The minister rejects the commission's view, says the budget legislature sets annual funding and the agreement is not the legal basis, and refuses to share internal advice and memos under the principle of cabinet unity.
I am not, because the cabinet does not share internal advice and memos relating to the drafting of the coalition programme, on the basis of cabinet unity.
Dat ben ik niet, omdat het kabinet geen ambtelijke adviezen en nota’s deelt die zien op het opstellen van het Regeerprogramma, op grond van eenheid kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de gang van zaken bij omroep Ongehoord Nederland, naar aanleiding van antwoorden op eerdere vragen

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science when the media regulator (Commissariaat voor de Media) informed her that it was closely investigating Ongehoord Nederland, which elements are involved, when the regulator can intervene if a supervisory board fails to act, and whether the MP's information right covers reported changes in the duties of a former managing director's daughter. The minister answers that the regulator notified her on 14 August 2024, lists the integrity, social safety, journalistic quality and governance issues, says the regulator decides on intervention and that the ledenraad also has a role, and declines to confirm the factual question because the regulator is still investigating, while promising to request the information from the regulator and inform parliament.
I could not and cannot answer the factual question because I simply did not know and still do not know exactly what happened.
Ik kon en kan u geen antwoord geven op de genoemde feitelijke vraag omdat ik gewoonweg niet wist en ook nu niet weet wat er precies is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Van der Burg over het bericht "Doodsbedreigingen en anonieme berichten: hoe Chinese studenten in Nederland worden geïntimideerd"

Two VVD MPs asked the Education minister and Foreign Affairs minister about reports that Chinese students in the Netherlands are threatened and intimidated, and what is being done. The minister agreed such intimidation is unacceptable, pointed to a broad approach against unwanted foreign interference, university responsibility for safety, a raised issue with the Chinese embassy, and ongoing work on academic freedom and self-censorship.
The cabinet considers every form of unwanted foreign interference completely unacceptable.
Het kabinet vindt elke vorm van ongewenste buitenlandse inmenging volstrekt onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Vijlbrief over de financiële positie van studenten

MPs Paternotte and Vijlbrief asked the government about student financial pressure: whether to lower interest on student loans, avoid cutting the basic grant, drop the long-study fine, and extend the supplementary grant to mbo students. The minister answered that there is no room for further measures, that the temporary grant increase ends and a higher basic grant cannot be applied retroactively, and that a second loan compensation of 1.4 billion euro is planned.
That is why this cabinet has chosen to invest 1.4 billion euro one-off to raise the compensation for student-loan-system students.
Daarom heeft dit kabinet ervoor gekozen om incidenteel € 1,4 miljard in te zetten voor het verhogen van de tegemoetkoming van leenstelselstudenten
Antwoord op vragen van Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Burgemeester Halsema overwoog activisten op UvA eigen universiteitsgebouw te geven'

An MP asked the Ministers of Justice and Education about reports that the Amsterdam mayor considered giving occupying activists a university building at the UvA, the damage costs, recovery of damages, student safety, student visas and protest policy. The government answered that the mayor and university boards are responsible for these matters, that damage recovery is for the institution, and that it will study the protest framework and reports by summer 2025.
It is therefore not for me to judge that.
Het is daarom niet aan mij om daarover te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over de subsidieverstrekking aan het Internationaal Theater Amsterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the international excellence supplement in the cultural basic infrastructure, which ITA received until recently, was not awarded to ITA after the Council for Culture classified it as a medium-sized theatre, and whether the funds could still be awarded. The Minister confirmed the regulation excludes medium-sized theatres, said the hardship clause has a very high threshold, and will decide later depending on developments at ITA.
Depending on further developments at ITA, I will make a decision on whether, and if so how, the funds could still lawfully be awarded.
Afhankelijk van de verdere ontwikkelingen bij ITA zal ik een besluit nemen over of, en zo ja, hoe de middelen alsnog rechtmatig zouden kunnen worden toegekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over studiefinanciering voor internationale studenten

An MP asked the ministers how many international students enrolled in 2024/25, the working-hour rules for student finance, cross-EU comparisons, cumulation with foreign child benefit, and how parental income is assessed. The minister said 2024/25 enrolment data are not yet available (expected in the 2025 forecast), gave EER student finance figures, described the 32/24-hour rules, committed to pushing an EU-level definition of migrant worker, and answered the remaining questions on cumulation and income assessment.
The number of international students who have enrolled to study in the Netherlands in academic year 2024–2025 is not yet known.
Het aantal internationale studenten dat zich heeft ingeschreven om in studiejaar 2024–2025 in Nederland te studeren is nog niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Tseggai over het Advies van het college voor de Rechten van de Mens om de discriminatiegrond ‘opleiding’ op te nemen in de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling

MPs Stultiens and Tseggai asked the ministers about the Human Rights Institute's advice to add education level as a protected ground under the equal treatment act, and about government support for vocational education. The minister acknowledged the advice, said the government will respond in a cabinet reaction, will study the advice together with the Interior Minister, and will examine socio-economic status as a ground separately.
I will study this advice carefully, together with my colleague the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal dit advies, samen met mijn collega-minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, goed bestuderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het artikel “UT grijpt rigoureus in, mogelijk ruim 500 banen op de tocht”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the University of Twente's cost-cutting reorganisation, minimum enrolment thresholds, programme closures, research impacts, regional positioning, the long-study fine and crisis organisations at other institutions. The minister answered that institutions have spending autonomy and are accountable to their internal supervisory and participatory bodies rather than to him, gave partial substantive answers on language rules and research funding, and declined to monitor other institutions' reorganisations.
They do not account for this to me, but to the participatory bodies and internal supervision.
Hierover verantwoorden zij zich niet richting mij, maar richting de medezeggenschap en het intern toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het uitspreken van een voorkeur voor een presidentskandidaat door een Nederlandse universiteit

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Education whether it is appropriate for a Dutch university to express a preference for a US presidential candidate. The minister said it was unclear whether such a statement was made, stressed freedom of expression and academic freedom, said judging such statements is not his responsibility, and that the supervisory board oversees the executive board.
I can also state that, in general, it is not part of my systemic responsibility to assess the statements by a university's executive board that you cite for desirability or appropriateness.

Ook kan ik aangeven dat het in zijn algemeenheid niet tot mijn stelselverantwoordelijkheid behoort om de door u aangevoerde uitspraken van een college van bestuur van een universiteit op wenselijkheid of gepastheid te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het bericht in Leids Universitair Weekblad Mare “Fors bezuinigen? Dan moeten we terug naar de kern (en al het andere zonder morren opofferen)”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a student newspaper article on overhead spending at universities, including staff ratios, the share of central funding going to the core process, and how to monitor that spending. The Minister said universities have spending freedom and are accountable to internal bodies, that OBP staff are about 32% of total staff (stable since 2010), and that no definition of the 'primary process' exists, so no single percentage can be given.
There is no definition of what can be understood as the 'primary process'.
Er bestaat geen definitie van wat kan worden verstaan onder het «primaire proces».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontebal over het bericht ‘Starmer begint zijn ‘reset’ met EU, Brexiteers vrezen dat hij het VK er weer ‘in rommelt’

An MP from the CDA asked the government whether it would take similar initiatives to intensify bilateral cooperation with the United Kingdom after Starmer's planned bilateral treaty with Germany and France, and whether it would invite Starmer to visit. The government welcomed renewed UK engagement with the EU, listed existing bilateral frameworks and defence and science cooperation, and said it was open to intensifying relations without announcing new concrete initiatives.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het besluit van het Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie om zes talentontwikkelings-organisaties in de klassieke muzieksector niet langer te subsidiëren

MP Baudet asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie's decision to stop funding six classical music talent development organisations from 2025 despite positive advice, including the composition of the assessment committees and the shift in funding criteria. The Minister acknowledges the negative impact, calls the outcome undesirable, and announces 1.9 million euros per year for 2025–2028 to support classical talent development, while defending the fund's independent committee process.

I have confidence that the Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie has shaped the decision-making and allocation procedure in a well-considered and lawful manner, based on its professionalism and knowledge of the sector.

Ik heb er vertrouwen in dat het Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie de besluitvorming en toekenningsprocedure op een weloverwogen en rechtmatige manier heeft vormgegeven, op basis van zijn professionaliteit en kennis van het werkveld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over kindermarketing door varkenshouderijen

An MP asks the state secretary why the pig sector's classroom material 'The Pig Story', judged by the Advertising Code Committee to be misleading child marketing, is still offered to schools, and whether it should be banned or corrected. The state secretary says schools are responsible for lesson content under constitutional educational freedom, that the committee's rulings should be respected, but that government will not ban or order a rectification of the material.
Given the constitutional freedom of education regarding teaching materials, I feel restraint is appropriate in going into the substance of such materials.
Gezien de grondwettelijke onderwijsvrijheid ten aanzien van leermiddelen past mij terughoudendheid om inhoudelijk in te gaan op dergelijke materialen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het slachtoffers bangalijsten op Telegram

An MP asked the government about Telegram 'bangalijsten' (lists targeting female students), victims' compensation, anonymity, sanctions on student associations and the role of the Dutch data protection authority. The government answered that universities and student associations bear primary responsibility, that victims can access support and civil or criminal routes, and that the AP acts independently and does not discuss enforcement with the ministry.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority is an independent supervisor that assesses case by case, on its own initiative or on request, whether the General Data Protection Regulation is complied with.
De AP is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die per geval – uit eigen beweging of op verzoek – beoordeelt of wordt voldaan aan de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming (hierna:
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Velde over Flock Together

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a literary festival's walk and interview restricted to people of colour, funded with 357,659 euro in subsidy, is compatible with the constitutional non-discrimination clause and whether it will be prevented. The Minister answered that constitutional questions are not his to decide, that the event was open to all and merely encouraged participation by people of colour, and that the festival had revised its wording.
How organising an activity only for people of colour relates legally to the Constitution is not for me as Minister of Education, Culture and Science to determine.
Hoe het organiseren van een activiteit alleen voor mensen van kleur zich juridisch verhoudt tot de Grondwet, is niet aan mij als Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap om te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht «Pro-Palestijnse activisten richten opnieuw vernielingen aan bij Universiteit van Amsterdam»

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the University of Amsterdam would press charges for vandalism of its buildings, and about the costs and visa measures. The minister answered that the UvA did file a police report, that the damage was estimated at €600, and that the IND will withdraw residence permits of non-EU students who threaten public order where proportionate.
The UvA also states that it always files charges for vandalism and that it did so in this case as well.
Ook de UvA geeft aan altijd aangifte van vernielingen te doen en dat ook in dit geval te hebben gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de herkansingsperiode voor leerlingen in het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs

An MP asked why vso pupils whose resits run into early September cannot enroll in higher education on time and what arrangements exist for them. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said institutions decide their own enrolment rules, and committed to arranging resits before 1 September for the affected group and to better communication.
For 2025 onwards I instruct the examination system to make it possible for the specific group of pupils who want to move on to hbo and wo to take their resits before 1 September

Voor 2025 en verder geef ik de examenketen de opdracht om het mogelijk te maken voor de specifieke groep leerlingen die willen doorstromen naar het hbo en wo hun herkansingen af te leggen vóór 1 september
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het item in Nieuwsuur "Hoe schoolbestuurders zakendoen met bekenden en zichzelf"

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Education about a Nieuwsuur report on school board members doing business with acquaintances and themselves, including the growth of education consultancy firms financed from public funds, the lack of transparency on spending, and whether intern toezicht and the Inspectorate should get more powers. The State Secretary acknowledged that conflicts of interest are unacceptable, pointed to existing rules and the Inspectorate's role, said spending is not separately reported, and announced a bill with stricter integrity requirements and expanded Inspectorate oversight, with an internet consultation planned for end of December.

With this bill I intend, among other things, to give a further and non-voluntary impulse to the professionalisation of education boards, and more direction will be given to internal supervision about what is expected.

Met dit wetsvoorstel wil ik onder meer de professionalisering van onderwijsbesturen een nadere en niet-vrijblijvende impuls geven en wordt er meer richting gegeven aan het intern toezicht over wat er wordt verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Paternotte, Rooderkerk, Paulusma en Sneller  over de btw-verhogingen op boeken, cultuur, sport en logies

D66 MPs asked the government what it aims to achieve by raising VAT on books, newspapers, culture, sport and accommodation, and about impact analyses, exemptions, legal risks, household purchasing power, sector and education effects, regional effects and the 40-organisation appeal. The state secretary answers that the rate change yields about 2.3 billion euros structurally, that no specific impact analysis was done and none is planned (only monitoring), that some reduced-rate categories are kept for policy-weighing reasons, and that most distributional, sectoral and regional effects cannot be quantified.
I do not intend to carry out a further impact analysis, but the effect of the tariff increase will be monitored.
Ik ben niet voornemens om een nadere impactanalyse uit te voeren, wel zal het effect van de tariefsverhoging worden gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen lid Ceder over instandhouding en herbestemming kerkgebouwen

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about preserving church buildings and their repurposing, including funding for restoration backlogs and whether the TRE programme will continue. The Minister answered that the programme runs to 2025, that a decision on its continuation will be communicated before summer 2025, and that a funding gap of €770 million for non-residential monuments cannot currently be met within existing budgets.
On the continuation I will inform your House before the summer of 2025.
Over het vervolg zal ik uw Kamer voor de zomer van 2025 informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Vroonhoven over het Rechtsstaatrapport van de Europese Commissie, uitgekomen op 24 juli 2024

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the government will respond to the European Commission's Rule of Law Report concerns on journalism: the Press Council's capacity, media ownership transparency and pluralism, public broadcaster governance and EMFA compliance, state advertising, journalist safety and anti-SLAPP. The minister answered that the Press Council is independent and self-regulating and will not be subsidised, that the government will discuss issues with it and reform public broadcasting, and that EMFA compliance and the anti-SLAPP bill are being prepared.
The Press Council is an independent, self-regulating body entirely supported by the sector.
De Raad voor de Journalistiek is een onafhankelijk, zelfregulerend orgaan dat geheel gedragen wordt door de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stultiens over de grote gevolgen van de geplande bezuinigingen op onderzoek en wetenschap

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the planned cuts to research and science in the coalition agreement, including the scrapping of sector plans, job losses, the Lisbon 3% R&D target, and the Bestuursakkoord. The minister acknowledged concerns but gave largely non-substantive answers, deferring details to the Regeerprogramma and the Prinsjesdag policy agenda.
At present the cabinet is further elaborating the coalition agreement, including the measures for hbo and wo, in the Regeerprogramma.
Op dit moment werkt het kabinet het hoofdlijnenakkoord, inclusief de maatregelen in het hbo en wo, verder uit in het Regeerprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht ‘Talenten in klassieke muziek hard geraakt door nieuwe subsidieronde’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about talent-development music institutions losing subsidy in the new 2025–2028 round and the wider decline of music education. The minister answered that the outcome followed a pre-published, independently assessed application procedure with oversubscription, that these organisations are not part of the cultural basic infrastructure, that a meeting with the sector is planned, and that seven positively assessed organisations together need nearly €10 million, with details promised around Prinsjesdag.
A meeting between these institutions and my ministry is already planned.
Er staat hierover reeds een gesprek gepland tussen deze instellingen en mijn ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de gang van zaken bij omroep Ongehoord Nederland

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she views mutual accusations of racism, antisemitism, and misconduct at Ongehoord Nederland, and about the director's conduct, the appointment of a relative, the board's role and alleged editorial instructions. The minister mostly declines to act, saying the Raad van Toezicht and the Commissariaat voor de Media are responsible and that the broadcaster must handle its own investigations.
It is up to the Supervisory Board as employer to act, and up to the Commissariaat voor de Media to supervise.
Het is hier aan de Raad van Toezicht als werkgever om op te treden en aan het Commissariaat voor de Media (hierna: commissariaat) om toezicht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over het bericht 'Mediawaakhond bekijkt zorgelijk vertrek minister Klever bij Ongehoord Nederland'

An MP asked the Minister about reports that the media watchdog is reviewing the departure of Ongehoord Nederland's commercial director Klever, covering integrity, social safety, journalistic quality, handover of duties, transparency of public spending and possible conflicts of interest. The Minister says the Commissariaat voor de Media, which has been given full attention on the case, is the competent supervisor and that the Raad van Toezicht must assess the governance questions, while declining to judge journalistic quality itself.
The commissariat has informed me that this case has its full attention.
Het commissariaat heeft mij laten weten dat deze casus de volle aandacht heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht 'Opnieuw irritatie in carnavalswereld Limburg over datum voorjaarsvakantie'

An MP asked why the 2025 spring holiday for the southern region does not coincide with the carnival week, and what weight is given to carnival as cultural heritage. The Staatssecretaris answered that the spring holiday is only an advisory date, schools may deviate, the 7-8 weeks school rhythm drives planning, and a 2024 evaluation of the holiday regulation will consider carnival's role.
First and foremost, all schools that wish to can simply hold their spring holiday during the carnival week.
Voorop staat dat alle scholen die dat willen, gewoon hun voorjaarsvakantie tijdens de carnavalsweek kunnen houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over de hervorming van de NPO

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reforming the NPO public broadcaster, including extending its recognition period, governance and transparency, and a timeline. The minister confirmed the parliamentary request and committed to a governance and oversight review and to a transparency letter, but gave no firm timeline and deferred the reform's content and timing.
Several advisory reports show that the governance of the national public broadcaster and the media supervision tasks need to be revised.
Uit meerdere adviezen en rapporten blijkt dat de governance van de landelijke publieke omroep en de taken in het mediatoezicht herzien moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Blaauw over antisemitische bezetting en veiligheid op de Gerrit Rietveld Academie
