The government explained IOM's reasons for not assisting (limited presence, unsafe situation, UN relations with the Assad regime), stated that no Dutch obstacles exist and that DT&V can help returnees, and said a new country report is expected in summer 2018.
On the Dutch government's side there are no obstacles preventing the voluntary return of Syrians.
Van de zijde van de Nederlandse overheid zijn er geen obstakels die de vrijwillige terugkeer van Syriërs verhinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Azmani over het bericht dat Tunesië een nieuwe springplank voor illegale migratie naar Europa wordt

MPs Ten Broeke and Azmani asked the ministers about reports that Tunisia is becoming a new departure route for illegal migration to Europe, including the scale of arrivals, possible undercounting, and cooperation with Tunisia. The government answered that arrivals from Tunisia have risen sharply but remain far below 2011 levels, that Tunisia is cooperating on border control and root causes, and that an integrated approach is needed.
Although this is relatively limited compared with the total number of arrivals in Italy, it is a striking increase compared with 2016.
Hoewel dit op het gehele aantal aankomsten in Italië relatief beperkt is, betreft het een opvallende stijging ten opzichte van 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Azmani over het bericht 'criminele Albanezen zijn de opkomende groep in de drugshandel'

MPs Van Oosten and Azmani asked the Justice Minister about reports that Albanian criminals are an emerging group in drug trafficking, and whether visa liberalisation for Albania should be reversed. The minister confirmed a rise in Albanian suspects, described ongoing enforcement and EU monitoring, and said the government will await the Commission's monitor before deciding on the emergency brake, while stating it has no reason to doubt Albanian authorities' cooperation.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Visser en Azmani over de gevolgen van toenemende agressie van verstekelingen

MPs Visser and Azmani asked about reports of rising aggression by stowaways targeting truck drivers near Calais, the scale of harm to Dutch drivers and transport firms, and whether the government will re-engage France and EU partners. The minister says the government has received no signals of increasing problems, cannot provide figures on driver victims, points to French responsibility for Calais security and existing EU rules, and sees no need for new talks now.
I have no figures on the number of Dutch drivers who have fallen victim to violence and threats since 2015.
Er zijn mij geen cijfers bekend over aantallen Nederlandse chauffeurs die sinds 2015 slachtoffer zijn geworden van geweld en bedreigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Azmani over het bericht ‘Omstreden alFitrah legt 1,7 miljoen euro op tafel en koopt pand alsnog’

MPs Tellegen and Azmani asked the government about reports that the contested alFitrah organisation bought a building with 1.7 million euros, and about its financial transparency, Kuwaiti funding and possible sanctions. The minister said the funds came via a Dutch company, that a criminal investigation is ongoing, that transparency measures such as a foundations publication duty are being examined, and that the municipality of Utrecht uses the three-track approach.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Azmani over het bericht ‘NAM erkent (gedeeltelijke) overschrijding, maar ontkent overtreding’

Two VVD MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister about reports that NAM exceeded its gas extraction uncertainty margin at Hardenberg-Oost, Monster and Maasdijk, and how supervision and penalties work. The minister explained the 20% margin is a planning assumption, said SodM is still assessing NAM's response, promised to clarify winning plans and permit conditions, and described the EUR 2 million as a coercive measure rather than a fine.
SodM is currently assessing that response, including whether the overrun could have been prevented.
SodM is op dit moment bezig met de beoordeling van die zienswijze, waarbij ook wordt bekeken in hoeverre de overschrijding was te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Azmani over het bericht “Christelijke scholen zwakken paasviering af”

Two VVD MPs asked the education state secretary whether Christian schools that reportedly scaled back their Easter celebrations were self-censoring, and what the ministry will do to support teachers and promote civic education. The state secretary answered that the schools deny the media account, that he has no signs of self-censorship, that teachers should feel supported by their own boards, and that a legislative tightening of the civic education duty is being prepared.
I am now preparing this legislative amendment. I will submit it to your House as soon as possible.
Ik bereid deze wetswijziging nu voor. Ik leg deze zo spoedig mogelijk aan uw Kamer voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Azmani over het bericht dat hulporganisaties mensensmokkelaars faciliteren

Two MPs from CDA and VVD asked whether NGOs rescuing migrants at sea cooperate with smugglers, whether Dutch organisations or subsidised groups are involved, and whether the government will act against such aid. The government says it has no evidence of direct contact between some NGOs and smugglers, welcomes Italian investigations, names Dutch NGOs without state subsidy, and says it will continue dialogue while stressing that the discussion belongs at EU level.
The cabinet has no indications that there is direct contact between some aid organisations and criminal smuggling networks.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over aanwijzingen dat er sprake zou zijn van rechtstreeks contact tussen sommige hulporganisaties en criminele smokkelbendes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht dat Eritrese vluchtelingen op vakantie gaan naar Eritrea

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that Eritrean refugees holiday in Eritrea, whether this shows they no longer fear persecution, and what checks exist on returning refugees. The State Secretary explains that residence permits for limited-term refugees are normally revoked after return visits, that checks found no Eritreans among those examined, and that cross-border information exchange with Belgium and Germany has started, but declines to change asylum policy for Eritrea now.
When it is established that aliens holding an asylum permit for a limited period have visited their country of origin, the IND generally starts a revocation procedure.
Als wordt geconstateerd dat vreemdelingen met een asielvergunning voor bepaalde tijd hun herkomstland hebben bezocht dan start de IND in de regel een intrekkingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Azmani, Jasper van Dijk, Sjoerdsma, Kuiken, Knops en Voordewind over het bericht “Onrust op ministeries over komst Eritrese partijfunctionaris”

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a planned Eritrean youth congress in the Netherlands, the planned speech by regime official Yemane Gebreab, and possible measures against regime-linked persons and the diaspora tax. The minister answered that the congress was banned by the Veldhoven mayor, that voluntariness of contacts with Eritrean authorities must remain the principle, that visa decisions are individual, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that a diaspora tax study is ongoing and will be reported in Q2 2017.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has commissioned an independent bureau to research the nature and extent of the Eritrean regime's diaspora tax.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft een onafhankelijk bureau opdracht gegeven om onderzoek te doen naar de aard en omvang van de diasporabelasting van het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Azmani en Koopmans over het bericht dat de Turkse AK-partij weer een ronselbrief aan Nederlanders met een Turkse achtergrond heeft gestuurd

VVD MPs asked whether the Turkish AK party again sent a recruitment letter, signed by the Turkish prime minister, to Turkish-Dutch citizens about the referendum, whether it used the same address list as in 2015, and whether the government will raise this with Turkey. The minister confirmed some recipients received the letter, said it is unknown whether the 2015 address list was reused, noted Turkish parties can buy voter address lists, and said the government remains opposed to political campaigning by Turkish officials in the Netherlands.
It is not known whether the AK party used the same address list as in 2015.
Het is niet bekend of de AK-partij gebruik heeft gemaakt van hetzelfde adressenbestand als in 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Ten Broeke en Azmani over de financiële bijdragen van provincies aan het hoofdwegennet

VVD MPs asked the minister why Overijssel appears to contribute the most provincial co-financing to national motorway projects, and how investment priorities and the Infrastructure Fund figures were determined. The minister answered that investments follow the SVIR and NMCA bottleneck analyses and File Top 50, that the table reflects cash flows (inflated for Overijssel by a 2015 transfer), and listed 2006-2015 and upcoming Overijssel projects with co-financing amounts.
The table was compiled from the annual reports of the Infrastructure Fund (IF).
De tabel is tot stand gekomen vanuit de jaarverslagen van het Infrastructuurfonds (IF).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Arno Rutte over het bericht dat Marokkaanse asielzoekers rovend door de stad Groningen trekken

Two VVD MPs asked why asylum seekers from safe countries, reportedly including Moroccans, are allowed to commit robberies in Groningen without being returned, how they are dealt with, and whether talks with Morocco are planned. The State Secretary answered that the government works on both the inflow and the nuisance through administrative and criminal approaches, and that Nederland wants to reach agreements with Morocco on taking back unlawfully staying nationals, with priority to be given.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en De Lange over het bericht “Amsterdam krijgt ‘Turks’ ziekenhuis”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports of a 'Turkish' hospital in Amsterdam, including its funding, whether it respects equal treatment, patient rights and gender norms, and when the inspectorate will visit. The minister answered that funding is for the hospital to disclose, that patient choice and anti-discrimination rules apply equally, that the hospital holds a WTZi licence and has been sent the inspectorate's questionnaire, and that a visit depends on the information received.
If there are signals that a hospital is not complying with the rules, action will be taken against it.
Indien er signalen zijn dat een ziekenhuis zich niet aan de regels houdt dan zal hier tegen worden opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Golfstaten Nederland informatie over financiële steun aan religieuze instellingen verstrekken

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Gulf states share information on financing of religious institutions in the Netherlands, including whether a list of Saudi-financed institutions exists and why it is withheld. The answer refers to the oral questions asked on the same topic, so no substantive answers to the written questions are given here.
The written questions from MPs Sjoerdsma (D66), Azmani (VVD), Knops (CDA) and Karabulut (SP) (question number 2016Z14749, submitted 13 July 2016) have been answered through oral questions.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Azmani (VVD), Knops (CDA) en Karabulut (SP) (vraagnummer 2016Z14749 , ingezonden 13 juli 2016) zijn beantwoord middels mondelinge vragen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Visser over gebrek aan informatie binnen de transportsector over ‘inklimmers’ en de oproep om de 'jungle' van Calais te ontmantelen

MPs Visser and Azmani asked about the transport sector's lack of information on migrants climbing into lorries at Calais ('inklimmers') and calls to dismantle the Calais 'jungle'. The State Secretary answers that information is shared with TLN through periodic consultation, that the French authorities are primarily responsible for Calais, and that the government will keep raising the issue in European and bilateral channels.
The claim that information would not be shared with TLN is not correct.
De stelling dat informatie niet met TLN zou worden gedeeld klopt niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Visser over het bericht “Docu over haatimams schokt Denen”

Two MPs asked whether foreign imams preaching hatred could also speak in Dutch mosques, what the government does to prevent incitement, and why Denmark's measures such as a watchlist and entry bans cannot be applied in the Netherlands. The minister responded that local authorities and institutions bear primary responsibility under a three-track approach, that visa-required preachers can be refused and EU alerts shared via the Schengen system, and that Denmark's measures are still being drafted so their applicability cannot yet be judged.
The Netherlands closely follows developments in Denmark and contact takes place at expert level.
Nederland volgt de ontwikkelingen in Denemarken nauwgezet en op expertniveau vindt contact plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over de blijdschap over de arrestatie van Ebru Umar in Turkije

MP Azmani asked the Minister of Social Affairs about social media celebration of the arrest of Ebru Umar in Turkey, whether this signals failed integration of second and third generation Turkish Dutch, and what measures would be taken. The minister answered that freedom of expression applies to all but threats and intimidation are punishable, that the reactions worry him and reflect weak identification with Dutch society, and listed a three-point integration agenda and a follow-up study into Turkish religious organisations.
At the request of your House, a follow-up study is also being launched into the role Turkish religious organisations play in this process.
Ook wordt er op verzoek van uw Kamer een vervolgonderzoek uitgezet naar de rol die Turks religieuze organisaties in dit proces hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Gemeenten en Rijk ruziën nog steeds over bed-bad-brood’

An MP asks the State Secretary about the stalled negotiations with municipalities over a governance agreement on shelter for irregular migrants, which municipalities resist, sanctions, and whether continued shelter attracts asylum seekers. The State Secretary answers that talks are ongoing, declines to name opposing municipalities or discuss sanctions, and confirms a temporary financial contribution continues pending the agreement.
At this stage of the negotiations I will not go into the content of these discussions.
Ik ga in deze fase van de onderhandelingen niet in op de inhoud van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Wat mis kan gaan bij een uitzetting; 3.165 vluchten geboekt 1.225 geannuleerd. Uitzetten vreemdelingen mislukt steeds vaker’

MP Azmani asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that many deportation flights were cancelled, and about causes such as procedural delays, administrative errors, uncooperative countries and FRONTEX participation. The State Secretary confirmed the rise in cancellations, attributed it partly to Dublin implementation limiting pre-departure detention, and outlined EU efforts to revise procedures while noting that only a small share of cancellations stemmed from administrative errors.
How often this happens as a result of administrative errors or delays en route is not tracked separately.
Hoe vaak dit gebeurt als gevolg van administratieve fouten of vertraging onderweg wordt niet apart bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Azmani over het rapport ‘Rotterdamse aanpak statushouders, 2016 – 2020’ van het Rotterdamse college van burgemeester en wethouders

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a Rotterdam report attributing its backlog in housing status holders to problems with IND documents, BSN numbers and file completeness. The government answered that it does not share that conclusion, outlined the registration and information-exchange arrangements and existing support teams, and gave the number of permit holders awaiting housing.
No, I do not share that conclusion.
Nee, die conclusie deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Azmani over het bericht dat de ‘persvrijheid is beknot bij azc-informatieavonden’

MPs Taverne and Azmani asked whether excluding journalists from municipal information meetings on asylum centres amounts to prior censorship under Article 7 of the Constitution. The minister answered that press freedom is a great good protected by law, that only specific reasons such as safety or limited space could justify excluding the press, and that municipalities must judge this, with the issue to be raised at the national asylum taskforce including the VNG.
Only specific reasons, such as safety or limited venue space, can be grounds for excluding the press or not admitting everyone.
Alleen specifieke redenen, zoals veiligheid of beperkte locatieruimte, kunnen aanleiding zijn de pers te weren of niet iedereen binnen te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Eritrese intimidatie in Nederland breidt zich uit’

MP Azmani asked the State Secretary whether asylum applications from Eritreans are checked for regime affiliation, whether deportation is possible and whether IND is informed of regime ties, and whether safe third-country arrangements can be made. The government answered that IND considers regime ties, that deportation is not currently on the agenda, that AIVD information can be shared case by case without public comment, and that EU partnership programmes are underway but safe third-country status is not yet achievable.
I do not make public statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Zijlstra en Azmani inzake ‘aanranding Almeerse door drie asielzoekers’ en ‘Kans op geweld tegen christenen is 100 procent’

MPs Zijlstra and Azmani asked the State Secretary about an assault on an 18-year-old woman in Almere by three asylum seekers and reports of violence against Christians in reception centres, asking whether asylum applications of those not respecting Dutch norms should be rejected and expelled. The State Secretary condemned such conduct, said COA house rules and police intervene, and promised to inform parliament on tightening national rules so asylum permits can be refused or withdrawn more readily after criminal convictions.

In the general consultation with your House of 30 September on, among other things, the increased inflow, I committed to your House to come with further proposals on how, within existing EU frameworks, national rules on this point can be tightened.

In het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer van 30 september jl. over onder meer de verhoogde instroom heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd met nadere voorstellen te komen hoe binnen de bestaande EU-kaders een aanscherping van de nationale regelgeving op dit punt kan worden gerealiseerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Duizenden asielzoekers fraudeerden voor generaal pardon’

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary whether large-scale identity fraude occurred among asylum seekers who obtained permits under the 2007-2008 general pardon, and how the IND and municipalities handle identity correction and revocation. The State Secretary rejected the claim of large-scale fraud, reported 160 revocations from 1360 procedures (only about ten for changed personal data), and refused to reopen the pardon cases or create a special naturalisation regime for pardon holders.
As I indicated in answer 1, I do not recognise the picture painted in the reporting.
Zoals ik in antwoord 1 heb aangegeven, herken ik het beeld dat in de berichtgeving wordt geschetst niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Azmani over verstekelingen die zich verstoppen in vrachtwagens, mede naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan Calais

MPs Visser and Azmani asked the government about stowaways hiding in lorries near Calais, the damage to Dutch transport, and whether France and the UK enforce EU asylum and immigration rules. The government answered that the damage is evident, that a meeting with French authorities and TLN is postponed to autumn, that extra Franco-British measures and joint enforcement commitments were agreed, and that it will raise secondary migration with France.
In my meeting with the French authorities this autumn I will raise attention to combating secondary illegal migration flows.
In mijn gesprek met de Franse autoriteiten dit najaar zal ik aandacht vragen voor de bestrijding van secundaire illegale migratiestromen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het stijgende aantal asiel aanvragen van Kosovaren in Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary about the rise in asylum applications by Kosovars, whether the voluntary return scheme enabled misuse, and whether it should be closed to them. The State Secretary confirmed the increase since May 2015, linked it likely to return payments, and ended financial and in-kind return support for Kosovars while keeping basic REAN support.
The outcomes of this research have led me to end the possibility for Kosovars to receive financial and in-kind return support.
De uitkomsten van genoemde onderzoek hebben er toe geleid dat ik de mogelijkheid voor Kosovaren om financiële en in natura terugkeerondersteuning te ontvangen heb beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Azmani over verstekelingen die zich verstoppen in vrachtwagens

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about drivers being fined in the UK for stowaways found in their trucks and about the Calais migrant problem, including whether Dutch drivers are penalised twice for rest-time violations caused by queues. The minister answered that the UK fines follow the Code of Practice, the number of affected Dutch drivers is unknown, EU rest-time rules leave room for exceptional situations, the government has raised the issue with the Commission and UK/French counterparts, and it has intensified border controls and consulted the transport sector.
The number of (possibly) affected Dutch drivers in 2014 and 2015 is not known.
Het aantal (mogelijke) Nederlandse gedupeerde chauffeurs in 2014 en 2015 is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Haatimams naar Utrecht’

An MP from the VVD asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Foreign Affairs about a planned Utrecht event featuring a controversial preacher, his radical views, and whether visa refusal or withdrawal and organiser responsibility could be used. The government answered that the preacher did not appear, there was no public order risk, and it outlined visa powers under the Schengen framework, local mayoral powers, and that the CMO will inform mosque organisations.
The event in Utrecht took place on Sunday 1 March last.
Het evenement in Utrecht heeft op zondag 1 maart jongstleden plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Inburgeringsplicht niet meer na vijf jaar en de conclusie van de advocaat generaal in zaak C-579/13, Europees Hof van Justitie’

An MP asks the minister how the Advocate General's opinion in case C-579/13 (no mandatory civic integration exam for long-term residents after five years) affects Dutch policy. The minister disagrees with the opinion on the exam, argues integration exams aid participation, and says the Court's ruling will be awaited before the Council of State decides.
The Advocate General's conclusion is an advice. The European Court of Justice is independent in forming its judgment.
De conclusie van de Advocaat Generaal is een advies. Het Europese Hof van Justitie is onafhankelijk in zijn oordeelsvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Benefiet ter discussie'?

An MP from the VVD asks the Justice Minister about a planned charity gala in Rijswijk featuring foreign salafist preachers, including whether the government can refuse visas or act against them and what responsibility organisers and venue owners bear. The government answers that visas of three speakers were withdrawn for public order reasons, that Schengen rules allow refusal on threat grounds, that Dutch authorities can ask other member states to revoke visas, and that free speech is limited where hatred or threats to public order arise.
The visas of three speakers were withdrawn in the interest of public order, against the background of social unrest, as set out in a letter from the NCTV.
De visa van een drietal sprekers zijn ingetrokken met het oog op de openbare orde, tegen de achtergrond van de maatschappelijke onrust, zoals verwoord in een brief van de NCTV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Azmani over het kort geding dat is aangespannen door twee vrouwen tegen de Islamitische Universiteit Rotterdam

MPs Duisenberg and Azmani asked about a summary-proceedings lawsuit by two women against the Islamic University of Rotterdam, the grounds for expelling students from non-funded programmes, and whether the institution's conduct should affect its accreditation. The minister answered that civil law governs non-funded institutions, that the court ordered the students reinstated, and that the Inspectorate and NVAO are conducting enhanced supervision and a visitation, with new legislation planned.
I have asked the Inspectorate to proceed with what in practice amounts to enhanced supervision.
Ik heb de Inspectie gevraagd om over te gaan tot wat in de praktijk neerkomt op verscherpt toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over "de toespraak van de Britse premier Cameron en de berichtgeving ‘Cameron presenteert strengere regels voor EU-migranten"

The Azmani MP questions asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UK Prime Minister Cameron's speech proposing stricter rules for intra-EU migrants, including job offers before migration, a six-month job-search limit, a welfare phase-in model, export limits on child benefit, and reform of EU social security coordination. The Minister answers that the Netherlands values free movement and will not back restrictions on it, notes existing EU limits, argues a seven-year welfare waiting period conflicts with international obligations and EU rules, and says it is pursuing reform of the unemployment provisions of Regulation 883/2004 with like-minded states.
The Netherlands will not support initiatives that restrict this fundamental principle for specific groups of EU citizens.
Nederland zal geen steun verlenen aan initiatieven die dit fundamentele beginsel voor specifieke groepen EU-burgers beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over de brief ‘Beleidsreactie op het WODC rapport over de au-pairregeling’

An MP from the VVD asks why the au pair scheme is being tightened on the basis of a 2012/2014 WODC study, given that the 2013 Modern Migration Policy Act already tightened enforcement, and why the government wants to cut weekly hours, require a Dutch course and limit cultural exchange. The State Secretary and Minister reply that the study shows widespread overwork and heavy household tasks contrary to the scheme's cultural-exchange purpose, that intensified enforcement and a declaration of commitment will be used, that the Dutch course is encouraged rather than mandatory, and that the letter sent with the answers contains the decision.
Therefore we are intensifying enforcement with the aim of improving compliance with the rules and detecting more violations.
Daaarom intensiveren wij de handhaving met als doel de naleving van de regels te verbeteren en meer overtredingen op te sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Cameron beperkt uitkeringen voor EU-migranten’

An MP asked whether the Netherlands could follow the UK in halving the period EU migrants may claim benefits, after UK Prime Minister Cameron announced such a cut. The minister replied that Dutch jobseekers get no social assistance so a halving is not applicable, and that EU workers keep worker status for at least six months under the free movement directive, with equal treatment required under Regulation 883/2004.
Distinguishing between migrants and Dutch nationals in benefit conditions is not permitted under the anti-discrimination rule.
Onderscheid binnen de uitkeringsvoorwaarden tussen migranten en Nederlanders is op grond van het discriminatieverbod niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het verstrekken van het burgerservicenummer

MP Azmani asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the municipality of Rotterdam's idea of withholding citizen service numbers (BSN) from EU migrants in cases of overcrowded housing is acceptable, and what can be done about overcrowding and nuisance. The minister answered that EU law does not allow withholding or refusing a BSN for this purpose, pointed to municipal instruments and pilots on registering residence addresses, and said the cabinet will seek allies in Europe against abuses of free movement.
Although I find this an interesting idea, European regulations leave no room for no longer issuing or temporarily withholding the BSN when there is overcrowding.
Hoewel ik dit een interessante gedachte vind, biedt de Europese regelgeving geen ruimte voor het niet meer verstrekken of het tijdelijk aanhouden van het BSN wanneer er sprake is van overbewoning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Pieter Heerma over het bericht ‘Duitsland mag EU-burgers uitkering weigeren’

MPs Azmani and Heerma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a German court ruling allowing benefits to be refused to EU citizens, its consequences for a motion on refusing assistance to EU job seekers, and whether they would exchange experiences with German and Belgian counterparts. The minister replied that the case concerns an economically inactive person and an Advocate General's opinion rather than a ruling, that job seekers from other EU states already have no right to assistance so no bill is needed, and that consultation with Germany and Belgium takes place where relevant.
As regards job-seeking citizens from other EU countries, it already applies in the Netherlands that they have no right to assistance.
Voor wat betreft werkzoekende burgers uit andere landen van de Europese Unie geldt in Nederland al dat zij geen recht hebben op bijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Vrijgelaten piraten willen asiel’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether it is acceptable that Somali pirates who shot at Dutch soldiers and were jailed could seek asylum in the Netherlands, and how asylum policy prevents such people from freely moving in the country. The Secretary declined to confirm individual asylum applications, explained that criminal records are weighed and that Article 1F or public-order grounds can lead to refusal, and stated that return of the roughly 25 Somali pirates is being pursued, with one already deported.
The Dutch government does not make statements about asylum applications submitted by individual foreigners.
De Nederlandse regering doet geen mededelingen over asielaanvragen die door individuele vreemdelingen zijn ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Zeker 28 illegalen op top 600-lijst’

MP Azmani (VVD) asked the State Secretary about reports that at least 28 illegal immigrants with criminal records are on Amsterdam's Top 600 list, and how their return is managed, including handover from prison to immigration detention and supervision measures. The State Secretary answered that a special case-consultation with DT&V, police, OM and others is in place, that a new VRIS protocol took effect in January 2014, and that supervision measures such as reporting duties and sureties are used case by case, without committing to new steps.
Since mid-2013 there has been a special case-consultation for foreigners within Amsterdam's Top600.
Sinds medio 2013 is er een speciaal casusoverleg voor de vreemdelingen binnen de Amsterdamse Top600.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Large increase to almost 435000 asylum applicants registered in the EU28 in 2013’

An MP asked the State Secretary about a Eurostat report on a sharp rise in asylum applications in the EU in 2013, the reasons for the rise in Somali applicants, whether family reunification rules for Somalis differ, and whether intake of Somalis could be restricted given social problems. The State Secretary attributed the Somali increase largely to family reunification, said there is no specific Somali reunification policy, and argued that EU law leaves no room to restrict intake, while explaining Dutch recognition rates as partly a product of procedure and nationality mix.
Without commenting on the possible extent of social problems with Somalis, I therefore see no possibilities to limit the inflow of Somalis.
Zonder een uitspraak te doen over de eventuele omvang van maatschappelijke problemen met Somaliërs, zie ik dan ook geen mogelijkheden om de instroom van Somaliërs te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht “Sjoemelen met moskeeën”

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether EU structural subsidy for a multifunctional centre in Amsterdam was misused to fund a mosque and gender-segregated Koran lessons. The minister answers that the mosque and the subsidised centre were separate parts of the building, that the EU fraud office OLAF is investigating the use of the subsidy and its outcome is awaited, and that the projects were checked by an accountant and the Auditdienst.
The outcome of the investigation cannot be anticipated.
Er kan niet worden vooruitgelopen op de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Pieter Heerma over het bericht “België wil af van ‘arme’ Nederlanders”

MPs Azmani and Heerma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Belgian reports on expelling EU nationals who become an unreasonable burden on social assistance, and whether Dutch practice and data-sharing with the IND and Belgian systems should change. The minister replied that the Netherlands already follows a similar course, that the Azmani/Hamer motion and the Rotterdam pilot are being worked on, that Dutch data exchange is not automated, and that the Belgium cooperation declaration focuses on integration rather than the Belgian control system.
Work is currently under way on implementing the Azmani/Hamer motion (dated 28 May 2013).
Op dit moment wordt gewerkt aan de uitwerking van de motie Azmani/Hamer (d.d. 28 mei 2013).
Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over «Minimaal 100 studiehuizen Gülen-beweging in Nederland» (ingezonden 5 februari 2014).

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of at least 100 Gülen-movement study houses in the Netherlands, including whether they fall under education inspection, whether they indoctrinate youth and whether they promote segregation. The minister said such private residences are not education under the inspection law, that the government finds isolation of youth undesirable, and that the studied Amsterdam houses had residents attending regular Dutch institutions.
Private initiatives such as these study houses do not fall under that.
Private initiatieven zoals deze studiehuizen vallen daar niet onder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Situatie in de Vluchtgarage dreigt uit de hand te lopen’

MP Azmani asks why a squat housing rejected asylum seekers in Amsterdam's Vluchtgarage is tolerated, why it is not cleared, and why violent incidents led to no detention. The state secretary replies that the squat is not a municipal shelter, that Amsterdam's policy avoids clearing vacant buildings, that police act where needed, and that the return service is available to talk to residents.
I am and remain of course in discussion with the mayor of Amsterdam about the situation that has arisen.
Ik ben en blijf uiteraard in gesprek met de burgemeester van Amsterdam over de ontstane situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht 'Amsterdam: 1,7 miljoen euro extra voor illegalen' en de brief van burgemeester Van der Laan van 30 januari jl.

The VVD MP Azmani asked whether the proposed structural 1.7 million euro for shelter for undocumented migrants in Amsterdam conflicts with the 2007 bestuursakkoord and whether the minister will act against municipalities offering structural shelter. Minister Teeven answered that the 2007 agreement still stands, that the Amsterdam plan is compatible with it as crisis shelter, and that the government will engage with municipalities that do not respect these limits.
With municipalities that do not respect these principles, I will enter into discussion.
Met gemeenten die deze uitgangspunten niet respecteren, ga ik in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht dat al bijna een jaar nauwelijks wordt ingeburgerd

An MP asked the minister about reports that almost no newcomers have been completing civic integration in the year since responsibility shifted to them, and about the lack of municipal oversight of integration progress. The minister replied that only 1,084 loans had been granted, that the number of loans is not a reliable measure, that municipalities no longer have any role, and that DUO and surveys will provide oversight, with a report to parliament promised for spring 2014.
I will inform the House in spring 2014 in more detail about the efforts and results of civic integration of new integration obligation holders in 2013.
Ik zal de Kamer in het voorjaar van 2014 nader informeren over de inspanningen en resultaten van de inburgering van nieuwe inburgeringsplichtigen in 2013.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Azmani en Van der Linde over signalen dat Sint Maarten zich bij het verlenen van de Nederlandse nationaliteit niet houdt aan de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap

MPs Bosman, Azmani and Van der Linde asked whether signals exist that Sint Maarten grants Dutch nationality in breach of the Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap, and whether the Sint Maarten Justice Minister wants to ease passport grants for immigrants, along with related questions. The state secretary answered that such signals are unknown, that the Sint Maarten minister disavowed the newspaper report and said only the Kingdom government may grant nationality, and that the rules should remain uniform across the Kingdom.
Signals as referred to in the first question are not known to us.
Signalen als bedoeld in de eerste vraag zijn ons niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over de brief «de aantallen opgelegde boetes aan luchtvervoerders die de Vreemdelingenwet overtreden»

An MP asks why undocumented passengers still exit aircraft despite carrier copy and care duties, and how carriers are fined and prosecuted under the Aliens Act. The State Secretary explains the copy duty applies to 27 departure airports, cabins are searched when suspicion arises, and fines and prosecutions were inconsistent before 2013 due to MOU arrangements and a legal gap, with stronger cost recovery planned as the main lever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘EU plan to suspend visa-free travel’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that the European Commission may take legal action over the EU mechanism to suspend visa-free travel, and what this means for the Netherlands. The government said the Commission's concerns concern the reciprocity mechanism, that the emergency brake was a Dutch initiative, and that it expects the legislation to be finalised quickly.
The European Commission's concerns relate to the reciprocity mechanism.
De bedenkingen van de Europese Commissie liggen op het terrein van het reciprociteitsmechanisme.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Kanslozenkaravaan uit Balkan komt eraan’

MP Azmani asked the Minister of Social Affairs about media reports of Romanian police encouraging unemployed people with criminal records to migrate to richer EU states, and asked whether the minister would contact Romanian and other counterparts and the Commission to stop it. The minister answered that he has no signals of such an encouragement policy, describes bilateral cooperation with Romania and Bulgaria on labour exploitation and malafide agencies, and says no further contact is warranted on that basis, while outlining existing options to expel or refuse Romanian offenders.
I have no indications that the Romanian government sees this differently.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de Roemeense overheid dit anders ziet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Politie hielp minderjarigen met islamitisch huwelijk’

An MP from the VVD asked the government whether police, Fier Fryslân and youth care helped minors enter a religious-only Islamic marriage to prevent honour-related conflict, and what consequences should follow. The minister answered that these bodies were involved only for safety and did not broker the marriage, that such marriages are prohibited, and that nationality withdrawal is not possible under current law.
The police only ensured the safety of the person involved.
De politie heeft slechts gezorgd voor de veiligheid van betrokkene.
Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Duitsers boos om asielbeleid Italië» (ingezonden 3 juni 2013).

Azmani (VVD) asks the state secretary whether Italy's granting of temporary residence and travel documents to African refugees affects the Netherlands and what can be done about it. Teeven answers that few such persons have been found in the Netherlands, that he will support EU colleagues in asking Italy for clarification, and that persons without sufficient means can be ordered to return to Italy.
However, I will support my colleagues in Europe who do experience major consequences from the Italian approach and are now asking the Italian authorities for clarification.
Wel zal ik in Europees verband mijn collega's steunen die wel grote gevolgen ondervinden van de Italiaanse handelwijze en nu bij de Italiaanse autoriteiten om opheldering vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Criminele Roma-families zetten eigen kinderen in’

MPs Azmani and Dijkhoff asked about reports that criminal Roma families use their own children in crime, including whether children are freed after arrest, whether birth registration and GBA deregistration hinder oversight, and what measures will be taken. The minister confirms a Police Academy study showing children involved in property crime, says there is no insight into amounts stolen, refers to earlier answers on prosecuting parents and GBA rules, and promises a joint programme to implement the study's recommendations.
In a joint programme with my colleague of Social Affairs and Employment, we will translate these recommendations into measures.
In een gezamenlijk programma met mijn collega van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid gaan wij deze aanbevelingen omzetten in maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Azmani over de uitvoering van de “koudweerregeling” die regelt dat uitgeprocedeerde vreemdelingen niet uit de opvang worden geplaatst als het vriest

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how the informal 'cold weather arrangement' (vorstcoulance) for rejected asylum seekers is applied, including criteria, whether COA evicted people during recent cold periods, how it handles forecast frost, and whether it will consult municipalities. The State Secretary answered that it is an informal COA practice, denied evictions during frost periods, said forecast-frost cases are weighed case by case, and saw no reason for consultation now, though the topic could be raised in regular VNG meetings.
COA ensures that during the frost period foreigners are not put out on the street by COA.
Het COA draagt er zorg voor dat vreemdelingen tijdens de vorstperiode niet door het COA op straat gezet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht «Jeugd naar Syrië gelokt voor djihad»

An MP asked the government about reports that Dutch youth were recruited to jihad in Syria, including foreign influence on youth, the number involved, follow-up with families and youth care, Morocco's deradicalisation projects, and imams from Lebanon and Syria. The government answered that it is concerned, has no evidence of foreign state recruitment, will not say how many radicalised youths or preachers are active and cannot give figures, and described existing AIVD and prosecution tools while leaving case-by-case handling open.
I have no indications that foreign powers are recruiting for the jihadist struggle.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat er sprake is van ronseling voor de jihadistische strijd door vreemde mogendheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over de toename van het gebruik van sociale uitkeringen door arbeidsmigranten

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about rising social benefit use by EU labour migrants and what the government would do, including whether such migrants should be entitled to benefits within a year of arrival. The minister answered that the increase is mainly linked to a larger migrant population and the crisis, that EU migrants with a right of residence as workers may claim assistance without losing residence rights in all cases, that the IND assesses residence consequences case by case, and that the government is pursuing EU-level changes such as a seven-year waiting period.
I intend to ask the SCP to pay attention, in the context of the Integration Annual Report 2013, to benefit use by migrants compared with comparable native Dutch people.
Ik ben voornemens het SCP te vragen in het kader van het Jaarrapport Integratie 2013 aandacht te besteden aan het uitkeringsgebruik van migranten in vergelijking met vergelijkbare autochtonen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht “Kamerleden nacht in ‘Vluchtkerk’”

MP Azmani asked the state secretary about a municipality (Smallingerland) funding temporary emergency shelter for ex-asylum seekers and whether this breaches the 2007 agreement, and what the government can do about it, plus alleged delays by India and Pakistan in issuing return documents. The state secretary answered that structural emergency shelter is unnecessary and undesirable, pointed to existing 12-week shelter for those cooperating with return, will engage in dialogue with the VNG and municipalities, and stated no countries are known to structurally refuse returns.
I note that the intended target group of the shelter in Smallingerland includes foreigners who cooperate in their return.
Ik stel vast dat de beoogde doelgroep van de opvang in Smallingerland onder meer vreemdelingen zijn die meewerken aan hun terugkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Yücel over moskee-internaten

MPs Azmani and Yücel asked ministers about moskee-internaten (mosque boarding schools), including Rotterdam's fire-safety enforcement, reports of corporal punishment, integration concerns, and whether legal tools exist. The ministers answered that local authorities are responsible, that the Rotterdam fire-safety conclusion is accepted, that a quality framework and supervision proposal will be developed by May, and that no full picture of indirect subsidies exists yet.

Therefore it has been agreed that central government and municipalities, in consultation with the internaten concerned and other parties, will develop a quality framework focusing on, among other things, pedagogical policy, safety and the welfare of children at these boarding schools.

Daarom is afgesproken dat rijk en gemeenten in afstemming met de betrokken internaten en eventuele andere partijen zullen komen tot een kwaliteitskader met aandacht voor onder andere het pedagogisch beleid, de veiligheid en het welzijn van kinderen op deze internaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Rel rond illegale Marokkanen’

MP Azmani asked the State Secretary about the ambassador's claim that illegal Marokkanen stay because of Moroccan obstruction, and what consequences this should have for relations with Morocco. The State Secretary said Morocco's cooperation on nationality checks and travel documents can improve, that the EU holds the readmission negotiating mandate, and that bilateral contacts and linkage to other dossiers are being pursued.
The Netherlands wants requests for nationality determination and issuance of replacement travel documents to be processed more quickly.
Nederland wil graag dat verzoeken tot nationaliteitsvaststelling en afgifte van vervangende reisdocumenten sneller worden afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Azmani over het bericht “Woningen speciaal voor Moslims in Amsterdam”

MPs Visser and Azmani asked whether housing corporation Eigen Haard's renovation of 188 flats in Amsterdam was tailored to Muslim residents' wishes (shoe cabinets, ritual-washing taps, sliding doors, satellite reception) and whether this constitutes misuse of public funds and segregation. Minister Blok answers that the reported details are largely inaccurate, the extra cost was only about 25 euro per tap, the flats are allocated under regular rules, and he finds religion-specific housing undesirable and will raise it with Aedes and, if needed, use legal instruments.
I will discuss this with Aedes.
Ik zal hierover met Aedes in contact treden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht “Ministerie ziet een duidelijke toename arbeidsuitbuiting”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of rising labour exploitation, whether zero tolerance applies, how many fines, sanctions or work stoppages were imposed, and what will be done to prevent it. The minister confirmed zero tolerance, explained the new sanctions law (effective 1 January 2013) and stated that court rulings on six completed investigations are still pending, so no details on violations or recidivism can be given.
Antwoord vragen Elias en Azmani over werkloze jongeren die op reis gaan naar Schotland

MPs Elias and Azmani (VVD) asked why unemployed youths are sent on a work placement to Scotland under an EU Leonardo da Vinci subsidy, questioning its value compared with domestic options and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The state secretary defended the project as eligible under EU criteria, said municipalities are responsible for tailored reintegration, and said the EU funds cannot be reclaimed while the project is still running.
These are EU funds, managed by the National Agency Lifelong Learning and awarded under European subsidy conditions.
Het betreft EU-middelen, die door het Nationaal Agentschap Leven Lang Leren worden beheerd en op grond van Europese subsidievoorwaarden zijn toegekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Azmani over "in het buitenland gedetineerde uitkeringsontvangers"

An MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about unemployment and social benefit recipients detained abroad, including whether the Foreign Ministry can share detention data and whether such benefits can be stopped. The government answers that benefits must stop during detention abroad, that current data-sharing rules under the privacy law block the transfer, and that a legislative amendment will create a legal basis for sharing the data.

On the basis of this statutory basis, the Minister of Foreign Affairs can provide data on detained Dutch nationals and foreigners with a Dutch residence permit, which he holds and which are necessary for entitlement to benefits, to municipalities, SVB and UWV.

Op basis van deze wettelijke grondslag kan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken de gegevens van in het buitenland gedetineerde Nederlanders en buitenlanders met een Nederlandse verblijfsvergunning, waarover hij beschikt en die noodzakelijk zijn voor het recht op een uitkering, verstrekken aan gemeenten, SVB en UWV.
Antwoord vragen Azmani over het bericht ‘Frauderende moeders moeten afval ruimen’ en het bericht ‘Arme fraudeurs moeten vuilnis rapen’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about news reports that mothers defrauding childcare benefits were sentenced to unpaid community work instead of fines, and whether this is proportionate. The minister replied that the reports overstated the numbers (38 women, not hundreds), explained the prosecution framework and fraud threshold, and announced stricter administrative fines and sanctions via a bill and revised prosecution guidelines.
The report speaks of "hundreds of women", while this concerns 38 women.
Het bericht spreekt van «honderden vrouwen», terwijl dit 38 vrouwen betreft.

Vragen van de leden Lucas, Van Nieuwenhuizen en Azmani (allen VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over studiefinanciering voor studenten u

MPs asked how many foreign students who also count as migrant workers receive study finance, the EU basis for the rule, other social provisions open to them, how hours worked are checked, and whether the eligibility threshold can be tightened. The state secretary reported a rising share of migrant-worker students among EU students, cited EU law and the Dutch 32-hour monthly norm checked by DUO, and announced raising the norm to 56 hours from next year.
I intend to implement this tightening with effect from next calendar year.
Ik ben voornemens deze aanscherping met ingang van volgend kalenderjaar door te voeren.

Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Grootschalige fraude met uitkeringsgeld jonggehandicapten» (ingezonden 12 december 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of large-scale fraud with benefit payments for young disabled people via jobcoach firms, whether UWV failed to act despite earlier internal signals, how hours are checked, and how fraud will be prevented and recovered. The state secretary confirmed at least 200,000 euro of suspected fraud at one firm, said earlier 2006 signals were not found to be ignored, described the hour-checking and accreditation rules, and promised recovery of all defrauded money with reference to a separate letter.
The starting point is that fraud must not pay and that this is being tackled firmly.
Voorop staat dat fraude niet mag lonen en dat dit hard wordt aangepakt.
Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over «Te veel jongeren in de Wajong» (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that municipalities moved young people from the WWB/WIJ benefit to the Wajong disability scheme for financial reasons, and about the role of UWV and the Wajong intake rate. The state secretary acknowledges the substitution effect, points to the planned Wet Werken naar Vermogen to unify responsibility with municipalities, and says he will consider preventing cost-shifting in the detailed design of that bill.
I will take this aspect into account in the further elaboration of the Werken naar Vermogen bill.
Ik zal dit aspect betrekken bij de nadere uitwerking van het wetsvoorstel Werken naar Vermogen.

Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de plannen van de gemeente Vaals om burgers uit de Europese Unie (EU) zonder inkomen te weren en de reactie van de EU daarop (inge

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the municipality of Vaals' plan to deny residence to EU citizens without income and the European Commission's reaction, including concerns about welfare claims by EU migrants. The minister said the situations are undesirable, announced a bill so benefits are granted only after IND confirms residence rights, and committed to exploring EU-level changes to aggregation and benefit rules.

I am preparing a bill that regulates that – where applicable – foreigners (EU citizens and non-EU foreigners) only become eligible for social assistance after the lawfulness of their residence right, precisely because of the claim on assistance, has been established by the IND.

Ik bereid een wetsvoorstel voor dat regelt dat – in voorkomende gevallen – vreemdelingen (EU-burgers en vreemdelingen van buiten de EU) pas in aanmerking komen voor bijstand, nadat de rechtmatigheid van het verblijfsrecht – juist vanwege het beroep op bijstand – door de IND is vastgesteld.
Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over Oost-Europeanen die frauderen om een uitkering te krijgen (ingezonden 4 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Eastern European EU citizens register as self-employed in the Netherlands to obtain benefits, as reportedly happens in Belgium, and how controls work. The minister answered that registration alone does not increase benefit eligibility, that no abuse comparable to Belgium is recognised, and pointed to measures in his April letter on labour migration.
At present I therefore do not recognise the abuse that may occur in Belgium. I see no reason to conduct research into this now.
Op dit moment herken ik dan ook niet het misbruik zoals dat in België mogelijk voorkomt. Ik zie geen aanleiding hier nu onderzoek naar te doen.

Vragen van de leden Ziengs en Azmani (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het feit dat door toedoen van de arbeidsinspectie goedwillende

VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the labour inspectorate's fining of employers who unknowingly hired foreign workers, due to incomplete government information, is acceptable and whether information provision and fine mitigation could be improved. The ministers answered that government information is adequate, fines can be moderated when fault is limited, and an information campaign and inter-agency coordination are ongoing, without committing to new rules.

If after finding a violation of the Foreign Workers Act it appears that an employer made sufficient efforts to ensure lawful implementation and can show they bear no blame for the violation, no fine will be imposed.

Indien na constatering van een overtreding van de Wet arbeid vreemdelingen blijkt dat een werkgever zich voldoende heeft ingespannen om een wetsconforme uitvoering te bewerkstelligen en hij aannemelijk kan maken dat hem voor de geconstateerde overtreding geen enkel verwijt treft, dan zal ook geen boete worden opgelegd.
Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over Roemeense seizoensarbeiders in West-Brabant (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether UWV tightened conditions for hiring Romanian seasonal workers in West-Brabant, whether employers had enough time to find Dutch workers, and whether unemployment benefits should be cut for refusing work. The minister replied that the conditions are unchanged but UWV now checks domestic and EU supply more strictly, that employers are primarily responsible for recruitment, and that UWV was asked to observe a transition period until 1 July.

Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen en Azmani (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het rapport van de Universiteit Utrecht en de Vrije

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Social Affairs about the Utrecht/VU report on Diyanet, the Turkish state religious authority, including whether Turkish imams in the Netherlands are employed by Diyanet, whether Diyanet links to Gülen movement activities exist, and whether subsidies to Diyanet-linked organisations should stop. The minister answered that the government holds no data on imams or mosques, that a foreign state's contacts with its nationals should be voluntary, that no Diyanet-Gülen cooperation was found, and that no subsidies go to integration-obstructing organisations.
The central government keeps no figures on the number of mosques in the Netherlands and has no insight into the number of imams or the type of employment they have.
De Rijksoverheid houdt geen cijfers bij van het aantal moskeeën in Nederland en heeft ook geen zicht op het aantal imams en het soort dienstverband dat zij hebben.

m: Amendement van de leden Van der Steur en Recourt ter vervanging van nr. 14, dat regelt dat niet langer overeenstemming dient te bestaan met de Sectorcommissie rechterlijke macht over voorstellen strek
Replaces the requirement of agreement with the Sectorcommissie rechterlijke macht on rules affecting judicial officials with a mere requirement to obtain its advice.
that agreement with the Sectorcommissie rechterlijke macht is no longer required for proposals
dat niet langer overeenstemming dient te bestaan met de Sectorcommissie rechterlijke macht over voorstellen

Amendement van het lid Van der Steur dat regelt dat niet langer overeenstemming dient te bestaan met de Sectorcommissie rechterlijke macht over voorstellen strekkende tot invoering, wijziging of intre
Amendment replacing the judiciary staff committee's consent requirement with a mere advisory role for rules affecting judicial officials.
'if agreement exists with the Sector committee for the judiciary' is replaced by: if advice has been obtained from the Sector committee for the judiciary
wordt «indien daarover overeenstemming bestaat met de Sectorcommissie rechterlijke macht» vervangen door: indien daarover advies is ingewonnen
Amendement van de leden Oskam en Van der Steur dat regelt dat de disciplinaire maatregelen zowel voorwaardelijk als onvoorwaardelijk kunnen worden opgelegd

Amendment allows disciplinary measures against judicial officials to be imposed conditionally as well as unconditionally, with supervision of conditions and enforcement by court presidents or the Hoge Raad.
The disciplinary measures, referred to in the first paragraph, may be imposed both conditionally and unconditionally.
De disciplinaire maatregelen, genoemd in het eerste lid, kunnen zowel voorwaardelijk als onvoorwaardelijk worden opgelegd.
Amendement van de leden Van der Steur en Oskam dat regelt een rechterlijk ambtenaar of rechterlijk ambtenaar in opleiding na de benoeming kan worden gevraagd opnieuw een verklaring omtrent het gedrag
Allows the functional authority or court president to ask sitting judges and judicial trainees to submit a new certificate of conduct (VOG) after appointment, as an extra integrity check.
The functional authority may request a judicial officer or judicial trainee to submit a certificate of conduct as referred to in Article 4a, first paragraph.
De functionele autoriteit kan een rechterlijk ambtenaar of rechterlijk ambtenaar in opleiding verzoeken een verklaring omtrent het gedrag als bedoeld in artikel 4a, eerste lid, te overleggen.

Amendement van de leden Van der Steur en Oskam dat regelt dat naast de disciplinaire maatregelen van schriftelijke berisping, schorsing en ontslag eveneens de disciplinaire maatregel van schriftelijke
Amendment adding the disciplinary measure of written warning for judges alongside reprimand, suspension and dismissal.
the disciplinary measure of written warning may also be imposed
eveneens de disciplinaire maatregel van schriftelijke waarschuwing kan worden opgelegd

Amendement van de leden Oskam en Van der Steur dat regelt dat naast de disciplinaire maatregelen van schriftelijke berisping, schorsing en ontslag eveneens de disciplinaire maatregel van gehele of ged
Adds salary withholding for up to three months as a disciplinary measure for judicial officials, imposable only by the Hoge Raad, plus transitional rules.
This amendment specifically provides that, alongside the disciplinary measures of written reprimand, suspension and dismissal, withholding of all or part of the salary may also be imposed.

Dit amendement regelt concreet dat naast de disciplinaire maatregelen van schriftelijke berisping, schorsing en ontslag eveneens de disciplinaire maatregel van gehele of gedeeltelijke inhouding van de bezoldiging kan worden opgelegd.

Amendement van de leden Van der Steur en Recourt dat regelt dat naast de reeds voorgestelde disciplinaire maatregelen van schriftelijke berisping, schorsing en ontslag eveneens de disciplinaire maatre

Amendment adds transfer and demotion measures (change of court assignment, dismissal with right to reappointment in a lower post) to disciplinary sanctions for judicial officials, imposed only by the Hoge Raad, with salary and reappointment rules.
These measures, like suspension and dismissal, can only be imposed by the Supreme Court.
Deze maatregelen kunnen, evenals de maatregelen van schorsing en ontslag, alleen worden opgelegd door de Hoge Raad.
Motie van de leden Schouw en Van Der Steur over in kaart brengen van effecten en kwaliteit van het toezicht vijftien jaar na invoering
Asks the government to evaluate, fifteen years after introduction, the use of long-term supervision of offenders, its effects on recidivism and the quality of supervision, and to report to the House.

requests the government, fifteen years after the introduction of long-term supervision, to map the application of long-term supervision, its effects on recidivism and the quality of supervision, and to present the results to the House for discussion

verzoekt de regering, vijftien jaar na de invoering van langdurig toezicht (wetsvoorstel 33816) de toepassing van langdurig toezicht, de effecten op recidive en de kwaliteit van het toezicht in kaart te brengen en de uitkomsten ter bespreking aan de Kamer voor te leggen
Motie van de leden Schouw en Van Der Steur over rapporteren over toepassing en effecten in de recidivemonitor van het WODC

Asks the government to have the WODC recidivism monitor explicitly report on the use and effects of long-term supervision and the independent measure for sex and violent offenders, and inform the House.
requests the government to have the WODC recidivism monitor explicitly report on the application and effects of long-term supervision
verzoekt de regering, in de recidivemonitor van het WODC expliciet te (laten) rapporteren over de toepassing en effecten van het langdurig toezicht

An MP asked ministers about reports that Salafists were standing watch during New Year's Eve in The Hague's Schilderswijk and about cooperation between the city and the as-Soennah mosque, including whether a Chamber motion to end such cooperation would be implemented. The government replied that local triangle bodies decide on cooperation with organisations, pointed to a normative framework sent to Parliament, and said police and municipality maintain a dialogue with a wide range of organisations.
In the local context, it remains up to the municipality to organise the involvement of organisations when shaping its integrated security policy.
In de lokale context blijft het aan de gemeente om bij de vormgeving van haar integraal veiligheidsbeleid betrokkenheid van organisaties te organiseren.

The government answered that volunteers have no special powers and are supervised by police, and that judging the mayor's performance is a matter for the municipal council.

MPs from the VVD asked whether personal injury compensation for road accident victims should be exempt from the asset income surcharge that affects Wlz and Wmo co-payments, following a call by insurers and victim groups. The government answered that the surcharge applies in principle, that only compensation for non-material damage and claims fixed before 11 October 2010 are excluded under the hardship clause, and that it is consulting stakeholders with findings promised before summer.
I expect to be able to inform your House before the summer about the outcomes of these consultations.

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment and the Minister of Security and Justice how waste crime by illegal dumpers is being tackled, including reinstating financial security deposits and escrow accounts. The government says it supports the polluter-pays principle, points to existing enforcement and prosecution tools, is willing to consult provinces and waste sector, but sees no reason yet to reintroduce financial security for these firms and considers escrow measures unsuitable.
Naturally I am willing to take measures if that helps to tackle the problem better, but for now I see no reason to reintroduce financial security for this type of company.

Vanzelfsprekend ben ik bereid om maatregelen te treffen als dat helpt om de problematiek nog beter aan te kunnen pakken, maar vooralsnog zie ik geen reden om financiële zekerheid voor dit type bedrijven opnieuw in te voeren.

The ministers replied that temporary extra capacity (135 fte) and e-gates will allow minimum performance in 2017, with structural needs to be considered in the 2018 budget and formation options to be proposed.
Together with the airports, the aim is a safe yet swift flow of passengers, and a proper balance between mobility and security is continually sought.
Gezamenlijk met de luchthavens, wordt gestreefd naar een veilige doch snelle doorstroom van passagiers en wordt voortdurend naar een juiste balans tussen «mobiliteit» en veiligheid gezocht.

MPs Van Toorenburg and Knops (CDA) asked ministers whether KMar border-guard capacity at Schiphol would be expanded given rising passenger numbers and terror threat, and about funding and timing of extra staff. The government answered that 135 temporary FTE are funded from incidental resources and available by summer 2017, that structural capacity will be considered in the 2018 budget and formation options, and that it declines to bear the 190 million euro automation cost at Schiphol.
In the current situation, with Schiphol's healthy financial position and a competitive cost level for airlines, the cabinet sees no reason to also contribute financially to the investment programme.

The minister said the ILT found no violations since the 2014 SOLAS ban, that it is considering joint checks with other inspection services, and that international action depends on further information.

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked ministers how the government will act on bullying after a 15-year-old pupil took her life, including whether an independent investigation will be launched and what is done to prevent bullying. The state secretary answers that school-safety law, inspection oversight and an ongoing joint inspectorate review are in place, that an independent review into the authorities' conduct is underway, and that specific national suicide-by-bullying figures are not available.
Under the banner of the Social Domain Supervision/Joint Youth Supervision (TSD/STJ), a preliminary investigation is currently taking place.
Onder de vlag van het Toezicht Sociaal Domein/Samenwerkend Toezicht Jeugd (TSD/STJ) vindt momenteel een vooronderzoek plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over jongeren die in een psychiatrische kliniek belanden na sexting

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about rising psychiatric admissions of young people after sexting, whether it should be criminalised, who the victims are, and whether clinics are prepared. The government answered that existing criminal law (art. 240b, 240, 139f/g, 266, 261, 262, 284, 138ab Sr) suffices, that prevention and parental/school education are being expanded, and that trauma care via CSGs and specialised youth psychiatry exists, while committing only to an ongoing study of victims' reporting motives.
As my predecessor indicated in the letter of 29 February 2016 to the House, there is no reason to amend the criminal law in connection with sexting.
Zoals mijn ambtsvoorganger in de brief van 29 februari 2016 aan uw Kamer heeft aangegeven is voor aanpassing van de strafwet in verband met «sexting» geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over gebrek aan snelheidscontroles in diverse gemeenten

An MP asked whether police in several municipalities are not enforcing speed limits on 30 and 60 km/h roads and whether this policy should be tightened for road safety. The minister replied that enforcement is decentralised to local tripartite arrangements, that police and prosecutors set national enforcement priorities including speed, and that no overview exists of how many municipalities include road safety in their plans.
I do not have an overview available of the total number of municipalities that have included road safety as a priority in their safety plans.
Ik heb geen overzicht beschikbaar van het totaal aantal gemeenten dat de verkeersveiligheid als prioriteit in de veiligheidsplannen heeft opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Pieter Heerma over het bericht 'Omstreden imam terug in Gouda'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Heerma asked why a controversial imam, whose visa had reportedly been revoked earlier, was able to speak in Gouda, and whether investigation, visa denial and withdrawal of the host association's ANBI status were pursued. The minister answered that the imam holds a Belgian (EU) passport so entry can only be refused on strict grounds, that police were present at the event without finding incitement, and that ANBI status can be withdrawn only after an investigation by the Tax Authority.
For preachers holding EU nationality, on the basis of statements made on Dutch soil that conflict with Dutch law, prosecution by the Public Prosecution Service may be possible.

Voor predikers die over een EU-nationaliteit beschikken geldt dat zij op basis van hun uitspraken die zij op Nederlandse bodem doen die in strijd zijn met Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving mogelijk vervolgd kunnen worden door het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Jihadonderzoeker UvA uitte zelf steun voor strijders van IS’

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about reports that a junior UvA researcher on a jihad study had posted online statements praising jihadist fighters, and whether this warrants prosecution and a response from the university. The government condemned the statements, said the UvA disavowed them, declined to comment on individual prosecutions, and treated the methodological debate as a matter of academic freedom outside ministerial involvement.
As your House knows, the Minister of Security and Justice does not make statements about individual (criminal) cases.
Zoals uw Kamer weet doet de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie geen mededelingen over individuele (straf)zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht ‘Jihadonderzoeker UvA uitte zelf steun voor strijders van IS’

PVV MPs asked whether a report that a UvA jihad researcher expressed support for IS fighters is used in prosecutions of Syria travellers, and what will be done to stop alleged misuse of education, and whether returnees can be barred. The government said the prosecution has no knowledge of the report being used in court, that academic quality is for the academic community to judge, and that it will act only against clear discrimination or calls to armed jihad; on travellers it described existing prosecution, monitoring and new nationality-revocation powers.
It is for the academic community to assess and qualify the scholarly character of research.
Het is aan de academische gemeenschap om het wetenschappelijk karakter van onderzoek te beoordelen en te kwalificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht ‘Jihadonderzoeker UvA uitte zelf steun voor strijders van IS’ en over een onderzoek naar Europese vrouwen in IS-gebied

Member Marcouch asked the ministers whether the government knew of a UvA study on European women in IS territory, whether it influenced policy or court cases, and whether its conclusions were verifiable. Minister Blok answered that the government was unaware of the study beforehand, that it has no influence on policy, that courts judge the weight of such research, and that the UvA handles methodological reflection itself.
It is up to the judge to weigh how much value the study has in a court case.
Het is aan de rechter om af te wegen hoeveel waarde het onderzoek in een rechtszaak heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht 'Cel voor gijzelen importbruid'

PVV MPs asked whether a sharia court dissolved a marriage in the Netherlands and whether Dutch law can be supplemented by Islamic law, and whether such organisations should be dissolved. The minister replied that no parallel legal structure is possible, that no sharia courts are known to exist in the Netherlands, and that the Public Prosecution Service will consider a dissolution request under Article 2:20 Civil Code if warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated that, if there is cause, it will consider filing a request with the court.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft laten weten dat indien daartoe aanleiding bestaat, zij de mogelijkheid om bij de rechtbank een verzoek in te dienen zal overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Yücel en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Armsten opgelicht’

MPs Recourt, Yücel and Nijboer asked the ministers about reports that bailiffs at BSR charged duplicate costs to vulnerable debtors, and what oversight, compensation and action would follow. The minister declined to prejudge the pending tuchtrecht case, said BFT oversight is risk-based and sufficient for now, that creditors should be compensated as far as possible via the bankruptcy estate, and that ACM and AFM are acting against malafide collection agencies.
It does not befit me to anticipate a case that is still before the court.
Het past mij niet vooruit te lopen op een zaak die nog onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de MH17

Dutch MPs Omtzigt asked the Justice, Foreign Affairs and Interior ministers about withheld MH17 documents (interview transcripts, the JIT agreement), the unfinished internal police evaluation, deleted emails under the Archiefwet, and Russian radar data. The minister refused disclosure of the interview records and JIT agreement on grounds of confidentiality and ongoing criminal investigation, and gave partial, procedural answers on the other points.
The JIT agreement is not suitable for disclosure because it records operational arrangements for an ongoing criminal investigation.
De JIT-overeenkomst leent zich niet voor openbaarmaking omdat hierin operationele afspraken over een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek zijn vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over slechte beveiliging van ziekenhuiswebsites

An MP asks the Health and Justice ministers about poor security of hospital websites, citing reports that many hospitals lack encrypted connections and that patient data may leak. The minister acknowledges the problem, places primary responsibility on hospitals under the Wbp and NEN norms with supervision by the AP and IGZ, and promises an action plan on patient data security.
Information security and privacy protection are first and foremost the responsibility of the healthcare provider itself.
Informatiebeveiliging en privacybescherming zijn in de eerste plaats de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieder zelf.
