Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de mishandeling en verwaarlozing van nertsen op fokkerijen

An MP asks the government about cruelty and neglect of mink on fur farms in Alphen aan den Rijn, including the NVWA's inspection history, whether the farms should be closed, when information on individual farm inspections will be published, and the status of a proposed ban on keeping animals after cruelty. The state secretary reports few past inspections with minor findings, commits to continued NVWA inspections in 2017, and promises a framework note on the animal-keeping ban before 1 April.
If violations are found, the NVWA will take appropriate enforcement action.
Als er overtredingen worden vastgesteld, dan zal de NVWA op passende wijze tot handhaven overgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Raak over Russische hackers die gebruikmaken van Nederlandse server

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that Russian hackers used a Dutch server, and whether such attacks can be prevented and how Dutch email vulnerabilities are addressed. The minister declined to comment on the specific case, said the government will keep parliament informed through general threat reports, and stated that political parties are primarily responsible for their own information security while the government raises cybersecurity awareness.
The cabinet does not make public statements about specific cases.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over specifieke casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Karabulut en Pieter Heerma over illegale huwelijken in moskeeen

MPs Van Nispen, Karabulut and Heerma asked about illegal religious marriages and forced marriage in mosques following an Undercover in Nederland broadcast, and what the government does about it. The minister says the scale is unknown, the Public Prosecution Service has found insufficient grounds for an investigation into the mosques named, and it is raising awareness among relevant parties while gemeenten handle victim care.
The Public Prosecution Service has judged that there are insufficient concrete grounds for a criminal investigation.
Het OM heeft geoordeeld dat er onvoldoende concrete aanknopingspunten zijn voor een opsporingsonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de aanpak van matchfixing in het tennis

MP Van Dekken asked the ministers whether the national matchfixing platform is adequate, whether the Public Prosecution Service should take a more active role given the limits of sports-body disciplinary rules, and whether betting on lower-tier Future tournaments should be banned. The minister defended the platform as a structured information-sharing forum, rejected a change in prosecution approach citing no signals of inadequacy, and said the risk exists at all levels and will be limited through rules under the online gambling bill.
I have committed to informing you further on this before summer 2017.
Ik heb toegezegd u hier voor de zomer 2017 nader over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de vernietiging van in beslag genomen nep-kleding

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the ministers whether seized counterfeit clothing is destroyed, who decides, and whether a central record exists and destruction can favour circular recycling. The minister answered that counterfeit goods are destroyed under the Criminal Procedure Code, that a central seizure portal exists but has gaps with implementation planned for 2018, and that destroyed materials can be recycled where possible.
This cross-chain central ICT system still has shortcomings.
Dit ketenoverstijgende centraal ICT-systeem kent nog onvolkomenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat er te weinig aandacht is voor mannen die door vrouwen worden mishandeld en misbruikt

An MP asked the government about the lack of attention and data on men who are abused or assaulted by women, including prevalence, shelter, and prevention. The state secretary answered that a prevalence study is due end-2017, that men-specific shelter exists in 40 places, and promised to highlight male victims in an existing public campaign.
The study is expected to be completed at the end of 2017.
Het onderzoek wordt naar verwachting eind 2017 afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de praktijken van Loterijverlies B.V.

An MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about the links between the Loterijverlies foundation and the Loterijverlies B.V., whether members were transferred to the B.V. without clear disclosure, the suspended foundation director's ties, and consumer-protection options. The minister answered that the relationships are subject to ongoing court proceedings and cannot be discussed in detail, cited the court rulings, and said ACM gives no public information on specific companies beyond its own enforcement findings.
These relationships and the course of affairs at the Loterijverlies foundation are also currently the subject of legal proceedings. For that reason I cannot go into them further.
Deze relaties en de gang van zaken bij de stichting Loterijverlies zijn daarnaast op dit moment onderwerp van juridische procedures. Ik kan hierop om die reden niet nader ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de opgepakte Syriëgangers in Turkije

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether returning jihadists should always be denied entry to the Netherlands, whether the government will explicitly refrain from requesting their extradition from Turkey, and the status of the nationality-revocation bill. The minister replied that the government does not adopt a blanket entry ban but assesses each returnee case by case with arrest, prosecution, multidisciplinary consultation and monitoring, declined to say whether extradition will be requested citing ongoing criminal investigations, and reported that the bill passed the Eerste Kamer plenary on 31 January 2017.
Regarding criminal investigations, the cabinet makes no statements about the instruments the Public Prosecution Service does or does not wish to deploy in that context.
Inzake strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doet het kabinet geen mededelingen over de instrumenten die het OM in het kader daarvan al dan niet wenst in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over uit de lucht geschoten zeldzame zeearend

An MP asked the state secretary and justice minister about a rare white-tailed eagle shot in Friesland, including whether a hunter could mistake it for a goose, whether prosecution and ballistic evidence were pursued, whether a reward was considered, and whether enforcement against raptor persecution is adequate. The government said police did not make the claimed statement, that a criminal investigation under the Public Prosecution Service is ongoing and it cannot comment further, that a reward was not considered because the offence does not qualify, and that oversight of hunting rules is sufficient though incidents cannot always be prevented.
Because this investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make any further statements about it.
Omdat dit onderzoek nog gaande is, kan ik daar geen verdere mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over "salafisten die moskeeën dreigen over te nemen"

An MP asked whether salafist takeovers of mosques, including the Al Ummah incident in Amsterdam, and German bans on salafist organisations warrant concern and a ban in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the government is concerned, supports local partners through a three-track approach, sees no comparable violence in other mosques, and explains that banning a legal entity under Civil Code article 2:20 requires very high thresholds, so signals alone are insufficient.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that, if there is reason to do so, it will consider submitting a request to the court, but that signals alone are in any case not sufficient.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij laten weten dat indien daartoe aanleiding bestaat zij de mogelijkheid om bij de rechtbank een verzoek in te dienen zal overwegen, maar dat enkel signalen daarvoor in ieder geval niet voldoende zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vertrekregeling voor ambtenaren

MP Omtzigt asked about early-retirement schemes for civil servants, RVU levies owed by the Belastingdienst, emails on internal warnings, contracts of the Broedkamer and unauthorised spending of 38 million euro under the Investment Agenda. The government answered that the schemes follow general ARAR rules, that 24 million euro in RVU levy was paid, that the emails are withheld to protect internal advice under Article 68 of the Constitution, and that the contracts will be made available confidentially.
On the basis of this cabinet line I do not provide the emails.
Op grond van deze kabinetslijn verstrek ik de emails niet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Van Oosten over het artikel ‘Geheimen mee in het graf’ dat oproept onder omstandigheden DNA-onderzoek te doen na een niet natuurlijke dood en omtrent een landelijk protoco

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers whether DNA of deceased persons who died unnaturally should be compared with the police DNA database and whether a national autopsy protocol is needed. The minister said such DNA sampling is not generally justified, that sampling from a deceased suspect is limited by article 69 Sr, and that the legal basis will be addressed in the Criminal Procedure Code modernisation, plus a working group on a national protocol.

In setting the rules for taking cell material for DNA research from a deceased suspect or victim, the fundamental right to bodily integrity is currently insufficiently taken into account, and an intrusion on that right must be provided for by or under law.

Bij de normering voor het afnemen van celmateriaal voor DNA-onderzoek bij een overleden verdachte of slachtoffer van een strafbaar feit is op dit moment onvoldoende verdisconteerd dat het grondrecht op de onaantastbaarheid van het lichaam daarbij een rol speelt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het bericht dat een verdachte zou zijn vrijgelaten vanwege het niet tijdig onderzoeken van een DNA-spoor

The MP asks about reports that a suspect was released because the NFI did not get to a DNA trace in time, whether forensic work is delayed, and how outsourcing to private forensic institutes and the LTC approval process works. The minister confirms the case, says the NFI is not systematically late, reports that the outsourcing budget is largely spent, rejects that the LTC blocks outsourcing, and commits to simplifying the LTC procedure.
I committed to you during the committee meeting of 19 February 2014 to examine whether the LTC's working method can be simplified.
Ik heb u tijdens het AO van 19 februari 2014 toegezegd te bezien of de werkwijze van de LTC vereenvoudigd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van der Steur over de gevolgen van de wet hervorming kindregelingen voor de hoogte van de te betalen kinderalimentatie

Two MPs asked whether the government was aware that the Wet hervorming kindregelingen could trigger reassessment of existing child maintenance orders and how many reassessments were expected. The State Secretary confirmed the law's measures can affect the maintenance criteria, cited the Raad voor de rechtspraak advice that the number of reassessments cannot be reliably estimated, and said the effects on courts, legal aid and the LBIO are uncertain.
The Council indicates that it is not possible to make a concrete estimate of this.
De Raad geeft aan dat het niet goed mogelijk is om hiervan een concrete inschatting te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Rutte over het wetenschappelijk onderzoek waaruit onder meer blijkt dat het gebruik van cannabis schadelijk is voor de gezondheid, leidt tot een lagere intelligentie en bi

MPs Van der Steur and Rutte asked the government about research linking cannabis use to health harm, lower intelligence and early school leaving, including the Addiction article, cannabis-driving risk, schizophrenia, IQ and school dropout figures. The state secretary answered each question, noting evidence is mixed on causality, that Dutch dropout has fallen, and that cannabis use before 18 should be discouraged.
The original article that Elsevier refers to, published in the journal Addiction, has been added as an annex.
Het oorspronkelijke artikel waaraan Elsevier refereert en dat verschenen is in het blad Addiction is als bijlage toegevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van der Steur over het bericht dat de rechtspraak een commercial court wil

MPs Van Oosten and Van der Steur asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the judiciary's proposal for a commercial court for large international trade disputes, including its effects on the business climate, comparisons with other countries, expected speed, and costs. The minister replied that he awaits the Council for the judiciary's exploratory study, cites the UK Commercial Court and existing specialised commercial jurisdiction, and declines to anticipate the outcome or give cost and speed estimates.
I await the outcomes of that exploration and do not consider it desirable to anticipate those outcomes.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van die verkenning af en acht het niet wenselijk op de uitkomsten daarvan vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van der Steur over de uitzending van Brandpunt over lijkschouwers

MPs Van Oosten and Van der Steur asked about a Brandpunt broadcast claiming forensic doctors miss crimes, and about standard protocols for death inspections (lijkschouw) including blood and urine testing. The minister replied that forensic doctors must be registered, that a national guideline exists requiring blood and urine sampling, that deviations are permitted if documented, and that no data on deviations is available.
There is no information available on whether, and if so how often, the guideline is deviated from.
Er is geen informatie beschikbaar over de vraag of, en zo ja, hoe vaak wordt afgeweken van de richtlijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Dijkhoff over het bericht dat er geen extra capaciteit ter beschikking wordt gesteld ten behoeve van de aanpak van zware criminaliteit in Zuid-Nederland

MPs Van der Steur and Dijkhoff asked whether the minister refuses extra capacity for fighting serious crime in South Netherlands, despite mayors' requests and police warnings about crime moving to the border regions. The minister answered that the authorities decided to deploy more police capacity from 1 October 2014 within existing strength, referring to a separate letter, and described the existing capacity and the earlier TaskForce B5 without giving new numbers on the extra deployment.
The competent authority in South Netherlands has therefore decided to deploy more police capacity to tackle undermining and organised crime from 1 October 2014, within existing strength.

Het bevoegd gezag in Zuid-Nederland heeft dan ook besloten om per 1 oktober 2014, binnen de bestaande sterkte, meer politiecapaciteit in te gaan zetten op de aanpak van ondermijnende en georganiseerde criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het bericht dat Curaçao kennelijk stopt met het arresteren van bolletjesslikkers

MP Van der Steur asked whether Curaçao was ceasing arrests of drug swallowers and what the Netherlands would do about rising cases. The Minister denied Curaçao had decided to stop arrests, said a temporary emergency facility was being set up and structural facilities planned, and reported that drug courier cases have declined.
Curaçao has not decided to stop arresting drug swallowers.
Curaçao heeft niet besloten te stoppen met het arresteren van bolletjesslikkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het kwijtraken van geld na een pseudokoop van drugs

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about undercover money going missing after a drug pseudo-purchase, including how it was lost, measures to prevent recurrence, and how responsibilities were divided with foreign partners. The Minister said the loss stemmed from an unforeseeable chain of events, the money may still be found, and declined further detail citing the ongoing investigation while stating that Dutch law was followed.

In the interest of the ongoing investigation I can make no statements on this other than that the loss of sight of the so-called show money was preceded by an unfortunate combination of circumstances that could not have been foreseen.

In het belang van het lopende onderzoek kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen anders dan dat aan het uit het zicht raken van het zogenaamde toongeld een ongelukkige samenloop van omstandigheden vooraf ging die niet was te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het proefschrift ‘Sexoffender Risk Assessment In The Netherlands – Towards a risk need responsivity oriented approach’

A Van der Steur (VVD) asks the State Secretary about Dr. W. Smid's dissertation on risk assessment and treatment allocation for sex offenders, including under- and over-treatment and whether standardised actuarial instruments should be mandatory. The State Secretary answers that the study concerns 1996-2002 cases, that RNR principles are already applied, that preferred instruments (HCR-20 V3, HKT-R) will be mandatory in clinical care from 2015, and that projects are underway to improve risk analysis.
I have also asked the sector this year to designate the preferred risk assessment instruments.
Aan de sector heb ik – eveneens dit jaar – gevraagd de preferente risicotaxatie-instrumenten aan te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Van der Steur over het bericht dat smartshops levensgevaarlijke drugs verspreiden

MPs Rebel and Van der Steur asked whether illegal narcotics sold as vitamin pills in smartshops were known, how the NVWA and IGZ supervise smartshops, whether national rules should replace local ordinances, and how drug-testing services and the police fit in. The state secretary answered that the four Amsterdam and Utrecht shops are under examination, that supervision is joint (NVWA, IGZ, police) and mostly complaint-based, and that no additional national rules are considered necessary.
Currently it is being examined further how action can be taken against the four smartshops in Amsterdam and Utrecht.
Op dit moment wordt nader onderzocht op welke wijze kan worden opgetreden tegen de vier smartshops in Amsterdam en Utrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Segers, Kooiman, Van der Steur, Van Oosten, Oskam, Rebel, Van Laar, Bontes en Jadnanansingover mensenhandel

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about cooperation with Romania and Bulgaria on human trafficking, including police results, victim reception and return programmes, liaison posts, Roma victims, EU funds and border controls. The minister answered in detail on operational cooperation, joint investigation teams, return and reintegration projects, and border checks, giving substantive answers while noting that some data is unavailable.
There are no figures available on the number of people travelling from countries such as Bulgaria and Romania to other European countries, including the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal personen dat vanuit landen als Bulgarije en Roemenië naar andere Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, reist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van der Steur over verschillende torenhoge boetes die het afgelopen jaar geïnd zijn

MPs Visser and Van der Steur asked the Minister of Security and Justice about very large unpaid fines collected in the past year, asking how many people are involved, why arrears grew so high, whether police enforcement and ANPR are used effectively, and whether gijzeling is adequate. The Minister answered that the cases involve confiscation orders, that 178 persons have open debts of 300,000 euro or more, that police enforcement and ANPR are used successfully and will expand, and that the approach to collecting financial sanctions will be reviewed with a letter to parliament in June 2014.
The State Secretary for Security and Justice and I have previously indicated that we are examining how the collection of financial sanctions, including the use of coercive measures, can be improved.

De Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en ik hebben eerder aangegeven dat bekeken wordt op welke wijze de inning van financiële sancties, inclusief de inzet van dwangmiddelen, verbeterd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het proefschrift van dr. Peggy van der Pol ‘The Dynamics of Cannabis Use and Dependence’

An MP asks how the government views a dissertation finding that about 40% of initially non-dependent heavy cannabis users became dependent over three years, and whether it will take measures against cannabis use and dependence. The state secretary says the study shows other factors matter as much as potency, that prevention and treatment should be updated, and that the findings give no reason for further measures.
The findings of this study give me no reason for further measures.
De uitkomsten van dit onderzoek geven mij geen aanleiding tot nadere maatregelen.
Antwoord vragen Van der Steur over het persbericht ‘pooier vrij, slachtoffer duikt onder’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the release of a suspected trafficker after a court acquittal, whether the victims were protected and informed, and whether the sentencing guidance and immediate enforcement bill would have changed the outcome. The minister answered that the court's acquittal removed the basis for detention, victims were informed in time, sentencing guidelines await sufficient case law, and the immediate-enforcement bill would likely not have changed the result.
Regarding any security measures that may have been taken, I will not make any statements in the interest of the victims.
Over eventueel genomen veiligheidsmaatregelen doe ik in het belang van de slachtoffers geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het wederom afwijzen door de rechter van een door de burgemeester van Veenendaal opgelegd gebiedsverbod aan een delinquent

An MP asked the state secretary about a court ruling that again annulled a area ban imposed by the Veenendaal mayor on an offender, and whether burgomasters should have stronger powers or advisory roles in reintegration decisions. The state secretary answered that the ruling does not change his view, that mayors can act where concrete public order disturbance is shown, and that he sees no reason to strengthen mayoral powers.
No. The aforementioned rulings give me no reason to strengthen the powers mayors have to maintain public order.
Nee. Bovengenoemde uitspraken geven mij geen aanleiding de mogelijkheden die burgemeesters hebben om de openbare orde te handhaven, te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over de voorwaardelijke invrijheidsstelling van een in het buitenland recidiverende pedoseksueel

An MP asked the minister about a Dutch national with prior child-abuse convictions, reportedly arrested in Bulgaria with orphan children, including whether he was still on probation and whether his suspended Dutch sentence should be enforced. The state secretary confirmed the facts, said the probation condition covers offences abroad, and explained that enforcement depends on the individual case and that Bulgaria is not obliged to transfer sentences to the Netherlands.
When general and/or special conditions are breached, however, whether the Public Prosecution Service seeks enforcement of a conditional sanction depends on the circumstances of the individual case.

Bij overtreding van de algemene en/of bijzondere voorwaarden hangt het echter van de omstandigheden van een individuele zaak af of het Openbaar Ministerie de tenuitvoerlegging van een voorwaardelijke sanctie vordert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind, Van der Steur en Van der Staaij over het gebruik van xtc onder jongeren

MPs asked the government about the high ecstasy use among young party-goers, rising XTC-related hospital and first-aid incidents, how easily XTC is obtained, controls at events, and the role of parents and municipalities in prevention. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to the new Trimbos VGHE prevention programme, noted increased incidents and drug strength, and said event organisers bear primary responsibility for security while enforcement focuses on production and trade.
For this reason I have instructed the Trimbos Institute to start the Safe and Healthy Hospitality and Events (VGHE) programme in 2014, as announced in the National Prevention Programme (NPP).

Mede om die reden heb ik het Trimbos-instituut opdracht gegeven om, zoals ook is aangekondigd in het Nationaal Programma Preventie (NPP), in 2014 te starten met het programma Veilige en Gezonde Horeca en Evenementen (VGHE).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Moors over de vergoeding van advocaatkosten van een oud-ambtenaar

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the reimbursement of legal costs for a former secretary-general after a court ordered prosecution to proceed, and whether reimbursement should continue after retirement. The minister answered that legal costs for the criminal defence will be terminated, civil proceedings and the earlier article 12 procedure remain reimbursed, no decision has been taken on the pre-trial witness hearing, and reclaiming paid costs is intended but depends on the eventual outcome.
If not, why not? Answer 4 Yes.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 4 Ja.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het bericht dat een Nederlandse schrijver na een bezoek aan de gevangenis een geheimhoudingsverklaring moest tekenen en niet over ‘misstanden’ mocht rapporteren

MP Van der Steur asked whether writer Arnon Grunberg was required to sign a confidentiality declaration barring him from reporting 'misstanden' after a prison visit, and whether he will be allowed a stay in a prison in 2015. The Secretary of State replied that the declaration covers only confidential prison and detainee-privacy information, that visitors may report alleged misstanden if confidentiality is protected, and that no action on the policy is planned.
As long as the confidentiality of the data and the privacy of detainees is guaranteed, visitors to penal institutions must be able to report alleged misstanden.
Zolang de vertrouwelijkheid van de gegevens en de privacy van gedetineerden wordt gewaarborgd, moeten bezoekers van penitentiaire inrichtingen melding kunnen maken van vermeende misstanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het smokkelen van mobiele telefoons en cocaïne door een gevangenismedewerker in De Schie in Rotterdam

An MP asked the State Secretary about a prison staff member at De Schie smuggling phones and cocaine, alleging delay after a journalist's report. The government answered that two staff were dismissed after an internal investigation, that the journalist was approached in time, and that cell inspections, phone detection and a market survey on blocking phones are underway.
Pending the investigation, one employee was placed on non-active duty.
Hangende het onderzoek is één medewerker op non-actief gesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur naar aanleiding van diens brief over ‘tapgesprekken in de zaak Van Rey’, een reconstructie van de NOS, en het bericht dat de uitleg over de tapgesprekken onwaarschijnlijk is

Opposition MP Van der Steur asked the Minister of Security and Justice about claims that a power outage did not explain why wiretaps of a call involving Van Rey and the State Secretary were not recorded, and why the backup system failed. The Minister answered that the 50-minute outage on 20 September 2012 was a fault in the storage component's power supply, not an external grid failure, detected by monitoring, and that measures were taken to prevent recurrence.
On 20 September 2012 from 13:14 to 14:04 a fault occurred in the power supply of the storage component, as a result of which the electronics did not function correctly.
Op 20 september 2012 van 13.14 uur tot 14.04 uur deed zich een storing in de voeding van de opslagcomponent voor, waardoor de elektronica niet correct heeft gefunctioneerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over de gevolgen van een uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State over de rol van KNSA

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the consequences of a Council of State ruling that the mandatory KNSA membership requirement for shooting clubs and individual firearm leave violates Article 11 ECHR. The Minister confirmed the ruling affects KNSA's de facto central role and said he is examining what regulatory changes are needed quickly.
Currently I am examining which amendment of the regulations is needed to bring the granting of firearm leave in line with the Council of State's ruling in the short term.
Momenteel bezie ik welke aanpassing van de regelgeving nodig is om de verlening van wapenverloven op korte termijn in overeenstemming te brengen met de uitspraak van de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Dijkhoff over de bevoegdheden van burgemeesters voor het opleggen van maatregelen aan (ex-)justitiabelen

VVD MPs Van der Steur and Dijkhoff asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a court annulment of a mayor's area ban on an ex-offender undermines mayors' exclusive powers, whether mayors have enough expertise under Article 172 of the Municipalities Act, and whether an advisory role for mayors is desirable. Minister Opstelten answered that the court's independent review is legitimate, that a formal advisory function is not desirable, and that a knowledge platform (handelingskader BIJ) has been launched to support mayors.
I do not share the view that a mayor can hardly exercise his independent power when a judge delivers his independent judgment on it.
Ik deel niet de mening dat een burgemeester nauwelijks zijn zelfstandige bevoegdheid kan uitoefenen wanneer een rechter zijn onafhankelijke oordeel daarover velt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Dijkhoff over het opleggen van maatregelen aan (ex-)justitiabelen

Two MPs (Van der Steur and Dijkhoff, VVD) asked the Minister of Security and Justice how to read a court ruling that municipalities cannot impose additional measures on ex-offenders, and whether mayors have sufficient powers over ex-offenders. The minister replied that such measures belong to the criminal judge, that mayors keep powers under public order law, and that no statutory expansion of their role is needed, though a supervision bill is forthcoming.
That does not alter the fact that the mayor has his own responsibility for maintaining public order and safety.
Dit neemt niet weg dat de burgemeester een eigen verantwoordelijkheid heeft als het gaat om de handhaving van de openbare orde en veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Dijkhoff over drugsmokkel op Schiphol

MPs Van der Steur and Dijkhoff asked whether employees arrested for drug smuggling at Schiphol held security-screened positions, whether screening is backlogged, and what measures are needed to prevent insiders from exploiting their positions. The minister answered that eight of fifteen arrested workers held screened positions, that there is no screening backlog, and that screening is one link in a broader security chain, with the overall safety of Schiphol judged good.
There is no backlog in carrying out security investigations.
Er is geen achterstand met betrekking tot het uitvoeren van veiligheidsonderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Van Oosten en Van der Steur over de civiele aansprakelijkheid van de Staat der Nederlanden bij militaire uitzendingen

Three VVD MPs asked whether the Supreme Court's 6 September 2013 rulings on State civil liability for the Srebrenica deployment affect future military deployments, local staff, command structures, the Bakker commission framework, and whether such liability can be excluded. The government answered that the rulings rest on Srebrenica-specific facts, do not change current practice, command or the assessment framework, and that excluding liability is not possible.

In future military deployments other facts and circumstances will be at issue. It is therefore not possible to make statements in advance about the possible liability of the State in future deployments.

Bij toekomstige militaire uitzendingen zullen andere feiten en omstandigheden aan de orde zijn. Het is dan ook niet mogelijk op voorhand uitspraken te doen over de eventuele aansprakelijkheid van de Staat bij toekomstige uitzendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur, Van der Burg en Van Toorenburg van uw Kamer over verboden voorwerpen in de cel van de veroordeelde voor het doodschoppen van Richard Nieuwenhuizen

MPs Van der Steur, Van der Burg and Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary about a PowNews broadcast showing contraband (a phone or camera, soft drugs, a key-fob and possible sexual contact) in the cell of a convicted youth at the Teylingereind youth institution. The State Secretary acknowledged the phone was unacceptable, described existing controls and a sector-wide review, said no sexual contact was found, and saw no reason for further action or concern about the institution's management.
I have instructed the Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen to survey across the sector how the illegal import and use of mobile phones can be further curbed.
Ik heb de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen de opdracht gegeven om sectorbreed te inventariseren hoe de illegale invoer en het gebruik van mobiele telefoons nog verder kan worden teruggedrongen.
Antwoord vragen Van der Steur inzake de handhaving van het ingezetenencriterium

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the Epicurus study showing many coffee shops sell to foreigners without checks, and whether enforcement of the residency criterion has been dropped in some municipalities such as Nijmegen and Hilversum. The minister answered that most coffee-shop municipalities have submitted enforcement plans, that the residency criterion is part of policy in over 70% of them, that Nijmegen has suspended its use of the criterion, and that talks with municipalities will follow where needed.
Municipalities that have not included the residency criterion in their enforcement policy, or do not intend to, will be engaged in talks.
Met gemeenten die in hun handhavingsbeleid het ingezetenencriterium niet hebben opgenomen of niet van plan zijn dit op te nemen wordt in gesprek gegaan.
Antwoord vragen Van der Steur over de wettelijke problemen rond de vervolging van internetoplichting

An MP asked the minister about legal gaps in prosecuting online fraud, where sellers take payment and deliver nothing, and whether a civil claim by 20 victims should instead be handled in a criminal case, and whether a law change is planned. The minister answered that civil law is generally the appropriate route for such contract disputes, that victims may organise collective civil claims, and referred to earlier answers on the same issue.
I refer to the answer to questions 3, 4 and 5 from Member Recourt on fraud at Marktplaats.
Ik verwijs hiervoor naar het antwoord op vragen 3, 4 en 5 van het lid Recourt over oplichting bij Marktplaats
Antwoord vragen Aukje de Vries en Van der Steur over het bericht ‘Plan voor verkoop pingegevens winkels in ijskast na golf van kritiek’

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister and Justice State Secretary about Equens' plan to sell ping (debit card) payment data to shops, which was shelved after public criticism. The minister confirmed banks adhere to the data-processing code, that Equens acts as a processor bound by it, that the CBP supervises compliance, and that Equens has halted activities pending broad societal support.
Equens has indicated that the way it makes analyses and planned reports from the data it uses as processor amounts to processing data that are not, or no longer, personal data.

Equens heeft aangegeven dat de wijze waarop zij analyses en voorgenomen rapportages maakt van de door haar als bewerker gebruikte gegevens neerkomt op het verwerken van gegevens die niet of niet langer zijn aan te merken als persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Bosman over de kwaliteit van rechtspraak in Zeeland

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of quality concerns at the prosecution service and courts in Zeeland, whether he shares them, their causes and remedies, and whether budget cuts and reorganisation could worsen matters. The minister acknowledges the problems, attributes them to several factors including the 2013 court-map merger of the Breda and Middelburg prosecution offices, says he sees no structural signs and expects quick resolution, and refers to a separate letter on budget effects.
There is intensive monitoring. I have no indications that the identified problems are structural in nature and I expect them to be resolved soon.
Er is sprake van intensieve monitoring. Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de geconstateerde problemen structureel van aard zijn en ga ervan uit dat zij spoedig worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het bericht dat qat gedoogd zal worden

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the public prosecutor would tolerate qat use, whether illegal qat trade should be fought, and about laundering of criminal profits and cooperation with UK authorities. The minister answered that qat was placed on List II of the Opium Act, that there will be no toleration of criminal acts regarding qat, that existing tools suffice against laundering, and that cooperation with the UK goes well.
There is and will be no question of tolerating criminal acts with respect to qat.
Er is en zal geen sprake zijn van het gedogen van strafbare handelingen ten aanzien van qat.
Antwoord vragen Van der Steur over het ingezetenencriterium en de bestrijding van straathandel

Van der Steur (VVD) asked the Justice Minister about the residency criterion for coffeeshops, street drug dealing and nuisance in Maastricht, court rulings, police capacity, and enforcement figures. Minister Opstelten answered that nuisance had fallen under the residency criterion but rose after Maastricht coffeeshops resumed selling to non-residents, that capacity is sufficient, that the criterion is enforced locally, and that a status report will follow before the summer recess.
As previously promised to your House, I will come before the summer recess with an interim status report on how local tailoring is being applied in municipalities across the Netherlands.
Zoals eerder toegezegd aan uw Kamer kom ik voor het zomerreces met een tussenstand over de invulling van het lokaal maatwerk in de gemeenten in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het bericht dat een 100 procentcontrole door de Koninklijke Marechaussee is gestaakt vanwege het protest van passagiers

Van der Steur (VVD) asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Defence whether the Royal Marechaussee's full 100 percent check of a Suriname flight was halted due to passenger protest, and how such influence will be prevented in future. The minister confirmed the report, said the full check of all passengers and baggage found no weapons or narcotics and was not cut short, and stated that passengers cannot influence how checks are carried out, though a check may be stopped for passenger safety and welfare after a risk analysis.
Passengers cannot exert influence through protest over the manner in which the checks are carried out.
Passagiers kunnen door middel van protest geen invloed uitoefenen op de wijze van de uitvoering van de controles.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het bericht dat GHB de nieuwe heroïne is

Mr Van der Steur (VVD) asked whether GHB is becoming the new heroin, whether GHB addiction is rising sharply, and what the government will do about monitoring, detection, prevention, enforcement, asset confiscation, treatment costs and the newer drug Krokodil. Minister Opstelten answered that GHB addiction cases rose from about 60 in 2007 to nearly 800 in 2012, outlined treatment and prevention measures, and said existing enforcement tools are sufficient while declining to quantify illicit GHB profits.
Information on the unlawfully obtained benefit in GHB cases cannot be generated from the Public Prosecution Service's business process systems.
Informatie over het wederrechtelijk verkregen voordeel in GHB-zaken kan niet uit de bedrijfsprocessensystemen van het Openbaar Ministerie worden gegenereerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over de recente rechtspraak van de Hoge Raad met betrekking tot witwassen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a recent Supreme Court ruling that possessing proceeds of one's own offence may not qualify as money laundering unless it conceals criminal origin, and whether this undermines prosecution and asset confiscation. The minister answered that prosecution for laundering remains possible where possession conceals or disguises criminal origin, that the legislature intended both offences to be prosecutable, that no legislative change is currently considered, and that confiscation cannot follow an acquittal.
For the time being I see no reason to consider a legislative amendment.
Voorshands zie ik geen reden om een wetswijziging te overwegen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over de achterstanden bij de tenuitvoerlegging van gevangenisstraffen, de vakantieplannen en het vaststellen van de identiteit van veroordeelden

Van der Steur (VVD) asked the state secretary about long delays before prison sentences are enforced, whether offenders' holiday plans should be accommodated, and whether sentences should be suspended for those lacking identity documents. The state secretary disputed the RTL figures as indicative only, promised a norm for starting enforcement, said a booked holiday will no longer be grounds for postponement, and said the letter will be amended on the identity document point.
That is why I am working with partners in the enforcement chain to formulate a standard for starting the enforcement of prison sentences.
Daarom werk ik samen met de partners in de executieketen aan het formuleren van een norm voor het starten van de tenuitvoerlegging van gevangenisstraffen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over drugssmokkel via de Antwerpse Haven

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Security and Justice about cocaine smuggling through the port of Antwerp, including enforcement against Dutch suspects, asset confiscation, the role of the Royal Marechaussee, cooperation with other EU states, and Belgian measures. The minister answered that police figures do not separate cocaine by country of origin, that about 8 million euros was confiscated in 2012 for cocaine and heroin related activity, that no overview of failed confiscations or sentences is kept, and that existing structures and cooperation are adequate.
The OM has informed me that no overviews are available of cases in which confiscation fails, or of the sentences imposed for this form of smuggling and the number of suspects successfully convicted.

Het OM heeft mij meegedeeld dat geen overzichten beschikbaar zijn van gevallen waarin ontnemen niet lukt, of van de straffen die zijn opgelegd voor deze vorm van smokkel en het aantal verdachten dat met succes is veroordeeld.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Van der Steur over rechters die hun nevenfuncties niet opgeven

MPs Recourt and Van der Steur asked the Justice Minister why some judges have not fully registered their ancillary positions, and whether this undermines trust in the judiciary. The minister answered that the registration duty took effect on 1 January 2013, that the courts' boards are checking the register, that he will press the Council for the judiciary and the judges' association to keep it complete, and that a bill on sanctions against judges will go to consultation by 1 April 2013.
I consider it, like the Council and the NVvR, of great importance that the register of ancillary positions is current and complete.
Ik acht het – evenals de Raad en de NVvR – van groot belang dat het register nevenbetrekkingen actueel en volledig is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over de illegale import van qat in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice minister about illegal qat imports from England by ferry, the size of the trade, customs controls, enforcement measures, and cooperation with the UK, including a ban there. The minister answered that customs apply risk-based integral controls, that enforcement after the January 2013 criminalisation is showing early results, that only official-level contact with UK authorities has occurred, and that the UK does not intend to list qat.
Since qat was included in the Opium Act on 5 January 2013, I do not have figures on the scale and market value of illegal imports.
Sinds qat op 5 januari 2013 in de Opiumwet werd opgenomen beschik ik niet over cijfers over de omvang en marktwaarde van illegale importen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en Steur over de berichten over lagere straffen na snelrecht Den Haag en lage straffen voor incidenten tijdens Oud en Nieuw

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why courts gave lighter sentences than the prosecution's 200% demand for violence against emergency workers during New Year's Eve 2012-2013, and whether summary procedures explain this. The minister answered that 732 people were arrested, the 200% surcharge was applied in settlements, the Hague court's lighter sentences were not significantly different from other courts, that courts may lower sentences for individual circumstances, and that the 200% demand will continue under the Veilige Publieke Taak programme.
A judge may impose a lower sentence if the circumstances of the case or the person of the offender give reason for it.
Een rechter kan een lagere straf opleggen als de omstandigheden van het geval of de persoon van de dader daartoe aanleiding geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur, Kooiman, Berndsen-Jansen en Oskam over pedofiele praktijken door vrouwen

MPs from VVD, SP, D66 and CDA asked the Justice Minister about a broadcast on female paedophile practices, including whether the conduct is prosecutable, whether a new network exists, and whether police and prosecutors are aware of female offenders. The minister condemned the conduct, said the OM is cooperating with Greek investigators and will assess Dutch prosecution, and confirmed existing awareness of female offenders while referring to earlier answers.

In light of the findings within the Greek investigation, it will be examined whether the conduct is prosecutable under Dutch law, individually or in association, and whether a criminal investigation in the Netherlands is warranted.

Mede naar aanleiding van de bevindingen binnen het Griekse opsporingsonderzoek zal worden bezien of gedragingen individueel dan wel in verenigingsverband naar Nederlands recht vervolgbaar zijn en een strafrechtelijk onderzoek in Nederland aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Jacobi en Van der Steur en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Openbaar Ministerie verlaat Leeuwarden’

MPs asked whether the Public Prosecution Service (OM) is leaving Leeuwarden for Groningen, what that means for Leeuwarden as a justice city, and whether Friesland was promised anything to protect jobs. The minister answered that Leeuwarden remains a full justice city with OM workplaces, that the regional ZSM and local cooperation are secured, and that no specific commitments were made to Leeuwarden or Friesland beyond attention to employment effects.
No commitments have been made to Leeuwarden and Friesland.
Er zijn geen toezeggingen gedaan aan Leeuwarden en Friesland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het rapport "Mensenhandel in en uit beeld"

Van der Steur (VVD) asked the minister of Security and Justice about under-registration of trafficking victims, whether Bureau Jeugdzorg and Nidos report minor victims, and the low conviction rate in trafficking cases, citing the National Rapporteur's report. Minister Opstelten answered that police have the reporting duty, that Nidos has agreed to report suspected minor victims to the Rapporteur and is examining direct reporting to CoMensha, that trafficking convictions are about 56% plus 22% for other offences, and that specialisation of judges and prosecutors is being introduced from 1 January 2013.
It is currently being examined whether Nidos can also report directly to CoMensha.
Er wordt op dit moment bekeken of melding door Nidos ook rechtstreeks bij CoMensha plaats kan vinden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over een uitzending van Omroep Brabant over drugssmokkel via de Antwerpse haven

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a regional broadcast claiming cocaine smuggling had shifted from Rotterdam to Antwerp, the role of Dutch criminal groups, police structure, and EU cooperation. The minister confirmed the shift and Dutch leadership of networks, pointed to existing cooperation with Belgium and other states, and stated that the Marechaussee's mobile controls are primarily aimed at illegal migration, with no plan to expand its drug-enforcement task.
The extent of cocaine imports from other EU member states and the amount of money this would generate is not known to the OM.
De omvang van de invoer van cocaïne vanuit overige EU-lidstaten en het bedrag dat dit zou opleveren is het OM niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over jurisprudentie in mensenhandelzaken

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the National Rapporteur on Trafficking's findings on inconsistent sentencing and compensation in trafficking cases, and whether judicial specialisation and guidelines will follow. The minister answered that specialisation is being arranged from 1 January 2013, sentencing guidelines await a LOVS assessment expected this year, and a judicial Best Practice on victim compensation is due in spring 2013, while declining to reopen talks with the judiciary.
From 1 January 2013, each court will concentrate the handling of trafficking cases with a small number of judges and legal staff with expertise in this area.
Per 1 januari 2013 wordt per gerecht de behandeling van mensenhandelzaken geconcentreerd bij een klein aantal rechters en juridisch medewerkers met expertise op dit gebied.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over de gevolgen van een uitspraak van het Europese Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens over de waardering van getuigenbewijs

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the ECtHR ruling in Vidgen v. Netherlands on the admissibility and weight of absent-witness evidence should be interpreted, its consequences for Dutch practice, its relation to the unus testis rule, and whether it affects pending cases and the crown witness scheme. The Minister answered that the ruling applies an existing framework differently to the facts, has limited general consequences, leaves the unus testis rule and the crown witness regulation unchanged, and that the Supreme Court will further concretise the principles.
The Court has however indicated that this starting point should not be applied in a rigid manner.
Het Hof heeft evenwel aangegeven dat dit uitgangspunt niet op een starre wijze dient te worden toegepast.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Van Oosten over de straf- en civielrechtelijke verjaringstermijnen bij diefstal in het algemeen en kunstroof in het bijzonder

MPs Van der Steur and Van Oosten asked the Minister of Security and Justice about criminal and civil limitation periods for theft in general and art theft in particular, following the Kunsthal and Noortman thefts. The minister explained the 12-to-24-year criminal limitation periods, the 20-year civil acquisitive prescription that does not run in favour of a concealing thief, and comparisons with other EU states and US states, and said he does not intend to change the rules.
Since the answers to questions under 2 show that neither the thief nor the receiver becomes owner of the stolen item, I do not intend to change the rules on limitation periods.
Nu uit de beantwoording van de vragen onder 2 blijkt dat de dief noch de heler eigenaar wordt van de gestolen zaak, ben ik niet voornemens de regels met betrekking tot verjaring te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Visser over de uitspraak van de voorzieningenrechter te Groningen inzake de strafrechtelijke ontruiming van krakers op grond van art. 551a Sv.

MPs Van der Steur and Visser asked the ministers about a Groningen interim judge's refusal to allow criminal eviction of squatters under art. 551a Sv, and how this affects enforcement of the squatting ban. The minister said the case is under appeal so he will not judge it, that enforcement is not undermined since other courts allowed evictions, and gave statistics showing most court challenges to criminal evictions succeeded for the state.
As long as the case is before the court, I refrain from passing judgment.
Zolang de zaak onder de rechter is, onthoud ik me van een oordeel.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Van der Burg over het bericht dat een serieverkrachter tijdens een proefverlof ontsnapt is en dat het Openbaar Ministerie de ontsnapping heeft stil gehouden

MPs Van der Steur and Van der Burg asked why a serious rapist was granted leave from a juvenile institution despite being deemed dangerous, and why the Public Prosecution Service did not publicise his escape. The State Secretary explained that the leave was an authorised medical visit under supervision, that the escape was reported and investigated, and that the prosecution service judged publicity would harm the investigation; he committed to reviewing the policy after analysing recent escapes.
Following this, I will examine whether there is reason to tighten the policy.
Naar aanleiding hiervan zal ik bezien of er reden is tot aanscherping van het beleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over de inzet van lokpubers bij de bestrijding van internetdating en kinderporno

An MP asked the Justice minister whether a court ruling that police decoy 'lokpuber' operations could not lead to prosecution of a man targeting an apparent 13-year-old was correct, and whether law should be changed to allow police fake accounts on social media. The minister confirmed the ruling, said the prosecution service is appealing, and will consider a legal amendment only after the outcome is known.
Only once the outcome of this is known can it be considered whether a legislative amendment is required.
Pas als het resultaat hiervan bekend is kan worden bezien of een wetswijziging geboden is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Elias en Van der Steur over misbruik door NS van gegevens van de OV -chipkaart

MPs Elias and Van der Steur asked the ministers whether NS misused OV-chipkaart travel data for marketing, as the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) found, whether this breached 2008 agreements, and what would ensure the misuse has stopped. The minister accepts the CBP's findings, notes NS has already destroyed the data and changed its practice, and states that monitoring and enforcement lie with the CBP rather than with the government.
The CBP is charged with supervising compliance with and enforcement of the Personal Data Protection Act (Wbp).
Het CBP is belast met toezicht op de naleving en handhaving van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het verlenen van gratie

An MP asked the minister about pardon (gratie) statistics, the gap between pardon requests received and decisions taken, the criteria and conditional pardons, and whether life sentences without realistic release prospects conflict with the ECHR. The minister answered that pardon decisions are made case by case under the Gratiewet, that 2010 saw 340 unconditional and 192 conditional pardons, and that the life-sentence procedure does not render pardon illusory.
There is no registration of the type of sentences for which pardon is granted and the form in which this occurs.
Er vindt geen registratie plaats van de aard van de straffen waarvan gratie wordt verleend en de vorm waarin dit gebeurt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur inzake het bericht ‘Pieter Baan Centrum gaat dicht’

Van der Steur asked whether the Pieter Baan Centre is closing, what the move to three locations means for report quality and staff, and whether the research can stay objective. The minister replied that it is relocating to Almere plus smaller sites in Eindhoven and Amsterdam, that quality and objectivity are safeguarded by central reporting and separate units, and that staff face relocation or possible surplus positions with support offered.
The Pieter Baan Centre is not closing but relocating.
Het Pieter Baan Centrum gaat niet sluiten maar verhuizen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Advocaat opgepakt om miljoenenfraude» (ingezonden 8 juni 2012).

Van der Steur (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the arrest of a lawyer suspected of multi-million euro fraude with client funds and how police, the Public Prosecution Service and the Bar handled it. Teeven declined substantive detail because the criminal case is ongoing, described the cooperation as smooth, and said current supervision of lawyers is insufficient, announcing a thorough revision via an amendment to the Advocatenwet.
The current regulations on the supervision of lawyers are in my view insufficient to achieve effective, independent and uniform supervision that is also proactive in nature.
De huidige regelgeving over het toezicht op advocaten acht ik onvoldoende om tot een effectief, onafhankelijk en uniform toezicht te komen, dat ook proactief van aard is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Steur en De Boer over drugsdealers in kraakpanden in Rotterdam

MPs Van der Steur and De Boer asked about drug dealers occupying squats in Rotterdam, the number involved, the municipal and police response, and whether other cities see similar activity. The state secretary answered that police raided nine properties on 22 May 2012, arrested six suspects, that the investigation is ongoing, and that the action focused on drug trade rather than evicting squatters, while structural squat-drug activity elsewhere is not established.
The investigation is still ongoing, so I cannot make any further statements about this at this time.
Het opsporingsonderzoek is nog gaande waardoor ik hierover thans geen verdere mededelingen kan doen.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur over het bericht "frustratie na 'vondst'gestolen ipad"

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van der Steur asked why the public prosecutor refused a house search even though an owner had located his stolen iPad via an app, and whether this could change. The minister answers that the law sets strict proportionality and subsidiarity requirements for house searches, refers to earlier answers, and sees no reason to think police and prosecution do not use available techniques.
The law sets strict requirements for the use of the intrusive coercive measure of searching a home, including the requirements of proportionality and subsidiarity.
De wet stelt zware eisen aan het inzetten van het ingrijpende dwangmiddel van doorzoeking van een woning, waaronder de eisen van proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit.
Antwoord vragen Van der Steur over verschillen in straftoemeting in soortgelijke zaken

Mr Van der Steur (VVD) asked the minister about a study finding that suspects with foreign-looking appearance and poor Dutch may receive harsher sentences, and whether measures will be taken with the judiciary to prevent arbitrariness. The minister refers to his answers to earlier questions from Mr Recourt on the same subject, without restating substance here.
I refer to my answers to the questions from Mr Recourt of your House
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoorden op de vragen van het lid Recourt van uw Kamer
Antwoord vragen de leden Taverne, Hennis-Plasschaert, Van der Steur en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over het bericht dat de wet zou wijken voor religieuze regels

Four VVD MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Justice whether a reported court ruling in The Hague, that religious obligations could take precedence over statutory duties such as showing identification, accurately reflects the judgment and whether it has been appealed. The minister confirmed the press report matches the oral ruling, that an appeal has been lodged, and referred the question of general principle to answers given to other MPs' questions.
The ruling itself provides no basis for those consequences.
Daarvoor biedt de uitspraak zelf geen grondslag.
Antwoord vragen Van der Steur over de ongelijke behandeling van ouders die zich niet houden aan de omgangsregeling

An MP asked whether the criminal provision on unlawful removal of a minor (art. 279 Sr) creates unequal treatment between parents who fail to honour a custody/visitation arrangement, and whether the law should be equalised. The minister answered that both parents exercising joint custody can be prosecuted under art. 279 Sr, so no inequality exists, but justice intervention in visitation disputes should remain strictly limited.

From the answer to question 2 it appears that both the parent who has care and the parent who does not have care can be prosecuted under article 279 Sr if both exercise parental authority over the child.

Uit het antwoord op vraag 2 blijkt dat zowel de ouder die de zorg heeft als de ouder die de zorg niet heeft, kunnen worden vervolgd ter zake van artikel 279 Sr indien zij beiden het ouderlijk gezag over het kind uitoefenen.
Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de wapenvergunning van Tristan van der V. (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether information about the granting of a weapons permit to Tristan van der V. had been deleted, whether that was lawful, and what retention rules apply to weapons-permit documents and departing police staff's correspondence. The Minister answered that a PDF attachment was lost when the info desk converted an email, that the Rijksrecherche and NFI could not locate it, and that retention follows the Wet Politiegegevens, with disciplinary rather than criminal consequences for wrongful destruction.
It has emerged that the info desk emailed a PDF file to the Bijzondere Wetten department.
Gebleken is dat door de infodesk een pdf-bestand aan de afdeling Bijzondere Wetten is gemaild.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het arrest van de Hoge Raad over «ontruiming kraakpand pas na kort geding» (ingezonden 1 november 2011).

An MP asked the Justice Minister how a 2011 Supreme Court ruling requiring a summary-proceedings (kort geding) wait before criminal eviction of squats affects the Squatting and Vacancy Act, and whether the law's principles still stand. The minister replied that the ruling approved the prosecution service's eviction policy, that the law's principle of property protection stands, and that the squatting ban can be adequately enforced.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Recourt (PvdA) en Van der Steur (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het Europees arrestatiebevel in relatief kleine strafzaken (ingezonden 25 oktober 2011).

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether the European arrest warrant should be used for Mr E., who faces surrender to Poland over a suspected bribe of about 25 euro, and whether Poland could use alternatives and proportionality could be raised. The minister replied that the warrant concerns two sentences totalling over three years plus prosecution for bribing a prison guard, that surrender was ordered with a guarantee of return, that Poland's changing warrant practice has been noted without specific action, and that no special intervention with Polish authorities is considered necessary.
Given the seriousness of the facts, I find it understandable that the Polish authorities issued a warrant in this case.
Gelet op de ernst van de feiten vind ik het begrijpelijk dat de Poolse autoriteiten in deze zaak een EAB hebben uitgevaardigd.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de pilot voor forensisch onderzoek (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

An MP asked the minister about a pilot letting private firms perform forensic investigations alongside the NFI, its evaluation timing, whether it will become permanent market policy, and pros and cons of market competition. The state secretary said the evaluation report is expected in early 2012, a decision on structural private involvement will follow by summer 2012, a temporary EUR 500,000 arrangement is set for the first half of 2012, and the pros and cons will be addressed in that later position.
I will inform you before summer 2012 about the possible structural involvement of private providers of forensic investigation.
Ik zal u voor de zomer van 2012 informeren over de eventuele structurele inschakeling van particuliere aanbieders voor forensisch onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «De Maffia wortelt in de polder» (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a newspaper report that Dutch police botched an arrest of two Ndrangheta suspects wanted by Italy, whether authorities underestimate such clans, and whether money laundering is being tackled. The minister says the suspects surrendered later, refers to the integrated approach and planned increases in cases against criminal networks, and declines to discuss ongoing investigations.
In the interest of investigation and prosecution, I cannot give any statement about ongoing and/or upcoming investigations.
Ik kan in het belang van opsporing en vervolging geen mededeling doen over lopende en/of aanstaande onderzoeken.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Psychiater ging onbevoegd zijn gang» (ingezonden 3 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a psychiater at the Pompe clinic who had acted without a valid BIG registration had affected court decisions on tbs-maatregelen, how this happened and how recurrence would be prevented. The minister said that in about half of the cases the measure had since been decided on a valid advice, that in some cases the courts ended the measure, that remaining cases will be corrected, and that a systematic check on BIG registration of advising specialists is being set up.
To prevent recurrence, I am currently having a systematic check set up on the validity of the BIG registration of medical specialists who draft advice for the legal process.

Om herhaling te voorkomen laat ik momenteel een systematische controle inrichten op de geldigheid van de BIG-registratie van medisch specialisten, die adviezen opstellen ten behoeve van de rechtsgang.

Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat Zwitserland het onder beslag liggend vermeend vermogen van Klaas Bruinsma heeft vrijgegeven (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

Mr Van der Steur (VVD) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reports that Switzerland released assets allegedly belonging to Klaas Bruinsma, due to formal errors, are accurate, why Switzerland decided so, whether the Netherlands could have prevented it, and whether gaps in Dutch law played a role. The Minister confirmed the report exists and referred to his answers to earlier written questions from Mr Gesthuizen, without giving substance here.
I refer to my answer to the written questions from Mr Gesthuizen of your House.
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoord op de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Gesthuizen van uw Kamer
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «Notaris wordt vrije beroepsoefenaar» (ingezonden 14 juni 2011).

MP Van der Steur asked the Justice Minister whether the 2011 EU Court of Justice ruling against nationality requirements for notaries means the Dutch notary nationality and training requirements can no longer be upheld, and whether the law will change. State Secretary Teeven answered that the ruling bars nationality requirements in principle, but public-interest justifications such as legal certainty may still allow establishment requirements, and that a bill removing the Dutch nationality requirement is already before the Senate.
A bill is currently before the Senate (file number 31040) that provides for dropping the Dutch nationality requirement for appointment as a notary.
Thans ligt bij de Eerste Kamer een wetsvoorstel (dossiernummer 31040 ) dat voorziet in het vervallen van de eis van Nederlanderschap voor de benoeming tot notaris.

Vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat instanties geen signalen of dossiers hadden over zedendelinquent die voogdij kreeg ov

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary how a man convicted of incest could obtain sole custody of his daughters and whether the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming checks parents' criminal records and keeps child files long enough. The state secretary answered that criminal records are not checked by default in custody cases, that a framework to address repeat-offence risk is being developed with field partners, and that child files will be kept longer, with periodic updates to parliament.
I consider it important that a seamless approach be established for cases where the risk of repetition of a serious offence, and thus a threat to the child, is high.
Ik vind het van belang dat er een sluitende aanpak komt voor die zaken waarin het risico op herhaling van een ernstig misdrijf en daarmee een bedreiging voor het kind groot is.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de benoemingsprocedure van rechters (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

MP Van der Steur asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a commentary in Trema calling for a state commission on judicial appointments and judicial quality is warranted, and whether more disciplinary instruments for the judiciary should be introduced. The Minister saw no need for a state commission, pointed to the Raad voor de rechtspraak's work on societal orientation, and said legislation will be prepared to broaden disciplinary measures and integrity instruments for judges.
Consultations have now taken place between my department, the Council for the Judiciary and the Dutch Association for the Judiciary on expanding the range of (disciplinary) measures.

Inmiddels heeft overleg plaatsgevonden tussen mijn departement, de Raad voor de rechtspraak, en de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Rechtspraak over een uitbreiding van het scala aan (disciplinaire) maatregelen.

Vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bestaan van onverzekerde en niet verzekerbare risico’s uit het verleden voor werkgevers (ingezonden 26 april 20

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Supreme Court rulings from 2001 to 2009 effectively imposed a retroactive insurance duty on employers for work-related traffic accident damage that was then uninsurable, and whether employers could fairly be held liable. The minister answered that the 2008 rulings do apply to earlier accidents but that insurance options were then limited, so employers are unlikely to face large liabilities, and he considered the insurance route rather than the general liability policy to be the current solution.
It is therefore likely that the insurance duty also covers those accidents.
Aannemelijk is daarom dat de verzekeringsplicht ook ziet op die ongevallen.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «iPhone maakt elke minuut een foto van je, ook in bed

Two MPs asked the ministers whether consumers should be told in advance about hidden location-tracking features in Apple devices, and whether government use of Apple products should be halted. The government answered that existing consumer information duties apply, declined to advise separately or ban Apple products, and pointed to security measures for sensitive functions.
I do not consider a separate advice on this point necessary.
Ik acht een separaat advies op dit punt niet noodzakelijk.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het CBP besluit over verzamelen van privégegevens door Google (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

MP Van der Steur asks the minister whether he agrees with the Dutch data protection authority's (CBP) order that Google must destroy accidentally collected private payload data, and whether collecting public Wi-Fi location data has value and is personal data. The state secretary declines to comment on the individual CBP decision, stating that the courts decide on appeal, and answers the other questions by referring back to the CBP's reasoning and to a European Article 29 Working Party opinion.
It is not appropriate for me to make statements about a CBP decision in an individual case.
Het past mij niet om uitspraken te doen over een besluit van het Cbp in een individuele casus.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Mishandelde bejaarde moet zelf achter daders aan» (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether a 97-year-old assault victim must herself pursue the damages awarded against her attackers, and whether a damages claim lapses if the convicted person serves substitute detention. The state secretary answered that the CJIB is still collecting the EUR 15,000 award, that the victim may use civil routes for any remainder, and that the advance scheme's limited access lasts five years, while not committing to a new mechanism.
The CJIB has taken several steps to arrive at collection.
Het CJIB heeft verschillende stappen ondernomen om te komen tot een incasso.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Wapendieven vrijgesproken» (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Security and Justice about the acquittal of suspects in the armed robbery of a Westpoint shooting range, whether a flaw in the charge caused it, whether prosecution continues, and how many weapons remain missing. The minister answered that the court acquitted on theft due to doubts about intent and that the OM sees no flaw in the charge, an appeal is pending with a possible amendment, the missing weapons report has been added, the suspects were released, and three of 180 weapons have been recovered.
On appeal there is the possibility to amend the charge.
In hoger beroep bestaat de mogelijkheid om de tenlastelegging te wijzigen.
Vragen van de leden Schouw (D66) en Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een ongelijk speelveld op de incassomarkt (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

MPs Schouw and Van der Steur ask whether the bailiff monopoly and the Verordening Onafhankelijkheid give bailiffs an unfair advantage in the debt-collection market, as the NMa suggests, and whether the government will curb bailiffs' commercial collection work. The minister denies an uneven playing field, defends the approval of the regulation as necessary for bailiffs' independence, and rules out banning bailiffs from non-official collection work.
I am not considering any measures to prohibit bailiffs from performing, alongside their official duties, non-official work such as debt collection.
Ik overweeg geen maatregelen om gerechtsdeurwaarders te verbieden naast de aan hen toebedeelde ambtelijke werkzaamheden ook niet-ambtelijke werkzaamheden, zoals incasso, te verrichten.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie inzake het onbestraft blijven van het downloaden van kinderporno (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

MP Van der Steur asked whether downloading child pornography goes unpunished, whether lack of evidence blocks house searches of Boylovers.net users, whether article 67 Sv prevents such searches, and whether the Public Prosecution Service faces legal limits. The minister replied that visiting the forum alone gives no grounds for suspicion, that article 67 does not bar searches once a concrete suspicion arises, and that the constraints are organisational and capacity-related, with a new approach being developed.
The College of Procurators General has told me it considers that the Code of Criminal Procedure provides sufficient powers to take criminal action against downloaders of child pornography.

De College van procureurs-generaal heeft mij laten weten van mening te zijn dat het Wetboek van Strafvordering voldoende bevoegdheden biedt om downloaders van kinderporno strafrechtelijk aan te pakken.

Vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Venrooy-Van Ark (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de uitzending «Alzheimerpatiënten steeds vaker opgelicht» (ingezo

MPs Van der Steur and Venrooy-Van Ark asked about a broadcast reporting that Alzheimer patients are increasingly defrauded by guardians, covering prevalence, offence types, a possible register of guardians, notary duties and measures. The minister answered that no figures on Alzheimer cases are available, pointed to a forthcoming bill on guardianship with stronger involvement of relatives, quality requirements and a wider debtor register, and rejected a public guardian register as not protecting against abuse.
I do not think a register of guardians offers the solution.
Ik denk niet dat een register van bewindvoerders de oplossing biedt.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het betrekken van toxicologische rapporten bij lijkschouwingen (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether a study showing drugs or medication as cause of death in some cases, and a possibly missed murder, should lead to standard toxicological testing at autopsies. The Minister says the study cannot establish cause of death from urine alone, that a criminal case is ongoing, that no guideline exists, and that the matter needs further consideration before any policy change.
I cannot give you any substantive information about the ongoing investigation.
Over het lopende onderzoek kan ik u inhoudelijk geen mededelingen doen.
