Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert, Taverne en Van der Steur (allen VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over inbeslagname servers door Stichting Brein (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Stichting Brein seized servers without a court order, accessed private data, and invoked Article 28 of the Copyright Act, and whether this amounts to vigilantism. The state secretary answered that the servers were handed over by the provider under Article 28, that a court later allowed judicial custody and seizure, that the parties dispute the legality and access issues and must resolve them or go to court, and that existing remedies suffice.
In the first instance it is up to the parties to resolve this.
Het is in eerste instantie aan partijen om hier uit te komen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de benoeming van nieuwe notarissen (ingezonden 7 januari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about notary appointments, including the Commission of Experts' advice criteria, confidentiality of third-party advice, the 8-month decision period, and the low number of new notary offices. The state secretary's supplementary answer corrected an earlier error: no objection can be lodged against the Commission's advice, but one can against the minister's refusal to appoint.

This is not correct. The intention was to indicate that no objection could be lodged against the advice of the Commission of Experts, but that one could be lodged against the Minister's decision in case of non-appointment based on the negative advice.

Dit is niet juist. Bedoeld was om aan te geven dat geen bezwaar kon worden ingediend tegen het advies van de commissie van deskundigen, maar wel tegen het besluit van de Minister in geval van niet-benoeming op basis van het negatieve advies.

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het opvragen van IP-adressen door politie en justitie (ingezonden 10 januari 2011).

VVD MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van der Steur asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police and prosecutors requesting IP addresses from news websites, including the procedure and a reported police bluff. The minister explained that the powers under articles 126nc and 126nd Sv require a balancing of interests including press protection, that a Crimesite request was withdrawn because journalistic interests were not weighed, and that the College of Procurators-General will issue a revised guideline on coercive measures against journalists.
For this reason the request was also withdrawn.
Om deze reden is de vordering ook ingetrokken.

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over handmatige acties en controles bij tap- of referentieverzoeken (ingezonden 22 december 2010).

MPs asked the Justice minister about a misdirected fax containing wiretap data, whether tap orders are sent by fax without adequate authentication or logging, and whether automated secure systems should replace manual steps. The minister called the incident an isolated manual error, said the KLPD process is already automated with logging, authentication and secure networking, and announced tightened procedures.
Measures have been taken to reduce the chance of such an incident in the future, including tightening procedures and instructing staff.
Er zijn maatregelen genomen om de kans op een dergelijk incident in de toekomst te verkleinen, onder andere door het aanscherpen van procedures en het instrueren van medewerkers.

Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de strafoplegging door rechters in rechtszaken naar aanleiding van de jaarwisseling (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

MP Van der Steur asks whether judges imposed lighter sentences than the prosecution demanded in New Year's Eve super-fast-track cases, how judges justify such deviations, and whether heavier punishment for violence against public servants is supported. The minister answers that the number of cases is too small to draw general conclusions, that a Tilburg study found judges followed 93% of prosecution demands, that mentions of reasons in oral judgments are hard to summarise, and that the prosecution raised its demand for such offences from 150% to 200% of the standard.
It is correct that in a number of the cases referred to, the judge imposed a lower sentence than the public prosecutor had demanded.
Het klopt dat de rechter in een aantal van de aangeduide zaken een lagere straf heeft opgelegd dan door de officier was geëist.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Sjaak vlucht voor Poolse rechter» (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

Deputy Van der Steur asked the Justice Minister about reports that the Netherlands surrenders EU nationals under the European Arrest Warrant for minor offences, and whether courts or the government should limit this. Minister Opstelten answered that the instrument is necessary, rejected fixed time limits and a higher threshold, denied that minor cases overburden the Amsterdam IRC, and said alternatives such as fine-enforcement are being explored with Poland.
The European Arrest Warrant instrument is intended to forcibly return persons who have evaded justice and remain abroad in another member state, either to stand trial or to serve a prison sentence.

Het instrument van het EAB is bedoeld om personen die zich hebben onttrokken van justitie en zich daaraan ook onttrokken houden door verblijf in een andere lidstaat, gedwongen terug te brengen om hetzij terecht te staan, hetzij een vrijheidsstraf uit te zitten.
Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over fouten in processen-verbaal (ingezonden 5 november 2010).

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether faulty police reports (processen-verbaal) cause cases to collapse, and whether ICT problems or the case-management system contribute. The minister acknowledged incorrect reports occur, said their frequency is unknown, pointed to audio-visual recording of interviews and local corrective measures, and denied that ICT systems are a cause.
The precise number of cases in which such incorrectly drawn-up reports occur, and the number of cases that consequently collapse, is not known.
Het precieze aantal gevallen waarin sprake is van dergelijke onjuist opgemaakte processen-verbaal, en het aantal zaken dat daar eventueel door stuk loopt, is niet bekend.
Vragen van de leden Nicolaï, Van der Steur en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en Veiligheid en Justitie over publicaties van Wikileaks (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

Three VVD MPs asked the foreign and justice ministers about WikiLeaks publications, including who can access SIPRNET, how allies store and control access to sensitive information, whether passenger data access is limited, and whether the government will seek clarification and safeguards. The minister answered that details of US systems are not disclosed, that NATO inspections and bilateral responsibility govern information security, that the Netherlands was pre-informed of publications, and that the need for additional measures is under study.
Regarding how the system is managed and who has access to it, no statements are made given the classification of the system.
Over de vragen hoe het systeem wordt beheerd en wie daartoe toegang heeft worden gezien de classificatie van het systeem geen mededelingen gedaan.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over kinderporno op de computer bij leraar basisschool (ingezonden 29 november 2010).

Rep. Van der Steur (VVD) asked the Justice Minister why the Public Prosecution Service waited two years to inform an Avenhorn primary school that its deputy head had child pornography on his computer, and what policy governs such notifications. State Secretary Teeven confirmed the delay, explained the Wjsg notification rules, and said the OM should have informed the school earlier and will take internal measures.
The OM should have informed the school management of the suspicion against their director earlier.
Het OM had de schoolleiding al eerder op de hoogte behoren te stellen van de verdenking tegen hun directeur.

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het DNA-verdrag tussen Nederland en de Verenigde Staten (VS) (ingezonden 25 november 2010)

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister about the Dutch-US DNA and fingerprint data exchange treaty, covering reciprocity, the purpose of serious-crime solving, privacy safeguards, the link to US Visa Waiver requirements, comparable treaties with other EU states, and EU coordination. The government answered that access is granted case by case through national contact points, that privacy is protected because reference data are not traceable to individuals, that the treaty was driven by slow manual matching rather than specific cases, and that EU coordination was informal.
As for reciprocity, I refer to my answer to question 3 from MP Schouw of your House.
Wat betreft de wederkerigheid verwijs ik naar mijn antwoord op vraag 3 van het lid Schouw van uw Kamer
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de verstoorde werksfeer bij strafrechters en de kwaliteit van de strafrechtspraak (ingezonden 22 november 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the reported disrupted working climate among criminal judges and the quality of criminal justice, prompted by a book by a court administrator, and asked whether the judiciary's self-correction, transparency and citizen complaint channels could restore trust. The minister replied that the book's observations are personal and not automatically generalisable but deserve serious attention, that criminal justice quality is not at issue, and pointed to existing quality systems, expanded transparency, promotion of digital complaints, and planned court-map reform, while leaving the judiciary to act on its own organisation.
I have drawn attention to this with the Council for the Judiciary.
Ik heb hiervoor aandacht gevraagd bij de Raad voor de rechtspraak.

Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een alternatief voor de traditionele rechtspraak (stichting E-Court) en de rol van de deurwaarder (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether private dispute body Stichting E-Court, which issues enforceable notarial deeds, requires bailiff involvement that the minister should recognise as official acts under the Gerechtsdeurwaarders law. The state secretary replies that E-Court is comparable to binding advice, that a court-referred test case is pending, and that the ministry awaits its outcome and the KNB's view before informing parliament in early 2011.
Therefore I am awaiting the outcome of said procedure and the further determination of the KNB's position.
Daarom wacht ik de uitkomstvan genoemde procedure en nadere standpuntbepaling van de KNB af.
Vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Financiën over de BKR-registratie en privacy (ingezonden 2 november 2010).

MPs Van der Steur and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether the 8 June 2010 Arnhem court ruling on BKR credit registration and the Personal Data Protection Act should lead to changes in BKR policy, including proportionality of registration, the complaints committee, and a right to request removal. The minister declined to comment on the pending Supreme Court case, stated that registration is legally required and that the existing correction and complaint routes remain available.
In the case in question, cassation has been lodged with the Supreme Court. Therefore I cannot go into this case, nor anticipate the outcome of the further proceedings.
In de genoemde zaak is cassatie ingesteld bij de Hoge Raad. Daarom kan ik niet op deze zaak ingaan, noch vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van de verdere procedure.
Vragen van de leden Schaart en Van der Steur (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Financiën inzake de BKR-regeling (ingezonden 15 november 2010).

MPs Schaart and Van der Steur asked whether telecom firms withdrawing from BKR credit registration over disproportionate effects should lead the government to change policy, and whether obligated parties should be free to leave the system. The minister answered that BKR registration remains useful for creditworthiness checks, that registration does not mean automatic refusal, and that any changes to the BKR rules are for participants to decide, with talks reported to have resumed.
Any amendments to the BKR regulations are for the participants of BKR.
Eventuele aanpassingen van het reglement van BKR zijn aan de deelnemers van BKR.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over bankgegevens (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a database of bank data was planned at the CIOT, what data it would hold, how privacy and unauthorized access are handled, and whether past unauthorized access to the telecom CIOT database occurred. The minister referred to earlier answers, said the plan was a central inquiry point rather than central storage, and reported one police unit's breach of access rules found in a 2008 audit with no criminal complaint filed.
Incidentally, the official exploration referred to did not involve central storage but a central inquiry point.
Overigens was er bij de daarin genoemde ambtelijke verkenning geen sprake van een centrale opslag maar van een centraal raadplegingspunt
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie over de aansprakelijkheid van deskundigen voor fouten in het deskundigenonderzoek in civiele zaken (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether court-appointed experts in civil cases are personally liable for errors, whether they can limit that liability, and whether the state should bear it. The minister confirms personal liability, describes two liability-limiting methods courts use, says the state need not bear liability given existing correction mechanisms and the very limited risk.
I do not share this view.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie over het leggen van conservatoir beslag (ingezonden 26 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether he agrees that proposals from the Council for the Judiciary's research on conservatory attachment (conservatoir beslag) do not go far enough and that Dutch attachment law should align more with neighbouring countries. The minister answers that the Utrecht study is being taken up by a working group of court chairs on possible changes to judicial practice, and he will await its findings before taking a position.
I consider it a good thing that the study's recommendations have directly found resonance in legal practice, and I want to await the findings of this working group before determining a position.

Ik acht het een goede zaak dat de aanbevelingen uit het onderzoek direct weerklank in de rechtspraktijk hebben gevonden, en wil de bevindingen van deze werkgroep eerst afwachten alvorens een standpunt te bepalen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie over rechtsbijstand, de kwetsbare positie van zzp-ers en «no cure no pay» (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

MP Van der Steur asks the Justice Minister whether the government will consider no-cure-no-pay arrangements and whether self-employed workers' vulnerability over legal costs is adequately addressed. The minister says no-cure-no-pay is mostly irrelevant for defence cases, that the Bar's rules already allow result-related fees for debt collection, and that entrepreneurs should provide for business risks themselves, while the Bar is asked to propose an experiment.
I have asked the Bar to initiate a proposal for an experiment with result-related fees.
Ik heb de Orde gevraagd een voorstel te initiëren voor een experiment met resultaatgerelateerde beloning.

Vragen van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) aan de minister van Justitie over de gevolgen van de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad in de ASMI-zaak voor de invulling van de Code Tabaksblat en de rol en taakvervulling van de Raad van

An MP asks the Justice Minister how the Supreme Court's ASMI ruling affects the Tabaksblat Code and the role of supervisory boards in listed companies, including whether companies can still deviate with explanation and whether supervisory boards must mediate. The minister answers that the ruling creates no duty to mediate, leaves the comply-or-explain system unchanged, and says investigators' fees will be considered in the pending reform of the enquiry right.
The Supreme Court's ruling brings no change to the comply-or-explain system prescribed for such obligations.
De uitspraak van de Hoge Raad brengt geen verandering in het «pas toe of leg uit» systeem dat voor dergelijke verplichtingen is voorgeschreven.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een terreur-imam in Eindhoven

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why a Kuwaiti preacher placed on a US terrorism list could speak at an Eindhoven mosque the next day, how the listing procedure works, and why mosques hosting such preachers are not closed or their foundations dissolved. The minister replied that a US sanctions listing alone is not sufficient grounds to bar a speaker, that Dutch listing is an independent procedure, that the high legal bar for dissolving a legal entity under Article 2:20 BW applies, and that measures for visa-required preachers are set out in the Integrated Approach to Jihadism programme.
Listing on the American sanctions list alone is insufficient grounds to refuse a speaker entry.
Vermelding op de Amerikaanse sanctielijst alleen is onvoldoende grond voor het weren van een spreker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat het leven van een politieagent aan diggelen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a press report on a police officer whose reputation was damaged after being wrongly suspected of breaching confidentiality, and about lessons learned, aftercare, and possible action. The minister confirmed the officer was wrongly treated as a suspect, said the investigation was justified and within legal bounds, declined to comment on the prosecution of the complaint or on individual cases, and refused an inquiry into media publication.
The Public Prosecution Service has taken note of the police officer's complaint. Given the stage the handling of this complaint is at, no further statements can be made about it.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft kennisgenomen van de aangifte van de betreffende agent. Gelet op de fase waarin de behandeling van deze aangifte zich bevindt, kunnen hier verder geen mededelingen over worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Justitie biedt vader meisje van Nulde excuses aan”

An MP asked why the father of a murdered girl from Nulde was informed too late about the unescorted leave of her killer, a TBS patient, and whether the Information Point for Detention Progress should face sanctions or compensation for late notifications. The Minister says the IDV informed victims within its 7-working-day target in 99.5% of cases, defends not introducing sanctions or automatic compensation, but commits to talks with DJI and the OM on better aligning leave decisions and victim notification.
For that short notice period, the Public Prosecution Service has offered apologies.
Voor die korte termijn heeft het OM excuses aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Segers en Verhoeven over het bericht dat drugs met medeweten van de politie Nederland in is gesmokkeld

MPs Van Nispen, Segers and Verhoeven asked whether police officers knowingly let cocaine shipments into the Netherlands, whether a tipster was paid, and whether the no-let-pass rule (doorlaatverbod) was breached. Minister Blok declined to address the specific questions because the criminal case is before the court, restated the legal framework for seizure and controlled delivery, and saw no reason for a further investigation.
Given that the criminal case is currently before the court, it is not appropriate for me to address these questions in substance.
Gelet op het feit dat de strafzaak momenteel onder de rechter is, past het mij niet om inhoudelijk in te gaan op deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Onschuldig en toch voor het leven gestraft'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about a report of a person wrongly treated as a suspect for about a year, with only a dismissal letter afterwards and little aftercare. The government acknowledges the harm, gives figures on wrongly-suspected cases and describes existing compensation routes and a re-integration convenant with municipalities, but offers no new aftercare for wrongly suspected persons beyond ongoing study.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it is currently considering whether it is possible in such cases (sepot 01 cases) to send a non-automated message to the person concerned.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij laten weten dat zij momenteel bezien of het tot de mogelijkheden behoort om in dit soort gevallen (sepot 01-zaken) een niet-geautomatiseerd bericht te doen uitgaan naar de betrokken persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat nietsvermoedende Nederlandse meisjes op Twitter worden aangeboden als prostituee

SP MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that girls' identities were used on social media to advertise them as prostitutes, and about police capacity, training, and the role of platforms. The minister confirmed awareness, said sextortion is not registered separately so no figures exist, defended police prioritisation and training, and placed responsibility for swift removal of content on social media providers.
Sextortion is registered as a form of extortion in police systems and not as a separate phenomenon.
Sextortion wordt als een vorm van afpersing geregistreerd in de politiesystemen en niet als apart fenomeen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het toch drastisch verminderen van de subsidie van de Stichting Geschillencommissies voor Consumentenzaken

An SP MP asked why the subsidy to the Stichting Geschillencommissies voor Consumentenzaken was apparently cut by 160,000 euro despite parliament's repeated wishes, and why the cut surfaced only after budget debates. The minister denied a cut, explained the 2009 transfer of the health-sector commission subsidy to his ministry, and said agreement was reached with the foundation on a 2017 subsidy of 1,273,060 euro.
The SGC board can accept a subsidy in line with the amount the SGC requested in its 2017 subsidy application, namely 1,273,060 euro.
Het bestuur van de SGC kan zich vinden in toekenning van een subsidie conform het bedrag dat de SGC in haar subsidieverzoek voor 2017 heeft aangevraagd, zijnde € 1.273.060.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de rol van prostitutiewebsites bij mensenhandel

A ChristenUnie MP asked whether adult-services websites enable trafficking and contact with minors, and whether their operators are held accountable and should need licences. The minister answered that existing criminal law (art. 273f and sexual offence articles) suffices, that prosecution of operators is not separately recorded, and that the police logo use on one site has been removed.
I intend to continue this consultation.
Ik ben voornemens dit overleg voort te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Toorenburg over intolerantie jegens religieuze instellingen

CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister whether arson at a planned mosque in Culemborg and vandalism at a church in Utrecht reflect intolerance toward religious institutions, how many such incidents occurred in 2016, and whether online racist reactions are pursued. The minister declined to judge the open cases, said incidents are not registered by religion, noted no reports were filed about online discrimination, and committed to pursuing perpetrators.
I have received the report that an investigation has been started in both cases.
Ik heb het bericht ontvangen dat er in beide gevallen een onderzoek is gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de beschieting van de basisschool As-Siddieq in Amsterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the shooting at the As-Siddieq primary school in Amsterdam, the state of the police investigation, threats to Islamic institutions, and protection measures. The minister declined substantive comment on the ongoing investigation, referred to the NCTV threat assessment finding no indication of a general threat to Islamic institutions, and said local authorities decide on protection measures.
The criminal investigation is currently ongoing. In the interest of the investigation, I will not make substantive statements.
Het opsporingsonderzoek loopt momenteel. In het belang van het onderzoek doe ik geen inhoudelijke mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het ontstaan van een tekort aan rechters

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the judicial vacancies and the claimed risk that the justice chain will stall. The minister answers that about nineteen judge vacancies exist, that this does not justify fears of a stall, and that the vacancies stem from replacement needs and the introduction of professional standards, with a phased rollout and intensified recruitment as remedies.
The Judiciary is taking measures by intensifying the recruitment and training of new judges, phasing in the professional standards and monitoring progress so that it can adjust in time if needed.

De Rechtspraak neemt maatregelen door de werving en opleiding van nieuwe rechters te intensiveren, de invoering van de professionele standaarden te faseren en de voortgang te monitoren, zodat zo nodig tijdig kan worden bijgestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rehabilitatie van onterecht veroordeelden

The MP Van Nispen asks the Minister of Justice about the rehabilitation of wrongly convicted people following a court ruling on state co-responsibility for Du Bois's crimes, and what support and apology he received. The minister declines to comment on the court ruling, explains that rehabilitation is case-by-case with compensation and municipal reintegration support, and says the state's efforts for Du Bois were considered complete, with no structural remedy promised.
It is not for me as Minister of Security and Justice to intervene in decisions of an independent judicial body.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie om te treden in beslissingen van een onafhankelijk rechterlijk college.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het verlof van de moordenaar van het meisje van Nulde

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the state will abolish unaccompanied leave for TBS detainees after a murderer of a girl from Nulde was granted such leave, and how the victim's father can be supported. The state secretary answered that leave is carefully phased with multiple assessments and revocation rules, that the government will not abolish unaccompanied leave, and that victims' relatives can use free support from Slachtofferhulp Nederland.
No, TBS treatment is aimed at a responsible and safe return to society.
Nee, de tbs-behandeling is gericht op een verantwoorde en veilige terugkeer in de maatschappij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het lekken van geheime politieinformatie naar de Telegraaf

The MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether leaked secret police information in Telegraaf articles on extremism in mosques had harmed ongoing investigations and which police services and individuals had access. The Minister declined to answer on substance, citing the rule against operational disclosures, ongoing investigations, and the policy of not providing information to Parliament about individual police officers.
Not only could any ongoing investigations be harmed by reporting to the House, but in principle no information is provided to the House about individual police officers.
Niet alleen kunnen eventuele lopende onderzoeken door rapportage aan de Kamer worden geschaad, ook wordt in beginsel geen informatie verstrekt aan de Kamer over individuele politiemedewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over alcoholcontroles in het verkeer

Two CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the reported sharp drop in drink-driving checks, and the reduced role of Veilig Verkeer Nederland volunteers, is accurate and what explains it. The minister confirmed the declining trend, attributed it to social media warnings making large checks less effective and to police shifting toward individual checks that are not always registered, and said police are in talks with VVN.
Registering individual checks, which also test for alcohol use, is not mandatory.
Het registreren van individuele controles, waarbij ook getest wordt op het gebruik van alcohol, is niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over Privacygevoelige informatie van 1-1-2-meldingen

An MP asked whether privacy-sensitive details from 112 emergency calls should be published and what measures will stop that, including the timing of encrypted P2000 messaging. The minister agrees such information should not be published, and says the renewed P2000 network will allow encrypted sensitive messages from early 2018, with emergency services preparing new equipment and procedures.
Yes, I share the view that privacy-sensitive information from 1-1-2 reports should not be published publicly.
Ja, ik deel de mening dat privacy gevoelige informatie van 1-1-2 meldingen niet openbaar gepubliceerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de voortdurende zorgelijke situatie bij Veilig Thuis Gelderland-Zuid

An MP asked the government about continuing problems at Veilig Thuis Gelderland-Zuid, including police reports not being handled properly and waiting lists. The State Secretary answered that inspectorates have kept the organisation under intensified supervision since April 2016, that waiting lists have fallen markedly since August 2016, and that the regional municipalities have taken steps, though the organisation is not yet fully in order.
The inspectorates are following developments at Veilig Thuis Gelderland-Zuid within the framework of intensified supervision.
De inspecties volgen de ontwikkelingen bij Veilig Thuis Gelderland-Zuid in het kader van het verscherpt toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Volp, Kooiman en Van Tongeren over het bericht dat burgemeester van der Laan vasthoudt aan de sluiting van acht coffeeshops

MPs Bergkamp, Volp, Kooiman and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Amsterdam's mayor insisting on closing eight coffee shops near schools, including the legal basis of an earlier informal agreement with the minister's predecessor and whether it obliges the mayor to enforce a 250-metre distance criterion. The minister answered that the agreement was oral, concerns phased enforcement priorities, that enforcement of the residence and distance criteria lies with the mayor or municipality, and declined to judge local research or to answer on the shorter deadline.
My predecessor made an oral agreement with the mayor of Amsterdam on prioritisation in enforcement regarding local coffee shop policy.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft met de burgemeester van Amsterdam een mondelinge afspraak gemaakt over prioritering in de handhaving met betrekking tot het lokale coffeeshopbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over het bericht dat niet-westerse Nederlanders vaker celstraf krijgen in plaats van taakstraffen

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that non-Western Dutch nationals receive prison sentences more often than community service, and whether ethnic profiling could operate in sentencing. The minister, citing the Raad voor de rechtspraak research, said the differences are explained by practical and legitimate factors, saw no need for further research, and noted the judiciary will advise on adjusting penalty conversion ratios.
The report concludes that, using the conversion keys customary for substitute detention, there are no differences in sentence severity between origin groups.
Het rapport concludeert dat er, bij hantering van de bij vervangende hechtenis gebruikelijke omrekensleutels tussen soorten straffen, geen verschillen bestaan in sanctiezwaarte tussen herkomstgroepen

Vragen van het lid Wilders (PVV) aan de Minister-President, Minister van Algemene Zaken over het nieuws dat de FBI vooraf geweten zou hebben van de aanslag in Garland op 3 mei 2015 (ingezonden 26 oktober 2016).

An MP asks whether the FBI shared threat information with Dutch authorities before the 2015 Garland attack and how the government will press the US if not, and demands quick answers. The minister reports that US authorities state they had no specific credible threat information beforehand and would have shared it with the Netherlands had they had it.
I asked the American authorities on 16 August 2016 to explain the reports in relation to the alleged foreknowledge of the FBI.
Ik heb de Amerikaanse autoriteiten op 16 augustus 2016 verzocht om de berichten te duiden in relatie tot de vermeende voorkennis van de FBI
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over maatregelen tegen discriminerende uitlatingen van medewerkers op Facebook

An MP asked ministers whether a PostNL driver's dismissal after a discriminatory Facebook post is being prosecuted, how often employers take measures against racist or discriminatory remarks, and whether employers should correct such conduct. The minister says the prosecutor is still considering prosecution, that no statistics exist on employer measures, that the labour inspectorate found 80-90 percent of 200 inspected firms lacked the legally required anti-discrimination policy and are being followed up, and that employers share responsibility through the Charter Diversiteit and the 2015 action plan.
The public prosecution service (OM) has the case under investigation.
Het openbaar ministerie (OM) heeft de zaak in onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over de schimmigheid omtrent teruggekeerde jihadisten

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about the status of 31 returned jihadists, how many are free or convicted, and whether all should be preventively detained. The minister said seven have been convicted and a prosecution decision has been taken on about eight more, withholding further detail to protect ongoing investigations, and rejected administrative detention as incompatible with the rule of law under Article 5 ECHR.
Providing further criminal-law information about persons designated as returnees, including any pending prosecution decisions, could possibly harm ongoing investigations.

Het verstrekken van nadere strafrechtelijke informatie over als terugkeerder aangemerkte personen, inclusief eventuele op handen zijnde vervolgingsbeslissingen, kan mogelijk lopende onderzoeken schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de snelwegpolitie wordt afgeschaft

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the motorway police is being abolished and why, given good results, and how this fits the goal of reducing road deaths. The minister answered that the 20 motorway enforcement staff are moved into the Dienst Infrastructuur, that enforcement stays at current levels with results agreements to follow, and that enforcement will focus on priority offences.
In addition, results agreements on motorway traffic enforcement will be formulated between the CVOM parquet and the National Unit, in consultation with Rijkswaterstaat.

In aanvulling daarop zullen tussen het parket Centrale Verwerking Openbaar Ministerie (CVOM) en de Landelijke Eenheid, in samenspraak met Rijkswaterstaat, resultaatafspraken worden geformuleerd met betrekking tot de verkeershandhaving op de snelwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Madlener over het bericht dat de snelwegpolitie wordt afgeschaft terwijl er juist behoefte is aan meer controle op verkeershufters

MPs Helder and Madlener asked whether the motorway police unit is being abolished, reducing control of dangerous drivers, and why the government is ignoring calls for more such enforcement and conflicting statements from prosecutors. The minister replied that motorway enforcement will be kept at least at current levels by the Dienst Infrastructuur, with result agreements to follow, and that the prosecution service, not the minister, directs enforcement priorities.
The House will be informed of the outcomes.
De Kamer zal over de uitkomsten worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over het weigeren van een Spaans rechtshulpverzoek door PSV

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice why PSV refused a Spanish legal assistance request to identify fans who humiliated beggars in Madrid, and what Dutch authorities would do to help Spanish prosecution. The minister replied that football clubs' stadium bans and criminal prosecution are separate tracks that can be used alongside each other, that Dutch justice will help Spain, and that PSV has since done further research and the request is being considered at administrative level.
After the Spanish judicial authorities indicated they would persist with the request, Dutch justice made a repeated demand to PSV to identify the football supporters concerned.

Nadat de Spaanse justitiële autoriteiten hebben aangegeven bij het verzoek te persisteren, heeft de Nederlandse justitie een herhaalde vordering gedaan aan PSV om de betreffende voetbalsupporters te identificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels, Belhaj en Van Veldhoven over de berichten 'Druk aan de Poort' en 'Zelfverrijking normale gang van zaken bij Rotterdams containerbedrijf'

D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Justice and Security, Infrastructure and Environment, and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that many containers in Rotterdam port are not systematically scanned for nuclear material and that fraud occurred at a container firm. The government answered that customs uses a risk-based approach, that scanning and inspection capacity was adequate for the Second Maasvlakte, that radiological screening is applied where feasible, and that it cannot comment on ongoing investigations.
However, I cannot make any statements about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken kan ik echter geen mededeling doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over grenscontroles door de douane in het binnenland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Justice and Security about customs checks in the interior, including the end of BPM checks on foreign-plated cars, the revenue recovered, the armed status of customs officers during excise checks, and cooperation with police and the Marechaussee. The State Secretary answered that BPM checks moved to the Tax Administration in 2010, that repressive recovery yields about 1.5 million euro per year, that a study on arming excise checks is ongoing, and that the Customs service has a 24-hour contact point.
The investigation announced in this letter into whether there are situations in which excise checks can be carried out armed is ongoing.
Het in deze brief aangekondigde onderzoek of er situaties zijn waarin de accijnscontroles bewapend uitgevoerd kunnen worden, loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het Meldpunt Discriminatie Internet (MiND) dat stelt gewelddadige homohaat mag op grond van de islam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether MiND (Meldpunt Discriminatie Internet) was right to say that violent anti-gay hatred based on Islam is not discrimination, and whether it should be subsidised. The Minister acknowledged a serious error by MiND, which has apologised and had the posts removed, but said the Public Prosecution Service is the body that judges criminal conduct and that he will talk with MiND without ending the subsidy for now.
MiND's response to the posts submitted to them was a serious error.
De reactie van MiND op de aan hen voorgelegde uitingen was een ernstige fout.

Vragen van het lid Kuzu (Groep Kuzu/Öztürk) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de berichten «Asielzoeker overlijdt na aanhouding in Maastricht» en «Getuigen fatale arrestatie Maastricht moesten beelden wisse

MP Kuzu asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that an asylum seeker died after arrest in Maastricht, including whether police used proportionate force, forced witnesses to delete footage, on what legal basis, and whether officers involved in a neck hold would be suspended or prosecuted. The Minister's reply is only an interim notice that the answers cannot be given within the usual period because not all information has yet been received, with answers promised as soon as possible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Asielcheck totaal fiasco"

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister and State Secretary of Security and Justice why the promised inspection report on asylum identification was delayed until December, why phone and data-carrier checks are not always fully carried out due to time, capacity and equipment limits, and whether the registration process can detect trafficking and terrorism signals. The government answers that the inspection finds the process now carefully executed with some improvement points, that devices are largely in order, that the delay was due to a procedural cycle with a publication on 21 December, and that further measures and a follow-up inspection on signal handling are underway.

With this, the commitment made by the Minister of Security and Justice during the General Consultation on Counterterrorism of 24 November 2016 to send the Inspection report with policy response to the House of Representatives before the Christmas recess has been fulfilled.

Daarmee is voldaan aan de toezegging van de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Terrorismebestrijding van 24 november 2016 om het Inspectierapport met beleidsreactie nog voor het kerstreces aan de Tweede Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het opnemen van politieverhoren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the quality of audiovisual recordings of police interviews and the status of the motion to record all such interviews. The Minister said current recording quality meets the obligations of the existing directive, that recording all interviews is not feasible in the short term, and that the motion will not be implemented soon.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Fokke (beiden PvdA) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de politie filmpjes van een arrestatie liet wissen (ingezonden 27 december 2016).

MPs Marcouch and Fokke asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police had required bystanders to delete video footage of a fatal arrest in Maastricht, and on what legal basis, including whether citizens had complained. The government's reply is only a holding notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all required information has been received yet.
since not all the required information has yet been received. I aim to answer the questions as soon as possible.
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen. Ik streef ernaar de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Van Oosten, Kooiman en Van der Staaij over de documentaire ‘Grenzeloos misbruikt’

Five MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about the documentary on child sex tourism and webcam abuse, including police capacity, investigative powers, Philippine cooperation, liaison staffing and funding. The government answered in detail, describing existing measures, the Plan van Aanpak, the Manila liaison extension and the Down to Zero programme, while declining to commit additional funds or expertise for Philippine police training due to scarce specialised capacity.

Because these efforts require scarce specialised operational police capacity, which would then not be available for investigation in the Netherlands, I am unfortunately forced to be restrained in this regard.

Omdat deze inspanningen de inzet vereisen van schaarse gespecialiseerde operationele capaciteit van de politie, die daardoor niet voor de opsporing in Nederland beschikbaar is, ben ik helaas gedwongen hiermee terughoudend om te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Verhoeven over de documentaire ‘Grenzeloos misbruikt’

D66 MPs Bergkamp and Verhoeven asked the ministers about the documentary 'Grenzeloos misbruikt' on online child sexual abuse, covering police undercover and honeypot powers, use of decoy personas, Philippine cooperation, detection technology like PhotoDNA, and education. The government answered that current law limits deanonymising darknet users, that pending bill Computercriminaliteit III would add powers, that decoy personas are permitted under the Tallon criterion, and described ongoing cooperation and education efforts.
Current legislation offers little to no possibility to de-anonymise users in the relevant environments on the TOR network.
De huidige wetgeving biedt weinig tot geen mogelijkheden om de gebruikers op de bedoelde omgevingen op het TOR-netwerk te de-anonimiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Swinkels over "de lange weg van Isis naar Isabella" over de moeite die het kost om controversiële voornamen te kunnen wijzigen

Two D66 MPs asked why changing a controversial first name requires a costly court procedure and whether it could be simplified as the 2009 naming-law working group recommended. The minister defended court review for minors, explained the historical and functional differences with surname changes, and declined to revisit the earlier decision, though a future cabinet might consider it.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over het stopzetten van internationaal draagmoederschap

MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma asked the government about reports that countries such as Cambodia are halting international surrogacy, the number of Dutch citizens affected, the legal position of intended parents and children, and whether a transitional arrangement is needed. The minister answered that no overview or data exists, that legal parentage is assessed case by case under Dutch law, and that a surrogacy regime is being considered in response to the Staatscommissie report, without committing to a transitional arrangement.
I do not have an overview of countries where international surrogacy exists, is threatened to be halted, or has been halted.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van landen waar internationaal draagmoederschap bestaat, dreigt te worden stopgezet of is stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het niet voorwaardelijk kunnen opleggen van een strafbeschikking door het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert asked why the Wet OM-afdoening does not allow conditional fines in prosecutorial penal orders, and whether the Public Prosecution Service sees a need for conditional sanctions and what a law change would require. The Minister explained the design choice (penal orders use instructions rather than conditions, with a court fallback), said prosecutors weigh cases individually, and noted the Public Prosecution Service wants conditional sentences, which would need legislation; the question has been passed to the ongoing WODC evaluation.
This would require a legislative amendment, which would have to provide, among other things, for additional procedural safeguards.
Dit zou wetswijziging vergen, waarbij onder meer zou moeten worden voorzien in extra procedurele voorzieningen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de aanhouding van een bejaarde Marokkaanse Nederlandse man

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the handcuffing and detention of an elderly Moroccan-Dutch man was disproportionate, and what would prevent recurrence. The Minister said that questions about the specific incident fall to the Amsterdam mayor, that police acted out of concern, apologised to the family, discussed the matter with the officers, and pointed to existing complaint routes and training on diversity and confused persons.
Answering specific questions about the incident falls under the responsibility of the mayor as the local competent authority.
Het beantwoorden van specifieke vragen over het genoemde voorval valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeester als lokaal bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘Politie biedt 84-jarige man excuses aan voor hardhandige arrestatie’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police apologised for the handcuffed arrest of an 84-year-old man for cycling on the wrong side of the road, questioning proportionality, language contact, possible ethnic profiling and police training. The Minister answered that questions about this specific incident fall under the local mayor's responsibility, that police acted out of concern for a confused man, that police apologised, and that ethnic discrimination is not tolerated.
Answering specific questions about the incident falls under the responsibility of the mayor as the local competent authority.
Het beantwoorden van specifieke vragen over het genoemde voorval valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeester als lokaal bevoegd gezag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Segers over het betrekken van de pilot ‘spreekuurrechter’ bij het onderzoek naar de haalbaarheid en inpasbaarheid in de reguliere rechtspraak van een vrederechter

MPs Van Nispen and Segers asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a 'spreekuurrechter' (walk-in judge) pilot at the Noord-Nederland district court and whether its experience would feed into the study of a vrederechter (justice of the peace) model. The Minister confirmed awareness, said the Judiciary is evaluating the pilot, and said the WODC study on Belgium and France will draw on pilot experience, without specifying the study design.
It is not yet known how the study referred to in the motion will be designed.
Het is nog niet bekend op welke wijze het onderzoek als bedoeld in de motie zal worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Oosenbrug over datalekken bij ziekenhuizen

MPs Oosenbrug and Bouwmeester asked the ministers of Justice and of Health about frequent data breaches at hospitals, their causes, whether patients were informed, and whether the Dutch data protection authority has fined providers for late reporting. The minister answered that breaches stem from various causes, that the authority has not yet imposed fines for late reporting, that a joint action plan on information security for patient data is being prepared, and that the authority's sanctioning choices are its own.
The AP has so far not imposed any fines for failing to report a data breach on time.
De AP heeft tot op heden geen boetes opgelegd vanwege het niet tijdig melden van een datalek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het bericht 'omstreden wondersap Xango werft student-verkopers'

An MP asked the ministers whether multilevel marketing sold to young people such as Xango is legitimate, whether it amounts to a pyramid scheme, and whether authorities will act against it. The minister answered that MLM is lawful, that businesses must follow consumer-protection and gambling rules enforced by ACM and the Kansspelautoriteit, that individual cases and ongoing investigations cannot be commented on, and that action against US legislation is not for the Dutch government.
It is not appropriate for me to give a judgement on the conduct of individual companies.
Het past mij niet een oordeel te geven over de handelwijze van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Swinkels, Van Toorenburg en Van Raak over het bericht dat een terreurverdachte op het vliegtuig naar Turkije kon stappen

MPs asked why a terror suspect could board a flight to Turkey after a German SIRENE alert was not passed on urgently due to a telephone outage and an unmonitored email inbox. The minister explained the outage, the procedures for passing on alerts, and measures taken, but declined to share the outage report in full, citing security concerns.
Because of the detailed information about the internal systems of the National Police and their vulnerability to possible misuse, I will share the outage evaluation confidentially with your House.

Vanwege de gedetailleerde informatie over de interne systemen van de Nationale Politie en de kwetsbaarheid daarvan ten aanzien van mogelijk misbruik, zal ik de storingsevaluatie vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer delen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Swinkels (beiden D66), Van Toorenburg (CDA) en Van Raak (SP) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een terreurverdachte op het vliegtuig naar Turkije kon stappen

MPs from D66, CDA and SP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why phone and email channels between SIRENE, the police Landelijke Eenheid and the CTER team failed when a terror suspect was able to board a flight to Turkey, and how the 088-number outage was handled. The minister's follow-up answer provides a storingsrapportage (outage report) for confidential inspection by MPs only, with the substantive explanations apparently in the referenced earlier answers.
I hereby offer you for confidential inspection until 31 January 2017 the outage report.
Hierbij bied ik u ter vertrouwelijke inzage tot 31 januari 2017 de storingsrapportage aan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het artikel 'België zet haatprediker uit naar Nederland'

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether the government would bar, denaturalise or expel a Belgian-expelled Dutch imam who preaches hatred. Minister Asscher answered that Dutch citizens cannot be refused entry or expelled, that Dutch national security shows no current threat so far, and that the government will monitor him and act against incitement.
Dutch nationals cannot be refused access to the Netherlands. Nor can they be expelled.
Nederlanders kan de toegang tot Nederland niet worden geweigerd. Evenmin kunnen zij worden uitgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de uitzetting van een “haatimam” van België naar Nederland

MP Marcouch asked the Justice Minister whether Belgium's expulsion of a Dutch-Moroccan imam, who has a Dutch nationality, is unwelcome and how his return to the Netherlands could be prevented or monitored. The minister answered that Dutch nationals cannot be refused entry or expelled, that no Dutch national-security threat is known, and that municipalities, police and prosecutors will closely monitor him and act against incitement.
I cannot go into how they do that.
Ik kan hier niet in gaan op welke wijze zij dat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brouwer over het bericht dat veel Nederlanders niet weten wanneer ze 1-1-2 mogen bellen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the public understands when to call the 112 emergency number, and whether misuse should be tackled and public information improved. The minister agreed the 112 rule should be widely known, reported that 35-40% of calls are misuse or non-urgent, and declined a new national campaign, citing the falling misuse trend and existing measures.
In view of the above, I see no reason to start a new information campaign from central government.
Ik zie gelet op het bovenstaande geen aanleiding om een nieuwe voorlichtingscampagne vanuit het rijk te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over de positie van de aandeelhouder bij faillissementen

MPs Nijboer and Recourt asked the Ministers of Finance and Justice about shareholders' position in bankruptcies, including debt-financing of firms, shareholder-creditors, pre-pack sales and carve-outs for suppliers. The government answered that the issues will be examined within the WCO I-III reform programme and a consultation draft is planned for summer 2017, while declining to assess specific cases.
It is not for us (as Ministers of Finance and Justice) to assess specific practical situations and to state whether employees or creditors may have been harmed.

Het is niet aan ons (als Ministers van Financiën en Veiligheid en Justitie) om specifieke praktijksituaties te beoordelen en ons uit te spreken over de vraag of werknemers of schuldeisers daarbij mogelijk zijn benadeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de brandweer in Groningen later ter plekke is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about fire brigade arrival times in Groningen (met in only 39% of cases), regional differences, rising fire service costs, and safety in sparsely populated areas. The minister said the regional safety board is responsible for arrival times, pointed to an Inspectorate study due by summer 2017, and said police response-time issues require local tailoring.
It is up to the board of the Groningen safety region to ensure that when setting fire brigade arrival times, the provisions of the Safety Regions Decree (Bvr) are met.

Het is aan het bestuur van Veiligheidsregio Groningen om ervoor te zorgen dat bij het vaststellen van de opkomsttijden van de brandweer wordt voldaan aan de bepalingen van het Besluit veiligheidsregio’s (Bvr).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat er alarm wordt geslagen over het geweld en corruptie in de cocaïnehandel

An SP MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about police and prosecution warnings over rising cocaine trade violence, port capacity and customs corruption. The state secretary answered that the signal is taken seriously, points to the integrated one-government approach and customs' smart supervision, says shootings may be indirectly linked to drug imports, and refers to earlier answers on anti-corruption measures at customs.
The regional triangle and Customs are examining which consultation model can best be given shape for this.
De regionale driehoek en de Douane onderzoeken in welk overlegmodel dit het beste vorm gegeven kan worden.

Vragen van het lid Wilders (PVV) aan de Minister-President, Minister van Algemene Zaken over het nieuws dat de FBI vooraf geweten zou hebben van de aanslag in Garland op 3 mei 2015 (ingezonden 26 oktober 2016).

An MP asks the Prime Minister whether the FBI withheld threat information before the 2015 Garland attack from Dutch authorities and what the government will do about it. The government's further answer says it has asked US authorities for specific additional information, has received no reply yet, and will report on progress by end of January 2017.
Unfortunately, I have not yet received an answer to this request.
Ik heb helaas nog geen antwoord op dit verzoek ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het uitvoeren van het VN-Vrouwenverdrag

MPs Dijkstra and Bergkamp asked several ministers about implementing the UN Women's Convention (CEDAW), covering reporting, the 2005 self-employed maternity compensation case, stereotyping in advertising, domestic violence, care for trans and intersex people, sex work registration, and Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered that it will inform parliament in January 2017, rejects the committee's recommendation on maternity compensation pending a Supreme Court-level ruling, and pledges several follow-up actions but declines to investigate some concerns.
The committee recommended that the Dutch government (financially) compensate self-employed women who gave birth in that period. The government decided not to follow this recommendation.

Het comité heeft de Nederlandse regering aanbevolen om vrouwelijke zelfstandigen, die in die periode zijn bevallen, (financieel) te compenseren. De regering heeft besloten om deze aanbeveling van het Comité niet op te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Bruins Slot en Amhaouch over het bericht dat een verwarde man in de boeien is geslagen

CDA MPs asked the ministers about a report of a confused man being hit while handcuffed, whether the police apology was appropriate, and the state of municipal care for confused persons. The minister answered that the matter is covered in a separate letter, that the Aanjaagteam found in September 2016 that no municipality had a well-implemented integrated approach, and that the Schakelteam will monitor progress and share results with parliament.
The Schakelteam has been tasked with promoting and monitoring progress towards an integrated approach.
Het Schakelteam heeft als opdracht meegekregen de voortgang van de sluitende aanpak te bevorderen en te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de terreurdreiging van een synagoge

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a terrorist threat to a synagogue in Amsterdam, the removal of police posts from Jewish sites, and whether the municipality should keep police posts alongside camera surveillance. The minister answered that current protective measures match the threat, that consultation with the Jewish community has occurred, and that Amsterdam chose camera surveillance as a more effective and efficient option within a broader package, declining to detail that package for security reasons.
For security reasons, I will not comment on the further content of this package.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik over de verdere inhoud van dit pakket geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over matchfixing in het voetbal

An MP asked the ministers about reports that matchfixers are buying European football clubs, whether Dutch clubs could be affected, and whether the KNVB's integrity checks and clemency for players who report matchfixing are adequate. The ministers answered that the KNVB has no signals of Dutch takeovers, that takeover screening is for the KNVB to decide, that clemency is rejected in general criminal law, and that cooperation platforms and international expert groups are in place.
As long as the investigation is ongoing, the KNVB will make no statements about it.
Zolang het onderzoek loopt doet de KNVB hierover geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de uitzending van Rambam met als onderwerp dokteronline.nl

SP MPs asked the health minister about a broadcast on dokteronline.com, a Curaçao-based site selling prescription medicines without a doctor visit, and whether her 2010 warning about online sales still stands and what concrete measures she has taken. The minister confirmed the warning, listed the 2011 law changes, notice-and-takedown agreements, the EU logo scheme and campaigns, and said the Inspectorate can act only against Dutch-based practitioners, so it is contacting Curaçao and foreign authorities.
As far as the IGZ is aware, Dokteronline.com no longer has any BIG-registered doctors or pharmacists working from the Netherlands.
Zover bekend bij de IGZ, zijn er bij Dokteronline.com geen artsen of apothekers meer werkzaam die BIG-geregistreerd zijn en vanuit Nederland werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de uniforme herkenbaarheid van voorrangsvoertuigen

An MP asked the ministers whether the Instituut Fysieke Veiligheid (IFV) was right to enforce against reputable transport providers using OOV striping and the Star of Life, and how the policy was applied to resold ambulances and to historic 2002 rules. The minister answered that unauthorised use is unacceptable, that GP out-of-hours services will adopt the secondary ambulance livery within five years, that talks with the transplant foundation are ongoing, and that the goal of uniform recognisability stands.
An agreement has been reached with the organisation of GP out-of-hours services (InEen) that they will adopt the so-called secondary variant of the ambulance house style.
Met de organisatie van huisartsenposten (InEen) is overeengekomen dat zij de zogenoemde secundaire variant van de ambulancehuisstijl gaan voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Oosenbrug over het bericht ‘niet melden van cybercrime is vaak verstandiger’

MPs Oosenbrug and Recourt asked the Minister of Justice about a report that not reporting cybercrime is often wiser, the experience with breach-notification duties abroad, and whether serious cybercrime reports get follow-up. The minister said no central data exists for cross-country comparison, rejected the claim that serious reports go unpursued while noting many complex investigations and few convictions, and pointed to a forthcoming bill and awareness campaigns, without committing to new resources for the data protection authority.
Answering this question is complex because there is no central registration from which data on other countries can be generated.
Beantwoording van deze vraag is complex omdat er geen centrale registratie wordt bijgehouden waaruit gegevens over andere landen te genereren zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over etnisch profileren in Nederland

MP Kuzu asked the Minister of Security and Justice about ethnic profiling by police in traffic checks following a Supreme Court ruling, and whether police discrimination harms public trust. The minister replied that selecting vehicles solely or predominantly on ethnic or religious grounds is not permitted, pointed to internal guidance on risk indicators, diversity and anti-discrimination policy, and said the questions on recherche misuse did not warrant further investigation.
However, it is not permitted to select for a traffic check on the basis of solely or predominantly ethnic or religious characteristics of the driver or other occupants of the vehicle.

Het is echter niet toegestaan om daarbij op grond van uitsluitend of overwegend etnische of religieuze kenmerken van de bestuurder of andere inzittenden van het voertuig te selecteren voor een verkeerscontrole.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Volp over het ‘pleidooi voor meer aandacht bij politieopleidingen voor het omgaan met slachtoffers van seksueel geweld’ van de Pimp de Troonrede-winnares

MPs Bergkamp and Volp asked the Minister of Justice and Security about calls for more police training on handling victims of sexual violence, reported sexual violence complaints, the new sexual offences directive, and whether complaints are taken seriously. The minister replied that complaints rose slightly in 2016, that police are trained and refer cases to specialised Team Zeden units, and that research on reporting reluctance is under way with results expected mid-2017.
Whether or not to file a complaint is therefore not an end in itself but must be seen within a broader package of means available to the victim.
Het al dan niet doen van aangifte is dan ook niet een doel op zich maar moet worden gezien in een breder pakket van middelen die ter beschikking van het slachtoffer staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Van Nispen en Karabulut over de aanhouding van demonstranten wegens belediging

Three SP MPs asked the Justice Minister whether arrests at a November 2016 demonstration for detained Kurdish parliamentarians were made for insult, how the decisions were taken, what the insults were, whether local authorities banned slogans, whether arrestees will be prosecuted, and whether protest rights are protected. The minister answered that one person was arrested for refusing to hand over a sign reading 'Erdogan Terrorista' with a Hitler-moustache image, which the Public Prosecution Service deemed insulting, that seven others were arrested for violence, that no slogan ban is known, that prosecution of the violence arrestees is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that freedom of expression is not absolute.
The Public Prosecution Service deemed this expression punishable as insult (article 266 of the Criminal Code).
Het Openbaar Ministerie oordeelde deze uiting als strafbaar (belediging, artikel 266 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over matchfixing

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about a Slovenian match-fixer caught at Schiphol with EUR 75,000 cash, whether the Slovenian conviction is final, whether he is suspected of match-fixing in the Netherlands, and what new insights the case gives. The Justice minister answered that the FIOD found no signs of match-fixing in the Netherlands, that the information was shared with Europol and Interpol, that the man was convicted in Slovenia and in the Netherlands for laundering the cash, and that further details cannot be given because the investigation continues.
I cannot make further statements about this, because this information is still the subject of further investigation.
Ik kan hierover geen nadere mededelingen doen, omdat deze informatie nog onderwerp is van verder onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de geheime moskeelijst van het kabinet

Two MPs asked whether a list of mosques and Islamic organisations receiving Saudi funding exists, why parliament was allegedly misinformed, and whether anything is being withheld. The government refers to earlier answers on the matter, says there is nothing further it is withholding, and states that the overview was shared confidentially with parliament.
The cabinet has shared the relevant overview with your House on a confidential basis.
Het kabinet heeft het betreffende overzicht vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Nispen over de asbestzaak in Dodewaard

MPs Smaling and Van Nispen asked how hundreds of visitors to an event in a contaminated former brick factory in Dodewaard were exposed to asbestos in 2011, why the building was not closed, and whether the Public Prosecution Service was fully informed. The government called the exposure reprehensible, said the owners were convicted, explained the closure and communication history, and said it had asked the municipality and province to inform visitors jointly.
The answer to how large the chance of actual health problems is depends on the specific circumstances of the case.
Het antwoord op de vraag hoe groot de kans is dat daadwerkelijke gezondheidsproblemen ontstaan, is afhankelijk van de specifieke omstandigheden van het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht ‘Meldingen kinderporno dit jaar verdubbeld’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that child pornography notifications had doubled, the reasons for the rise, prevention, prosecution figures, trauma expertise and police digital capacity. The minister attributed the rise mainly to Dutch internet infrastructure and reporting volume rather than a confirmed increase in material, gave prosecution statistics and described prevention, care and prioritisation measures without announcing new measures.
At this moment I have received no signals from this reporting that would require additional measures.
Op dit moment hebben mij geen signalen bereikt naar aanleiding van deze berichtgeving extra maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het door nabestaanden opvragen van onderzoeksdossiers

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether bereaved relatives doubting a cause of death should be entitled to a copy of the (possibly anonymised) investigation file, and under what conditions copies are given. The minister answered that files are normally offered for inspection first, copies are assessed case by case balancing third-party privacy, and a broader entitlement is not planned, though the OM is reviewing clearer options for second opinions and will report by summer 2017.

Providing complete investigation files to relatives, whether or not anonymised, will always require an individual assessment because of the weighing of interests described above and the OM's responsibility toward third-party interests in society.

Een verstrekking van complete – al dan niet geanonimiseerde -onderzoeksdossiers aan nabestaanden, zal vanwege de hierboven geschetste belangenafwegingen en de verantwoordelijkheden van het OM ten aanzien van belangen van derden binnen de samenleving, altijd om een individuele beoordeling blijven vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over geregistreerde meldingen en incidenten op en rondom COA-opvanglocaties

An MP asked why COA-registered aggression incidents at asylum reception centres far exceed the number of police reports and criminal complaints, and asked about the nationalities involved, refused residence permits and deportations. The State Secretary explained that COA registers all incidents, that not every report leads to a complaint or prosecution, that nationality data cannot reliably be linked to incidents, and that the average IND processing time for safe-country applicants was ten days.
I cannot rule out that there were cases involving material damage or a victim where no complaint was filed or no prosecution was instituted.
Ik kan niet uitsluiten dat er gevallen zijn waarbij er wel materiële schade of een benadeelde was, maar geen aangifte is gedaan of vervolging is ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Gesthuizen, Sjoerdsma, Voortman, Van der Staaij en Thieme over uitlevering van verdachten aan Rwanda

MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether the extradition of two Rwandan-national suspects should be reconsidered in light of testimony from Witteveen about Rwandan courts, fair-trial risks and the Bandora case, and whether a broader extradition inquiry should be conducted. The minister refused to revisit the decision, stating Witteveen's findings were already weighed, the Court of Appeal found no real fair-trial risk, and the two men were extradited on 12 November 2016.
I see no reason to revisit the decision regarding the extradition.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de beslissing ten aanzien van de uitlevering te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over terreursteun voor Rotterdamse salafistenschool

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a Qatari charity linked to terrorism financed a Rotterdam salafist school, whether its foundations should be dissolved, and whether salafist schools and foreign funding should be banned. Minister Plasterk answered that the property was bought with Qatari funds but that the organisation is not on Dutch, EU or UN sanctions lists, that dissolution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, and that the government will address foreign funding in a letter in November.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether there are facts and circumstances that give cause to file a request with the court for civil prohibition or dissolution under art. 2:20 BW.

Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of er feiten en omstandigheden aanwezig zijn die aanleiding vormen om een verzoek tot civielrechtelijke verbodenverklaring of ontbinding ex art. 2:20 BW bij de rechtbank in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Tongeren over de term ‘verkooppraatje’ bij het opleggen van een bijzondere voorwaarde aan een veroordeelde

MPs Van Nispen and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Justice about the term 'verkooppraatje' used when imposing a special probation condition on a convicted offender, and why the government's letters of 31 August and 27 September 2016 appeared to conflict. The Minister answered that the statements are not contradictory: the August letter concerned the Public Prosecution Service's interpretation of the recordings, while the September letter concerned the words actually used, which both sides agree included 'verkooppraatje' by one advocate-general.
There was also then no difference of view between Van der G.'s lawyer and the OM that the word 'verkooppraatje' was used during the conversation of 17 September 2015.
Er bestond ook toen geen verschil van inzicht tussen de advocaat van Van der G. en het OM dat het woord «verkooppraatje» tijdens gesprek van 17 september 2015 is gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘OM wraakt rechtbank’

The MP asks the Justice Minister about the public prosecution service (OM) seeking to recuse three Almelo judges in a drugs case, and whether scheduling ignored the prosecutor's availability. The minister answers that the recusal was rejected, that the OM rarely uses this power, that scheduling is a judge's call, and that a planning improvement taskforce is underway.
I cannot give insight into aspects related to the OM's procedural position in an ongoing criminal case.
Ik kan geen inzage geven in aspecten samenhangende met de procespositie van het OM in een lopende (straf)zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Volp over het voorkomen van seksueel misbruik in de zorg

MPs Bruins Slot and Volp asked why the Public Prosecution Service (OM) had apparently not shared with the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) a conviction of a healthcare worker for a serious sexual offence committed in private, and how the procedure works. The minister replied that the OM has informed the IGZ only once since July 2015, that the OM does not register professions, that the protocol is considered sufficiently watertight with no known failures, and that no retroactive review will be ordered.
I currently have no indications that the arrangement set out in the Cooperation Protocol is not watertight.
Ik heb op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat de regeling die nu in het Samenwerkingsprotocol is verwoord niet sluitend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat 200 mensen aangehouden zijn bij de intocht van Sinterklaas

MP Kuzu asked the Justice and Interior ministers about the arrest of about 200 anti-Zwarte Piet demonstrators, the Rotterdam city-centre demonstration ban, the emergency order, police conduct and the broader Zwarte Piet debate. The minister answered that the police offered to escort the group to Maassluis but they chose to go to central Rotterdam, that the mayor's ban was justified for public order, and that complaints about police force can be filed with the police or courts, while the Zwarte Piet tradition is a matter for society and broadcasters.
The mayor of Rotterdam committed in the council debate of 17 November 2016 to evaluate the events surrounding the arrests for the council.
De burgemeester van Rotterdam heeft in het raadsdebat van 17 november 2016 toegezegd aan de raad de gebeurtenissen omtrent de aanhoudingen te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de gemeenschap die deels opdraait voor schade door krakers
