An MP asks why Utrecht municipality and police settled with squatters for EUR 37,500 instead of the nearly EUR 60,000 damage awarded, and whether taxpayers should bear part of the cost. The minister explains the settlement was a deliberate procedural choice given costs, delays and the squatters' inability to pay, while stating that full recovery of damages remains the aim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Oosenbrug over de mobiele bereikbaarheid in Nederland

MPs Agnes Mulder (CDA) and Oosenbrug (PvdA) asked the ministers about poor mobile coverage in dozens of villages, regional differences, municipal antenna permitting, and reports of 112 emergency calls failing. The minister answered that coverage is generally very good, that municipalities and operators share responsibility for local improvements, that Agentschap Telecom offers technical help, and that the national government has no power to override a municipal refusal of an antenna permit.
The national government has no possibility to overturn such a decision by a municipality.
De rijksoverheid heeft geen mogelijkheden om een dergelijk besluit van een gemeente te verwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de campagne ‘zet een streep door discriminatie’

An MP asks the Interior Minister whether he will remove Giel Beelen from the government anti-discrimination campaign spot after Beelen's racist remarks, and whether the government's refusal condones discrimination. The minister answers that discrimination is unacceptable, the spot is no longer broadcast, Beelen has apologised, and the matter is not for the cabinet to decide.
The matter is not for the cabinet to decide.
De zaak is niet ter beslissing voor het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder over het bericht “Asielkraak kost goud”

PVV MPs Fritsma and Helder asked why a group of undocumented migrants squatting buildings in Amsterdam has not been deported or stopped, and whether squatting bans and bed-bath-and-bread provision will be enforced or ended. The State Secretary replied that deportation depends on cooperation from countries of origin, that evictions of such squats have been carried out and upheld in court, that the financial compensation to municipalities for bed-bath-and-bread will be stopped, but refused an asylum stop while announcing targeted measures.
I informed your House on 21 November that I am ending the financial compensation for the bed, bath and bread provisions offered by municipalities.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 21 november geïnformeerd dat ik de financiële vergoeding voor de door gemeenten geboden bed, bad en broodvoorzieningen stopzet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het artikel ‘Nederlands overnamerecord: topman NXP pakt 380 miljoen’

MPs Klein asked whether the NXP CEO's roughly 380 million euro gain from his shares and options on the takeover is fair, and whether the claw-back rule for takeover bonuses works as intended. The minister answered that the government does not set executive pay in private companies, that the gain is accrued value rather than a payout, that the claw-back rule's evaluation is pending, and that the rule applies only to companies listed on a European exchange.
In the government's reaction to the evaluation of the claw-back rule in article 2:135(7) of the Civil Code, the geographic scope of the rule will be considered.
In de kabinetsreactie op de evaluatie van de afroomregeling van artikel 2:135 lid 7 BW zal de geografische reikwijdte worden betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Verhoeven over de zeer hoge uitkering aan de topman van NXP bij de verkoop van het bedrijf

MPs Gesthuizen and Verhoeven asked whether the reported USD 428 million payout to NXP's chief executive from the company's sale, and the risks of such exorbitant pay, were acceptable, and whether the clawback rules and NXP subsidies would be reviewed. The minister, on behalf of the economic affairs minister, declined to judge the amount, said pay assessment is for shareholders and the company, referred to earlier answers on clawback and subsidies, and gave no new commitments.
I have no opinion on the amount reported in the media that the NXP chief executive would keep from the takeover if he exercised his options and sold his shares.
Ik heb geen oordeel over de in de media genoemde hoogte van het bedrag dat de uitvoerend bestuurder van NXP zou overhouden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Oosten over het bericht ‘Aantal dumpingen drugsafval afgelopen jaren gestegen’

MPs Dijkstra and Van Oosten asked the Minister of Justice and Security about rising drug-waste dumping and whether many incidents go unreported and unpunished. The Minister acknowledges unreported cases, points to integrated regional approaches and the LFO specialist unit, and says cost recovery from offenders cannot be fully reported from existing systems.
No complete overview of cases in which suspects were convicted for dumping drug waste, and of the costs recovered from them, can be generated from the registration systems of the OM and the police.

Uit de registratiesystemen van het OM en de politie is geen volledig overzicht te genereren van zaken waarin verdachten zijn veroordeeld voor het dumpen van drugsafval en de eventueel op hen verhaalde kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Bergkamp, Koser Kaya en Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Politie heeft geen zicht op dumpingen drugsafval’

Four D66 MPs asked the ministers whether police and partner agencies have sufficient visibility and capacity over illegal dumping and discharge of synthetic drug waste, given a report that many dumpings go undetected and carry health and environmental risks. The government answered that dumping is difficult to detect, that enforcement focuses on production, that regional protocols and projects are being developed, and that it sees no need for additional research, controls or a national approach.
At this moment I see no reason for additional actions.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullende acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat moslims steeds vaker slachtoffer zijn van discriminatie vanwege hun geloof

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the ministers about reports that Muslims are increasingly victims of religious discrimination, including the rise in reported incidents, the effects of terrorism and rhetoric by politicians, possible measures, and a registry of cases and sentences. The government answered that discrimination is unacceptable, pointed to the 2015 discrimination report and the Nationaal Actieprogramma, and gave incident counts for 2013-2015 while declining a separate racism police force and taking no firm new measures beyond awaiting a study on triggers.
On the basis of this report, I want to examine, after consulting relevant partners, where efforts to combat Muslim discrimination can be further strengthened.
Op basis van deze rapportage wil ik, na overleg met betrokken partners, nagaan waar de inzet op het bestrijden van moslimdiscriminatie verder versterkt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de uitzending van Brandpunt over verborgen vrouwen

An MP asked the government about a broadcast on women confined to their homes, whether the number of such women is known, how they are informed, which organisations and Veilig Thuis are involved, and whether they can be helped toward education. The minister answered that the number is unknown and not pursued further, committed to providing information to relevant parties, and pointed to municipalities and existing participation and education programmes.
The number of women who are forcibly confined in their homes is not known.
Het aantal vrouwen dat gedwongen vastzit in huis is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de samenwerking tussen Belastingdienst en OM bij het afpakken van crimineel vermogen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked whether cooperation between the Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the Tax Authority on seizing criminal assets is still insufficient, whether OM's claim that Tax Authority referrals are declining is accurate, how the AAFD protocol is implemented, and what measures will be taken, including OM's suggestions for a training course and wider use of the Afpak-app. The minister rejects the claim of declining cooperation, describes the protocol procedures, RIEC and regional examples, says the Afpak-app is available and that no further measures are needed, while committing only to continued dialogue and attention to a regional contact point and best practices.
I do not recognise the picture that cooperation in this area between the Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the Tax Authority is declining.
Ik herken mij niet in het beeld dat de samenwerking op dit terrein tussen het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en de Belastingdienst terugloopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over de berichten ‘Curator stapt vaker de ring in’ en ‘Pandrechten leiden tot meer rechtszaken bij faillissement’

Two MPs asked whether creditors, especially banks holding pledges, are unfairly privileged in bankruptcy, whether curators are pressured, and whether shareholders misuse bankruptcy to take over assets and shed staff. The minister answered that pledge holders have legitimate priority under existing law, that worker protections exist via UWV, that curators have a central role in any doorstart, and that the issues will be addressed in the forthcoming WCO III bill after consultation with interest groups.
Within the bankruptcy law review programme, work is underway on a proposal for the Business Continuity Act III (WCO III).
Binnen het programma herijking faillissementsrecht wordt gewerkt aan een voorstel voor de wet continuïteit ondernemingen III (de WCO III).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het niet behandelen van aangiften van discriminatie door het Openbaar Ministerie

MP Marcouch asked the Justice Minister why roughly three quarters of discrimination complaints are not handled by the Public Prosecution Service, how this fits the Aanwijzing Discriminatie, and whether a planned revision lowers expectations. The minister answered that most complaints never reach the OM for evidential or other reasons, acknowledged that two cases were left unhandled through an omission, and said the Aanwijzing is being revised because it expires, not to lower standards.
That this did not happen in two cases mentioned in the RTL Nieuws report is an omission with no policy considerations behind it.
Dat dit niet is geschied in twee in het bericht van RTL Nieuws genoemde zaken is een omissie waaraan geen beleidsoverweging ten grondslag heeft gelegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Miltenburg en Van Oosten over het bericht 'OM kan aangiften discriminatie niet aan, slechts kwart behandeld'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers about a report that prosecutors cannot handle discrimination complaints and only a quarter are processed, and how this fits the government's call to report discrimination. The minister confirmed the figures, said police must record all discrimination complaints under the Aanwijzing Discriminatie, admitted no verified explanation exists for the decline, and pledged to keep discrimination prosecution a priority while noting measures to raise reporting rates.
Yes, I share that view and I have also expressed my concerns about this to the Chair of the College of Procurators-General.
Ja, die mening deel ik en ik heb hierover ook mijn zorgen geuit aan de voorzitter van het College van Procureurs-Generaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat slechts een kwart van de aangiften van discriminatie in behandeling wordt genomen door het openbaar ministerie

An MP asked the ministers about reports that only a quarter of discrimination complaints reach the public prosecution service, and what is being done to raise reporting and improve handling, including online discrimination. The government denies the figures as stated, says it shares concern about reporting and is reviewing the Discrimination Directive with police and OM, but refuses a racism register, a racism police unit, and dedicated extra budget, pointing to existing action programmes.
For an explanation of this, I refer to the answer to questions 2 and 3 from Member Marcouch.
Voor een verklaring hiervoor verwijs ik naar het antwoord op de vragen 2 en 3 van het lid Marcouch
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Jacobi over de belangenverstrengeling bij commerciële stichtingen die consumenten zouden moeten helpen bij collectieve schaderegelingen

MPs Mei Li Vos and Jacobi asked whether the governance of claim foundations representing consumers in mass-damage cases is adequate, given research showing most do not comply with the voluntary Claimcode, and whether a Consumer Ombudsman should be created. The minister acknowledged the non-compliance, said a bill would make certain Claimcode requirements legal admissibility conditions for collective actions, and declined to create a Consumer Ombudsman for now, citing the private-enforcement primacy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het beveiligingsteam van de Oranjes een bende is

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the security team protecting the royal family (Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen) was a clique, including unrest, a corruption probe, workload and training. The minister answered that an external culture study led to improvement measures, the head of the service stepped down, and the report would be shared confidentially with parliament.
The investigation report concerns an internal study aimed at addressing the underlying causes of the signals of unrest and dissatisfaction within the Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen.
Het onderzoeksrapport betreft een intern onderzoek met als doel om de achterliggende oorzaken van de signalen van onrust en onvrede binnen de Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Beveiligingsteam Oranjes bende”

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about press reports of a toxic atmosphere and alleged corruption in the Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen, including a whistleblower on leave for 17 months. The minister answered that an external culture investigation and an internal integrity inquiry were under way, that the head of the service is stepping down, and that the whistleblower was on leave for five months and the investigation is careful rather than fast.
Following the report, the current head of the Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen, in consultation with the police chief, has decided to make his position available.
Naar aanleiding van het rapport heeft het huidige hoofd van de Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen in goed overleg met de politiechef besloten dat hij zijn functie beschikbaar stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bestaan van verschillende uittreksels van justitiële documentatie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a sepot-01 (dismissal for lack of evidence of the suspect's involvement) that was wrongly recorded in criminal records, and whether such dismissals should be excluded from extracts and the compensation rights of those affected. The Minister said dismissals of this kind are excluded from justitiële documentatie by design, that the sepot-01 entry was an erroneous re-delivery corrected in 2013, and that victims can still seek damages via the civil courts.

Because a sepot 01 is not included in the justitiële documentatie, this fact cannot play a role in, for example, sentencing in a subsequent criminal case or the issuing of a certificate of conduct (VOG).
Doordat een sepot 01 niet in de justitiële documentatie wordt opgenomen, kan dit gegeven geen rol spelen bij bijvoorbeeld de straftoemeting in een navolgende strafzaak of de afgifte van een VOG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Swinkels en Recourt over mediation in het strafrecht

MPs asked why funding for mediation in criminal cases ran out, halting new referrals after 28 October 2016, and how the government would meet article 51h of the Code of Criminal Procedure without it. The minister answered that the pilots were evaluated, a national scheme costs about €1.5 million a year, no structural funds were found, and restorative mediation remains possible through a subsidised victim-offender scheme.
There will simply no longer be money available for it from my budget.
Er zal alleen geen geld meer beschikbaar voor zijn vanuit mijn begroting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de kosten van extra veiligheidsmaatregelen rond de Amerikaanse ambassade in Wassenaar

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice who bears the costs of extra security around the new US embassy in Wassenaar and whether the municipality is liable for unforeseen measures. The minister replied that under the 2015 circular the costs are borne locally, the mayor is responsible for public-order security measures, and the matter is a local affair on which he has already spoken with the mayor.
Designating these objects does not mean that the Minister of Security and Justice is therefore also responsible for financing these measures.
Het aanwijzen van genoemde objecten brengt niet met zich mee dat de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie daarmee ook verantwoordelijk is voor de financiering van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Oosten over de kwaliteit van forensische artsen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Oosten asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the quality of forensic doctors, citing claims that non-natural deaths and abuse are often missed by treating doctors and that forensic work is done on the side. The minister acknowledged the knowledge gap among treating doctors, said the profession is primarily responsible for quality, and pointed to ongoing steps including a NFI review of lijkschouw and the Hoes committee report due at year end.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Tsunami van jihadisten’

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of a possible wave of ISIS fighters returning to Europe, asking whether the government is worried, how returnees will be handled, and whether borders should be closed to stop them. The minister answered that returnees are treated as a security risk and are interviewed, prosecuted where possible, and assessed in local case meetings, but that fully sealing the borders is neither practically nor legally possible, so intensified controls are used instead.
This question gives the impression that it would be practically or legally possible to hermetically seal the Dutch borders and thereby easily eliminate all risks to society.
Deze vraagstelling wekt de indruk dat het praktisch of juridisch mogelijk zou zijn de Nederlandse grenzen hermetisch af te sluiten en zo eenvoudig alle risico’s voor de samenleving weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Swinkels over het bericht dat de politie foto’s neemt van personen en hun identiteitsbewijzen in Apeldoorn

MPs Verhoeven and Swinkels (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police photographing people and their identity documents in Apeldoorn, and whether this is lawful under the Wet politiegegevens and consistent with the National Ombudsman's findings. The Minister answered that such photography is permitted when necessary for police tasks, that storage is kept brief and deleted at end of shift, that the practice is being replaced by the MEoS scanning app, and that he accepts the Ombudsman's view that automatic deletion should be the aim, while answering late.
The making of photos of identity documents becomes unnecessary with the introduction of MEoS.
Het maken van foto’s van identiteitsbewijzen wordt door de invoering van MEoS overbodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het door het openbaar ministerie negeren van de wens van ouders van misbruikte kinderen

An MP asks the Justice Minister why police and prosecutors do not systematically notify parents or guardians when images of their abused children reappear in new sex-crime cases, and whether a US-style notification system will be adopted. The minister replies that notification is case-by-case and victim-centred, that a systematic US-style model is not desirable, and describes existing Dutch and Interpol image databases.
Structurally notifying victims, as in the American model, is not something I consider desirable.
Het structureel notificeren van slachtoffers, zoals in het Amerikaanse model, acht ik niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het bericht “Duitse privacywaakhond verbiedt datadelen WhatsApp”

An MP asked the State Secretary about a German privacy regulator's order to Facebook to stop processing WhatsApp users' data and whether it affects Dutch data sharing, and asked whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority had contacted its German counterpart. The government answered that it cannot comment on Dutch consequences, that Facebook has appealed the German order to the Hamburg court, and that the Dutch authority is in contact with EU counterparts and the Article 29 group sent a joint letter to WhatsApp.
No statements can be made about this.
Hierover kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het niet inzetten van registertolken bij de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst en de Nationale Politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the failure to use registered sworn interpreters at the IND and police, the use of unsworn interpreters and short interrogations, and oversight by courts. The Minister said the Wbtv permits exceptions, that the legal framework and court review suffice, and that the Raad voor de Rechtspraak will be asked to address stricter control of registered interpreter use.
I will bring the aspect of the mandatory use of registered interpreters and the recording of deviating use to the attention of the Raad voor de Rechtspraak.
Ik zal het aspect van het verplichte gebruik van geregistreerde tolken en het vastleggen van een afwijkend gebruik bij de Raad voor de Rechtspraak onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de openbare gegevens in het kadaster

MP Bashir asked ministers about publicly accessible personal data in the Kadaster after a broadcast showed how easily identity numbers and marriage details could be obtained. The minister defends the openness of the registers for legal certainty, notes that searching by person requires a subscription or written request, and says the government will review the balance with privacy and safety and consult the Dutch Data Protection Authority.

I will therefore consult with the Kadaster to examine whether the current balance between accessibility in the interest of legal certainty on the one hand and protection of personal data, including security aspects, on the other is still appropriate.

Ik zal daarom in overleg met het Kadaster bezien of de huidige balans tussen toegankelijkheid in het belang van de rechtszekerheid enerzijds en bescherming van de persoonsgegevens inclusief veiligheidsaspecten anderzijds nog steeds passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Groot over een datalek bij de Belastingdienst

MPs Oosenbrug and Groot asked about a data leak at the Tax Authority in which taxpayer data on CD-ROMs was sent to the wrong tax consultant, and whether affected taxpayers should have been informed. State Secretary Wiebes answered that the leak was reported to the Dutch DPA, that the risk was low so individual notification was not required, and that the Tax Authority tightened checks and is digitising the extension process.
The scope of the data leak is not exactly known.
De omvang van het datalek is niet exact bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het door derden onttrekken van gegevens aan het WOZ-waardeloket

Gesthuizen (SP) asked whether third parties are harvesting WOZ property valuation data from the WOZ-waardeloket for commercial purposes, whether this is allowed under Article 40a Wet WOZ, how it is monitored and prevented, and whether access could be restricted via DigiD. Minister Plasterk answered that automated bulk extraction is not permitted, that anti-scraping safeguards and monitoring by the Kadaster are in place, but that full prevention is not feasible without undermining transparency, and that the government will decide on bulk provision after evaluation and a working group is examining further openness.
It is indeed not permitted to extract data from the WOZ-waardeloket in an automated manner.
Het is inderdaad niet toegestaan om op geautomatiseerde wijze gegevens aan het WOZ-waardeloket te onttrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Swinkels naar aanleiding van de antwoorden op eerdere vragen over het bericht dat een terreurverdachte op het vliegveld naar Turkije kon stappen

MPs Pechtold and Swinkels asked why Dutch authorities responded slowly to a German alert about terror suspect Martijn N. in February 2016, and why no arrest warrant followed sooner. The Minister answers that a technical phone fault at the SIRENE bureau delayed the report until 29 February, after which a European arrest warrant was issued the same day, and that he cannot discuss the interventions further for reasons of the criminal investigation.
In the interest of the criminal investigation, I cannot go further into the interventions deployed in this case.
Ik kan in het belang van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek niet nader ingaan op de ingezette interventies in voorliggende casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over dubieuze spelersmakelaars in het voetbal

An MP asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about dubious football player agents who take money from parents with false promises, and what rules govern agents. The government answered that no other signals had been received, that only KNVB-registered intermediaries may act, that a quality mark is in development, and that a fraud complaint has been filed and will be investigated by police.
Only persons registered with the KNVB as intermediaries may also act as such.
Uitsluitend personen die bij de KNVB staan geregistreerd als intermediair mogen ook als zodanig optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over meer bevoegdheden om raddraaiers beter te kunnen oppakken

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and mayors should gain new powers, such as preventive detention or 24-hour administrative holding, to take troublemakers off the streets before public order is disrupted. The minister answered that existing powers (administrative holding, emergency ordinances, area bans, criminal law) are sufficient, that the Zaanstad mayor already restored order with current tools, and that no expansion is planned.
No, there are sufficient other options to restore order and calm, see the previous answers.
Nee, er zijn voldoende andere mogelijkheden om de orde en rust te herstellen, zie de vorige antwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een integriteitsonderzoek binnen de Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen

MP Van Raak asks whether an internal investigation into integrity complaints at the Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen is commercial, whether its leadership and culture are examined, and whether its investigators have personal ties to officers, raising doubts about objectivity. The Minister confirms the study covers leadership and culture, that an external training and advisory firm conducts it following procurement rules, and that one investigator has a police background, with the works council and union informed and sitting on a supervisory committee.
One of the investigators has a police background and therefore knows people within the police organisation.
Een van de onderzoekers heeft een politieachtergrond en kent daardoor mensen binnen de politieorganisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat drie moskeeën zijn aangevallen

An MP asked ministers about reports that three mosques were attacked, the security of Islamic buildings, the rise in anti-Muslim incidents and whether protection should match that for Jewish sites. The government answered that violence against mosques is unacceptable, that compensation would be sought through civil or criminal channels, that no generic preventive measures are advised at present, and that an anti-discrimination action programme and a working group on mosque security are in place.
Violence against Muslims and mosques is unacceptable.
Geweld tegen moslims en moskeeën is onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Rotterdam omtrent het niet toepassen van jeugdstrafrecht

An MP asked the Minister about a Rotterdam court ruling that declined to apply juvenile criminal law because suitable housing and help for the suspect might not be arranged in time, and asked how treatment delays for young offenders would be addressed. The government acknowledges the concern, says municipalities are responsible for youth care, and points to a monitoring study, knowledge-sharing efforts, a VNG tool, and a commitment to inform parliament in spring 2017.
I am aware of the signals about cases where too much time passes between the ruling and the start of treatment/youth care
Ik ken de signalen over zaken waarin te veel tijd zit tussen de uitspraak en de start van de behandeling/jeugdhulp
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de implementatie van de Wet Precursoren voor Explosieven

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Security and Justice why explosive precursors such as acetone and hydrogen peroxide could be bought easily in shops after a TV investigation, and how implementation of the new precursor law is being supervised. The Minister replies that the products are legitimately sold, that reporting duties apply to suspicious transactions, that an awareness campaign and advisory materials exist, and that the ILT has not yet received signals on effectiveness or used its audit powers.
These instruments were handed over on 18 November 2015 and made available to all other EU member states to strengthen implementation of the EU Regulation at European level as well.
Deze instrumenten zijn op 18 november 2015 overgedragen en beschikbaar gesteld aan alle overige EU lidstaten om de uitvoering van de EU Verordening ook op Europees niveau te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht dat dat de Kinderombudsman wordt bedreigd vanwege haar mening over Zwarte Piet

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about reports that the Children's Ombudsman was threatened over her views on Zwarte Piet, and about discrimination children experience and whether the tradition breaches the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. The government condemned the threats, said security measures are taken when needed without detailing them, declined to take a cabinet position on Zwarte Piet, and offered facilitation of dialogue plus a planned new research study.
However, I cannot provide information about the content of any security measures.
Ik kan echter geen informatie verstrekken over inhoud van eventuele beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over vechtende voetbalhooligans

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister about secret fights between football hooligans, whether they resemble the 1997 Beverwijk fight in which a man died, and whether clubs share responsibility. The minister says the scale is unknown but appears limited to a few incidents, that the fights are less comparable to Beverwijk, that clubs should take a stand, and that participants commit a crime.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de uitzending van De Monitor over “verwarde personen”

Christian Democrat MP Bruins Slot asked the ministers of Health and Justice about a De Monitor broadcast on confused persons, the police plan to stop transporting and holding such persons from 1 January 2017, the legal basis for police cell detention, the readiness of municipalities and mental health providers, and the availability of assertive community treatment teams. The minister answered that the police will phase out this role in 2017, that no full coordinated approach will be in place by 1 January 2017, and that a Schakelteam and ZonMw funding will support municipalities until 2018.

That the police want to stop holding confused persons in cells from 1 January and transporting them during 2017 when they have committed no offence is in line with the recommendations of the Confused Persons Task Force.

Dat de politie per 1 januari wil stoppen met de opvang in cellen en in de loop van 2017 met het vervoer van verwarde personen die geen strafbaar feit hebben gepleegd, is in lijn met de aanbevelingen van het Aanjaagteam Verwarde Personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Fokke over het bericht dat de politie in Maastricht een incident met drie drag queens niet serieus genomen zou hebben

MPs Marcouch and Fokke asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in Maastricht failed to act seriously when three drag queens were harassed by youths, and how such incidents are handled. The minister replied that questions about the local case belong with the mayor, noted that police are willing to discuss perceived bias, and said a meeting took place between police and COC Maastricht.
Specific questions about the incident in Maastricht can therefore be put to the local authority.
Specifieke vragen over het genoemde voorval in Maastricht kunnen dan ook worden gesteld aan het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat door de lange wachttijd bellers van de politielijn massaal afhaken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why callers to the police non-emergency line are abandoning calls due to long waits and whether this is acceptable. The minister acknowledged the reports, said the police are working on short- and long-term measures to improve the line's availability, and described steps taken on staffing with temporary and permanent hires.
The number 0900 8844 is intended for non-urgent contacts.
Het nummer 0900 8844 is bedoeld voor niet spoedeisende contacten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over problemen in een Zaandamse wijk

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about intimidation of a film crew and criminal disturbances in the Poelenburg district of Zaandam, including reports to police, arrests, and whether the situation is representative. The minister answered that 40 reports and 21 arrests related to the unrest were recorded over three months, that the local authority acted decisively, and that the district is not representative of the whole neighbourhood.
I do not make statements about reports by individual persons or parties.
Over aangiftes van individuele personen of partijen doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Rechters slap met misbruik’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a newspaper report claiming judges impose lenient sentences for child sexual abuse, with few prison terms and rare professional bans, and whether minimum sentences or sentencing guidelines should be introduced. The minister answered that a meeting with the Public Prosecution Service, the judiciary and the National Rapporteur will discuss how the rapporteur's recommendations can contribute, and that the Chamber will be informed of the outcome.
I will inform the Chamber of my response to the report and of the outcome of this meeting.
Ik zal uw Kamer berichten over mijn reactie op het rapport en over de uitkomsten van deze bijeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Albert de Vries Albert over spoedeisende medische zorg op zee

MPs Vermue and Albert de Vries asked the ministers of Health and of Justice and Security about emergency medical care at sea, including whether the Zeeland provincial government's concerns are shared and whether a RIVM norm for sea rescue should be developed. Minister Schippers replied that the government is examining with the Infrastructure minister what sea medical care can learn from land care, with a response on the Safety Board report promised before year end, and she set out existing maritime rescue care norms and the division of responsibilities.
Before the end of the year the Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment will respond on behalf of the government to the Safety Board report and send that response to the House.
Voor het einde van het jaar zal de Minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu namens de regering reageren op het rapport van de Onderzoeksraad en deze reactie aan de Kamer toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Oosenbrug over een bericht 'Sekslijst studentes verspreid op internet'

MPs Volp and Oosenbrug asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a sexual ranking list of female students circulated online, asking whether it was known, whether it is punishable, whether the student association and education institutions can sanction those responsible, and whether privacy law, criminal law, and victim support apply. The minister answered that the list is reprehensible, that the association suspended thirteen members, that institutions have sanction powers, that the Data Protection Authority may investigate on complaint, and that no police report had been filed.
I agree with you that drawing up and publicly distributing such a list is reprehensible.
Met u ben ik van mening dat het opstellen en het openbaar verspreiden van een dergelijke lijst verwerpelijk is.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat het ministerie van VWS zorgverleners aanraadt om browsers niet te updaten

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked why the Ministry of Health advised healthcare providers not to update browsers over Java plugin support ending, and whether this exposed patient data to cyberattacks. The minister explained the advice was to avoid uncontrolled updates that could break software, that responsibility lies with providers, that NCSC was not initially involved but now is, and that a solution is expected by year-end.
It is important that healthcare providers themselves weigh security against possible limits on functionality.
Het is belangrijk dat zorgverleners zelf de afweging maken tussen beveiliging en mogelijke beperking in functionaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Marcouch en Asante over een ernstig incident bij een ontgroening in Groningen

MPs Recourt, Marcouch and Asante asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a serious injury during a Groningen student hazing and whether criminal prosecution, victim reporting, and a 25,000 euro confidentiality fine clause in a student association contract are legally valid. The Minister said mistreatment is condemnable, the public prosecutor opened an ex officio investigation, the association filed a report, and the confidentiality fine is a civil, not criminal, sanction that can be contested or moderated.
While this investigation is ongoing, I will not make substantive statements.
Lopende dit onderzoek doe ik geen inhoudelijke mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de uitspraak dat een lid van een criminele motorbende in dienst mag blijven van Justitie

MP Van Toorenburg asked the Justice Minister about a Central Appeals Tribunal ruling that a civil servant who is a member of the criminal motorcycle gang Satudarah cannot be dismissed on that basis, and what the government will do about such memberships. The minister agreed that such memberships are undesirable, said he is still considering how to execute the ruling and aims to decide the objection within statutory deadlines, and noted the Public Prosecution Service is assessing whether a civil ban on outlaw motorcycle gangs is feasible.
I am still deliberating on how I can implement the ruling.
Ik beraad mij nog over de wijze waarop ik de uitspraak kan uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het bericht dat het Amerikaanse congres het veto van president Obama heeft overruled

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the US JASTA law, which overrode Obama's veto, could expose the Dutch state to liability in US courts for terrorist acts partly prepared in the Netherlands, and how the government would respond. The minister said JASTA is in tension with international law, that Dutch liability is possible in theory but depends on US court interpretation, and that the government will monitor developments and raise concerns with the US, with EU action likely after the US elections.
In theory the Netherlands could be held liable before the American court.
In theorie zou Nederland aansprakelijk gesteld kunnen worden bij de Amerikaanse rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Recourt over het bericht dat het openbaar ministerie toegang tot versleutelde informatie wil

MPs Oosenbrug and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the public prosecution service wants access to encrypted communications, and whether the government will oppose restrictions on encryption. The minister reaffirmed the unchanged cabinet position against weakening encryption, said the prosecution service prefers obtaining data via the service provider, and pointed to the Computercriminaliteit III bill and cooperation with private parties.
The cabinet's view on encryption is set out in the cabinet position of 4 January 2016. This position has not changed since.
De mening van het kabinet over versleuteling is weergegeven in het kabinetsstandpunt van 4 januari 2016. Dit standpunt is sindsdien niet veranderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over radardata m.b.t. MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russia holds raw primary radar data from the MH17 area, why it was not shared for over two years, and how the Dutch government assesses cooperation and prosecution strategy. The minister answered that Russia has promised to share the data with the JIT but has not yet handed it over, that the government has repeatedly urged full cooperation, and that prosecution options (an ad hoc tribunal or national prosecution) remain open.
For that reason we cannot inform your House in detail which information was requested or received from which party.
Om die reden kunnen wij uw Kamer niet in detail melden welke informatie van welke partij is gevraagd of gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Criminelen wijken uit naar Gelderland voor dumpen drugsafval’

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked about reports that drug waste dumping is shifting to Gelderland and why few people claim from the co-financing fund for cleanup costs, and whether the fund could pay faster or a higher share. The minister acknowledges a slight rise, explains low claim numbers (unawareness, missing documents, small amounts), refuses faster payment to keep the pro-rata system, and says talks with provinces on a higher share and a possible offender levy are ongoing.
I am in discussion with the provinces to explore the possibilities for better use of the compensation scheme.
Ik ben met de provincies in gesprek om de mogelijkheden voor betere benutting van de vergoedingsregeling te verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat Frankrijk een internationale aanpak wil op het gebied van encryptie

An MP from D66 asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Economic Affairs about France's proposal for an international approach to encryption, including whether the Netherlands received the proposals and whether weakening encryption would harm security and trust. The government confirmed it was informed of the Franco-German initiative, reaffirmed its unchanged position supporting strong encryption, and said it sees no current way to weaken encryption without compromising digital security.
The Dutch position and the considerations underlying it have been translated into English and are actively promoted internationally.
Het Nederlandse standpunt en de afwegingen die daaraan ten grondslag liggen zijn vertaald naar het Engels en worden internationaal actief uitgedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de uitzending van Argos waaruit blijkt dat Bureau Jeugdzorg Noord-Brabant niet aan waarheidsvinding doet

Member Bergkamp (D66) asked the State Secretary about a Argos broadcast claiming Bureau Jeugdzorg Noord-Brabant does not establish the truth in custody disputes, and what steps would be taken, including forensic investigation and reviewing the family guardian's role. The State Secretary replied that the statutory duty to state facts fully applies, the bureau rectified its regional director's statement, existing complaint and disciplinary routes exist, and no further action or forensic expansion is planned, while a separate advisory process on forensic research is underway.
Certified institutions are obliged to state the relevant facts fully and truthfully in reports or petitions (article 3.3 of the Youth Act).
Gecertificeerde instellingen zijn verplicht in rapportages of verzoekschriften de van belang zijnde feiten volledig en naar waarheid aan te voeren (artikel 3.3 van de Jeugdwet).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over overlast van hangjongeren in Maassluis

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police, budget cuts and the creation of the national police cause youth nuisance in Maassluis, whether police should do more, and how reports and 112 response times were handled. The minister rejects a direct causal link, says all reports (8) are being investigated under OM direction with 5 suspects arrested, and states the 15-minute response norm for emergency calls.
This week all victims will again be informed by the police about the status of their reports.
Deze week worden alle slachtoffers nogmaals door de politie op de hoogte gebracht over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot hun aangiften.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Turkse Grijze Wolven door de straten van Arnhem marcheren

MPs Karabulut asked whether an Arnhem Turkish festival parade linked to the Grey Wolves was acceptable, whether the municipality and a mosque were connected to the organisers, and whether the municipality should have known. The government answered that the parade had a folkloric character and a permit, that the municipality's only link was facilitating the festival, that free expression has limits but people are judged on conduct, and that the municipality chose to be present at the festival.
It is up to the municipality of Arnhem to decide whether it wants to be represented at a multicultural event in its municipality.
Het is aan de gemeente Arnhem om te bepalen of zij vertegenwoordigd willen zijn in een multicultureel evenement in hun gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over spanningen binnen de Turkse gemeenschap in Nederland

An MP asked ministers about attacks on a Turkish mosque and intimidation of a Kurdish family, possible cross-border involvement, and tensions between Turkish, Kurdish and Alevi communities, and what was being done about reported incidents. The minister answered that criminal investigations are ongoing and details cannot be shared, that incidents are reported to police rather than a central registry, and that dialogue meetings with community organisations continue.
In the interest of this ongoing investigation, no further substantive statements can be made.
In het belang van dit lopende onderzoek kunnen geen verdere inhoudelijke mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over bedreigingen en geweld tegen de Hizmet gemeenschap in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers about threats and violence against the Hizmet community in the Netherlands and what the government was doing to register, investigate and protect targets and to address online hate. The ministers answered that police handle criminal cases, that a special police team now collects reports, that local authorities bear primary responsibility with national support available, and that agreements exist with social media companies.
Given the large concentration of reports in the Rotterdam unit, it was decided to temporarily set up a special team at the police for this purpose.
Gezien de grote concentratie van aangiften in de eenheid Rotterdam is besloten om hiervoor tijdelijk een speciaal team in het leven te roepen bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over doodsbedreigingen aan adres Nederturken door Erdogan-aanhangers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the ministers about threats, boycott lists and demonstrations by Erdogan supporters against critical Turkish-Dutch people, and about foreign influence via Diyanet. The government condemns intimidation and refers to earlier letters, says foreign funding of mosques is not banned but is watched for undue influence, and states that Turkish-Dutch integration is a concern to be discussed with communities.
The Netherlands has no ban on foreign financing of mosque associations, general religious associations or institutions.
Nederland kent geen verbod op buitenlandse financiering van moskeeverenigingen, algemene religieuze verenigingen of instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Turkse Nederlanders en journalisten worden bedreigd

MP Karabulut asked the Dutch government about threats against Turkish-Dutch people and journalists after the 2016 Turkish coup attempt, including vandalism, boycott lists and calls by the Turkish consulate to support Erdoğan, and about integration policy. The government condemned threats, vandalism and boycott lists, said local authorities use an integrated approach, and referred to earlier letters and consultations for the rest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht dat orthodontisten vingerafdrukken afnemen

An MP asked whether orthodontists may take and store children's fingerprints and whether this breaches privacy rules. The minister answered that the practice uses finger-scan templates linked to patient numbers rather than fingerprints, that consent is required under the data protection rules, and that roughly 15 of about 200 practices use it, with the Dutch Data Protection Authority responsible for judging compliance.
It is therefore not appropriate for me to pass judgement on whether the applicable regulations are being violated.
Het past mij dan ook niet een oordeel uit te spreken over de vraag of de geldende regelgeving wordt geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Je laat je kind niet in de steek”

MP Leijten asked ministers about a newspaper report on a psychotic, addicted unemployed man left without support, asking for analysis, cost data, housing figures, and coordination between agencies. Minister Schippers acknowledged fragmented, cross-domain service delivery, stated she lacks overviews on costs and discharges without housing, and said she will urge regional parties to act but cannot resolve the individual case.
I do not have such an overview.
Ik beschik niet over een dergelijk overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over “de reactie van de minister op twee moties van het lid Klein”

MP Klein asks the Secretary of State for Safety and Justice about the government's response to two of his motions on child protection, including whether guardians' reports separate facts from opinions, whether substitute guardians threaten truth-finding in court, and whether guardians should swear an oath before the court. The Secretary of State points to a privacy/facts-and-opinions guideline, says no data exist on how often guardians are replaced, reasons that the oath was abolished as a formality without added value, and relies on the certification, registration and disciplinary system instead of reinstating the oath.
Substitution at the hearing has no effect on the report as such; the way the relevant facts are presented in it does not change when the guardian is replaced at the hearing.

Vervanging ter zitting heeft geen invloed op de rapportage als zodanig; de manier waarop daarin de van belang zijnde feiten worden aangevoerd verandert niet door vervanging van de gezinsvoogd ter zitting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat voortvluchtige criminelen ongrijpbaar zijn voor justitie in Arabische Emiraten

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister whether fugitive Dutch criminals in the UAE are beyond reach of justice due to lack of a treaty, how large the problem is, and what agreements exist or will be made. The minister disputed the scale of the problem, pointed to shared UN conventions providing an extradition basis, past extraditions, and existing cooperation talks, while promising to engage the UAE when necessary.
It is a fact that the Netherlands and the UAE are both party to various UN conventions on organised crime, drugs, terrorism and corruption, which all provide a treaty basis for extradition.

Het is een feit dat Nederland en de VAE beide partij zijn bij diverse VN-verdragen over georganiseerde criminaliteit, drugs, terrorisme en corruptie die allen een verdragsbasis bieden voor uitlevering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over de voorspelde toename van intimidatie en bedreiging van politieke bestuurders

The MP asked how threats and intimidation of political office-holders stemming from the fight against organised crime are being addressed, whether the programme has been revised, and why the minister asks parliament for extra funds. The minister answered that local government is central to the approach, that threats are dealt with firmly, that a monitoring study and a WODC study are pending, and that extra funding of 7 to 10 million euros a year plus 14 million for the Public Prosecution Service has been allocated.
I have no information available about the expected threats and intimidation.
Over de te verwachten bedreigingen en intimidaties heb ik geen informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Nispen over de convenanten met KLM en TUI ter voorkoming van recidive van drugskoeriers

MPs Van Bommel and Van Nispen asked about the convenants with KLM and TUI listing drug couriers, including legal protection, duration of listing and whether the listing amounts to extra punishment. Minister Van der Steur answered substantively on each point, describing the listing as a civil-law measure with rights of access and correction under the Wpg and Wbp and a three-year term, while stating the measure is reasonable and has few complaints.
It concerns a term that can be considered reasonable.
Het gaat om een redelijk te achten termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het gebruik van prepaidkaarten door de Minister van Defensie

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Defence Minister's use of prepaid phones for security reasons is consistent with the planned ban on anonymous prepaid SIM cards, and whether the ban would affect ministers' security protocols. The minister answered that no general ban is planned, only an investigation into mandatory registration of prepaid SIM holders, and declined to detail security protocols for security reasons.
For security reasons I will not go into the content of security protocols or rules.
Om veiligheidsredenen ga ik niet nader in op de inhoud van beveiligingsprotocollen of – regels.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Knops en Rog over de uitlatingen van de Turkse consul-generaal te Rotterdam over de Hizmet/Gülen-beweging en de invloed die Turkije uitoefent op burgers in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt, Knops and Rog asked the ministers about the Turkish consul-general in Rotterdam's remarks on the Gülen movement, pressure on Turkish-Dutch citizens, threats and the effects of the post-coup crackdown in the Netherlands. The government condemned intimidation, said Turkish authorities must not interfere with Dutch citizens' choices, noted about 175 reports and ongoing investigations, and answered the remaining questions largely by restating policy and citing ongoing proceedings.
It is unacceptable that foreign governments openly try to influence those choices.
Het is onacceptabel dat buitenlandse overheden die keuzes openlijk proberen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Hoogland over het beginnersrijbewijs

Two MPs from VVD and PvdA asked the Ministers of Justice and of Infrastructure about weak enforcement undermining the beginners' driving licence, including stops, points, and police capacity. The government reported few suspensions since 2011, admitted unrecorded cases and capacity gaps, and promised an improvement trajectory and an evaluation of the scheme.
As indicated in the covering letter, there is an improvement trajectory regarding the beginners' scheme and the scheme will be evaluated.
Zoals aangegeven in de aanbiedingsbrief is er een verbetertraject met betrekking tot de beginnersregeling en zal de regeling geëvalueerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de handhaving van het strafpuntensysteem voor beginnersrijbewijzen

An MP from D66 asked why enforcement of the penalty-point system for novice drivers appears weak, citing very few suspensions, a sharp drop in traffic stops from 2007 to 2015, and the link to road safety goals. The Minister answered that the figures refer to prosecutor notifications rather than suspensions, attributed the drop mainly to police CAO actions and shifting priorities, listed enforcement priorities for 2016–2018, and committed to informing the House further and evaluating the novice regulation.
I informed your House by letter of 18 February 2016 about various topics concerning traffic enforcement.
Antwoord 11 Ik heb uw Kamer bij brief van 18 februari 2016 2 geïnformeerd over verschillende onderwerpen op het gebied van verkeershandhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over uitwisseling van passagiersgegevens tussen EU en Canada

The SP MP Gesthuizen asked the Justice Minister how the government views the Advocate General's opinion that the EU-Canada passenger data agreement breaches fundamental rights, and what it means for the Canada and US agreements and the PNR directive. The minister declined substantive comment while the Court of Justice is still deliberating, noting the Parliament's referral under Article 218(11) TFEU, and promised to report on the Court's ruling.
I therefore refrain from a further substantive response at this time.
Ik onthoud mij daarom op dit moment van een nadere inhoudelijke reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over ‘Golf van seks zonder vergunning’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of large-scale unlicensed prostitution advertising in eastern Netherlands, asking about trafficking risks, enforcement capacity, financial coercion, policy targets and reporting of trafficking victims. The minister answered that advertising has no licence requirement, that research finds no conclusive link between regulation and trafficking, and that enforcement is handled by regional police teams, while promising a follow-up letter after the Monitor Mensenhandel part two is published.
Once these figures are available, I will inform the House of the measures I intend to take to achieve an increase in the number of registered trafficking victims in the coming period.

Zodra deze cijfers beschikbaar zijn, informeer ik uw Kamer over de maatregelen die ik voornemens ben te treffen om in de komende periode een stijging van het aantal geregistreerde slachtoffers mensenhandel te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over signalen over misstanden in de illegale prostitutie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of abuses in illegal prostitution in Eastern Netherlands, including an alleged police report, the number of unlicensed sex workers, and whether licensing and controls prevent abuse. The minister said no such report exists (only an internal memo), that prostitution is legal under conditions, that the market is shifting toward flexible internet-based forms, and that the Wrp licensing law will help regulate the sector.
There is no report from the Prostitution Control Team (PCT).
Er is geen sprake van een rapport van het Prostitutie Controle Team (PCT).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de KNVB-app makkelijk te kraken zou zijn

The MP asks whether the KNVB fingerprint-based reporting app for banned hooligans, reportedly easy to hack, remains a good tool and how it will be developed. The minister says the demonstration is not conclusive, the pilot used different technology, and an Amsterdam pilot with attention to security will be awaited, while listing other measures.
Regarding the exact means used, G4S makes no statements for security reasons.
Over de exacte gebruikte middelen doet G4S om veiligheidsredenen geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat er wederom een ernstige corruptiezaak binnen de Nationale Politie is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported corruption case involving a police commissioner, when the minister learned of it, and what action and measures would follow given it is a third such case this year. The minister confirmed being informed by the prosecution service, said the officer was suspended, stated no extra measures were currently needed beyond existing ones, and pointed to an Inspectorate report and a forthcoming WODC study due spring 2017.
This is a subject that continues to receive my attention. That is why I asked the WODC to carry out a phenomenon study
Het is een onderwerp wat blijvend mijn aandacht heeft. Daarom heb ik aan het WODC verzocht een fenomeenonderzoek uit te voeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over een Erdogan-informant bij de politie

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether police data on victims of threats linked to criticism of Erdogan was leaked to Erdogan supporters, how many such cases exist, what measures will protect victims, and whether the situation undermines the rule of law. The Minister said leaks are unacceptable, an investigation into the reported case is ongoing so no conclusions can be drawn, no similar reports are known, and any officer can take a complaint regardless of background.
If there are reasons to assume this is the case, an investigation will be launched.
Indien er redenen zijn om aan te nemen dat hier sprake van is, wordt een onderzoek ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Knops over het bericht “Nederlandse pro-Erdogan-agent lekt informatie aangifte bedreiging”

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police leaked information about a woman who filed a threat complaint against a pro-Erdogan supporter, whether she is protected, and what consequences the officer faces. The minister condemns any breach of trust, says an investigation is ongoing, and will inform parliament of any measures after its outcome.
I do not want to anticipate possible outcomes of the currently ongoing investigation.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op eventuele uitkomsten van het thans lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Swinkels, Van Tongeren en Segers over de financiering van de rechtspraak

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Security and Justice about how the judiciary is funded, including judicial independence, the role of efficiency considerations, funding for new projects and workload from new legislation, and the Warsaw declaration on objective budget criteria. The answers were referred to a separate letter ('Positionering en financiering rechtspraak', Kamerstuk 29 279, nr. 352) rather than answered in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over tekortkomingen in de bestuursstructuur van de rechterlijke organisatie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice nine questions about alleged flaws in the governance structure of the judiciary, including its effect on the bench, on judicial independence and on the minister's distance from the judiciary. The minister responded by referring to a separate letter on the positioning and financing of the judiciary, as the questions were answered there.

The written questions from MP Van Nispen (SP) to the Minister of Security and Justice on shortcomings in the governance structure of the judiciary, question number 2016Z13490, have been answered by letter 'Positioning and financing of the judiciary'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Nispen (SP) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over tekortkomingen in de bestuursstructuur van de rechterlijke organisatie , vraagnummer 2016Z13490 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «Positionering en financiering rechtspraak» (Kamerstuk 29 279, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over misleidende datingsites met valse profielen

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and Economic Affairs about dating sites using fake profiles, including whether such sites can be taken offline and how victims are supported. The government answered that the ACM can investigate and fine misleading practices but cannot take websites offline, that this power is under discussion at EU level, and that it is working with victim support organisations.
It is not possible to take websites offline, because the ACM lacks the power to do so.
Het is niet mogelijk om websites offline te halen, omdat de bevoegdheid hiertoe bij de ACM ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Marcouch over het rapport van de Nationale ombudsman

MPs Servaes and Marcouch asked ministers to respond to the National Ombudsman's report on unintended loss of Dutch nationality, including whether government informed citizens adequately and whether nationality law should change. The government largely rejects the claim of inadequate information, pointing to past campaigns and its website, promises to examine how outreach can be more active, and says it cannot yet judge the report's findings on nationality law.
On the basis of the recommendations in this report, I will examine whether that information can be made even more active and targeted.
Aan de hand van de aanbevelingen van dit rapport zal ik onderzoeken of die voorlichting nog actiever en gerichter kan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het rapport ‘Zorg tussen wal en schip’

An MP asked several ministers about the OVV report on medical assistance at sea by the Kustwacht, covering staffing, investment, coordination with healthcare, and whether the Kustwacht annual report is sent to parliament. The minister defers substantive answers on most questions to a forthcoming full response to the OVV report, providing only partial information on summer incident patterns and the state of helicopter talks.
The answer to the above questions 2, 3, 4 and 5 I will include in my response to the OVV report.
Het antwoord op bovengenoemde vragen 2, 3, 4 en 5 neem ik mee in mijn reactie op het OVV-rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over een wetsvoorstel op grond waarvan Amerikaanse burgers de Nederlandse staat zouden kunnen gaan vervolgen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the US Justice Against Sponsors of Terrorism Act could let American victims sue the Dutch state in US courts for 9/11-related harm, and how this fits with state immunity. The government answered in detail, explaining the bill's scope, its tension with international law, Dutch immunity rules, and that it has raised concerns with the US government while awaiting the bill's outcome.
The Netherlands has, however, conveyed its concerns about JASTA to the US government, together with other EU member states.
Nederland heeft evenwel de zorgen ten aanzien van JASTA kenbaar gemaakt aan de Amerikaanse regering, samen met andere EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Swinkels over het bericht “Priester vermoord bij gijzeling in kerk Normandië”

MPs Pechtold and Swinkels asked the Justice Minister whether a perpetrator of the Saint-Etienne-du-Rouvray church attack had tried twice to reach Syria, was flagged as a state threat and in the Schengen system, and how Dutch and EU rules on ankle monitoring and similar labels for terror suspects compare. The minister confirmed the French facts, said the Netherlands has no 'staatsgevaarlijk' label, described the two ankle-monitored returnees and the planned Twbmt powers, and said no uniform EU rules exist.
The Netherlands does not have the designation 'state dangerous'.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het archief van de MH17

An MP asks the government about the archiving of MH17 crisis documents, including whether emails were lost, why interview transcripts and evaluations were withheld, and the status of the JIT and prosecution strategy. The minister answers that no separate hotspot list exists, that archive transfers have not yet taken place, that interview transcripts remain confidential to protect research validity, and that some evaluations and prosecution strategy details are still in progress.
This promised confidentiality weighs very heavily for me in considering not sending the report to your House.
Deze toegezegde vertrouwelijkheid weegt voor mij zeer zwaar bij de afweging om het verslag niet aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het artikel “Ze dacht dat Nederland veilig was"

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about press reports of intimidation and threats against a human rights lawyer working with the International Criminal Court in the Netherlands, and what protection and oversight measures were taken. The government confirmed a criminal investigation has been open since February, withheld details of protection measures for security reasons, and described an activated consultation mechanism with NGOs, the Court and the host state, with follow-up meetings planned.
That investigation began in February of this year. Because of the investigation, the cabinet cannot respond with details.
Dat onderzoek is februari dit jaar begonnen. Vanwege het onderzoek kan het kabinet niet op details reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat een mensenrechtenjurist in Nederland ernstig bedreigd wordt

MP Kuzu asked whether a human rights lawyer working for al-Haq on ICC preliminary examinations of Israel and Palestine was threatened, why police initially did not take threats seriously, whether NGOs were obstructed, whether a state actor was behind the threats, and whether the Kamer would be informed of the investigation. The ministers confirmed the threats and an ongoing criminal investigation, described a consultation mechanism with the ICC and NGOs, but declined to comment on state involvement and said it is not customary to inform parliament about ongoing investigations.
It is not customary to inform the Kamer about ongoing investigations or their conclusion.
Het is niet gebruikelijk de Kamer te informeren over lopende onderzoeken of de afronding hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over mogelijk etnisch profileren van ondernemers

An MP asks several ministers whether inspection and licensing bodies may be ethnically profiling entrepreneurs through risk models, large joint enforcement teams and the 'slecht levensgedrag' licence criterion. The minister answers that ethnicity is not a selection variable, that the government opposes profiling and points to existing measures, but declines to provide lists, case-level quickscans or a fundamental investigation, pointing to municipal responsibility.
No, a list of fined companies alone cannot support any conclusion about how companies are selected.
Nee, uit alleen een overzicht van beboete bedrijven valt geen conclusie te trekken over de selectie van bedrijven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over de brief van een Nederlandse politieliaison in Thailand aan de Thaise autoriteiten getiteld “Request for initiating an investigation in Thailand” in de zaak-Van

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch consular conduct and detention conditions for Van Laarhoven in Thailand, the Thai money-laundering conviction linked to Dutch cannabis-shop revenue, and possible bias of the Dutch prosecutor. The government answered that Thailand receives extended consular assistance, that it cannot judge foreign rulings, that the Dutch prosecution is ongoing, and that no substantive irregularities were found in the investigation.
The Public Prosecution Service decides which instruments it considers necessary within an ongoing criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) bepaalt welke instrumenten het wanneer nodig acht in het kader van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Recourt, Van Nispen, Van Tongeren, Thieme, Van Klaveren, Krol, Houwers en Klein over de brief van een Nederlandse politieliaison in Thailand aan de Thaise autoriteiten

MPs asked the ministers about a 14 July 2014 letter from a Dutch liaison officer in Thailand requesting that Thai authorities open their own investigation into Van Laarhoven, and whether the Dutch government bears responsibility for his Thai prosecution. The minister answered that the request was made at the public prosecutor's request to speed up mutual legal assistance, that the courts found the state's conduct lawful, that consular assistance is provided, and that the prosecutor decides on instruments such as a transfer.
In general, cooperation with foreign authorities is not unusual when a suspect is located in another country.
In zijn algemeenheid is het niet ongebruikelijk dat samenwerking plaatsvindt met buitenlandse autoriteiten indien een verdachte zich in een ander land bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en van Dekken over de ‘Soldiers of Odin’

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked the ministers about the Soldiers of Odin group, a far-right street patrol in Winschoten, including whether a man allegedly assaulted by the group had been properly investigated and whether the police response was too lenient. The minister answered that the group is limited in size, opposes intimidation, that police investigated the injuries and the man's conduct, and that no criminal offences were yet established.
Intimidating or discriminating against groups or persons is prohibited.
Het intimideren en/of discrimineren van groepen of personen is verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat een modelagent gearresteerd is door eigen collega’s

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that a model police officer was arrested by his own colleagues and whether ethnic profiling by the police is only incidental. The minister said ethnic profiling is not systematic, that an internal investigation is underway and its results will be sent to parliament, and that a national working group on ethnic profiling exists.
An investigation into the facts and circumstances is being carried out by the Amsterdam and East Netherlands units.
Er wordt door de eenheden Amsterdam en Oost-Nederland een onderzoek ingesteld naar de feiten en de omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels en Koser Kaya over het bericht ‘Jij ziet er helemaal niet uit als een politieman!’

MPs Swinkels and Koşer Kaya asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report of a Dutch-Surinamese man's treatment by police, alleged ethnic profiling in the police (including the arrest of rapper Typhoon), measures against and training on ethnic profiling, and data on people of non-Dutch background in custody and prosecution. The minister said an internal investigation is ongoing, denied a systemic trend of ethnic profiling while acknowledging the problem, described diversity and training programmes, and declined to provide ethnicity-based statistics because such registration is not permitted.
No, I cannot provide you with such figures.
Nee, ik kan u dergelijke cijfers niet doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verlagen van de maximumvergoeding voor sociale advocatuur naar 900 punten

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the minister will still lower the maximum legal-aid fee for social lawyers to 900 points, questioning the rationale, cost savings, impact on access and income, and the proposed mixed practice. Minister Van der Steur confirmed the plan to cap points at 900 (regular) or 1,520 (complex) cases, with exceptions by the raad voor rechtsbijstand, and refused to withdraw it, though many questions were answered in part or with general reasoning.

I will propose an amendment to the Legal Aid Act that makes it possible to limit the number of points for which a legal aid provider can be assigned to 900 points (regular cases) or 1,520 points (complex cases).

Ik zal een wijziging van de Wet op de rechtsbijstand (Wrb) voorstellen die het mogelijk maakt het aantal punten waarvoor een rechtsbijstandverlener kan worden toegevoegd te beperken tot 900 punten (bij reguliere zaken) onderscheidenlijk 1.520 punten (bij bewerkelijke zaken).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Swinkels over het bericht dat een terreurverdachte op het vliegtuig naar Turkije kon stappen

MPs Pechtold and Swinkels asked the Justice Minister how a terror suspect was able to board a flight to Turkey using a Dutch identity card despite earlier being stopped, and how information sharing with EU partners failed. The minister answered that the suspect was signalled in SIS-II and Interpol systems, that the investigation into the gap is ongoing, and pointed to the proposed exit ban and passport law changes and EU information-sharing roadmap as remedies.
Because of the ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot go into further detail on the interventions deployed in this case and their effect.
Ik kan vanwege het lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek niet nader ingaan op de ingezette interventies in voorliggende casus en het effect daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de uitzending 'hoe de mysterieuze Stellar-group voetbalfamilies verleidt'

An MP asked the ministers whether they would investigate the Stellar Group's approaches to young footballers' families before the boys turn 16, and about the rules, supervision and possible new measures against child transfers. The minister answered that FIFA and the KNVB supervise the rules, that existing rules are adequate, and that no new measures are planned, while declining to say whether the Public Prosecution Service investigates.
As previously indicated to your House, the Public Prosecution Service (OM) cannot make statements about whether or not it is investigating something.
Zoals eerder aangegeven richting uw Kamer, kan het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) geen mededelingen doen over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over de voorgenomen wijziging van de Regeling verkeersregelaars
