MPs Bruins Slot and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the planned amendment of the traffic controllers regulation, including whether separate appointment decisions can be abolished, whether permits and no-objection declarations can be linked, whether the one-year validity of the instruction declaration was reviewed, and practical problems for motorcycle escorts. The Minister answered that the separate appointment decisions will be abolished and embedded in event permits, that permits and declarations cannot be coupled to traffic controller appointments, that the annual e-learning is retained for quality, and that talks with stakeholders are ongoing on the motorcycle escort issue.
The appointment of the event traffic controller will be arranged in the event permit.
De aanstelling van de evenementenverkeersregelaar wordt in de evenementenvergunning geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat het onderzoek van rioolwater vaker leidend zou kunnen zijn bij het ijken van drugsbeleid

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether sewage epidemiology could be used to calibrate drug policy and detect drug labs, and about the privacy risks of small-scale sewage research. The minister answered that local authorities decide on usefulness, no order for drug-lab detection has been given, sewage research does not fall under the Dutch data protection act in normal cases, and the safeguards in the research code are considered sufficient.
In principle the Wbp does not appear to apply to sewage research because its results cannot be traced, not even indirectly, to individual persons.
In beginsel lijkt de Wbp niet van toepassing op het rioolwateronderzoek omdat deze resultaten niet (ook niet indirect) zijn te herleiden zijn naar individuele personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Kerstens over een inbraak in de database van de gemeente Ede

MPs Oosenbrug and Kerstens asked about a hack of the Ede municipal database exposing residents' data, whether a police report was filed, the Data Protection Authority's role, municipal hack statistics, and whether a central municipal secure portal should be created. The minister confirmed a police report and ongoing investigation, declined to comment on the specific case, reported 147 municipal breach notifications in early 2016, and pointed to existing municipal cooperation and a possible KING proof of concept.
An investigation is currently ongoing. Therefore no statements can be made about this.
Er loopt momenteel een onderzoek. Derhalve kunnen hieromtrent geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Big-data experiment legt onzichtbare criminaliteit bloot’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the FinPro big-data programme in Rotterdam-Zuid, including whether the data were destroyed and why the Tax Administration did not take part. The minister answered that the project aimed to explore fraud patterns, that the data were destroyed under data-protection rules, and that participants were promised confidentiality, so the findings cannot be shared; a legal basis via a framework data-sharing law is under study.
Against that background, I cannot provide this information.
Tegen die achtergrond kan ik deze informatie niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over het bericht dat uitgebuite Roma-kinderen gered en teruggehaald zijn naar Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that exploited Roma children were rescued and returned to the Netherlands, including how children under youth protection supervision go missing, how they are sheltered, police handling and the future of a programme on exploitation of Roma children. The minister said exact numbers cannot be given for investigative reasons, outlined protection and placement options, and said the programme will end in its current form at the end of 2016 with its approaches being embedded locally.
Because of investigative interests, I make no statements about exact numbers.
Vanwege opsporingsbelang doe ik geen uitspraken over exacte aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het aanpakken van frauderende franchisegevers door OM en FIOD

An MP from the Labour party asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and of Security and Justice why the public prosecutor and FIOD declined to prosecute alleged franchise fraud, and how franchisees are protected in the pre-contractual phase, including the Dutch Franchise Code and acquisition fraud law. The minister replied that the prosecutor decided not to prosecute after investigation, that a court challenge under article 12 Sv is pending and cannot be discussed, that the Franchise Code remains self-regulation with plans for possible legislation later, and that the law on acquisition fraud is not retroactive.
I cannot say anything further about that while this procedure is still ongoing.
Ik kan daar verder niets over zeggen zolang deze procedure nog loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Swinkels over het bericht dat banken namen van vermoedelijke jihadisten krijgen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that banks receive names of suspected jihadists from FIU Nederland, including the legal basis, data protection, and redress for those listed. The minister answered that the list is compiled by the police rather than FIU Nederland, that some listings reflect suspicion and others indications, and that a temporary authorisation for a pilot exchange with banks is being prepared, after an earlier practice was stopped and data destroyed.
FIU Nederland has asked the banks to destroy the data of four persons that were provided on this basis.
FIU-Nederland heeft de banken verzocht de gegevens van een viertal personen die op grond hiervan zijn verstrekt te vernietigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Ten Broeke over het bericht “Government austerity policy a breach of international human rights, says UN report”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a UN committee report finding UK austerity policy breaches economic and social rights, and whether such committee judgments are appropriate for the Netherlands. Minister Koenders answered that the committee's recommendations are non-binding, that the Dutch parliament is better placed to judge Dutch laws, and that the Optional Protocol ratification is still under consideration.
The Committee was established by ECOSOC with the aim of supervising compliance with the ICESCR by states parties.
Het Comité is door ECOSOC in het leven geroepen met als doel toezicht te houden op de naleving van het ESC-Verdrag door de staten die partij zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat er kritiek is op de hulpverlening na drama Stieltjeskanaal

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about criticism of emergency response after a car accident in the Stieltjeskanaal, including whether regions without dive teams slow rescue and whether a legal duty for dive teams should be introduced. The minister answered that regions decide their own rescue arrangements, that response times depend on the case, and that no change or new talks are planned.
For that reason, safety regions are not obliged to have a dive team.
Veiligheidsregio’s zijn om die reden niet verplicht te beschikken over een duikteam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de ontvoering van de heer R. van Duijn

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about the 1970 criminal investigation into the abduction of R. van Duijn, including why no prosecution followed, whether an apology was made, and whether the case should be reopened. The Minister confirmed knowledge of the case, said the evidence was insufficient for prosecution, noted that the College of Procurators-General recently apologised to Van Duijn in a private meeting, and referred him to the Noord-Hollands archief for access to the archived files.
It is not appropriate for me to make further public statements about the content of these contacts.
Het past mij niet publiekelijk over de inhoud van deze contacten nadere uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over het pleidooi de uitleveringen aan Turkije te stoppen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Bommel asked whether extraditions to Turkey should be suspended given doubts about judicial independence, fair trial rights, long pre-trial detention and possible reintroduction of the death penalty after the failed coup. The minister said the government is seriously concerned and urges the rule of law, but that a blanket suspension of extradition and legal assistance would be undesirable, with each request assessed case by case under the treaties and ECHR.

Suspending all extradition and legal assistance to Turkey in advance would mean that all suspects or convicted persons, including for example in human trafficking, sexual or violent offences, could evade their punishment or prosecution.

Het op voorhand volledig opschorten van alle uitlevering en rechtshulpverlening aan Turkije zou tot gevolg hebben dat alle verdachten of veroordeelden, dus ook inzake bijvoorbeeld mensenhandel, zeden- of geweldsdelicten, hun straf(vervolging) kunnen ontlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de intimidatie en doodsbedreiging aan het adres van een homostel

Two MPs asked the ministers about intimidation and death threats against a gay couple in Amsterdam, including whether police advised them not to file a complaint and whether non-Western minorities are overrepresented in anti-gay violence. The minister condemned the threats, said police encouraged mediation but that a discrimination complaint should always be recorded, rejected the statistical framing, and pointed to existing action plans and a planned protocol with partners.
A complaint of discrimination must always be recorded under the Discrimination Directive.
Een aangifte van discriminatie dient volgens de Aanwijzing Discriminatie altijd opgenomen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over het bericht dat extreem rechtse milities de buitengrenzen van de Europese Unie bewaken

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked whether Pegida Nederland members are hunting asylum seekers at the Bulgarian-Turkish border, whether such participation is criminal, how it is monitored, how many Dutch nationals are involved, and whether Dutch and Bulgarian justice have been in contact. The minister said he has no overview of Pegida members there, that Dutch criminal law could apply under article 7 Sr while Bulgarian authorities have primary responsibility, that the Dutch OM decides on opportunity to investigate, and that no contact with Bulgarian justice has taken place.
I have no overview of Pegida Nederland members who may be guarding the external borders of the EU in Bulgaria.
Ik heb geen overzicht van leden van Pegida Nederland die mogelijkerwijs in Bulgarije de buitengrenzen van de EU bewaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het feit dat het OM nu de MH17 radargegevens in Rusland opvraagt

Two MPs asked whether the Public Prosecution Service's request to Russia for raw primary radar data on MH17 reflected political pressure, whether an ICAO dispute should be launched, and why Russia, Ukraine and the UN had not fully complied with Security Council resolution 2166 and the victims' families' letters. The minister replied that the prosecution's independence must be protected, that the Netherlands is ready to assist on request, that no ICAO dispute will be started because the safety investigation did not need the data, and that the Russian authorities have said they are willing to cooperate.
The cabinet does not want political influence on this important criminal investigation.
Het kabinet wil geen politieke beïnvloeding van dit belangrijke strafrechtelijke onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over antisemitische bedreiging na tonen Israëlische vlag

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether they recognise that Jewish citizens are threatened for displaying an Israeli flag, whether they share concern about rising antisemitism and its causes, and what measures the government will take. The minister says such threats are unacceptable, cites research linking Middle East tensions to antisemitism, and points to the existing National Action Programme against Discrimination, with a progress report promised for early 2017.
The cabinet takes the feelings of fear and unease within the Jewish community seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de gevoelens van angst en onbehagen binnen de joodse gemeenschap serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over zaken die te maken hebben met huiselijk geweld

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about domestic violence: whether Veilig Thuis quality covers households without children, which inspectorate supervises shelters and Veilig Thuis, PTSD expertise and treatment capacity, whether victims of stalking can adopt a new identity, the sharing of victims' addresses with suspects, police expertise on psychological abuse, and scheduling. The government answered that the inspectorates' scope covers all victims, that municipalities are responsible for oversight of Veilig Thuis, that existing care and a standard on trauma are relied on, that a new identity is not possible while an analysis of victim data use is ongoing, and that address restrictions and domicile choice protect victims in most cases.
Municipalities are therefore responsible for the oversight of the VT organisations.
Gemeenten zijn dus verantwoordelijk voor de controle van de VT-organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het archaïsch taalgebruik door gerechtsdeurwaarders

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why bailiffs' legal notices (exploten) still use archaic language, whether it is required by law, and what can be done to make it clearer. The minister replied that debtors are entitled to clear explanation, pointed to the KBvG's plain-language legal guides made mandatory for bailiffs, and said the formal wording is largely required by law (e.g. Art. 475 Rv), with simplification of the beslagvrije voet as a further route.
The debtor has a right to clear explanation and information from the bailiff.
De schuldenaar heeft recht op een duidelijke uitleg en voorlichting van de kant van de gerechtsdeurwaarder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ulenbelt over de politie die actievoerende brandweerlieden intimideert

MPs Kerstens and Ulenbelt asked whether police contacting, phoning or visiting firefighters ahead of a union action intimidates them and whether this is acceptable given the right to strike. The government confirmed that police may seek information about planned actions as part of public order duties, denied that the approach was intimidation, and condemned any intimidation of strikers as a breach of the right to strike.
Actively contacting the persons involved in response to such signals by the police is one of the possibilities for this and forms part of normal police work.
Het actief contact opnemen door de politie met betrokkene(n) naar aanleiding van dergelijke signalen is daartoe een van de mogelijkheden en maakt deel uit van het normale politiewerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het aantal slachtoffers van sextortion dat explosief groeit

MP Bergkamp asked whether the rapid growth in sextortion victims is concerning, how victims can be supported, how stigma can be addressed, how criminal organisations can be tackled, and which criminal provisions apply. The government answered that the Help Wanted figures do not show explosive growth, outlined victim support measures, awareness and education programmes, Interpol-coordinated enforcement, and the existing legal options, while stating it will examine making sextortion with a sexual motive a sexual offence.
The Public Prosecution Service does not specifically register cases involving coercion or extortion with a sexual motive.
Het Openbaar Ministerie registreert niet specifiek op gevallen waarbij sprake is van dwang of afpersing met een seksueel motief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming 130 tijdelijke mensen aanneemt

MP Kooiman asked the Justice and Health ministers about long waiting times at the Child Protection Board (Raad voor de Kinderbescherming) and the temporary hiring of 130 staff, including whether waiting times will be reduced, what the effects are on the wider child protection chain, and whether extra funds will follow. The minister answered that the hiring is a temporary response to unexpected rising intake, that waiting times may rise further before easing by year-end, that the chain will be monitored and funding adjusted if the rise persists, and that other chain organisations are the responsibility of municipalities.
We see no need to take other measures in anticipation of this.
Wij zien geen noodzaak om vooruitlopend hierop andere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over algemene voorwaarden van sportscholen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about gym terms and conditions and whether consumers can complain when a gym is not a member of the Fit!Vak trade association, which controls access to the Consumer Foundation's dispute committee. The minister answered that non-members can use the general dispute committee or the court (kantonrechter), that consumers can have unfair terms annulled, and that trade codes and keurmerken still create incentives and can influence judicial standards.
If the entrepreneur is not affiliated with one of the dispute committees, the consumer can appeal to the district court judge.
Indien de ondernemer niet is aangesloten bij één van de Geschillencommissies, kan de consument een beroep doen op de kantonrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over de oproep van de Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers voor een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de fatale brand in Hellevoetsluis

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he would order an independent investigation into the fatal Hellevoetsluis fire, after a volunteer firefighters union called the Rotterdam-Rijnmond safety region's own report inadequate. The minister replied that the Inspectorate does not consider further investigation necessary, but will include the Hellevoetsluis fire in a nationwide review of firefighting response in all 25 safety regions.
The Inspectorate has studied the investigation report of the Rotterdam-Rijnmond safety region on the Hellevoetsluis fire. It does not consider further investigation necessary at this time.
De Inspectie heeft het onderzoeksrapport van de veiligheidsregio Rotterdam-Rijnmond naar de brand in Hellevoetsluis bestudeerd. Een nader onderzoek acht zij nu niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat agenten een spijkermat willen

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether he would reconsider the police leadership's decision not to purchase spike mats for officers, who reportedly wanted them, and whether he would discuss the matter with the police chief. The minister replied that the police chief judged the spike mat not worth buying after a 2012-2013 pilot used it only ten times, mostly successfully, and that he sees no reason to reopen the discussion.
As I indicated in my letter of 13 June, the assessment of the need for a new weapons system involves external studies, tests and the experiences of staff.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 13 juni jl. heb aangegeven, worden bij de beoordeling van de behoefte aan een nieuw wapensysteem (externe) onderzoeken, testen en ervaringen van medewerkers betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de politie ontevreden is over de robuuste basisteams en het aanbieding van het rapport Basisteams in de Nationale Politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he agreed with a research report finding that the robust basic police teams do not function well, and whether he would revise them, publish the report and address concerns about reduced accessibility, the role of neighbourhood officers, reactive policing, and complex structures. The minister answers that the findings are an early signal from a six-team study, that the teams will be given time to become fully operational by end 2017, that the police will use the insights, and that the report will be sent to parliament with a fuller reaction before the budget debate.
The report was prepared by Radboud University Nijmegen, commissioned by the independent research programme Police and Science. I am sending you the report as an annex to these answers.

Het rapport is opgesteld door de Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen, in opdracht van het onafhankelijke onderzoeksprogramma Politie en Wetenschap. Ik zend het u het rapport als bijlage bij deze antwoorden toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de politiebaas grif tekende

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the police chief signed off spending by the police works council (COR) that exceeded its budget of 1.6 million euro by about 226,000 euro, including alleged luxury boat expenses, and whether this reflected a quid pro quo. The minister confirmed an initial inquiry and an internal investigation by the police integrity unit, but withheld substantive findings and conclusions pending the investigation, promising to inform parliament after it concludes.
Pending the investigation, I cannot inform your House any further at this time.
Hangende het onderzoek kan ik uw Kamer op dit moment niet nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen, De Boer en Lodders over het artikel ‘Burgemeester Almere heeft geen tijd’

VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that bus stone-throwing in Almere's Kruidenwijk continued and that no one had been arrested, and what role the mayor should play. The minister said about ten incidents are under investigation, some arrests have been made, the government is working on an integrated public transport safety approach with the municipality and operator, and recovery of damages through criminal proceedings is possible but no concrete statements can yet be made.
As the investigation into these various incidents is still ongoing, I cannot currently provide further substantive information on this.
Nu het onderzoek naar deze diverse incidenten nog loopt, kan ik hier op dit moment geen verdere inhoudelijke mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over online-casino’s vanuit Curaçao in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Interior and Justice ministers about online casinos licensed from Curaçao operating in the Netherlands, including ownership, oversight, a telecom provider's role, and the gambling sector's revenue. The minister answered that the Dutch Gambling Authority has investigated such operators and ended violations through informal enforcement, but that online gambling oversight on Curaçao is a matter for Curaçao's government and Public Prosecutor, won't answer questions on individual companies, and will raise concerns with Curaçao's Justice Minister.
It is not possible to answer questions about individual Curaçao companies, business structures and citizens.
Het is niet mogelijk om vragen over individuele Curaçaose bedrijven, bedrijfsconstructies en burgers te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over grootschalige illegale gokactiviteiten vanuit Curaçao en de rol van KPMG

An MP asked the government about large-scale illegal online gambling run from Curaçao, the telecom company UTS's role, and KPMG's ties to UTS and other state-owned companies. The minister answered that Curaçao's gambling oversight is a Curaçao matter, that the Dutch gambling authority lacks enforcement powers there, and declined to answer questions about individual companies and citizens.
It is therefore a matter for the government and the Public Prosecution Service of Curaçao to properly regulate the oversight of online gambling.
Daarmee is het een aangelegenheid van de regering en het Openbaar Ministerie van Curaçao om het toezicht op online-kansspelen goed te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de racistische en discriminatoire gebeurtenissen in de weken 22 en 23

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about racist incidents in Geesteren and elsewhere, victim support, police reporting practices, specialisation in discrimination cases, rising racist violence, and non-implementation of ECRI recommendations. The Minister said victim support follows standard procedure, the motorcop case is under investigation so no comment is possible, police reporting uses a multichannel approach, discrimination training is being strengthened, and the ECRI recommendations are partly addressed through the National Action Programme with a progress report due January 2017.
This case is currently being investigated. While the investigation is ongoing, I cannot make any statements about it.
Deze zaak wordt momenteel onderzocht. Lopende het onderzoek kan ik hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Helder over het bericht dat de effecten van bezuinigingen op het NFI onder de pet worden gehouden

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether budget cuts at the Netherlands Forensic Institute are delaying murder and rape cases, whether the NFI director and the ministry tried to hide the effects and to keep the works council from speaking to parliament, and whether the Chamber has been misinformed. The minister replies that longer turnaround times are acknowledged with remedial measures, that the Chamber has received all relevant information, that the works council was in fact allowed to speak, and that there is no reason for sanctions.
The Chamber has not been withheld information.
De Kamer is geen informatie onthouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over de aanbesteding van dienstauto’s voor de brandweer

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked about the tender for fleet cars for the fire service, including the diesel requirement, sustainability criteria and tax treatment. The State Secretary replied that the diesel requirement is being dropped, that the fire service's procuring body (IFV) has been asked to pay attention to environmental aspects, and that the choice of diesel versus alternatives has cost implications.
As indicated in the reply of 13 April 2016, the diesel requirement is being dropped.
Zoals aangegeven in de beantwoording van 13 april 2016 1 wordt de dieseleis geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Tongeren over het gebruik van een privé-e-mailadres voor werkaangelegenheden

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about his use of a private email account for work matters, the security rules that apply, the 2014 hacking investigation and possible foreign access to the data. The minister admitted frequent but not prohibited business use of private email, ordered an Auditdienst Rijk investigation into whether classified material was present, and promised to inform parliament after the summer recess.

I have therefore instructed the Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) to investigate whether documents bearing the classifications Departmental Confidential, State Secret Confidential, State Secret Secret or State Secret Top Secret under the VIR-BI were present in my private email account.

Ik heb daarom de Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) opdracht gegeven onderzoek te doen naar de vraag of documenten met de rubriceringen Departementaal Vertrouwelijk, Staatsgeheim Confidentieel, Staatsgeheim Geheim of Staatsgeheim Zeer Geheim zoals bedoeld in het Voorschrift Informatiebeveiliging Rijksdienst Bijzondere Informatie (VIR-BI) op mijn privé e-mailaccount aanwezig waren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Minister van Economische Zaken doorgaat met het gebruik van Gmail voor communicatie met ambtenaren

An MP (Verhoeven, D66) asked whether Minister Kamp's use of a private Gmail account for work email exposed state secrets, whether he was phished, and whether ministers receive cybersecurity training. The minister answered that he has ended the private-account use, that an Auditdienst Rijk investigation into classified material is underway with results expected after the summer recess, and that he sees no grounds to assume classified information reached third parties.

I have therefore instructed the Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) to investigate whether documents bearing the classifications Departementaal Vertrouwelijk, Staatsgeheim Confidentieel, Staatsgeheim Geheim or Staatsgeheim Zeer Geheim were present on my private email account.

Ik heb daarom de Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) opdracht gegeven onderzoek te doen naar de vraag of documenten met de rubriceringen Departementaal Vertrouwelijk, Staatsgeheim Confidentieel, Staatsgeheim Geheim of Staatsgeheim Zeer Geheim
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over matchfixing en georganiseerde criminaliteit

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about match-fixing, organised crime links, information exchange with Germany (Rode Paul case) and prosecution priorities. The minister answered that police and prosecutors give match-fixing priority, that international cooperation will be stepped up through EU expert groups, and that organised-crime links will be examined in a 2017 threat assessment.
Repeatedly requesting the same case documents from German colleagues by different investigative and prosecution services has indeed not been efficient.
Het meermalen opvragen in het verleden door verschillende opsporings- dan wel vervolgingsdiensten van dezelfde dossierstukken bij de Duitse collega’s is inderdaad niet efficiënt geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de langdurige en omvangrijke landelijke storing in de systemen van de rechtspraak

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the long, nationwide IT outage at the judiciary in May 2016, including its duration, consequences, costs, cause and prevention. The minister answered that the outage lasted until 24 May, caused hearings to be postponed and cases adjourned, cost about 1.8 million euros, was caused by an unstable central network component, and that the judiciary is taking technical and continuity measures to prevent recurrence.
From 23 May 2016 at 07:35, a large part of judiciary staff experienced problems using their IT resources.
Vanaf 23 mei 2016 07:35 uur heeft een groot deel van de rechtspraakmedewerkers problemen ondervonden met het gebruik van hun IT middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Cyber security van apparatuur in ziekenhuizen kwetsbaar’

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked about reports that medical equipment in hospitals is vulnerable to cyber attacks, including malware infections and whether ministers would investigate device security and push for a national approach. The minister replied that hospitals are responsible for their own information security, pointed to existing NCSC initiatives (ISAC, Z-CERT) and a forthcoming quickscan, and committed to further study and discussion with stakeholders.
Information security is an own responsibility of a healthcare institution.
Informatiebeveiliging is een eigen verantwoordelijkheid van een zorginstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bezoek van een antisemitische geweldsimam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a preacher with antisemitic violent rhetoric would speak in the Netherlands and why he was not barred, and urged dissolving the inviting organisation. The minister said there was no confirmation of a Dutch appearance, declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to visa and entry-refusal tools and the courts' power to dissolve organisations, and considered current practice consistent with the Bontes motion.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de acties van de brandweer voor een betere cao

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the fire brigade's summer strike action over a better collective agreement, the heavy nature of firefighting work and the stalled negotiations between safety regions and unions. The minister answered that the parties must reach agreement themselves, that he is not a party to the negotiations and sees no reason to intervene for now, and that he raised the pension gap with the safety regions in 2015.
Responsibility for the staff's terms of employment lies with the boards of the 25 safety regions.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de arbeidsvoorwaarden van het personeel ligt bij de besturen van de 25 veiligheidsregio's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een Amerikaanse undercoveroperatie in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether a US undercover drug operation on Dutch soil was reported accurately to parliament, whether mutual legal assistance was needed, and how such activities are prevented. The minister rejects that earlier answers were incorrect, argues the online pseudo-purchases took place abroad so no Dutch consent was required, and states that foreign investigative activity without consent would be raised with the country concerned.
In the case of Marc W. there was therefore no undercover operation on Dutch territory for which Dutch permission was required.
In het geval van Marc W. was er dan ook geen undercoveroperatie op Nederlands grondgebied waarvoor Nederlandse toestemming vereist was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gevolgen van extreme weersomstandigheden

An MP asked the ministers about the consequences of extreme weather, climate scenarios, municipal climate risk preparedness, funding for adaptation, and event planning. The government answered that existing Delta Programme decisions remain valid, gave an overview of current programmes and an evaluation due end 2016, and said municipal capacity is the responsibility of local authorities.
The ambition is that by 2020 climate-resilient action and water-robust planning will be an integral part of their policy and conduct.
De ambitie hierbij is dat in 2020 klimaatbestendig handelen en waterrobuust inrichten een integraal onderdeel van hun beleid en handelen is

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over de risico’s op privacyproblemen en identiteitsfraude door de verspreiding van het Burger Servicenummer (BSN) bij paspoortkopieën en door de koppeling aan het B

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the BSN printed on passport copies and its linkage to the VAT number create identity fraud and privacy risks, and whether the Belastingdienst has a legal basis for that linkage. The Staatssecretaris answered that the BSN carries no greater risk than other passport data, that no fraud cases are known from the VAT link, that Wabb permits the use, and that a consultation with ANWB and hospitality bodies and a campaign will be started.
Stating the Burger Servicenummer (BSN) on travel documents carries no greater risk than stating the other personal data on travel documents.
Het vermelden van het Burger Servicenummer (BSN) op reisdocumenten draagt geen grotere risico's mee dan het vermelden van de andere persoonsgegevens op reisdocumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onafhankelijkheid van deurwaarders en de verwevenheid met incassobureaus

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about enforcement of the rules on independence of bailiffs, their links to debt collection agencies, a discrepancy in reported DAS shareholdings, and action against collection agencies overstating their powers. The minister answered that the existing KBvG regulation still applies pending internal debate, that verification of links is left to the KBvG, Bureau Financieel Toezicht and disciplinary courts, and that the ACM, AFM and NVI are investigating or tightening controls, without giving figures on the DAS discrepancy.
In the interest of the investigation, the ACM will not make further statements about its progress.
In het belang van het onderzoek doet de ACM verder geen uitspraken over de voortgang daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Gesthuizen over claimstichtingen van massaschades

MPs Van Nispen and Gesthuizen (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about oversight of claim foundations pursuing mass-damage claims, after reports that many lacked adequate safeguards against misuse of funds and conflicts of interest. The minister acknowledged the problems, said courts currently check only limited criteria, and announced a bill tightening rules for collective representatives, while rejecting a mandatory public annual accounts requirement and a separate Onderzoeksraad for mass damages.
In practice, the review against the criterion of sufficiently safeguarded interests has so far been limited.
In de praktijk blijkt de toetsing aan het criterium van de voldoende gewaarborgde belangen tot op heden beperkt.

Vragen van het lid Van Nispen (SP) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het door het Openbaar Ministerie achterhouden van een rapport dat ontlastend was voor de veroordeelde in de Showbizzmoordzaak (ingezonden

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice why the Public Prosecution Service withheld an exculpatory 2004 analysis from the convicted Showbizz murder case defendant and from the CEAS, and whether the matter can be investigated and prevented in future. The minister's further answer says the prosecution service did know new CIE information was being assessed by the district office and that consultation did take place, though the reason the case was not referred to the CEAS in 2006 is now judged likely to be that the file gave no grounds and limitation barred further investigation.

However, a recent further analysis by the OM of internal communication and decision-making shows that the regional prosecutor's office was in fact aware that the district office, on the basis of the new CIE information, was assessing whether further investigation was needed.

Uit een recent door het OM verrichte nadere analyse van interne communicatie en besluitvorming blijkt echter dat het ressortsparket er wel van op de hoogte was dat door het arrondissementsparket, op basis van de nieuwe CIE-informatie, werd bezien of nader onderzoek moest plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch, Yücel en Van Dekken over onveiligheid voor  homo's en lesbiennes

MPs asked the Justice Minister about insecurity for gay men and lesbians in nightlife, reports that incidents were not reported to police, and how reporting rates would be raised. The minister confirmed that 30.2% of gay men and lesbians feel unsafe near nightlife venues, said the police is improving the reporting process and training, and listed a campaign and Roze in Blauw networks to increase reporting.
Reports arising from such incidents must be taken seriously.
Aangiften n.a.v. dergelijke incidenten dienen serieus genomen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Yücel over de hoge kosten die een gerechtsdeurwaarder in rekening kan brengen

MPs Recourt and Yücel asked why bailiff enforcement costs can reach many times the debt, and whether government policy will limit debt build-up and stop commercial creditors from pressing payment during a moratorium. The minister replied that bailiff fees follow fixed tariffs not tied to the claim amount, that a breed moratorium will apply to all creditors including commercial ones, and that the government sees no need to change the tariff system.
The costs a bailiff may charge for official acts are set out in the Decree on tariffs for official acts of bailiffs.
De kosten die een gerechtsdeurwaarder voor ambtshandelingen in rekening mag brengen, zijn vastgelegd in het Besluit tarieven ambtshandelingen gerechtsdeurwaarders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug, Vermue en Ypma over het bericht dat Zeeuwse gemeenten medische gegevens van kinderen eisen

MPs Oosenbrug, Vermue and Ypma asked whether Zeeland municipalities demanding children's medical data to decide on reimbursement of care complies with privacy law and the Youth Act, and whether municipal officials are qualified and trained to handle it. The state secretary says only one complaint is known, no diagnosis information was requested, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens supervises compliance, and that privacy safeguards and a definitive ministerial regulation are being developed, while leaving municipal oversight largely to local bodies.

I do not have a picture of whether, and if so how many, municipalities since the Youth Act took effect have asked for medical data of youth care clients to assess whether medical costs can be reimbursed.

Ik heb niet in beeld of, en zo ja, hoeveel gemeenten sinds de inwerkingtreding van de Jeugdwet medische gegevens van jeugdhulpcliënten vragen voor de beoordeling of medische kosten vergoed kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Visser over het bericht “Docu over haatimams schokt Denen”

Two MPs asked whether foreign imams preaching hatred could also speak in Dutch mosques, what the government does to prevent incitement, and why Denmark's measures such as a watchlist and entry bans cannot be applied in the Netherlands. The minister responded that local authorities and institutions bear primary responsibility under a three-track approach, that visa-required preachers can be refused and EU alerts shared via the Schengen system, and that Denmark's measures are still being drafted so their applicability cannot yet be judged.
The Netherlands closely follows developments in Denmark and contact takes place at expert level.
Nederland volgt de ontwikkelingen in Denemarken nauwgezet en op expertniveau vindt contact plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat men de afbraak van de beveiliging nu beu is

The MP Kooiman asks whether the minister is aware of staff complaints about high workload, declining quality and sick leave in the Den Haag police unit's Bewaken en Beveiligen team, and whether reduced police numbers should be reversed. The minister answers that the unit's leadership has held talks with staff, that extra capacity is drawn from other teams, that the quality claim is rejected, and that sick leave is being investigated generally, without committing to restore the planned reduction.
An operational strength of at least 49,500 FTE has been agreed with your House.
Met uw Kamer is een operationele sterkte afgesproken van tenminste 49.500 FTE.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Eerste hulp bij vermissingen’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police use of mobile phone tracing in missing-person cases should be legally permitted, and about the status of follow-up legislation after the report on search tools for urgent missing-person cases. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, said separate legislation is being prepared and will go to consultation after the summer.
I intend to put this into consultation after the summer.
Ik ben voornemens deze na de zomer in consultatie te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het artikel ‘Griffierecht hoort in het medisch tuchtrecht niet thuis’

MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked whether the government still plans a 50-euro court fee for health-care disciplinary cases and whether that fee serves the public interest. Minister Schippers confirmed the plan, citing parallel fees for legal professions, argued it filters out unsuitable complaints while refunding founded ones, and said she will submit a bill to the Wet BIG.
I intend to submit a bill to parliament to include the court fee in the Wet BIG.
Ik ben voornemens om een wetsvoorstel voor te leggen aan het parlement om het griffierecht op te nemen in de Wet BIG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over een racistische aanval in Zwolle

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about a racist attack in Zwolle, victim support, rising racist violence, stronger penalties such as an educational sentence for discrimination, police specialisation in discrimination complaints, and budgets for combating discrimination and radicalisation. The government replied that victim support follows the regular procedure, existing sentencing options suffice, police already have discrimination contact persons, and gave the budget figures, but declined to answer the questions before the plenary debate.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Dader Zelhem moest naar psychiatrische kliniek’

An MP asked the Justice Minister six questions about court and prosecution decisions preceding the release of the suspect in the fatal Zelhem accident, including whether a forced psychiatric admission could have been arranged. The minister declined to answer on substance, citing the ongoing investigation and the victims' families' information position, and promised a letter to parliament later.

In this General Consultation I indicated, in response to questions on this subject, that the investigation is ongoing and that it is therefore not appropriate for me to answer questions on this subject in detail.

In dit Algemeen Overleg heb ik in reactie op vragen over dit onderwerp aangegeven dat het onderzoek op dit moment loopt en dat het mij daarom nu niet past op detailniveau op vragen op dit onderwerp in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht 'Samenscholingsverbod na 'Marokkaanse' onlusten in Ede'

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about a ban on gatherings after riots in Ede, the arrests made, and whether Moroccan youth over-representation in crime and military-style discipline should be pursued. The government answered that 10 suspects were arrested and released, that youth crime risk factors are social and spatial rather than ethnic, and that it does not support military discipline, favouring tailored interventions.

So far 10 suspects have been arrested for violating the gathering ban, resisting officers, insult, failure to obey an official order, deliberately violating the area ban, violating the Identification Act, rowdiness, or a combination of these offences.

Er zijn tot nu toe 10 verdachten aangehouden voor respectievelijk overtreding van het samenscholingsverbod, wederspannigheid, belediging, niet voldoen aan een ambtelijk bevel, het opzettelijk overtreden van het gebiedsverbod, overtreding van de Wet op de Identificatieplicht, baldadigheid of voor een combinatie van deze feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het inroepen van hulp van de Marokkaanse consul bij rellen Ede

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether calling in the Moroccan consul to restore order among rioting youths in Ede undermined Dutch authority, and what the government would do to restore order. The minister replied that the consul only sought talks at the mayor's request, that Dutch authorities alone hold authority, and that maintaining public order is a local responsibility with no further central measures announced.
Maintaining public order is a local responsibility.
Het handhaven van de openbare orde is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat volksvertegenwoordigers worden bedreigd

An MP asked the government how it responds to reports that elected officials are being threatened, whether figures show a trend, what protective and preventive measures exist, and how threats are prosecuted. The minister answered that threats are unacceptable, that reported incidents fell from 38% to 23% of local officials between 2012 and 2014, that a new monitor is pending, and that existing measures and prosecution practice are sufficient.
It cannot be clearly established what the effectiveness of these measures and instruments is individually.
Het is niet eenduidig vast te stellen wat de effectiviteit van deze maatregelen en instrumenten afzonderlijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de brandweer in Enkhuizen regelmatig buiten dienst is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether fire brigade understaffing in Enkhuizen, and a variable-crew trial in Hellevoetsluis, were safe, and whether the Inspectorate would investigate. The Minister said the safety region is responsible for adequate fire services, the Inspectorate will examine repressive fire care in all safety regions this year, and no talks or further sending of the regional report were planned, referring questions to the regions and municipal councils.
The Inspectorate of Security and Justice will carry out an investigation into the quality of repressive fire brigade care in all safety regions this year.
De Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie zal dit jaar in alle veiligheidsregio’s een onderzoek uitvoeren naar de kwaliteit van de repressieve brandweerzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over matchfixing in het tennis

An MP asked the ministers of Health and of Justice whether matchfixing in professional tennis is more widespread than known, whether attempts occurred at Dutch matches, whether they are punishable, whether complaints or criminal investigations exist. The minister answered that signals were shared with the Tennis Integrity Unit, that attempted fixing is criminally punishable under certain articles if leads arise, that no complaint was filed because players involved were unidentified, and that the Public Prosecution Service does not disclose investigations.
The Public Prosecution Service makes no announcement about whether or not it is investigating anything.
Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen mededeling over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek en Volp over de dumpingen van drugs en ander (gevaarlijk) afval in Gelderland

MPs Cegerek and Volp asked about illegal dumping of drug-lab and other hazardous waste in Gelderland, including prosecution rates and cost-sharing. The minister answered that enforcement focuses on production and prosecution, that the 50% state funding applies only to drug waste, and that a provincial cooperation like those in Brabant and Limburg would be joined if Gelderland wants it.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over de rechtsbijstand aan slachtoffers van ernstige gewelds- en zedenmisdrijven

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Justice Minister about legal aid for victims of serious violent and sexual crimes, including the LANGZS black book, referrals by Slachtofferhulp Nederland, Raad voor Rechtsbijstand fee points and budget cuts. The minister answered that referrals have been stimulated and fee points are under review with stakeholders, but largely pointed to existing policy and promised further consultation without committing to new structural changes.
My ministry has asked the organisations concerned to respond to the cases mentioned in the black book.
Mijn ministerie heeft de betrokken organisaties gevraagd om een reactie op de in het Zwartboek genoemde casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het Rapport “Pre-trial detention in the Netherlands: legal principles versus practical reality”

An MP asked the Justice Minister to respond to a Leiden study finding Dutch pre-trial detention practice problematic under ECHR case law, including high detention numbers and little use of alternatives. The minister largely disagreed with the high-detention claim, noting the Netherlands is mid-table in Europe per Trema data, while accepting the need for more consideration of alternatives and promising discussions with prosecutors and judiciary and a legislative review within the Code of Criminal Procedure modernisation.

I share the main conclusions of the researchers, namely that it is important that the necessity of imposing pre-trial detention is always critically examined and that alternatives could be considered more emphatically.

Ik deel de belangrijkste conclusies van de onderzoekers, namelijk dat het belangrijk is dat altijd kritisch wordt gekeken naar de noodzaak van het opleggen van voorlopige hechtenis en dat alternatieven nadrukkelijker zouden kunnen worden overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over onderzoek naar het overlijden van een man in Groningen in 1990

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a 1990 death in Groningen, reported as possibly a killing, could still be prosecuted and whether new information justifies reopening the case. The minister answered that no indications of murder exist, the 2005 closure was based on investigative findings, doodslag would be time-barred, and there is no reason to reopen.
The investigation was closed by the Public Prosecution Service in 2005 due to the lack of sufficient investigative indications.
Het onderzoek is in 2005 door het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) gesloten vanwege het ontbreken van voldoende opsporingsindicaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een jihad-prediker naar de As Soennah moskee

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a Belgian imam who allegedly preaches violent jihad could speak at the As Soennah mosque in The Hague, and whether the mosque should be closed or dissolved and the municipality should stop cooperating with it. The minister answered that the imam showed no incitement to violence, that as an EU national he cannot be barred, that the prosecutor has seen no grounds to seek dissolution, and that cooperation with the mosque is a municipal matter.
Based on the facts and circumstances, the prosecution service has so far seen no reason to ask the court to close a mosque.
Op basis van feiten en omstandigheden heeft het OM tot op heden geen aanleiding gezien om de rechter te verzoeken een moskee te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Miltenburg over de opgenomen doelen en streefcijfers van de veiligheidsagenda 2015-2018

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the approach to anti-LHBT (homophobic) violence is being given shape, how the strengthened approach works in practice and what results exist, and whether the 2017 budget will set measurable goals and indicators. The minister described consultations, the National Action Programme against Discrimination, police and prosecution measures and a campaign, but refused to add goals and indicators to the budget, citing existing reporting agreements.
I see no reason to depart, for the approach to anti-LHBT violence, from the agreements I made with the House on how to report on the priorities listed in the Security Agenda.

Ik zie geen reden ten aanzien van de aanpak van homofoob geweld af te wijken van de afspraken die ik met Uw Kamer heb gemaakt over de wijze van rapporteren over de prioriteiten die gemeld staan in de Veiligheidsagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Volp over bestraffing van misdrijven buiten de rechter om

MPs Recourt and Volp asked the Justice Minister whether the prosecution service increasingly settles not only minor but also serious offences outside court, and whether this is appropriate given procedural safeguards. The minister answered that the ZSM approach is limited to relatively simple cases such as small cannabis matters, that OM penalty orders carry legal safeguards including the right to object before a judge, and that the prosecution decides case by case without restructuring the criminal justice chain.
The Wet OM-afdoening gives the public prosecutor the power to impose sanctions without judicial intervention through a penalty order for offences carrying up to six years' imprisonment.
De Wet OM-afdoening geeft de officier van justitie de bevoegdheid om zonder tussenkomst van de rechter in een strafbeschikking sancties op te leggen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels en Bergkamp over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie in Brabant heeft besloten om de ZSM-afdoening op te rekken naar zwaardere strafbare feiten en drugscriminelen niet langer

MPs Swinkels and Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Brabant police and prosecutors were expanding ZSM out-of-court settlements to more serious offences and no longer bringing drug criminals before a judge, and how this fits the ZSM purpose. The minister denied any expansion of ZSM, said case handling is the independent prosecution service's decision, and gave largely referential answers without confirming the Brabant decision was reviewed by him.
It is for the public prosecution service to decide, case by case and in light of all facts and circumstances, how a case is handled.
Het is aan het OM om per individueel geval, gelet op alle feiten en omstandigheden, te bepalen op welke wijze een zaak wordt afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Geen straf coffeeshop Meetpoint Den Bosch’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about court rulings that let coffeeshop suppliers go unpunished for holding stocks above the 500-gram limit, and whether the government still enforces drug crime policy consistently. The minister answered that appeals are pending in several cases, that the ministry does not register such rulings so no full overview can be given, and that courts are independent while the government continues its fight against drug crime.

The Ministry of Security and Justice does not register rulings in which Opium Act offenders were found guilty but received no punishment because the drug stock was deemed necessary for supplying a coffeeshop.
Er wordt door het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie niet geregistreerd op uitspraken waarin overtreders van de Opiumwet wel schuldig zijn bevonden, maar geen straf hebben kregen opgelegd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Pak criminelen hun geld af, dan tref je ze het hardst’

MP Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the ZSM out-of-court settlement approach to drug cases in Brabant, its revenue, legal and evaluation issues, and whether drug-offence sentencing and penalties should change. The Minister denied any broader rollout, reported about 150,000 euros collected and 23 objections in one district, stated that the business case evaluation is still pending for June, and said no change to drug penalties is needed.
The Public Prosecution Service is still busy with the practical elaboration of its plan of action for the investment of 3 million euros.
Het OM is nog druk doende met de praktische uitwerking van haar plan van aanpak voor de investering van de € 3 mln.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over schelden bij jeugdvoetbal

An MP asked the ministers about verbal abuse, aggression and discrimination at youth football and what the Naar een veiliger sportklimaat programme has achieved. The minister answered that the programme is being extended by two years with a focus on weak clubs and volunteer board members, and pointed to fair play competitions and the referee and player licence system, without addressing the MP's specific questions in detail.
For that reason I have extended the action plan 'Towards a Safer Sports Climate' by two years.
Om die reden heb ik dan ook het actieplan «Naar een Veiliger Sportklimaat» met twee jaar verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bergkamp over legale wietteelt als positieve mensenrechtenverplichting

MPs Kooiman and Bergkamp asked whether international human rights law obliges the state to regulate legal cannabis cultivation, and about the budgetary and tax effects of regulation. The minister answered that the conditions for a human-rights-based space for regulation are not met, that regulation would not reduce enforcement costs or yield tax revenue as claimed, and that no change of course is warranted given the parliamentary majority against regulation.
Therefore I see no reason for a change of course.
Derhalve zie ik geen reden voor een koerswijziging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bezoek van een terreurprediker aan een moskee in Boskoop

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a controversial imam speaking at a mosque in Boskoop and whether such preachers should be barred, mosques closed, or ANBI status withdrawn. The minister said the cleric is Belgian and EU free-movement rules limit exclusion, that the government opposes intolerant speakers and will act on criminal conduct, and that no mosque closure or ANBI revocation was warranted so far, while noting the mayor's response.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Recourt over intimidatie van Molukkers bij hoog Indonesisch bezoek

MPs Tanamal and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about security guards from the Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen ordering Moluccan women to remove a flag and scarf during an Indonesian president's visit, and whether this violated free expression. The minister said free expression is protected, the flag is not punishable, the guards acted on a risk assessment, and complaints can be filed with the police.
It is not for me, through answering written parliamentary questions, to pass judgement on the individual functioning of these DBB employees.
Het is niet aan mij om middels de beantwoording van schriftelijke Kamervragen een uitspraak te doen over het individuele functioneren van deze medewerkers van de DBB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat Zeeland de ideale plek is voor drugssmokkelaars

MP Kooiman asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether drug smuggling is shifting to Zeeland, whether inspection reports show too little police capacity there, and whether he will cut police staffing by about 2,000 FTE. The minister says enforcement is risk-based and integrated, points to inspection work that gave no verdict on Zeeland drug enforcement, notes agreed capacity measures and a port prosecutor, and states the operational strength will be reduced to the agreed 49,500 FTE.
Do the inspection reports indeed show that there is far too little capacity in Zeeland to tackle this problem? Are you willing to also send these reports to the House of Representatives?
Vraag 3 Blijkt uit de inspectierapporten inderdaad dat er veel te weinig capaciteit is in Zeeland om deze problematiek aan te pakken? Bent u bereid deze rapporten ook naar de Tweede Kamer te sturen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat Turkije niet meewerkt in de zaak-Demmink en het onderzoek daarmee is afgerond

MP Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether it is unacceptable that Turkey refuses Dutch legal assistance requests to hear witnesses in the Demmink case, and what steps the government has taken. The Minister answered that Turkey invoked the ne bis in idem ground, that this has no consequences for judicial cooperation, that he has pressed Turkish counterparts repeatedly, and that he must respect Turkey's decision.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de registratie van jihadgangers en terugkeerders

The MP Segers asked the Minister of Security and Justice why registrations of jihadist travellers in Europol's Focal Point Travellers and EIS rose sharply since March 2015, how travellers were tracked, whether they are stopped at borders, and how many may be unregistered. The Minister explained that information sharing has grown through EU cooperation, that border checks rely on SIS II and the Stolen and Lost Travel Documents database rather than Focal Point Travellers or EIS, and that exact unregistered numbers cannot be known, while withholding details on the Paris and Brussels attackers because of ongoing investigations.
It is not possible to say with certainty how many unknown jihadist travellers are not registered in the Focal Point Travellers or the EIS, nor in any other system such as SIS II.
Het is niet mogelijk met zekerheid te zeggen hoeveel onbekende jihadgangers niet geregistreerd zijn in het Focal Point Travellers of het EIS, noch in enig ander system, zoals het SISII.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Gerven over nader onderzoek naar het verband tussen het gebruik van bepaalde medicijnen en agressie

Two MPs from the SP asked the Justice and Health ministers about research into links between antidepressant or benzodiazepine use and aggression, the Public Prosecution Service's stance on such research, and whether suspects should be tested for medication. The minister replied that pharmacovigilance via Lareb and the CBG already handles side-effect reporting, that no legal basis for mandatory blood tests of suspects should be created, and pointed to ZonMw research funding.
At present there is no legal basis for taking blood samples from suspects after a (violent) offence to determine whether medication has been used.
Op dit moment is er geen wettelijke grondslag om na een (gewelds)delict bloedmonsters af te nemen bij verdachten om te achterhalen of er sprake is van gebruik van geneesmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het melden van verdachte of ongebruikelijke transacties door notarissen en de angst voor bedreigingen als gevolg daarvan

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the notary's name in an unusual-transaction report later appears in criminal files, and about notaries who fear threats and therefore do not report or refuse cases. The minister replied that reports must be made under the Wwft, that threats can be reported to the national prosecutor and protected via anonymous-witness or witness-protection measures, and that anonymous reporting is not possible within current law because verification and follow-up are needed.
Anonymous reporting to the FIU of an unusual transaction is not possible within the current legal framework.
Anoniem melden bij de FIU van een ongebruikelijke transactie is binnen de huidige wettelijke kaders niet mogelijk
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Toorenburg, Knops en Keijzer over de zaak Saban B. in Turkije

CDA MPs asked about the case of Saban B., convicted in the Netherlands to 7 years 9 months for trafficking and assault but still free in Turkey, and about Turkey's cooperation on enforcing Dutch sentences. The minister answered that Turkish proceedings are still pending, that Dutch requests since 2010 cover 23 persons with at least 6 granted, and that a memorandum of understanding is being negotiated, but did not provide a complete list or the requested one-week timeline.

In the context of protecting the privacy of the persons concerned, I can only inform you that since 2010 the Netherlands has, under the Wots, expressed to Turkey the wish to transfer enforcement of a Dutch sentence for 23 persons.

In het kader van bescherming van de privacy van de betrokken personen, kan ik u slechts mededelen dat Nederland vanaf 2010 op grond van de Wots ten aanzien van 23 personen aan Turkije de wens kenbaar heeft gemaakt de tenuitvoerlegging van een Nederlands vonnis aan Turkije over te dragen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderzoek over de radargegevens van de OVV, de non-disclosure clausules in het JIT MH17 verdrag, het archief over de MH17 en de brieven van nabestaanden

An MP asks the government about radar data on MH17, JIT non-disclosure clauses, the MH17 archive, and letters from relatives to Ukraine, Russia and the US. The minister answers that the government took note of the OVV report, that JIT-related agreements are not public, that the archive is being indexed, and that the interview notes of the Twente evaluation cannot be disclosed.

The cabinet wants to avoid that starting a dispute procedure could be taken to mean that the Netherlands considers this data necessary to draw the conclusions of the OVV report and that the investigation must be reopened.

Het kabinet wil voorkomen dat uit het starten van een geschillenprocedure zou kunnen worden geconcludeerd dat Nederland van mening is dat deze gegevens nodig zijn voor het trekken van de conclusies van het OVV rapport en dat het onderzoek heropend moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Smaling en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat er door een drugs-lab giftige stoffen zijn vrij gekomen in een woonwijk in Tilburg

MPs asked the government how harmful the toxic release from a Tilburg drug lab was, how residents are being informed and trained to spot drug labs, and how many labs are dismantled and what resources are assigned. The minister answered that methanol and sulphuric acid were present, residents were informed by letter, training and a smell map are being rolled out in the south, and labour conditions at the dismantling unit were investigated and improved.
In any case it is an undesirable situation when a drug laboratory is found in a residential area.
Het is hoe dan ook een onwenselijke situatie als een drugslaboratorium in een woonwijk wordt aangetroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Swinkels over het bericht dat steeds meer schadevergoedingen worden uitgekeerd voor het onterecht vastzitten

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the rising number of compensation payments for wrongful detention, including whether pre-trial detention and police custody (inverzekeringstelling) are used more in the Netherlands, why custody of minors has changed, and whether alternatives like bail should be explored. The Minister answered that Dutch pre-trial detention rates are in the middle range in Europe and falling, attributed the rise in compensation to more short custody episodes possibly reflecting broader use of custody, committed to evaluate custody practice, and said alternatives to pre-trial detention are a matter for judges and will be discussed with prosecutors and the judiciary.

I will raise the possible alternatives to pre-trial detention, including paying a bail sum, before the summer in my regular consultations with the College of Procurators General and the Council for the Judiciary.

Ik zal de mogelijke alternatieven voor voorlopige hechtenis, waaronder het betalen van een borgsom, nog voor de zomer aan de orde stellen in mijn reguliere overleggen met het College van procureurs-generaal en de Raad voor de rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kooiman over het bericht over een bedreigd Rotterdams gezin

MPs Karabulut and Kooiman asked whether honour-related violence against a Rotterdam family is being recognised and acted on in time, and whether knowledge should be strengthened at police units. The minister declined to discuss the individual case because a criminal investigation is ongoing, defended the existing police and LEC EGG structure, and agreed knowledge should be present in all regional units while saying existing arrangements already provide for it.
However, I cannot go into the details of an individual case, because of the privacy of those involved and in the interest of the criminal investigation that is still ongoing.
Ik kan echter niet ingaan op de details van een individuele casus, vanwege de privacy van betrokkenen en in het belang van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat momenteel nog gaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de sterke afname van contacten bij het Juridisch Loket

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister why contacts at the Juridisch Loket (legal aid desks) fell sharply, whether access to legal aid is threatened, and what the government will do to keep it accessible. The Minister attributes the fall partly to supply-side changes such as reduced opening hours and a shift to telephone service, denies a budget shortfall or a gap in legal aid, and says a monitoring report and reform reactions will follow.
The Juridisch Loket continuously adjusts its range of assistance to the volume of demand from people seeking legal help in relation to the available budget.
Het Juridisch Loket stemt zijn hulpaanbod voortdurend af op de omvang van de vraag van rechtzoekenden in relatie tot het beschikbare budget.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over strafrechtelijke boetes in de schuldhulpverlening

MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked about a Rotterdam court ruling forcing the CJIB into a debt-settlement arrangement, the inability to include recent versus nearly-expired criminal fines in voluntary debt schemes, and whether this would lead to more forced settlements. The State Secretary defended the enforcement of criminal fines, citing installment options, clemency, and the statute of limitations extension, and said he finds widespread final debt relief undesirable.
For Wahv sanctions, as stated in the answer to question 2, since 1 January 2016 further collection of outstanding Wahv sanctions is ended after a successfully completed voluntary debt settlement.

Voor de Wahv-sancties geldt dat, zoals in antwoord op vraag 2 gemeld, sinds 1 januari 2016 de verdere inning van openstaande Wahv-sancties wordt beëindigd na een succesvol afgeronde minnelijke schuldregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat de subsidie-imam angst zaait

MPs Öztürk asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Justice about a subsidised imam's warnings of an imminent attack in Amsterdam and about government funding of his organisations and of the Expertise-unit Sociale Stabiliteit (ESS). The minister declined to discuss the imam's motives, said police and the municipality saw no new information, and described ESS budget, projects, and hiring procedures, stating that some organisations receive subsidies or contracts.
I will not go further into individual contract awards here.
Ik ga hier verder niet in op individuele opdrachtverleningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een toekomstig tekort bij het Nederlands Register Gerechtelijk Deskundigen

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister how he views the NRGD's 2015 annual report on budget cuts (taakstelling) and the future of the forensic expert register. The minister replied that the NRGD must absorb the coalition-agreement cuts while keeping its statutory tasks, outlined his expectations for the register's expansion and cost review, and said he would not commit to more funding beyond the stated framework.
I expect that the NRGD, like other government organisations, will implement the efficiency cuts in its business operations as set out in the coalition agreement.
Daarbij verwacht ik dat ook het NRGD, net zoals andere organisaties van het Rijk, de in het regeerakkoord opgenomen taakstellingen op de bedrijfsvoering invult.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Nieuwe drug vervangt de zware XTC-pil'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about health risks of the new drug 4-FA (XTC-light), its long-term effects, prevention, and whether it will be banned under the Opium Act. The State Secretary answered that long-term risks are unknown, the drug is monitored, prevention runs through regular channels, and no ban is planned for now based on the 2015 CAM quick scan and WHO advice.
The CAM will examine this year whether there is reason to update the quick scan.
Het CAM zal dit jaar bekijken of er aanleiding is de quick scan te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over de aanpak van verkeershufters

MPs Van Helvert and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked why fines for road offences such as overtaking on the right and tailgating have fallen and how this fits the 2020 road-casualty target. The minister attributes the drop mainly to police CAO actions in 2015, vacancies and shifting priorities, announces a 2016-2018 enforcement plan, and declines to reinstate the alcohol-lock programme as not opportune.
An important reason for the decline in the number of fines imposed is the police CAO actions in 2015.
Een belangrijke reden voor de daling van het aantal opgelegde boetes zijn de CAO-acties van de politie in 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de handreiking schriftelijk euthanasieverzoek

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked about the handreiking on written euthanasia requests, including how the brochure was drafted, uptake among doctors, and wording on dementia suffering. The ministers answered that the handreiking was developed by a working group with consultation of stakeholders to clarify the Wtl, that uptake is unknown, and that doctors must still assess unbearable suffering case by case.
We have no insight into the extent to which doctors use the handreiking.
Antwoord 3 We hebben geen inzicht in de schaal waarop artsen gebruikmaken van de handreiking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het halveren van de subsidie van de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Rechtspraak

An SP MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice why the subsidy to the judges' and prosecutors' association NVvR was halved, questioning its link to the association's critical stance on budget cuts and the planned loss of its consent right. The minister answers that budget constraints required cuts to non-statutory subsidies, denies any link to the association's positions, and says NVvR advice will continue to be requested and the subsidy will not be reversed.

There is no relationship whatsoever between this cut and the NVvR's activities and positions on any file, nor does this cut anticipate the outcome of a discussion yet to be held about the future powers the NVvR should receive as a trade association in the system.

Er is geen enkele relatie tussen deze korting en de activiteiten en standpunten van de NVvR op enig dossier, noch anticipeert deze korting op de uitkomst over een nog te voeren discussie over de toekomstige bevoegdheden die de NVvR moet krijgen als vakvereniging in het stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de berichtgeving inzake halvering van het aantal flitspalen

An MP asks why the number of speed cameras (flitspalen) in the Netherlands has halved, whether this reduces road safety, and how placement and removal decisions are made. The minister explains that placement follows the Openbaar Ministerie policy framework, that the number fell mainly because analogue cameras were replaced by digital ones (642 suitable locations identified), and that digital cameras enforce around the clock, so enforcement has in fact increased.
I do not have the precise number of speed cameras that were actively enforcing in 2011.
Het precieze aantal van het aantal flitspalen dat in 2011 in handhaving stond heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over samenwerkingsverbanden tussen notarissen en niet-notarissen

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the KNB's Interdisciplinary Cooperation (IDS) regulation 2015, which governs notaries working with non-notaries, and about related cases such as the Nationale Notaris and HEMA notary models. The Minister approves the regulation, says it is consistent with law and the public interest, and states that the BFT supervises compliance but does not specifically audit cooperation arrangements absent specific signals.
The BFT, as integral supervisor, follows developments with interest and will use its powers where necessary.
Het BFT, als integraal toezichthouder, volgt de ontwikkelingen met belangstelling en zal waar nodig gebruik maken van zijn bevoegdheden.
