Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Veldslag van motorclubs bij Van der Valkhotel Rotterdam’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a clash between Hells Angels and Mongols motorcycle club members at a Rotterdam hotel, including arrests, fugitives, aftercare, the Mongols' emergence, and the status of a civil ban on clubs. The minister declined to give details on ongoing investigations and prosecutions for reasons of investigation and privacy, but described aftercare for victims and staff, and said he would report on the civil-ban study in early June.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de aanpak van Outlaw Motorcycle Gangs

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the approach to Outlaw Motorcycle Gangs, including case numbers, whether OMGs can be barred or required to obtain certificates, and whether the law should make banning them easier. The minister promised to report on case figures later and said the civil ban route is complex and slow, with the outcome uncertain; he declined to commit to a legislative change for now.
As promised in the police committee meeting of 19 April, I will inform your House more fully about the approach to motorcycle gangs before the planned general meeting on organised crime on 16 June.
Ik zal, zoals toegezegd in het AO Politie van 19 april jl., uw Kamer vóór het geplande algemeen overleg georganiseerde criminaliteit op 16 juni a.s, nader informeren over de aanpak van motorbendes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht “Help! Mijn demente ouders worden beroofd”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that professional guardians (bewindvoerders) exploit dementia patients, including the low share who belong to a branch association, the lack of a protected title or professional chamber, and whether oversight by overburdened sub-district judges is adequate. The minister replied that guardianship is supervised by judges with mandatory annual accounts, quality requirements and a central quality bureau since 2016, that no protected title or order is planned, and that the 2017 evaluation of the law will examine enforcement.
In light of this, I believe sufficient safeguards already exist to monitor the appointment and work of guardianship administrators.
In het licht hiervan meen ik dat reeds voldoende waarborgen bestaan om het aanstellen en het werk van beschermingsbewindvoerders te controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert en Visser over het besluit om het alcoholslot op te heffen

MPs Van Helvert (CDA) and Visser (VVD) asked why the government abolished the alcohol interlock programme (ASP) after court rulings, questioning its cost, recidivism effects and whether alternatives were examined. The minister defended the abolition on cost and legal grounds, saying the programme could not be kept in administrative law and would add little in criminal law, while pointing to other measures and pending WODC research.

Weighing everything, we conclude that placing the ASP in criminal law offers too little added value beside existing instruments to tackle drink-driving, and that it is therefore not expedient to maintain the ASP.

Alles afwegende komen wij tot de conclusie dat het onderbrengen van het ASP in het strafrecht te weinig meerwaarde biedt naast het bestaande instrumentarium om rijden onder invloed aan te pakken en dat het derhalve niet opportuun is om het ASP in stand te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over aanhoudende misstanden rondom zwanendrifters in het Groene Hart

MP Thieme asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Security and Justice about persistent abuses in swan herding (zwanendrifters) in the Groene Hart, including whether convicted offenders should lose hunting permits, protection for the complainant, and a ban on collecting swan eggs for commercial purposes. The government answered that the police chief decides on withdrawing permits, that police increased surveillance around the complainant's home, and that egg collection is allowed only for damage control under provincial permit, while hatching and selling swans is not permitted.
It is up to the chief of police to decide on any withdrawal of hunting permits he has granted when violations of the Flora and Fauna Act are established.
Het is aan de korpschef van politie om te beslissen over een eventuele intrekking van door hem verleende jachtakten bij geconstateerde overtredingen van de Flora- en faunawet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat de Haagse politie een rapport over discriminatie zou hebben gemanipuleerd

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Hague police manipulated a study on discrimination and whether the government misinformed parliament about the research on ethnic profiling. The minister denied misinforming parliament, said the research was not designed to be a ministry study, and stated that the study had value but no further investigation is planned given other ongoing reports.
No, I do not share this view.
Nee, deze mening deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over corruptie bij de douane in de haven van Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Security and Justice about corruption among customs officers in the Port of Rotterdam, including whether the problem is structural, what measures are taken, and whether an independent inquiry will be held. The government denies a structural problem, describes preventive and disciplinary measures and new controls, says it cannot give a complete overview of smuggled goods, and declines an independent investigation, citing existing monitoring programmes.

The Customs service and the Public Prosecution Service do not have information to provide a complete overview of products (drugs, weapons) that entered in the past five years through bribery of customs personnel.

De Douane en het OM beschikken niet over informatie om een compleet overzicht te kunnen geven van producten (drugs, wapens) die de afgelopen vijf jaar via omkoping van douanepersoneel zijn binnengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over Israëlische dreigementen tegen aanhangers van de boycot, desinvesteringen en sancties (BDS)-beweging

MP Grashoff asked the Dutch government about Israeli ministers' statements calling for targeted measures against BDS activists, Israeli anti-boycott legislation, and possible sanctions against Dutch or EU citizens. The government said it cannot interpret foreign ministers' remarks, noted the Israeli minister's clarification that he meant no physical measures, described the anti-boycott law and a visa bill as not yet having led to cases, and stated that supporting BDS falls under freedom of expression.
It is not for the cabinet to explain what ministers of another state precisely mean by their statements.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om uit te leggen wat bewindspersonen van een andere staat met hun uitspraken precies bedoelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brouwer en Vermue over een storing van alarmnummer 112 in West-Brabant

MPs Brouwer and Vermue asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a brief outage of the 112 emergency number in West-Brabant on 16 March 2016, its cause, duration, incidents, regional preparedness and prevention. The minister confirmed the outage, said it lasted until about 8 hours, was caused by reduced line capacity, that 112 remained reachable for citizens, and that the cause is still under investigation with possible further measures to follow.
The exact cause of the outage is still under investigation.
De exacte oorzaak van de storing is nog in onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het griffierecht voor onvermogenden en het recht op toegang tot het recht

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister of Justice about the consequences of a Supreme Court ruling that charging court fees to people without income or assets violates the right of access to court, and whether fee levels, a hardship clause or other measures will be considered. The minister answers that the ruling lets judges waive fees in cases of inability to pay, that individual assessment applies, that no generic fee reduction or express hardship clause is planned, and that applicants can raise inability to pay with the registrar or judge.
This ruling of the Supreme Court means that the judge can also exempt the litigant from paying court fees in civil proceedings in case of inability to pay.
Dit arrest van de Hoge Raad heeft tot gevolg dat de rechter ook in civielrechtelijke procedures de rechtzoekende kan vrijstellen van betaling van griffierecht in geval van betalingsonmacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken over het bericht 'Gemaskerd protest tegen ‘asielfabriek’

Two MPs asked whether the Kameraadschap Noord-Nederland demonstrations against an asylum centre were legally notified, whether masked participants can be restricted, and whether they can be asked for ID. The minister answered that the group is extreme-right, that Oldambt required notice for one demonstration, that the mayor could impose mask bans and issued an emergency order, and that police may request ID when there is a good reason.

This emergency order requires demonstrators wearing face-covering clothing in Winschoten to keep away from, or be removed on first police instruction from, the gathering before, during and after the event, until 23.00.

In dit noodbevel is voorzien in een verplichting voor demonstranten met gezichtsbedekkende kleding die zich in Winschoten bevinden om zich voor, tijdens en na de bijeenkomst op eerste aanzegging van de politie verwijderd te houden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over geweld in het amateurvoetbal

Two MPs asked whether violence in amateur football is increasing and what the government will do about it. The minister answered that police and KNVB figures show no clear upward trend, that incidents still occur, and that the safer sports action plan will be continued with added support for at-risk clubs.
On the basis of the available figures, there is so far no sign of an increase in violence in amateur football.
Op basis van de beschikbare cijfers lijkt van een stijging van geweld in het amateurvoetbal vooralsnog geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Noodtoestand in Amerikaans ziekenhuis wegens ransomware’ (een chantagemethode op internet)

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked whether a ransomware-driven emergency like the US hospital case could happen in the Netherlands and what safeguards exist for hospital IT. The minister answers that no such emergency is known, that information security is the hospitals' own responsibility under existing NEN norms, and points to breach notification duties, IGZ outreach, and planned NIS directive and Z-CERT measures, but declines to commit to mandatory IT testing.
Information security is the hospital's own responsibility.
Informatiebeveiliging is een eigen verantwoordelijkheid van ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de rechtszaak over hoge ontruimingskosten is gestopt

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that a disciplinary case over high eviction costs by bailiffs was withdrawn, and whether unnecessary costs will be prevented and refunded. The minister replied that the disciplinary ruling is now final, that bailiffs must assess case by case whether a second notice is necessary, and that the KBvG will issue guidance and reminders to members, but refused to decide individual cost disputes.
It is not for me, nor for the KBvG, to determine in individual cases whether costs were unnecessarily incurred.
Het is niet aan mij, noch aan de KBvG om in individuele gevallen te bepalen of kosten onnodig gemaakt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over een mishandeling van een lesbisch stel in Groningen

The MP asks the Justice Minister about a violent assault on a lesbian couple in Groningen, the role of Roze in Blauw police teams, and how to tackle anti-gay harassment and under-reporting. The minister condemns the incident, says the mayor's contact with victims is a municipal matter, reports 19 sexual-orientation complaints to the Groningen discrimination reporting point in 2015, and commits to continued campaigns to raise reporting willingness.
Information on police reports of discrimination will be provided to the House of Representatives through the national police discrimination figures report, expected before the summer.

Over de aangiften bij de politie wordt de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd via de landelijke politierapportage over discriminatiecijfers, die naar verwachting voor de zomer aan de Tweede Kamer zal worden gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over de Nationale Reddingsvloot

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about financing for the National Rescue Fleet (Reddingsbrigade Nederland) after 2016 and whether safety regions had diverted funds. The minister replied that he urged the Security Council to find a funding solution, that safety regions are responsible for water rescue capacity, and that a one-off 2016 contribution was granted while talks continue.
I have invited the Security Council to consult on this before the end of May.
Ik heb het Veiligheidsberaad uitgenodigd om hierover voor eind mei in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Geurts over de Nationale Reddingvloot

MPs Van Toorenburg and Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Reddingsbrigade Nederland's rescue fleet may be dismantled over unresolved funding after 2016. The minister answered that safety regions are responsible for water rescue capacity, that a one-off 2016 contribution was given, and that he urged the Veiligheidsberaad to reach structural arrangements before end of May.
It is the responsibility of the safety regions to provide sufficient rescue capacity during crises and disasters on and around water.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de veiligheidsregio’s om te voorzien in voldoende hulpverleningscapaciteit bij crises en rampen op en rond het water.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Van Oosten over moleculaire drugs die niet onder de Opiumwet vallen

MPs Ziengs and Van Oosten (VVD) asked about reports that new molecular drugs fall outside the Opium Act, the online trade in such drugs, and related research. The state secretary answered that existing procedures (CAM, EMCDDA, WHO risk assessments) can place substances under the Opium Act, that current enforcement against online drug trade is adequate, and that pending WODC and Trimbos studies will be sent to parliament.
I consider the current effort adequate.
Ik acht de huidige inzet afdoende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over dumping van drugsafval in Gelderland

ChristenUnie MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about the rise in illegal drug-waste dumping in Gelderland, including the cost-sharing fund, dumping figures, offender liability and cooperation with provinces. The government answered that it had not contacted Gelderland, that dumping appears to shift from Brabant toward neighbouring provinces, that a 1 million euro cofinancing fund covers all provinces with a review due by 1 September, and that it will not change its drug enforcement approach.
The total subsidy requested remains well below the available amount of 1 million euros, and the number of applications is also smaller than expected.
Het totaal aan gevraagde subsidie blijft ruim onder het beschikbare bedrag van € 1 miljoen en ook het aantal aanvragen is kleiner dan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Merkies over de onthulling in de Panama Papers dat een Rotterdams notariskantoor mee heeft gewerkt aan dubieuze financiële constructies

MPs Van Nispen and Merkies asked whether a Rotterdam notary firm helping set up dubious financial structures, revealed by the Panama Papers, breached notarial duties and whether investigation is warranted. The Minister said he awaits the outcome of an investigation by the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, which the firm itself reported, and sees no reason yet for broader inquiry into Dutch notaries and lawyers, while stating that helping move money out of the tax authorities' view is not a notary's task and is criminal.
Pending the outcome of that, I refrain from judging the situation and for now see no reason to launch broader investigation into Dutch lawyers and notaries.

In afwachting van de resultaten hiervan onthoud ik mij van een oordeel over de situatie en zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding om een breder onderzoek naar Nederlandse advocaten en notarissen in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een jager die ongeboren reekalfjes uit moeder snijdt

An MP asked whether a certified hunter who shot a pregnant roe doe and removed the unborn fawns should be prosecuted, and whether a general ban on shooting protected animals during gestation is planned. The State Secretary answered that the shooting was lawful under a provincial exemption within the permitted February-March season, no report was drawn up, and no general ban is planned, while acknowledging that shooting suckling does is undesirable.

Inquiries with the national police and the Faunabeheereenheid Noord-Brabant showed there was no poaching, but that the roe doe was shot by a certified hunter acting in accordance with the conditions of the exemption granted by the Noord-Brabant provincial executive.

Uit navraag bij de Nationale politie en de Faunabeheereenheid Noord-Brabant, is gebleken dat hier geen sprake is van stroperij, maar dat de reegeit is geschoten door een gecertificeerde jager die conform de voorwaarden uit de door gedeputeerde staten van Noord-Brabant verleende ontheffing heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over het privacybeleid bij de gemeente Amsterdam

MPs Oosenbrug and Fokke asked the ministers about a report finding that privacy of Amsterdam citizens was not adequately protected, including unauthorised staff access, unsecured email and non-anonymised data use. The minister answered that such access is unacceptable, that municipalities are themselves responsible for privacy compliance, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens rather than the ministries supervises, and that support and campaigns are ongoing.
Information on this is not systematically collected by the ministries of Justice and Security or of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Informatie hierover wordt niet systematisch verzameld door de ministeries van Veiligheid en Justitie of Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Koser Kaya over het bericht ‘Wetgeving hoeft niet te worden veranderd om voor levenloos geboren kinderen een geboorteakte op te maken’

Two D66 MPs asked whether stillborn children can be registered and whether parents are informed of the option to receive a birth record, and whether a national register is possible. The ministers answered that a death-register record is made under art. 1:19i BW without a gestation minimum, that such children are not entered in the BRP, that the minister will study registration options and report before summer, and that the government has improved information for parents.
I would point out that the record of a stillborn child is kept in the civil registers and is therefore findable and consultable.
Ik wil erop wijzen dat de akte van een levenloos geboren kind wordt bewaard in de registers van de burgerlijke stand en daardoor vindbaar en raadpleegbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het misbruik van privégegevens door apps

An MP asked the ministers whether apps such as Facebook and Tinder violate privacy rules by sharing sensitive health data and by relying on broad user consent via terms and conditions. The minister declined to judge specific conduct, which he left to the Autoriteit persoonsgegevens, but stated that existing law (Wbp art. 16) already protects health data and that users bear some responsibility for consenting to terms.
It therefore does not befit me to pass judgment on whether Facebook and Tinder are violating the applicable regulations.
Het past mij dan ook niet een oordeel uit te spreken over de vraag of Facebook en Tinder de geldende regelgeving schenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de mogelijkheden de transparantie te vergroten bij rechterlijke zaakstoedeling

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about the lack of transparency in how courts assign cases to individual judges and whether objective, publicly known criteria will be introduced. The minister agreed the current differentiated system is vulnerable and open to improvement, pointing to the Code zaakstoedeling and digitalisation programmes (KEI and Taskforce OM-ZM) expected to be completed in 2016-2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht “Wie is wie in de Amsterdamse Mocro-oorlog?”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a news report on criminal violence in the Amsterdam underworld involving many suspects of Moroccan origin, and whether police information positions and the share of police officers of Moroccan origin could be improved. The minister declined to comment on ongoing investigations, said police do not record ethnicity but noted the importance of intelligence and diversity programmes, and stated that promotion depends on several competencies, not seniority alone.
Since the question is directed at ongoing investigation, I cannot make further substantive statements about it.
Nu de vraagstelling gericht is op lopend onderzoek, kan ik hier geen verdere inhoudelijke uitspraken over doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels en Van Veldhoven over de militaire beveiliging van Belgische kerncentrales en het oordeel van de Hoge Gezondheidsraad dat België onvoldoende is voorbereid op een kernramp

Two D66 MPs asked whether Belgian nuclear plants guarded by the army reflect a terrorist threat, whether the Netherlands faces similar risks, and how the Belgian Health Council's finding of inadequate nuclear emergency preparedness affects Dutch policy. The minister answered that no concrete threat information underlies the Belgian measures, that Dutch nuclear security is standard and in line with law, and that the Council's findings do not change the risk picture; the OVV is still considering an investigation.
No substantive information is given on specific security measures, including whether or when military personnel are deployed.
Over specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen worden verder geen inhoudelijke mededelingen gedaan, dat geldt ook voor het moment waarop al dan niet militairen worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de zwakke beveiliging van de Nederlandse kerncentrales tegen terrorisme

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the weak protection of Dutch nuclear power plants against terrorism, with only unarmed guards, is acceptable, and whether the government will follow US experts' advice to station armed teams on site. The minister answered that protection meets national and international rules, threat levels are monitored, no concrete threat information exists, and the government will not change its approach without concrete threat intelligence.
No substantive information is provided about specific security measures.
Over specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen worden verder geen inhoudelijke mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht 'Verdachte weddenschappen bij NEC-Willem II'

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about reported suspicious betting around NEC-Willem II, how the KNVB, OM and European partners share information on match-fixing, and how reports can be made. The ministers describe existing platforms, EU cooperation, reporting channels and say the OM does not disclose whether it investigates specific cases.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de politie het vaakst te laat komt in Rijnwaarden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police response times differ widely between municipalities, such as Rijnwaarden, and whether vehicle cuts and station closures worsen policing there. The Minister said the police now measure response times, that national performance has improved to 85%, that more resources would be needed to meet the norm everywhere, and that vehicle cuts and station closures would not reduce service, while promising an analysis of lagging areas.
I will ask the chief of police to conduct a closer analysis of the specific areas, such as Rijnwaarden, where performance is substantially lower than the national average.
Ik zal de korpschef vragen een nadere analyse van de specifieke gebieden, zoals Rijnwaarden, waar de prestaties substantieel lager zijn dan het landelijk gemiddelde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over nepwapens

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about replica firearms that look like real guns and the police response they trigger. The State Secretary answered that police seized 125 and 140 such items in 2014 and 2015, that the Toy Directive limits national options, and that current airsoft rules are considered adequate, without committing to new measures.
I do not consider it appropriate to call the Toy Directive into question.
Ik acht het niet aan de orde om de Speelgoedrichtlijn ter discussie stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over politiebezoek na een tweet over juichende leerlingen vanwege aanslagen België (Herdruk)

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether police visits to a Breda resident after a tweet about students cheering the Brussels attacks were intimidating, what the police meant by a quoted remark, and what the government thought of cheering students. The minister said wijkagents may judge such conversations part of normal policing under local authority responsibility, that the quoted remark was not used by police, and that teachers should be equipped to handle such reactions.
I therefore see no reason to change the police's approach on this point.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om de werkwijze van de politie op dit punt te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de politie die het onderspit delft tegen zware criminaliteit

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and prosecution capacity in the south of the Netherlands should be increased in response to organised crime, and whether official crime statistics give a realistic picture. The Minister points to existing measures and a EUR 3 million budget for the south, says a WODC study on online crime is underway, and says statistics are a realistic picture while noting that some crime is not registered.
Dismantling the criminal industry is not an easy task. It requires our full attention.
Het afbreken van de criminele industrie is geen makkelijke opgave. Het vereist onze volle aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over “de onwil bij OM en FIOD om frauderende franchisegevers aan te pakken”

MP Mei Li Vos asked whether prosecutors and the FIOD are failing to pursue franchisors who defraud franchisees by reporting widely varying inventory valuations, and whether the Dutch fraud law or the Franchise Code can be used against them. The minister replied that each complaint is assessed individually on criminal liability, provability and expediency, that no separate registration exists for franchise fraud, that the acquisition-fraud bill offers civil and criminal routes, and that the Franchise Code is a self-regulatory instrument rather than a government enforcement tool.
The Public Prosecution Service's registration systems do not separately record the classification 'franchise fraud' or 'inventory valuation fraud'.
In de registratiesystemen van het Openbaar Ministerie wordt niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd op de classificatie «franchisefraude» of «inboedeltaxatiefraude».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat te hard rijden in Frankrijk je een rijverbod kan opleveren en antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake geflitste buitenlandse bestuurders

An MP asks whether French points-based licence penalties for speeding would affect Dutch drivers, and asks follow-up questions on enforcement of cross-border traffic fines, parking fee collection and access to flash photos. The minister answers that the French system only applies to CBE offences, does not strip Dutch licences, and that enforcement gaps and data retention questions are being addressed through technical changes and ongoing procedures.
The system does not infringe on the Netherlands' competence to conduct road safety policy for its own territory.
Het systeem maakt geen inbreuk op de bevoegdheid van Nederland om een verkeersveiligheidsbeleid voor het eigen grondgebied te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de zware mishandeling van knobbelzwanen door jagers

An MP asked the government how it would respond to a broadcast showing hunters seriously mistreating wounded mute swans, why police did not act on complaints, and whether it would ban swan hunting and hagel shot. The state secretary said police checked hunting requirements and that a criminal investigation into possible mistreatment is being considered, but declined to say more, and defended provincial discretion on swan culling without committing to a ban.
Regarding possible criminal offences, such as mistreatment, it is currently being considered whether a criminal investigation should be launched.
Ten aanzien van eventuele strafbare feiten, zoals mishandeling, wordt op dit moment bezien of een strafrechtelijk onderzoek moet worden ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin van Dijk over de privacyschending door ziekenhuizen

MPs Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked the ministers whether hospitals' outsourcing of scanning patient files to Belgian prisoners, and the resulting privacy breaches reported by Omroep Max, were acceptable and what action would be taken. Minister Schippers answered that the situation is undesirable, that a national investigation into hospital data-security practice will be reported by end 2016, and that the Dutch Data Protection Authority is investigating, while stressing its independence and enforcement priorities.
As indicated, I find the situation undesirable and not discreetly handling patient data unacceptable.
Zoals aangegeven vind ik de situatie onwenselijk en het niet discreet omgaan met patiëntgegevens niet acceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over de aanbesteding voor nieuwe politieauto’s

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked whether the police tender for new patrol cars requiring diesel engines and a 140 g/km CO2 limit, and lacking further climate criteria, is consistent with air quality and sustainable procurement goals. The government answered that the diesel requirement will be dropped from the final programme of requirements, that the police are considering sustainability criteria, and that fiscal incentives (BPM and MRB exemptions) make diesel economically attractive for high-mileage vehicles.
However, this requirement will be dropped and will therefore not form part of the final programme of requirements.
Deze eis zal echter worden geschrapt en zal dus geen onderdeel uitmaken van het definitief programma van eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de gemeentelijke BOA de rol van de agent overneemt

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers whether municipal enforcement officers (BOAs) are taking over police tasks, whether weapons and assaults on BOAs are a concern, and about neighbourhood watch groups. The minister replied that BOAs take over no police tasks, that the police remain primarily responsible for public order, and that the issues raised are local matters or outside the government's direct remit, while committing to further consultation and to answer questions before the police debate.
Municipal enforcement officers (BOAs) take over no tasks from the police.
Gemeentelijke Buitengewoon Opsporingsambtenaren (hierna: boa's) nemen geen taken over van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Gesthuizen over de samenwerking tussen het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en Belastingdienst in ontnemingskwesties

MPs Van Nispen and Gesthuizen asked why cooperation between the Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the Tax Authority on confiscating criminal assets was so weak for eighteen years and why the AAFD protocol came only in 2015. The minister replied that cooperation does exist, that the protocol is not a dead letter, and that the Prosecution Service and Tax Authority will tighten the rules and the Lower House will be informed later.
Following the recommendations of the Investigation Committee, the College of Procurators-General is revising the Aanwijzing and Instructie on asset confiscation.
Naar aanleiding van de aanbevelingen van de Onderzoekscommissie herziet het College van procureurs-generaal de Aanwijzing en de Instructie afpakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over de onafhankelijkheid van deurwaarders en de verwevenheid met incassobureaus

SP MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked the Minister of Justice about the independence of bailiffs (gerechtsdeurwaarders) and their ties to debt-collection agencies, including the role of legal insurer DAS and the use of 'incasso & gerechtsdeurwaarders' branding. The minister replied that the 49% third-party stake cap and participation ban in the current KBvG regulation adequately protect independence, that enforcement of these rules rests mainly with the KBvG and disciplinary court, and that misuse of the bailiff title will be addressed through the new register and criminal complaints.
It is primarily up to the KBvG to give form to independence in professional practice through its regulatory power.
Het is primair aan de KBvG om de onafhankelijkheid in de beroepspraktijk vorm te geven met haar verordenende bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over bedreigingen van raadsleden

An MP asked the ministers about threats against municipal councillors, the reporting rate to police, and whether police take such complaints seriously. The minister answered that survey figures are not directly comparable, that police treat these complaints seriously under national agreements, and that most recommendations of the Periklesinstituut are already being implemented or will be pursued with associations.
The police take these reports extremely seriously.
De politie neemt deze aangiften uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Karabulut over het bericht ‘Uitgehuwelijkt: ‘Teruggaan betekent mijn dood’

MPs Yücel and Karabulut asked about a report of women forced into marriage while on holiday abroad and what the government does about it. The minister says forced marriage is criminal, cites prosecution options, prevention and awareness campaigns, and an action plan, but says no hard data on the number of cases exists.
It is inherent in the nature of the problem that no hard data are available on this.
Het is inherent aan de aard van de problematiek, dat hierover geen harde gegevens beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat de overlast van verwarde personen de pan uit rijst

MPs Kooiman and Leijten (SP) asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about reports that nuisance from confused persons is rising sharply, the police figures behind it, and whether mental health care budget cuts, bed reductions, the FACT-team rollout and police capacity cuts are to blame. The minister answered that police registrations rose about 65% between 2011 and 2015 but are incident counts rather than unique persons, that no causal link to ggz cuts has been shown, and that the aanjaagteam, a regional study and a handle for insurers and municipalities are underway.
I make growth room available for curative mental health care every year and therefore do not cut.
Ik stel elk jaar groeiruimte beschikbaar voor de curatieve GGZ en bezuinig dus niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Bosman over mogelijke betrokkenheid van KPMG bij (illegale) gokpraktijken op Curaçao en Sint Maarten

MPs Van Raak and Bosman asked about reports of illegal online sports betting on Curaçao, possible links to the US market, and KPMG's alleged role auditing casino owner Francesco Corallo on Sint Maarten. The minister replied that gambling oversight is primarily a local matter for the Public Prosecution Services, pointed to a 2015 protocol and the Bientu conviction, and declined to comment on individual companies.
The gambling world and the handling of possible abuses within it is primarily a local matter.
De gokwereld en de aanpak van mogelijke misstanden daarbinnen is primair een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over een Nederlandse voormalig coffeeshopeigenaar die is veroordeeld in Thailand

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about information given to Thai authorities on the Dutch coffeeshop toleration policy, the Thai conviction of a former coffeeshop owner for laundering drug money, the prosecutor's role, and police testimony. The minister answered most questions in substance, withheld Thai and ongoing-investigation documents, and rejected the claim that the conviction exposes Dutch coffeeshop operators to prosecution.
I cannot provide any documents on this, as they are Thai documents in the Thai criminal investigation.
Ik kan eventuele stukken hierover niet verstrekken, nu dit Thaise stukken betreffen in het Thaise strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Miltenburg en Tellegen over het bericht "Asielzoekers randden 18-jarige aan tijdens stapnacht

MPs Van Miltenburg and Tellegen asked the government how it responds to reports of sexual assaults on a young woman by asylum seekers, how victims are supported and given copies of reports, and whether police register and prosecute such assaults. The minister answered that all sexual offences are condemned and pursued, victims receive support through Slachtofferhulp Nederland and forthcoming sexual violence centres, and police and prosecutors treat all reports without distinguishing by origin of offenders.
I see no reason to change this approach as a result of the events in Cologne.
Ik zie geen aanleiding deze werkwijze als gevolg van de gebeurtenissen in Keulen aan te passen.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanpak van transportcriminaliteit door de Nationale Politie (ingezonden 25 februari 2016).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about conflicting reports on cargo theft, underreporting, violence and organised roaming gangs, and whether the disbanded Landelijk Team Transportcriminaliteit left enforcement weaker. The minister answered by referring to earlier answers, denied that the team was abolished (its work continues under Team Vervoer en Transport and the Landelijke Eenheid), and described the current enforcement set-up.
It is a misunderstanding that the Landelijk Team Transportcriminaliteit has been abolished.
Het is een misverstand dat het Landelijk Team Transportcriminaliteit is opgeheven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de koppositie van Nederland in transportcriminaliteit

An MP asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about the Netherlands' leading position in cargo theft, citing a TAPA report showing high figures and falling reporting willingness. The Minister answered that police figures show a 20 percent drop in cargo theft from 2014 to 2015, explained differences with TAPA's methodology, outlined reporting facilitation, enforcement cooperation, secured truck parking efforts and cross-border cooperation, while defending ANPR camera use.
Based on the reported figures for 2014 and 2015, it can be stated that the number of cargo thefts in the Netherlands has decreased by 20 percent.
Afgaande op de aangiftecijfers van 2014 en 2015 kan worden gesteld dat het aantal ladingdiefstallen in Nederland met 20 procent is afgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over oerwoudgeluiden bij Harkemase boys

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked about racist shouting by a supporter toward a dark-skinned player at an amateur football match, whether such incidents are frequent, and what the Safe Sport programme does to prevent them. The minister condemned the behaviour, said no figures exist on amateur incidents, pointed to reporting channels, and described the KNVB-HALT action plan and monitoring results showing reduced feelings of insecurity.
No figures are available on how often incidents of this kind occur on amateur football pitches.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal keer dat incidenten van deze aard plaatsvinden op het amateurveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over wangedrag van zichzelf voetbalsupporter noemende Nederlanders in Madrid

MPs asked how the government views Dutch football supporters' misconduct in Madrid, whether mayors can impose liberty-restricting measures under article 172a of the Municipalities Act for racist behaviour, and when the new football-violence law takes effect. The minister said Spanish authorities lead, the club has issued stadium bans, mayors decide on individual measures, and the law has applied since 1 July 2015, extending the available powers.
It is up to the mayor of the municipality from which a person originates to determine whether there is cause to impose a measure under the Municipalities Act.
Het is aan de burgemeester van de gemeente waaruit een persoon afkomstig is om te bepalen of er aanleiding is om een maatregel op grond van de Gemeentewet op te leggen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de benoeming van de topambtenaar die zich op het Ministerie bezig hield met de Raad van State tot staatsraad

An SP MP asked whether the senior official who handled the Council of State reform bill was appointed to the Council of State shortly afterwards, and whether this created a conflict of interest. The Minister answered that the appointment followed standard procedure, that the bill was only at the nader rapport stage when the appointment was made, and that there is no conflict of interest.
There is no question of an appearance of conflict of interest or a dubious transfer.
Van schijn van belangenverstrengeling en een dubieuze overstap is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het antisemitische motief van een extreem gewelddadige overval

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a violent robbery of an elderly Jewish couple with alleged antisemitic motive, including whether the Public Prosecution Service withheld the antisemitic aspect from a TV appeal. The minister said the investigation covers all aspects including discrimination, declined to discuss ongoing investigative details, explained that appeal content was limited to verified information, and listed prevention measures against antisemitism without addressing the withholding question substantively.
Since this is an ongoing investigation, I cannot provide further information on the content of the investigation.
Aangezien het een lopend onderzoek betreft kan ik over de inhoud van het onderzoek geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Ziekteverzuim onder politieagenten explodeert’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that sick leave among police officers was surging, including the figures, a split between operational and support staff, progress on sick-leave files, the reasons for absence, and whether an in-depth study of causes would be commissioned. The minister gave the figures, said the Wet verbetering Poortwachter compliance target is 80% by end 2017 with some older files no longer fixable, and declined a separate study, pointing to a letter on causes instead.
In connection with privacy legislation, medical data are only queried and documented in the medical file by those authorised to do so, namely the company doctor and the psychologist.

In verband met de privacywetgeving worden medische gegevens uitsluitend bevraagd en gedocumenteerd in het medisch dossier door degene die daartoe bevoegd zijn, zijnde de bedrijfsarts en de psycholoog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht ‘Ziekteverzuim onder politieagenten explodeert’

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he would respond to reports that sick leave among police officers is surging, what he would do to reduce it, and whether he agreed that uncertainty over reassignment drives absence and that the 2014 task force had not worked. The minister referred to a separate letter to parliament on sick leave and measures, acknowledged that workforce reorganisation may be one explanatory factor, and rejected the claim that the task force had failed, citing over 1,800 long-term absence cases closed.
Simultaneously with answering these parliamentary questions, I am informing your House by letter about the development of sick leave and the measures the police are taking to reduce it.
Gelijktijdig met de beantwoording van deze Kamervragen, informeer ik uw Kamer bij brief over de ontwikkeling van het ziekteverzuim en de maatregelen die de politie neemt om dit terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Werkdruk leidt tot ontsporen van crimefighter’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reported work pressure leading to misconduct by a prosecutor, the NVvR's call to invest in the Public Prosecution Service, support available to prosecutors, threats against local officials, and the status of a criminal investigation into the prosecutor. The minister replied that work pressure is not directly linked to budget cuts, pointed to existing support and new structural funding, said the criminal investigation is ongoing and declined to give details of its status, and committed to a careful assessment of prosecution.
I cannot give you any information about the status of the criminal investigation.
Over de stand van zaken van het opsporingsonderzoek kan ik u geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat elk jaar duizenden uitspraken van de rechter waardeloos zijn

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether an estimated 100,000 civil court judgments go unenforced each year, and whether non-compliance should be registered or sampled so citizens can weigh whether litigation is worthwhile. The minister answered that no registration exists or is planned, since enforcement is the creditor's own responsibility, and pointed to a 2009 WODC study and the new central attachment register and creditor-debtor signalling tools as alternatives.
I do not intend to start keeping a registration.
Ik ben niet voornemens een registratie bij te gaan houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over samenwerkingsverbanden tussen notarissen en niet-notarissen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the KNB's Interdisciplinary Cooperation regulation (IDS 2015) and cooperation between notaries and non-notaries, including the Hema notary and the Nationale Notaris case, and about oversight by the BFT. The minister said the regulation is under review for legality and public interest, that the KNB must provide input, and that full answers will follow in writing later.
I therefore cannot provide you with adequate answers at this time and will inform you later in writing, explicitly addressing the questions posed.
Ik kan u daarom op dit moment niet van adequate antwoorden voorzien en zal u later schriftelijk informeren, waarbij expliciet ingegaan zal worden op de gestelde vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Keijzer over het onderzoek inzake de kunstroof in het Westfries Museum in Hoorn

Two Christian Democrat MPs asked why Ukraine appears not to take the Hoorn museum art theft investigation seriously, including questions about unheard suspects and the Ukrainian security service's role. The Ministers answered that Ukraine is conducting a criminal investigation, that the Netherlands cannot comment on an ongoing prosecution, and that cooperation is satisfactory, while declining to share case progress details with Parliament.
Since this concerns an ongoing criminal investigation, no statements about it will be made to the House.
Gezien het een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek betreft, worden hierover geen mededelingen aan de Kamer gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de onderzoeken naar de vliegramp bij Faro en de mogelijke heropening van dat onderzoek door de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV)

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked whether new facts justify asking the OVV to reopen the Faro air disaster investigation, and why the Netherlands seeks reopening of the Portuguese report, with questions on confidentiality, expert access to documents, and maintenance responsibility. The State Secretary answered that the OVV was asked to assess new relevant facts, that the Portuguese authority alone can reopen the investigation, that ICAO rules restrict disclosure of records, and that the aircraft was found airworthy and maintenance-deferral records remain unverified.
I have not asked the OVV to reopen the Portuguese investigation.
Ik heb de OVV niet gevraagd het Portugese onderzoek te heropenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Swinkels over de World Check databank

MP Swinkels asked the Justice and Security Minister about the World-Check database, the doubling of the national terrorism list and whether Dutch banks and agencies use the database without safeguards. The minister answered that World-Check is a commercial database of open-source data covering several crime types, that Dutch financial institutions use it for know-your-customer checks, and that the list expansion follows government policy, though no direct link exists between the two databases.
There is, however, no link between the doubling of the number of individuals on the National Terrorism List and the existence of the World-Check database.
Er is echter geen verband tussen de verdubbeling van het aantal individuen op de Nationale Terrorismelijst en het bestaan van de World-Check databank.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders, Van Dekken en Recourt over wildstroperij

MPs Leenders, Van Dekken and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the safety of green BOA enforcement officers fighting poaching, their training, the lack of separate registration of poaching, equipment, and police capacity. The minister answered that deployment is the responsibility of private employers and local triangles, that poaching is not a separate offence so is not registered, that equipment can be granted on justified request, and that a provincial coordination platform is being set up.
Poaching is not a separately defined criminal offence in law, so separate registration is not possible.
Wildstroperij is geen afzonderlijk in de wet opgenomen strafbaar feit, waardoor aparte registratie niet mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het gratieverzoek van een Nederlands staatsburger gedetineerd in een Amerikaanse gevangenis

The MP asks whether the government has supported a clemency request on humanitarian grounds for a Dutch national detained in a US prison, whether that request has been filed, and whether the Prime Minister discussed it with the Californian governor. The government answers that it has repeatedly expressed Dutch support for both the parole and clemency requests, including via the ambassador and a Prime Minister letter, and declines to speculate on the timing of the US decision.
I do not want to speculate on the answer to the question of when the American authorities will decide on the requests of Mr. S.
Ik wil niet speculeren over het antwoord op de vraag wanneer de Amerikaanse autoriteiten gaan beslissen op de verzoeken van de heer S.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over 117 medewerkers bij het Openbaar Ministerie die berispt of ontslagen zijn na fouten

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why figures on 117 Public Prosecution Service staff reprimanded or dismissed for misconduct only emerged after FOIA requests, and whether reporting, screening and disciplinary standards would be improved. The Minister answered that the OM reports integrity cases annually, that it will now publish the anonymised half-yearly overviews each year, and that screening and whistleblowing channels exist, while declining to break down cases by sex, ethnicity, function or pay scale to protect privacy.
The OM will in future annually and actively publish the BI-OM overviews in addition to the annual report.
Het OM zal in het vervolg jaarlijks in aanvulling op het jaarbericht de BI-OM-overzichten actief publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over een aanbesteding van software

MP Oosenbrug asks about the EASP2015 software tender won by Protinus IT and Comparex, including its strategic importance, whether the winners' lack of open-source references and fraud reporting was weighed, how vendor dependence and open-source preference are protected, how oversight will be exercised, and how this fits earlier parliamentary motions. The minister answers that the tender is coordinated by VenJ with open-source use built in, that exclusion on the reported fraud was not legally possible in advance, and that oversight runs through departmental contract management with periodic overviews.
Under procurement law it is not possible to exclude a bidder in advance on the basis of the attached media reports.
Aanbestedingsrechtelijk is het niet mogelijk om op basis van bijgevoegde berichtgeving vooraf een inschrijver uit te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over een nazistisch “pamflet” dat aan moskeeën in Nederland is gestuurd

An MP asked the ministers whether they knew of a Nazi-themed pamphlet with anti-Islam text sent to many mosques, how many mosques received it, and what was being done about its authors and the safety of mosques. The minister confirmed the pamphlet is condemnable, reported 33 mosques had filed complaints, said the OM considers it punishable and a criminal investigation is ongoing, and committed to renewed talks with mosque leaders and heightened vigilance.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot provide further information on this matter.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik hierover verder geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over het bericht 'Eritrese intimidatie in Nederland breidt zich uit'

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked about reports of intimidation of Eritrean regime critics in the Netherlands, including threats at asylum locations and whether IND interpreters are linked to the regime. The government said it has no specific registration of such incidents, pointed to police and prosecution duties, outlined vetting and a code of conduct for IND interpreters with two interpreters dropped and an external audit, and referred back to earlier answers on regime levies.
The Public Prosecution Service and the police do not specifically record in their systems the link between offences and the Eritrean regime.
Het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie registeren niet specifiek in de systemen op de relatie van delicten met het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Swinkels over het opheffen van drie onderzoeksgebieden bij het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut

MPs Van Nispen and Swinkels asked whether the NFI has stopped handling new handwriting, paint and hair comparison cases in-house and outsourced them despite earlier assurances. The Minister confirms that since 1 January 2016 these cases are outsourced to accredited external labs, with about five extra working days and an estimated cost of EUR 150 per hour, and says the NFI retains archiving and quality oversight without checking results.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Hoogland over alcoholcontroles in het verkeer

MPs Volp and Hoogland asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about alcohol checks in traffic, including how many occur at night, whether the night-time share cited by EenVandaag is correct, and whether night-time enforcement chances are lower. Minister Van der Steur answered with tables showing most checks occur in the evening and night, that the cited 10 percent figure is incorrect, that police target checks by information, and that the data cannot separate offences by check type.
The police registration does not separately record how many offences are found per check.
In de politieregistratie wordt niet apart bijgehouden hoeveel overtredingen per controle worden geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Teeven over de bewapening van politie en marechaussee

Two VVD MPs asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Defence about heavier arming of police and Royal Marechaussee in light of the terror threat, and about staffing and training. The government replied that equipment and armament are set per situation based on threat assessment, that the Marechaussee can carry out its core tasks though capacity is tight, and that extra staff is being recruited.
Should it become apparent that the performance of the Marechaussee's core tasks is at risk, the desirability and possibility of new additional measures will of course be reassessed.

Mocht blijken dat de uitvoering van de kerntaken van de Kmar in het geding komt, dan zullen de wenselijkheid en de mogelijkheid van nieuwe aanvullende maatregelen vanzelfsprekend opnieuw worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de opmerkingen van het OM over de vervolging van Julio Poch in Argentinië

MPs Sjoerdsma asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about remarks attributed to the Public Prosecution Service on the Argentine prosecution of Julio Poch, whether a fair trial was assured, and whether an independent trial observer would be sent. The minister replied that the quoted remark came from an anonymous source not identified as the Dutch prosecutor, that the Dutch state's cooperation was judged lawful by a civil court, and that the state does not interfere in foreign proceedings beyond routine consular assistance.
The Dutch State cooperated in the arrest of Mr Poch in Spain by providing information about his travel movements.
De Nederlandse Staat heeft meegewerkt aan de aanhouding van de heer Poch in Spanje door informatie te verschaffen over zijn reisbewegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Van Dekken over een slechte bereikbaarheid van 112 in de omgeving Vlagtwedde, Oost Groningen

MPs Vermue and Van Dekken asked whether 112 is poorly reachable by mobile phone around Vlagtwedde in Groningen, whether this is an exception, and what steps will be taken. The government answered that mobile reachability of 112 is good nationally, that 100% is not achievable, that supplementary tests show 99.58% success, and referred to a letter of 18 February for the status update.
100% mobile reachability of 1-1-2 is not possible.
100% mobiele bereikbaarheid van 1-1-2 is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de bijstand die verleend wordt aan Romano van der Dussen, die op 11 februari 2016 is vrijgelaten

Two CDA MPs asked how Romano van der Dussen, released from a Spanish prison in February 2016 after 12 years, will receive reintegration help, legal assistance, and progress on his case. The government replied that consular assistance, coordination with Spanish authorities and Dutch reclassering/municipal support are available, that further legal procedures are his own responsibility, and referred to earlier letters for the case history.
See my letter to your House of 17 February 2016 (TK 30 010, no. 26).
Zie mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 17 februari 2016 (TK 30 010, nr. 26 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht van de FBI ‘Health care systems and medical devices at risk for increased cyber intrusions for financial gain’

An SP MP asked ministers about an FBI warning that medical records have value for criminals, and about data security in Dutch healthcare after reports on Belgian prisoners handling patient files. Minister Schippers answered that information security is the responsibility of healthcare providers under data protection law and NEN 7510, supervised by the Dutch Data Protection Authority and the Health Inspectorate, but declined to provide figures on past data breaches.
I have no insight into the number of healthcare organisations and hospitals that have experienced problems with the security of their electronic data systems and devices over the past five years.
Ik heb geen inzicht in het aantal zorgorganisaties en ziekenhuizen dat de afgelopen vijf jaar te maken heeft gekregen met problemen in de beveiliging van hun elektronische datasystemen en apparaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de uitspraak van een gemeenteraadslid dat de Islam “weggevaagd” mag worden

Marcouch (PvdA) asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a Hague councillor's statement that Islam may be wiped away, asking whether criminal law applies, whether a complaint was filed, and whether the law on group insult should cover religion. Minister Van der Steur replied that the municipality distanced itself from polarising statements, a complaint was filed on 8 February and is being studied by the Public Prosecution Service, and that case law shows such statements may be criminal depending on circumstances, so no change to the law is needed.
A complaint was filed on 8 February, and this complaint is currently being studied by the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Op 8 februari jl. is aangifte gedaan, deze aangifte wordt momenteel door het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het vonnis van de rechtbank Amsterdam in de zaak van de HIV-patiënt die zijn eigen hennep mag telen

The MP asked the Minister of Justice about an Amsterdam court ruling acquitting an HIV patient growing his own cannabis, and whether it creates a precedent, requires changes to the Opiumwet, or shows courts undermining cannabis law. The Minister answered that the ruling is exceptional and sets no precedent, that the medicinal cannabis supply is being expanded and no legal change is needed, and that the courts must apply the law as it stands.
As the Amsterdam court itself indicated, the ruling is exceptional and applies only to this individual case, so no precedent is created.
Zoals de rechtbank Amsterdam zelf ook heeft aangegeven, is de betreffende uitspraak uitzonderlijk en alleen in dit individuele geval van toepassing en wordt er dus geen precedent geschapen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het automatisch opleggen van boetes

Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the consequences of a Court of Appeal ruling that fully automated traffic fines conflict with the Wet administratiefrechtelijke handhaving verkeersvoorschriften because no room is left to assess special circumstances, and whether RDW's system should change. The Minister answered that the Supreme Court annulled that ruling on 16 February 2016 as based on a wrong legal view, so the existing policy will not be changed.
Since the Supreme Court has annulled the judgment of the court of appeal, I see no reason to change the existing policy.
Nu de Hoge Raad het arrest van het gerechtshof heeft vernietigd, zie ik geen reden tot wijziging van het bestaande beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de doodsbedreigingen aan het adres van een anti-IS-strijder

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Justice Minister about death threats against Jitse Akse, a Dutch anti-IS fighter who is under criminal investigation, and whether the government would instruct the prosecutor to drop the case. The minister condemned threats, said protective measures are not disclosed, and stated the prosecution decision is for the Openbaar Ministerie without a directive.
The investigation by the Openbaar Ministerie into Jitse A. is still ongoing.
Het onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie naar Jitse A. loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman over de dood van een Eritrese asielzoeker

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked whether police and prosecutors would investigate the disappearance and death of an Eritrean asylum seeker, why COA and police information was not shared with German authorities, and whether a conflict with a roommate was reported. The minister replied that the German authorities handled and closed the investigation, that the COA reported a roommate dispute but no threat, that the person was moved to another room, and that the COA's notice to the EMM was not passed on under standard procedure, while promising to inform relatives if new insight arises.
The investigation into the death of the Eritrean asylum seeker, Mr. Mekonen, falls under the competence of the German authorities.
Het onderzoek naar het overlijden van de Eritrese asielzoeker, de heer Mekonen, valt onder de bevoegdheid van de Duitse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Verhoeven over het vermeende Oekraïense filmpje dat op internet is geplaatst

MPs Sjoerdsma and Verhoeven asked whether the government is aware of reports that a threatening Ukrainian video against the Netherlands was a forgery, and whether it would promptly investigate the video's origin and share the results with parliament. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that the Ukrainian government and the Azov battalion disavow the threats, and said the videos are known to Dutch investigative authorities, without committing to an investigation or disclosure.
The videos are known to the Dutch investigative authorities.
De filmpjes zijn bekend bij de Nederlandse opsporingsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht m.b.t. strafexpedities op VenJ tegen ambtenaren die misstand melden

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the position of the former integrity confidential adviser was repeatedly undermined, whether whistleblower reports were rerouted and annual reports removed, and whether staff can report confidentially to the Oosting commission. The minister denies any systematic undermining, says the reporting lines remain confidential, and refers to earlier letters on the whistleblower scheme.
The position of the former integrity and undesirable conduct confidential adviser was not repeatedly undermined in recent years.
De positie van de voormalig Vertrouwenspersoon integriteit en ongewenste omgangsvormen (VPI) is niet herhaaldelijk in het geding geweest de afgelopen jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanhoudende bedreigingen door een militie uit Oekraïne in verband met het referendum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a threatening video from a Ukrainian militia against the Dutch public in connection with the referendum is authentic, whether earlier threats were investigated, and whether security measures will be taken, including for referendum initiators. The minister answered that the Ukrainian government and the Azov battalion distance themselves from the threats, the videos are known to Dutch investigative authorities, and security measures would be taken under local authority if the threat warrants it.
The videos are known to the Dutch investigative authorities.
De filmpjes zijn bekend bij de Nederlandse opsporingsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de Franse dreiging om de content van een Nederlandse website te censureren

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether France's threat to block content of the Dutch website TPO.nl, and possible censorship, is compatible with freedom of expression and how the Netherlands would respond. The Minister answered that such requests are specific, that member states implement EU counter-radicalisation commitments under their own law, that the Netherlands uses notice-and-take-action procedures and stresses rule-of-law limits, and that the Turkish YouTube case differs because the French request is targeted and providers can go to French courts.
The specific request referred to in the TPO article came from the French authorities.
Het specifieke verzoek waaraan wordt gerefereerd in het TPO-artikel is uitgegaan van de Franse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Twee keer per dag vergeet justitie verdachte op te halen’

MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that suspects are often not transported to court hearings, with hundreds of cases where transport was never requested. The Minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service, not DV&O, requests transport, that court-data figures cannot establish causes, that adjournment costs about 87,000 euro per year, and that DJI is exploring earlier notice of the right to waive attendance.
The figures show the number of cases the Council for the Judiciary reports as adjourned because a suspect did not appear on time for the hearing.
De cijfers geven het aantal zaken weer dat volgens uitvraag van de RvdR wordt aangehouden wegens het niet tijdig verschijnen van een verdachte op de zitting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en  Bontes over het doorgaan van een bijeenkomst met een islamitische geweldsprediker

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would bar an Islamist preacher of violence from a planned gathering in Almere, in line with their motion. The Minister of Security and Justice said visa-required speakers who spread anti-integrative or anti-democratic messages are not welcome, that individual cases are assessed on their merits, that EU-national access can only be refused for a current, serious threat, and that criminal law and mayoral area bans remain available.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Veiligheid uit het oog verloren’

An MP from the PVV asks whether police capacity problems force surveillance staff into roles they are not trained for, whether recruits were misled about promotion timelines, and whether critics within the police face reprisals. The Minister replies that surveillance staff are not trained for firearm incidents, denies promises of a three-year promotion path, states the police have a handling framework for attacks and that staff have adequate room to voice concerns.
The chief of police has informed me that there is currently sufficient attention and room within the police for staff to express their views and concerns about the policy pursued.
De korpschef heeft mij laten weten dat er op dit moment binnen de politie voldoende aandacht en ruimte is voor medewerkers om hun mening en zorgen over het gevoerde beleid te uiten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gebruik van roofvogels tegen drones

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police tests using birds of prey against drones, including injuries to the birds, the criteria for deployment, and housing and training conditions. The minister answered that no birds were injured in training, that animal welfare is one aspect in the test phase, and that the birds are housed under general animal housing rules and trained without coercion.
At present the police are examining various scenarios to counter misuse of drones.
Op dit moment bekijkt de politie verschillende scenario’s om misbruik met drones tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over een opgepakte anti-IS-strijder

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the arrest and possible prosecution of a Dutch veteran who fought against IS in Syria, and why returning jihadists receive assistance while he is detained. The minister declined to comment on the individual case under investigation, described the general approach to returning jihadists, and explained that fighting IS can in principle be prosecuted under ordinary criminal law.
The investigation by the Public Prosecution Service into Jitse A. is still ongoing. I will not comment on an individual case that is still the subject of a criminal investigation.
Het onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie naar Jitse A. loopt nog. Ik ga niet in op een individuele casus die nog onderwerp is van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Swinkels over het in vreemde krijgsdienst treden

D66 MPs Pechtold and Swinkels asked whether a Dutch man arrested for fighting ISIS alongside the Kurdish YPG breaches the ban on joining foreign military service, whether the YPG is terrorist-listed, and whether the concept of 'vreemde krijgsdienst' should be revised. The Minister declined to discuss the ongoing case, said the YPG is not on Dutch, EU or UN terrorism lists, and saw no need to revise the concept, while noting a bill to allow nationality revocation for terrorist participation.
The investigation by the Public Prosecution Service into Jitse A. is still ongoing. I will not comment on an individual case that is still the subject of a criminal investigation.
Het onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie naar Jitse A. loopt nog. Ik ga niet in op een individuele casus die nog onderwerp is van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over een onderzoek naar een anti IS-strijder

An MP from the CDA asked the Justice and Defence ministers about the investigation of a Dutch citizen fighting ISIS in Syria, the handling of returning jihadist fighters, and the legal limits on private citizens fighting in armed conflict. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed in detail, described the existing criminal and administrative approach to returnees, and gave limited figures on ongoing investigations.
I cannot therefore provide any information on the state of the investigation or the powers deployed.
Over de stand van zaken van het onderzoek en de ingezette bevoegdheden kan ik daarom geen mededeling doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Omtzigt, De Roon, Sjoerdsma en Bontes over het rondetafelgesprek van 22 januari 2016 over de beleidsreactie onderzoeksrapporten over MH17

MPs asked the government to reflect on the January 2016 round-table discussion on prosecution of the MH17 downing, including suggestions on a possible Dutch-Russian tribunal, the interpretation of article 552y of the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure, and victims' relatives' rights in proceedings. The government answered that it keeps both national and international prosecution options open pending the criminal investigation, acknowledges that article 552y should be amended (a bill is with the Council of State), and will consider the concerns raised about relatives' participation.
Should there be a need to speed up the legislative process with a view to possible prosecution of offences related to the downing of MH17, the available options will be used.

Mocht er met het oog op de eventuele berechting van misdrijven gerelateerd aan het neerhalen van MH17 behoefte zijn om het wetgevingsproces te versnellen zullen de beschikbare mogelijkheden daartoe aangegrepen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over racistische uitingen van de supporters van ADO Den Haag tijdens de wedstrijd tegen Ajax

MPs Kuzu and others asked ministers about racist chants by ADO Den Haag supporters against Ajax players and whether the government would act, including on investigation, prosecution and the KNVB's handling of such incidents. The government replied that clubs, KNVB and Eredivisie CV agreed to act faster against offensive chants, that prosecution is considered in provable cases, and that existing monitoring and action plans are sufficient, declining new investigations.
Professional football clubs, the KNVB and Eredivisie CV have agreed to act faster and more firmly against offensive chants in football.
Betaald voetbalclubs, KNVB en Eredivisie CV hebben afgesproken sneller en kordater op te treden tegen scheldkoren in het voetbal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over het aanvallen van een scheidsrechter door spelers van de voetbalclub Nieuw Sloten

Two MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers whether a complaint had been filed over football players of Nieuw Sloten attacking a referee, whether the Public Prosecution Service would prosecute, and whether the KNVB was investigating. The minister answered that no complaint was filed, the OM decided not to prosecute given the seriousness, the referee's wish not to file, and the club withdrawing the team, and that the KNVB disciplinary investigation is ongoing with players suspended.
The Public Prosecution Service decided not to prosecute ex officio, given the seriousness of what occurred.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft besloten niet ambtshalve tot vervolging over te gaan, vanwege de ernst van hetgeen dat is voorgevallen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over drugsafval in landbouwakkers

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about drug waste dumped in farmland and gierkelders, including health risks, soil contamination, cost of cleanup, and enforcement capacity. The minister answered that detected amphetamine/MDMA levels pose no health danger, that no evidence yet shows dumping at other farms, that cleanup costs fall on polluters or landowners with a €1 million annual national fund for provinces, and that Intensivering Zuid strengthens anti-drug enforcement in Brabant.
Strong efforts are therefore being made to combat drug crime and the dumping of drug waste.
Er wordt dan ook stevig ingezet op het bestrijden van drugscriminaliteit en dumping van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de signalen dat DNA-onderzoeken door het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut (NFI) zijn vertraagd

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why about 250 DNA investigations at the Netherlands Forensic Institute were delayed, whether the delays exceed three months, and how workload, sick leave, reorganisation and budget cuts will be addressed. The Minister attributes the delays to combined factors such as MH17 work, sick leave, reorganisation and year-end inflow, reports the backlog reduced to 74 cases, announces temporary extra capacity and €5 million extra budget, and commits to sending the triennial forensic signalering to parliament before the summer recess and to a study of management culture at the NFI.
Only after completion will I send the triennial signalering to the House.
Eerst na afronding zal ik de driejaarlijks signalering aan de Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Weer een veiligheidslek politiesysteem C2000’
