An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the police C2000 radio system can be detected by devices (Target Blue Eye) that reveal nearby police vehicles, and what would be done. The minister answered that the detection capability has been known since 2013, that the police account for it in their working methods, and that he will examine whether legal measures could help, while noting a ban would have limited effect and enforceability questions.
Nevertheless, I will examine whether possible legal measures could support an effective and unhindered performance of the tasks of the police and other emergency services.
Niettemin zal ik onderzoeken of eventuele juridische maatregelen ondersteunend kunnen zijn aan een doelmatige en ongehinderde uitvoering van de taken van de politie en andere hulpverleningsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de benoeming van de voorzitter van Regionale Toetsingscommissies Euthanasie

MP Dik-Faber asked whether former NVVE chair Jacob Kohnstamm's appointment as coordinating chair of the Regional Euthanasia Review Committees was procedurally sound and whether his past role at a pro-euthanasia advocacy group compromised impartiality, and whether doctors' pressure linked to NVVE activities should be addressed. The ministers answered that the procedure followed a joint nomination by the committee chairs with published profile and selection steps, that Kohnstamm's past NVVE chairmanship is not an obstacle given the committee's role, and that they will not require him to resign from NVVE membership.
The chairs of the RTEs stated in their nomination that Mr Kohnstamm shows a keen awareness of the impartial position and role of the coordinating chair and the RTEs.
De voorzitters van de RTE's hebben in hun voordracht aangegeven dat de heer Kohnstamm blijk geeft van een scherp zicht op de onpartijdige positie en rol van de coördinerend voorzitter en de RTE's.

Vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de Ministers van Financiën, van Veiligheid en Justitie, de Staatssecretaris van Financiën en de Minister van Defensie over de rapporten van de auditdienst rijk (inge

MPs Ronnes and Omtzigt asked several ministers about Auditdienst Rijk reports, including the 2015 list of reports, late submission of audits, and six promised investigations. The Minister of Justice and Security answered by releasing findings on Justice department audits (procurement, bookkeeping, prison and staffing matters) publicly and sending one report confidentially because of business security concerns.
Publication is not desired because of the business security of the government service.
Openbaarmaking is niet gewenst vanwege de bedrijfsveiligheid van de Rijksdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht 'Onderzoek naar moord in gedrang volgens hoofdofficier justitie Breda'

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the Breda public prosecution service might stop investigating difficult murder cases due to capacity constraints and budget cuts. The Minister replied that no investigation is being stopped, that prioritisation is an ordinary part of operational decisions, and that budgets for the prosecution service are being increased.
The chief public prosecutor does not say in the interview that he is stopping difficult investigations into liquidations.
De hoofdofficier zegt in het interview niet dat hij stopt met lastige opsporingsonderzoeken naar liquidaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van der Burg over sexting

MPs Van Oosten and Van der Burg asked the Minister of Security and Justice about sexting, police and prosecution policy on sexual images of minors, and whether current prevention is adequate. The minister answered that case-by-case judgment applies under the existing child pornography law, that the framework allows enough room for tailored prosecution, and that a review of more tailored sentencing for juvenile offenders is planned, while listing existing awareness campaigns.
According to all organisations in the criminal justice chain, the current legal framework on child pornography offers sufficient room for tailored prosecution.
Volgens alle organisaties in de strafrechtketen biedt het huidige wettelijk kader met betrekking tot kinderpornografie voldoende ruimte voor maatwerk bij de vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over dat de politie te weinig leert van klachten die worden ingediend door burgers

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the Justice Minister why nearly 3,000 of 10,898 citizen complaints against police in 2014 were not handled and why the police learn too little from complaints. The minister explains many unhandled complaints were misdirected or registered as received, points to measures already taken, and declines further investigation or an apology.
There can be various reasons why a complaint was not taken up in the complaints procedure or is still open at year-end.
Er kunnen diverse redenen zijn waarom een klacht niet in de klachtenprocedure in behandeling is genomen of aan het eind van het jaar nog open staat voor behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat een bisschop misbruik volgens het Vaticaan niet per se hoeft te melden

An MP asked ministers whether a Vatican document saying new bishops need not always report child abuse allegations was acceptable, and whether they would seek clarification from the Dutch bishops' conference. The minister called the statement incorrect and unwise, explained it stemmed from a misunderstanding in a training course that will be corrected, and declined a meeting because the Dutch bishops confirmed that reporting to the prosecutor is required.
Accusations of child abuse must be reported and a police report must be filed.
Beschuldigingen van kindermisbruik moeten gemeld worden en er moet aangifte van worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bergkamp over een uitspraak van de Rechtbank Amsterdam inzake coffeeshops

MPs Kooiman and Bergkamp asked the Justice Minister how to view a Amsterdam district court ruling that government policy keeps cannabis trade in criminal hands, and whether experiments with regulated cannabis supply to coffeeshops should be allowed. The minister declined to comment on the judgment, maintained that regulating cultivation would not solve crime and is blocked by international treaties, and refused experiments, while noting the coffeeshop policy has been repeatedly backed by parliament.
It is for the judge to rule on cases brought before him within the framework of the law.
Het is aan de rechter om binnen de kaders van de wet te oordelen over zaken die aan hem worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de komst van een haat- en geweldprediker naar Utrecht

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government would bar Haitham al-Haddad, a British cleric they say preaches stoning and rejects the democratic legal order, from entering the Netherlands for an Utrecht conference. The minister confirmed awareness, said EU free-movement rules allow refusal only for a genuine, serious threat based on personal conduct, declined to comment on the individual case, and referred to strafrechtelijke handhaving and separate answers on intolerant behaviour.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een  geweldsprediker naar Utrecht

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a violent preacher (al-Haddad, who reportedly calls for killing adulterers and apostates) should be denied entry to the Netherlands, how this fits the Bontes motion, whether foundations inviting such preachers could be banned, and whether a database of such preachers exists. The government answered that intolerant preachers are unwelcome and that visa or entry refusal depends on individual assessment and legal status (for this UK national, entry can only be refused on an actual, serious threat), that a study on the 'danger criterion' for banning associations is underway, and that no blacklist exists, only an alert list.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over de rapporten van de Auditdienst Rijk

Two MPs (Ronnes and Omtzigt, CDA) asked the Finance, Justice and Security, and Defence ministers about the Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) audit reports, including a list of 2015 reports, when each was sent to parliament, and the status of six announced audits. The government answered that it sent most reports promptly, gave dates for each, said some audits are unfinished or were commissioned by other ministers, and committed to publishing the reports on the ministries' websites.
The study referred to under b is being carried out on the instructions of the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and has not yet been completed.
Het onderzoek bedoeld onder b wordt uitgevoerd in opdracht van de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over een Nederlandse voormalig coffeeshopeigenaar die is veroordeeld in Thailand

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about a former Dutch coffeeshop owner sentenced in Thailand to 103 years (effectively 20), including whether Dutch authorities initiated the prosecution and whether the Dutch tolerance policy was explained to Thai authorities. The minister declined to judge the foreign ruling, said the Thai authorities were informed of Dutch tolerance policy, refused to share the liaison officer's letter citing an ongoing criminal investigation, and gave a partial account of embassy contacts.
Can you send this letter to the House? Answer 8: The investigation referred to is part of an ongoing criminal investigation.
Kunt u deze brief aan de Kamer zenden? Antwoord 8 Het onderzoek waarnaar wordt verwezen is onderdeel van een nog lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de 39 aanhoudingen tijdens een PEGIDA demonstratie

An MP asks the Justice Minister about 39 arrests at a PEGIDA demonstration in Rotterdam, including the alleged violent arrest and denial of medical help and delayed lawyer access of a journalist, and about press freedom. The minister declines to comment on the individual case while a police complaints investigation (BVIK) is ongoing, describes the standard procedure for lawyer access, and says other journalist cases are not known to him.
During this investigation I cannot make a statement on the content of this case.
Gedurende dit onderzoek kan ik geen uitspraak doen over de inhoud van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de noodkreet van verontruste rechters

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice about judges' concerns over the judiciary's Meerjarenplan, court-map reform, productivity pressure, and the relationship between management and staff, as raised in a Tegenlicht survey. The minister answered that the Raad voor de rechtspraak shares several concerns, points to ongoing talks and evaluation of the HGK law, and says funding will be addressed in price negotiations.
I do not want to anticipate the outcomes of this evaluation.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht “Streekbus met 185 geflitst, verkeersagenten Oost-Nederland twijfelen aan apparatuur”

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that mobile speed cameras record implausible speeds (e.g., a bus clocked at 185 km/h) and whether citizens wrongly fined can easily object and how future errors will be prevented. The Minister replies that errors arise only in specific reflection situations, that the system is NMi-certified and reliable, that officers can filter faulty images, that wrongly issued fines can be dismissed via the police, and that software upgrades and reminders to officers are underway.
When two large vehicles, such as buses and lorries, pass each other in opposite directions and are in the radar beam at exactly the same moment, the measurement can deviate due to reflection.

Wanneer twee grote voertuigen, zoals bussen en vrachtwagens elkaar in tegengestelde richting passeren en zich op precies hetzelfde moment in de radarbundel bevinden, kan de meting afwijken als gevolg van reflectie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht mobiele flitsapparatuur politie is onbetrouwbaar

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that mobile police speed cameras give unreliable readings, including the causes, error rates, costs and prevention. The minister answered that errors occur only rarely in specific reflection situations, that images are reviewed by an officer, that costs are commercially confidential, and that software upgrades are planned.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht dat veel gemeenten de beveiliging van persoonsgegevens in Suwinet niet op orde hebben

MPs Oosenbrug asked whether municipalities' weak security of personal data in Suwinet is worrying, whether the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens should be needed for enforcement, whether officials misusing Suwinet data are sanctioned, and whether the Autoriteit has enough sanctioning powers and staff. The government acknowledges the concern, describes an escalation protocol, the VNG self-test, Inspectie SZW investigations with possible binding instructions, Security Officer controls, and states the Autoriteit has sufficient powers and capacity.
At this moment the State Secretary is sending the first letters announcing a binding instruction to municipalities that do not meet all 7 norms.
Op dit moment verstuurt de Staatssecretaris de eerste brieven met een aankondiging tot een aanwijzing aan gemeenten die niet voldoen aan alle 7 normen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het ontslaan van leden van Outlaw Motorcycle Gangs (OMG)

An MP asked the ministers whether municipalities can dismiss civil servants who belong to Outlaw Motorcycle Gangs, and whether membership is incompatible with public employment. The minister answered that dismissal requires concrete conduct linked to the function and prior dialogue, that the government considers such membership undesirable, and that a civil-law ban on OMGs is being assessed by the Public Prosecution Service.
Before imposing a disciplinary measure or initiating a dismissal procedure, it is reasonable for the employer to talk with the civil servant about membership and about keeping distance from the OMG.

Alvorens over te gaan tot het opleggen van een disciplinaire maatregel of het in gang zetten van een ontslagprocedure, ligt het overigens in de rede dat de werkgever met de ambtenaar in gesprek gaat over het lidmaatschap en over afstand houden van de OMG.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Oosten en Van der Linde over het boek ““Wat niet mag, kan nog steeds”; kraakhandleiding 2015/2016”

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a squatting handbook with tips on illegal occupation should be tolerated, whether its publication is punishable, and whether a Hogeschool van Amsterdam staff member's study time was misused to write it. The minister said the book is inappropriate but that judging free speech limits is not for him, referred the criminal question to the Public Prosecution Service, pointed to local administrative enforcement powers, and said the college's work was an 1 individual student's responsibility after checking that the original paper concerned legal policy.
As the title suggests, the authors of the book are aware that squatting is a punishable offence.
Zoals uit de titel valt af te leiden, zijn de schrijvers van het boek ermee bekend dat kraken een strafbare handeling is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut versleutelde berichten op telefoons kan kraken

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Forensic Institute uses software to crack encrypted phone messages, what technique it uses, and whether it exploits unknown vulnerabilities. The government declined to name the software or techniques for operational reasons, and said it would address the handling of zero-day vulnerabilities in a separate letter.
providing information on which specific software the investigative services use carries major risks for the usability of those means
brengt het verstrekken van informatie over welke specifieke software de opsporingsdiensten gebruiken grote risico’s met zich mee voor de inzetbaarheid van die middelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak over het bericht dat de Al Fitrah-moskee dubieus geld heeft ontvangen

MPs Karabulut and Van Raak asked whether the Al Fitrah mosque's funding from Kuwait, including ties to an entity once on a US sanctions list, was checked by intelligence and tax authorities, what the municipality knew, and what action the government would take. The minister declined to comment on the specific case, said the municipality had known of the Kuwaiti funding since 2014, and deferred the mosque-funding question to a forthcoming letter on salafism.
In general, I do not make statements about specific cases.
In zijn algemeenheid doe ik geen uitspraken over concrete casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Toorenburg en Pieter Heerma over de Al Fitrah-moskee in Utrecht

CDA MPs asked whether the Al Fitrah mosque in Utrecht received funding from Kuwaiti organisations linked to Al-Qaida, whether tax and intelligence services checked its income, whether it publishes accounts, and what the mayor has done about it. The government largely declined to comment on specific cases citing confidentiality and procedural secrecy, while describing a three-track approach of dialogue, confrontation and enforcement and promising a forthcoming salafism letter.
In general I do not make statements about concrete cases.
In zijn algemeenheid doe ik geen uitspraken over concrete casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over de privacyschending door ziekenhuizen

An MP from the PvdA asked the ministers whether outsourcing scanning of patient records to a Belgian firm that used prisoners and sheltered workshops, and the resulting privacy breach, was acceptable, and how destruction of records and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens' powers are supervised. The minister answered that such outsourcing is allowed under the Wbp if processor agreements are in place, that hospitals remain responsible, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens has sufficient enforcement powers, and that the Inspectie will write to hospitals and watch processor agreements.
The Health Care Inspectorate has already indicated to me that it is paying attention to how processor agreements were concluded at those hospitals still transitioning from paper to digital records.

De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg heeft mij al aangegeven dat zij aandacht hebben voor de wijze waarop de bewerkersovereenkomsten zijn gesloten bij die ziekenhuizen die nog in transitie zijn van papieren naar digitale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de ‘doofpot’ na aanrandingen in Almere

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether sexual assaults by asylum seekers in Almere were withheld or discouraged from reporting by police. The Minister said one case with four suspects was known locally, three victims filed complaints, police did not discourage reporting, and publicising incidents is for local authorities and the prosecution service.
Making incidents and reports public falls under the responsibility of local authorities.
Het openbaar maken van incidenten en meldingen valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat er steeds meer brand is bij thuiswonende senioren

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about rising fire incidents among independently living seniors, brigade staffing and voertuigbezetting, veiligheidsregio governance, and fire-brigade keuring. The minister answers largely by referring responsibility to veiligheidsregio boards and municipalities, provides some inspection reports, and promises a letter from another minister and further inspection work.
The boards of the safety regions are responsible for organising fire brigade services.
De besturen van de veiligheidsregio's zijn verantwoordelijk voor de organisatie van de brandweerzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Swinkels en Van Nispen over de arrestatie van enkele demonstranten te Spijkenisse

MPs from GroenLinks, D66 and SP asked whether the arrest of demonstrators in Spijkenisse and the handover of one arrestee to the aliens police was lawful and compatible with freedom of expression. The Minister answers that the demonstrators defied repeated police orders to move to a designated location, that nine were released the same day, and that one was handed to the aliens police only to establish her identity, after which she was released without detention.
For that reason she was handed over on Sunday morning, in line with established policy, to the aliens police to establish her identity.
Daarom is zij zondagochtend, conform vastgesteld beleid, overgedragen aan de vreemdelingenpolitie om haar identiteit vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over de primaire radargegevens van de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked whether the Public Prosecution Service told the minister that primary radar data for the MH17 investigation was no longer needed, and how such oral communications are recorded. The minister confirmed the prosecution's oral statements of 14 and 19 January that no further radar requests were needed, said oral and written briefings have equal status, and declined to have them put in writing, citing rechtshulp requests already made.
Oral information is not registered as such in the administration.
Mondelinge inlichtingen worden niet als zodanig in de administratie geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat de politie zelf drugs gaat testen

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police will test drugs themselves, questioning the reasons, timelines, quality, training, capacity and future of the arrangement. The minister answered that pilots showed on-site police testing with NFI interpretation is quick (about 24 hours versus 19-21 days), equivalent in quality, needs only a two-day training for technical handling, and does not require extra police capacity, while noting extra NFI funding of 5 million euro from 2016.
The outcomes were in all cases the same.
De uitkomsten waren in alle gevallen gelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders, Van Dekken en Recourt over de berichten 'Nieuwe generatie jagers op komst'  en 'Aantal stropers is verdubbeld op de Veluwe'

MPs Leenders, Van Dekken and Recourt asked the Justice Minister about reports of 'new hunters' and a doubling of poaching on the Veluwe, including sentencing, enforcement and national trends. The minister said poaching is not a separate offence and prosecution can yield unconditional prison terms, described enforcement cooperation with private landowners' wardens, and said poaching is not registered separately so national trends and arrest figures cannot be provided without disproportionate manual review.
In police and justice registrations, poaching offences are not recorded separately.
In de registraties van politie en justitie worden stroperijdelicten niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over politiebezoek om twitter-kritiek op AZC

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police home visits over critical tweets about asylum centres were intimidating and how to stop them. The Minister rejected the concern, saying police may verify social media signals of possible public order disturbances, that home visits are normal policing under the mayor's authority, and that no change in policy is planned.
No, I do not share that. The police have the task of maintaining public order.
Nee, die deel ik niet. De politie heeft tot taak het handhaven van de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Weer politiebezoek aan burger om anti-AZC uitlatingen op twitter’

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether police visits to citizens over critical tweets about an asylum reception centre are correct, what risk to public order was seen, and whether such visits should stop. The Minister confirms that police may contact people over social media signals as part of normal policing under local authority, says there was no public order risk in this case, and sees no reason to change the practice.
Actively contacting the persons concerned by the neighbourhood officer following such social media signals is one of the options for this and belongs to normal police work.
Het actief contact opnemen door de wijkagent met betrokkene(n) naar aanleiding van dergelijke signalen op social media is daartoe een van de mogelijkheden en behoort tot het normale politiewerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Amhaouch over privacybelemmeringen bij de uitwisseling van bijzondere persoonsgegevens van prostituees ten behoeve van een intakegesprek

MPs Van Toorenburg and Amhaouch asked why resolving privacy rules that hinder Amsterdam's intake interviews with sex workers is taking so long, and about evaluation outcomes and other municipalities. The minister replied that existing privacy rules remain the starting point, that Amsterdam should seek a workable method within them, that the Amsterdam evaluation is the municipality's responsibility, and that no other municipalities have reported the same problem.
The ministry has indicated that the applicable privacy rules are and remain the starting point.
Vanuit het ministerie is daarbij aangegeven dat de geldende privacyregels het uitgangspunt zijn en blijven
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht “Matchfixing en het Nederlandse tennis”

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a report that Dutch authorities are lax in detecting match-fixing in tennis and cooperate poorly with Belgium on a suspected fixed match. The minister denied the claim, said the Functioneel Parket leads match-fixing enforcement with police and FIOD capacity available, and declined to say whether any investigation exists into the specific match, citing investigative and privacy interests.
The Public Prosecution Service makes no statement about whether or not it is investigating any matter.
Het OM doet geen mededeling over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over een journalist die maandenlang is gevolgd door de recherche

MP Bontes asked whether a police investigation of a journalist, who had been followed for months, was connected to his journalistic work on trafficking and abuse, and whether the press-facing directive on coercive measures against journalists applied. The minister answered that the suspicion concerned the journalist as a private individual, unrelated to his journalism, so the directive did not apply, and gave no further detail on the offences.
The Public Prosecution Service further makes no statement about the nature of the criminal offences to which the suspicion related.
Het Openbaar Ministerie doet verder geen mededeling over de aard van de strafbare feiten waarop de verdenking zag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht van de ANWB dat autofabrikanten ongezien data van automobilisten verzamelen

An MP asked ministers about reports that car manufacturers collect driver data without drivers' knowledge, including which privacy law applies, whether consumers are informed and must consent, and whether data can be sold to third parties. The government answered that manufacturers are responsible for complying with privacy law under the European directive and Dutch Wbp, that information duties and consent via purchase contracts apply, and that transfer or sale of personal data is only allowed within legal limits.
A complete overview of all data that all types of cars generate and store cannot be provided.
Een volledig overzicht van alle gegevens die alle typen auto’s genereren en opslaan kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht dat een Joods gezin is bekogeld met vuurwerk

MP Segers asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the government responds to reports that a Jewish family in Amsterdam was pelted with fireworks and subjected to antisemitic chants on New Year's Eve, and what protection, prosecution, and anti-antisemitism measures exist. The minister condemned antisemitism, said police opened an investigation with two minors sent home under a conduct order, and pointed to existing discrimination prosecution policy and the national action programme, while declining to comment on the ongoing investigation.
Furthermore, the police investigation is ongoing, and I cannot make any statements about it.
Daarnaast loopt het politieonderzoek, waarover ik geen uitspraken kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Marcouch over de hoge salarissen van de top bij de politie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police leadership salaries exceeding a minister's pay, whether the 2013 request to waive part of salaries was honored, and whether the top can be made to lower incomes. The minister answered that no top officials exceeded the WNT salary norm in 2013 or 2014, that no legal means exist to force reductions for non-top staff, and that he is willing to talk with the officials concerned.
Legal possibilities are therefore lacking to enforce a reduction.
Juridische mogelijkheden ontbreken derhalve om verlaging af te dwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het antisemitisch Nieuwjaarsgeweld

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about antisemitic violence during New Year's Eve 2015 in Amsterdam, the scale of antisemitism, Holocaust teaching and security needs of Jewish institutions. The minister answered that the suspects were sent home with a conduct order, that the government rejects antisemitism, and listed measures such as teacher support, a dialogue with community leaders and recording of incidents.

Early 2016 SZW therefore organises a consultation with key figures from the Jewish and Islamic communities on their efforts to reduce the impact of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict in the Netherlands.

Begin 2016 organiseert SZW daarom een overleg met sleutelfiguren uit de Joodse en islamitische gemeenschap over hun inzet om doorwerking in Nederland van het Israelisch-Palestijnse conflict te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de ‘verdwenen’ radarbeelden van MH17

MP Ten Broeke asked whether the government took action through ICAO to obtain the allegedly missing MH17 radar images, whether ICAO received legal assistance requests, how ICAO's dispute procedure works, and whether the Safety Board and JIT need the images. Minister Van der Steur answered that the government pressed for cooperation bilaterally, that the prosecutor and Safety Board currently have sufficient information, that no ICAO request was made, and that JIT legal assistance requests were sent to states holding the images without disclosing details.
Evidence gathering and the legal assistance requests aimed at it are by their nature confidential.
Bewijsgaring en daarop gerichte rechtshulpverzoeken zijn naar hun aard vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Tellegen over de berichtgeving dat de politie in Zweden kennis over de achtergrond van daders van aanrandingen niet naar buiten heeft gebracht

MPs Keijzer and Tellegen asked whether situations like the Cologne New Year's assaults had occurred in the Netherlands, what the National Police's policy is on publicising incidents that could cause social unrest, and whether police transparently report the origin of perpetrators of group sex crimes and theft. The Minister answered that there are no signals of such incidents in the Netherlands, that disclosure is the responsibility of the local authority and/or Public Prosecution Service, and that police record suspects' birthplace and nationality and inform the competent local authority.
Disclosure of incidents and reports falls under the responsibility of the local authority and/or the Public Prosecution Service.
Het openbaar maken van incidenten en meldingen valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag en/of het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Swinkels over de nieuwe onthullingen rondom de Teevendeal

MPs Van Nispen and Swinkels asked the Justice Minister about new revelations in the Teeven deal, including whether he knew the search for a backup was halted in June 2014 and how this affected a debate. The minister answered that he was not aware during the December debate, was not informed of the Nieuwsuur publication before the January debate, and guarantees IT staff will not face negative consequences for speaking openly.

At the time of the parliamentary debate on the investigation into Professor Maat on 20 January 2016, I was not aware of the content of the Nieuwsuur publication, and therefore it did not influence my position in the debate.

Ten tijde van het Kamerdebat over het onderzoek naar professor Maat op 20 januari 2016 was ik niet op de hoogte van de inhoud van de publicatie van Nieuwsuur en heeft dit derhalve mijn houding in het debat niet beïnvloed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Oosenbrug over het bericht: Filmmakers naar de rechter: ‘Staat doet te weinig tegen piraterij’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Oosenbrug asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that filmmakers were taking the state to court over insufficient action against piracy, including whether consumers should be warned and how internet providers and rights holders could cooperate. The minister answered that legal alternatives, information campaigns and private civil enforcement are the main tools, reported on a November 2015 seminar, and said he would convene follow-up talks between rights holders and internet providers.
I am willing to initiate follow-up consultations at my department within a reasonable time to bring the parties closer together.
Ik ben graag bereid binnen afzienbare tijd vervolgoverleg te entameren op mijn departement om partijen nader tot elkaar te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van verschillende geweldspredikers naar Eindhoven

Two MPs asked whether preachers who legitimise suicide bombings and call for the death penalty for homosexuals should be denied entry, why such visits keep being allowed despite a motion to bar them, and whether foundations inviting them should be dissolved under Book 2 of the Civil Code. The government answered that visas are refused or withdrawn for preachers threatening public order, that each case is assessed individually and some visas were withdrawn, that it is pursuing a three-track approach, and that dissolution of legal persons is a matter for the courts on request by the public prosecutor.
Each individual case is assessed on its own merits and tested against these principles.
Elk individueel geval wordt op zijn eigen merites beoordeeld en getoetst aan deze uitgangspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de overdracht van een tot levenslang veroordeelde aan Engeland

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister why a life-sentenced Englishman was to be transferred to England, what the reasons and agreements were, how dangerous detainees would be prevented from early release, and why victims' relatives were not informed. The minister answered that DJI initiated a proposed transfer, the public prosecutor advised negatively after relatives were consulted, the proposal was withdrawn on 20 January, and procedures for involving relatives have been tightened.
The OM has informed me that the arrangements for involving next of kin in such cases have been tightened.
Het OM heeft mij laten weten dat de afspraken met betrekking tot het betrekken van nabestaanden in dit soort gevallen zijn aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over uitlevering van een levenslange gedetineerde in Nederland naar Engeland

An MP asked the Justice Minister why a transfer of a life-sentenced prisoner (Daniel S.) to England was initiated, whether such transfers had occurred before, what happens to his life sentence, and why the victim's relatives were not informed and why extradition was not sought for the suspected commissioner. The minister answered that the transfer proposal was withdrawn after the prosecution service, having belatedly consulted the relatives, advised negatively, that no transfer has yet occurred for a life prisoner, and that the Secretary of State is exploring how life sentences are enforced, with a letter promised in Q1 2016.
The prosecution service saw insufficient concrete and direct evidence of Robert D.'s involvement and also did not expect to be able to obtain it.
Het OM zag onvoldoende concreet en direct bewijs voor betrokkenheid van Robert D. en verwachtte ook niet dat te kunnen verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de druk op de beveiliging in asielzoekerscentra groot is

SP MPs asked whether reports of high pressure on security at asylum reception centres were accurate, how many violent incidents occurred, whether training and police support were adequate, and how staff safety is ensured. The Secretary of State answered that incidents rose in number but are not disproportionate, that contracted security is certified, that a mantle agreement with the security firm covers staff safety, and that police support is available, while stating that incidents with weapons are not separately registered and that the COA could not split its figures by location type.
Incidents involving weapons are not registered separately.
Incidenten waarbij wapens betrokken zijn worden niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de aangekondigde islamitische conferentie in Eindhoven

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether a visa should be granted to a preacher who endorses suicide bombings and whether the Al Waqf/Al Fourqaan mosque in Eindhoven should be closed after inviting a violent preacher to a December 2015 conference. The minister replied that visas can be refused or revoked for threats to public order, that some visas were revoked, and that there is no basis under current law to dissolve or close the foundation.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik geen uitspraken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het feit dat de OVV onderzoekers geen primaire radargegevens ontvangen hebben voor het onderzoek naar de MH17 van de Rusland, van Oekraïne of van andere landen, terwijl ze daar

An MP asked the ministers why the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) did not receive primary radar data on the MH17 downing from Russia, Ukraine or other countries despite requesting it and despite ICAO obligations to retain such data. The government answered that the OVV had sufficient information for its conclusions, that Russia stated no radar data was stored, that Ukraine's radars were not operational, and that the OVV's investigation was independent, with the government having no role in obtaining the data.

In view of this, the Netherlands will work within the EU and ICAO to remove this ambiguity by advocating a retention obligation that always applies when radar data may be relevant to aviation accident investigations.

Met oog hierop zal Nederland zich in EU-verband binnen ICAO inzetten om deze onduidelijkheid weg te nemen door een bewaarplicht te bepleiten die altijd aan de orde is als radargegevens relevant kunnen zijn voor onderzoek naar luchtvaartongevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het gooien van jonge nertsen in gaskisten

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister whether a Rosmalen fur farm treated mink cruelly, whether it should be closed as a notorious offender, and when a permanent fur-farming ban would be added to the Criminal Code. The government reported two welfare inspections showing no violations, four NVWA inspections in five years with one fine, found no basis to call the firm a notorious offender, and promised the evaluation and policy response of the criminal ban to Parliament soon.
Actively making the inspection results of an individual company public is currently not possible.
Het actief openbaar maken van de inspectieresultaten van een individueel bedrijf is op dit moment niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht 'We zijn een schietschijf voor terroristen', marechaussee bij Tweede Kamer klaagt over klein pistool’

Tellegen (VVD) asked whether the Koninklijke Marechaussee is adequately armed to resist terrorist attacks at sites it guards, including the Tweede Kamer, and how it scales up in emergencies. The minister answered that armament is set per threat-based security concept, regularly reviewed and adjusted with the NCTV and local authorities, but declined to give details of equipment or escalation as this would reveal working methods.
I cannot provide details on the precise equipment, including armament, because this would give insight into the working methods of the Royal Marechaussee.
Over de precieze uitrusting, inclusief de bewapening, kan ik geen mededelingen doen, omdat dit inzicht geeft in de werkwijze van de Koninklijke Marechaussee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de WK-kandidatuur van Nederland en België

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Toorenburg asked whether the minister pressed the KNVB for an independent investigation into the Netherlands-Belgium 2018 World Cup bid, who commissions and conducts it, whether the Public Prosecution Service will investigate, what the 2009 departure of Alain Courtois and ministry knowledge of alleged Belgian misconduct involved, and whether the minister has contacted Belgian counterparts. The minister answers that the KNVB independently commissioned an independent accountant's investigation expected in Q1 2016, that the ministry has contact with the KNVB and will be informed of results, that the Public Prosecution Service cannot comment on its investigations, that the 2011 evaluation was limited in scope, that the ministry had no subsidy relationship with Beltomundial, and that the ministry has contacted Belgian colleagues who await their own internal investigation.
Once the results are known, the KNVB will inform me of the findings and conclusions and I will inform the House of Representatives.
Zodra de resultaten bekend zijn, zal de KNVB mij op de hoogte brengen van de bevindingen en conclusies en zal ik Uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over overdracht van persoonsgegevens op grond van de Europese Dataprotectieverordening

An SP MP asked whether the new Article 43a of the EU data protection regulation means foreign demands for personal data from companies can only be met via an international agreement, and what this means for businesses, including smaller firms. The minister answered that other legal bases in Chapter V (administrative arrangements, Article 44(1)(h) derogation) remain available, that businesses should know the relevant law, and that he considers Article 43a a balanced provision.

I consider Article 43a of the GDPR, also against the background of Chapter V of the GDPR as a whole, a provision that ensures an adequate balance between the interests of personal data protection and the interests of the EU, the Member States and third countries.

Ik acht artikel 43a van de AVG, mede tegen de achtergrond van Hoofdstuk V van de AVG in zijn geheel, een bepaling die een voldoende evenwicht waarborgt tussen de belangen van de bescherming van persoonsgegevens en de belangen van de EU, de lidstaten en derde landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Marcouch over het bericht dat de nieuwe korpschef van de Nationale Politie € 75.000 compensatie voor salarisverlies krijgt

PvdA MPs Kerstens and Marcouch asked about the reported €75,000 compensation for salary loss given to the new national police chief, and why it was paid as a severance under the civil service rules rather than a WNT exception. The ministers answered that it is a discretionary payment under the civil service regulation capped at €75,000 by the WNT, justified by the public interest in filling the post quickly, with any further compensation to be arranged within police employment rules.
In order to remove this obstacle, it was examined whether there was a possibility to compensate.
Ten einde deze belemmering weg te nemen, is bezien of er een mogelijkheid was te compenseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de rol van private equity in de ondergang van V&D

An MP asks ministers about the role of private equity firm Sun Capital in the bankruptcy and possible restart of V&D, and whether bankruptcy law protects against abuse. The government answers that the curator leads any restart under judicial supervision, that existing rules guard against abuse, and that the private equity role will be examined in a separate study.
Because of competitive sensitivity, the curators do not disclose the identity of the selected parties.
De curatoren maken vanwege de concurrentiegevoeligheid de identiteit van de geselecteerde partijen niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog over coffeeshops die in verzet komen tegen de komst van scholen in de buurt

MPs Oskam and Rog asked the Minister of Justice and Security about coffeeshops resisting nearby schools, including the 250-metre distance agreement with the VNG, enforcement in Amsterdam, and whether the distance criterion should be written into the Aanwijzing Opiumwet. The minister replied that the distance rule is a local choice under local tailoring, that 84.5% of coffeeshop municipalities have a distance criterion (55% at 250 m or less), that Amsterdam's approach is a local matter, and that he sees no need to change the current policy.
Reducing the visibility of coffeeshops to pupils is local tailoring.
Het verkleinen van de zichtbaarheid van coffeeshops voor scholieren is lokaal maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over de winstuitkering aan deurwaarders

An MP asks the Justice Minister about profit-making by the automation subsidiary SNG of the bailiffs' association, which overcharged clients and then refunded the excess to bailiffs' offices. The minister says the practice was not correct, was changed in 2012 on the association's initiative, and that retrospective refunds are impractical to reconstruct.
I do not consider this way of working correct.
Ik acht deze werkwijze niet correct.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over het feitenrelaas over professor Maat

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about missing documents in the Maat case, the drafting of the police chief's letter, why it went to the Director-General, and when the Wob appeal decision would come. The Minister answered that missing documents were added to the file, listed the notes received, explained the drafting changes, and said the Wob decision follows statutory deadlines with a hearing expected mid-February 2016.
The incomplete file that Professor Maat viewed on 23 November 2015 did not contain the internal memo from the Algemeen Commandanten.
Het onvolledige dossier dat professor Maat op 23 november 2015 heeft ingezien bevatte niet het interne memo van de Algemeen Commandanten
Vragen van de leden Oskam (CDA) en Kooiman (SP) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over criminelen die shoppen bij spionagewinkels (ingezonden 11 november 2015).

MPs Oskam (CDA) and Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about criminals buying gadgets from spy shops to frustrate police investigations, asking for a product overview, enforcement practice, and a possible blacklist. The Minister said such devices are only punishable if illegal or knowingly used to facilitate crime, that enforcement is up to the OM and police, that no complete data exist, that a blacklist is not practical, and that Amsterdam is exploring a licensing scheme with which he will engage.
I do not have conclusive data on the range of products sold by spy shops.
Ik beschik niet over sluitende gegevens met betrekking tot het assortiment van spyshops.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Fritsma over het bericht dat Belgisch Limburg bezorgd is om de waakzaamheid van Nederland

PVV MPs Helder and Fritsma asked why vigilance in Belgian Limburg is reportedly higher than on the Dutch side, whether the Netherlands should raise vigilance and close its borders, and how information exchange with mayors will be improved. Minister Van der Steur answered that Belgium raised its threat level, that the Netherlands has been at 'Substantieel' since 2013 with additional measures, that border closure is not justified now while mobile checks and ANPR were intensified, and that information exchange is being strengthened internationally and locally.
After the attacks in Paris, it was decided among other things to intensify measures at locations where travel movements to and from Belgium and France take place.
Na de aanslagen in Parijs is onder meer besloten tot intensivering van de maatregelen op locaties waar reisbewegingen van en naar België en Frankrijk plaatsvinden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de route tussen wietkweker en coffeeshophouders

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about ripdeals, the illegal intermediaries between cannabis growers and coffeeshops, the penalties for such trade, and the rules on joint-rolling and the 500-gram stock limit. The minister answered that no ripdeal statistics are kept, that the Opiumwet does not distinguish growers from intermediaries, that the 500-gram limit is a tolerance condition coffeeshops must meet, and that prosecution data lack case-specific details.
Figures on such offences are not kept separately.
Cijfers over dergelijke delicten worden niet apart bijgehouden.
Antwoord op van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de politie-pc’s brandhout zijn

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about a report that police PCs were unusable, when the minister learned of the ICT funding shortfall, whether he would fund it before the Spring Memorandum, and whether an investigation into ICT project steering is needed. The minister says the report paints too bleak a picture, reports progress under the Aanvalsprogramma, admits the 2016 ICT portfolio cannot be funded and promises an external review of financial steering by the Commissie van toezicht, while rejecting a separate investigation.
I have asked the Commission for supervision of police management to take on the external investigation.
Ik heb de Commissie van toezicht op het beheer politie gevraagd om het externe onderzoek voor haar rekening te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de rellen rond een raadsvergadering over de komst van een asielzoekerscentrum in Geldermalsen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the riots around a council meeting on an asylum centre in Geldermalsen could have happened, whether police and riot units were adequately prepared, and what measures are planned to protect politicians and officials. The minister answered that the mayor and police had assessed risks as low beforehand, that the riot unit arrived in time, that a criminal investigation into a threat against a councillor is ongoing, and that guidance tools exist and the council will evaluate the events.
As usual, I cannot say whether threat and risk have given (or given cause) to take security measures in relation to the councillor and his family.
Zoals gebruikelijk kan ik geen mededelingen doen over de vraag of dreiging en risico aanleiding zijn (geweest) tot het nemen van beveiligingsmaatregelen in relatie tot het raadslid en zijn gezin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bashir over de weinig coulante houding van de Belastingdienst bij vermissingszaken

MPs Van Nispen and Bashir asked why the Tax Administration persisted with a payment order and showed little leniency toward the relatives of a missing taxpayer, and whether it follows a protocol for missing persons. The State Secretary acknowledged the handling was regrettable, described an ongoing protocol with Slachtofferhulp Nederland and a planned verification via the national missing persons register.

The letter the trustee sent to the Tax Administration should have led to immediately blocking all ongoing activities and pursuing settlement of outstanding tax matters in consultation with the trustee.

De brief die de bewindvoerder aan de Belastingdienst heeft gestuurd, had ertoe moeten leiden alle lopende activiteiten onmiddellijk te blokkeren en in overleg met de bewindvoerder afwikkeling van lopende belastingaangelegenheden na te streven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over het politieonderzoek naar professor Maat, dat de minister keer op keer op keer weigerde om openbaar te maken

MPs Omtzigt and others asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the police investigation into professor Maat's MH17 role was kept confidential and heavily redacted under the Wob, and whether the termination of his cooperation was justified. The minister answered that the file was made available to parliament confidentially under article 68 of the Constitution, that redactions protected officials' personal policy views and witness cooperation, and that he apologised to Maat for reacting too emotionally.
the file, including the witness statements, has been made available for confidential inspection by your House since 2 December 2015.
het dossier, waaronder de getuigenverklaringen, vanaf 2 december 2015 ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd in uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Swinkels over de indiening van het wetsvoorstel computercriminaliteit III bij de Tweede Kamer

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security why a press release announced the computer crime III bill after a two-year consultation, before it was submitted to parliament, and when it would be submitted. The minister defended active government communication about legislative steps, said the release marked a ministerial council decision on the anti-jihadism action programme, and noted that all four bills have since been submitted.
I consider open and transparent communication about legislative processes an important part of government information.
Ik acht het open en transparant communiceren over wetgevingsprocessen een belangrijk onderdeel van overheidsvoorlichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat er gevoelige informatie uit een gevangeniscel is gestolen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a report that sensitive documents from a prisoner's cell in a retrial case were taken without his presence and not returned, and about who ordered the search. The state secretary said the prisoner has a summary proceeding pending, so the substance cannot be addressed, but confirmed the search was ordered by the prison governor's deputy and run by a special unit, with regular staff kept outside.
For this reason, the substance of the case, which is to be heard on Monday 25 January 2016, cannot be addressed at this time.
Om deze reden kan thans niet inhoudelijk op de zaak, die op maandag 25 januari 2016 zal dienen, worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Oskam over het bericht ‘Boete tijdens vervoer doodziek kind’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a speeding fine issued to a driver transporting his critically ill daughter escorted by ambulance and police vehicles, and how the OM and CJIB weigh such circumstances. The Minister answered that the OM erred, reduced the fine to zero, apologised, and that the CJIB cannot fully reconsider cases beyond narrow correction grounds, with €15 million committed to OM service improvement.
The OM has indicated that the decision of the public prosecutor, as well as the reasoning behind it, was incorrect in this case.
Het OM heeft aangegeven dat de beslissing van de officier van justitie, alsmede de motivering van deze beslissing, in deze zaak onjuist is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het rapport Racisme, antisemitisme en extreemrechts geweld in Nederland

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the reported rise in racist incidents, the low level of prosecution and conviction for discrimination offences, and whether crimes with a discriminatory aspect are properly registered. The Minister acknowledged the rise in police-registered incidents, attributed it partly to changed registration methods and possibly greater reporting willingness, and gave prosecution figures while noting data limitations and no concrete new measures beyond an upcoming action programme.
The cabinet is making efforts to prevent and combat racism.
Het kabinet spant zich in om racisme te voorkomen en te bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de Syrische zelfmoordterrorist die via Griekenland naar Europa kwam

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether a Syrian suicide bomber in Paris entered Europe via Greece as a refugee, how this fits with the NCTV's statement that no jihadists were known to enter via the refugee flow, and whether the government will stop admitting asylum seekers. The Minister replies that the French investigation is ongoing but two attackers likely came through the migration flow, that the NCTV considers such abuse conceivable, that asylum seekers are screened, and that he is not willing to stop admitting people fleeing war.
The French investigation into the circumstances of the attacks and the events leading up to them has not yet been concluded.
Het Franse onderzoek naar de toedracht van de aanslagen en de aanloop daarnaartoe is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de uitbreiding van de voorschotregeling voor slachtoffers van misdrijven per 1 januari 2016

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the extension of the advance payment scheme for crime victims from 1 January 2016, including communication to victims, outstanding compensation orders and cases closed by the CJIB. The minister confirmed the extension, described the communication plan, but refused to extend the scheme retroactively to older outstanding orders for cost reasons and declined to change the notification process.

Retroactively extending the expansion of the advance payment scheme to outstanding compensation orders from 1 January 2016 would conflict with the decision of my predecessor, Minister Hirsch Ballin, on phased introduction.

Het per 1 januari 2016 alsnog verruimen van de uitbreiding van de voorschotregeling naar openstaande schadevergoedingsmaatregelen zou haaks staan op het besluit van mijn ambtsvoorganger, Minister Hirsch Ballin, tot gefaseerde invoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over het gemak van inbraken bij sociale huurwoningen

MPs Kooiman and Bashir (SP) asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Housing about burglary risks in social rental housing, including the share of doors and windows with weak locks and whether the government will fund better protection. Minister Van der Steur answered that prevention is locally led and primarily the responsibility of residents and landlords, announced a 2 million euro co-financed fund for hotspot neighbourhoods, and said no national data on burglaries in social rental housing are kept.
No national figures are kept on the number of burglaries in social rental housing.
Over het aantal inbraken bij sociale huurwoningen worden landelijk geen cijfers bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de Europese oproep extra maatregelen te treffen tegen chemische of biologische terreuraanvallen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why the government reacts calmly to an EU call for extra measures against chemical or biological terror attacks, whether the Netherlands has taken new steps such as producing an antidote, and whether the public will be informed preventively as in France and the UK. Minister Van der Steur answers that the Netherlands has long been alert to misuse of CBRN substances, has taken precautionary measures, and has already provided information to the public on how to act in a crisis, referring to earlier answers.
The Netherlands has been alert for years to the threat posed by misuse of chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear substances and has taken the necessary precautionary measures.
Nederland is al jaren alert op de dreiging die uitgaat van misbruik van chemische, biologische, radiologische en nucleaire stoffen en heeft daarvoor de nodige voorzorgsmaatregelen getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Van Dekken en Jan Vos over het onderzoek van RTV-Noord dat Groningers uit een bepaald gebied geen rechtsbijstandverzekering kunnen afsluiten

MPs Recourt, Van Dekken and Jan Vos asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether residents of the Groningen earthquake area can obtain legal expenses insurance, whether insurers should offer alternatives for non-quake disputes, and about insurers' deal with the Stichting WAG. The minister replied that the claim is inaccurate, that some insurers accept new clients from the area and others do not, that the NCG will examine whether conditions are disproportionate, and that insurers decide how to inform clients about the WAG agreement.
The Minister of Economic Affairs has additionally asked the NCG to conduct further research into the conditions insurers impose for taking out legal expenses insurance within the earthquake area.

De Minister van Economische Zaken heeft daarnaast de NCG gevraagd om nader onderzoek te doen naar de voorwaarden die verzekeraars stellen om een rechtsbijstandsverzekering af te sluiten binnen het aardbevingsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat rechtsbijstandsverzekering taboe is voor Groningers in aardbevingsgebied

An SP MP asks whether insurers excluding residents of the Groningen earthquake area from legal expenses insurance, citing an ongoing dispute, is acceptable, and raises related questions on subsidised legal aid, the WAG foundation arrangement and the NCG's proposed arbiter. The minister replies that insurers say residents can still obtain cover for future claims depending on each insurer's policy, that no equivalent exclusion areas are known elsewhere, and that the NCG has been asked to investigate whether insurers' conditions are disproportionate.
The Dutch Association of Insurers has informed me upon request that the claim that residents of the Groningen earthquake area cannot take out legal expenses insurance is not accurate.
Het Verbond van Verzekeraars heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten dat de stelling dat bewoners uit het Groningse aardbevingsgebied geen rechtsbijstandsverzekering kunnen afsluiten, niet accuraat is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Nauwelijks controle op ingetrokken rijbewijs’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice why drivers under a driving ban face almost no checks, whether enforcement should be stepped up, what local safety triangles are doing, and what consequences follow for a driver who caused a fatal crash and drove again during a ban. The minister answered that police check licences where possible but such checks are labour-intensive, that driving while banned is a crime, that a letter on stricter enforcement will follow in January, that local teams handle traffic enforcement, and that a criminal investigation is pending so the court must decide.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over achterstand onderscheidingen politie

MP Kooiman asked whether police officers face multi-year delays receiving commemorative certificates and decorations, and what will be done. The minister (answering for the Interior/Justice portfolio) acknowledges backlogs in some units, says most have been cleared, and that national management of certificates is intended to prevent recurrence.
In a number of units there is indeed a backlog in issuing the certificates.
In een aantal eenheden is inderdaad sprake van achterstand bij het uitreiken van de oorkondes.
Vragen van het lid Oskam (CDA) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Meer drugszaken sneuvelen bij rechter» (ingezonden 19 november 2015).

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether rising acquittals in drug cases reflect critical judges and whether municipalities facilitating cannabis clubs fit the government's drug policy. The minister disputed that drug acquittals are unusually high, found no LOVS guideline change explaining the trend, and said Utrecht and Amsterdam do not facilitate cultivation and no enforcement is needed.
The share of acquittals in Opium Act cases in 2014 does not differ from the share of acquittals in all criminal cases, 11%.
Het aandeel vrijspraken in Opiumwetzaken wijkt in 2014 niet af van het aandeel vrijspraken bij alle misdrijfzaken, 11%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Tellegen over het bericht "Financiële sector let te weinig op terrorisme, zegt DNB"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Tellegen asked the Finance and Justice Ministers about DNB's finding that the financial sector pays too little attention to terrorism financing, and about the effectiveness of the Wwft, its gaps and EU/international plans. The Minister said the effectiveness of the measures cannot be quantified, acknowledged DNB's concerns, pointed to ongoing supervision, the FEC project and EU/FATF discussions, but gave no firm new legislative commitments.
Because it concerns sensitive information, this information will probably not be made publicly available.
Omdat het gevoelige informatie betreft, zal deze informatie waarschijnlijk niet publiek ter beschikking worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht ‘Vrij spel voor kinderhandelaren’ inzake illegale adoptie uit Nepal

An MP asks the Justice Minister about reports of child trafficking and illegal adoption from Nepal after the 2015 earthquake, including whether Dutch couples may be involved and whether the Hague Adoption Convention is sufficient safeguard. The minister answers that the Netherlands has not adopted from Nepal since 2009, that illegal adoption by Dutch nationals cannot be excluded but would require emergency travel documents from the honorary consulate, and that Nepal has not yet acceded to the Hague Convention and has not implemented the recommended reforms.
The Netherlands has not adopted from Nepal since 2009.
Nederland adopteert sinds 2009 niet meer uit Nepal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Ypma over het bericht dat een man die verdacht wordt van kinderporno toch actief kon blijven als docent

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a teacher suspected of child pornography was not reported to his school and kept working there. The Minister said the Public Prosecution Service decides case by case, under the Wjsg and its Aanwijzing, whether to share information, that the school was informed only after a conviction, and that the school itself decides whether the teacher can remain.

In weighing whether, when and which information should be provided, a balance is always struck between the interests of those seeking the information, the interests of investigation and prosecution, and the protection of the suspect's privacy.

In de afweging of, wanneer en welke informatie verstrekt dient te worden, wordt steeds een afweging gemaakt tussen de belangen van de betrokkenen bij het verkrijgen van de informatie, de belangen van opsporing en vervolging en het belang van de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de verdachte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over wachttijden bij het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut (NFI)

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the NFI's budget cuts supposedly do not affect core forensic output despite warnings of insufficient capacity, and whether NFI turnaround times have really fallen given changes in how they are measured. The Minister replied that he monitors NFI implementation, allocated an extra 5 million euros from 2016, explained the shifts in the turnaround-time definition, and declined to commission a separate study, citing an ongoing review by Professor Zouridis.
If substantial deviations occur, I am informed of this by the NFI.
Indien zich substantiële afwijkingen voordoen, word ik hierover door het NFI geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug, Kerstens en Van Dekken over de exorbitante gouden handdruk voor de vertrekkend directeur van Buma

MPs Oosenbrug, Kerstens and Van Dekken asked whether the large severance payment to the departing Buma/Stemra director, who refused to moderate pay under the WNT, is acceptable, and whether the rules could prevent such payments. The minister answered that pre-WNT contracts fall under transitional law, that the College van Toezicht examined the arrangement, that the contract's content is a matter between private parties, and that no change to transitional rules is planned.
Beyond that, it is not for me to disclose the content of the employment contract between two private parties.
Het is voor het overige niet aan mij om mededeling te doen over de inhoud van de arbeidsovereenkomst tussen twee private partijen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over de handelspraktijken van incassobureaus

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked about debt collection agencies' practices, including excessive pressure, threats of measures they cannot legally take, excessive collection costs and time-barred claims, and whether fines or consumer protection would follow the ACM report. The minister answers that no fines have yet been imposed, that the ACM and AFM will act jointly, that consumers can reclaim undue costs and seek legal advice, and that she rejects making excessive collection costs a tort, citing existing remedies.
At this moment, no fines have yet been imposed for the problems identified in the report.
Op dit moment zijn voor de in het rapport gesignaleerde problemen nog geen boetes opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de brandweer in Breskens veel te laat kwam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that fire services in Breskens arrived too late, whether safety is at risk, and whether the Zeeland safety region's 'Maatwerk in Brandweerzorg' plans were tested. The minister replied that the Zeeland safety region is primarily responsible, that the Inspectorate found the plans largely compliant with rules while uncertainties remain to be checked during implementation, and that the region acted in line with the motion on closing posts.
I trust that the board, in addition to the steps already taken, which the inspectorate judges positively, will take additional measures to prevent a situation like the one in Breskens.

Ik vertrouw erop dat het bestuur naast de reeds gezette stappen, waarover de inspectie positief oordeelt, aanvullende maatregelen neemt om een situatie zoals zich in Breskens heeft voorgedaan te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het beboeten van illegale downloads en de vrijheid van het internet

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether filmdistributors and Stichting BREIN may monitor and pursue individual downloaders and uploaders, and whether such databases of IP addresses are lawful and privacy-compatible. The Minister answered that enforcement is civil, IP data may be obtained from providers only under court-supervised balancing, the CBP must review BREIN's sensitive-data processing, and no specific filmdistributor application had yet been received.
If the internet service providers do not wish to provide this data, copyright holders can ask the court to rule on it.
Wanneer de internet service providers deze gegevens niet willen verschaffen, dan kunnen auteursrechthebbenden de rechter vragen hierover een uitspraak te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Keijzer over een wijziging van het procesreglement Civiel Jeugdrecht

CDA MPs Oskam and Keijzer asked whether the change to the Civil Youth Law procedure rules, which stops non-guardian parents from relying on their rights as interested parties, could be reversed by a judge and how many parents are affected. The Minister answered that the judge decides who is an interested party, that no body records how many parents are affected, and that the Adviescommissie Burgerlijk Procesrecht is advising, with a report expected in spring 2016.
We have asked the Adviescommissie Burgerlijk Procesrecht to advise on the concept of interested party within the meaning of article 798(1) Rv in cases concerning supervision orders.
Wij hebben de Adviescommissie Burgerlijk Procesrecht verzocht om te adviseren over het begrip belanghebbende in de zin van artikel 798 lid 1 Rv in zaken betreffende de ondertoezichtstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Swinkels en Bergkamp over het spreekrecht van stieffamilie in het strafrecht

MPs Swinkels and Bergkamp asked whether the right to speak at criminal trials should extend to non-blood relatives such as stepfamily in blended families, citing a Rechtbank Oost-Brabant call for this. The minister declined to comment on the pending case, said judges can already admit non-relatives on request, and said the issue would be considered in the 2017 evaluation of the law and a pending bill.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Swinkels over het artikel ‘Tientallen vliegtuigen bij Schiphol met laser beschenen’ en de uitzending van het programma opsporing verzocht

Two D66 MPs asked about reports of lasers aimed at landing aircraft at Schiphol and about a Opsporing verzocht broadcast on the matter, including police action, the difficulty of catching the perpetrator, and possible restrictions on laser pointer sales. The state secretary answered that police have acted, the suspect has not yet been caught because the beam is hard to trace, the government sees no need for new national measures or a campaign, and sales from foreign webshops are hard to supervise.
In the interest of the criminal investigation, I cannot provide further information on the exact nature of the actions taken by the police.
In het belang van het opsporingsonderzoek kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen omtrent de exacte aard van de acties die door de politie zijn verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over Brabantse veroordeelden die vrij rondlopen

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked about reports that about 1,600 convicted persons in Brabant walk free, and about how many outstanding prison sentences are actively sought and why the 120-day threshold applies. The Staatssecretaris agreed the situation is undesirable, reported 2,843 outstanding sentences subject to active search and about 10,000 not pursued actively due to likely foreign residence, and outlined investment in information sharing and fast-track sentencing.
I agree with you that this is an undesirable situation.
Ik ben het met u eens dat dat een onwenselijke situatie is.
Vragen van het lid Oskam (CDA) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Meer drugszaken sneuvelen bij rechter» (ingezonden 19 november 2015).

Oskam (CDA) asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the rising number of acquittals in drug cases reflects critical judges and whether the Council for the Judiciary should be engaged, and asks about municipalities facilitating cannabis clubs despite the motion against regulated cultivation. The minister announces that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because not all necessary information has yet been received, and promises an answer as soon as possible.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from MP Oskam (CDA) to the Minister of Security and Justice about the report 'More drug cases fall at the judge' (submitted 19 November 2015) cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Oskam (CDA) van uw Kamer aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht Meer drugszaken sneuvelen bij rechter (ingezonden 19 november 2015) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de brief van de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie d.d. 3 november 2015 betreffende het ontbreken van een acceptatieplicht bij autoverzekeringen

Mr Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether insurers refer ex-detainees to Rialto Verzekeringen with higher premiums and extra financial demands for car insurance. The minister answered that insurers have no database of detention, that prior detention is not decisive for premiums, that Rialto's surcharges reflect its higher risk and deposit requirements, and that no signals of misconduct justify a new investigation.
I have received no signals that this is the case, nor that it causes abuses.
Mij hebben geen signalen bereikt, dat hiervan sprake is, en evenmin dat hierdoor misstanden zouden ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de integriteitsregels van de advocatuur

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a disciplinary ruling on the professional integrity rules for lawyers in Article 10a of the Advocatenwet, including who may invoke those rules and whether lawyers may coordinate procedural steps with opposing parties with both parties' consent. The Minister answered that the core values codify existing practice, that complaints are open to anyone directly affected, and declined to comment on the individual case, leaving the assessment of coordination and conflicts of interest to the disciplinary judge.
I will not get involved in this individual case.
Ik zal niet treden in deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de van terrorisme verdachte asielzoeker

Two MPs asked the government about an asylum seeker arrested on terrorism suspicion, whether other suspects exist, and how screening failed to detect him at intake. The State Secretary said the case is under investigation, no confirmed cases of asylum seekers joining the stream for terrorist motives exist per the NCTV threat assessment, and no decision on the asylum claim will be made until the investigation concludes.
Until then, no decision is taken on the asylum application.
Tot die tijd wordt niet op de asielaanvraag beslist.
Vragen van het lid Segers (ChristenUnie) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over ruilprostitutie bij rijscholen (ingezonden 14 oktober 2015).
