MP Segers asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about reports of driving instructors offering lessons in exchange for sex, the police signal on this, enforcement, and the scale of exchange sex among young people. The government answered that such exchange is not prostitution but is forbidden with minors, that a police signal is being studied by LIEC and the recipient ministries, that no complaints have been filed, and that a new monitor on sex among under-25s is planned.
Administrative signals cannot simply be made public given the confidentiality, nature and content of such reports.
Bestuurlijke signalen kunnen niet zomaar openbaar worden gemaakt gelet op de vertrouwelijkheid, aard en de inhoud van dergelijke rapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over concurrentieverstoring door subsidieregelingen

Two VVD MPs asked whether the subsidy to LTO for the 'beveilig mijn boerenbedrijf' project led to only one supplier being chosen per product, and whether subsidy rules should require multiple suppliers. The minister confirmed LTO selected the suppliers itself and said the government sees no need for supplier-selection rules in specific subsidy schemes beyond existing competition law.
The cabinet sees no reason to set rules in specific subsidy schemes in this area, beyond the applicable competition laws and regulations.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om, naast de geldende wet- en regelgeving ter bevordering van concurrentie, op dat terrein ook regels te stellen in specifieke subsidieregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog over het bericht dat coffeeshops in verzet komen tegen de komst van scholen in de buurt

Two MPs asked the Justice and Education ministers about coffeeshops opposing nearby schools, including Amsterdam's refusal of a school location due to a nearby coffeeshop and whether closures or hour limits should follow. The minister answered that distance criteria and school housing are local matters, no overlap with him occurred, and gave no commitment to new action.
Because the location of coffeeshops near schools are local matters, no consultation has taken place with me about the cases mentioned.
Omdat de vestiging van coffeeshops in de buurt van scholen lokale aangelegenheden zijn, heeft er geen overleg met mij plaatsgevonden over genoemde casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over verkeersboetes in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a court ruling that traffic fines raised in 2008, 2011 and 2012 were unlawfully high, and what follow-up steps and a new fine system would involve. The minister said the ruling has no wider effect on fines already imposed, that the Public Prosecution Service will not appeal in the interest of the law, and that the motion on a progressive fine system continues with information promised before the Christmas recess.
The Arnhem sub-district court ruling has no wider effect and does not directly affect traffic fines already imposed.
De uitspraak van de kantonrechter Arnhem heeft geen bredere werking en is niet direct van invloed op eerder opgelegde verkeersboetes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht dat de verkeersboetes in Nederland te hoog zijn

SP MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister whether traffic fines raised in 2008, 2011 and 2012 were too high after a court ruling, why he did not intervene despite police criticism, and whether fines will only be raised to improve road safety and refunds given. The minister disagreed that the increases were excessive, said the Wahv sets only procedural requirements, argued fines deter offences, and stated the ruling has no consequences for fines or the 2016 budget.
I do not agree with the finding that the fine increases in 2008, 2011 and 2012 were too high.
Ik ben het niet eens met het oordeel dat er in 2008, 2011 en 2012 te hoge boeteverhogingen zijn doorgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Nationale Politie meer aandacht moet hebben voor stalkingszaken

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the police handle stalking cases, including capacity, expertise, the ZSM fast-track procedure, specialised prosecutors and central registration. The Minister answered that prioritisation and case-screening, cooperation with Veilig Thuis, a police work-process pilot in 2016 and existing specialised prosecutors are in place, while stalking is not always registered in a uniform way.
No new guideline is being developed. The police are, however, working on improving the stalking work process.
Er wordt niet gewerkt aan een nieuwe richtlijn. De politie werkt wel aan het verbeteren van het werkproces Stalking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van geweldsboodschapper Haneen Zoabi naar een Kristallnacht-herdenking

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Justice Minister about the planned visit of Knesset member Haneen Zoabi to a Dutch Kristallnacht commemoration, her support for the kidnapping of three Israeli boys, and whether such figures could be denied entry to the Netherlands. The minister replied that Zoabi is an democratically elected Knesset member, that Israel suspended her for six months without prosecution, that the Netherlands can refuse visa-free third-country nationals on public order or national security grounds assessed case by case, and that inflammatory messages can be addressed through criminal law.
In general, the Netherlands can refuse visa-free third-country nationals entry if their presence or activities pose a threat to public order or national security.

In algemene zin geldt dat Nederland aan visumvrije derdelanders de toegang kan weigeren indien van hun aanwezigheid of hun activiteiten een gevaar uit gaat voor de openbare orde of nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over witwasdossiers die blijven liggen bij de Financial Intelligence Unit

Two PvdA MPs asked why suspicious-transaction reports from the Financial Intelligence Unit seem to go unused in money-laundering cases, and whether the number of prosecutor requests has fallen. The minister answered that such reports are useful intelligence but are not separately tracked in criminal files, that cooperation and new registration agreements are being improved, and that money laundering is prosecuted alongside confiscation.
The Public Prosecution Service does not record on the basis of what type of information a criminal case was started.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) registreert niet op grond van welke soort informatie een strafzaak is gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Oosenbrug over de registratie van levenloos geboren kinderen

MPs Wolbert and Oosenbrug asked whether stillborn children, who by law are deemed never to have existed, could be entered in the Basisregistratie Personen, and how other EU countries register them. The minister answered that stillborn children are not entered in the BRP because it only holds data needed by government bodies, that a special civil-status deed is issued instead, and that practice differs across EU states.

Recording in the BRP of data on a stillborn child that is not necessary for the performance of government bodies' or designated third parties' tasks is not consistent with the purpose and principles of the basic personal records registration.

Opname in de BRP van gegevens over een levenloos geboren kind, die niet noodzakelijk zijn voor de vervulling van de taken van overheidsorganen of aangewezen derden, is niet in overeenstemming met het doel en de uitgangspunten van de basisregistratie personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat opsporingsdiensten witwasdossiers laten liggen

SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that money-laundering case files are left unprocessed by investigative services, asking about FIU cooperation, reasons for not investigating signals, and capacity. The minister answered that FIU reports are not equal to case files, that signals are continuously weighed with the OM, that the FIU receives no feedback from the Belastingdienst, and that capacity is considered sufficient with time allocated to money laundering rising.
A suspicious transaction that FIU-Nederland passes on to an enforcement or investigative body cannot be equated with a money-laundering case file.
Een verdachte transactie die FIU-Nederland doorgeeft aan een handhavings- of opsporingsinstantie kan niet gelijk gesteld worden aan een witwasdossier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'Noorden laat zware misdaad liggen'

MPs Oskam and Mulder asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the north of the Netherlands neglects serious crime, including staffing of the Ondermijning team and the risk of a waterbed effect. The minister answered that the team is being expanded to 69 FTE with temporary staff bridging vacancies, that large investigations increased, that the OM's warning was about long-term effects rather than observed displacement, and that the information position still needs strengthening.
The Ondermijning investigation team of the Regional Criminal Investigation Service had a formal staffing of 35.43 FTE as of 1 November 2015 and will be expanded to 69 FTE in the new establishment.
Het team Opsporing Ondermijning van de Dienst Regionale Recherche heeft per 1 november 2015 een formele bezetting van 35,43 fte en wordt in de nieuwe formatie uitgebreid naar 69 fte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het onderzoek naar de professor die uit het MH17 team gezet werd en het onderzoek daarna, dat totaal onleesbaar aan de Kamer gestuurd is

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked why the police investigation into Professor Maat's removal from the MH17 team was largely blacked out when released under the Wob, and why the minister had not disclosed the witness statements and the conversation report. The minister defended the redactions on Wob grounds and personal policy views, but agreed to place the investigation documents for confidential inspection by parliament from 2 December 2015.

To respond further to your Chamber's request for information, the relevant documents from the police fact-finding investigation will be placed for confidential inspection by your Chamber from 2 December 2015.
Om nader op de informatievraag van uw Kamer in te gaan liggen per 2 december 2015 de betreffende stukken van het feitenonderzoek van de politie ter vertrouwelijke inzage in uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat aangerande vrouwen vinden dat hulp politie tekort schiet

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether police response to sexual assault victims is too slow, including delays before contact by the sex crimes unit, the practice of not talking to suspects when no case is opened, and referral to sexual violence centres. The minister explains the 7-day target for the informative conversation, the criteria for talking to suspects, and that temporary funding will support a nationwide network of sexual violence centres.
The informative conversation is held within 7 days unless this is not possible for the reporter.
Het informatief gesprek wordt binnen 7 dagen gevoerd tenzij dit voor melder niet mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat een geflitste buitenlandse bestuurder vaak vrijuit gaat

MPs Visser (VVD) asked follow-up questions on foreign drivers escaping fines for traffic offences, including EU CBE directive enforcement, French blockades, and collection of parking and traffic fines from non-Dutch plate holders. The minister answered that enforcement and collection depend on directive implementation, bilateral treaties and technical adaptations, that some collection routes are working while others (Belgium, France, other EU states) are not yet effective, and that a law amendment is planned by year-end.
We aim to bring a proposal amending the Act on mutual recognition of financial sanctions into procedure by the end of the year.
Wij streven er naar voor het einde van het jaar een voorstel tot aanpassing van Wet wederzijdse erkenning van geldelijke sancties en beslissingen tot confiscatie in procedure te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over berichten in de media dat buitenlandse verkeersovertreders de dans ontspringen

A Dutch MP asks why photos of traffic offences by foreign-plated vehicles were destroyed and whether foreign offenders escape fines, and asks about research access and road safety. The minister explains that fines are issued to foreign drivers caught at the roadside, that digital enforcement fines are not yet sent to most foreign plate holders pending EU cross-border agreements, that the photos contain personal data under privacy rules and the law will not be changed, and that the government has not committed to new research access beyond the data's availability.
The flash photos contain privacy-sensitive data to which privacy legislation applies.
De flitsfoto’s bevatten privacy gevoelige gegevens, waarop privacy wetgeving van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Berndsen-Jansen over berichten in de media omtrent de “massale vernietiging van bewijsmateriaal van buitenlandse verkeersovertreders”

MPs Hachchi and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether evidence on foreign traffic offenders was massively destroyed, why, and how EU cooperation on collecting traffic fines works. The Minister answered that no fines were destroyed, that about 20% of fines are not collected, that cooperation generally works well, and that digital enforcement is being extended to foreign plates, though the reasons for deleting some data are only set out in a separate letter.
There is no question of destroyed fines.
Er is geen sprake van vernietigde boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over ontvoering van kinderen

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that 25 Dutch children were abducted abroad over summer, and about the case of two children held in Egypt since 2003. The government said the figure came from a CIKO press release, explained the Hague Convention and diplomatic routes for return, and declined to discuss individual cases citing privacy law.
I cannot go into the substance of ongoing individual cases in the interest of those cases and under the Personal Data Protection Act.
Op de inhoud van lopende individuele zaken kan ik in het belang van deze zaken en in het kader van de Wet Bescherming Persoonsgegevens niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de Berkelse ondernemer die schade heeft geleden als gevolg van nalatig handelen van het Openbaar Ministerie

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister why a Berkel entrepreneur's administration and equipment were not returned after a criminal investigation, and why no compensation was paid despite admitted negligence by the Public Prosecution Service. The minister declined to discuss the individual case citing privacy, and explained that evidence is normally secured by forensic copy so that owners keep their original data.
For reasons of privacy of the persons involved, I will not make further substantive statements about this individual case.
Omwille van de privacy van betrokken personen doe ik verder geen inhoudelijke uitlatingen over deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind en Krol over de Nederlander die mogelijk 31 jaar ten onrechte vastzit in de VS

MPs from several parties asked whether the Netherlands should accept transfer of Mr Singh, a Dutch national serving a long US sentence, citing family ties, a municipal offer of reintegration support and humanitarian grounds. The Minister refused transfer under the Vogp and Wots, citing exceeded sentence maximum, insufficient remaining sentence and insufficient ties, while the Foreign Ministry said it would support parole and clemency requests on humanitarian grounds.
For the sake of completeness I note that I assess Mr Singh's ties to the Netherlands as insufficient.
Voor de volledigheid merk ik op dat ik de binding van de heer Singh met Nederland als onvoldoende beoordeel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Volp en Servaes over de inzet van Nederland tijdens de United Nations General Assembly Special Session (UNGASS) on the World Drug Problem die in 2016 zal plaatsvinden

Four MPs asked the ministers whether Dutch policy for the 2016 UN drugs special session had changed, whether the Netherlands should back regulated cannabis cultivation, and how death penalty cases for drug offences would be handled. The government answered that the Dutch position has not changed, that it opposes regulated cannabis cultivation and mayors' calls for it, and that it works to end the death penalty for drug offences while noting three Dutch nationals face such sentences.
Regulation/legalisation of cannabis cultivation is not cabinet policy, so it is not appropriate for the Netherlands to take the leading role the questioners propose at the UNGASS.
Regulering/legalisering van de hennepteelt is geen kabinetsbeleid en het ligt daarom niet voor de hand bij de UNGASS een door de vragenstellers beoogde voortrekkersrol op dit vlak te vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Verhoeven en Keijzer over kosten van RADAR

MPs from SP, D66 and CDA asked about the cost of the RADAR ICT system, including the value of the Capgemini delivery contract, extra work paid after termination, and external staffing costs. The State Secretary corrected earlier figures, estimated about 350,000 euro extra for Capgemini's support on the KvK interface, declined a detailed breakdown of staffing costs as too burdensome, and promised a planning for that answer.
I therefore suggest, given the administrative burden, that you refrain from this effort.
Ik geef u daarom in overweging mee, met het oog op administratieve lastendruk, af te zien van deze inspanning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de toegestane hoeveelheid harddrugs tijdens het Amsterdam Dance Event

An MP asked the Justice Minister how many drug-related arrests occurred at the Amsterdam Dance Event, how the local Amsterdam prosecution threshold of 5 pills or 0.5 gram relates to the national OM guideline, and how that policy came about. The minister answered that about 176 suspects were arrested at the Arena zone (170 for drugs), 131 were dismissed below the threshold, 39 face prosecution, and the threshold was set locally for capacity and trafficking-indication reasons, with the OM still reviewing capacity.
The OM has indicated it will keep looking at the capacity that can be deployed at such events.
Het OM heeft aangegeven te blijven kijken naar de capaciteit die bij dergelijke evenementen kan worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over drugsgebruik op het Amsterdam Dance Event (ADE)

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Security and Justice about drug use and arrests at the Amsterdam Dance Event, including the 'five-pill' policy, what the organisation's responsibility was, and whether festivals with widespread hard drug use could be banned. The government answered that licensing and enforcement are local matters for the municipality, that the organisers and venue owners bear responsibility under their permits, and that it is developing guidance and talking with mayors, without committing to a ban.
Granting and refusing permits and enforcing permit conditions are local matters.
Het verlenen en weigeren van vergunningen en het handhaven van aan vergunningen verbonden voorwaarden zijn lokale aangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over plannen voor het aanbesteden van forensische zorg en onderzoek door de Nationale Politie

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice and Health ministers about the tendering of forensic medical care and forensic investigation by the National Police, including whether the process was stalled, who provides the care, and whether tendering should be avoided until legal safeguards are in place. The minister answered that the tender was halted in July because no bidder met the requirements, existing contracts are being extended, and the police are deciding on next steps while maintaining that current arrangements sufficiently safeguard forensic medicine.
The police are currently deliberating on the follow-up to the halted tender procedure.
De politie beraadt zich op dit moment over het vervolg op de gestaakte aanbestedingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de werkvoorraden in de rechtspraak

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a large backlog of commercial civil cases at the 's-Hertogenbosch Court of Appeal, where hearings could only be held in 2017, and asked about backlogs elsewhere and planned budget cuts. The Minister explained the backlog stems from a 2012 pilot that sped up proceedings but increased caseload, says extra judges are being recruited with the backlog expected to be cleared in 2016, and says the other requested analyses will be reported to parliament early next year.
I have asked the Council for the Judiciary to inventory and analyse the necessary information and will report to your House on this early next year.
Ik heb de Raad voor de rechtspraak gevraagd de benodigde informatie te inventariseren en te analyseren en zal uw Kamer daarover begin volgend jaar nader berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Bouwmeester over het bericht “Kinderarts Radboudumc opgepakt voor kinderporno”

MPs Volp and Bouwmeester asked about the arrest of a Radboudumc paediatric intensive care doctor on suspicion of possessing child pornography, including whether patients were harmed, how parents were informed, screening (VOG) at hiring, and information sharing between prosecutors, the IGZ and employers. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, described the notification of parents and the revised IGZ-OM protocol, and said no further extension of the Wjsg was needed.
I will not comment on the accuracy of media reports concerning individual ongoing (criminal) cases.
Ik ga niet in op de (on)juistheid van berichten in de media met betrekking tot individuele lopende (straf) zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Oskam over de financiële gevolgen van het voorgenomen besluit van de Raad voor de rechtspraak zeven rechtbanken te ontmantelen en de toekomst of leegstand van deze gebouwen

MPs Van Nispen and Oskam asked about the financial consequences of the Judiciary's plan to dismantle seven courthouses, including ownership, costs, reuse of vacant buildings, and effects on court users and regions. The Minister answered that the Judiciary projects savings of 6 to 15 million euros annually, that the State owns most buildings, and that he declined to ask the Judiciary to assess negative effects in advance because the Minister's oversight is ex post.
For this reason I do not consider it appropriate for me to ask the Judiciary Council in advance to map out all possible negative (financial) consequences of the Judiciary's proposed location policy.
Daarom acht ik het niet passend dat ik de Raad vooraf verzoek allerlei mogelijk negatieve (financiële) gevolgen van het voorgenomen locatiebeleid van de Rechtspraak in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de oproep tot geweld tegen Israëlische toeristen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a public call to attack Israeli tourists and what measures would prevent such violence. The Minister said the call is punishable, that police protect everyone including Israeli tourists when needed, and that a criminal investigation is ongoing, so no further details can be given.
In the interest of the investigation, no further statements can be made at this time.
In het belang van het onderzoek kunnen op dit moment verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Pieter Heerma over de uitlatingen gedaan op Facebook om Israëlische toeristen 'total loss' te slaan

MPs Oskam and Heerma asked whether Facebook calls by Youness Ouaali to attack Israeli tourists are punishable, whether a criminal investigation is underway and whether pre-trial detention could apply. The Minister of Justice answered that the statements are condemned, that a criminal investigation is ongoing and no further details can be given for its sake, and that pre-trial detention requirements are set out in law without pre-judging the case.
A criminal investigation into Mr Ouaali is currently ongoing. In the interest of the investigation, no further statements can be made at this time.
Op dit moment loopt er een strafrechtelijk onderzoek tegen de heer Ouaali. In het belang van het onderzoek, kunnen op dit moment verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over politievrijwilligers

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the reorganisation of the national police, recruitment and retention of police volunteers, the proposal of a volunteer in police leadership, pay and benefits differences, and uniform volunteer policy. The minister answered that volunteer intake is postponed to after 2017 with priority on existing volunteers, that a uniform volunteer policy and legal status regulation are being developed with unions and the LOPV, and that a leadership vision will be presented in December.
However, there are currently no plans to appoint a police volunteer to the top of the police organisation.
Vooralsnog zijn er echter geen plannen om een politievrijwilliger te benoemen in de top van de politieorganisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over Ajax-fans die gedupeerd worden door antisemitische uitlatingen van anderen

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked the government about antisemitic chants at a football match and whether an KNVB sanction that let FC Utrecht fans sit elsewhere in the stadium undermined the fight against antisemitism. The minister replied that the sanction was legally applied, that no perpetrators could be identified for criminal prosecution, and that a zero-tolerance policy already exists.
I understand that FC Utrecht has decided to allow the supporters of the Bunnikside to take seats elsewhere.
Ik heb begrepen dat FC Utrecht besloten heeft de supporters van de Bunnikside in de gelegenheid te stellen elders plaats te nemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Aukje de Vries over het artikel “Eumedion vreest uitbuiting kleine aandeelhouders”

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Aukje de Vries asked whether the government sees risks in the concentration of control by majority shareholders at Dutch listed companies and whether minority shareholders should be better protected, following an Eumedion position paper. The minister disputes the doubling figure, finds it impossible to judge whether control has concentrated, sees existing Dutch company and securities law as adequate, and is cautious about new procedural rules while committing to consider the position paper and to evaluate the Wet bestuur en toezicht in 2016.

Dutch company law aims both to give entrepreneurs a legal infrastructure enabling them to fully pursue their activities and to give those involved in the company, including shareholders and creditors, sufficient protection against abuse of power.

Het Nederlandse vennootschapsrecht strekt er enerzijds toe om ondernemers een juridische infrastructuur te bieden die hen in staat stelt hun activiteiten ten volle te ontplooien en anderzijds om de bij de vennootschap betrokkenen, waaronder aandeelhouders en crediteuren, voldoende bescherming te bieden tegen (machts)misbruik.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen, Oskam, Swinkels en Van Der Staaij over de geruchten dat er extra geld vrijkomt om de gaten in de begroting van Veiligheid en Justitie te dichten en de door de bezuin

MPs from SP, CDA, D66 and SGP asked whether extra money is available for the Justice and Security budget for 2016, how it would be allocated across police, prosecution, judiciary, forensics, probation and prisons, and whether it should be decoupled from the Eerste Kamer risk on fee and legal aid measures. The answer refers the MPs to the government's budget letter for the 2016 Justice and Security budget (Kamerstuk 34 300 VI, nr. 23) rather than answering each question directly.

Further answer: the written questions from MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen (both SP), Oskam (CDA), Swinkels (D66) and Van Der Staaij (SGP) have been answered by way of the letter 'Draft budget 2016 Security and Justice'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen (beiden SP), Oskam (CDA), Swinkels (D66) en Van Der Staaij (SGP) Van Oosten (VVD) vraagnummer 2015Z21968 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Ontwerpbegroting 2016 Veiligheid en Justitie»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over de opkomst van lachgas als partydrug bij minderjarigen

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about the rise of nitrous oxide (lachgas) as a party drug among minors, its health risks, nuisance to residents, and why enforcement under the Medicines Act is not applied. The government acknowledges rising use, points to existing Trimbos information channels, says local authorities decide on nuisance enforcement, and explains that police and inspectorate enforcement is limited by priorities and that use itself is not criminal.
Enforcement action by the police against nitrous oxide under the Economic Offences Act has no priority in maintaining public order and enforcing criminal offences.
Handhavend optreden door de politie ten aanzien van lachgas op grond van de WED heeft bij de handhaving van de openbare orde en strafbare feiten geen prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de uitzendingen van Radar d.d. 5 en 19 oktober jl. over de vergoeding van schade door middel van een contra-expertise door verzekeraars

An MP asked whether insurers' policy clauses capping reimbursement of counter-expert costs at the level of the insurer's own expert fees comply with the Civil Code, and what the AFM and insurers' association will do about it. The minister answered that such a general cap is incompatible with the statutory reasonableness standard, that reasonableness must be judged case by case, and that the AFM will examine the issue in its 2015-2016 claims-handling study.
A general capping of reasonable costs to an amount lower than the insured sum is not compatible with the aforementioned provisions.
Het in algemene zin maximeren van de redelijke kosten tot een lager bedrag dan de verzekerde som is met voornoemde bepalingen niet verenigbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat verdachten veel vaker zonder straf de rechtszaal uit lopen

MP Helder asked the Minister of Justice whether the rise in acquittals (from about 4% to 10.3% of criminal cases) was caused by police or prosecution failures linked to cuts, and whether the cuts would be reversed. The minister attributed the rise to stricter judicial review of evidence, fewer joined cases, and quality problems in summary-penalty cases, said the budget for the Public Prosecution Service was not yet shown to be inadequate, and promised a letter on the justice budget before the budget debate.

In my letter to the House of 15 September 2015 I stated, in response to the report on the feasibility of the Public Prosecution Service budget, that I do not think it is already justified to conclude that the 2016 budget framework is inadequate.

Bij mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 15 september 2015 3 , heb ik in reactie op het rapport «actualisatie validatie-onderzoek haalbaarheid budgettair kader Openbaar Ministerie» aangegeven dat ik niet van mening ben dat reeds nu al de conclusie gerechtvaardigd is dat het budgettair kader van 2016 ontoereikend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Helder over het bericht dat de snelheidscamera’s op de A2 goed zijn voor 48 miljoen euro aan boeteopbrengsten

MPs Madlener and Helder asked whether speed cameras on the A2 generating 48 million euro in fines treat motorists as a cash cow, how many minor violations are involved, whether the controls are necessary for road safety, and whether the speed limit will be raised to 130 km/h. The minister replied that the controls aim at compliance with limits, gave the breakdown of fines by excess speed, cited a Rijkswaterstaat analysis showing reduced speeds, and said a decision on raising limits awaits a court ruling and will be communicated this year.
I will inform the House about this still this year.
Ik informeer uw Kamer hier dit jaar nog over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over trajectcontroles en boeteregen op de A2

An MP asked the Infrastructure and Environment minister why the A2 tops speeding-fine lists, whether speed limits on the A2 and A4 should rise to 130 km/h, and for an overview of section speed checks and their safety rationale. The minister answered that the A2's high traffic volume explains the fines, that limits below 130 km/h rest on air quality, noise or safety grounds, and that studies on raising limits on the A2 and A4 will be sent to parliament.
This year I expect to be able to inform you of the outcomes for the A2, and in the first half of 2016 about the options for the A4.
Nog dit jaar verwacht ik u te kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van de A2 en in de eerste helft van 2016 over de mogelijkheden op de A4.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over enorme verwarring bij automobilisten over de maximumsnelheid op de A2

MP Bashir asked about widespread driver confusion over the speed limit on the A2 and the large number of speeding fines from the average-speed check there. The minister replies that about 98% of drivers keep to the limit, the A2 share of fines is well under a third, signage follows guidelines with extra measures taken, and the limit will be raised on parts of the A2 subject to a pending court decision.
I will inform the House about this within this year.
Ik informeer uw Kamer hier dit jaar nog over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin van Dijk over voortdurende onbereikbaarheid van 112 voor doven en slechthorenden

MPs Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked why 112 emergency access for deaf and hard-of-hearing people remained unreliable, citing Signaal's finding that over half of test calls got no text reply, and asked about timelines, adoption of the REACH112 recommendations and release of technical reports. Minister van der Steur answered that a software upgrade caused the problem, that it was fixed on 23 October 2015, that an independent TNO study is pending, and that selected technical reports are attached.
I have made a selection of the technical reports on the reachability and reliability of 112 for deaf and hard-of-hearing people that are relevant to you.
Ik heb een selectie gemaakt van voor u relevante rapportages van de technische onderzoeken naar de bereikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid van 112 voor doven en slechthorenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht dat Windows 7 en 8.1 meer data van gebruikers gaan verzamelen

An MP asked ministers whether Windows 7, 8.1 and 10 updates add tracking software that collects more user data, and how this fits Dutch privacy and cookie rules. The minister confirmed Microsoft's diagnostic data exchange, explained the consent and information duties under the Telecommunicatiewet and data protection law, and noted the CBP may investigate, without committing to new action.
Supervision of compliance with Article 11.7a of the Telecommunications Act rests with the Authority for Consumers and Markets.
Het toezicht op de naleving van artikel 11.7a van de Telecommunicatiewet berust bij Autoriteit Consument en Markt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over adoptie van kinderen uit Bulgarije

An MP asked the Justice Minister about alleged misconduct in Bulgarian child adoptions to the Netherlands, the Hague Adoption Convention's trust principle, and whether an international supervisory authority is needed. The minister said all about 30 recent Bulgarian adoption files were reviewed with no reason to think children came in irregularly, that the trust principle and state responsibility for supervision remain adequate, and that no international authority is needed.
For that reason I have had all about 30 files of children adopted from Bulgaria over the past two years reviewed again.
Om die reden heb ik alle circa 30 dossiers van kinderen die de afgelopen twee jaar uit Bulgarije zijn geadopteerd nogmaals laten bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het adopteren van kinderen uit Bulgarije

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that children in Bulgarian institutions were adopted abroad although relatives might have cared for them, and about EU funding and safeguards in Bulgaria. The minister answered that re-checking about 30 adoption files found no reason to think children were moved irregularly, that a working visit and dialogue with Bulgarian authorities are planned, and that the Hague Convention's subsidiarity and mutual trust principles mean the Netherlands does not review Bulgaria's national determinations of adoptability.
For that reason I have had all about 30 files of children adopted from Bulgaria over the past two years reviewed again.
Om die reden heb ik alle circa 30 dossiers van kinderen die de afgelopen twee jaar uit Bulgarije zijn geadopteerd nogmaals laten bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over schiettraining van politieagenten

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice how many hours of shooting training police officers receive in initial and post-initial training, whether the four two-hour blocks per year are sufficient, and what will be done to expand laser-based training pilots. The minister answered that recruits get 38 shooting hours in year one and 14 in later years, that post-initial officers get eight live-fire hours per year, that this is considered sufficient, and that the Integrale Beroepsvaardigheidstraining review will examine on-the-job training options.
The eight hours of live-fire shooting training, supplemented by practice-oriented shooting exercises, have proven sufficient to maintain shooting proficiency.
De acht uren schiettraining met scherp, aangevuld met de praktijkgerichte (schiet)oefeningen blijken voldoende te zijn om de schietvaardigheid te onderhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over adopties vanuit Bulgarije

An MP asks the Minister whether intercountry adoptions from Bulgaria, after a Brandpunt documentary alleging children are taken from parents without consent, should be investigated and paused. The Minister says all about 30 recent Bulgarian adoption files were rechecked with no reason found to think rules were broken, a working visit to Bulgaria is planned, and adoptions will not be suspended for now.
For that reason I have had all approximately 30 files of children adopted from Bulgaria over the past two years reviewed again.
Om die reden heb ik alle circa 30 dossiers van kinderen die de afgelopen twee jaar uit Bulgarije zijn geadopteerd nogmaals laten bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kooiman en Gesthuizen over de balans tussen veiligheid en rechtsstaat

Three SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the balance between security and the rule of law has tipped toward security, how he would restore it given budget cuts, and whether the police should return to the Ministry of the Interior. The minister denied any tipping, pointed to intensifications, and declined to change the police's ministerial placement, saying a future cabinet could decide that.
The cabinet sees no reason to anticipate this.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding hierop vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht ‘politie nam in 2,5 jaar 24.000 vuurwapens in beslag’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police seized 24,000 firearms in 2.5 years, and whether illegal arms trafficking networks and police capacity are adequately tackled. The minister confirmed the correct figure is about 11,500 firearms, provided a breakdown of seizures by category, said he does not hold European seizure data, and described measures against illegal arms trafficking while denying that police capacity is insufficient.
I do not have these figures.
Ik beschik niet over deze cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Recourt over het gebruik van de  Friese taal in de rechtbank

MPs Jacobi and Recourt asked the Minister of Justice whether the decision to hear a Friesland-linked case in Zwolle rather than Leeuwarden was consistent with court presidents' statements that regionally tied cases can be heard locally. The minister answered that the Overijssel court moved the hearing to Zwolle to shorten travel, that Friesland is outside its jurisdiction, and that the statements concern allocation within one court.
The options for the Overijssel court regarding the choice of hearing location for a case are limited to the hearing venues within its own jurisdiction.
De mogelijkheden voor de rechtbank Overijssel ten aanzien van de keuze voor de locatie van behandeling van een zaak beperken zich tot de zittingsplaatsen binnen het eigen rechtsgebied
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het wel of niet verdwijnen van expertises bij het NFI

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether handwriting, paint and hair expertise would leave the Netherlands Forensic Institute (NFI) and how quality would be controlled after outsourcing, and about cost and reorganisation risks. The minister answered that these three areas will be outsourced with the NFI retaining responsibility via accredited partners, that staff will be moved under the Van Werk Naar Werk scheme, and that a follow-up review and budget consultation will take place.
The NFI's responsibility does not end when the research is carried out by other parties through cooperation, but it will be organised differently.
De verantwoordelijkheid van het NFI stopt niet op het moment dat het onderzoek via samenwerking door andere partijen wordt gedaan, maar zal wel anders worden ingevuld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over wachttijden bij het NFI

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about long waiting times at the Netherlands Forensic Institute (NFI), which cause distress to victims and relatives, and about the effect of budget cuts. The minister acknowledged long waits are undesirable, attributed the increase to the MH17 workload and reduced average turnaround to 14 days, said cuts will not affect core production, and noted a reserved budget for outsourcing to private bureaus.
In recent years the NFI has reduced investigation turnaround times from about 130 days in 2007 to an average of 14 days now.
De afgelopen jaren heeft het NFI de doorlooptijden van onderzoeken teruggebracht van ongeveer 130 dagen in 2007 naar gemiddeld 14 dagen nu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht: ‘Alarm om bezuinigingen NFI’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that budget cuts at the Netherlands Forensic Institute (NFI) are alarming investigative services, whether unnatural deaths are being under-autopsied, and whether the cuts will be reversed. The Minister denied that investigative services issued the alarm, said no evidence shows homicides are being missed, announced an exploratory study of decision points in the death investigation process, and said the cuts cannot be reversed given the NFI's capacity limits.
I have therefore instructed the NFI to conduct an exploratory study into the decision points in that process.
Ik heb het NFI daarom opdracht gegeven een verkennend onderzoek te doen naar de beslismomenten in dat proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Tellegen, Van der Staaij en Oskam over een hooggeplaatst lid van ISIS

Six MPs asked ministers whether a report that a senior ISIS member was en route to the Netherlands or Germany was credible and how intelligence services had examined it. The government answered that the report closely resembles earlier media reports, that services remain vigilant, and that it cannot publicly discuss the nature of its investigations.
The cabinet cannot make public statements about the nature of the services' investigations.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over de aard van onderzoek door de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grashoff en Voortman inzake het bieden van premiekorting in ruil voor privédata door verzekeraar Achmea

MPs Grashoff and Voortman asked ministers whether insurer Achmea may offer premium discounts in exchange for personal behavioural data, and how data use, consent, sanctions and societal effects would be policed. The government answered that such data use is permitted only within the Wbp framework and purpose limitation, that the Cbp supervises compliance, and that insurers must inform customers of privacy risks, while acknowledging possible societal effects.
It is up to the Cbp to assess whether the Wbp is being complied with.
Het is aan het Cbp om te beoordelen of de Wbp wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over bedreigingen, geweldsdelicten en brandstichtingen gericht tegen Turkse of Koerdische buurthuizen

Marcouch asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about threats, violence and arson against Turkish or Kurdish community centres, and whether Turkish-Kurdish tensions are spilling over to the Netherlands. The minister said police do not record incidents by target type so no reliable figures exist, described tensions linked to Turkey and outlined dialogue efforts and possible security measures.
The police record numbers of incidents such as threats, violent offences and arson, but do not routinely record which type of object they were directed against.
De politie registreert aantallen incidenten zoals bedreigingen, geweldsdelicten en brandstichtingen, maar registreert daarbij niet standaard tegen welk soort objecten dit is gericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar een gemeenteraadslid

Two MPs asked whether a criminal investigation into a Haarlemmermeer council group leader, reportedly filed by the mayor, is real, and what action will be taken after a police officer's alleged remarks in a café. The minister confirmed a criminal investigation exists but withheld further details citing the investigation's interests, referred the officer's conduct to the police internal affairs unit, and said notifying a suspect early depends on the case.
In the interest of this investigation, I cannot currently provide any further information.
In het belang van dit onderzoek kan ik op dit moment geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Kooiman over benodigdheden voor hennepteelt door de overheid aangeboden op een veiling

MPs Volp and Kooiman asked whether the government offered hemp-cultivation equipment seized under the Opium Act on a public auction site, and whether it is wrong that businesses cannot sell the same goods. The minister answered that he disagrees the listing was a mistake, refers to earlier answers for the remaining questions, and says re-use cannot be excluded but the legal test is whether the seller knew or had serious reason to suspect professional cultivation use.
I refer you to my answers to the written questions from Member Berndsen-Jansen (D66) of your House.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen (D66) van uw Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de berichtgeving dat de belastingdienst kweekbenodigdheden voor de hennepteelt heeft doorverkocht op een veiling

An MP asked whether the Tax Authority wrongly auctioned cannabis-cultivation equipment seized for tax debts, in conflict with Opiumwet article 11a, and how such sales will be prevented. The minister answered that the seizure was fiscal, predated article 11a's entry into force, that a national procedure now requires police consultation and destruction of such goods, and declined to disclose sale proceeds.
Information on the sale proceeds falls under the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the Invorderingswet 1990.
Informatie over de verkoopopbrengst valt onder de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Invorderingswet 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het betalen van goodwill door notarissen die een kantoor willen overnemen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether paying goodwill when notaries take over a practice is acceptable, what limits exist, and whether there are integrity problems. The minister answered that paying reasonable goodwill is customary, that the Commission of experts assesses goodwill in the appointment procedure, and that no integrity damage from goodwill is known.
In that context, paying reasonable goodwill by (starting) notaries who want to take over an office is customary and not objectionable.
In dat kader is betalen van een redelijke goodwill door (startende) notarissen die een kantoor willen overnemen gebruikelijk en niet bezwaarlijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jan Vos over personen die wedstrijdinformatie doorspelen via de telefoon vanaf voetbaltribunes

MPs asked whether people relaying match statistics by phone from football stands are a growing problem, what powers clubs have to remove them, and whether gambling restrictions are needed. The minister answered that clubs set house rules and can remove people for misconduct or nuisance, that there is no increase in complaints, and that the gambling questions are addressed in a separate bill answer.
It is up to the clubs themselves to determine the level of nuisance.
Het is aan de clubs zelf om de mate van overlast te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het negeren van een negatief advies door de inlichtingendienst door de politie

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the police disregarded a negative AIVD advice when a police officer suspected of being a mole was cleared, and what measures will ensure such advice has consequences. The answer refers to a separate letter on the suspected officer rather than answering the questions in this document.
Further answer: the written questions from MP Helder (PVV) number 2015Z19390 have been answered by means of the letter 'Information about the suspected police officer'.
Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Helder (PVV) vraagnummer 2015Z19390 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Informatie over de verdachte politieambtenaar»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over campagnebrieven van de AK-partij aan Turkse Nederlanders

An MP asked whether foreign-party campaign letters from the AKP sent to Turkish Dutch residents had used Dutch government or consulate data, and whether the CBP is investigating. The government answered that political activity by foreign parties is lawful unless legal limits are crossed, that the CBP has requested information and its outcome will be awaited, and that it will consult Belgian and German counterparts on experiences there.
The Data Protection Authority (CBP) has sent a request for information.
Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) heeft een verzoek om inlichtingen uitgestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de aanpak van radicalisering is gedoemd te mislukken

Rep. Kuzu asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Dutch approach to radicalisation, which an expert called doomed to fail, polarises society, is based on a wrong equation of counter-terrorism with Islamic culture, and should be replaced by a more effective approach with concrete measures. The minister replies that the approach targets all forms of violent extremism, that the integrated evaluation of the National CT strategy is underway with results to be sent to the House in spring 2016, and that psychosocial factors are taken into account while research continues.
The results of the evaluation will be sent to the House of Representatives in spring 2016.
De resultaten van de evaluatie zullen in het voorjaar van 2016 naar de Tweede Kamer worden verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de politie de nekklem mag blijven gebruiken van de rechter

MP Kuzu asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police use of the neck hold after a court ruling allowed it to continue, including its training, deaths and injuries, whether it should be banned pending an Inspectorate investigation, and prosecution of officers. The Minister replied that force is assessed case by case, the court found no general ban was warranted, the Inspectorate is investigating neck-hold use with results expected in December, and the Rijksrecherche investigates deaths and serious injuries with prosecution decided by the Openbaar Ministerie.
As I informed your House on 10 July, I asked the Inspectorate of Security and Justice to launch an investigation into police use of the neck hold.
Zoals ik uw Kamer op 10 juli jl. liet weten heb ik de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie verzocht een onderzoek in te stellen naar het gebruik van de nekklem door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over huisbezoeken van wijkagenten bij leden van Asielzoekerscentra (AZC)-alert in Enschede

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether police home visits to members of the anti-asylum-centre group AZC-alert in Enschede, which may feel intimidating, should be stopped and whether this capacity could be used for crime fighting. The minister replied that such contact is routine police work under local authority responsibility, does not infringe free speech or assembly, and that there is no reason to change the practice.
In view of my answers to the above questions, there is no reason to change the police's working method on this point.
Gelet op mijn antwoorden op bovenstaande vragen, is er geen reden om de werkwijze van de politie op dit punt te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder, Fritsma en Wilders over wijkagenten die bezoeken brengen aan leden en sympathisanten van de protestgroep Asielzoekerscentra (AZC)-alert

PVV MPs asked whether police home visits to members and sympathisers of the anti-AZC protest group AZC-alert, in uniform and by police car, are intimidating and whether they will stop. The minister replied that proactive contact with groups planning demonstrations is routine police work under local authority, aimed at reducing tension, and that there is no reason to change the practice.
This takes place under the responsibility of the local authority.
Dit gebeurt onder verantwoordelijkheid van het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Nispen over het bericht dat het aantal rechtszaken over zorg fors is gestegen

MPs Van Gerven and Van Nispen asked why lawsuits over municipal Wmo care decisions keep rising, whether the government will intervene, and whether higher court fees and cuts to legal aid endanger citizens' access to justice. The Secretary of State answered that the rise partly stems from the new Wmo 2015 and that municipalities should improve careful implementation, with the government able to use supervisory powers only in cases of structural non-compliance, while declining to register social costs and promising a decision on legal aid after a commission report.
It is up to municipalities to learn from these rulings where necessary and improve policy implementation.
Het is aan gemeenten om – waar nog nodig – lering te trekken uit deze uitspraken en de beleidsuitvoering te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over de slechte bereikbaarheid en gebrekkige kennis van de politie te water

MPs Kooiman and Bashir asked why water-police calls are poorly handled, why police officers without shipping expertise are deployed on water, and whether the abolished Deelorgaan Binnenvaart should be reinstated. The minister says the national service line is professional, the Landelijke Eenheid has invited shipping association ASV to discuss its complaints, the integrated Dienst Infrastructuur is designed to add capacity and knowledge, existing consultation forums exist, and no reinstatement is needed because the function is secured in current law.
The National Unit of the police has invited shipping association ASV to a meeting to gain more clarity about the problems it raised
De Landelijke Eenheid van de politie heeft de schippersverenging ASV uitgenodigd voor een gesprek om meer duidelijkheid te krijgen over de door haar genoemde problemen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over de onderhandelingen van stichting 'Qanitoen' om een pand in de Schilderswijk te kopen ten behoeve van de prediking van de radicaal salafistische imam

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the radical imam Fawaz, his prior convictions, the foundation Qanitoen's attempts to secure premises in The Hague, and what the government will do to prevent him gaining a fixed base. The minister answered that individual cases are not discussed, that municipalities and local partners decide intervention strategies case by case, and that a new counter-terrorism administrative measures law is pending before the Council of State.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen mededeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman en Ulenbelt over onveiligheid en beroepsziekten bij de brandweer

MPs Kooiman and Ulenbelt asked whether the government will act on a broadcast reporting that about 130 fire stations fail safety requirements and that occupational cancer risks among firefighters are poorly monitored. The minister answered that the safety regions as employers are responsible, that the Labour Inspectorate has given them six months to remedy shortcomings, and that a national 'clean work' guideline and further research are underway, while further action rests with the regions.
The Labour Inspectorate has given the safety regions 6 months to remedy the shortcomings.
De Inspectie SZW heeft de veiligheidsregio’s 6 maanden de tijd gegeven om de tekortkomingen op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over de rol van banken bij faillissementen

MPs Nijboer and Recourt asked the Ministers of Finance and Justice about banks' role in the Imtech bankruptcy, including criticised information provision, pre-pack procedures, account blocking and protection of stakeholders. The Minister of Justice answered in general terms, declining to assess the specific case, and pointed to the Wet continuïteit ondernemingen I and related faillissementsrecht reforms as remedies.
To avoid misunderstanding, I note that in answering these questions I make no findings about the factual course of events surrounding the Imtech bankruptcy.

Ter voorkoming van misverstanden merk ik op dat ik bij de beantwoording van de hier aan de orde zijnde vragen geen vaststellingen doe over de feitelijke gang van zaken rond het faillissement van Imtech.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de schiettraining van politieagenten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police firearms training hours, comparing them unfavourably with civilian gun-permit requirements, and asked about laser-based training. The minister gave hours figures, said the comparison is not apt, pointed to CAO negotiations and IBT renewal, and said the laser pilot will be evaluated before any decision on expansion.
The pilot will be evaluated, after which the desirability of a possible follow-up will be considered.
De pilot wordt geëvalueerd waarna de wenselijkheid van een eventueel vervolg zal worden bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Volp over het bericht dat de politie dagelijks met levensgevaarlijke chemicaliën werkt

MPs Marcouch and Volp asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police dismantling illegal drug labs face life-threatening conditions, including work weeks of 60 hours, staffing levels of the LFO team, and whether a safety analysis was done. The Minister confirmed the 2014 Inspectorate re-inspection report, attached it with correspondence, referred to earlier answers for substance, and said a mandatory safety analysis has since been carried out for LFO work.
As requested, I am sending you the report and the accompanying correspondence as an annex to these answers.
Zoals gevraagd doe ik u als bijlage bij deze antwoorden het rapport en de begeleidende correspondentie toekomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht “Politie die drugslabs ontruimde ‘onverantwoord’ ingezet”

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police dismantling drug labs were overworked and exposed to dangerous conditions, and whether leadership knew and why the Inspectorate's report was not published. The minister acknowledged high workload, cited doubled LFO capacity, tightened deployment criteria and stricter Arbeidstijdenwet compliance, and explained that individual inspection reports are not published, only aggregate factsheets.
Individual fine reports are not published by the Inspectorate.
Individuele boeterapporten worden door de Inspectie niet gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat voorschotfraude toeneemt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why advance-fee fraud (fake inheritance and lottery scams) appears to be rising, what causes it, how it is prevented and prosecuted, and whether international cooperation is adequate. The minister answered that the reported increase is partly overstated, attributed rises to internet use and awareness, pointed to prevention, the Veiligheidsagenda target of 1,500 horizontal fraud cases in 2015, and an international working group, while stating he has no data on the exact chance of being caught.
I do not have data to determine the exact chance of being caught.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens om de exacte pakkans te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat agrariërs in Eemnes een auto met drie Marokkaanse jongens hebben geblokkeerd

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether farmers in Eemnes blocking a car with three Moroccan youths, and alerting police, amounted to suspicion based on ethnicity and whether the minister would discuss this with the mayor. The minister relayed the mayor's account that the car was parked suspiciously at night, the road was not actually blocked, police checked the occupants, and declined a meeting, leaving public order to local authority.
It is up to the local authority to maintain public order and up to the municipal council to exchange views with the mayor on this if desired.
Het is aan het lokale gezag om de openbare orde te handhaven en aan de gemeenteraad om hier desgewenst met de burgemeester over van gedachten te wisselen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘OM wil van RIVM info hielprik baby container’

MPs Oskam and Bruins Slot asked whether the Public Prosecution Service could compel RIVM to release medical data from a newborn heel-prick test in a baby-in-container case, and how medical confidentiality is protected. The ministers replied that no court action is currently under consideration, that confidentiality can be overridden only in exceptional circumstances as set by the Supreme Court, and that RIVM has rarely received such requests and has not overridden confidentiality since 2012.
Taking legal steps is currently not at all on the agenda.
Het nemen van gerechtelijke stappen is op dit moment in het geheel niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de invoering van de digitale meldplicht en vernieuwing van het Voetbal Volg Systeem

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the digital reporting obligation (digitale meldplicht) for football violence had not yet been used, why municipalities showed little interest, and whether the Voetbal Volg Systeem renewal would be delayed. The minister answered that the option became legally available on 1 July 2015, two municipalities are exploring it, municipalities bear the costs, and the Voetbal Volg Systeem's further development is planned to start in 2016 subject to police absorption capacity.
Because no administrative decision-making has yet taken place in these municipalities, I cannot name them.
Omdat in deze gemeenten nog geen bestuurlijke besluitvorming heeft plaatsgevonden, kan ik ze niet bij naam noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een nieuwe islamitische geweldprediker naar Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a preacher known for endorsing flogging and violence would speak at a Rotterdam mosque, whether his visa could be revoked, and what measures would stop such foreign preachers. The government said the preacher holds a visa issued by another Schengen country and no grounds for revocation currently exist, the mosque has no ANBI status, and it will use enforcement plus dialogue and, where needed, criminal action against incitement.
This preacher received a visa from another Schengen country.
Deze prediker heeft van een ander Schengenland een visum gekregen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over de business case om de rechtbank Almelo half te ontmantelen

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a business case exists for halving the Almelo court, whether local officials can receive it, and whether it will be made public. The minister answered that the judiciary prepared no business case for Almelo, only financial projections based on reference projects and existing contracts, and that the figures were shared with local administrators.
The judiciary, as the Council for the Judiciary has informed me, has not prepared a business case for the planned housing arrangements for Almelo.
De rechtspraak heeft, zo heeft de Raad voor de rechtspraak (hierna: Raad) mij meegedeeld, voor de voorgenomen huisvestingplannen met betrekking tot Almelo geen business case opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ulenbelt over de omstandigheden bij het Europees octrooibureau in Rijswijk en de inzet van Nederland

SP MPs asked why the Dutch representative on the EPO Administrative Council supported 2013 strike restrictions and 2015 sick-leave rules, whether Dutch privacy and labour inspection apply to the EPO, and what Netherlands is doing about labour conflict. The State Secretary answered that the rules were modelled on ILO standards, that Netherlands pushed for safeguards and review, that the Netherlands joined the Supreme Court appeal on EPO immunity, and that the social dialogue has so far produced no concrete results.
However, if it turns out that intervention by a third party, for example through mediation, is indeed desirable, I would like to commit to that, in consultation with other countries.
Als echter blijkt dat interventie door een derde, bijvoorbeeld via mediation, inderdaad wenselijk wordt, dan wil ik mij daar graag, in samenspraak met andere landen, voor inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over arbeidsomstandigheden bij het Europees Octrooibureau (EOB)

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked about working conditions and reported suicides at the European Patent Office, including whether a social dialogue has improved things and whether an independent Inspectorate SZW investigation can be arranged. The Staatssecretaris answers that the dialogue is difficult and not yet producing results, that the Inspectorate lacks powers due to EPO immunity and would only inspect at the request of management, and that the Administrative Council has no independent power to order such an investigation.
The labour inspectorate is willing to carry out an inspection at the EPO should a request be received, provided management asks for it and commits to it.
De inspectie SZW is bereid een inspectie uit te voeren bij het EOB mocht een verzoek daartoe ontvangen worden vooropgesteld dat het management daarom vraagt en zich eraan committeert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat een man op social media dreigt met massamoord op Turkse Nederlanders

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a social media video in which a man threatens mass murder of Turkish Dutch people, and whether the person's identity and PKK links would be investigated. The minister said all instruments are used against threats, declined to comment on individual cases for investigative reasons, and reported no current indications of physical threat from the PKK in the Netherlands.
For the sake of investigation and prosecution interests, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Omwille van de belangen van opsporing en vervolging kan ik over individuele gevallen geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp, Jacobi en Ypma over het bericht van kindermishandeling in een tehuis voor jongeren met het Prader-Willi syndroom

Three PvdA MPs asked about reports of systematic abuse of residents at a Prader-Willi youth home under enhanced Inspectorate supervision, and whether the home should be closed. The State Secretary answered that the IGZ found no evidence of abuse in its visits, that a prosecution was dropped for insufficient evidence, and that the home remains under monitoring with a follow-up inspection pending.
The Northern Netherlands district public prosecution service opened a criminal investigation following complaints by former staff about abuse.
Het arrondissementsparket Noord-Nederland heeft een strafrechtelijk onderzoek ingesteld naar aanleiding van aangiftes door oud-medewerkers over mishandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de Nederlander die mogelijk 31 jaar ten onrechte vastzit in de VS

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the Netherlands refuses to support the transfer of Dutch national Singh, who may be wrongly imprisoned in the US, and whether consular support, his health and the Ombudsman's recommendation were considered. The Minister answered that Singh lacks sufficient ties to the Netherlands and no sentence remainder after transfer, so no exception to policy is justified, and that the Netherlands bears no responsibility for the US judicial process.

Based on a careful review of all available information, including that of the Dutch Consulate-General in San Francisco on Mr Singh's health and the information submitted by his lawyer, it appears he does not meet the conditions for transfer to the Netherlands and an exception to policy is not justified in this case.

Op basis van een zorgvuldige toetsing van alle beschikbare informatie, waaronder die van het Nederlandse Consulaat-Generaal te San Francisco over de gezondheidstoestand van de heer Singh en de informatie ingebracht door zijn advocaat, blijkt betrokkene niet te voldoen aan de voorwaarden om naar Nederland te worden overgebracht en is een uitzondering op het beleid in deze casus niet gerechtvaardigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Berndsen-Jansen over de detentie van een Nederlands staatsburger in het buitenland

MPs Sjoerdsma and Berndsen-Jansen asked why the government refuses to transfer Dutch detainee Mr Singh from the US and why WOTS requests are refused for Dutch citizens abroad for more than five years. The minister answered that transfer requires sufficient ties with the Netherlands and a remaining sentence of at least four months, neither of which is met, and that the five-year rule is only an indication while medical situation is subordinate to resocialisation.
In this case neither of the two criteria is met.
In deze casus wordt aan beide criteria niet voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht “Alarm om relatie psychotherapeute met gedetineerde”

An MP asked whether a forensic psychotherapist who married a long-sentenced prisoner should still be allowed to carry out assessments, and how conflicts of interest are prevented. The Secretary of State answered that she declared the relationship, agreed to avoid certain reports and prisons, and that her professionalism and the safeguards are sufficient, so no termination of cooperation is needed.
Agreements have been made with her on carrying out her work in connection with this former relationship.
Met haar zijn afspraken gemaakt over het uitvoeren van haar werkzaamheden in verband met deze ex-relatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat het nieuwe tapbeleid van Justitie een aanval is op onze grondrechten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the new interception standard means police now tap phone and internet data by default, and questioned proportionality, transparency, retention and the CBP's role. The Minister replied that the change is technical and procedural only, that the legal framework and tapping practice are unchanged, that each tap request is reviewed by the prosecutor and examining magistrate, and that tap counts no longer distinguish phone from internet taps.
There is no situation in which all telephone and internet data are now tapped by default.
Er is geen sprake van een situatie dat nu standaard alle telefoon- en internetgegevens worden getapt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht Foto met mijn favoriete geleerde

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about a senior prison-service manager's tweet praising an Islamic scholar linked to the Muslim Brotherhood, and whether he holds an incompatible position with an advisory body; the government says the secondary activities were approved and periodically reviewed, the individual was reminded of social media conduct, and it sees no need for a broad screening of all ministries. Answers refer to AIVD assessments and existing integrity mechanisms but commit to no new action.
No, I see no need for this.
Nee, hiertoe zie ik geen noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Keijzer over de gevolgen van een wijziging van een procesreglement van de rechtbanken

MPs Oskam and Keijzer asked whether a 2015 change to the Civil Youth Law procedural regulation, based on a Supreme Court ruling, removed parents without custody from the status of interested party in child supervision and placement cases, along with their rights to information, file access and participation, and what support they would receive. The minister confirmed the change, said the removal of automatic party status is a consequence of the ruling, that no data on the group exist, that parents should not be blamed and the consequences will be examined, and that no extra measures are planned because information provision is considered adequate.
That a parent without custody is no longer (by default) regarded as an interested party therefore means that the abovementioned rights lapse.
Dat een ouder zonder gezag niet langer (standaard) als belanghebbende wordt aangemerkt betekent dus dat de hierboven genoemde rechten vervallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat de Turkse autoriteiten de verzoeken om rechtshulp inzake de kwestie Demmink niet hebben gehonoreerd

MP Bontes asks whether Turkey's refusal of Dutch legal assistance requests in the Demmink case rests on a final dismissal that covers only one complainant, whether Turkish witnesses are needed, and whether the lawyer received the requests and replies. The minister declines to discuss the content of the ongoing criminal investigation, says he expects Turkey to reconsider after a call with the Turkish justice minister, and states that the public prosecution service informed the complainants' lawyer.
On the content of the case I cannot, as usual with ongoing criminal investigations, make any statements.
Over de inhoud van de zaak kan ik, zoals gebruikelijk bij lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken, geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over de storing bij Ziggo ten gevolge van DDos-aanvallen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Ziggo outage caused by DDoS attacks, including its effect on public services, government measures, private anti-DDoS initiatives and the NCSC's role. The state secretary answered that providers are primarily responsible for their own security, that the outage did not affect government digital services directly, and that the government is pursuing general cyber resilience measures and a facilitating role with private initiatives.
Parties, both inside and outside government, are themselves primarily responsible for securing their own networks and systems.
Partijen zijn, zowel binnen als buiten de overheid, zelf primair verantwoordelijk voor de beveiliging van de eigen netwerken en systemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het bericht dat de rechtbank in Almelo compleet wordt uitgekleed

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about plans to strip the Almelo court of its functions, citing the Teeven/Heerts motion, earlier commitments, the penitentiary link, travel times and unemployment. The minister answered that the 32 hearing locations are equivalent but may differ in case mix, that the plan is driven by building vacancy and budget cuts, and that the Masterplan has not yet been adopted by the judiciary, which will be sent to parliament after adoption.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Fokke over het sluiten van de rechtbank in Almelo

MPs Recourt and Fokke asked whether the court in Almelo would be closed, whether this threatens local jobs, and how it fits with the motion on accessible justice. The minister replied that no closure is planned, that the judiciary's own multi-year plan (not a ministerial decision) moves workplaces to Zwolle without job losses in Overijssel, and that any zoning change is the judiciary's responsibility under board and Raad oversight.
The MJP is a document of the judiciary and is not approved by the Minister of Security and Justice.
Het MJP is een document van de rechtspraak en wordt niet door de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie bekrachtigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Wolbert over het sluiten van de rechtbank in Assen

MPs Recourt and Wolbert asked whether the Assen district court would be closed, citing a press report, and about job losses and conflict with a motion on local access to justice. The Minister replied that there is no plan to close the Assen location, that shifting some workplaces to Leeuwarden and Groningen would not cost jobs in the court district, and that the court board is responsible for any zoning decision under Council for the Judiciary oversight.
There is no intention to close the Assen location of the Noord-Nederland district court.
Er is geen sprake van een voornemen om de locatie Assen van de rechtbank Noord-Nederland te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en De Caluwé over de meerjarenplannen van de Raad voor de Rechtspraak
