Two MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers how access to justice at reasonable distance is guaranteed under the judiciary's multi-year plans, and about regional employment effects and coordination with other government relocations. The minister answered that the 32 court locations remain legally fixed, that the relocation may shift jobs locally but not reduce total judiciary employment, and that the housing minister will report in autumn on regional employment effects.
The proposed location policy, as described in the proposed multi-year plan, leads to a shift of jobs within a number of courts.
Het voorgenomen locatiebeleid, zoals beschreven in het voorgenomen MJP, leidt tot een verschuiving van arbeidsplaatsen binnen een aantal gerechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Agnes Mulder over de gevolgen van de huisvestingsplannen van de Rechtspraak voor de rechtbank Assen

MPs Oskam and Agnes Mulder ask the Minister of Justice how the judiciary's proposed housing plans would reduce the Assen court's caseload and staff, whether Assen remains a full sitting location, and how local consultation is handled. The Minister answers that Assen remains one of 32 sitting locations, that the plan is only a proposed decision, that criminal cases against detained suspects and commercial claims over EUR 25,000 would likely no longer be heard there, and that detailed staff and travel figures cannot yet be given.
At this stage, in which the Council and the presidents have taken a proposed decision, I cannot give an answer to this question.
Op deze vraag kan ik in dit stadium, waarin de Raad en de presidenten een voorgenomen besluit hebben genomen, geen antwoord geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Oosenbrug over het gebruik van open standaarden in de informatievoorziening van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) en het departement van Veiligheid en Ju

MPs Gesthuizen and Oosenbrug asked whether UWV PDF documents could be read by open-source readers, what UWV's open-standards rules are, and whether the government will follow the motion favouring open standards and open-source software. The minister answered that UWV switched some letters to a more advanced PDF version that failed in open-source and mobile readers, so it reverted to simpler PDFs, and promised to inform the House on the motion's implementation.
Following these signals, UWV has meanwhile reverted to using the less advanced PDFs for the most frequently used letters to customers.
Naar aanleiding van die signalen is UWV voor de meest gebruikte brieven aan klanten inmiddels weer overgegaan op het gebruik van de minder geavanceerde PDF's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de open brief van de regioburgemeesters inzake het afpakken van crimineel vermogen

MP Van Oosten (VVD) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a letter from regional mayors urging stronger confiscation of criminal assets, including a revolving fund, the budgeting obstacles, and the claimed EUR 9.3 billion in criminal wealth. The Minister welcomed the proposals, pointed to funding already provided and EUR 3 million structurally added, said a business case needs more evidence, and called the EUR 9.3 billion estimate unsubstantiated.

The ministries of Finance and of Security and Justice will therefore take the initiative to jointly examine with the relevant chain partners whether and how a sufficiently robust business case can be drawn up.

De ministeries van Financiën en van Veiligheid en Justitie nemen daarom het initiatief om gezamenlijk met betrokken ketenpartners te bezien of en hoe een voldoende harde business case kan worden opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de tientallen miljoenen die het Rijk laat liggen door een versnipperde aanpak

MP Helder asks whether the state leaves tens of millions unclaimed through a fragmented approach to seizing criminal assets, and whether the government will pool budgets and invest in regional asset-seizure teams. The minister disputes the underlying estimates as unreliable, calls the current target ambitious but realistic, and points to a structural 3 million euro increase in the 2016 budget while referring to earlier answers.
There are no reliable estimates of how much criminal money actually circulates in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen betrouwbare schattingen over hoeveel «misdaadgeld» er precies omgaat in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het plan van burgemeesters en de voorzitter van het College van procureurs-generaal (OM) om meer crimineel vermogen af te pakken

MP Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a mayors' and Public Prosecution Service plan for more integrated confiscation of criminal assets, and whether the existing approach, the Aanwijzing afpakken, funding and targets need changing. The minister answered that integrated confiscation is supported and already practised, that a €3 million structural increase is provided, and that no concrete budget or revised targets will be set until a sufficiently solid business case is made.

The ministries of Finance and of Security and Justice therefore take the initiative to jointly examine with the relevant chain partners whether and how a sufficiently robust business case can be drawn up.

De ministeries van Financiën en van Veiligheid en Justitie nemen daarom het initiatief om gezamenlijk met betrokken ketenpartners te bezien of en hoe een voldoende harde business case kan worden opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Fokke over het sluiten van een rechtbank in Limburg

Two PvdA MPs asked whether a court in Limburg (Roermond or Maastricht) would close, with consequences for jobs, and how this fits the motion on keeping small-claims justice accessible. The Minister answered that neither location is being closed, that planned relocation of workplaces within the district means no job losses in Limburg, and that the Rechtspraak retains responsibility for its locations under ministerial oversight.
There is no intention to close either of the two locations of the Limburg district court, namely the sitting places Maastricht or Roermond.
Er is geen sprake van een voornemen om een van de twee locaties van de rechtbank Limburg, namelijk de zittingsplaatsen Maastricht of Roermond, te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over het ondermijnen van bestuurdersaansprakelijkheid

Two MPs from the PvdA ask whether foreign legal-entity directors can shield individuals from liability, whether a permanent representative should be required as in other EU states, and how money laundering and company fraud can be prevented. The minister answers that Dutch law already reaches such cases in some situations, that a mandatory representative for all corporate directors would burden trade and may conflict with EU freedoms, and points to the forthcoming UBO register and other measures.

Since the liability of the director of a corporate director is structured in this way in the Netherlands, there is insufficient reason to legally oblige every corporate director to appoint a permanent representative.

Nu de aansprakelijkheid van de bestuurder van een rechtspersoon-bestuurder in Nederland op deze wijze is vormgegeven, bestaat er onvoldoende reden om iedere rechtspersoon-bestuurder wettelijk te verplichten om een vaste vertegenwoordiger aan te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over een mogelijke verijdelde terreuraanslag bij de politie in Rotterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported foiled terror attack on the Rotterdam police and whether security measures at police sites were relaxed too quickly and are inadequate. The minister confirmed awareness, described the January 2015 incident as local with no prosecution, and declined to comment publicly on threats to specific sites, citing security reasons.
For security reasons, I do not make public statements about threats and risks regarding specific objects and services.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik in het openbaar geen uitspraken over dreiging en risico ten aanzien van specifieke objecten en diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Berndsen-Jansen over de berichten dat de Nederlandse Politie Sint Maarten te corrupt vindt

MPs Hachchi and Berndsen-Jansen asked about reports that the Dutch police consider the Sint Maarten police too corrupt to cooperate with, and about the rules, powers and remedies around the Recherche Samenwerkingsteam. The government answered that the team's reinforcement is planned for 24 months, that an Integrity Chamber law was adopted in Sint Maarten, and that cooperation with the Sint Maarten police will be intensified under the 24 May 2015 protocol.
The Integrity Chamber Ordinance was adopted by the Estates of Sint Maarten on 18 August 2015.
De Landsverordening Integriteitkamer is op 18 augustus 2015 door de Staten van Sint Maarten vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Recourt over het gebruik van de Friese taal in de rechtszaal

MPs Jacobi and Recourt asked why a Frisian-only mestsilo case was assigned to Almelo rather than Friesland, and whether defendants may be tried in Frisian. The minister explained that specialist Functioneel Parket cases are concentrated at four courts, and that the court has moved the hearing to Zwolle to reduce travel while offering a Frisian interpreter.
Since the case could also have been heard in Almelo in Frisian with the help of a Frisian interpreter, there was no reason to deviate from this arrangement.
Aangezien de behandeling van de zaak ook in Almelo in het Fries had kunnen plaatsvinden met behulp van een tolk Fries, was er geen reden om van deze afspraak af te wijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het onderzoek dat gedaan is naar de gang van zaken rond de presentatie van een professor m.b.t. de ramp met de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked the Minister of Security and Justice to publish the police investigation behind the 10 June letter on the presentations by Professor Maat about the MH17 victim identification, and to clarify who was interviewed, when statements were signed, what agreements existed, and how the photos were shared. The Minister answered that large parts of the internal fact-finding report will be made public in anonymised form once personal data is protected, gave Maat access without secrecy, acknowledged the handling of photos was not careful and that formal rules are being drawn up, and declined to answer the questions one by one within the regular deadline.
Following your questions and four requests under the Freedom of Information Act (Wob) that have since been received, the police have considered the possible publication of the investigation.

Mede naar aanleiding van uw vragen en vier verzoeken op grond van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob), die inmiddels zijn ontvangen, heeft de politie de mogelijke openbaarmaking van het onderzoek bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Oskam over het bericht dat woningen onbereikbaar worden

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether housing is becoming unreachable due to the rise in asylum residence permits, and what the government is doing about it. The minister answered with figures on the housing quota for permit holders, mentioned the Ministerial Commission on Migration and local tools, but gave few concrete commitments.
I further expect that the measures proposed by the Ministerial Commission will offer further additions in this regard.
Ik verwacht daarnaast dat de maatregelen die door de Ministeriële Commissie voorgesteld worden daarop nog aanvullingen zullen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het farmaceutische bedrijf Mylan

An MP asked ministers whether Dutch pharmaceutical firm Mylan supplies drugs used in US executions and what it will do to prevent this. The minister answered that Mylan refused to give a guarantee, that the government expects further steps, and that EU export controls and the OECD complaint process are being pursued.

Since the answer to the parliamentary questions mentioned in question 1, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has had repeated contact on this matter with Mylan itself, investor APG, the NGO Reprieve, and the lawyer Stapert.
Sinds de beantwoording van de in vraag 1 genoemde Kamervragen heeft het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken over deze kwestie verschillende malen contact gehad
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de fair play competitie voor jonge voetballertjes

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Justice about the KNVB's fair play youth football competition without referees and with parents kept at a distance, and whether it could be rolled out nationally. The minister replied that she supports the KNVB initiative and the Veiliger Sportklimaat action plan, leaving scaling-up to sport itself while sports clubs are linked to partners in a broader chain approach.
I therefore support the KNVB in continuing this process.
Ik steun de KNVB dan ook in het doorzetten van dit traject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Gesthuizen en Kooiman over het artikel ‘De 7 plagen van het ministerie van Veiligheid & Justitie’

The SP MPs Van Nispen, Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice to react to a NRC article describing dysfunction at the ministry, including image management and weak business operations. The minister disputes the article's characterisations, says the ministry manages its operations well and is open and transparent, and promises separate answers and reference to the Oosting inquiry.
I do not recognise the claim in the article that problems are taboo or that we operate in a hostile environment.
Ik herken mij bijvoorbeeld niet in de bewering in het artikel dat problemen «taboe» zijn of dat we in een «vijandige omgeving» opereren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat een automobilist €2500,00 aan onterechte boetes heeft gekregen

An MP asked whether a motorist wrongly received EUR 2,500 in speeding fines from a speed camera, how many such cameras exist, and whether other drivers were affected. The minister said the case involved one vehicle with specific characteristics, that a supplier fix has been implemented on all cameras of this type, and that no further investigation is needed.
There are no known other cases in which an offence was wrongly recorded.
Er zijn geen andere gevallen bekend waarbij ten onrechte een overtreding is geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat usb-sticks gestolen zijn bij een inbraak bij een officier van justitie

An MP asked whether unencrypted USB sticks holding case information of the public prosecution service (OM) were stolen in a burglary and how such leaks will be prevented. The minister confirmed the incident, said the data was placed on unsecured sticks by mistake, and gave no figure on how many unsecured sticks are in use, while stating that rules were reiterated to staff.
By mistake, the information was placed on unsecured USB sticks.
Per abuis is de informatie op onbeveiligde usb-sticks gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Marcouch over de gewelddadige dood van een vrouw uit Waalwijk

MPs Rebel and Marcouch ask the Minister of Security and Justice how police handled reports and complaints of threats, stalking and domestic violence before a woman from Waalwijk was killed, and whether it was linked to shelter capacity, police capacity or the lack of a protocol. The minister answers that police assess each case, that there is no evidence of cuts to women's shelters, that recruitment and capacity have grown, and that no additional protocol or investigation is needed beyond planned victim-protection implementation.
I therefore do not consider an additional protocol necessary.
Ik acht een aanvullend protocol dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over kennis en procedures van de politie over bedreigingen en huiselijk geweld

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about errors in the police investigation of threats against a victim, the number of comparable cases, police capacity and expertise, protocols for threats, and officer training. The minister acknowledged the errors but said no comparable case count is known, the police have sufficient powers and training, and a specific protocol is not considered necessary.
The requested number of comparable cases is not known.
Het gevraagde aantal vergelijkbare gevallen is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over de opslag van DNA-data bij onder andere Google en Amazon

MPs Gesthuizen and Leijten (SP) asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about the lack of oversight of DNA data storage and sale by companies such as Google, Amazon and Illumina, including consent, legal basis, and the role of the Cbp. The minister answered that DNA is a free market regulated by privacy law, that the Cbp decides independently whether to investigate, and that a planned bill on control over body material and EU data-protection rules are in progress.
Given the independent position of the Cbp, it is up to the Cbp itself to determine whether it proceeds to do so.
Gelet op de onafhankelijke positie van het Cbp, is het aan het Cbp zelf om te bepalen of het daartoe overgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Potters over de opvang van geradicaliseerde meisjes en jongens in jeugdzorginstellingen

Two VVD MPs asked how many minors have been intercepted or returned from Syria or Iraq, where radicalised youths are housed, and whether separate deradicalisation facilities exist. The government answered that about 35 Dutch jihadists have returned, that radicalised youths can be placed in regular youth care without separate facilities, and that a new exit facility with tailored trajectories will open in September 2015, with more detail promised in the next progress report.
On individual cases or further breakdown, the cabinet makes no statements.
Over individuele gevallen of verdere uitsplitsing doet het kabinet geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het negeren van een uitspraak van de Reclame Code Commissie

An MP asked ministers why an erotic website's advertising, already ruled against by the Advertising Code Commission, could reappear on a beach banner and whether current enforcement tools are sufficient. The government answered that the Code applies to banners, that the firm complied with the earlier ruling (96% of advertisers comply), that a new complaint is being assessed, and that current instruments are adequate.
Given the high percentage of advertisers that follow a ruling (96%), I consider the current instruments sufficient.
Gelet op het hoge percentage adverteerders dat een uitspraak opvolgt (96%), acht ik de huidige instrumenten voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Potters en Tellegen over het bericht ‘terrorist sprak in moskee’

Two VVD MPs asked why authorities were not informed about a convicted terrorist speaking at a mosque in Geleen, and what the government would do against mosque boards inviting such speakers, including whether mosques should be closed and whether a blacklist of hate preachers is appropriate. The government declined to discuss specifics of information sharing, said mosque boards inviting speakers with intolerant messages is unacceptable, pointed to criminal prosecution and the local triangle, and said no blacklist exists but an alerting list maintained by the NCTV for visa assessment.
No statements can be made publicly about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat de bezuinigingen op het NFI problemen opleveren voor het opsporen van criminelen (tevens verzoek Van Nispen)

The MP asks whether cuts of 9 million euros at the Netherlands Forensic Institute (NFI) will harm criminal investigations, given concerns from the Public Prosecution Service, and whether the cuts will be reversed. The minister answers that the cuts are part of the efficiency target, that police and prosecutors manage forensic demand through existing agreements, that reorganisation costs are incidental, and that core NFI production stays intact, without reversing the cut.
The core production of the NFI remains fully intact.
De kernproductie van het NFI blijft onverkort overeind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van der Staaij over gebruik van onderzoek naar drugsresten in rioolwater als aanvullend instrument naast andere drugsmonitoringmethoden

MPs Segers and Van der Staaij asked whether wastewater analysis for drug residues is a useful supplement to other drug monitoring methods and whether it should be deployed structurally and nationally, including for designer drugs. The state secretary replied that the method has limited added value compared with national surveys and other monitoring sources, saw no need for further research, and declined to step up its use.
I therefore see no added value in further research.
Ik zie derhalve geen toegevoegde waarde in nader onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het aantal paspoorten dat vervallen verklaard wordt

Opposition MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the government to reconcile conflicting figures on passports declared void for suspected jihadist travel, whether Dutch citizens' passports are revoked alongside second-nationality passports, and whether cooperation with Turkey and Morocco exists on revoking passports. The Minister gave figures clarifying the difference between total signalled passports and active signals, acknowledged that identity cards can still enable travel, announced a bill on travel bans and identity card revocation, and stated there are no specific agreements with Turkey on mutual passport revocation.
I do not provide further statements about individual cases.
Over de individuele gevallen doe ik geen nadere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Terrorist sprak in moskee’

Members Oskam and Van Helvert (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a convicted terrorist and a controversial preacher spoke at the Al Houda mosque in Geleen and what authorities knew and did. The minister answered that police found no evidence that the man in the footage is Ouaboer or of any criminal offence, so no investigation was opened, and that the government considers preaching of intolerant or anti-democratic messages unacceptable, while declining to detail information sharing between agencies.
However, I will not go into further detail on the extent and manner in which information was shared between the authorities involved.
Ik zal echter niet nader ingaan op de mate en wijze waarop informatie is gedeeld tussen betrokken instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ark en Tellegen over de berichten ‘Aangifte doen na aanranding zo makkelijk nog niet’ en ‘Onbegrip over verplichte bedenktijd bij aangifte aanranding’

VVD MPs Van Ark and Tellegen asked whether the mandatory reflection period offered to victims of sexual offences before filing a report, and related protection and anonymity questions, deter reporting. Minister Van der Steur answered that the reflection period is optional and flexible, that victims can file immediately if they wish, that the police inform victims about procedure, and that protection and anonymity options exist but full anonymity toward a known suspect is impractical.
It is not a procedural requirement before a report can be filed.
Het gaat niet om een procedurele verplichting alvorens aangifte gedaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over de behandeling van aangiften van zedenmisdrijven door de politie

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether a journalist's rape complaint was handled per the prosecution guideline on sexual abuse, and whether police always have specially trained officers take such reports, plus whether victims' secondary victimisation has been studied. The Minister says the handling followed the guideline except that the report was taken by one certified sex-crimes detective and a team officer due to time pressure, agrees victims should decide on filing, and points to 2010 and 2014 studies and a 2013 study on sexual violence centres, seeing no need for new research.
The handling of the journalist's case followed the said guideline, except for the taking of the report.
De behandeling van de zaak van de journaliste is conform de genoemde aanwijzing verlopen, met uitzondering van het opnemen van de aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Bergkamp over seksueel misbruik bij boeddhisten in Nederland

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Bergkamp asked the ministers about alleged sexual abuse by Buddhist monks and teachers in the Netherlands, including prevention, reporting, victim support and prosecution limits. The government said it cannot establish misconduct from police and prosecutor information but cannot rule it out, pointed to free certificates of conduct for volunteers, a 'safe church' toolkit, awareness campaigns and victim support services, and noted that statutes of limitation no longer apply to serious sexual offences against children.
Based on information from the Public Prosecution Service and the police, I cannot establish whether Buddhist monks and/or teachers have committed sexual abuse.
Op basis van de informatie van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en de politie kan ik niet vaststellen of boeddhistische monniken en/of leraren zich schuldig hebben gemaakt aan seksueel misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanslag in een Thalys vanuit Amsterdam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about the foiled terrorist attack on a Thalys train from Amsterdam: the attacker's nationality, whether it was jihadist, how a Kalashnikov could be carried aboard, and whether armed forces and marechaussee should guard vulnerable locations and honour the passengers who overpowered him. The minister answered that the attacker was Moroccan with a Spanish residence permit and that French authorities assume a jihadist motive; that passenger checks on international trains have limits; that security measures are reviewed after each incident without disclosing specific locations; and that the government respects the passengers' response, referring to earlier answers on decorations.
For security reasons I do not wish to go into the locations and the security measures in more detail.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen wil ik niet nader ingaan op de locaties en de beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht «Voormalig Paleis van Justitie in handen omstreden vastgoedman»

An MP asked whether the Bibob screening of the director of developer M7 was properly weighed against his prior prosecution settlement with the Public Prosecution Service, and about the sale of the former Amsterdam courthouse. The minister declined to discuss the Bibob advice details due to confidentiality, stated the sale is completed, and said any further zoning and Bibob decisions rest with the municipality.
I therefore cannot go into the specific content of the Bibob advice.
Ik kan derhalve niet op de specifieke inhoud van het Bibob-advies ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over de arrestatie van Carvajal en dreigende inval van Venezuela op Aruba

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked about the arrest of Venezuelan official Carvajal on Aruba, reports of Venezuelan warships approaching Aruba, and whether there was a military threat. The government answered that Carvajal enjoyed consular immunity under the Vienna Convention and was released, that the Venezuelan naval vessels were in Venezuelan territorial waters, that no military threats were made, and it answered most questions in substance while declining to comment on the exact words attributed to the Prime Minister.
The cabinet has taken note of the reports.
Het kabinet heeft kennisgenomen van de berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de zaak van R. van der D. (vervolgvragen)

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked why the minister withheld the confidential Grimbrere report on the case of R. van der D., when the government first learned of the DNA match, and what it has done to secure a Spanish DNA comparison and review. The minister answers that the report contains sensitive personal data so disclosure is the individual's choice, that Dutch policy is not to intervene in foreign judicial verdicts, and that the embassy is pressing Spanish authorities for a swift DNA verification.
The trust report contains special personal data (health and criminal data) within the meaning of the Dutch Data Protection Act, which stand in the way of sharing that information.

Het vertrouwensrapport bevat bijzondere persoonsgegevens (daar wordt onder verstaan: gezondheid en strafrechtelijke gegevens) zoals bedoeld in paragraaf 2, hoofdstuk 2 van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, die eraan in de weg staan om die informatie te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Smaling over het gebrekkige toezicht en de handhavingsaanpak bij zwanendriften

MPs Thieme and Smaling asked whether police and NVWA enforcement against swan-harassment is inadequate, whether the NVWA emergency line works, and whether a ban is needed. The minister rejects claims of inadequate enforcement, says NVWA and police coordinate well, and promises to investigate a legal ban by autumn.
There is no question of deficient enforcement.
Er is geen sprake van een gebrekkige handhavingsaanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Graus over de uitzending van EenVandaag over zwanendrifters

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police did not intervene against threats and abuse toward a veterinarian and residents involved with swan-drivers, and what would be done to protect them and stop the animal abuse, and whether a dedicated animal police should be reinstated. The minister replied that the police recorded the complaints, proces-verbaals were sent to the public prosecutor, the matter is handled under High Impact Crime, and the animal police function is kept as a task accent with about 180 task-accent holders deemed sufficient.
When people want to file a report of threat or mistreatment, the police record it.
Wanneer mensen aangifte willen doen van bedreiging of mishandeling, dan wordt dit door de politie opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de Katwijkse aanpak van drugs

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Katwijk's combined repressive and preventive approach to underage cannabis use should serve as a model, whether other municipalities can use the Public Prosecution Service's cooperation, and whether the government will inventory local practices and share the Katwijk approach. The minister called the combination of repression, prevention and parental involvement a good approach that can serve as an example, said municipalities can consult police, prosecution and Halt on comparable problems, and declined to inventory or circulate local initiatives because policy is a matter for local government.
Drafting policy that best suits the local situation is a matter for the competent local authority.
Het opstellen van beleid dat het meest geschikt is voor de lokale situatie is een zaak van het bevoegd lokaal gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Oproep tot ‘jihadbendes’ in Europa

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the ministers of Interior, Security and Justice, and Social Affairs about a report of calls for Muslim 'jihad gangs' in Europe, including calls to arm, attack police and recruit children, and whether the NCTV's dismissal of the material was adequate, and asked whether Islam is a problem requiring 'de-Islamisation'. The government answered that it takes jihadist violence seriously under its integrated action programme, that the NCTV rightly labelled the material jihadist propaganda with no reason to revise that view, and that Islam enjoys the same constitutional and human rights protection as other religions.
The cabinet takes the threat posed by violent jihadism extremely seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de dreiging die van het gewelddadig jihadisme uitgaat uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Politieleiding te vaag over gebruik geweld’ en het bericht ‘Bond: schietende agent moet standaard verdachte zijn’

An MP asked whether police officers are uncertain when they may use force under the Ambtsinstructie, whether force used outside those rules can still be justified, and whether officers who shoot should be treated as suspects or tried in a special court. The Minister says the rules are the outer limit, justification depends on the facts and is for the courts to judge, and the questions on suspect status, disciplinary law and a specialised court will be addressed in an ongoing review, with a letter to parliament promised before the 2016 budget debate.
In the short term, and in any case before the budget debate for my ministry for 2016, I will inform your House of my intentions on this matter.
Op korte termijn – en in ieder geval voor de behandeling van de begroting van mijn ministerie voor het jaar 2016 – zal ik uw Kamer informeren over mijn voornemens hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Oskam en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht “Pleidooi voor instellen speciaal tuchtrecht voor politie-agenten”

MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a special disciplinary law for police officers, similar to that for soldiers, should be studied given calls from police unions and experts. The Minister acknowledged the proposal and said it is being considered within the broader reform of how police use of force is handled, promising to inform parliament before the 2016 budget debate.
In the short term, and in any case before the budget debate of my ministry for 2016, I will inform your House of my intentions on this matter.
Op korte termijn – en in ieder geval voor de behandeling van de begroting van mijn ministerie voor het jaar 2016 – zal ik uw Kamer informeren over mijn voornemens hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het door het Openbaar Ministerie achterhouden van een rapport dat ontlastend was voor de veroordeelde in de Showbizzmoordzaak

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the Public Prosecution Service withheld an exculpatory report in the Showbizz murder case, whether privacy of others justified this, and what investigation and safeguards exist. The minister declined to judge while the case is before the court, denied the privacy justification, explained the report was only shown in 2012 and that the reason for not referring the case to the CEAS cannot be established, and pointed to the successor advisory committee and the procureur-generaal.
Since the case is now before the court, it is not appropriate for me to give a judgement on the course of events and the investigation.
Nu de zaak onder de rechter is, past het mij niet een oordeel te geven op de gang van zaken en het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de peperdure vliegtrips van de politietop

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about business-class flights by the national police leadership, the amounts spent, and whether such spending will be restricted and reviewed. The minister confirmed the amounts relate to business-class flights for the top 61 officers, said the Besluit allows business class only outside Europe, and that a change to the regulation restricting this is being finalised, while pointing to existing conduct rules and periodic review of trips.
At this moment the finishing touches are being put on the relevant regulation.
Op dit moment wordt de laatste hand gelegd aan de betreffende regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de mogelijke vervolging in Oostenrijk van een Nederlandse parlementariërparlementariër

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would object to Austrian prosecutors considering prosecuting Dutch MP Wilders for incitement, and whether it would relax Dutch hate speech laws. The minister replied that assessing criminality abroad is for Austrian authorities, expressed confidence in their decision, and said the cabinet will take a position on the initiative bill in parliament.
Assessing the criminality of acts that occurred in another country is primarily reserved for the authorities of that country.
Beoordeling van strafbaarheid van handelingen die zich hebben voorgedaan in een ander land is in eerste instantie aan de autoriteiten van dat land voorbehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van Oosten, Rebel, Oskam, Van Tongeren en Van der Staaij over de inzet van de Koninklijke Marechaussee bij de bestrijding van mensenhandel

MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Royal Marechaussee's role in combating human trafficking, its legal basis in the Police Act, and more sniffer dogs for searching lorries. The minister confirmed the KMar's frequent involvement and stated that its trafficking-combating task is covered by existing police tasks, with a review of possible legal changes ongoing and some capacity measures taken.
Consultations are currently taking place between my department, the Public Prosecution Service, the police and the KMar to further improve cooperation in combating human trafficking.

Momenteel vindt er overleg plaats tussen mijn departement, het Openbaar Ministerie, de politie en de KMar om de samenwerking op het gebied van de bestrijding van mensenhandel nog verder te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Nispen over een uitzending van Brandpunt waaruit blijkt dat miljoenen aan EU-subsidies voor kwetsbare groepen niet goed terecht komen

SP MPs Van Bommel and Van Nispen asked, following a Brandpunt broadcast, why EU subsidies meant for Roma and Sinti were spent improperly, who checks such projects, and whether the EU should prevent this rather than create a European Public Prosecutor. The government answered that the Roemenian authorities and the Commission are responsible for spending and control, that a full audit chain exists, that new 2014-2020 rules stress performance, and that withdrawing subsidies and a European Prosecutor are distinct tools, while declining to judge specific projects before audits conclude.

Before the cabinet can make statements about a specific case or individual project, it is important to await further investigation by the responsible bodies (in this case the European Commission and European Court of Auditors).

Voordat het kabinet uitspraken kan doen over een specifieke casus of een individueel project, is het van belang om nader onderzoek door de verantwoordelijke instanties (in dit geval de Europese Commissie en Europese Rekenkamer) af te wachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog inzake het bericht 'Verplicht archeologisch onderzoek'

CDA MPs asked whether a fire victim in Alkmaar must pay about 60,000 euro for mandatory archaeological excavation before rebuilding, and whether the 'polluter pays' principle can be applied to victims. The minister confirmed the amounts (halved by the municipality from 120,000), explained that municipalities set conditions via the environmental permit, and said the RCE will report on insurers' practice by 31 December 2015.
I have asked the Cultural Heritage Agency to carry out an exploration of insurers' conduct in these cases and report to me by 31 December 2015.
Aan de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed heb ik gevraagd een verkenning uit te voeren naar de handelwijze van verzekeraars in deze gevallen en mij hier voor 31 december 2015 over te rapporteren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Bergkamp en Verhoeven over de gevolgen van de onlangs ingevoerde aanpassing van de Opiumwet (nieuw art. 11a) voor Nederlandse ondernemers in de hennepzaadindustrie en in d

MPs from D66 asked whether the new article 11a of the Opiumwet could criminalise sales of hemp seed, whether that conflicts with legality, the economic size of the hemp seed industry, and whether seized seeds would be grown by police. The minister answered that hemp seed is excluded from the Opiumwet prohibitions but that sales can fall under article 11a when intended for illegal cultivation, that legal fibre hemp cultivation remains permitted under Green Deals, and that the claim of police growing cannabis is untrue, with seeds only undergoing DNA testing.
Yes, I know this report, but it does not match the facts.
Ja, ik ken dit bericht, maar het stemt niet overeen met de feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat de overheid zelf materiaal voor het kweken van hennep bij een veiling heeft aangeboden

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether government auctions offered cannabis-cultivation equipment, including seized items, and whether this breached the Opium Act. The minister answered that four seized items (three transformers and a tent) were offered via a state auction agency in error, withdrawn on 18 May 2015, and that controls were tightened.
DRZ has in the meantime reviewed and tightened the control mechanisms again to prevent recurrence.
Inmiddels heeft DRZ de controlemechanismen nogmaals doorgenomen en aangescherpt om herhaling te voorkomen.
Vragen van het lid VanTongeren (GroenLinks) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de dood van een arrestant te Den Haag (ingezonden 1 juli 2015).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about unrest in The Hague's Schilderswijk after a man died in police custody, about trust between residents and police, SCP findings on perceived discrimination, and whether the festival policing and the Rijksrecherche investigation will be evaluated and reported. The Minister describes community-relations efforts, notes perceived but not established police discrimination, and says the Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie has been asked to investigate neck-hold use and training, with the Rijksrecherche investigation ongoing so no statements on it are possible.
I have, as I reported to your House by letter on 10 July, asked the Inspectorate for Security and Justice to conduct an investigation into the police use of the neck hold.
Ik heb, zoals ik uw Kamer op 10 juli jl. per brief heb gemeld, de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie verzocht een onderzoek in te stellen naar het gebruik van de nekklem door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat een festivalbezoeker is overleden na hardhandig optreden van de Haagse politie

MP Kuzu asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the death of Mitch Henriquez after police restraint in The Hague, including the number of custody deaths, the handling of officers, racism within the police, and independent complaint mechanisms. The Minister answered that the Rijksrecherche investigation is ongoing, that officers were placed off duty, that no evidence of systemic discrimination was found, and that complaints can go to independent commissions and the Nationale ombudsman, while withholding detailed ten-year data and declining several structural measures.
When an arrestee dies, the Rijksrecherche investigates all events from the first report up to and including the death.
De Rijksrecherche onderzoekt bij het overlijden van een arrestant alle gebeurtenissen vanaf de eerste melding tot en met het overlijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanhoudende onrust in de Schilderswijk

Two MPs asked whether the government shares outrage over riots in The Hague's Schilderswijk after a death in custody, whether it will distance itself from racism accusations against police, how many rioters were arrested and how damage will be recovered, and why the mayor allegedly failed to restore order and whether a curfew and marechaussee deployment will be pressed. The minister answered that the Rijksrecherche investigation is ongoing and cannot be commented on, that 246 suspects were arrested, that municipal damage is EUR 77,600 with recovery being explored, and that the mayor acted as competent authority and did not fail.
Since the investigation into the acts of violence is still ongoing, the number of arrested suspects may increase further.
Het onderzoek naar de geweldplegingen nog in volle gang is, kan het aantal aangehouden verdachten verder oplopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de identificatie van de slachtoffers van de MH17

An MP asked the ministers whether the government would fully disclose who authorised Professor Maat's MH17 victim-identification presentations, what the internal police study found, and whether the study report would be shared. The minister answered that the presentations were not explicitly authorised by police leadership, that a colleague's presentation was, and that the internal study's report would not be published, with rules for presentations to be formalised later.
The investigation itself is an internal study that is known only within the police.
Het onderzoek zelf is een intern onderzoek dat alleen binnen de politie bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over de subsidieregeling beveiliging agrarische bedrijven

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked whether a subsidy scheme for securing agricultural businesses favours a single supplier, distorting competition and consumer choice. The minister answered that a one-off subsidy went to the LTO Nederland farmers' organisation, which selected six products and suppliers based on a member survey, and that farmers remain free to choose other products.
A one-off subsidy was granted to the Land- en Tuinbouworganisatie (LTO Nederland) for a project aimed at raising awareness of the risk of falling victim to crime among agricultural entrepreneurs.

Er is een eenmalige subsidie toegekend aan de Land- en Tuinbouworganisatie (LTO Nederland) voor een project dat is gericht op de bewustwording van risico's op slachtofferschap van criminaliteit bij agrarische ondernemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Recourt over de voortgang van het centraal aandeelhoudersregister voor besloten en (niet-beursgenoteerde) naamloze vennootschappen

MPs Groot and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about delays and a possible cost overrun in setting up the central shareholders register (CAHR), and whether the KNB's alternative based on the Central Digital Repertory could be pursued. The minister confirmed the importance of the register, said costs cannot yet be estimated, stated the Chamber of Commerce is designated manager, and indicated further decision-making is expected in autumn 2015.
My estimate is that further decision-making can take place this autumn.
Mijn inschatting is dat dit najaar nadere besluitvorming kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat de Turkse autoriteiten de verzoeken om rechtshulp inzake de kwestie Demmink niet hebben gehonoreerd

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked why Turkish authorities have not honoured Dutch requests for legal assistance in the criminal investigation into former senior civil servant Demmink, and what the government will do to secure cooperation. The Minister replied that Turkey is still studying the requests, that a final Turkish dismissal of the facts may conflict with ne bis in idem, that the government has pressed hard including a personal call with the Turkish minister, and rejected the suggestion of an atmosphere of obscurity.
The possibility of executing the Dutch legal assistance requests is still being studied in Turkey.
De mogelijkheid tot uitvoering van de Nederlandse rechtshulpverzoeken wordt in Turkije nog bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Kooiman over benodigdheden voor hennepteelt door de overheid aangeboden op een veiling

MPs Rebel and Kooiman asked whether the government was wrong to offer hemp-cultivation equipment seized from growers for sale on an auction site, whether such items could still be used for cultivation, and what criteria the Dienst Domeinen applies. The Minister refers to earlier answers to MP Berndsen-Jansen and does not answer the questions on substance, while confirming that the items were offered.
I refer to my answers to the written questions from MP Berndsen-Jansen (D66) of your House.
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen (D66) van uw Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de gevangenisstraf voor een optredende agent

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a prison sentence and damages imposed on a police officer who fired on a suspect in a ramming case conflicts with public sense of justice and deters police action. The Minister declined to comment on the case because it is before the courts, acknowledged the emotional impact on police, and pointed to an ongoing review of the legal framework for police use of force with a letter promised after the summer.
Because the case is before the courts, it is not appropriate for me to make statements about it.
Omdat de zaak onder de rechter is, past het mij niet hierover uitspraken te doen.
Vragen van de leden Kooiman en VanNispen (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «OM trekt verklaring over dode arrestant in» (ingezonden 1 juli 2015).

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister why the Public Prosecution Service retracted its statement that a man who died after an arrest became unwell during transport, whether it had a basis for that claim, and whether video footage exists and is known to the OM and Rijksrecherche. The minister said the Rijksrecherche will investigate all events from the first report to the death, that he will await its results before commenting on the OM's statements, that the investigation will take months, and described police first-aid training.
The Rijksrecherche will investigate in this case all events from the first report up to and including the death.
De Rijksrecherche zal in deze zaak alle gebeurtenissen vanaf de eerste melding tot en met het overlijden onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over de toenemende problemen in Nederland met rondtrekkende Britse en Ierse zigeunerbendes

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about a rising problem of Irish and British traveller groups posing as handymen who intimidate and defraud vulnerable clients, including elderly people, and whether specific policy and effective measures exist. The minister says the problem is long-standing and hard to measure due to low reporting, that these offences are handled within regular police practice without separate policy, and that prevention and awareness efforts exist, but offers no new concrete measures.
However, it is difficult to establish whether there is currently an increase; in the summer season there are on average more reports concerning Irish Travellers than in the winter season.
Het is echter moeilijk vast te stellen of er thans sprake is van een toename; in het zomerseizoen zijn er gemiddeld meer meldingen inzake Irish Travellers dan in het winterseizoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de zaak van R. van der D.

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about Romano van der Dussen's Spanish conviction, consular visits, a commissioned defence-counsel report, and a DNA match on a victim. The government answered that consular visits continue, that the report is confidential and did not address guilt, and that the Spanish courts alone can decide on reopening, with Dutch consular assistance continuing.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not make confidential reports public.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken maakt vertrouwensrapporten niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het misbruiktribunaal binnen de Rooms-Katholieke Kerk

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a Vatican tribunal on bishops who failed to act on child abuse is sufficient, whether it is independent, and why such bishops were not sanctioned earlier. The minister answered that the tribunal is solely the Catholic Church's responsibility, declined to judge its independence or the application of canon law, welcomed church measures in general, and said criminal prosecution of abuse is a state task that may apply where ignoring abuse amounts to complicity.
The establishment of the tribunal falls entirely under the responsibility of the Roman Catholic Church.
De instelling van het tribunaal geschiedt volledig onder verantwoordelijkheid van de Rooms-Katholieke Kerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat de Friese rechtspraak wordt ontmanteld

An MP (D66) asked the Minister of Justice whether the Frisian judiciary is being dismantled, citing cases moved to Groningen and Zwolle, and what this means for accessibility and Frisian-language proceedings. The minister denied dismantling, explained the court allocation rules and concentration of administrative law cases in Groningen, and said the Council for the Judiciary will decide on the multi-year plan, which will be sent to parliament.
I refer further to my answers to questions 5, 6 and 7.
Ik verwijs verder naar mijn antwoorden op vragen 5, 6 en 7.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam over het niet vervolgen van Rabobankiers bij de Libor/Euribor-fraude

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked which Rabobank settlement transactions were agreed, whether the Dutch settlement shields staff from prosecution, and why the Libor/Euribor case led to no prosecution of current employees. The government answered that the non-prosecution decision was an independent OM decision confirmed in the settlement, refused to publish the Dutch settlement, and defended the approach as proportionate while acknowledging slow DNB action and FIOD evidence handling issues.
In the Dutch system a settlement agreement is not made public.
In het Nederlandse stelsel wordt een vaststellingsovereenkomst niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het dragen van gevaarlijke laserpennen niet verboden is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether dangerous high-powered laser pointers should be banned or more actively enforced, including customs seizures, NVWA action against foreign web shops, police capacity and the risk of unknowing misuse. The minister answered that existing rules under the Warenwet, Wet wapens en munitie and Criminal Code are sufficient, gave seizure and enforcement figures, and declined further research.
I consider the current legal instruments adequate and see no reason to conduct research.
Ik acht het huidig wettig instrumentarium afdoende en zie geen aanleiding voor het verrichten van onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Recourt, Berndsen-Jansen, Segers en Van Tongeren over de uitzending van Argos over de verdwenen tapgesprekken

MPs from five parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about an Argos broadcast on missing wiretap recordings, including whether the ADR inquiry into the system failure was adequate, the role of the supplier, and whether the government controls the stored data. The minister replied that the broadcast revealed no new facts, that the ADR found no sign of deliberate human action, that the supplier withheld one detail for trade-secret reasons, and that the police manage the system and have taken additional measures.
It is true that the ADR investigation did not provide complete clarity on all points.
Het klopt dat het onderzoek van de ADR niet op alle punten volledige duidelijkheid heeft opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over misstanden bij de Europese Octrooiorganisatie

Two MPs asked the government about alleged misconduct and poor working conditions at the European Patent Organisation, including sick-leave rules, a union lawsuit and non-compliance with a court ruling. The State Secretary replied that Nederland has no enforcement power over the EPO under international law, that worker protection rests with the EPO and its ILO tribunal, and that the Netherlands has pushed for careful implementation and a social dialogue within the Administrative Council.
However, under international law the Netherlands does not have the authority to enforce action against the EPO.
Nederland heeft echter onder internationaal recht niet de bevoegdheid handhavend op te treden jegens de EOO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Excuses om weigeren vrouw met nikab in bus’

An MP asked whether a bus driver who refused a woman wearing a niqab was right, whether staff may refuse face-covering clothing before a ban exists, and whether the government will defend such staff. The government answered that a ban on face-covering clothing in education, care, government buildings and public transport is being prepared, that no legal ban exists yet, and that the driver breached company rules and the company apologised.
No, at this moment there is no legal ban on face-covering clothing, and under the carrier's company rules the niqab wearer should have been treated the same as all other passengers.

Nee, op dit moment is er geen wettelijk verbod op gezichtsbedekkende kleding en volgens de bedrijfsregels van de vervoerder had de niqaab draagster op dezelfde manier behandeld moeten worden als alle andere reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de weinig coulante houding van Zorginstituut Nederland bij vermissingszaken

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the Zorginstituut Nederland was right to show no leniency toward the family of a missing woman, and what should be done about insurance, banks and care premiums for relatives of missing persons. The minister regretted the Institute's overly formal handling, reported an apology and internal measures, and pointed to a model protocol, ongoing sector talks and Slachtofferhulp Nederland's support.
The Zorginstituut positioned itself too formally in this emotional case.
Het Zorginstituut heeft zich in deze emotionele zaak te formeel opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders, Recourt en Rebel over het bericht “Ambtenaren: geen 'bolletjesvluchten' vanaf Eindhoven Airport”

PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether an internal memo proposed banning flights from Curaçao and Aruba to Eindhoven Airport due to drug-mule smuggling risks, and about controls and responsibilities. The minister answered that the consultation is ongoing and he will inform parliament later on the memo and risks, while noting that Curaçao and Aruba are responsible for their own controls and that inter-ministerial coordination took place.
I cannot yet answer these questions, as consultation with all those involved is still ongoing.
Ik kan op deze vragen nog geen antwoord geven, aangezien het overleg met alle betrokkenen nog gaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de aanpak van wraakporno en onderzoek naar sexting

A Christian Union MP asked the Justice Minister about revenge porn, whether it can only be prosecuted under insult and slander laws, the number of cases and convictions, sexting used by loverboys, and prevention material. The minister referred to an earlier letter for most questions, said convictions for slander cannot be traced to revenge porn cases, cited a WODC finding on minors pressured via sexting, and pointed to existing education and media-literacy programmes.
From the total of convictions for slander or defamation, it cannot be determined how often a link can be made to a report concerning revenge porn, because this is not recorded as such.

Uit het totaal aan veroordelingen op grond van smaad of laster, kan niet worden herleid hoe vaak een relatie kan worden gelegd met een aangifte inzake wraakporno omdat dit niet als zodanig wordt geregistreerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Pieter Heerma over de uitspraak van de burgemeester van Hilversum, die “de noodzakelijke emancipatieslag voor moslims” waarnaar wordt verwezen, vergelijkt met “emancipatiebeweging

CDA MPs asked the ministers about the Hilversum mayor's comparison of Muslim emancipation with the Catholic labour movement, and whether such statements and radicalisation figures were appropriate. The minister answered that the mayor may freely express his opinion, that the city council has already received his explanation, and that national agencies monitor departures to Syria/Iraq and inform municipalities when needed.
In addition, administrators are accountable to a representative body.
Daarnaast zijn bestuurders verantwoording schuldig aan een vertegenwoordigend lichaam.
Vragen van het lid Kuzu (Groep Kuzu/Öztürk) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het «warrior weekend», schiet weekend in een dorpje in Polen (ingezonden 12 juni 2015).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about a Polish 'warrior weekend' shooting event open to Dutch participants, asking whether EU rules should bind such training, whether participants risk radicalisation, and whether the organisers should be investigated. The government's reply is only a holding notice: the answers cannot be given within the usual period because not all necessary information has been received, and the minister aims to answer as soon as possible.
because not all necessary information has yet been received
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Oskam over de toename van voedselfraude binnen het Europese voedselsysteem

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about the rise in food fraud in the EU, citing a 2015 Europol/OHIM report, and asked about EU coordination, training, labelling and non-EU organic certification fraud. The government answered that food fraud is hard to measure, that the NVWA, the Food Fraud Network and training initiatives are underway, and that importers and private certifiers bear primary responsibility.
Food is one of the many product categories that were assessed.
Voedsel is één van de vele productcategorieën die zijn beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bestaan van verschillende uittreksels van justitiële documentatie

MP Van Nispen asked whether a parallel, unlawful system of criminal records exists alongside the official justitiële documentatie, and why different versions of one person's criminal record exist. The Minister answers that there is a single system, that differences arise from purpose-bound extracts, timing of mutations and corrections of sepot 01 entries, and that Justid will automate removal of sepot 01 decisions by 1 August 2015.
Justid is therefore aware of this phenomenon and will shortly proceed to automatically omit a sepot 01 decision from an extract, including in cases with multiple facts.
Justid is zodoende bekend met dit fenomeen en gaat op korte termijn over tot het – ook in zaken met meerdere feiten – automatisch weglaten van een sepot 01 beslissing uit een uittreksel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Tellegen en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “Verkeershufters worden minder vaak gepakt”

Three VVD MPs asked whether speed trajectory controls are justified for environmental goals (CO2, fine dust, noise) and how their boetes and effects are documented, given reports that traffic offenders are caught less often. The minister answered that the purpose of trajectory controls is compliance with the posted speed limit, that environmental and safety considerations shape the limits themselves, and gave a fine table for 2010–2014 and noise-cost figures.
The purpose of trajectory controls is compliance with the applicable speed limit.
Het doel van trajectcontroles is naleving van de geldende snelheidslimiet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Houwers over de chip in de kentekenplaat

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a privately developed RFID chip in licence plates, its purpose, privacy safeguards, costs and future use. The government answered that a private pilot runs until June 2016, that no introduction decision has been taken, and that privacy, costs and access questions will be assessed only once the pilot results are known.
Only if it were decided to introduce the RFID chip would it be examined whether this must be put out to tender.
Pas als zou worden besloten om de RFID-chip in te voeren, wordt bekeken of dit dient te worden aanbesteed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Hoogland over het gebruik van RFID-chips in kentekens

MPs Oosenbrug and Hoogland asked about a planned RFID-chip trial in licence plates, including the technical design, data access, privacy safeguards and alternatives to combat plate fraud. The government described a test at a defence training centre, deferred decisions on data access and whether to adopt the chip until results are known, and promised a later government position and parliamentary debate.
Once the results of these tests are known, the cabinet will take a position on whether or not to introduce an RFID chip in licence plates.
Op het moment dat de resultaten van deze testen bekend zijn, zal het kabinet een standpunt innemen over de wenselijkheid van het al dan niet doorvoeren van een RFID-chip in kentekenplaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Berndsen-Jansen en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de nationale politie proeven houdt met privacy schendende chips in kentekenplaten

D66 MPs asked whether the national police is testing privacy-invasive RFID chips in number plates that could track all drivers' movements, and how this relates to the pending ANPR bill. The minister denied police involvement, said a private developers' field test at a defence training centre is underway, and said a privacy assessment and CBP advice would follow only if the government later decides to introduce the chip.
Once the results of the test are known, the cabinet will consider whether it is desirable to introduce the RFID chip.
Op het moment dat de resultaten van de proef bekend zijn, zal het kabinet bezien of het wenselijk is om de RFID-chip in te voeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘112-app kan bellen met meldkamer’

Tellegen (VVD) asked the minister whether the SOS Alarm app suggests cooperation with the national 112 emergency line, whether it creates false security, and whether a government-recognised 112 app with location tracing and images should be pursued. The minister answered that SOS Alarm is a private initiative, that 112 remains the official channel, that the initiator was asked to avoid appearing governmental, and that voice calls currently offer guarantees data apps lack, while app-based location and images are considered for the new Landelijke Meldkamerorganisatie.
I have pointed out to the initiator of the SOS Alarm app the potential safety risks of its manner of communicating about the app.
Ik heb de initiatiefnemer van de SOS Alarm app gewezen op de potentiële veiligheidsrisico’s die zijn wijze van communiceren over de SOS Alarm app met zich meebrengt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over privacy regels die de veiligheid en de gezondheid belemmeren

MPs asked whether addresses of ambulance call-outs remain findable online, whether privacy rules block locating callers in emergencies, and why the address-anonymity issue has not been resolved after two years. The Minister says alternative alerting methods are being explored in half the regions, encryption is an option in the new C2000 tender, and precise location of 112 callers is limited only by technical factors, so no wise-persons commission is needed.
The possibility of a more precise location determination is limited only by technical factors and the time required, not by (privacy) legislation.
De mogelijkheid voor het doen van een meer nauwkeurige plaatsbepaling wordt alleen beperkt door technische factoren en de tijd die ervoor nodig is, niet door (privacy)wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een extremistische moslimprediker in Almere

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a preacher linked to jihadist groups, invited by an Almere mosque, could be stopped from spreading extremist messages in the Netherlands, including via visa refusal and revoking the mosque's ANBI tax status. The minister answered that the preacher holds Belgian nationality so no visa applies, that he cannot be pinned to jihadism, that non-visa preachers can be addressed through criminal law, and that ANBI status can be withdrawn without legislative change if activities conflict with the public interest.

Regarding non-visa-required preachers who call for hatred and violence, the letter of 3 March stated that if they lawfully reside in the Schengen area, they can be assessed on the message they spread during their stay.

Ten aanzien van niet-visumplichtige predikers die oproepen tot haat en geweld is in de brief van 3 maart gesteld, dat indien zij rechtmatig in het Schengengebied verblijven, zij beoordeeld kunnen worden op de boodschap die zij tijdens hun verblijf uitdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat een dj zelf zijn gestolen apparatuur via Marktplaats terughaalt

SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police advising a DJ to arrange with the seller himself the return of stolen equipment via Marktplaats was desirable given the victim's risks, and who is responsible for evidence gathering. The minister answered that police, with the victim's help, chose this route given the case situation, that three suspects were arrested, and declined to judge the desirability while the case is before court; evidence gathering lies with police and prosecution.
As long as this case is still before the court, I refrain from judging the desirability of the course of events.
Zolang deze zaak nog onder de rechter is, onthoud ik mij van een oordeel over de wenselijkheid van de gang van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Potters over het bericht dat de invloed van ultraorthodoxe moslims in Nederlandse moskeeën toeneemt

MPs Tellegen and Potters asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and Social Affairs about reports that ultra-orthodox Muslim influence in Dutch mosques is growing, and how mosque boards could better resist radical influences and prevent salafist ideas spreading among Dutch-speaking preachers. The minister answered that the government is religiously neutral but combats active intolerance in concrete cases, that a NCTV/AIVD analysis of salafism will follow after the summer, and that the AIVD has observed increasingly audible intolerant voices.
Within a democracy, all persons and groups are bound by the applicable frameworks of the democratic legal order.
Binnen een democratie zijn alle personen en groepen gehouden aan de geldende kaders van de democratische rechtsorde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over berichten over mogelijk Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij de FIFA omkopingszaak

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reports of possible Dutch involvement in the FIFA bribery case, including money allegedly parked in a Dutch shell company and an ex-Nike director, indicate criminal offences in the Netherlands and what the KNVB is investigating about Nike's sponsorship of the national team. The minister confirmed the reports, declined to say whether the Public Prosecution Service is investigating, said the KNVB's inquiry is outside government knowledge, and agreed that the KNVB should inform the prosecutor if there are signs of criminal offences.
The Public Prosecution Service (OM) cannot make statements about whether or not it is investigating a matter.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) kan geen mededelingen doen over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over frauderen met rijkssubsidies

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether it is really easy to commit subsidy fraud with government funds, how subsidy applicants are screened, and whether government IT systems can recognise applicants previously caught for fraud. The minister acknowledged the press report, said risks are being examined and will be reported this autumn, and described existing screening rules, departmental registration of abusers, and the Bibob instrument, without committing to specific new measures yet.
Whether and how subsidy fraud can be committed, and what additional measures could be taken to limit possible fraud risks as far as possible, is currently being examined further.

Of en hoe fraude met overheidssubsidies kan worden gepleegd en welke aanvullende maatregelen mogelijk kunnen worden ondernomen om eventuele frauderisico's zoveel mogelijk te beperken, wordt thans nader onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Marcouch over het bericht dat listige jihadloverboys piepjonge meisjes inpalmen

MPs Rebel and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that jihadist 'loverboys' groom young girls for marriage and travel to the caliphate, asking for numbers, the role of advisory bodies, and the legal tools available. The minister answered that signals exist and some cases involve possible grooming, but declined to give numbers due to ongoing investigations, and described existing criminal law, school support and prevention measures.
The Public Prosecution Service will not make further statements about these ongoing investigations and concrete numbers because of investigative and prosecution interests.
Over deze lopende onderzoeken en concrete aantallen doet het OM geen nadere mededelingen vanwege opsporings- en vervolgingsbelangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over de buitenlandse financiering van islamitische instellingen

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked ministers about foreign funding of Islamic institutions, the AIVD's remit, and ANBI transparency obligations for mosques and churches. The government answered that the RAND study revealed nothing new, that it will apply ANBI publication rules from 2016 and revoke status where obligations are unmet, and that intelligence services investigate foreign influence only where serious suspicions arise.
No public statements can be made about how the AIVD concretely organises its investigations.
Over de wijze waarop de AIVD concreet onderzoeken inricht, kunnen in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over plankzaken bij de politie door drukte bij het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he responds to reports that police cases are shelved because the Netherlands Forensic Institute is overloaded, and whether the service level agreement is exhausted. The minister answered that demand always exceeds NFI capacity, that the SLA is not exhausted over the year, that monthly overruns can be carried over, and that unexhausted SLA does not show the number of shelved cases; he will discuss the issue with the LFO.
No conclusions about the number of shelved cases can be drawn from whether the SLA is exhausted or not.
Uit het al dan niet uitputten van de SLA kunnen geen conclusies over het aantal plankzaken worden getrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de vervolging wegens de ‘fuck de koning-uitspraak’

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the government whether article 111 of the Criminal Code (insult of the King) is outdated, whether prosecution under it should be deprioritised, whether its five-year maximum sentence and its compatibility with free speech are justified, and whether it should be repealed. The Minister referred back to earlier answers to D66 questions and refused to repeal the provision, defending it as it stands.
Are you willing to repeal article 111 of the Criminal Code? If not, why not?
Bent u bereid artikel 111 Sr te schrappen? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Schouw over het vervolgen van een activist voor het beledigen van de koning en de koningin

Two D66 MPs asked the government about the prosecution of an activist for insulting the King and Queen (lese majesty), questioning whether arresting him was justified and whether these articles should still be enforced. The Minister of Security and Justice answered that the OM decides on prosecution, the case was dropped after the objection, and that lese majesty provisions remain in force, to be applied prudently and only when necessary, while providing prosecution figures for recent years.
The OM has since informed the suspect and his counsel that the case has been dismissed.
Het OM heeft inmiddels aan de verdachte en diens raadsman laten weten dat de zaak is geseponeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het benutten van wettelijke mogelijkheden om uitreizen naar IS-gebieden te voorkomen

CDA MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the government why local authorities do not use passport measures to prevent jihadist departures to IS territory, and about information provision to mayors and the monitoring of departures. Minister Van der Steur answered that passport signalling is one useful tool within a broader package, that mayors and municipal councils have been adequately informed, that about seventy passports were flagged for invalidation, and that the government will not publish per-municipality departure figures, which remains the responsibility of each municipality.
As indicated, it is not for the cabinet to communicate about individual departing persons or the number of departures per municipality.
Zoals aangegeven is het niet aan het kabinet om over individuele uitreizigers of het aantal uitreizigers per gemeente te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Weer twee Gouwenaars vertrokken naar Syrië’

MP Oskam (CDA) asked why measures failed to prevent two young men from Gouda leaving for Syria, whether they were among about 20 people the municipality monitored, and whether they had ties to recruiters. Minister Van der Steur answered that the local approach is person-focused and preventive, that departure cannot always be prevented, and declined to comment on specific cases while noting periodic confidential briefings to the municipal council.
I do not make statements about specific cases.
Over specifieke gevallen doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Helvert over het boetebeleid dat gemeenten hanteren middels de buitengewoon opsporingsambtenaren en over het overnemen van een parkeerkaartje

MPs Oskam and Van Helvert asked about inconsistent municipal fining policy by enforcement officers (boa's), whether boa's should take on more police fining powers, and the legality of transferring a parking ticket. The government replied that local enforcement differences are a municipal matter, it opposes extending boa fining powers into police territory, and it will not change the fiscal parking rules, while noting that no administrative fine but a tax assessment is imposed for ticket transfer.
Given local circumstances and differences in the nature and extent of nuisance, there is no need for national uniformity in government action against local nuisance.
