Gelet op de lokale omstandigheden en verschillen in de aard en omvang van overlast is er geen noodzaak tot (landelijke) eenheid in overheidsoptreden bij de aanpak van lokale overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Bruins Slot over het bericht “Matchfixing in amateurvoetbal aan orde van de dag”

MPs Van Dekken and Bruins Slot asked the government about match-fixing in amateur football, including preventive measures, disciplinary and criminal tools, and reporting to the KNVB. Minister Schippers answered that the KNVB and NOC*NSF run education and reporting channels, a national platform coordinates enforcement, and the OM takes signals seriously but intervenes only when there are sufficient grounds.
Match-fixing can only be combated through close cooperation between the sports, gambling and investigation and prosecution sectors.
Matchfixing kan alleen worden bestreden door nauwe samenwerking tussen de sectoren sport, kansspel en opsporing en vervolging.
Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over «warriortrainingen» van Nederlanders in Polen (ingezonden 2 juni 2015).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about 'warrior trainings' in Poland attended by Dutch citizens, including whether such training is criminal under Dutch law, whether organisers face legal barriers, and whether Dutch firearm permits and VOG certificates should be refused. The minister's reply only announced a delay because not all necessary information had been received, promising an answer as soon as possible.
since not all the necessary information has yet been received
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over de voorgestelde Voetbalwet en de mogelijkheden Nederlandse relschoppers te weren bij uitwedstrijden in het buitenland

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked whether the proposed football law and existing powers can stop Dutch hooligans from travelling to away matches abroad, and whether mayors should be given power to ban such supporters from away games. The minister answered that the proposal is creative but not simple, that existing tools (stadium bans, reporting duties, area bans under the amended Penal Code) already reach abroad, and that the pending bill should proceed without waiting for the mayoral proposal.

I am of the opinion that the handling of the bill on tightening measures against football vandalism and serious nuisance should not wait for that; the powers contained therein must become available as soon as possible.

Ik ben van oordeel dat de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel Aanscherping maatregelen ter bestrijding van voetbalvandalisme en ernstige overlast daarop niet moet wachten; de bevoegdheden die daarin zijn opgenomen, moeten nu zo spoedig mogelijk beschikbaar komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de conclusie van wetenschappers dat Utrecht faalde met het sluiten van de prostitutieramen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about research concluding that closing Utrecht's Zandpad brothel windows harmed sex workers, and what lessons, alternatives, monitoring and support should follow. The minister replied that the local authority is responsible for prostitution policy, pointed to the national prostitution programme and anti-trafficking tools for municipalities, and said monitoring individual sex workers is not a government task because it would seriously harm their privacy, while promising to study the full publication once released.
Monitoring and tracking prostitutes when there are no signals of human trafficking is not a government task and would seriously harm the privacy of prostitutes.
Het monitoren en volgen van prostituees als er geen signalen zijn van mensenhandel is geen taak van de overheid en zou de privacy van prostituees ernstig schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Terreurverdachte gepakt in Limburg’

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers about reports of a terror suspect arrested in Limburg, whether terror suspects should be kept out of the Netherlands, whether this should be treated as a security warning, and whether the Netherlands should leave Schengen and reintroduce border controls. The government confirmed the arrest, said suspects can be arrested, prosecuted or extradited, noted the threat requires vigilance, and rejected leaving Schengen while defending its policy of preventing departures of foreign terrorist fighters.

The Cabinet is of the view that persons about whom there is a well-founded suspicion that they will travel to Syria and Iraq with the intention of joining a terrorist organisation must be prevented from departing.

Het Kabinet is van mening dat personen ten aanzien waarvan het gegronde vermoeden bestaat dat zij naar Syrië en Irak zullen uitreizen met de intentie om zich aan te sluiten bij een terroristische organisatie, het uitreizen moet worden verhinderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Rebel over minderjarigen in voorlopige hechtenis

MPs Recourt and Rebel asked about the high share of detained minors in pre-trial detention in Dutch youth institutions, comparison with other EU states, whether judicial review is adequate, and alternatives such as night detention and forensic foster care. The State Secretary answered that judicial review under the 'suspend unless' principle is adequate, that about 75% of minors in pre-trial detention are suspended, and that alternatives and a pilot are being pursued, without an evaluation of the review itself.
I consider this judicial review sufficient.
Ik acht deze rechterlijke toets afdoende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Van Ark over het beter rekening houden in het familierecht met kinderen en volwassenen die leven met een intersekse conditie

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Van Ark asked about the population size of people with intersex conditions, whether people should not face pressure to register a sex, and whether the Staatscommissie Familierecht should examine allowing people not to register a sex. The minister agreed sex registration has lost legal weight, promised to consider steps to reduce burdens, and said he would ask the Staatscommissie herijking ouderschap to examine whether sex can be dropped from parenthood legislation.
I am willing to ask the Staatscommissie herijking ouderschap to examine whether it is possible and desirable to omit the mention of sex from parenthood legislation.

Ik ben bereid de Staatscommissie herijking ouderschap te vragen om te onderzoeken in hoeverre het mogelijk en wenselijk is om in de wetgeving over het ouderschap af te zien van vermelding van het geslacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Leijten over het bericht dat in Frankrijk wetgeving van kracht wordt die het aanmoedigen van anorexia strafbaar stelt

SP MPs asked whether the Netherlands could ban and prosecute pro-anorexia websites, as France was doing, and what the effects of the current pop-up warning approach are. The state secretary answered that encouraging self-starvation is not a crime under current law, that a ban would not be effective, that he will talk with providers and clinicians about updating the pop-up system, and that a treatment standard for eating disorders is in preparation.
The French initiative prompted me to examine whether a ban on pro-ana content would be desirable and legally possible in the Netherlands.
Het Franse initiatief is voor mij aanleiding geweest om te bezien of een verbod van pro-ana uitingen ook in Nederland wenselijk en juridisch mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over het voornemen van het kabinet om de verheerlijking van anorexia te verbieden

CDA MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked whether the government would investigate a ban on pro-ana content after France, and why it had not pursued such measures earlier. The government answered that existing law does not criminalise encouraging extreme dieting, that a ban would not be effective, and that it will instead update the pop-up warning system with providers and engage the fashion sector.
Banning and criminalising these expressions sends the wrong signal to these people and does not encourage them to seek help.
Het verbieden en strafbaar stellen van deze uitingen is een verkeerd signaal naar deze personen en bevordert niet dat zij hulp gaan zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat een omstreden sjeik naar Eindhoven komt

Parliamentarian Van der Staaij asked why a controversial sheikh was able to enter the Netherlands for a conference in Eindhoven despite being refused by France, and about the powers to revoke Schengen visas and residence permits on public order grounds. The government answered that Italy had withdrawn the visa, the organiser cancelled the event, and explained the legal framework for public order refusals of EU and non-EU nationals.

Because Italy, as the issuing country, withdrew the visa, the speaker mentioned in the article no longer meets the requirements for stay within the Schengen area and may no longer travel to the Netherlands.

Omdat Italië als afgevend land het visum heeft ingetrokken, voldoet de in het artikel genoemde spreker niet langer aan de vereisten voor verblijf binnen het Schengengebied en mag hij niet meer naar Nederland reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Potters, Oskam en Karabulut over het bericht dat een omstreden sjeik naar Eindhoven komt

MPs from ChristenUnie, VVD, CDA and SP asked ministers whether a controversial sheikh who was to visit Eindhoven had received a visa, how entry bans and SIS alerts work, whether the mayor and foreign partners were consulted, and whether a list of hate preachers exists. The government answered that the Italian visa was withdrawn so the sheikh may not stay in the Netherlands, that the mayor consulted the NCTV, that entry-ban and SIS procedures are explained in general terms, and that an alert list of preachers is in use but numbers are not disclosed.
I cannot provide any information on the number of persons on this list.
Over het aantal personen op deze lijst kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Omstreden haatsjeik donderdag naar Eindhoven’

Two PVV MPs asked whether a cleric calling for throat-cutting and skull-smashing should receive or keep a visa, and whether the Al Fourqaan mosque should be closed for hosting him. The government answered that Italy issued and then withdrew the visa so the speaker may not stay in the Netherlands, and that closing a building is only possible for building-safety violations, drug trade, or if the organisation's aims breach public order, while criminal incitement is prosecuted by the Public Prosecution Service.
This speaker therefore may not reside in the Netherlands.
Deze spreker mag dan ook niet in Nederland verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bezoek van weer een haatsjeik, ditmaal aan een moskee in Helmond

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether a preacher who allegedly called for violence against Jews, Christians and Shiites should be allowed to speak at a Helmond mosque and whether his visa and the mosque should be blocked. The government answered that free speech is limited when incitement to hatred or violence threatens public order, that visas are refused to preachers calling for hatred, and that after local consultation the mosque cancelled the invitation.
By refusing visas to preachers from visa-requiring countries who call for hatred and violence, the government seeks to temper polarisation and radicalisation.
Door middel van het weigeren van visa aan predikers uit visumplichtige landen, die oproepen tot haat en geweld, tracht de overheid polarisering en radicalisering te temperen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat een gevaarlijke killer nachtverlof heeft gekregen tegen de regels in

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether a six-fold murderer serving life imprisonment, who remains in a forensic psychiatric clinic with unsupervised leave, was granted night leave against the rules, and how such situations are prevented. The Secretary of State confirmed the case, explained that leave was granted by court order and that clinic staff exceeded the permitted scope, stated that life sentences are in principle for life, and said that placement of lifers in such clinics is no longer policy except in individual cases.

At the end of February 2015 it was found that the Van der Hoeven clinic, in exercising the leave authorisation for the person concerned, granted him more freedoms than the leave authorisation permitted.

Eind februari 2015 is geconstateerd dat de Van der Hoevenkliniek in de uitoefening van de verlofmachtiging van betrokkene meer vrijheden aan betrokkene heeft verleend dan op grond van de verleende verlofmachtiging was toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de enorme groei van het aantal antisemitische incidenten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a sharp rise in antisemitic incidents, including a rise of over 70 percent and a doubling of insults and physical violence against Jews, and asked what measures would be taken. The minister confirmed concern, linked the rise to Middle East events and jihadist attacks, and pointed to existing policy letters and a planned reassessment of the anti-discrimination approach before year end.
Before the end of this year, the cabinet will make proposals to recalibrate the approach to discrimination.
Voor het eind van dit jaar zal het kabinet voorstellen doen om te komen tot een herijking van de aanpak van discriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over berichten dat de totale advocaatkosten in de affaire Demmink meer gekost hebben dan aan de Kamer werd gemeld

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the total legal costs in the Demmink affair exceeded what had been reported to the House, and why earlier answers omitted costs of the State Attorney. The minister denies incomplete information, explaining that the disputed costs were incurred for the State itself, and gives the reimbursed legal aid figures for Demmink, including a newly received claim of EUR 21,243.17 plus about EUR 6,000 in procedural costs.
These costs were therefore not incurred "for Mr Demmink" but on behalf of the State.
Deze kosten zijn dus niet «voor de heer Demmink» gemaakt, maar ten behoeve van de Staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Winkels in nood door roofklanten’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that shop theft has stayed high, that retailers face large losses, that theft is not a police priority, and whether foreign suspects dominate. The minister answered that theft is unacceptable, cited CBS figures showing a slight decline, described OM prioritisation, a revised prosecution guideline and encouragement to file reports, and stated that Eastern European suspects are about 13 percent of registered suspects.
Shop theft certainly has priority for the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Winkeldiefstal heeft zeker prioriteit voor het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Recourt over de inzet van Nederland bij de bijeenkomst in Riga tussen de EU en de VS over o.a. terrorismebestrijding, databescherming en migratie

PvdA MPs Maij and Recourt asked why Parliament was not informed in advance about the Dutch and EU position at the June 2015 EU-US Justice and Home Affairs ministerial in Riga, and about a draft agreement on counterterrorism, migration and data protection. The Minister replied that the meeting is a routine twice-yearly ministerial consultation, that the non-binding Riga statement was negotiated under a Council mandate Netherlands could accept, and that Parliament will be informed via the JBZ Council agenda and report.
Your House will be informed about this, as is customary, through the annotated agenda of the JBZ Council and the report of the Council.
Uw Kamer wordt, zoals te doen gebruikelijk, hierover geïnformeerd middels de geannoteerde agenda van de JBZ-Raad en middels het verslag van de Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de gemeentelijke plannen om wietteelt te reguleren en andere vragen ten aanzien van het Nederlands drugsbeleid

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about seizure and import figures for drugs, electricity theft by cannabis growers, coffeeshop turnover, drug harm rankings, illegal distilleries, public support for regulated cannabis cultivation, and a Groningen court ruling on home growers. The minister answered that most figures are not kept or are unavailable because the trade is illegal or the tax data cannot be broken down, gave harm rankings from RIVM and European research, and declined to comment on the pending appeal.
The import of soft and hard drugs concerns an illegal market that operates in secret. No overviews of this are available.
De import van soft- en harddrugs betreft een illegale markt, die zich in het verborgene afspeelt. Hiervan zijn geen overzichten beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verrichten van gerechtelijke sectie bij zelfmoord

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about calls by a forensic pathologist for autopsies in all suspected suicides, about the availability of clinical pathologists, the criteria for judicial autopsies, and the Belgian comparison. The minister answered that judicial autopsies are ordered by the public prosecutor only when a criminal interest exists, that clinical autopsy is a matter for the treating doctor and relatives, and declined to commission further research into other pathologists' experiences.
From my responsibility as Minister of Security and Justice, I consider it important that an autopsy is ordered by the public prosecutor when this is necessary from a criminal-law interest.

Vanuit mijn verantwoordelijkheid als Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie vind ik het van belang dat er sectie door de officier van justitie gevorderd wordt indien dit vanuit het strafrechtelijke belang noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het artikel “Organisaties die schending van de privacy willen verhullen”

An SP MP asked the Justice minister how to respond to reports that companies go to court to block publication of privacy-violation findings by the CBP, and whether the CBP should be legally obliged to publish its investigations. The state secretary said courts weigh publication against the harm to the complainant, and agreed to examine a statutory publication duty for CBP findings and enforcement decisions, reporting back by year-end.
I am, together with the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, willing to examine whether a statutory duty to publish could and should be introduced for the CBP.

ben ik, mede namens de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, graag bereid om te onderzoeken of er voor het Cbp een wettelijke openbaarmakingsplicht in het leven kan en moet worden geroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de zorgen van gemeenten omtrent de financiering van de Veiligheidsregio’s

A D66 MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about municipal concerns over cost increases and budget cuts at the safety regions, including a 56% contribution rise in Langedijk, and how this affects safety and democratic control. The minister replied that service levels are the regional board's responsibility, that the Inspectorate can intervene if performance is inadequate, and that municipal councils can influence funding through the regional arrangement, without giving figures on how many municipalities face problems.
I do not have an overview of the number of municipalities that have problems with the funding. That is a matter for the municipalities and the safety region.
Ik beschik niet over een beeld van het aantal gemeenten dat problemen heeft met de bekostiging. Dat is zaak van gemeenten en veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Recourt over de roep om een aparte juridische status voor vermisten

MPs Arib and Recourt asked ministers whether a separate legal status for missing persons should be created, given practical and financial problems for relatives who cannot act on behalf of a missing family member. Minister Van der Steur answered that a separate official document would have the same legal effects as a declaration of presumed death and could cause confusion, preferring practical solutions such as protocols, case managers, a central register and existing guardianship arrangements.
I am of the opinion that introducing an official document confirming that someone is missing, alongside the existing declaration of presumed death, is not a good solution.

Ik ben echter van mening dat het invoeren van een officieel document, waarin bevestigd wordt dat iemand is vermist naast de bestaande verklaring van rechtsvermoeden van overlijden geen goede oplossing biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over concrete ervaringen van discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt

An MP asked ministers about a reported case of a qualified Moroccan-origin applicant being rejected in favour of a less experienced candidate, and about discrimination in hiring generally. The government answered that complaints go to the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, courts or police, that the Inspectie SZW only supervises employer anti-discrimination policy and not recruitment, and that it set up a new team on labour-market discrimination without committing to a wider role.
No police records specifically on discrimination in job applications can be derived from the police systems.
Aan de politiesystemen zijn geen aangiftecijfers specifiek over discriminatie bij sollicitaties te ontlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over concrete ervaringen van discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt

An MP asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about reports that a man was turned away by police when trying to file a discrimination complaint after applying for jobs under different names. The minister acknowledged the officer wrongly refused the report, said police contact him for a new appointment, and stated that complaints must be taken seriously and officers are trained on discrimination law.
When he told the police station that he had applied under different names, the police officer wrongly stated that they could not take a report about this.

Toen hij op het politiebureau vertelde dat hij onder verschillende namen heeft gesolliciteerd, heeft de betrokken politieambtenaar ten onrechte aangegeven dat zij hier geen aangifte over op kon nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de problemen op de markt van overheidswerk voor tolken en vertalers

An MP asked the government about problems in the market for interpreting and translation services for public bodies, including concerns over the quality of interpreters in asylum and legal aid cases, the supply obligations and clustering of tenders, and cartel and pricing issues. The State Secretary replied that new tariffs are higher, the IND does not use intermediaries, registered interpreters are used in most cases, the supply obligation does not lower quality, tenders were designed to admit newcomers, and market prices are set by competition.
I do not share the NGTV's view that contractual supply percentages put quality under pressure.
Ik deel de opvatting van het NGTV niet dat contractuele leveringspercentages de kwaliteit onder druk zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de bouw van een moskee in Gouda

MPs Oskam, Omtzigt and Knops (CDA) asked ministers how the sale of the PWA barracks in Gouda to a large mosque project was handled, including the origin of its funding, the Bibob review, and whether the state would follow the process. The ministers answered that the matter is a local responsibility, that a new local process is under way, and that financing was checked by a forensic accountant and Bibob advice, but that the results are not publicly disclosed and no independent state investigation will be launched.
No, this concerns a local matter.
Nee, dit betreft een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het proefschrift 'Captivated by fear. An evaluation of terrorism detention policy'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a dissertation evaluating terrorism detention policy, including the separate terrorist wing, international experience, and deradicalisation programmes. The government answered that it is reviewing whether the wing regime can be tailored per case and will report before the summer recess, and that a deradicalisation exit facility will be operational in September 2015.
This exercise also looks at placing these suspects and detainees on a separate ward and whether the different types of terrorism-related detainees should and could be separated from each other.
Daarbij wordt tevens aandacht besteed aan de plaatsing van deze verdachten en gedetineerden op een afzonderlijke afdeling en de vraag of de verschillende typen TA-gedetineerden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Recourt over "het flitsfaillissement bij Princen Transmission"

MPs Kerstens and Recourt asked the ministers about the Princen TransMission flash bankruptcy, the pre-pack method, the alleged selection of workers by health records, and whether the planned bankruptcy fraud law should address this misuse. Minister Asscher answered that pre-pack is a court practice aimed at preparing bankruptcy, that dismissal protection is lost through bankruptcy rather than pre-pack, that the curator and judge-commissioner should safeguard creditors including workers, and that a study on workers in bankruptcy will be sent before summer.
I will send that study to your House before the summer.
Dat onderzoek zal ik voor de zomer aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dijkgraaf over verminderde douanecontrole, beveiliging en patrouilles op de Waddenzee en op de Westerschelde

Two SGP MPs asked whether reduced customs, marechaussee and police patrols on the Wadden Sea and Western Scheldt weaken interdiction of drugs and smuggling, and whether RHIB boats and port checks are adequate. The government replied that patrols are not being halted but shifted to intelligence-led, faster-response boats, that port controls continue 24/7, and that it sees no need for continuous patrols; it did not register controls or tips in a way that allows measuring their results.
This is not correct. Checks continue unchanged in the Zeeland ports of Terneuzen and Vlissingen.
Dit is niet juist. In de Zeeuwse havens Terneuzen en Vlissingen vinden onverminderd controles plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bouw van een nieuwe moskee in Gouda

An SP MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Social Affairs whether a 2014 meeting report on a mosque complex in Gouda showed the government helping segregate women in public space, and whether the report was removed from the municipal website. The minister answered that the report remains online, that segregation by sex is undesirable, and that the planned physical separation of the entrance was requested by a special school and day-care centre for their pupils, not to separate men and women.
The report of 8 May 2014 is known to me. The report was made public by the municipality of Gouda and can still be found on the municipality's website.
Het verslag van 8 mei 2014 is mij bekend. Het verslag is door de gemeente Gouda openbaar gemaakt en is nog altijd terug te vinden op de website van de gemeente Gouda
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van de zoveelste islamitische geweldsprediker naar Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the preacher Al-Qarni, who calls for violence, was able to enter the Schengen area and whether measures would be taken against him and mosques or organisations inviting such preachers. The minister replied that Italy issued the visa and later revoked it, so he may not stay in the Netherlands, that the event was cancelled, and that incitement to hatred can be prosecuted under criminal law while closing buildings is only possible under specific conditions.
The Netherlands did not issue a visa to the person in question.
Nederland heeft geen visum verstrekt aan de genoemde persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de aanwezigheid van verdachten van zware geweldsdelicten bij rechterlijke uitspraken

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether suspects of serious violent crimes should be required to attend court judgments, citing a 2015 Assen sentencing and arguments about accountability and victims' sense of justice. The Minister answered that there is no attendance obligation for judgments, that a court can order transport of the suspect only in exceptional cases, and that victim-related arrangements can be handled case by case.
Whether a judge decides to do so I would like to leave to the judge.
Of een rechter hiertoe besluit wil ik graag aan de rechter overlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over schendingen van de rechten van sekswerkers

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Amsterdam mayor's request for a legal basis to process sex workers' sensitive personal data, the requirement to assess sex workers' self-reliance, and banking and insurance exclusion. The minister said talks with Amsterdam were ongoing and largely pointed to existing draft rules and other ministries on the banking question, while answering the rights questions in general terms.
Following the Amsterdam mayor's request, I am currently still in consultation with the municipality of Amsterdam.
Naar aanleiding van het verzoek van de burgemeester van Amsterdam ben ik momenteel nog in overleg met de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de brandweer in Noord-Holland Noord alarm slaat omdat bezuinigingen ten koste gaan van de veiligheid

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that firefighters in Noord-Holland Noord raised alarm over budget cuts, including the number of cuts, dive team suspension and director salaries. The minister said the regional board is responsible for budgets and operations, pointed to public budgets and annual accounts, saw no need for a separate inspection of cuts, and noted the inspectorates found shortcomings in the dive teams.
The board of a safety region adopts the (multi-year) budget of the region.
Het bestuur van een veiligheidsregio stelt de (meerjaren)begroting van de regio vast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de uitzending ‘Ongelukkige Spoed’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a broadcast on weekly accidents involving emergency vehicles, the speed-through-red rule, use of crash-recording systems, and driver training. The minister answered that hulpdiensten are working on prevention, that police training will be phased in through 2017, and that further measures will wait for the results of existing ones.
I intend to wait for the results of the measures already taken.
Ik ben voornemens om de resultaten van de reeds genomen maatregelen af te wachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi, Van Veldhoven en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht ‘Bluscapaciteit ontoereikend bij grote brand’

MPs Hachchi, Van Veldhoven and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether insufficient firefighting water capacity in the water mains poses a national risk to businesses, schools and hospitals, whether the government knew of it, and what should be done. The minister answered that he was not aware of such a problem, that the Veiligheidsberaad sees no national issue and deems water supply a matter for municipalities and safety regions, and that no extra action is needed.
The Veiligheidsberaad indicates that the availability of firefighting water is a matter for municipalities and safety regions; the fire service is part of the safety region.
Het Veiligheidsberaad geeft daarbij aan dat de beschikbaarheid van bluswater een zaak is van gemeenten en veiligheidsregio's; de brandweer maakt deel uit van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat een tekort aan brandweervrijwilligers leidt tot onveilige situaties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that shortages of volunteer firefighters create unsafe situations, and about regionalisation, post closures, bureaucracy and budget cuts. The minister answered that responsibility lies with the safety regions' boards, that most regions report no unsafe situations, and that regions have consulted volunteers through works councils and other bodies, while giving detailed figures per region.
It is the responsibility of the boards of the safety regions to ensure an adequate organisation of fire brigade services.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de besturen van de veiligheidsregio’s om zorg te dragen voor een adequate organisatie van de brandweerzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het ontbreken van een visie op privacybescherming

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he would respond to a coalition's call for a vision on privacy protection, and whether he would develop such a vision and facilitate public debate. The minister answered by referring to a letter sent to the parliamentary committee in response to its request, which contains the answers.
The letter to the Committee with my response is attached to this letter and also contains the answers to your questions about a vision on and public debate on privacy protection.

De brief aan de Commissie met mijn reactie vindt u bijgevoegd bij deze brief en bevat tevens de beantwoording van de door u gestelde vragen omtrent een visie op en het publieke debat over privacybescherming.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over de uitspraak van een lid uit een coalitiefractie dat de korpschef van de Nationale Politie er goed aan doet sollicitanten te checken op PVV-achtige opvattingen

Two PVV MPs asked whether a coalition MP's remark that the police chief should screen job applicants for PVV-like views was acceptable and whether he would distance himself from it. The government answered that selecting applicants on political views is not permitted under the Constitution and the ECHR, that political affiliation plays no role in selection, and that it would not judge individual MPs' opinions.
Selecting applicants on political views is not permitted under Article 1 of the Constitution, Article 14 of the European Convention on Human Rights and other treaties.

Het selecteren van sollicitanten op politieke opvattingen is niet toegestaan op grond van artikel 1 van de Grondwet, artikel 14 van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens en andere verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het weigeren van verzekeringen aan mensen met een strafblad

An SP MP asked whether refusing car insurance, or charging higher premiums, to people with a criminal record is legitimate and whether the government will discuss a solution with insurers' association Verbond van Verzekeraars. The minister defended the insurer's right to assess risk and asserted that few ex-offenders face problems, so no talks are planned.
The Verbond van Verzekeraars indicates that there are few or no complaints or reports on this issue.
Het Verbond van Verzekeraars geeft aan dat er op het gebied van deze kwestie weinig tot geen klachten of meldingen binnenkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Oskam over het bericht ‘Utrecht vreest komst Belgische martelsjeik’

Two MPs (Segers and Oskam) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Utrecht feared a visit by a Belgian preacher and about possible blacklists, visa measures, and cooperation against hate preachers. The minister answered that the local triangle found no legal grounds to act, that no blacklist exists though an alerting list is kept, and that the answers on intelligence and foreign contacts are limited.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de privacy-schendingen door trajectcontroles

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether average-speed (trajectory) camera controls violate privacy, since all passing vehicles are recorded, and how long the data is kept. The minister answered that data of non-offenders is deleted automatically within 72 hours, that the system fits existing law, and that he has no plans to stop using trajectory controls, citing court rulings.
All data is automatically deleted from the trajectory control system after a maximum of 72 hours.
Alle gegevens worden na maximaal 72 uur automatisch in het trajectcontrolesysteem gewist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht 'Willekeur aanpak growshops'

MP Oskam (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about regional differences in enforcement against growshops after the new offence of preparing illegal cannabis cultivation took effect, including risks of displacement, advertising of anonymous sales, and whether enforcement reaches large online suppliers. The Minister answered that enforcement only began on 1 March 2015, that a national approach with local room for tailored enforcement is in place, that no displacement signals have been received, that the offence can be triggered by selling a single product where there is serious reason to suspect illegal cultivation, and that results and follow-up investigations are still pending.
Since the law took effect on 1 March 2015 and the investigations following the inspections are still ongoing, I cannot yet provide information on more serious and underlying forms of crime.

Aangezien de wet 1 maart 2015 in werking is getreden en de onderzoeken naar aanleiding van de controles nog lopen, kan ik nog geen informatie geven over zwaardere en achterliggende vormen van criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het krantenartikel ‘Regeltjes nekken bloemencorso’

An MP asked the ministers about newspaper reports that rules were hampering a flower parade (bloemencorso), whether stricter rules were justified, and about Rijkswaterstaat's role in transporting carnival floats on the A76. The minister answered that local events fall under municipal permits, the state sets no explicit rules for them, and float transport on motorways cannot be permitted under the current traffic law.
The national government is not a party to the organisation of local events.
Het rijk is geen partij bij de organisatie van lokale evenementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een radicale prediker naar Almere

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government knew of a radical preacher's arrival in an Almere mosque, whether his anti-Western, jihad-linked message should be countered, and how security services and municipalities coordinate on such preachers. The minister acknowledged the preacher's past inflammatory statements, said the message undermines social cohesion, noted that the AIVD investigates only individuals or organisations posing a threat rather than mosques generally, and pointed to existing cooperation with municipalities under the jihadism action programme.
The AIVD does not monitor mosques in general, but investigates persons or organisations for which there are indications that they pose a threat to the democratic legal order and/or national security.

De AIVD houdt niet moskeeën in algemene zin in de gaten, maar doet onderzoek naar personen of organisaties waarover aanwijzingen bestaan dat zij een bedreiging vormen voor de democratische rechtsorde en/of staatsveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het dragen van gevaarlijk krachtige laserpennen niet verboden is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a broadcast showing high-powered laser pointers causing eye injuries, whether police, prosecutors and the NVWA are acting and have enough tools, and whether the carrying of such pens should be banned. The minister said the existing legal framework is sufficient, that no national figures on laser-pen incidents exist, that the NVWA supervises sales within the Netherlands but not possession or online sales from abroad, and declined to extend the weapons research or add a ban.
Currently there is therefore no national overview available of the number of incidents involving laser pens.
Momenteel is er dan ook geen landelijk overzicht beschikbaar van het aantal incidenten met laserpennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Groot over Roemeense voetbalfraude

Two MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports that Dutch letterbox firms facilitated Romanian football transfer fraud, and whether Dutch tax rules and treaties can prevent such structures. The minister said transfer fraud should be tackled, pointed to existing matchfixing platforms and a Niet-Melders project, said tax authorities already share information on football, and argued a source-tax on payments abroad would be disproportionately harmful.
I agree that (transfer) fraud in sport should be tackled.
Ik deel de mening dat (transfer)fraude in de sport aangepakt dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de komst van radicale sjeiks naar Utrecht

An SGP MP asked whether radical preachers were given a platform in Utrecht, whether one was convicted for inhuman treatment and another linked to the Hofstad investigation, whether visas, permits and Schengen travel restrictions apply, and how they are monitored. The government answered that the local tripartite found no criminal or administrative ground to act, that one speaker was not present, that a visa was issued only to one visa-required speaker, that the event needed no permit, and that visa withdrawal and criminal prosecution remain available, so no change to Schengen rules is planned.

The local tripartite in Utrecht, based on police investigation and consultation with the National Coordinator for Counterterrorism and Security (NCTV), concluded there was no criminal or administrative ground to act.

De lokale driehoek in Utrecht heeft op basis van politieonderzoek en na overleg met de Nationaal Coördinator Terrorismebestrijding en Veiligheid (NCTV) de conclusie getrokken dat er geen strafrechtelijke of bestuurlijke grond was om op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van verschillende imams naar Utrecht

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why no action was taken against the planned visit of several controversial imams to Utrecht, including one convicted in Belgium for torture during an exorcism, and whether the visiting organisation (stichting alFitrah) holds ANBI tax status. The Minister replied that the local triangle found no criminal or administrative grounds to act, that the speaker concerned did not attend, that alFitrah has no ANBI status, and that incitement to hatred remains prosecutable while visa refusal is pursued for foreign preachers.

The local triangle in Utrecht, based on police investigation and after consultation with the National Coordinator for Counterterrorism and Security (NCTV), concluded there was no criminal or administrative ground to act against the foundation alFitrah and the announced speakers.

De lokale driehoek in Utrecht heeft op basis van politieonderzoek en na overleg met de Nationaal Coördinator Terrorismebestrijding en Veiligheid (NCTV) de conclusie getrokken dat er geen strafrechtelijke of bestuurlijke grond was om op te treden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Schouw over de oorzaak en consequenties van het neerstorten van een ScanEagle

MPs Hachchi and Schouw asked about the cause of a 2013 ScanEagle drone crash, the adequacy of operator training, the Military Aviation Authority's review, why the investigation was not sent to parliament, and the use of the drone over populated areas and by police. The minister said a faulty sensor coating caused the crash, training has been adjusted, the report was withheld for confidentiality reasons, and the drone has not yet been deployed over the Netherlands for civil support.
Investigation reports on such incidents are as a rule not sent to the House of Representatives.
Onderzoeksrapporten van dergelijke incidenten worden in de regel niet naar de Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over raamprostitutie in Utrecht

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the closure of Utrecht's street-prostitution windows, possible human trafficking, the regulation bill, and the welfare of sex workers. The minister answered that the Wrp bill will counter displacement, that the municipality (not the prosecutor) based licence withdrawal on police reports, and that outreach support remains available.
The content of this research is not known to me.
De inhoud van dit onderzoek is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat de politie steeds vaker te maken krijgt met verwarde en overspannen mensen

Two MPs asked whether rising police contact with confused persons reflects cuts to psychiatric beds, and about notifications from ministries and municipalities. The minister answered that the causes are unclear, that no notifications from other ministries or municipalities were received, and that the bed reduction was not meant as savings and a misunderstanding about GGZ cuts exists.

As already announced, consultation will be held with the chain partners involved, focusing on relieving the police and identifying bottlenecks and improvements regarding confused persons on the street.

Zoals reeds aangekondigd zal overleg gevoerd worden met de bij het onderwerp betrokken ketenpartners, waarin zowel aandacht zal zijn voor het ontlasten van de politie als voor het inventariseren van knelpunten en het aandragen van verbeteringen met betrekking tot de verwarde personen op straat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over het bestemmingsplan in Utrecht omtrent het (Nieuwe) Zandpad

MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Utrecht zoning plan for 162 brothel windows at the Nieuwe Zandpad, including police and task force involvement in past closures linked to human trafficking and resource implications. The minister said local authorities are responsible for such choices, that the police and prosecution systems cannot report time spent in FTE at the requested level of detail, and that no national inspection was involved.
The systems of the police and the Public Prosecution Service are not designed to determine the time spent in FTEs in a simple and reliable way at the requested level of detail.
De systemen van de politie en het OM zijn er niet op ingesteld om op een eenvoudige en betrouwbare wijze tot op het gevraagde detailniveau de bestede tijd in fte's te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het alsnog straffen van een ambtenaar om een IS-tweet

MP Kuzu asks the Minister of Security and Justice why a civil servant was given a conditional dismissal over an IS-related tweet despite the AGFA advisory committee's findings that ministers' public statements contributed to the unrest, how the advice leaked to the press, and why other officials making racist posts faced no discipline. The minister replies that he informed parliament by letter, that he knows of no leak from his officials, that it is improper for officials to learn of their own cases via media, and that discipline is decided case by case.
I conclude that the NRC has the advice. How the NRC obtained the advice is not known to me.
Ik concludeer dat de NRC over het advies beschikt. Op welke wijze de NRC de beschikking over het advies heeft gekregen, is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het verzwijgen van het aantal Syriëgangers door de burgemeester van Amersfoort

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why the mayor of Amersfoort withholds the number of Syria travellers and whether a national public register of returned jihadists should be created. The Minister replied that municipalities decide whether and how to publish such figures, that the national approach is in place, and that a public list conflicts with the rule of law.
In line with the division of responsibilities in the Dutch system, it is up to municipalities themselves to decide how to communicate with residents.
Conform de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling in het Nederlandse stelsel is het verder aan gemeenten zelf om te bepalen op welke wijze te communiceren met de inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over de verkoop van voetbalkaartjes via Marktplaats

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked about the resale of football tickets on Marktplaats, including security risks, price inflation, fraud and the powers of clubs and the KNVB to stop it. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the KNVB can cancel invalid tickets and impose stadium bans, and concludes that further government intervention does not appear necessary for now.
No, this does not appear to be necessary for now.
Nee, dit lijkt vooralsnog niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Sjoerdsma over opgepakte Nederlandse jihadisten bij de Turks-Syrische grens door Turkije

Two D66 MPs asked how many Dutch jihadists Turkey has detained at the Syrian border, what happens to them, whether agreements or extradition requests exist, and what the Netherlands does to stop those released from returning or travelling again. The minister answers that about 10 Dutch nationals were reported by Turkey since early 2015, that Turkey deports them, that no specific agreements exist, that extradition has not been considered so far, and lists Dutch measures such as passport invalidation, alerts and a pending travel-ban bill.
On whether there is an intention to submit extradition requests, no answer can be given in view of the interests of investigation and prosecution.
Op de vraag of het voornemen bestaat uitleveringsverzoeken in te dienen, kan met het oog op belangen van opsporing en vervolging geen antwoord gegeven worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over schadevergoeding aan een veroordeelde pedoseksueel

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked why the municipality of Amersfoort must pay damages to a convicted sex offender after disclosing his residence, and whether such rulings undermine trust in the judiciary and whether such offenders may be housed near children. The minister replied that a court found the municipality acted unlawfully, damages were halved for the offender's own fault, and that re-housing decisions weigh public safety against the individual's right to resettle.
An independent judge, based on the information submitted and the applicable statutory provisions, concluded that the municipality acted unlawfully toward Van der V.

Een onafhankelijke rechter is op basis van de ingebrachte informatie en op basis van de toepasselijke wetsartikelen tot het oordeel gekomen dat de gemeente onrechtmatig heeft gehandeld jegens Van der V.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het draagvlak voor legalisering van softdrugs

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a poll showing majority support for municipal cannabis cultivation experiments and whether he would allow regulated cultivation to address nuisance, illegal drug trade and fires. The minister declined to allow cultivation experiments, citing international drug treaties, a WODC report that 80-90% of Dutch-grown cannabis is exported, and pointing to the new criminalisation of preparatory cultivation acts while committing to continued joint enforcement.
In light of the international agreements the Netherlands has committed to, it is currently not possible to proceed to (experiments with) regulation of cultivation.
In het licht van de internationale afspraken waar Nederland zich aan heeft verbonden is het op dit moment niet mogelijk om over te gaan tot (experimenten met) regulering van de teelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Wanbetalers niet meer de cel in'

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about reports that judges find the Public Prosecution Service too quick to seek imprisonment (gijzeling) of people who cannot pay fines. The state secretary responded that new procedures will require motivation of ability to pay, that data on requests and refusals are limited, and that the government will monitor the effects before deciding on further measures.
The Public Prosecution Service and the CJIB in some cases have a full picture of the debtor's financial situation, but in many cases they do not.
Het OM en het CJIB beschikken in sommige gevallen over een volledig beeld van de financiële situatie van betrokkene, maar in veel gevallen ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht 'Wanbetalers niet meer de cel in'

D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that judges are refusing committal (gijzeling) requests for unpaid fines, which the courts say the Public Prosecution Service files automatically with thin justifications. The minister acknowledges the need for better motivation of such requests, points to planned measures such as instalment payments from 1 July, and says the Public Prosecution Service and CJIB will improve reasoning for the new-style requests.
I am of the view that these requests must be submitted to judges with such motivation that they are enabled to test the lawfulness of the request on that basis.
Ik ben van mening dat deze vorderingen zodanig gemotiveerd moeten worden voorgelegd aan rechters dat zij in staat worden gesteld de rechtmatigheid van de vordering hierop te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de minister de feiten over wietteelt verdraaide

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister whether he will act on reports that he distorted facts about cannabis cultivation (suppressing unwelcome research, selective conclusions, steering questions) and on the lack of clear export figures, and whether a new independent study on regulated cultivation will be commissioned. The minister denies the allegations, refers to an earlier letter, says export figures carry uncertainty but most Dutch cannabis is likely exported, and sees no reason for a new study since research is independent and fully shared with parliament.
I do not recognise myself in these signals.
Ik herken mij niet in deze signalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat een Russisch museum delen van de MH17 tentoon gaat stellen

An MP asked the ministers whether a Russian local war museum would exhibit MH17 wreckage, whether the pieces were deliberately left behind and donated, and whether the government would raise concerns with Russia. The government answered that it has no indication the exhibition will take place, that it protested to Russian and Ukrainian authorities, that Russia denies the reports, and that it has publicly and bilaterally voiced concerns.
Naturally, developments will be closely monitored and further action will be taken if necessary.
Vanzelfsprekend zullen de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend gevolgd worden en zal nadere actie ondernomen worden indien nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake het niet beschikbaar zijn van de website van de NOS tijdens de stroomstoring op 27 maart 2015

An MP asked whether the NOS website was offline for an hour during a 27 March 2015 power outage and how the public broadcaster's emergency back-up and role as disaster broadcaster are arranged. The government replied the outage lasted about 20 minutes, that crisis.nl serves as the online equivalent, and that the back-up is partly realised with the cause of the failed generator at the data centre under investigation.
Yes, I have asked the NPO about this.
Ja, ik heb dit bij de NPO nagevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de discriminerende uitspraak van de burgemeester van Gilze-Rijen

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked whether the mayor of Gilze-Rijen, who made discriminatory remarks about the Turkish-Dutch community, should be sanctioned or should step down. The minister defended the mayor's crime-fighting role, noted the mayor apologised and that the dialogue was resumed, and saw no reason for intervention, saying the mayor is accountable to the municipal council.
I see no reason for further intervention regarding the mayor's position.
Ik zie geen reden tot een nadere interventie met betrekking tot de positie van de burgemeester.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat Nederland een knooppunt vormt voor wapensmokkel

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the Netherlands is a transit hub for illegal weapons from Eastern Europe, why prosecutors intercepted only one shipment rather than the whole smuggling route, and when weapons trafficking would become a national top priority. The minister said Europol cannot confirm regular large shipments, declined to comment on the ongoing case, and pointed to a new operational network and an intensified approach within the jihadism action programme with measures still to be developed.
Beyond that, I cannot make any statements about this ongoing criminal case.
Voor het overige kan ik over deze lopende strafzaak geen uitlatingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de aanwas van gespecialiseerde agenten stokt

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reducing operational strength just means aligning police staffing with the formation plan, and asked for training and deployment figures for specialist police roles. The minister said formation and staffing are being balanced to a affordable operational strength of 49,500 fte, gave training reservation and enrolment figures for specialist courses, and promised to report on financial and cybercrime specialists through the Veiligheidsagenda.
On the realisation of the intake targets for specialists in financial and cybercrime, I will report to your House as agreed, within the framework of the Security Agenda.
Over de realisatie van de doelstellingen voor de instroom van specialisten op het gebied van finec en cybercrime zal ik uw Kamer conform afspraak rapporteren in het kader van de Veiligheidsagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Brand door hennepteelt breekt vaak uit in bewoond huis’

MP Oskam (CDA) asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Economic Affairs about a report that cannabis-cultivation fires often break out in occupied homes, and what measures will be taken to dismantle more plantations in 2015 and whether energy-theft identification requirements will be introduced. The minister says the problem is serious, describes existing enforcement measures and the new preparatory-acts offence, and reports talks with the energy sector on civil claims and an identification requirement, which remain under consultation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over minder criminaliteit door militairen op straat

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government would deploy soldiers in the Netherlands to tackle crime at hotspots, after a Belgian report of reduced crime where soldiers patrol. The minister replied that the National Police is adequately equipped, but civilian authorities can request military assistance in specific situations.
The National Police is generally adequately equipped to tackle and combat crime, including at places referred to as hotspots.
De Nationale Politie is in het algemeen voldoende toegerust om criminaliteit aan te pakken en te bestrijden, ook op plaatsen waar aan wordt gerefereerd met de term «hot spots».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over de vervolgings- en berechtingsstrategie van verdachten van het neerhalen van vlucht MH17 op 17 juli 2014

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the prosecution and trial strategy for suspects in the downing of MH17, including promised notes, possible trials in absentia, extradition, and amnesty under Minsk-2. The government said no prosecution strategy can be disclosed yet to protect the criminal investigation, but it reaffirmed that prosecution is the goal and promised to inform parliament once the investigation allows.
Releasing prosecution strategies prematurely is not in the interest of the investigation.
Het voortijdig naar buiten brengen van vervolgingsstrategieën is niet in het belang van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over de onderzoeken naar de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked about the authenticity and sharing of a leaked July 2014 Kiev briefing memo, ICAO and airspace warnings over Crimea, information sharing with airlines, Dutch–Ukrainian and Minsk arrangements for the crash site, and the state secrecy of MCCb MH17 minutes. The government largely refused to release the briefing memo and MCCb minutes on confidentiality grounds, while describing remedial steps such as the ICAO website pilot and planned consultations with airlines.
For the same reason, the cabinet will also not share the document with which the essence of the briefing was shared with other departments.
Om diezelfde reden zal het kabinet ook het document waarmee de essentie van de briefing is gedeeld met andere departementen niet delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een verbod op het doorgeven van nog geldige parkeerkaarten

An MP asked the government about a court ruling that transferring a still-valid paid parking ticket is not allowed, whether this should be changed, and whether parking tariff increases should be capped. The minister replied that parking tax is a per-vehicle fiscal obligation under the Gemeentewet, that a printed ticket is only proof of payment, that no change is planned, and that municipalities set their own tariffs so no cap is needed.
This is a consequence of the fact that parking tax and the supplementary assessment fall under fiscal legislation.
Dit is het gevolg van het feit dat parkeerbelasting en de naheffingsaanslag onder de fiscale wetgeving vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over het bericht “Doorgegeven parkeerkaartje ongeldig”

Two CDA MPs asked whether it is acceptable that a motorist who took over a transferred parking ticket that was still valid was fined, and whether the rules should allow such tickets to be passed on. The minister answered that these are two separately taxable facts, that there is no refund or transfer of remaining parking time, and that changing the regulation is not necessary based on this single case.
Changing the substantive basis of the relevant regulations as a foundation is not necessary in my view based on this single case.
Wijziging van de inhoudelijke grondslag als fundament voor de terzake doende regelgeving acht ik niet noodzakelijk op basis van deze ene casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over digitaal rechercheren bij verdenking van seksueel misbruik van jonge kinderen

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the 2011 recommendation to search for child abuse imagery in sexual abuse cases was followed, and whether digital investigation of suspected sexual abuse of young children depends on the prosecutor's discretion. The Minister says the recommendation required no separate follow-up, that digital investigation is case-by-case under existing legal conditions, and that it is not limited to child pornography offences.
Digital investigation is a broad term covering all police research into various forms of digitally available information.
Digitaal rechercheren is een ruime term die ziet op al het onderzoek dat de politie doet naar verschillende vormen van digitaal beschikbare informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel 'Luchtalarmsirenes gaan verdwijnen'

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about plans to phase out the air-raid siren system (WAS) and whether this excludes people without internet or mobile access, older people, and the hearing-impaired. The minister confirms the planned phase-out from 2018, points to a package of alternatives (NL-Alert, social media, regional broadcasters) and says the siren is used only once or twice a year, with the phase-out still to be worked out with the Veiligheidsberaad.

Together with the Security Council I want to look, in the run-up to 2018, at the further development of the above package of crisis communication tools, with attention also to the reach to vulnerable groups.

Samen met het Veiligheidsberaad wil ik in aanloop naar 2018 kijken naar de verdere (door)ontwikkeling van het bovengenoemde pakket aan crisiscommunicatiemiddelen, waarbij ook het bereik van kwetsbare groepen aandacht zal krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het oordeel ‘onzorgvuldig’ door de toetsingscommissies euthanasie

An MP asks why the regional euthanasia review committees again judged a Levenseindekliniek euthanasia case 'onzorgvuldig' and whether the committees overstep by nuancing that judgment, and asks the government to act against the clinic and order an independent investigation. The minister replies that the committees only assess compliance with the statutory due-care criteria, that the case has been referred to the IGZ and the Public Prosecution Service which must decide independently, and that she sees no grounds for measures or an independent investigation at this stage.
In view of this, I refrain from giving a judgment.
Gelet hierop onthoud ik mij van een oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de onrust en onvrede onder de agenten die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de veiligheid op het spoor, de snelwegen en het water

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about unrest among police officers responsible for rail, motorway and water safety, including deployment of untrained staff and removal of 112 emergency calls from the national unit's control room. The Minister acknowledged the transition causes concern, defended cross-specialism deployment as more effective, and said the works council concerns will be discussed, without committing to restore old arrangements.
Supervised deployment fits my policy of promoting professional skill in and on the job.
Het begeleid optreden past in mijn beleid van het bevorderen van het vakmanschap in en op het werk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Oskam over de aanpak van synthetische drugs en georganiseerde misdaad

MPs Kooiman and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about tackling synthetic drugs and organised crime, including a generic ban on new precursor chemicals, extra investigative capacity in the south, RIEC case backlogs, NFI turnaround times, and protective clothing for police at drug labs. The minister answered that a generic ban would be too broad, that the Labour Inspectorate investigation is ongoing, and that protective gear is provided only to specialist LFO staff while Parliament will be informed by end of April.
The instrument of a generic criminalisation is therefore too coarse-meshed.
Het middel van een generieke strafbaarstelling is dus te grofmazig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht: ‘7 op de 10 hoort niets na aangifte woninginbraak’

MP Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about public dissatisfaction with police feedback after reporting burglaries, and whether reporting is worthwhile given low reporting and clearance rates. The minister acknowledged the gap, pointed to multichannel reporting, victim follow-up measures and a planned status-tracking service, and said he lacked proof of causal effects of policy while providing statistics by reference to published reports.
Therefore a nationwide 'reporting tracking service' will be realised this year, through which victims are better informed about the start and progress of their case.
Daarom zal dit jaar landelijk een «aangiftevolgservice» worden gerealiseerd, waarmee slachtoffers beter worden geïnformeerd over de aanvang en de voortgang in hun zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Albert de Vries en Çegerek over het verlies van banen bij het gerechtshof in Arnhem

MPs asked whether the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court of appeal may relocate from Arnhem to Zwolle, with possible job losses, and how this fits the goal of spreading government jobs. The Minister said the court board is only exploring housing scenarios with no decision taken, that some scenarios move posts out of Arnhem, and that a decision on locations would be made after the Rvdr's review rather than waiting for the 2018 evaluation.
The board of the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court of appeal is currently exploring the future housing needs of the court's organisational units.
Het bestuur van het gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden voert op dit moment verkenningen uit naar de toekomstige huisvestingsbehoefte van de organisatieonderdelen van het gerechtshof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat het aantal instromende discriminatiezaken bij het OM op het laagst gemeten aantal is

Two D66 MPs asked why reported discrimination cases reaching the Public Prosecution Service fell to a record low despite thousands of police reports, and whether police and prosecutors are adequately resourced. The minister explains the gap through registration differences and lack of perpetrator indicators, says capacity is sufficient, and promises a broader report from 2016 while declining to publish the current figures report now.
No. The discrimination figures of the Public Prosecution Service have already been made public with the sending of the progress letter on discrimination.
Nee. De discriminatiecijfers van het OM zijn reeds bekend gemaakt met de toezending van de Voortgangsbrief discriminatie.

Asks the government to abolish VAT on product repair.

requests the government to include concrete health targets in the new implementation agenda of the Clean Air Agreement

Asks the government to adopt the College voor de Rechten van de Mens recommendations on public transport accessibility for people with disabilities and to send the door-to-door transport improvement plan to the Chamber quickly.
requests the government to adopt the recommendations
verzoekt de regering om de aanbevelingen over te nemen
Motie van het lid De Hoop c.s. over snel effectieve maatregelen nemen tegen geluidoverlast en uitstoot van schadelijke stoffen door Schiphol
Asks the government to quickly take effective measures against Schiphol noise and emissions, such as much fewer night flights and phasing out old aircraft, or agree binding measures with the sector.
requests the government to quickly take other measures or agree binding measures with the sector

Motie van de leden Kostić en Gabriëls over een informatie- en minimalisatieplicht voor ZZS in afvalstromen instellen voor bedrijven die de oorspronkelijke ontdoener zijn van het afval
Asks the government to introduce an information and minimisation duty for very high-concern substances in waste streams for companies that are the original waste producers.
requests the government to introduce an information and minimisation duty for very high-concern substances in waste streams for companies that are the original waste producers
verzoekt de regering om een informatie- en minimalisatieplicht voor ZZS in afvalstromen in te stellen voor bedrijven die de oorspronkelijke ontdoener zijn van het afval
Motie van het lid Bamenga c.s. over de mogelijkheid voor alle omwonenden van Chemours en de Westerschelde om hun bloed te laten testen op de aanwezigheid van pfas
Asks the government to make blood testing for PFAS available to all residents near Chemours and the Westerschelde.
requests the government to make it possible for all residents near Chemours and the Westerschelde to have their blood tested for PFAS
verzoekt de regering het mogelijk te maken voor alle omwonenden van Chemours en de Westerschelde om hun bloed te laten testen op de aanwezigheid van pfas
Motie van het lid Kostić c.s. over duidelijke vermelding op cosmeticaproducten als er pfas in is verwerkt
Asks the government to ensure cosmetics containing PFAS are clearly labelled so consumers can protect themselves.
requests the government to ensure it must be clearly stated on cosmetics if PFAS is processed in them

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 38 over extra middelen voor zorgmedewerkers met langdurige post-COVID klachten
Shifts €21 million from the undistributed budget item to the health budget to extend the scheme for healthcare workers with long-term post-COVID complaints.
The funding for these extra resources is found in article 11 (Undistributed).
De dekking voor deze extra middelen wordt gevonden op artikel 11 (Nog onverdeeld).

Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 20 over extra middelen voor zorgmedewerkers met langdurige post-COVID klachten

Dit amendement op de begroting van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport 2024 verhoogt het verplichtingen- en uitgavenbedrag in artikel 4 (Zorgbreed beleid) met € 21 miljoen
Motie van het lid De Hoop c.s. over beide plannen voor de A27 bij Amelisweerd toetsen op alle maatschappelijk relevante effecten
Asks the government to assess both A27 Amelisweerd plans on all socially relevant effects and report to the Chamber before further steps.
requests the government to assess both A27 plans at Amelisweerd on all socially relevant effects and to inform the Chamber before further steps are taken
verzoekt de regering om beide plannen voor de A27 bij Amelisweerd te toetsen op alle maatschappelijk relevante effecten, en de Kamer hierover te berichten voordat verdere stappen worden genomen

Asks the government to introduce a sponsorship ban for the fossil fuel industry in schools.
requests the government to introduce a sponsorship ban for the fossil fuel industry

Motie van het lid Teunissen c.s. over gezonde en groene schoolpleinen
Asks the government to consult schools, municipalities and IVN and propose how national government can help realise greener school playgrounds, starting with the most vulnerable schools.
requests the government to consult with schools, municipalities and IVN
verzoekt de regering in overleg te treden met scholen, gemeenten en IVN

Asks the government to draw up with universities a guideline for responsible research funding covering external financiers.
requests the government to draw up with universities a guideline for responsible research funding

Motie van het lid Teunissen c.s. over een jaarlijks toenemend deel van het onderzoeksbudget voor het BPRC oormerken voor proefdiervrij onderzoek
Asks the government to earmark an increasing share of the BPRC monkey research budget for animal-free research methods.
requests the government to earmark as soon as possible an annually increasing part of the research budget for the BPRC
verzoekt de regering om zo snel mogelijk een jaarlijks toenemend deel van het onderzoeksbudget voor het BPRC te oormerken
Motie van het lid Teunissen c.s. over een centraal fonds voor het stroomlijnen van financiering van wetenschappelijk onderzoek door derden

requests the government to explore the possibility of a central fund for streamlining third-party financing of scientific research

Motie van het lid Sneller c.s. over het opheffen van de vrijstelling van inkomstenbelasting voor de leden van het Koninklijk Huis
Asks the government to propose amending Article 40 of the Constitution to abolish the income tax exemption for members of the Royal House and to report on implementation.
requests the government to submit to the House a proposal to amend Article 40 of the Constitution to abolish the income tax exemption for members of the Royal House
verzoekt de regering een wijzigingsvoorstel van artikel 40 Grondwet aan de Kamer voor te leggen om de vrijstelling van inkomstenbelasting voor leden van het Koninklijk Huis op te heffen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over Nederlandse rol in Europese onderhandelingen over Nieuwe Genomische Technieken (NGT) en uitvoering van motie Kostic´ en motie Akerboom

MPs Kostić asked the Dutch government about its role in EU negotiations on new genomic techniques (NGT), including labelling, organic sector protection, patents, risk assessment and compliance with motions. The state secretary answered that the compromise matches Dutch policy, that labelling for end consumers is not proportionate, and that patent law changes require amending the European Patent Convention.
The technical negotiations in the Council and in the trilogues are confidential; I cannot share documents about them here.
De technische onderhandelingen in de Raad en in de trilogen zijn vertrouwelijk, hier kan ik geen stukken over delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het doodschieten van een wolf op de Utrechtse Heuvelrug

An MP asked the state secretary about a wolf shot on the Utrechtse Heuvelrug that may not have been the permit-covered problem wolf, and about sanctions, enforcement and whether Gelderland should revoke a permit. The state secretary confirmed by DNA test it was the permitted wolf GW3237m, said enforcement was not currently warranted, noted the provinces are responsible for permits, and declined to intervene in Gelderland.
I do everything I can to prevent incidents as much as possible and to ensure that, should they nonetheless occur, decisive action can be taken.
Ik doe er alles aan om incidenten zoveel mogelijk te voorkomen en om te verzekeren dat – als deze zich toch voordoen – er daadkrachtig kan worden opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over landbouwgif in populaire snoepgroenten voor jonge kinderen

An MP asked the government about pesticide residues in sweet vegetables for young children, including hormone-disrupting and PFAS pesticides, and whether the 0.01 mg/kg baby-food limit should apply to such products. The state secretary answered that residues stay within the legal MRLs, that EFSA considers current risk assessment suitable for young children, and that the Ctgb is still studying Danish findings before deciding on any withdrawals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het risico van resistente schimmels door het gebruik van landbouwgif

An MP asks the health and agriculture ministers about the risk of azole-resistant Aspergillus fumigatus from fungicide use in agriculture, cross-resistance with medicines, and why France banned such pesticides while the Netherlands did not. The ministers acknowledge the risk, point to the national AMR action plan, EU-level work and efforts to reserve new antifungals for human use, but decline to ban the substances and admit they could not answer all questions within the requested timeframe.
No, unfortunately this was not achieved.
Nee, dit is helaas niet gelukt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Thijssen, Kröger, Kostić en Teunissen over de Joint Letter of Intent met Tata Steel, de fors hogere uitstoot van Tata Steel, staalslakken en de forse salarisverhogingen van direc
