MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA and the Partij voor de Dieren asked about Tata Steel's higher emissions in 2024, the Joint Letter of Intent with the state, executive pay rises amid job cuts, and steel slag use across the Netherlands. The government answered that the emission rise may reflect new measurements and reporting, that the permit procedure is still pending, that a steel slag taskforce and a reporting obligation are being set up, and that pay policy is for the company to decide, though the JLoI requires a reasonable pay policy to be specified later.
The cabinet understands that this article and its headline raise questions.
Het kabinet snapt dat dit artikel en deze kop vragen oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden De Hoop en Kostić over werkzaamheden aan de A-pier op Schiphol

MPs De Hoop and Kostić asked whether Schiphol's ongoing A-pier construction lacks a valid Natura 2000 permit, who is responsible for permitting and enforcement, and whether works should be halted. The State Secretary confirms the works require a permit that was annulled by the court in June 2025, that enforcement is a discretionary balancing of nature against airport interests, and that a pending enforcement request will be decided separately without prejudging the outcome.
I cannot anticipate that decision-making in answering these parliamentary questions.
Op die besluitvorming kan ik bij de beantwoording van deze Kamervragen niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Gabriëls over de staalslakkenkwesties

MPs Gabriëls and Kostić asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about steel slag use: whether soil rules will be tightened for leaching of non-regulated substances, why rules were not updated sooner, whether a permit requirement or total ban is warranted, liability of Tata Steel, classification as waste versus by-product, and Natura 2000 risks. The State Secretary replied that a temporary emergency regulation restricts risky uses, a notification duty is coming, the soil rules are under review, and that no retroactive ban or total prohibition is planned for now.
If there are new scientific insights into the substances relevant to properly mapping the risks of a building material in use, I will review this again.
Als er nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten zijn over de stoffen die van belang zijn om de risico’s van een bouwstof bij toepassing goed in beeld te brengen zal ik dit opnieuw bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Koekkoek over de getekende Joint Letter of Intent met Tata Steel

MPs Kostić and Koekkoek asked about the signed Joint Letter of Intent with Tata Steel, covering government liability, the closure of the coke-oven plant KGF2, enforcement, health protection for residents, emissions history, and the €2 billion subsidy risk. The ministers answered that the JLoI contains only inspanningsverplichtingen with opzeggronden, that binding result obligations will follow in a later maatwerkafspraak, and that health goals and public consultation are part of the process.
Through the JLoI the parties can be held to the inspanningsverplichtingen, but the results cannot yet be enforced.
Door de JLoI kunnen partijen aan de inspanningsverplichtingen worden gehouden, maar kunnen de resultaten nog niet afgedwongen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het massaal doden van straathonden in Marokko voor het WK- voetbal

An MP asked the government whether it knows that stray dogs in Morocco are being mass-killed ahead of the 2030 World Cup, whether it will raise this with Morocco, and whether it will press against a draft law criminalising feeding strays. The government replied that the matter is an internal Moroccan affair, that it supports a combined approach to stray dogs rather than mass killing, and that it will not raise the issue bilaterally or at EU level beyond noting Morocco's new national legislation.
This concerns an internal Moroccan matter.
Het betreft hier een interne Marokkaanse aangelegenheid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over aanwezigheid van de staatssecretaris Landbouw, Visserij, Voedselzekerheid en Natuur (LVVN) bij een diner gericht op de bestrijding van uitheemse rivierkreeften en het aangekondi

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary for Agriculture, Fisheries, Food Security and Nature whether he attended a crayfish dinner where crustaceans may have been boiled alive, and how this fits with his planned ban on live boiling. The secretary confirmed attending and eating crayfish served there, said he did not know how they were killed, reaffirmed support for the ban and promised a progress report by year-end with the ban targeted for 2026.
I am not aware of how the crayfish served at this dinner were killed.
Het is mij niet bekend op welke wijze de rivierkreeften zijn gedood, die tijdens dit diner zijn geserveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over ‘de rechterlijke uitspraak dat Nederland burgers onvoldoende beschermt tegen landbouwgif’

MP Kostić asks the government how it will respond to a court ruling that the Netherlands inadequately protects residents from pesticide use near homes, including whether it will apply the precautionary principle, correct the Ctgb's approach, reinstate the pesticide bill and ban spraying near housing. The minister replies that the ruling is a non-final civil case with no direct effect on other crops, rejects the claim of failure by the legislature and the Ctgb, points to ongoing research and existing rules, and declines to commit to new bans or a fixed timeline.
The ruling is not final; a merits procedure and cassation are possible.
De uitspraak is niet onherroepelijk, o.a. een bodemprocedure en cassatie zijn mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat TUI bakken met geld verdient aan het lijden van dolfijnen en orka’s

An MP asks the State Secretary about TUI selling tickets for dolphin and orca activities abroad and at the Dolfinarium, plus whether the government will ban such sales and public interactions. The State Secretary says Dutch rules on the park's licence prevent harmful shows, no inspections have occurred since the court ruling, a ban on sales is not legally feasible, and a study on public interactions is due in 2026.
No inspections have taken place at the Dolfinarium since the court's interim injunction ruling.
Er hebben sinds de gerechtelijke uitspraak op de voorlopige voorziening geen controles plaatsgevonden bij het Dolfinarium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over alternatieve plannen voor Tata Steel Nederland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government about the Wijmond business case for alternative uses of the Tata Steel IJmuiden site, including financial risks of the Green Steel plan, reductions of pollution, soil remediation liability and housing and nature scenarios. The state secretary answers that the government remains committed to the Green Steel plan and ongoing negotiations, does not consider new research necessary, and declines to disclose negotiation details.
The cabinet cannot make further public statements about what forms part of the negotiations on tailored agreements.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen verdere mededelingen doen over wat onderdeel is van de onderhandelingen over maatwerkafspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de uitspraken van de minister over regenboogsymbolen en hakenkruizen

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science to explain and apologise for earlier remarks equating a rainbow crossing vandalised with a swastika with the groups responsible, and for suggesting there were two sides. The minister repeatedly refers to her letter to parliament, reiterates that she opposes all vandalism and intimidation, and gives no apology beyond a general statement on the matter.
I would like to refer to my letter to your House of 9 September, in which I explained this further in writing.
Ik verwijs graag naar mijn brief aan uw Kamer op dinsdag 9 september jongstleden waarin ik dit schriftelijk verder heb toegelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat Nederland burgers onvoldoende beschermt tegen landbouwgif

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the government is adequately protecting residents from pesticides after a court ruling that the regulator Ctgb and the legislator failed to shield neighbours of lily farms, and what concrete steps will follow. The State Secretary rejected the claim of failure, pointed to the strict EU authorisation framework, ongoing SPARK research, planned spray-zone guidance and an information point for residents, and gave no new binding commitment beyond reintroducing the pesticides bill.
I do not share the view that the legislator or the Ctgb have failed in protecting residents.
Ik deel niet de opvatting dat de wetgever of het Ctgb steken hebben laten vallen in de bescherming van bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over economische belangen zwaarder laten wegen dan gezondheid

An MP asks whether the state secretary weakened a total ban on steel slag because of Tata Steel's economic interests, and why health, environment and animal welfare were outweighed by regulatory burden concerns, including the role of the ATR advisory body. The state secretary denies that economic interests drove the choice, states the regulation protects health and environment, defends the ATR's advisory role, and rejects abolishing it.
I do not recognise myself in this. In every policy process the various interests are carefully mapped and weighed.
Ik herken mij hier niet in. In elk beleidsproces worden de verschillende belangen goed in kaart gebracht en gewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het stikstofplan 'Bouwstenendocument emissiereductie landbouw'

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether the government will adopt the stakeholder 'building blocks' document on nitrogen emission reduction, whether it complies with the Habitats Directive, the Greenpeace court ruling and the advice of the state advocate, and whether binding deposition and emission targets for 2030 will be legally secured. The Minister states that the document was used in the government's follow-up package, that the shift from deposition to emission steering is consistent with EU obligations, that the court did not order binding targets, and that sectoral emission targets will be set and legally anchored.
The cabinet is pursuing a shift from deposition to emission-based steering.
Het kabinet zet in op een omslag van depositie naar emissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Thijssen, Rooderkerk, Bamenga, Postma, Gabriëls, Wingelaar, Teunissen en Koekkoek over de MER Tata Steel en misleidende communicatie over uitstootcijfers

MPs asked the government about the Tata Steel HeraCless environmental impact report (MER), including rising fine particulate, NOx and dioxin levels, unclear emission reduction figures, EAF slag risks, CO2 reduction claims, the pending health impact assessment, job cuts and conditions for state subsidy. The state secretary largely deferred to the competent authority (Province of Noord-Holland) and the ongoing procedure, while stating that negotiations on the maatwerk agreement continue and that binding, enforceable terms and monitoring will be included.
The national government cannot yet take positions, because the competent authority still has to interpret and assess the MER.
Er zijn door de Rijksoverheid nog geen stellingen in te nemen, omdat het bevoegd gezag de MER nog moet interpreteren en beoordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de veiligheid van verouderde installaties bij Tata Steel IJmuiden naar aanleiding van de recente explosie met dodelijke slachtoffers in een Amerikaanse staalfabriek

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary whether the ageing coke-oven plants at Tata Steel IJmuiden, and their harm to nearby residents, warrant stricter action after a fatal explosion at U.S. Steel in Pennsylvania. The State Secretary answers that the cause of the US incident is unknown, that enforcement of Tata Steel lies with the province and its environmental service, that enforcement measures and a warning decision are ongoing, and that the law does not allow immediate closure of the plants.
The competent authority for the polluting activity in this case is the province of Noord-Holland and its mandated Seveso environmental service Noordzeekanaalgebied (OD NZKG).
Het bevoegd gezag voor de milieubelastende activiteit is in dit geval de provincie Noord-Holland en de door haar gemandateerde Seveso-omgevingsdienst Noordzeekanaalgebied (OD NZKG).
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mohandis, Eerdmans, Kostić en Oostenbrink over ledenwerving van ledenomroep WNL op het VVD-congres

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, JA21, PvdD and BBB asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether it is acceptable that broadcaster WNL recruited members at the VVD party congress while wearing press badges, and how this squares with the integrity code and WNL's statutes. The Minister says such recruitment is undesirable, that broadcasters must be careful to distinguish membership drives from journalism, that the Commissariaat voor de Media is the supervisor of the binding parts of the code, and that the membership criterion will be abolished in the planned reform of the public broadcasting system.
I attach great value to the independence of the media.
Ik hecht zeer grote waarde aan de onafhankelijkheid van de media.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over (bodemroerende) visserij in de Waddenzee

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary for Agriculture, Fisheries, Food Security and Nature about bottom-trawling shrimp fishing in the Dutch Wadden Sea, a UNESCO World Heritage site, referencing David Attenborough's film and the government's own evaluation of damage to the seabed. The State Secretary answers that the shrimp fishing natuurvergunning was granted on 18 June with strict conditions, a 10% reduction in ecological fishing hours, a voluntary buy-out scheme, and six-yearly evaluations, while declining to meet Attenborough or consult UNESCO and stating the government's ocean policy aims are unchanged.
On 18 June I granted the shrimp fishery a nature permit.
Ik heb op 18 juni jl. de garnalenvisserij een natuurvergunning verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de vergunning voor het doden van een wolf in Gelderland

An MP asks whether the ministry was substantively involved in the permit to kill a wolf in De Hoge Veluwe, and questions the DNA evidence, the 'acute threat' justification, the park director's role and the independence of the ecological expert. The state secretary acknowledges legal support from ministry lawyers but says the province alone decided, the court upheld the permit, and no conflict of interest exists.
Lawyers from my ministry provided support in the preparation of the permit.
Juristen van mijn ministerie hebben ondersteuning geboden bij totstandkoming van de vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de noodzaak van het stellen van een concrete maximumnorm om varkens te beschermen tegen ziekmakende giftige staldampen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture to set a concrete maximum ammonia concentration for pig barns, citing the NVWA's call, Wageningen UR and EFSA findings, and norms in Germany and France. The Minister answered that the open welfare norm needs measurable, enforceable and practically feasible specification, that the evidence does not establish a clear dose-response threshold, and that a maximum ammonia norm is intended to be included in the AMvB dierwaardige veehouderij.
I intend to include a norm for a maximum ammonia concentration for pig barns in the AMvB dierwaardige veehouderij.
Ik ben voornemens een norm voor een maximum ammoniakconcentratie voor varkensstallen op te nemen in de AMvB dierwaardige veehouderij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het niet beboeten van ernstig dierenleed door botbreuken, bloedingen en ontwrichtingen bij miljoenen kippen, eenden en kalkoenen

An MP asked the minister why enforcement against bird-catching injuries in poultry was limited to above 1% injury thresholds, whether NVWA can still act after a court ruling, and whether breeding restrictions or consumer disclosure would be pursued. The minister answered that enforcement continues in a revised form, defends the sector's voluntary improvements, and refused breeding restrictions and consumer communication while committing to study the ruling and adjust oversight of catching and transport.
The NVWA will study the court ruling carefully and arrive at the most effective solution for supervising the catching, loading and transport process, applying appropriate enforcement where necessary.

De NVWA zal de uitspraak van de rechter goed bestuderen en daarbij komen tot de meest effectieve oplossing om toezicht te houden op het vang-, laad- en transportproces en waar nodig passende handhaving toe te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over PFAS-lozingen Custom Powders

An MP asked the government about PFAS discharges by Custom Powders in Helmond, including the role of oversight, health effects, liability, costs and future prevention. The minister answered that the municipality will commission an independent investigation into its own oversight role, that PFOA effects are recognised but causality is not established, that liability lies with polluters through courts, and that structural measures (VTH reform, Routekaart, industry action agenda) are under way with further information promised before the summer recess.

The municipality of Helmond, as competent authority for the sewage discharges, has therefore announced an independent investigation into the role of the municipality and the environmental service, including licensing, supervision and enforcement.

De gemeente Helmond, als bevoegd gezag voor de rioollozingen, heeft daarom aangekondigd dat er een onafhankelijk onderzoek komt naar de rol van de gemeente en de milieudienst, inclusief vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kostić over milieu- en gezondheidsschade door industriële emissies

An MP asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about health and environmental damage from industrial emissions, cuts to clean air and noise policy, enforcement capacity, independent monitoring and conditions on negotiated agreements with polluting firms. The government responds that it takes the OVV findings seriously, points to ongoing measures such as the Industry and Residents action agenda, RIE implementation and studies due late 2025, but declines to commit to specific new funding or binding conditions for now, citing its demissionary status and pending studies.

At present, as part of the Industry and Residents Action Agenda, it is being mapped which improvements and innovations are possible regarding monitoring and controlling polluting emissions at companies.

Op dit moment wordt als onderdeel van de Actieagenda Industrie en Omwonenden in kaart gebracht welke verbeteringen en innovaties mogelijk zijn ten aanzien van het monitoren en controleren van verontreinigende emissies bij bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Kostić over geweld tegen klimaatdemonstranten

MPs Teunissen and Kostić asked whether the government condemns a provincial councillor who drove into a peaceful Extinction Rebellion demonstrator and whether it will act against calls for violence against demonstrators. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, noting a police report had been filed and the OM is investigating, and said responsibility for demonstration safety lies with local government while any suggestion of violence against demonstrators is unacceptable.
It is not for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to make statements about individual and ongoing cases.
Het is niet aan mij, als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, om uitspraken te doen over individuele en lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over ernstige en structurele misstanden bij de ganzenjacht

An MP asked the state secretary about video of a goose killed by neck-breaking during a goose cull near Stolwijk, alleged structural animal welfare abuses in goose and hare hunting, and oversight of such activities. The state secretary answered that oversight of faunabeheer lies with the province and its environmental service, that citizens can report suspected violations, and that no separate independent investigation or hunting moratorium is planned.
I also see insufficient reason to launch a separate investigation.
Ik zie ook nog onvoldoende aanleiding om een apart onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het gebruik van lijmvallen voor ratten en muizen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary for Agriculture whether glue traps for rats and mice should be banned as in Flanders, citing animal suffering and risks to protected species. The State Secretary agrees that glue traps cause unnecessary suffering, notes existing rules outdoors and enforcement by the NVWA, and promises to consult pest control associations and report in Q3 2025 on possible bans on use and sale, though the answers were late.
I will inform the House in the third quarter of 2025 about the results and follow-up steps arising from these discussions.
Ik informeer uw Kamer in het derde kwartaal van 2025 over de resultaten en vervolgstappen die voortkomen uit deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat minstens 25 rashondenverenigingen de wet overtreden

An MP asked the state secretary about a Zembla broadcast alleging that at least 25 breed associations' breeding rules conflict with the law on hereditary defects, and about enforcement, the Raad van Beheer's stamboom practices and the NVWA's role. The state secretary confirmed the breeding ban in principle, said enforcement targets breeders rather than associations, and reported ongoing talks with the NVWA and Raad van Beheer and planned awareness campaigns.
A breed association is an interest organisation and cannot commit an offence under this legislation, because the legislation concerns breeding acts initiated by the breeder.
Een rashondenvereniging is een belangenvereniging, zij kunnen geen overtreding begaan van deze wetgeving, omdat de wetgeving gaat over de door de fokker geïnitieerde fokhandelingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kostić over het bericht waaruit blijkt dat het Dolfinarium met twintig showonderdelen de wet overtreedt

An MP asks the State Secretary whether the Dolfinarium's twenty unnatural show acts, found in violation by RVO following a complaint, justify tougher action including revoking its zoo licence and a ban on dolphin breeding and display. The State Secretary acknowledges the violations as unacceptable, says closure is possible if regular enforcement fails and repeat breaches occur, but rules out revoking the licence now and defends the educational value of the park.
I find it objectionable; clear agreements were made that are attached as conditions to the licence.
Ik vind het kwalijk, er zijn duidelijke afspraken gemaakt die als voorschriften aan de vergunning zijn verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het lot van de witoorpenseelapen in het apenproefdiercentrum

An MP asked whether the BPRC primate centre will rehome its roughly 50 white-eared pied colobus monkeys to a foreign research institute rather than a sanctuary, and why the government supports this. The minister confirmed the transfer abroad, stated that the destination is not yet known, argued that the monkeys remain needed for research on serious infectious disease, and declined to ask the BPRC to choose a sanctuary instead.

The BPRC has been asked to inform me, in compliance with applicable regulations such as the GDPR, as soon as it has reached an agreement with an organisation or institution and the monkeys have been moved there.

Het BPRC is gevraagd mij, met in achtneming van geldende regelgeving zoals de AVG, te informeren zodra het BPRC tot een overeenkomst met een organisatie of instelling is gekomen en de apen daar naartoe zijn verplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Bamenga, Van Kent, Koekkoek en Kostić over de berichten dat milieutoezichthouders strengere regels wilden voor staalslakken

MPs asked the State Secretary about reports that environmental inspectors (ILT) wanted stricter rules for steel slag, why the ILT advice was not shared with parliament, and whether slag use as a building material is safe. The State Secretary answered that the ILT advice was tied to a permit application never filed, that a notification duty will replace the planned information duty (expected early 2026), and that use of LD slag as sand substitute in layers thicker than half a metre is being investigated, while ruling out generic classification of slag as waste.
The advice did not acquire formal status because no permit application was submitted.
Het advies heeft geen formele status gekregen vanwege het ontbreken van een aanvraag voor een vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het massale gebruik van glyfosaat voor de productie van veevoer

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether glyphosate use for feed crops, its proximity to homes, possible health and Parkinson's risks, and bee losses justify a ban or tighter measures. The minister replied that the EU re-approval rests on independent science, that a legal ban on glyphosate uses is not possible, that a draft decree to make alternatives mandatory is with the Raad van State, and that RIVM research on glyphosate and Parkinson's will report in 3-5 years.
Partly because of your House's wish, I have taken steps to make alternatives to the use of crop protection products mandatory.
Mede vanwege de wens van uw Kamer heb ik wel stappen gezet om alternatieven voor het gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen te verplichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de gevolgen van het niet naleven van Europese milieu- en natuurwetgeving

An MP asked the ministers what EU legal tools besides infringement procedures could force the Netherlands to comply with environmental and nature law, and about related talks with the Commission and other member states. The minister answered that the Commission could theoretically cut EU funds such as CAP money, that talks with the Commission are confidential so details cannot be disclosed, and that compliance is discussed with other states without a central focus on level playing field.
To be able to exchange views openly with the Commission on various issues and possible solutions now and in the future, confidentiality is of great importance.
Om nu en in de toekomst met de Commissie open van gedachten te kunnen wisselen over verschillende vraagstukken en mogelijke oplossingsrichtingen, is vertrouwelijkheid van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het verdwijnen van wolven en stroperij in Nederland

An MP asked whether the disappearance of wolves and signs of poaching warrant investigation, enforcement expansion, and protection for ecologists. The government declined further investigation, saying provinces are responsible for fauna oversight and it sees no indications of unusual disappearances or threats.
Supervision of fauna policy is a provincial task. I have no indications that provinces are falling short in this supervision.
Het toezicht op faunabeleid is een provinciale taak. Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat provincies te kort schieten in dit toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het insecticide deltamethrin

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about the insecticide deltamethrin, citing a court ruling on the Ctgb's failure to assess hormone-disrupting effects and recent studies on neurotoxicity, and asks for an Article 21 review and a ban. The minister replies that the Ctgb has adjusted its method, that the substance is already under EU re-evaluation with new limits that cover the cited effects, and that there is currently no reason to press the Commission for an early review.
Following this ruling, the Ctgb announced on 30 July 2024 that it would adjust its method for assessing crop protection products in certain respects.
Naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak heeft het Ctgb op 30 juli 2024 bekendgemaakt de werkwijze bij de beoordeling van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen op onderdelen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, De Hoop en Kostić over renovatie van wijken met erfgoedwaarde zoals Meezenbroek

MPs Timmermans, De Hoop and Kostić asked the housing minister about demolition of the historic Meezenbroek neighbourhood in Heerlen, residents' right to return, tenant protections, consultation, and the financial and environmental case for renovation over demolition. The minister answered that housing corporations decide locally, that tenant protections and a national demolition-and-renovation statute apply, that no absolute right of return is desirable, and that a national study on demolition is due end 2025.
Given the major impact demolition/new construction has on residents, I attach importance to involving residents in good time in such projects.
Vanwege de grote invloed die sloop/nieuwbouw op bewoners heeft, hecht ik waarde aan het tijdig betrekken van bewoners bij dit soort trajecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Kostić over “de onbetrouwbaarheid van de inschatting van saneringskosten voor de grond vanTata Steel”

MPs Teunissen and Kostić asked the government about the reliability of the estimated remediation costs of up to 12 billion euros for Tata Steel's land, including the assumptions, possible bankruptcy liability and the absence of a parent company guarantee. The minister answered that the underlying analysis is confidential, that remediation costs depend on future land use, that the polluter-pays principle applies, and that a maatwerkafspraak is being pursued to avoid a bankruptcy scenario.
No. Wijers and Blom, supported by BCG, conducted independent research.
Nee. Wijers en Blom hebben, ondersteund door BCG, onafhankelijk onderzoek gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de ernstige vogelgriep-situatie

An MP asks the ministers about the severe avian influenza situation, including the need for financial support for animal rescue organisations handling wild birds, the risk to humans, and the government's refusal so far to fund them. The minister answers that human risk is low to moderate, that animal rescue groups have no formal task in removing dead wild birds, that no financial support is needed for now, and that the situation will be reassessed if it worsens.
Financial support is currently not something I consider necessary.
Financiële ondersteuning acht ik op dit moment niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het bericht dat er wolven in Nederland verdwijnen en dat experts aanwijzingen voor stroperij zien

An MP asked the State Secretary and Justice Minister about reports that a quarter of registered wolves in the Netherlands have vanished without explanation and that experts see signs of poaching, asking about preventive measures, police action, and protection of ecologists. The government answered that poaching is condemned and handled by police and provinces, that BIJ12 has not found an unusual pattern and reports no concrete poaching complaints, and that no special measures are planned.
I have no indications to share these concerns.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen om deze zorgen te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Bamenga, Van Kent en Kostić over het beschermen van burgers, dieren en milieu tegen staalslakken

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management how citizens, animals and the environment are protected against LD steel slag, which RIVM classifies as hazardous, and how regulation, enforcement and interbestuurlijk toezicht will be strengthened. The State Secretary answered that duty-of-care rules and enforcement apply, that several steps (information duty, updated circular, regulatory review) are underway, and that the risks are recognised, while stating that municipalities and provinces carry enforcement responsibility.
That is why steps have been taken and I am currently working, as part of the review of soil regulation, on
Daarom zijn er stappen ondernomen en ben ik op dit moment in het kader van de herijking van de bodemregelgeving aan de slag met
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de schokkende beelden van ernstig dierenleed op een hertenboerderij

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister about hidden-camera footage showing prolonged suffering of deer shot in a commercial deer farm, and whether the NVWA was present, had inspected, and could close the farm. The Minister says the footage is shocking and the NVWA is reviewing it, but gives no commitment to close the farm, states no inspections occurred in three years, and offers to talk with the deer farmers' association.
The NVWA's investigation into these images is ongoing, so no statement can yet be made on this question.
Het onderzoek van de NVWA naar deze beelden loopt, waardoor er over deze vraag nog geen uitspraak gedaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Gabriëls, Kostić en Koekkoek over Chemours

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, PvdD and Volt asked the State Secretary about Chemours, its recent leak and past accidents, its lobbying in Europe against the PFAS ban, and the scientific claims used by industry. The State Secretary answered that supervision of the Seveso site is shared with inspection partners, that the leak caused no soil, water or drinking water effects, and that the PFAS restriction is under assessment by ECHA, with the government saying it would take a position once the Commission proposal exists.
I am not responsible for that.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Diederik van Dijk, Van den Hil, Krul, Ceder, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Slagt-Tichelman, Kostić en Eerdmans over een solide toekomstplan voor Kamp Westerbork naar aanleiding van 80 jaar

MPs asked the government to respond to Kamp Westerbork memorial's financial shortfalls, deferred maintenance and the need for a sustainable future plan, and to say what it will do about the memorial's proposed plan and the Moluccan history. The state secretary answers that a solid future plan will be developed with the memorial centres, one-off 2025 funds have been reserved, the memorial's financing plan is under study, and an OHW letter on progress is expected around summer 2025.
I am studying this plan and looking at what role the central government can play in it.
Ik ben dit plan aan het bestuderen en bekijken welke rol de Rijksoverheid daarin kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het overtreden van het verbod op het doden van aal met een zoutbad

An MP asked the state secretary about eel being killed in brine without stunning in Urk, despite a legal stunning requirement, and about enforcement and sanctions. The state secretary said the stunning rule applies only to commercial slaughter, not private household killing, that such brine killing may still constitute animal cruelty, and that NVWA inspections and sanctions will continue.
That does not alter the fact that exposing eels to a brine bath unmistakably causes these animals a great deal of pain and stress.
Dat neemt niet weg dat het blootstellen van palingen aan een zoutbad onmiskenbaar veel pijn en stress oplevert bij deze dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de lozing van FrieslandCampina op de Waddenzee

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about FrieslandCampina's discharge of a hazardous cleaning agent into the Wadden Sea, including whether the chemicals' composition, long-term impacts, legal compliance and the permit process are adequately controlled. The minister answered that the provincial authority of Groningen is responsible, that the permit is being actualised with stricter discharge conditions expected this quarter, and that the process follows national and EU rules, while several details (such as the warm-water discharge study) are still pending further research.

The competent authority, in this case the provincial executive of Groningen, is responsible for assessing this indirect discharge, granting it through an environmental permit and updating the discharge conditions in that permit.

Het bevoegd gezag, in dit geval het college van gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Groningen (in het vervolg: de provincie of de provincie Groningen), gaat over de beoordeling van deze indirecte lozing
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het bericht 'Zeekoeten onder de parafine aangespoeld aan de kust: 'Zelf gaan ze het niet redden''

MP Kostić asked the ministers about reports that seabirds were dying from paraffin discharged at the coast, the care duty for injured animals, financial support for animal ambulances and wildlife centres, and Dutch and IMO rules on washing tanks and discharging residues. The government answered each question, pointing to existing voluntary arrangements, IMO work expected to conclude in 2026, and Dutch proposals at the IMO, while declining to provide compensation or structural funding for individual rescue organisations.
There is no compensation scheme from central government for individual rescue actions by animal ambulances or wildlife centres.
Er bestaat vanuit het Rijk geen compensatieregeling voor individuele reddingsacties van dierenambulances of wildopvangcentra.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de balanced approach-procedure Schiphol

MP Kostić asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, Madlener, about the Schiphol balanced approach procedure, including claims that the European Commission warned against the old downsizing plan, the history of the procedure and its noise-reduction targets, and EU law on noise and fundamental rights. The minister answers most questions, denies that the noise target was weakened, explains the phasing and additional fleet renewal rules, and shares documents only under confidential inspection, citing EU correspondence confidentiality.
The starting point is that correspondence with the European Commission is strictly confidential and is not made public during ongoing procedures.
Uitgangspunt is dat correspondentie met de Europese Commissie strikt vertrouwelijk is en niet openbaar wordt gemaakt tijdens lopende procedures.
Antwoord op vragen vragen de leden Kostić, Ram, Graus, Hirsch, Paternotte, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de wrede jacht op kangoeroes en de Nederlandse betrokkenheid daarbij

MPs from several parties asked the government about the cruel kangaroo hunt, Dutch imports of kangaroo meat and leather, and calls for an import ban. The Staatssecretaris answered that animal welfare concerns are shared, that Australia regulates its own hunting, that an import ban can only be set at EU level and must comply with WTO rules, and that a plan under a prior motion is being prepared; several answers were deferred.
Banning the import of a product from a country outside the European Union, in this case Australia, can only be arranged at European level.
Import van een product verbieden dat uit een land komt van buiten de Europese Unie, in dit geval Australië, kan alleen op Europees niveau geregeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Teunissen over toenemende investeringen en leningen in sectoren die verantwoordelijk zijn voor tropische ontbossing

MPs Kostić and Teunissen asked the government about rising financing of sectors linked to tropical deforestation, whether Dutch financial institutions should be held to account, and how the EUDR and other instruments could regulate financial flows. The minister answered that financial institutions are expected to follow OECD and UN due diligence standards, that the EU will assess in December 2025 whether to bring financiers under the EUDR (which the cabinet considers unsuitable in its current form), and that supervisors already apply climate and nature risk expectations, while declining to commit to a binding ban on such investments.

The cabinet is of the view that the EUDR in its current form is not suitable for checking financial institutions and financial flows, because it is aimed at checking the production and supply chains of physical products and goods.

Het kabinet is van mening dat de EUDR in de huidige vorm niet geschikt is om financiële instellingen en geldstromen te controleren, omdat deze is gericht op het controleren van de productie en toeleveringsketens van fysieke producten en goederen.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Kostić, Wingelaar, Koekkoek, Gabriëls, Bamenga en Van Kent over het RTL Nieuws onderzoek 'Meer ziekmakende stoffen in de lucht bij 125 bedrijven door heel Nederland’

Six MPs asked the state secretary about an RTL Nieuws investigation showing rising emissions of hazardous substances (including PAK) at many industrial firms, and about the effectiveness of the ZZS minimisation duty, reporting errors at Tata Steel and the role of competent authorities. The state secretary answered that enforcement and assessment of emissions data is primarily the responsibility of competent authorities such as the provinces and environmental services, pointed to the Impulsprogramma Chemische Stoffen and the Actieagenda, promised to consult competent authorities and to ask RIVM and the Expertgroep for a reassessment, and declined to act on several requests because they fall under other bodies.
The competent authority may use all means available to it, including filing a criminal complaint; I do not interfere further in this.
Het bevoegde gezag kan gebruik maken van alle middelen die hen ter beschikking staan, waaronder het doen van aangifte, ik meng mij hier verder niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het bericht ‘Steden klaar met falend lachgasbeleid’

An MP asked the government about municipalities' complaints that the nitrous oxide ban has caused disposable canisters to end up in household waste, causing explosions and costs of around 150 million euros a year, and whether the state will compensate them. The government answered that the problem stems from illegal disposal and non-refillable canisters rather than the ban itself, rejected liability and compensation beyond a pilot, and said it will keep supporting municipalities with a toolkit, a 450,000 euro pilot and enforcement, without new regulation.
The State is not liable for the conduct of those who illegally dump the nitrous oxide canisters with residual waste or in public space.
De Staat is niet aansprakelijk voor het handelen van degenen die illegaal de lachgascilinders bij het restafval of in de openbare ruimte dumpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over het niet ondertekenen van de overeenkomst waarmee toezichthouders eindelijk kunnen ingrijpen bij het houden van te veel dieren in stallen

An MP asked the minister why the data-sharing agreement allowing enforcement bodies to check actual animal numbers in stables has not been signed, despite a motion adopted by parliament. The minister confirmed awareness of the motion, said he is consulting parties on next steps, and agreed with them to take joint steps toward a broadly supported agreement.
I spoke with the relevant parties about this on Monday. We have agreed to take joint next steps, with the aim of reaching a broadly supported agreement.
Ik heb maandag met betrokken partijen hierover gesproken. We hebben afgesproken gezamenlijk vervolgstappen te zetten, met als doel om tot een gedragen overeenkomst te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Teunissen over het voornemen van dit kabinet om Tata Steel in de verduurzaming te ondersteunen en de benodigde investeringen daarvoor

MPs Kostić and Teunissen asked the minister why the state should subsidise Tata Steel IJmuiden's decarbonisation given the company's weak finances, low investment and limited emissions cuts before 2045. The minister answered that a maatwerk agreement is under negotiation to accelerate decarbonisation and health gains beyond legal requirements, that the terms are confidential, and that viability and subsidy amounts cannot yet be disclosed.
As indicated, I cannot publicly discuss the ongoing negotiations and any possible contribution from the state.
Zoals aangegeven kan ik niet in het openbaar ingaan op de lopende onderhandelingen en een eventuele bijdrage van de staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over pesticiden in vogelvoer

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture about pesticide residues found in bird feed, including PBO, deltamethrin and chlorpyrifos-methyl, and what the government will do to phase out harmful pesticides and label or regulate bird feed. The minister answered that the residues stay below legal maximum residue limits, that the NVWA controls feed, that consumers choose their own bird feed, and that no quantitative pesticide-reduction targets existed in the 2013 Gezonde Groei, Duurzame Oogst policy note.
In the PAN Nederland study, pesticide residues were found in bird feeds, but these are below the legal MRL standards.
In het onderzoek van PAN Nederland zijn residuen van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in vogelvoeders aangetroffen, maar deze liggen onder de wettelijke MRL-normen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat afgedankte Ierse racepaarden in snacks terechtkomen

An MP asked the ministers about research showing retired Irish racehorses entering the food chain in the Netherlands through identity fraud, and about inspection, traceability and slaughterhouse oversight. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging fraud risks, stating that an NVWA investigation of the horse supply chain is underway, and committing to tighter rules and intensified transport supervision.
The NVWA is currently investigating where the greatest fraud risks lie within the horse supply chain.
De NVWA onderzoekt op dit moment waar de grootste frauderisico's liggen binnen de paardenketen.
Antwoord op van de leden Kostić, Van Kent, Gabriëls en Bamenga over het beschermen van burgers, dieren en milieu tegen staalslakken

MPs asked whether LD steel slag is a waste or a by-product usable as building material, citing a critical report from Stichting Natuurlijk Schoon Eerbeek, and asked about contamination risks, enforcement, financial incentives and possible suspension of use. The Minister rejected the report's conclusions, stated that the 2017 legal opinion is not a generic ruling, said use is permissible within regulatory frameworks, and announced a planned nationwide information obligation and review of soil regulation, while declining to suspend use or detail Tata Steel agreements.
As part of the review of soil regulation, I will examine to what extent it is desirable to tighten the regulations further.
In het kader van de herijking van de bodemregelgeving zal ik bezien in hoeverre het wenselijk is de regelgeving nog verder aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over het instemmen van Nederland voor uitstel van verplichtingen voor het traceren van pesticiden om de last voor boeren te verlichten

An MP asked why the minister supported, in the EU Council, postponing traceability rules for pesticide use registers and how government can monitor, enforce and protect citizens without this data. The minister replied that Dutch practice largely complies already, that CBS monitoring continues on the EU schedule, that a digital monitor is being reconsidered with the sector, and that authorities can demand register data for supervision.
I will inform the House further about this in the short term.
Daar zal ik de Kamer op korte termijn verder over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het niet nakomen van internationale afspraken voor aanpak biodiversiteitscrisis

MP Kostić (PvdD) asked the state secretary why the Netherlands is not meeting international biodiversity commitments, including the NBSAP deadline and a motion on halting species decline. The state secretary replied that the NBSAP will be submitted in Q2 2025 after being aligned with the new cabinet's policy, and that the Natuurherstelplan and the motion will be addressed in a letter by end 2024.
The cabinet needs more time to finalise the NBSAP. The NBSAP will be submitted in the second quarter of 2025.
Het kabinet heeft meer tijd nodig om het NBSAP af te ronden. Het NBSAP wordt in het tweede kwartaal van 2025 ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Krul, Stultiens, Kostić en Beckerman over het bericht 'Juristen: regeerprogramma op meerdere punten niet rechtsstatelijk'

Five MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how he views a legal commission's finding that cutting higher-education funding agreements unilaterally breaches the rule-of-law principle of a reliable government, and whether he would share the internal advice and memos behind the coalition programme before a committee debate. The minister rejects the commission's view, says the budget legislature sets annual funding and the agreement is not the legal basis, and refuses to share internal advice and memos under the principle of cabinet unity.
I am not, because the cabinet does not share internal advice and memos relating to the drafting of the coalition programme, on the basis of cabinet unity.
Dat ben ik niet, omdat het kabinet geen ambtelijke adviezen en nota’s deelt die zien op het opstellen van het Regeerprogramma, op grond van eenheid kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over een onvolledige reactie op zorgen van SchipholWatch

MP Kostić asks the minister why her reply to SchipholWatch's August letter on health, liveability and legal protection around Schiphol was incomplete, and requests a full answer before the aviation debate. The minister says the letter will be addressed in a reactienota expected end of October, and that the Chamber will be informed then, without answering the seven points on substance now.
The reactienota is expected to be ready at the end of October, after which the Chamber will be informed.
Naar verwachting is deze reactienota eind oktober gereed, waarna de Kamer wordt geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over krimp van luchtvaart en bescherming van burgers, gezondheid, natuur en klimaat

Rep. Kostić (PvdD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the reversal of Schiphol flight-cap reductions, alleged pressure on civil servants, exclusion of residents and health experts, consistency with court rulings, and climate obligations. The Minister answered at length, defending the revised noise-reduction package, the new flight-movement bandwidth, the consultation process, and planned monitoring, while largely restating the procedural framework.
To follow up on the RBV judgment, the balanced approach procedure (BA) will be continued.
Om opvolging te geven aan het RBV-vonnis wordt de balanced approach-procedure (BA) verder doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´ en De Hoop over het rapport «Groei zonder winst»

Two MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the report 'Groei zonder winst' on Schiphol's growth strategy and Lelystad Airport, and about an ESB article on aviation costs, including whether the social costs of aviation exceed its benefits. The minister rejects the report's conclusions, argues that Schiphol's hub and connectivity are significant economic benefits, and points to a planned distance-based flight tax from 2027 and a decision on Lelystad Airport in 2025.
The government programme provides that the decision on opening Lelystad Airport to commercial civil aviation will take place in 2025.
In het regeerprogramma is opgenomen dat besluitvorming over de opening van Lelystad Airport voor de commerciële burgerluchtvaart in 2025 plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Gabriëls, Kostić en Koekkoek over het bericht dat vertraging dreigt voor Tata Steel’s verduurzamingsplannen

MPs asked whether Tata Steel's delayed submission of the environmental impact report (MER) and the health effects report (GER) for its green steel plans could hold up permits, and whether parliament will see these documents before a Joint Letter of Intent is signed. The government says the company intends to submit everything in one go at year-end despite repeated warnings from the environmental service, that the GER methodology is still being developed, that negotiation details cannot be disclosed publicly, and that parliament will be briefed confidentially and may see the MER/GER if finalised before the JLoI.

Given the State's negotiating position and the possible market sensitivity of information on the negotiations, I cannot publicly address the conditions of the possible agreements between TSN and the State.

Gezien de onderhandelingspositie van de Staat en de mogelijke koersgevoeligheid van de informatie over de onderhandelingen, kan ik in het openbaar niet ingaan op de voorwaarden van de mogelijke afspraken tussen TSN en de Staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Kostić over een brand op een balkon waar een lhbti+ vlag hing

MPs Mutluer and Kostić asked the Justice and Education ministers about an arson fire in Breda that possibly targeted a rainbow flag, the aftercare for the victim, rising anti-LGBTI discrimination, the regenbooggemeenten programme, the timing of a new action plan, and the implementation of motions on police and intersectional discrimination. The minister condemned the incident while noting the investigation is ongoing, listed support measures, school programmes and planned research, and committed to a follow-up approach and action plan by spring 2025 while declining to comment on the victim's case for privacy reasons.
Because of the privacy and safety of the victim, I will not make further statements about this specific case.
Vanwege de privacy en de veiligheid van het slachtoffer doe ik geen verdere uitspraken over deze specifieke zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het gebruik van de mobiele schaapskooi ter bescherming van schapen

An MP asked the ministers about a mobile sheep shelter as a wolf-protection measure and whether it can help meet the legal duty to protect livestock from predators. The minister confirmed the duty, said a policy rule for the open standard is being drafted with broad stakeholder involvement, and noted that provinces run subsidy schemes, while declining to provide data on how many farmers currently take adequate measures.
Currently I am working on a policy rule for filling in the open norm on protection of animals not kept in a building.
Momenteel werk ik aan een beleidsregel voor de invulling van de open norm over bescherming van dieren die niet in een gebouw worden gehouden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het maatschappelijk manifest voor schoon en voldoende water voor mens en natuur

MP Kostić asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a civil-society manifesto calling for clean, sufficient and affordable water, and about the government's ability to meet Water Framework Directive goals by 2027, including licensing, costs and the Commission's infringement procedure. The minister said the approach is supported, that the government will reconsider specific manifesto points after the 2025 budget, and that it is unlikely all WFD targets will be met by 2027, while outlining planned licence reviews, a pending law change on indefinite permits, and a future Ctgb framework for pesticide authorisation.
European infringement procedures are strictly confidential.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over de dreigende dood van miljoenen zwerfhonden in Turkije

An MP asked the ministers whether Turkey's proposed law, expected to kill millions of stray dogs, should be opposed, and whether the Dutch humane approach (capture, sterilisation, vaccination, registration) could be promoted with Turkey. The government confirmed awareness, said humane solutions should be sought where possible, and said Turkey's approach is an internal matter, though the Dutch approach will be shared with Turkish authorities where relevant.
The concrete approach applied by Turkey is an internal Turkish matter.
De concrete benadering die door Turkije wordt toegepast is een Turkse interne aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over kindermarketing door varkenshouderijen

An MP asks the state secretary why the pig sector's classroom material 'The Pig Story', judged by the Advertising Code Committee to be misleading child marketing, is still offered to schools, and whether it should be banned or corrected. The state secretary says schools are responsible for lesson content under constitutional educational freedom, that the committee's rulings should be respected, but that government will not ban or order a rectification of the material.
Given the constitutional freedom of education regarding teaching materials, I feel restraint is appropriate in going into the substance of such materials.
Gezien de grondwettelijke onderwijsvrijheid ten aanzien van leermiddelen past mij terughoudendheid om inhoudelijk in te gaan op dergelijke materialen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´, Teunissen, Koekkoek, Thijssen, Gabriëls, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Zeedijk over de analyse van de toekomstplannen van Tata Steel door CE Delft

MPs from several parties asked the government to respond to a CE Delft analysis (commissioned by Greenpeace) comparing Tata Steel's transition plans with the Gezondheidsultimatum scenario on health, CO2, costs and feasibility. The government answered that the Gezondheidsultimatum is not feasible, that it will pursue a negotiated maatwerkafspraak based on Tata's plan with accelerated nuisance reduction, and that many details remain confidential due to ongoing negotiations.
The cabinet cannot make negotiated agreements on unfeasible plans and has chosen to pursue Tata Steel's plans with accelerated nuisance reduction.
Het kabinet kan geen maatwerkafspraken maken over onhaalbare plannen en heeft gekozen om in te zetten op de plannen van Tata Steel met versnelde overlastreductie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´ en Teunissen over dierlijk vet in biobrandstof

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about animal fat used in biofuel, its links to intensive livestock farming, palmoil deforestation and fraud in imported used cooking oil. The state secretary answered that the fat is a low-value waste product, that limits apply and that Dutch oversight by independent certifiers and the Netherlands Emissions Authority is robust, while promising to press the Commission on inspections in Asia.
The Netherlands has a robust system that oversees the supply chain of biofuels.
Nederland staat voor een robuust systeem dat toeziet op de toeleveringsketen van biobrandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over dat het advies met betrekking tot PFAS in zeeschuim is aangescherpt, maar strandgangers van niks weten

An MP asked why the advice to keep children and pets out of sea foam containing PFAS was only published on zwemwater.nl and not on beach signage, and asked about further PFAS measures. The minister replied that the advice was clarified rather than tightened, that the website and app reach about half a million visitors a year, and that beach signs are reserved for acute dangers, with no plans to add the advice to signage.
There is currently no reason for that.
Daar is op dit moment geen aanleiding voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over dat er minder milieucontroles plaatsvinden vanwege personeelstekorten bij de omgevingsdiensten

An MP asked the State Secretary whether staff shortages at environmental services (omgevingsdiensten) are reducing inspections at major polluting firms, the harm this causes, and why the number of services is not being reduced as the Van Aartsen and Sorgdrager reviews advised. The State Secretary acknowledged the shortages, said inspection priorities lie with competent authorities, offered no data on reduced controls, and pointed to robustness criteria due by April 2026 and ongoing legislative work.
I do not have figures on the number of inspections, nor do I have insight into whether fewer inspections are carried out than would be the case with more staff.
Cijfers over aantallen controles heb ik niet, ook heb ik geen inzicht of er minder controles worden uitgevoerd dan wanneer er meer personeel zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Teunissen inzake het toepassen van de Wet aanpak dierenmishandeling

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked whether the Animal Mistreatment Act's new powers (lifetime keeping bans, NVWA business closures, prosecutor conduct orders, RVO educational measures) are being used, how often, and about a suspected pig farm case in Twente. The government confirmed the powers exist, reported very few imposed measures, said the educational measure cannot yet be applied, and declined to comment on the individual farm inspection.
The NVWA does not make statements about its inspection findings at individual companies.
De NVWA doet geen uitspraken over haar inspectiebevindingen bij individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op van het lid Kostić over de brief 'Uitkomst overleg over misstanden inzet flexkrachten en arbeidsmigranten in vleessector'

An MP asked whether a blanket ban on temporary agency work in the meat and poultry sector would be considered, how the government will prevent abuse by malafide agencies, and how migrant workers can report abuses safely, including in other languages. The minister says talks with the sectors continue, a complaints point will be set up by the sectors with a link to the Work in NL information points, multilingual support is planned, and the Wtta licensing regime will address malafide agencies, with reporting to parliament after the summer.
It has been promised that the House will be informed again about this after the summer.
Toegezegd is dat de Kamer hier na de zomer opnieuw over zal worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het onderzoeksrapport over dierentuin Mondo Verde

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about a critical investigative report on Mondo Verde zoo, raising welfare concerns about lions, dogs, camels and staff, and questioned inspection and licensing. The minister acknowledged the concerns, announced a joint RVO and NVWA welfare investigation, and largely defended existing inspection and enforcement practice while declining to revoke the licence.
RVO and the NVWA will therefore join forces to thoroughly re-examine the welfare of the animals in the zoo and reassess the animal enclosures.
RVO en de NVWA zullen daarom samen optrekken om het welzijn van de dieren in de dierentuin nogmaals grondig te onderzoeken en de dierverblijven opnieuw te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het onderzoek naar de naleving van de gemaakte verbeterafspraken door het Dolfinarium

An MP asks the Minister about an inspection finding that the Dolfinarium still offers paid photo and touch interactions with dolphins that breach agreed rules, and about enforcement, possible licence withdrawal, and a planned sale of dolphins to China. The Minister confirms one agreement is breached, announces an intended last onder dwangsom and an investigation into banning public interactions, but declines to withdraw the licence or impose a breeding ban for now, and says a talk with the zoo must first take place.
The inquiry shows that the Dolfinarium is not complying with one of the agreements.
Het onderzoek wijst uit dat het Dolfinarium één van de afspraken niet naleeft.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kostić over het bericht ‘Dagen na ongeval met vrachtwagen vindt gezin nog tientallen halfkale kippen: ‘Wat hier gebeurt, kan echt niet’’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether the government will ensure that injured chickens left after a truck accident receive care, and why no authority rescued them, given the legal duty to aid animals. The minister says the transporter met legal obligations, responsibility lies with Rijkswaterstaat and its contracted salvagers, no enforcement is planned, and the government will not act further beyond thanking the rescuing family.
By doing so, the transporter has, according to the applicable laws and regulations, sufficiently fulfilled its responsibility.
Hiermee heeft de transporteur volgens de geldende wet- en regelgeving voldoende zijn verantwoordelijkheid genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het krantenartikel ‘Meer sleepnetvisserij in Nederlandse natuurgebieden dan in zes andere landen bij elkaar’

An MP asked the ministers about a report showing heavy bottom-trawling in Dutch Natura 2000 marine sites and its impact on seabed biodiversity. The ministers confirmed the trawling hours roughly but could not verify the Dutch share or the comparison with other countries, and pointed to EU exclusive competence and the slow Article 11 procedure while committing to work toward 15% seabed protection by 2030.
For sea fisheries (so outside the 3-mile zone), the European Union has exclusive competence to take measures, to the exclusion of the member states.
Voor de zeevisserij (dus buiten de 3 mijlszone) geldt dat de Europese Unie exclusief (dus met uitsluiting van de lidstaten) bevoegd is om maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Kostic´ over het gebruik van onnodig geweld tegen vreedzame klimaatdemonstranten

MPs Teunissen and Kostić asked the Minister of Justice and Security about alleged excessive police force against peaceful climate protesters, including a broken elbow and alleged sexual touching, and about press freedom, UN criticism and the right to protest. The Minister declined to comment on individual cases, stated that force is a last resort governed by strict rules and oversight by the public prosecutor and courts, and announced an independent study into protests that push legal boundaries.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Eerdmans over puppy-yoga

MPs Kostić and Eerdmans asked the minister about puppy yoga practices shown by Radar, including puppies handled for hours, lack of animal behaviour oversight, and possible welfare violations. The minister agreed the practice is undesirable, reported NVWA inspections finding overtreding with intended fines, and announced preparation of a general administrative order (AMvB) to ban puppy yoga.
I will therefore prepare a general administrative order to prohibit yoga with puppies.
Ik zal dan ook een algemene maatregel van bestuur voorbereiden om yoga met puppy's te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over een dikbilstier die vanwege de stress is overleden op de veemarkt in Schagen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about a double-muscled bull that died from stress at a cattle market in Schagen, and about welfare problems linked to markets, NVWA inspection, breeding of double-muscled cattle and caesarean births. The minister calls the death an incident, rejects a market ban and a fokverbod, and says a welfare-based breeding agreement is planned while the sector's evaluation is still pending.
Introducing a breeding or keeping ban conflicts with the European Breeding Regulation 2016/1021.
Het instellen van een fok- of houdverbod is in strijd met de Europese Fokkerijverordening 2016/1021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de Verordening welzijn en traceerbaarheid van honden en katten

An MP asked whether the Netherlands would push for bans on brachycephalic breeding, chip and registration duties for all dogs and cats, and registration of all breeders in the EU dog and cat welfare regulation, and questioned the exemption for small-scale trade. The minister confirmed Dutch participation, said the Netherlands supports the proposal and will push for these measures, though full EU-wide identification of all animals is unlikely.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over de noodzakelijke verbeteringen aan het statiegeldsysteem

An MP asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why deposit-return collection rates for plastic bottles and cans fall short of the 90% legal target, why producer organisation Verpact communicates favourable figures, and what will be done about the slow timeline and the deposit regulation. The State Secretary answers that official reporting is not yet available, that the ILT has started enforcement and a notice of intent to impose penalties, and that the deposit regulation will be evaluated in 2024 with possible legislative changes deferred to a new cabinet.
Later this year I will receive official figures for 2023, which should show whether and what improvement has occurred.
Later dit jaar ontvang ik officiële cijfers over 2023, waaruit moet blijken of en welke verbetering is opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over een via Nederland verspreide tuberculose-uitbraak bij apen die als proefdier worden gebruikt

An MP asked the health and agriculture ministers why parliament was not informed of a tuberculosis outbreak in laboratory macaques imported via the Netherlands, and about the import and export controls on such animals. The minister replied that the risk to public health was negligible, that no enforcement was needed because the importer broke no rules, that the import trade continues because research still needs these animals, and that the answers came late.
Infections with (possible) zoonoses in kept or wild animals are found more often. We do not report every infection to you, only where it may have consequences for public health.

Het komt vaker voor dat er besmettingen met (mogelijke) zoönosen bij gehouden of wilde dieren worden aangetoond. We melden u niet elke besmetting, alleen waar dat mogelijk gevolgen voor de volksgezondheid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Kostić over ‘het onder druk zetten van de minister van LNV om glyfosaat niet te verbieden’

MPs Ouwehand and Kostić asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that he opposed the Minister of Agriculture's plan to vote against renewing glyphosate approval, despite a Chamber motion. Minister Harbers confirmed discussion in the cabinet, deferred to the independent scientific advice (EFSA, Ctgb) and denied external lobbying contacts, but gave no direct answer on his own motives.
I have not held any discussions on this subject with external companies, institutions or organisations during this period.
Ik heb in deze periode geen gesprekken over dit onderwerp gevoerd met externe bedrijven, instellingen of organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Kostić over gezondheidsrisico’s door het nog tien jaar toelaten van glyfosaat

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the ten-year re-approval of glyphosate ignores possible health risks such as Parkinson's, and whether the precautionary principle should apply. The minister replied that the Zembla broadcast revealed no new facts, that no causal link to Parkinson's is established, that research with RIVM is being pursued, and that EFSA found safe use possible, while the Netherlands abstained in the EU vote.
That is why I am, together with the Minister of LNV, pursuing additional research by the RIVM into a possible link between Parkinson's disease and plant protection products.
Daarom zet ik samen met de Minister van LNV in op aanvullend onderzoek door het RIVM naar een mogelijk verband tussen de ziekte van Parkinson en gewasbeschermingsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Kostić over ‘de toelating van glyfosaat met tien jaar verlengen’

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked the state secretary about scientific criticism of the glyphosate renewal, the precautionary principle, and whether the Netherlands should oppose or ban glyphosate in Europe. The government defends the EFSA and Ctgb assessments finding no causal link to Parkinson's or cancer, acknowledges public concern, commissions RIVM research, but refuses to vote against or push for an EU ban.
That is why the Minister of Agriculture has called on the European Commission to develop a specific assessment framework for evaluating neurodegenerative effects.
Daarom heeft de Minister van LNV de Europese Commissie opgeroepen om specifiek toetsingskader te ontwikkelen voor de beoordeling van neurodegeneratieve effecten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Kostić over over het bericht dat Adema achter de schermen pleitte voor een glyfosaatverbod

MPs Ouwehand and Kostić asked the minister, after a Zembla report, why the Netherlands did not vote against renewing glyphosate's EU approval, citing scientific criticism of the Ctgb's cancer and Parkinson's assessment. Minister Adema answered that the Netherlands abstained, that EU and national assessments found no causal link to Parkinson's or cancer, that a RIVM study on Parkinson's was commissioned, and that approvals would be revisited if new evidence emerged.
I cannot make any statements about the precise content of the discussions within the cabinet.
Over de precieze inhoud van de gesprekken binnen het kabinet kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over dat Appelsientje de frisdrankentaks ontwijkt door koemelk aan een product toe te voegen

An MP asked why fruit juice producer Appelsientje can avoid the soft drinks excise by adding a small amount of milk fat, and whether the government will close this loophole and reconsider the dairy exemption. The state secretary answered that the dairy exemption has existed since 1993 and is currently lawful, that a contour letter sets out options for a differentiated sugar-based levy and for changing the dairy exemption, and that any change would need 12 to 24 months of preparation by Customs.
The attached contour letter sets out the options for a differentiated consumption tax.
In bijgaande contourenbrief zijn de opties voor een gedifferentieerde verbruiksbelasting uiteengezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het grote verschil tussen de Duitse en de Nederlandse Schijf van Vijf

An MP asked the state secretaries of Health and Agriculture about the gap between the revised German and the Dutch food guidelines (Schijf van Vijf), including the 60/40 plant-animal protein target and whether sustainability should be weighed. The government confirmed the 50/50 target for 2030, said the Gezondheidsraad advice is being followed, and explained the differences in method and scope, while leaving updates of the Schijf van Vijf to the Voedingscentrum and new ambitions to a new cabinet.
Formulating new ambitions or policy goals is up to a new cabinet.
Het formuleren van nieuwe ambities of beleidsdoelen is aan een nieuw kabinet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over het aanpassen van antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen over de landelijke vrijstellingslijst en het toch niet uitvoeren van een aangenomen motie, vlak na gesprekken met de jagers

An MP asks why the minister's answers to written questions on the national exemption list were changed after lobby groups from the hunting sector met ministry officials, and why a motion to remove threatened species from the list has not been implemented. The minister admits a wrong version was sent by mistake, says the revised answers reflect the need for more consultation with provinces, and commits to preparing withdrawal of the exemptions for rabbit, wood pigeon and jay, with a report to parliament in June.
Implementing the motion is, however, more complex than foreseen in advance.
Het uitvoeren van de motie is echter complexer dan vooraf voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Koekkoek, Bamenga, Gabriëls en Thijssen over Tata Steel en de HUMAN documentaire STAAL

MPs from PvdD, Volt, D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the state secretary about the HUMAN documentary STAAL on Tata Steel, including alleged concealment of emissions, the reliability of company emission data, citizen-operated cameras, health ultimatums and the dismissal and rehiring of a critical employee. The state secretary answered that emissions must fall, that the government will seek faster health-focused agreements with Tata Steel, and that enforcement and monitoring lie with the provincial authority and the Omgevingsdienst, while declining to judge several specific allegations.
Enforcement and supervision of Tata Steel is a task of the competent authority, the province of Noord-Holland.
Handhaving en toezicht op Tata Steel is een taak van het bevoegd gezag, de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Kostić over Kritiek op besluit provincie Friesland tegen actief regenboogbeleid

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether rainbow provinces should be obliged to run active LGBTI policy, after Friesland's decision to drop such a stance, and requested figures on discrimination reports and police reports in Friesland. The minister answered that the rainbow-province label is a provincial initiative with no national conditions, that policy content is for provinces themselves, and supplied reporting figures from Tumba and the police.
I am happy to work together with the provinces on this, but as stated, the content of rainbow policy is ultimately up to the provinces themselves.
Ik werk hierin graag samen met de provincies, maar zoals gezegd is de invulling van het regenboogbeleid uiteindelijk aan de provincies zelf.
