Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Teunissen en Beckerman over belastingontwijking door bedrijven zoals Chemours

Three MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax avoidance by Chemours, including whether its low corporate tax payments reflect transfer pricing and whether the Tax Authority supervises it. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual tax files under confidentiality rules, explained loss offset and arm's-length transfer pricing in general terms, and set out measures against tax avoidance and conduit companies.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de AWR kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de verkoop van illegaal gefokte dieren met ernstige erfelijke aandoeningen via Marktplaats

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why illegally bred Scottish Fold kittens with hereditary defects can still be advertised on Marktplaats, and what enforcement and platform measures will stop it. The minister confirmed breeding is prohibited and enforcement letters were sent, but said platforms have no duty to verify legality, declined to require faster removal of ads, and pointed to a planned house-ban and EU rules as the remedy.
To ensure an end to the illegal breeding of animals that suffer from hereditary traits, it is also necessary to stop the demand for these animals.
Om ervoor te zorgen dat er een einde komt aan de illegale fok van dieren die lijden vanwege erfelijke kenmerken is het ook nodig om de vraag naar deze dieren te stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de felle kritiek op dierenpark Mondo Verde

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about public criticism of zoo Mondo Verde, including enclosure conditions for wolves, camels, big cats and panthers, prior permit refusals, and past welfare incidents, and whether the zoo's licence would be withdrawn. The minister answered that RVO and the NVWA are handling inspections and enforcement, that a camel enclosure lacks a permit and will be addressed, and that the licence will not be withdrawn yet pending the inspection findings.
RVO will hold the animal park to account on this and the situation must be restored.
RVO zal het dierenpark hierop aanspreken en de situatie moet hersteld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Kostić over de vrijheid van meningsuiting voor ambtenaren

MPs Chakor and Kostić asked whether civil servants may publicly criticise government and climate policy, and how Article 10 of the Civil Servants Act is applied. The state secretary answered that civil servants have the same fundamental rights, that Article 10 limits them only where their function is at risk, that assessment is case-by-case, and that the employer and AGFA advisory body handle enforcement while a Handreiking is being developed.
Civil servants, like everyone in the Netherlands, have the right to freedom of expression, freedom of association, and the right to assemble and demonstrate.
Ambtenaren hebben, zoals iedereen in Nederland, het recht van vrijheid van meningsuiting, het recht tot vereniging en het recht tot vergadering en betoging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over dumpprijzen van nieuw plastic

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary whether low prices for virgin plastic threaten recycling firms and whether a mandatory recyclate blend should start before 2027 and a tax on virgin plastic should be introduced. The government called the market disruption undesirable, pointed to EU recyclate targets, a national circular plastics norm from 2027 and financial support, but said an earlier mandate was not possible and it judged a virgin-plastic tax disproportionate because of leakage effects.
It is very undesirable that the market for recyclate cannot function properly.
Het is zeer onwenselijk dat de markt voor recyclaat niet goed kan functioneren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Tjeerd de Groot, Kostić en Koekkoek over de controle op visfraude door de NVWA

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, D66, PvdD and Volt asked the minister about the court ruling on NVWA fish-fraud controls, overfishing, the adequacy of staffing and EU compliance of the inspection system. The minister acknowledged ongoing EU infringement procedures and announced capacity expansion and a revised steekproefplan, while largely defending current staffing levels and declining to share confidential Commission advice.
These advice and remarks are confidential.
Deze adviezen en opmerkingen zijn vertrouwelijk.

Motie van de leden Bolkestein en Diertens over de doelmatigheid van het bijschrijven van dagleidinggevenden op de horecavergunning
Asks the government to research whether adding daily managers to hospitality licences is effective for preventing crime, reporting to the House by June 2021.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Bolkestein over het bericht 'Nieuwe drug 3-MMC duikt op in Zeeland'

The minister answered that use data are limited but rising, 3-MMC is still legal and sold online, a NPS bill will ban it, and the CAM will review evidence and consider next steps.
Once the cathinones fall under the Opium Act, production of and trade in 3-MMC will be illegal.
Zodra de cathinonen onder de Opiumwet vallen zal productie van en handel in 3-MMC illegaal zijn.

requests the government to examine when and how the split between heat production and supply on the one hand and heat transport and network management on the other is possible
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken wanneer en op welke manier de splitsing tussen productie en levering van warmte enerzijds en het warmtetransport en netbeheer anderzijds mogelijk is

include a separate scheme for solar PV energy cooperatives in the SDE+ scheme
een aparte regeling voor energiecoöperaties zon-PV op te nemen in de SDE+-regeling
Motie van de leden Van der Lee en Jetten over verbeteren van de energiebesparingsverplichting
Asks the government to improve and extend the energy-saving obligation under the Environmental Management Act so firms know which measures are legally required.
requests the government to improve and supplement the energy-saving obligation under the Environmental Management Act
verzoekt de regering om, de energiebesparingsverplichting onder de Wet milieubeheer te verbeteren en aan te vullen
Motie van het lid Moorlag c.s. over werven van technici en vakmensen
Asks the government to include in the climate and energy agreement arrangements for training, retraining and recruiting technicians and skilled workers for the energy transition.
noting that the energy transition, including making the housing stock energy neutral, requires large numbers of technicians and skilled workers
constaterende dat de energietransitie, waaronder het energieneutraal maken van de woningvoorraad, grote aantallen technici en vakmensen vraagt
Motie van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius c.s. over inventariseren van belemmeringen bij innovaties
Asks the government to inventory regulatory obstacles to innovation via a digital platform and report to the House in 2018.
requests the government, via a digital platform, to inventory the bottlenecks and obstacles regarding innovations and to inform the House in 2018
verzoekt de regering, via een digitaal platform de knelpunten en belemmeringen met betrekking tot innovaties te inventariseren en de Kamer in 2018 te informeren
Motie van de leden Dik-Faber en Jetten over het pilotproject Blue Energy
Asks the government to actively contribute to realising the Blue Energy pilot project in Katwijk.
requests the government to actively contribute to realising the Blue Energy pilot project
verzoekt de regering, actief bij te dragen aan het realiseren van het pilotproject Blue Energy
Amendement van het lid Jetten over 750.000 euro voor Nijmegen Green Capital
Moves 750,000 euro from the economy ministry budget to fund Nijmegen Green Capital 2018 through a one-off subsidy.
by making available a one-off 750,000 euro to the organisation of Nijmegen Green Capital 2018
door eenmalig € 750.000 ter beschikking te stellen aan de organisatie van Nijmegen Green Capital 2018
Motie van het lid Sienot c.s. over innovatieve oplossingen voor bereikbaarheid
Motion asks the government to enable an innovative mobility-as-a-service pilot in each province within the MIRT cycle in 2018.
requests the government, in 2018 within the MIRT cycle, to enable an innovative pilot in each province
verzoekt de regering, in 2018 in het kader van de MIRT-cyclus in iedere provincie een innovatieve pilot mogelijk te maken
Motie van het lid Sienot c.s. over de regionale knelpunten op het spoor
Asks the government to talk with concession grantors, regional operators and ProRail before the autumn 2018 MIRT consultations to tackle regional rail bottlenecks.
asks the government, before the autumn 2018 MIRT consultations, to talk with concession grantors, regional operators and ProRail to tackle regional rail bottlenecks

verzoekt de regering, voorafgaand aan de MIRT-overleggen in het najaar van 2018 in gesprek te gaan met concessieverleners, regionale vervoerders en ProRail om de regionale knelpunten op het spoor aan te pakken
Motie van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Jetten over meer transparantie in de Nationale Energieverkenning
Asks the government to provide more transparency and clarity in the annual National Energy Outlook on energy consumption figures and the rise in levies added to energy prices.
requests the government to provide more transparency and clarity in the annual National Energy Outlook about the figures on energy consumption and the rise in levies

verzoekt de regering, in de jaarlijkse Nationale Energieverkenning meer transparantie en duidelijkheid te verschaffen over de cijfers ten aanzien van het energieverbruik en de stijging van de heffingen
Motie van het lid Jetten c.s. over snelle verplaatsing van personen
Asks the government, with hyperloop parties and private partners, to examine whether a viable business case exists for a hyperloop test site.
requests the government, in cooperation with hyperloop parties and private parties, to examine whether a feasible business case can be made
verzoekt de regering om, in samenwerking met hyperlooppartijen en private partijen te onderzoeken of er een haalbare businesscase kan worden gemaakt
Motie van het lid Jetten c.s. over fietsvoorzieningen
Asks the government to take e-bikes, speed pedelecs and cargo bikes into account when building bicycle parking and cycle highways.
requests the government, when building bicycle parking and cycle highways, to take e-bikes into account as much as possible
verzoekt de regering, bij aanleg van fietsenstallingen en fietssnelwegen zo veel mogelijk rekening te houden met elektrische fietsen
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over de bestaande capaciteit van het spoor
Asks the government, with rail managers and users, to draw up a plan for making optimal use of existing rail capacity.
requests the government, in consultation with the rail manager and users, to draw up a plan to make optimal use of existing rail capacity
verzoekt de regering, in overleg met de beheerder en gebruikers van het spoor een plan op te stellen om de bestaande capaciteit van het spoor optimaal te benutten
Motie van het lid Jetten c.s. over de fietsinfrastructuur
Motion asks government to check, for each new state-funded infrastructure investment, whether a parallel cycling infrastructure upgrade should be studied.
requests the government, for each new infrastructure investment funded from national funds, to examine whether a study into simultaneously improving cycling infrastructure in the area is relevant

verzoekt de regering, bij elke nieuwe investering in infrastructuur die vanuit rijksmiddelen wordt bekostigd, na te gaan of een onderzoek naar een gelijktijdige verbetering van de fietsinfrastructuur in het betreffende gebied relevant is
Motie van de leden Jetten en Van der Graaf over de Noordelijke Randweg Utrecht
Asks the government to reach an agreement quickly with Utrecht municipality and province on the investments needed for the Noordelijke Randweg Utrecht road.
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over grensoverschrijdende treinverbindingen
Asks the government to investigate cross-border train connections with Belgium and Germany and inform the House by mid-2018.
requests the government to conduct further research into the opportunities and plans for all possible cross-border train connections
verzoekt de regering, nader onderzoek te doen naar de kansen en voornemens van alle mogelijke grensoverschrijdende treinverbindingen
Motie van het lid Kröger c.s. over alternatieven voor korte vliegreizen
Asks the government to analyse what is needed to make international travellers choose rail over short-haul flights.
requests the government, building on the Toekomstbeeld OV, to carry out an analysis
verzoekt de regering om, voortbouwend op het Toekomstbeeld OV, een analyse te doen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Paternotte over de gevolgen van bezuinigingen op onderwijsinstellingen en de gevolgen van de aanpak internationalisering

MPs Jetten and Paternotte asked about layoffs and department closures at Dutch universities (Twente, UCR, Open Universiteit, UvA) linked to budget cuts, the effects on regional functions and technical labour shortages, and the rules on English-language programmes. The minister answers that the layoffs are not directly tied to the cuts, that institutions have autonomy over their choices, that the cuts will not be reconsidered, and that a regional criterion in the internationalisation law and a broader approach to student numbers are planned.
The cabinet stands behind the choices made and considers the budget cuts realistic and feasible.
Het kabinet staat achter de gemaakte keuzes en beschouwt de bezuinigingen als realistisch en uitvoerbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Jetten, Dijk, Ouwehand, Bikker, Dassen en Van Baarle over de uitzetting van de elfjarige Mikael

MPs asked the government whether it could grant a residence permit to eleven-year-old Mikael and his mother despite a Council of State ruling, and why the child-amnesty rules required being 'in beeld' with the immigration chain. The minister answered that residence permits require a statutory basis, that the discretionary power was replaced in 2019 and is limited to harsh circumstances in the first application, and that the government will not take measures to prevent harsh outcomes in individual cases.
The cabinet does not intend to take these measures.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om deze maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Ellemeet en Ploumen over het artikel "De Deense zaad-invasie: hoe Deense klinieken profiteren van een ongereguleerde markt"

MPs Jetten, Ellemeet and Ploumen asked the health minister about a Follow the Money article on Danish sperm clinics exploiting an unregulated market, including the donor-limit rules, cross-border donor supply, monitoring, and the Wdkb amendment. The minister answered that the Wdkb amendment is pending (expected March 2022), that a 12-family cap per donor applies under the national standard, that monitoring is by individual clinics with no central oversight yet, and that internet/private donation is not regulated.
There is currently no central monitoring in the Netherlands of the maximum number of children per donor.
Er is op dit moment geen centrale monitoring in Nederland van het maximumaantal kinderen per donor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Ellemeet over de onrechtmatige staatssteun aan Siriz

MPs Jetten and Ellemeet asked the state secretary about Siriz's unlawful state aid, its subsidy history, contacts with the ministry, and the Court of Audit's findings. The state secretary acknowledged that the subsidy constituted unlawful state aid, gave a year-by-year payment table, but declined to make the 2019 state-aid assessments available and said recovery is not possible while no Commission or court ruling exists.
There are no documents containing full state-aid assessments that can be sent to your House.
Er zijn geen documenten met integrale staatssteuntoetsen die aan uw Kamer kunnen worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Klaver, Ploumen en Van der Staaij over de snelheid van het vaccineren en de uitvoering van de vaccinatiestrategie

Four MPs (Jetten, Klaver, Ploumen, Van der Staaij) asked the health minister why the Netherlands lags the EU average in COVID-19 vaccination, about planning, stock management, the role of Defence and business, and vaccinating nursing-home residents. The minister answered that the first shot was given later than in other member states, that a large safety stock was held, that stock management and planning are being adjusted, and that vaccination groups are being prioritised by risk, while the answers on Defence/business offers and prognoses were largely restated policy or deferred.
It is not easy to estimate when the Netherlands will be at the same vaccination rate as the other EU countries or even above it.
Het is niet goed in te schatten wanneer Nederland op dezelfde vaccinatiegraad zit als de andere EU-landen of zelfs daar boven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Jetten over het bericht 'Wereldleiders willen ambitieuzere aanpak natuurverlies: 'We hebben geen moment te verliezen'

MPs De Groot and Jetten asked the Prime Minister about the outcome of the One Planet Summit, whether the Netherlands joined the 30% land and sea protection goal ahead of the Kunming biodiversity summit, the link between biodiversity loss and COVID-19, and how the Jetten/De Groot motion was followed up. The Prime Minister answered that the summit built momentum, that the Netherlands joined the High Ambition Coalition for Nature and People, that the zoonosis link is acknowledged by researchers but the SARS-CoV-2 origin is not settled, and that the summit contributed to implementing the motion.
The Netherlands has become a member of the High Ambition Coalition for Nature and People.
Nederland is lid geworden van de High Ambition Coalition for Nature and People.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over de vaccinatiestrategie in Nederland

MPs Jetten and Diertens (D66) asked the health minister about the Dutch COVID-19 vaccination strategy, including why logistics for the BioNTech/Pfizer vaccine (ultra-cold storage, 975-dose packs) were not anticipated earlier, why care workers were prioritised over frail elderly, and why the start was late. The minister answered that preparations began before summer 2020, RIVM discussed packaging with Pfizer from October and repacking proved unfeasible, and the strategy was adjusted after Gezondheidsraad advice.
The RIVM was not surprised that the vaccine was packaged differently from vaccines normally used, for example against flu.
Het RIVM was niet verrast dat het vaccin anders verpakt was dan vaccins die regulier worden ingezet, bijvoorbeeld tegen de griep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Jetten over 'Wouter wilde bloedplasma doneren voor middel tegen corona, maar werd geweigerd'

MPs Bergkamp and Jetten asked the Minister of Health why gay and bisexual men are excluded from donating blood plasma against COVID-19 and what the criteria are. The minister explained that Sanquin's MSM-based selection rules rest on higher infection risks and announced that a 4-month deferral criterion will extend to plasma donations, while a RIVM study on sexual risk behaviour as an alternative criterion has been delayed.
Sanquin has informed me that the current selection criterion for whole blood donation by men who have sex with men (MSM) will soon also apply to plasma donations.

Sanquin heeft mij laten weten dat het huidige selectiecriterium voor het doneren van volbloed door mannen die seks hebben gehad met andere mannen (MSM) binnenkort ook van toepassing zal zijn voor plasmadonaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Sienot over het artikel ‘Nederland zit niet te wachten op geld uit groene subsidiepot van de EU’

MPs Jetten and Sienot asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the Netherlands would not take part in the EU Just Transition Fund given its high emissions and low renewable generation, and whether it would press for funding for gas-extraction regions such as Groningen. The minister answers that the cabinet supports the mechanism but wants its size limited within the Dutch MFK position, and will argue for objective criteria that include employment effects in hard-hit regions; details are referred to a separate BNC-fiche.
The cabinet will then argue for the use of objective criteria, which should also take into account employment in the regions hardest hit by the climate transition.

Het kabinet zal vervolgens pleiten voor het gebruik van objectieve criteria, waarbij ook de werkgelegenheid in regio's die het hardst worden geraakt ten gevolge van de klimaattransitie moet worden meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over het rapport 'Duurzame en betaalbare energie in Caribisch Nederland'

Two D66 MPs asked whether geothermal exploration permits on Saba, granted by the island council to Teranova rather than via EZK and the Staatscourant, comply with the Mijnwet BES, and what the legal consequence would be. The minister answered that the Mijnwet BES contains no geothermal rules, so responsibility lies with Saba's public body, and promised to consider amending the law and consult the public bodies concerned.
I will examine how the granting of geothermal permits for the BES islands can be anchored and whether an amendment of the Mijnwet BES is desirable.
Ik zal bezien hoe de vergunningverlening rond geothermie voor de BES eilanden verankerd kan worden en of daarbij een aanpassing van de Mijnwet BES gewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Jetten over de gevolgen van de Brexit voor de Nederlandse luchtvaart

MPs Paternotte and Jetten asked the government about the consequences of a no-deal Brexit for Dutch aviation, including Airbus contingency plans, flight permissions, licences and a future air services agreement with the UK. The minister answered that companies are responsible for their own preparations, that the government will work with the EU and sector partners on contingency measures, and that aviation rights with the UK will be sought at EU level.
It is not the role of the cabinet, certainly not for individual companies, to speculate about the possible relocation of activities.
Het is niet de rol van het kabinet, zeker niet bij individuele bedrijven, om te speculeren over de mogelijke verplaatsing van activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Jetten over het bericht dat Hardenberg in alle nieuwbouwwijken gasaansluitingen toelaat

Two MPs from D66 asked ministers whether Hardenberg's blanket exemption from the gas connection obligation for all new-build neighbourhoods was lawful and in line with the law's intent. The minister answered that the municipal exemption power is limited to specific projects or locations, that he cannot judge whether Hardenberg complied with the rules, and that objection and appeal are open to affected parties.
Whether the college of mayor and aldermen of the municipality of Hardenberg took this decision in accordance with the provisions of the law, I cannot assess.
Of het college van burgemeester en wethouders van de gemeente Hardenberg dit besluit conform de bepalingen in de wet heeft genomen, kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Jetten over het terugdringen van de klimaatimpact van de financiële sector

MPs Dik-Faber and Jetten asked whether other Dutch banks, insurers and pension funds have published commitments to measure and reduce the climate impact of their full balance sheets, and whether the minister will make concrete agreements with the financial sector in the Klimaatberaad as required by an outstanding motion. The minister replied that about fifteen financial firms pledged to measure climate impact by 2020 and that a financial task group within the Klimaatakkoord talks will develop plans, without committing to specific agreements.
Soon I will inform your House about progress towards a Climate Agreement.
Binnenkort informeer ik uw Kamer over de voortgang om te komen tot een Klimaatakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over de berichtgeving omtrent de mogelijke toekomstige zoutwinning ten zuidoosten van Enschede

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why the municipality of Enschede was not informed about salt-mining plans by SGW, and how information and involvement of municipalities will be improved. The minister answers that no formal municipal role existed under the old procedure, that the amended Mijnbouwwet now gives municipalities an advisory role, and that a consultation and information evening will be organised.
I agree with the municipality of Enschede's position on the role it wants in the permit processes for salt mining.
Ik ben het eens met het standpunt van de gemeente Enschede over de door haar gewenste rol in de vergunningenprocessen voor de zoutwinning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz, Dik-Faber, Jetten en Agnes Mulder over het vertrek van de NCG

MPs asked about the role of the National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) after its director Alders resigned, covering its remit, houses inspected and reinforced, the shift of damage handling to an independent commission, funding, timelines for reinforcing 2,500 homes, and continuity of the programme. The minister answered in detail, stating the NCG no longer handles damage claims, that reinforcement decisions should be made independently of NAM with advice from the Mijnraad, and that continuity is being secured.
Because of these developments, the NCG no longer has a role in damage handling.
Vanwege deze ontwikkelingen heeft de NCG geen rol meer in de schadeafhandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over het rapport ‘Duurzame en betaalbare energie in Caribisch Nederland’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about results, targets, timelines and affordability of renewable energy in the Caribbean Netherlands following a report. The minister replied island by island (Saba, Sint Eustatius, Bonaire), noting new solar and wind capacity, prioritising reliability and affordability on Bonaire, and stating that small consumers have an affordable tariff though not a cheap one.
A sustainable energy supply is of great importance in the Caribbean Netherlands, as are safety, security of supply and affordability.
Een duurzame energievoorziening is van groot belang in Caribisch Nederland, evenals veiligheid, leveringszekerheid en betaalbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over de stijging van water- en elektriciteitstarieven op Bonaire

MPs Jetten and Diertens asked the ministers about rising water and electricity tariffs on Bonaire and whether low-consumption households are unfairly burdened. The government answered that it has provided subsidies, is preparing a short-term amendment to the Wet elektriciteit en drinkwater BES to restore a discount for small consumers, and will examine tariff options, while stating that the subsidy does not imply dependence on the Netherlands.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Özütok over “het verzoek van Friesland en Zeeland aan jongeren stemrecht vanaf 16 jaar te gunnen”

MPs Jetten and Özütok asked whether the minister would support a request from Friesland and Zeeland to trial voting at 16 in the 2019 provincial elections, and on the criteria and research behind voting age. The minister replied that no formal request was received, that the Constitution does not allow lowering the voting age even as an experiment, and that she sees no current demand for lowering it, offering instead other forms of youth participation.
The Constitution does not permit granting the right to vote to younger persons, not even by way of an experiment.
De Grondwet staat niet toe het kiesrecht toe te kennen aan jongere personen, ook niet bij wijze van experiment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over een mogelijke aanval van taxichauffeurs op het hoofdkantoor van Uber

An MP asked about a reported plan by taxi drivers to attack Uber's Amsterdam headquarters, prior warnings, illegal taxi complaints, and ILT inspection capacity and enforcement in Amsterdam. The government answered that police are alert, the ILT has 25 inspectors working on a risk-based approach, and cooperation with the municipality, police and prosecutors is set out in a convenant.
Do you think the ILT has sufficient capacity to ensure in Amsterdam that entrepreneurs and drivers in the taxi sector comply with the rules?
Bent u van mening dat de ILT voldoende capaciteit heeft om er in Amsterdam op toe te zien dat ondernemers en chauffeurs in de taxibranche de regels naleven?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Van Brenk over het bericht ‘Proef met OV-chip op mobiel mislukt’

Two MPs (Jetten and Van Brenk) asked the state secretary why the mobile OV-chip pilot failed and what consequences follow for mobile payment in public transport. The state secretary answered that the pilot was ended because the Mifare-based system was too complex for large-scale rollout, that the NOVB is preparing a switch to an open standard, and that mobile payment remains a goal, though no concrete follow-up is yet agreed.
The pilot is not being ended because of insufficient technical cooperation between the parties, but because OV-chip mobile in its current form is too complex for large-scale rollout.
De proef wordt niet beëindigd vanwege onvoldoende technische samenwerking tussen de partijen, maar omdat OV-chip mobiel in de huidige vorm te complex is voor grootschalige uitrol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over de nieuwe tariefstructuur van de IC Amsterdam – Brussel

An MP asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about the new fare structure for the Intercity Amsterdam–Brussels, including price changes by booking time, timing, the seven-day early-booking window, effects on spontaneous trips, and cross-border rail options. The State Secretary answered that NS sets the fares within concession frameworks, that she has reservations about the seven-day window and asked NS to bring the evaluation forward to three months after introduction, and that she will assess the effects on travel behaviour in that evaluation.
NS cannot currently say whether most travellers will face a price increase or decrease, because this depends on how far in advance the trip is booked and when it takes place.
NS kan op dit moment niet zeggen of voor de meeste reizigers sprake is van een prijsstijging of een -daling, omdat dit afhangt van de termijn van het boeken van de reis, en van het moment van reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Jetten over een mogelijk 'klimaatakkoord' voor de luchtvaart

D66 MPs asked the ministers about the ICAO CORSIA aviation emissions scheme, including its effectiveness, transparency, enforcement, offset quality, biofuel sustainability criteria, participation and Dutch lobbying. The government answered every question on substance, acknowledged concerns on offset quality and biofuel criteria, and committed to raising them in future EU and ICAO evaluations.
The Netherlands will use these and other evaluation moments to further improve the system on sustainability, effectiveness and environmental integrity.
Nederland zal van deze en andere evaluatiemomenten gebruik maken om het systeem verder te verbeteren op punten als duurzaamheid, effectiviteit en milieu-integriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Sienot over geluidshinder van de A50 in Niftrik

MPs Jetten and Sienot (D66) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about long-standing noise nuisance from the A50 at Niftrik, including road surface, expansion joint design, noise-production ceilings and whether measurements should replace calculations. The minister answered that RWS is compliant with the noise production ceilings based on calculations, sees no reason for new surfacing or joints or new measurements now, and makes no commitment to action.
Because no exceedance of the noise production ceilings is expected in the short term, there is no reason to consider measures.
Omdat er op korte termijn nog geen overschrijding van de GPP's wordt verwacht is er geen aanleiding om maatregelen te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Sienot over het bericht ‘Rotterdam wil af van steenkool in de haven’

MPs Jetten and Sienot asked whether the government will support Rotterdam's motion to phase out coal handling at the port, use its shareholder powers and tariffs to curb coal transshipment, and support similar phase-outs in Amsterdam. The minister answered that the coal contract is a matter between the port company and private operators, that restricting coal handling would only shift flows to German and Belgian ports, and that the state will oversee sound financial decisions by the port company as shareholder.
Restricting coal handling in Rotterdam does not lead to a reduction in CO2 emissions, unlike a ban on coal use for electricity production, which does.
Het beperken van de op- en overslag van kolen in Rotterdam leidt niet tot vermindering van de CO 2 -uitstoot, zoals een verbod op het gebruik van kolen voor elektriciteitsproductie dat wel doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over het goederenvervoer tussen Hamont, Budel en Weert

An MP asked whether the Hamont-Budel-Weert freight line meets safety requirements, whether unguarded level crossings there will be included in the dangerous-crossings programme, and when the line will be reactivated for passenger transport. The state secretary answered that the line meets applicable safety rules, that ProRail found no extra crossing measures needed given the very low train frequency, and that a decision on passenger reactivation is targeted for 2018 pending cost clarity and operator consultation.
I will inform the House in the spring about the implementation of the Van der Graaf et al. motion.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het voorjaar informeren over de uitvoering van de motie Van der Graaf c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Jetten over wisselstoringen op het spoor door het winterweer in december

MPs Amhaouch and Jetten asked the state secretary about rail switch failures during the December 2017 winter weather, including preparation, back-up plans, evaluation, information provision and oversight of ProRail and NS. The state secretary said the cause cannot yet be determined pending the evaluation by ProRail and NS, committed to sending evaluations to parliament, and argued that internalised winter practices make ministerial steering a premature conclusion to draw.
I think it is premature to draw this conclusion. I will first await the evaluation by NS and ProRail, the lessons they draw from it and the changes they will make to their approach.

Ik vind het te voorbarig om deze conclusie te trekken. Ik wacht eerst de evaluatie van NS en ProRail af, de lessen die ze op basis daarvan trekken en de wijzigingen die ze in hun aanpak gaan doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Jetten over het gebruik van de OV-fiets

MPs Sienot and Jetten (D66) asked the state secretary about low OV-bike use after bus and metro trips and whether NS should expand OV-bike rental beyond stations. The state secretary attributes low use to short walking distances, supports broader OV-bike availability, and commits to talks with concession holders and pilots on station bicycle parking.
Yes. I am happy to talk with public transport concession holders about the opportunities for shared bicycles as part of a smooth door-to-door journey for travellers.
Ja. Ik ga graag met ov-concessiehouders in gesprek over de kansen voor deelfietsen als onderdeel van een soepele deur-tot-deur-reis voor reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over het uitstempelen van zeevarenden in de haven van Rotterdam

An MP asked whether stamping departing non-EU seafarers' documents in Rotterdam harbour, after a practice change in 2016, distorts the level playing field for the maritime repair sector and whether it is in line with the Schengen Border Code given a 2017 court ruling. The State Secretary answered that the Schengen Code applies uniformly across member states, that exit stamps are only placed when departure is imminent, and that the government is appealing the court ruling and negotiating working arrangements with the sector.
In my view this ruling does not do justice to the provisions of the Schengen Border Code. I have therefore lodged an appeal against the ruling of the Hague District Court, Rotterdam sitting.

Naar mijn mening doet deze uitspraak geen recht aan de bepalingen van de Schengengrenscode. Ik heb daarom tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag, zittingsplaats Rotterdam, hoger beroep ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Sjoerdsma over bureaucratie bij het aanvragen van een genderneutrale ov-chipkaart

Two D66 MPs asked why applying for a gender-neutral OV-chipkaart involved bureaucracy, and whether such a card should be offered. The state secretary answered that the sector committed to dropping the m/v gender marker on all new cards from 1 January 2017, with NS cards following by 20 December 2017, and that she welcomes this and supports gender-neutral cards.
That is why I am glad that very soon, without bureaucratic obstacles, no m/v marking will be visible on any new OV-chipkaarts.
Daarom ben ik blij dat er zeer binnenkort zonder bureaucratische drempels op alle nieuwe OV-chipkaarten geen m/v vermelding meer zichtbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Jetten over het bericht ‘Reclameborden op A'dam CS weten wanneer en hoelang jij kijkt’

MPs Verhoeven and Jetten asked the government about reports that cameras in advertising billboards at Dutch railway stations, including Amsterdam Centraal, collect viewer data. The government answered that NS and operator Exterion Media turned off the cameras and software after the publicity, claimed only anonymous statistical counts were generated, and noted the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is asking questions.

Following the conversation, it was decided to switch off the cameras and underlying software on the billboards, even though according to Exterion Media it falls within all applicable laws and regulations.

Naar aanleiding van het gesprek is besloten om de camera’s en achterliggende software op de borden uit te zetten, ondanks het feit dat het volgens Exterion Media binnen alle geldende wet- en regelgeving valt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Groothuizen over de Nederlandse transporteur die stopt met ritten naar Engeland vanwege problemen met vluchtelingen die als verstekeling meereizen

MPs Jetten and Groothuizen asked the government what it has done about stowaway migrants in Calais threatening Dutch truck drivers, and whether a European approach and insurance measures are in hand. The minister replied that the Calais security situation is the responsibility of the French authorities, that the government raises it in European and bilateral channels, and that it works with the transport sector, without committing to new concrete steps.
The security situation in Calais falls under the responsibility of the French authorities.
De veiligheidssituatie in Calais valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de Franse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Von Martels over opwaardering Maaslijn en realisatie station Grubbenvorst Greenport-Venlo

MPs Jetten and Von Martels asked why the Maaslijn upgrade faces a funding shortfall and whether station Grubbenvorst Greenport-Venlo can still be realised. The state secretary answers that the national government paid its contributions, that the shortfall stems from the province misreading VAT rules, that the state remains willing to provide a capped subsidy if the province applies, and that the project planning is the province's responsibility.
The decision whether or not to proceed with building station Grubbenvorst rests with the province of Limburg.
De afweging om al dan niet over te gaan tot aanleg van station Grubbenvorst is aan de provincie Limburg.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Jetten over het rapport van de Europese Commissie waarin stevige kritiek wordt geuit op de manier waarop de veiligheid van ons voedsel aan de Europese buitengrenzen (Schiphol e

Two MPs from D66 asked the ministers about an EU Commission audit criticising the document checks on food imports at Schiphol and Rotterdam, including scanned rather than original certificates. The government acknowledged the findings, defended the current approach for non-animal products, and said an impact analysis and concrete actions would follow.
I acknowledge the conclusions and the accompanying recommendations.
Ik erken de conclusies en de daarbij horende aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van Engelshoven en Jetten over de berichtgeving dat de nieuwe drugstest voor automobilisten mogelijk problematisch is voor mensen met ADHD medicatie

Three D66 MPs asked whether the new saliva drug test for drivers could wrongly flag people taking ADHD medication containing dexamfetamine, and whether this risks loss of driving licences and discourages necessary medication. The minister confirms the test detects amphetamine including dexamfetamine, says medicinal users rarely show signs prompting testing and can explain their medication to the prosecutor, and announces a broader exemption for medically supervised use of dexamfetamine, morphine and medicinal cannabis to be worked out with pharmacists and implementing bodies, with Parliament to be informed as soon as possible.
They will look at an exception to criminalisation for persons who use these substances on medical prescription and under medical supervision and take part in traffic.
Wij zullen daarbij kijken naar een uitzondering op de strafbaarstelling voor personen die op medisch voorschrift en onder medisch toezicht deze stoffen gebruiken en deelnemen aan het verkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Verhoeven over OV-chipkaartbedrijf Translink dat de reisgegevens van honderden studenten heeft doorgegeven aan de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs

MPs Jetten and Verhoeven asked how Translink could hand travel data of hundreds of students to DUO, on what legal basis, and whether travellers are notified. The government answered that DUO relied on general supervisory powers and data protection provisions, that the Hague court has since ruled these insufficient and transfers stopped, and it declined to address pending appeal questions while promising limited follow-up on privacy and information sharing.

The Hague District Court ruled in its judgment of 8 May that Articles 5:16 and 5:17 of the General Administrative Law Act do not in themselves provide a sufficiently specific legal basis for the data processing.

De rechtbank Den Haag heeft echter in haar uitspraak van 8 mei jl. geoordeeld dat de artikelen 5:16 en 5:17 van de Awb als zodanig geen voldoende specifieke wettelijke grondslag bieden voor de gegevensverwerking
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Van Eijs over de Redichemse Waard en de bredere problematiek van verondieping van Nederlandse (diepe) waterplassen

MPs Jetten and Van Eijs asked the government about the planned shallowing of the Redichemse Waard lake with contaminated sludge and soil, its recreational and ecological value, and the legal basis for dumping, including imported waste. The minister answered that shallowing is not automatically a useful application, that Rijkswaterstaat assesses the draft plan without approving it, and that existing rules and the Omgevingswet give limited scope for further protection.
Shallowing a deep lake is not by definition a useful and functional application.
Het verondiepen van een diepe plas is niet per definitie een nuttige en functionele toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Visser, Jetten en Bruins over de vluchtroutes naar Lelystad

Five MPs from CDA, VVD, D66 and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about the Lelystad airport flight routes, including the Alderstafel advisory process, consultation records, airspace safety and feasibility, environmental costs and the Helios second opinion. The state secretary answered most questions on substance, stating that no minutes or attendance lists were kept, that routes were designed within existing airspace structure, and that the Helios opinion would be sent before the committee meeting.
No minutes are made of the meetings of the Alderstafel Lelystad, nor is an attendance list kept.
Van de vergaderingen van de Alderstafel Lelystad worden geen verslagen gemaakt, noch een presentielijst bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over de aanhoudende berichten dat er paraffine aanspoelt op de Nederlandse stranden

An MP from D66 asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment, after repeated paraffin wash-ups on Dutch beaches, what action has been taken since parliamentary debates, why further discharges occurred, and about costs, enforcement, and international bans. The minister replies that discharges are currently legal under MARPOL, that the Netherlands is pushing for a global ban via the IMO with a decision expected in 2018, and that enforcement and cost recovery face practical difficulties.
An overview of the scale for environmentally hazardous chemicals in general is not available.
Een overzicht van de schaal voor milieugevaarlijke chemicaliën in algemene zin is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over het bericht ‘Overheid, doe iets tegen vertraging containerterminals’ en ‘Wereldwijde scheepvaart worstelt met stookolie’

The MP Jetten (D66) asks about container terminal congestion in Rotterdam harbour that delays inland shipping and about the failure of IMO talks to phase out heavy fuel oil in shipping, and whether the government will lead on climate ambitions. The minister acknowledges the congestion, lists measures under way and says the government supports the Arctic heavy fuel ban at the IMO and pursues 2020 sulphur limits, without committing to a new concrete step beyond ongoing consultation.
I have no insight into the business information of the companies involved.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de bedrijfsinformatie van de betrokken ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Laçin over oneerlijke mededinging in wegtransport

MPs Jetten and Laçin asked the minister about reports that the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport struggles to keep road transport firms compliant as they devise new manipulation methods, and whether the inspectorate has enough knowledge and capacity. The minister acknowledges increasingly sophisticated manipulation, says inspectors receive ongoing training and equipment and that the ILT works with manufacturers and European partners, but gives no figures on the total scale of the problem.
Since these are targeted inspections, the number of detected manipulation cases says nothing about its total scale.
Aangezien het om gerichte inspecties gaat, zegt het aantal ontdekte gevallen van manipulatie niets over de totale omvang ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Visser en Jetten over het vliegveld Teuge

MPs asked whether the province of Gelderland pushed for a new flight route over the Teuge airport, whether provinces were consulted and informed about the planned airspace connections for Lelystad Airport, and what alternatives exist. The state secretary denied that Gelderland pushed for a route over Teuge, said the provinces were involved and informed, that a consultation procedure starts in September, and that she is exploring with Teuge and the parachute centre how to limit the effects.
There is no question of the province of Gelderland having pushed for a flight route over Teuge.
Er is geen sprake van dat de provincie Gelderland op een vliegroute boven Teuge zou hebben aangestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over het bericht dat de boete voor NS en ProRail niet ten koste mag gaan van de reiziger

MP Jetten asked whether the fine on NS and ProRail for underperformance should avoid passing costs to passengers, and whether the IC-direct supplement should be scrapped while performance lags. The State Secretary agreed fines should not burden travellers, placed the fine money in a passengers' fund, and committed to temporarily abolishing the IC-direct supplement off-peak this autumn.
To meet travellers on the IC direct, I intend to temporarily abolish the supplement on the IC direct in off-peak hours on weekdays and at weekends this autumn.
Om de reizigers op de IC direct tegemoet te komen ben ik voornemens om de toeslag op de IC direct in de daluren op werkdagen en het weekend dit najaar tijdelijk af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Paternotte over het grote aantal gunningen van infrastructuurprojecten aan buitenlandse bouwers

MPs Jetten and Paternotte asked why foreign builders won a large share of major infrastructure contracts and how this fits the Marktvisie. The minister replied that most GWW contracts went to Dutch firms, that foreign partners add expertise and better price-quality, and that the government and market will jointly implement the Marktvisie.
The large majority of the contracts went to Dutch construction firms: 49 of the 53 GWW contracts in the study were awarded to (combinations of) companies with no foreign involvement.

Het overgrote deel van de opdrachten is naar Nederlandse bouwbedrijven gegaan: 49 van de 53 GWW opdrachten uit het onderzoek zijn gegund aan (combinaties van) bedrijven waar geen sprake is van buitenlandse inbreng.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Groothuizen en Bouali over het bericht dat verdachte schepen niet worden gecontroleerd

MPs Jetten, Groothuizen and Bouali (D66) asked whether ships that switched off their AIS signal or changed identification before entering Dutch waters are being properly checked, and what the consequences for security and enforcement are. The government answers that AIS gaps have many legitimate causes, that the Kustwacht and Douane use risk profiling and treat AIS switch-offs as a risk indicator, that the numbers from Winward cannot be confirmed, and that modernisation and EU cooperation are underway.
The Coast Guard does not have the investigation data on which Winward based its conclusions and therefore cannot confirm the numbers Winward cites.
De Kustwacht beschikt niet over de onderzoekgegevens waarop Winward haar conclusies heeft gebaseerd en kan derhalve de door Winward genoemde aantallen niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Van Helvert en Jetten over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen inzake de situatie op Schiphol

MPs Visser, Van Helvert and Jetten asked the state secretary about long queues at Schiphol airport, including slot allocation, KMar staffing, selectiveness policy and Lelystad. The government replied that Schiphol committed to fully staffing security lanes over summer, extra KMar capacity is planned, and most questions were answered with policy restatements and referrals to other bodies.
Soon I want to discuss in a follow-up meeting with Schiphol, KLM and BARIN which actions these parties can take to work towards a more structural solution in the medium term.
Binnenkort wil ik in een vervolggesprek met Schiphol, KLM en BARIN bespreken welke acties deze partijen kunnen nemen om op middellange termijn naar een meer structurele oplossing toe te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over 'duidelijkheid omtrent de bestemming van de Spiegelwaal in Nijmegen'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment for clarity on the rules governing the Spiegelwaal in Nijmegen, including whether a promised clarification before summer 2017 had materialised and whether a rescue brigade could be involved. The Minister answered that existing regulations apply, that the government, municipality and province are negotiating practical arrangements, and that agreement on a cooperation agreement and development plan is targeted for early July.
The aim is to approve these documents and the practical arrangements made in them at administrative level in early July.
Het streven is om deze documenten en de daarin gemaakte, praktische afspraken begin juli op bestuurlijk niveau te accorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Jetten over het boetebeleid voor onverzekerde auto’s die buiten gebruik zijn

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about stacking fines for uninsured cars that are no longer used and about the RDW's approach to uninsured vehicles. The minister defended the fines as a deterrent, pointed to preventive measures and a pilot, and said the progressive fine system, including moving enforcement to criminal law, is under review.
It is not recorded whether the vehicles fined for breaching Article 30(2) of the Wam are no longer on the road.
Er wordt niet bijgehouden of de voertuigen waarvoor een boete wordt opgelegd wegens overtreding van artikel 30, tweede lid van de Wam niet meer op de weg komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Ronnes, Omtzigt, Jetten en Van Weyenberg over het bericht in de Trouw van 4 mei 2017 “Staatsbedrijf NS ontwijkt fiscus weer”

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the government about reports that state-owned NS avoids Dutch tax via an Irish leasing subsidiary, including whether the 2015 agreements were honoured and how much tax is lost. The minister defended the arrangement as consistent with a 'level playing field' for foreign concessions, and refused to give tax figures citing secrecy rules and business confidentiality while promising phase-out of the Irish route on Dutch lines.

A more detailed specification of amounts I cannot give because under article 67 of the AWR I cannot make statements about the taxes of individual taxpayers, as business confidentiality precludes this.

Een nadere specificatie van bedragen kan ik niet geven omdat ik op grond van artikel 67 van de AWR geen uitspraken kan doen over de belastingen van individuele belastingplichtigen omdat bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid zich hiertegen verzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Jetten over de aanschaf van een Boeing 737 Business Jet als nieuw regeringsvliegtuig

Two D66 MPs asked why all four bids in the government aircraft tender were declared invalid, why negotiations went only with Boeing rather than retendering, the claimed 18 million euro price difference, Airbus's objection, and the King's role in choosing the aircraft. The minister answered that no bid met all criteria, that Airbus did not supply required documents, that the price gap is under 2 million euro once VAT is considered, that Airbus did not appeal, that the King had no role in the decision, and provided a timeline, while citing procurement-law limits on disclosing bid details.
The principles of procurement law limit me in making information about the bids public.
De beginselen van het aanbestedingsrecht beperken mij in het openbaar kunnen maken van informatie over de inschrijvingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Jetten over de aanschaf van een Boeing 737 Business Jet als nieuw regeringsvliegtuig

MPs Van Meenen and Jetten asked why four tenders for a new government aircraft were rejected, why negotiations went exclusively with Boeing, the role of the Royal House, total costs, pricing comparisons, future rules on scheduled flights, and related matters. The minister answered most questions substantively, explaining the procedure, costs (about 89 million euro net), and that the Royal House had no say in the procurement decisions, while declining to verify external price figures.
The Royal House had no say in decision-making on the design of the tender procedure, the assessment of bids, or the negotiations with Boeing.
Het Koninklijk Huis had geen zeggenschap in besluitvorming over de vormgeving van de aanbestedingsprocedure, de beoordeling van inschrijvingen alsmede de onderhandelingen met Boeing.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'RWE hoopt op geitenpaadje voor project met waterstof uit afval'

An MP asked whether RWE's FUREC project producing green hydrogen from household waste counts toward the RED-III binding green hydrogen target, how other EU states handle this, and what the government will do to support such projects and resolve grid connection delays. The minister answered that the project does not qualify as RFNBO because it uses partly biogenic waste rather than renewable electricity, that the government remains in contact with RWE and will keep supporting it, and that grid congestion is being addressed through prioritisation rules and the industry decarbonisation programme.
No. RED-III uses the term 'renewable fuel of non-biological origin' (abbreviated RFNBO in English) for green hydrogen.
Nee. In de RED-III wordt de term «hernieuwbare brandstof van niet-biologische oorsprong» (in het Engels afgekort tot RFNBO) gehanteerd voor groene waterstof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het onderzoek «De keuze voor warmtenetten of andere warmteoplossingen»

An MP asks the ministers how the government reacts to a Berenschot study finding district heating cheaper than heat pumps from a societal perspective, whether the cost-plus tariff method in the Wet collectieve warmte will raise consumer prices, how the WIS subsidy and tariff protection will help consumers and projects, and whether cost sharing and financing can be improved. The minister acknowledges the cost-distribution issue, expects cost-based tariffs to lower prices for roughly 45-64% of consumers with phased introduction and a possible tariff cap, and describes subsidy changes, a planned guarantee fund and forthcoming studies, mostly promising further letters and evaluations without firm commitments on the specific demands.
The cabinet is preparing a letter exploring complementary policy options (in addition to the Wcw) to safeguard the affordability of collective heat.
Het kabinet bereid een Kamerbrief voor waarin flankerende beleidsopties (in aanvulling op de Wcw) worden verkend om de betaalbaarheid van collectieve warmte te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht “Zonnepanelen minder lucratief maar leveren nog altijd 17 jaar gratis stroom”

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a 2024 report that solar panel owners face rising costs such as feed-in charges under ACM model contracts, and about the reasonableness of large fixed-fee increases. The minister answered that the ACM will review model contract terms, will examine whether feed-in charges may be introduced, and has found the examined tariffs of four suppliers reasonable, while confirming that further ACM scrutiny is planned.
However, on 15 August 2024 the ACM announced that it will revise the terms of the model contract, partly due to the adjustments required by the Energy Act bill.
Wel heeft de ACM op 15 augustus 2024 bekendgemaakt dat zij de voorwaarden van het modelcontract zal herzien, mede door de aanpassingen die benodigd zijn vanuit het wetsvoorstel Energiewet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Waakhond ACM zet als enige in Europa de industrie op achterstand'

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about the ACM's abolition of the volume correction scheme for grid tariffs, which benefited about 35 industrial firms, and whether this disadvantages electrification and creates an uneven playing field with Germany and Belgium. The Minister acknowledges the scheme's removal raised costs for those firms, says the ACM's cost-based analysis gave no basis for it, and commits to raising the harmonisation issue with ACER and the European Commission, while stating that tariff structure remains the ACM's exclusive competence.
I do not have information on the discount received per individual company.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de ontvangen korting per individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de kosten voor het transport van elektriciteit naar Duitsland

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the costs of deep landfall of offshore wind power and the Delta Rhine Corridor cables, including whether costs fall on Dutch consumers, and whether cost-sharing with Germany is being negotiated. The Minister answered that costs currently pass through network tariffs, that the DRC investment decision and cost allocation with Germany remain open, and that cost-sharing is being pursued through EU and North Seas Energy Cooperation channels.
I do not foresee that the decision-making process on the DRC will be jeopardised if no satisfactory agreements on cost allocation can be reached with Germany.
Ik voorzie niet dat het besluitvormingstraject over de DRC in gevaar komt als er geen bevredigende afspraken kunnen worden gemaakt over de verdeling van kosten met Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeer en Eerdmans over de zonne-atollen op het IJsselmeer

MPs Vermeer and Eerdmans asked the Minister about opposition to the floating solar 'zonne-atollen' plan on the IJsselmeer, including its Natura 2000 status, defence use, water storage and timing. The Minister answers that the plan is only being explored in an integrated study (Wieringerhoek), with a decision on a formal project procedure targeted for Q4 2024, and that participation will follow in any later procedure.
Only with a positive decision will there be a project procedure for which my department is responsible.
Pas bij een positief besluit zal er sprake zijn van een projectprocedure waarvoor mijn departement verantwoordelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat de nieuwe elektrische boiler bij de elektriciteitscentrale van Vattenfall in Diemen ongebruikt blijft vanwege de hoge netwerkkosten

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister about reports that Vattenfall's new electric boiler at Diemen stays unused because of high grid costs, including the cost increase, savings potential, and possible support schemes. Minister Hermans answered substantively on all nine questions, acknowledging the rent-driven cost rise and outlining SDE++ options, new grid contracts and an ongoing policy review.
I am currently exploring the possibilities for a category in the SDE++ that would only compensate the operational costs of an e-boiler.
Ik verken momenteel de mogelijkheden voor een categorie in de SDE++ waarin alleen de operationele kosten van een e-boiler worden vergoed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens het artikel 'Ingrijpen in energiemarkt noodzakelijk om stroomtekort te voorkomen'

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister for Climate and Energy how the government will safeguard electricity supply adequacy in the energy transition, including whether capacity mechanisms like those in the UK or Belgium should be introduced. The Minister answers that no supply risks are expected until 2030, that a 2033 shortfall prompts an implementation plan, and that options including a capacity mechanism are being inventoried, with a letter to the Chamber promised at the end of 2024.
In line with my predecessor's commitment, I will inform the Chamber further about this at the end of 2024.
Conform de toezegging van mijn ambtsvoorganger zal ik de Kamer hierover eind 2024 nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over “de verdubbeling van Europese subsidies voor vleesreclames”

An MP asked the government whether it accepts that EU subsidies for meat and dairy advertising, which doubled for 'eat more meat' campaigns, conflict with climate goals and the cabinet's protein-transition plans, and whether it will speak out against such subsidies in Europe. The minister answered that the cabinet favours abolishing EU promotion policy for regular agricultural products, supports the Wassenberg/Van Raan motion excluding meat promotion, and will speak out when the opportunity arises.
As long as the EU promotion policy exists, however, the cabinet is of the view that this policy must be fully aligned with other EU policy
Zolang het EU-Promotiebeleid echter bestaat, is het kabinet van mening dat dit beleid volledig in lijn moet zijn met ander EU-beleid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Thijssen en Kröger over de toename van fossiele financieringen door banken

MPs Van der Lee, Thijssen and Kröger asked whether banks' rising fossil financing conflicts with Paris goals, how the climate commitment measures CO2 (relative versus absolute), and why finance does not invest more in Dutch sustainability. The government answered that the IEA sees no room for new oil and gas fields, that the climate commitment guidance will be revised to include absolute and sectoral targets, and that a review of further measures is underway, though it could not answer all questions in time.
The revised version of the guidance will be published after the summer.
De herziene versie van de leidraad wordt na de zomer gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Vermeer over Huisarts waarschuwt voor negatieve gezondheidsgevolgen van windturbines

MPs Van der Plas and Vermeer asked the ministers about a GP's warning on health effects of wind turbines, including whether noise limits and distance norms adequately protect residents. Minister Dijkstra answered that RIVM monitors the evidence, that sleep and hinder effects are documented but other health effects lack sufficient evidence, and that new environmental rules are being prepared through a plan-MER with a decision expected after summer 2024.
As long as the process is still ongoing, I cannot anticipate the outcomes.
Zolang het traject nog loopt, kan ik niet op de uitkomsten vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Zonnepanelen minder lucratief, ‘maar leveren nog altijd 17 jaar gratis stroom’’

An MP asked the energy minister about energy suppliers charging solar owners for feeding electricity back to the grid, and about consumer information, batteries and tenants of housing corporations. The minister answered that the costs are cost-based and not prohibited, that the ACM found tariffs not unreasonable, that the matter is for the regulator and suppliers, and that the terugleverkosten effects on tenants will be studied.
It is up to the ACM as an independent regulator to take steps if it considers this necessary.
Het is aan de ACM als onafhankelijk toezichthouder om stappen te ondernemen indien zij dit noodzakelijk acht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Bushoff over gasboring in de Waddenzee

Two MPs from GroenLinks/PvdA asked the government why it cannot refuse the NAM's gas production drilling at Ternaard under the Waddenzee, citing the NAM's track record, the Mijnbouwwet grounds for refusal and withdrawal, and the UNESCO World Heritage status. The state secretary answered that existing permits cannot be refused under article 9, that withdrawal under article 21 is limited by property protection under ECHR Protocol 1, that article 36 grounds are limited, and that a decision on the winningsplan is still pending after new subsidence advice.
Withdrawing a production permit can, however, only take place if the requirements of Article 1 of the First Protocol of the European Convention on Human Rights are met.
Intrekken van een winningsvergunning kan echter alleen als is voldaan aan artikel 1 van het Eerste Protocol van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht Energieleveranciers misleiden klanten met CO2-gecompenseerd gas

MP Kröger asked the minister whether energy suppliers mislead customers with 'CO2-compensated gas' claims, whether a ban is needed, and what the ACM and EU do to regulate voluntary carbon markets. The minister answered that EU rules from 2026 will ban such claims, that the ACM already enforces against misleading claims, and that the Netherlands is pushing for better regulation of the voluntary carbon market.

This legislation, which takes effect in mid-2026, prohibits companies from claiming that a product or service has a neutral, reduced or positive environmental effect thanks to compensating greenhouse gas emissions through carbon certificates.

Deze wetgeving, die medio 2026 ingaat, verbiedt bedrijven onder meer te beweren dat een product of dienst dankzij de compensatie van broeikasgasemissies via koolstofcertificaten een neutraal, verminderd of positief milieueffect heeft.
Antwoord opvragen van het lid Beckerman over bericht dat energieleveranciers klanten misleiden met ‘CO2-gecompenseerd gas’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether reports that energy suppliers mislead customers with CO2-compensated gas are accurate, whether compensation projects underdeliver, whether cheap or non-additional projects and vague terms should be banned, and whether CO2 certificates work at all. The Minister answered that the ACM enforces against misleading claims, that a new EU directive from mid-2026 will prohibit neutrality claims based on offsetting, and that a ban on purchasing offsets from projects outside the EU is not planned for now.
It is not for me as Minister to comment on a specific case that was before the Advertising Code Committee.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om op een specifieke zaak die voorlag bij de Reclame Code Commissie in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Energieleveranciers misleiden klanten met CO2 gecompenseerd gas'

An MP asked the minister about reports that energy suppliers sold CO2-compensated gas whose offset projects underperformed or delivered no compensation, and how consumers can be protected and the offsets verified. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to upcoming EU rules banning compensation claims from 2026, ACM guidance and voluntary market recommendations, and referred to earlier answers for validation.
That it does not deliver the promised CO2 reduction or removal does not mean that supporting climate projects has no positive effects at all.
Dat het niet de beloofde CO 2 -reductie of verwijdering oplevert betekent niet dat het steunen van klimaatprojecten helemaal geen positieve effecten heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Erkens over het vinden van een balans tussen drinkwater en geothermie in Limburg

MPs Grinwis and Erkens asked how their amendment protecting drinking water reserves in Limburg would be applied to geothermal drilling, including interpretation, EBN's plans, permitting speed, and double casing standards. The State Secretary answered that the amendment's scope depends on whether 'designated or reserved' covers only water-catchment areas or also supplementary protection zones, that a legal opinion is pending, and that double casing is already legally required for geothermal wells.
The advice is expected this summer and I will share it with your House.
Het advies wordt deze zomer verwacht en zal ik met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach, Vedder, Postma, Grinwis en Pierik over de visserij en ETS-2

Five MPs asked whether fisheries should be brought under the EU ETS-2 carbon market and what the consequences would be for the sector. The minister answers that the cabinet has decided not to opt fisheries in, citing lack of a viable path for the sector, EU state-aid limits and unequal competition, and that a WECR impact study will be sent to Parliament.
The cabinet has now decided not to bring fisheries under ETS2 through the opt-in.
Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten om visserij niet onder het ETS2 te brengen middels de opt-in
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het steeds verder naar voren schuiven van de Nederlandse Overshoot Day

An MP asked why the Dutch Earth Overshoot Day has moved earlier each year, now to 1 April, and what the government will do to reduce the Dutch ecological footprint and curb consumption. The minister acknowledges the trend, attributes it partly to rising imports and biomaterial land use, and points to existing targets, the forthcoming biodiversity action plan, food and circular economy policies, and the upcoming Climate Plan.
Our society faces the task of substantially reducing that footprint.
Onze samenleving staat voor de opgave om die voetafdruk substantieel terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht ‘Utrecht wil niet meer samenwerken met Eneco en eigen warmtebedrijf oprichten’

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the City of Utrecht abandoning its heat network partnership with Eneco and setting up its own heat company, including effects on support, investment and household energy bills. The minister acknowledged the collapse, attributed it to rising costs and limited transparency in the business case, and pointed to forthcoming legislation (Wcw), a possible national shareholding and a guarantee fund, while noting the Utrecht case has stalled so the bill question is moot.
It is my intention to send the Wcw to your House in the short term, which will also provide clarity to municipalities and heat companies.
Het is mijn voornemen om op korte termijn de Wcw naar uw Kamer te zenden, waarmee ook duidelijkheid gegeven wordt aan gemeenten en warmtebedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de rol van EBN in het stimuleren van nieuwe fossiele projecten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about EBN's role in promoting new fossil projects, including gas extraction in the North Sea, its consistency with climate advice, the lack of a phase-out plan, and the 2040 extraction horizon. The minister answers that gas will remain needed for some time, that domestic production is preferable to imports, that an extraction phase-out path is being monitored with a 2045 end date, and that a larger EBN role in exploration is only being explored, with a Mining Act change required.
In weighing extraction and imports against saving gas, the policy is therefore to maximise savings.
In de afweging tussen het winnen en importeren versus besparen van gas, wordt dus ingezet op een zo groot mogelijk aandeel besparen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk  over het artikel 'Netbeheerders kunnen weinig met prioriteit voor Brainport'

CDA MPs asked whether the minister knew of reports that grid operators could do little with the government's promised priority for the Brainport region, why the November 2023 letter seemed to surprise them, and what the grid response would be. The minister answered that the priority concerns congestion instruments and the regional energy infrastructure plan (MIEK), not individual connection priority which is set by the regulator ACM, and described short-, medium- and long-term actions with TenneT, Enexis and the region.
The priority status of Brainport is not intended to mean that connecting individual companies on the waiting list in the region would automatically get higher priority than in other regions.

Met de prioritaire status van Brainport is niet bedoeld dat het aansluiten van individuele bedrijven die op de wachtlijst staan in de regio per definitie een hogere prioriteit zou krijgen dan in andere regio's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de inzet van weerbeïnvloedingstechnieken / geo-engineering

An FVD MP asked the climate minister about geoengineering and weather modification, including WEF ambitions, international regulation, monitoring, and private-sector and research projects. The minister answered that the Netherlands applies no such techniques, opposes SRM deployment, works toward international governance, and is not involved in the cited projects.
The Netherlands does not apply techniques to influence precipitation patterns.
Nederland past geen technieken toe om het neerslagpatroon te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Hermans en Erkens over de vergunningverlening bij DOW naar aanleiding van het artikel 'Hoe een groen megaproject muurvast zit door ruzie Dow en overheid’

MPs Erkens, Hermans and Thijssen asked ministers about stalled permitting for Dow Chemical's planned hydrogen-based decarbonisation investment, reportedly blocked by nitrogen emission limits and conflict with government. The minister answered that talks continue, that initial plans exceeded the 80 mg/Nm3 nitrogen limit, that Dow is preparing revised plans, and that a permitting solution will be sought before further updates to parliament.
I will inform your House further about progress via the progress report on the tailor-made approach.
Ik zal uw Kamer nader informeren over de voortgang via de voortgangsrapportage maatwerkaanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het opschalen en toepassen van waterstof in de industrie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about hydrogen use in steel (TSN IJmuiden, Thyssenkrupp Duisburg), the FUREC project at Chemelot, grid congestion and offtake. The minister answered that negotiations with TSN are starting, gave a technical view of Thyssenkrupp's plans without judging their feasibility, and said the ministry is in talks with RWE and OCI but that offtake and grid prioritisation are largely for companies and network operators.
I can well understand this response from RWE.
Ik kan me deze reactie van RWE goed voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van Campen over de productie van groengas via monomestvergisting

Two VVD MPs asked the minister why small monomanure digestion projects already granted SDE++ subsidies at the old lower rate cannot switch to a new higher-rate category, and whether this undermines viable business cases. The minister confirmed that switching is not possible once a subsidy decision is granted, that the rate increase was communicated in advance, and that projects which did not proceed can reapply in 2024.
It is undesirable, and therefore not possible, to submit a new SDE application in a subsequent year after receiving an SDE++ decision merely because tariffs have risen in that year.

Het is niet wenselijk, en daarom niet mogelijk, om nadat men een SDE++ beschikking heeft gekregen opnieuw in een daaropvolgend jaar een SDE-aanvraag in te dienen, enkel omdat in dat jaar de tarieven gestegen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het artikel waarin vermeld staat dat een Frans bedrijf honderden laadpalen wil aanleggen in Nederland
