An MP asks whether the grid can absorb a new French charging-point operator given existing grid congestion, its effect on waiting lists and competition, and the risk of French consolidation and data access. The State Secretary answers that new entrants are desirable, that outcomes are unknown, that municipalities keep control through tenders, and that GDPR applies.
It is not known where Electra wants to place charging points, so no assessment of this threat can be made.
Het is niet bekend waar Electra laadpalen wil plaatsen, dus kan geen inschatting van deze dreiging worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de berichten 'Costs overruns and delays risk nuclear’s place in energy transition' en 'Komt er nu wel een Borssele 2?’

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about cost overruns at Hinkley Point C and Vogtle, their implications for the planned Dutch nuclear plants, the feasibility of two additional plants, land needs, waste storage capacity and the CO2 footprint of nuclear power. The minister explained the causes of overruns and mitigation measures, said the site and cost questions depend on pending studies, and said the cost per MWh and land use cannot yet be determined.

I am aware of the significant cost overruns in the construction of nuclear power plants in other countries and attach great importance to a good understanding of the causes and implications for the new build project in the Netherlands.

Ik ben mij bewust van de significante kostenoverschrijdingen bij de bouw van kerncentrales in andere landen en hecht groot belang aan een goed begrip van de oorzaken en de implicaties voor het nieuwbouwproject in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het afzwakken van de klimaatdoelen door Shell

MP Kröger asked the minister about Shell weakening its carbon intensity target for 2030, falling renewables investment share, non-implementation of the court ruling on emissions, and government contacts with Shell. The minister confirmed awareness, said renewables investment rose, declined to comment on the pending appeal, and stated the government discusses climate goals with Shell and holds it to the Expression of Principles.
Hearings on the appeal take place in April. I refrain from commenting as long as the ruling is pending before the court.
In april vinden zittingen plaats over het hoger beroep. Ik onthoud mij van een reactie zolang de uitspraak onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Geen plaats op transportnet voor nieuwe kerncentrales’

An MP asked why two new nuclear plants are absent from TenneT's grid investment plans and how grid connection delays will be avoided. The minister said a further study will inform an integrated decision in Q2 2025, with no delay to plant realisation expected.
I am currently having a follow-up study carried out so that I can take an integrated decision on the integration of two new nuclear power plants in the second quarter of 2025.
Ik laat momenteel een vervolgonderzoek uitvoeren, zodat ik in het tweede kwartaal van 2025 een integraal besluit kan nemen over de inpassing van twee nieuwe kerncentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Veltman over het bericht 'Een derde van Gronings dorpje bezoekt dokter vanwege klachten windturbines'

MPs Erkens and Veltman asked about wind turbine distance and noise norms after a report that a third of a Groningen village visited a doctor over turbine complaints, including the status of the draft decree, the motion on a four-times-tip-height distance norm, and whether projects should be paused. The ministers answered that national norms are in draft with planned entry into force on 1 July 2025, that municipalities may set local norms via environmental assessment, and that no pause is warranted as the Nivel study shows no clear health risks.
To prevent delay, I aim to submit the draft decree to your House as soon as possible, expectedly after the summer.
Om vertraging te voorkomen probeer ik zo spoedig mogelijk, naar verwachting na de zomer, het ontwerpbesluit bij uw Kamer voor te hangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over de voortgang van de Delta Rhine Corridor

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked about the progress, investment timing, realisation deadline, the absence of an LPG/propylene pipeline initiator, and next steps with Germany on the Delta Rhine Corridor. The minister answered that the government supports and coordinates spatial planning and permits while investment decisions rest with private initiators, that no LPG/propylene initiator emerged, and that a letter on schedule effects will follow before summer.
I will inform the House before the summer of this year with a letter on the effect of this exercise on the project's planning.
Ik informeer uw Kamer voor de zomer van dit jaar met een brief over het effect van deze exercitie op de planning van het project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Nationale ombudsman vindt aanvraagprocedure Noodfonds Energie oneerlijk'

An SP MP asked the ministers about the National Ombudsman's criticism that the digital application procedure for the Temporary Energy Emergency Fund was unfair, excluding people without DigiD, guardianship cases and those with block connections. The minister defended the fund's targeting and accessibility support, said the fund is now closed, and offered no new fund or rule changes beyond promises to consult energy suppliers on future support.
The Emergency Fund is a private initiative that, within the limits of implementation possibilities and budget, reached as large a share of this target group as possible.
Daarnaast is het Noodfonds een privaat initiatief dat binnen de kaders van de uitvoeringsmogelijkheden en het uitvoeringsbudget een zo groot mogelijk aandeel van deze doelgroep heeft bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht dat Shell honderden miljoenen heeft verdiend aan het ETS-systeem

Teunissen (PvdD) asked whether Shell's large profits from surplus free EU ETS allowances, and the speculation in emission rights, undermine the polluter-pays principle and should be curbed. The minister agreed free allocation is undesirable in principle but defended ETS trading, rejected retroactive repricing of allowances and a statutory emissions duty, and pointed to the tightened Fit-for-55 rules.
I agree that it is undesirable for companies to earn money from an emissions trading system to the extent that this results from too many freely allocated emission allowances.
Ik ben het eens dat het onwenselijk is als bedrijven geld verdienen aan een emissiehandelssysteem voor zo ver dat het gevolg is van te veel gratis toegewezen emissierechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over congestiemanagement op het elektriciteitsnet

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about grid congestion management, including whether network operators can refuse bids for congestion services and how standard terms and prices should be set. The minister answered that network operators may refuse bids only when the requested fee exceeds what is customary in the market, that a standard price formula agreed with Energie Samen and Holland Solar was approved by the ACM, and that a government information webpage is planned.
It is up to the network operator to justify a refusal.
Het is aan de netbeheerder om een weigering te onderbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over Integratie van de Europese elektriciteitsmarkten

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a Bruegel article on deeper integration of EU electricity markets, covering its benefits, the risk of fragmentation, strategic autonomy, the need for a clear vision, and the costs of not integrating. The Minister broadly endorses the article's conclusions, stresses that integration is also a political question, states the cabinet's consistent support for integration, and declines to commission new cost-benefit studies, citing existing EU research.

Given the large number of studies on the returns and positive welfare effects of further market integration, the cabinet sees no reason to further map out the implications of further market integration.

Gezien de grote hoeveelheid studies over de opbrengsten en positieve welvaartseffecten van verdere marktintegratie ziet het kabinet geen reden om de implicaties van verdere marktintegratie nader in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over Borselse Voorwaarden

An MP asked about Borsele municipal conditions for new nuclear plants, including a 2050 final repository and zoning of salt caverns, and the timing of the 2130 repository policy. The state secretary answered that the conditions will be negotiated with the province and municipality without guarantees, that the 2130 policy remains, and that the NPRA update with an environmental assessment and public participation will follow later.
Current policy on radioactive waste concerns putting a geological final repository into operation in 2130.
Het huidige beleid ten aanzien van radioactief afval ziet op het in bedrijf nemen van een geologische eindberging in 2130.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse regering een pauze heeft afgekondigd van de uitbouw van verdere LNG-fabrieken

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the Dutch government would pause expansion of LNG infrastructure after the US paused new LNG export approvals, citing methane leakage and health impacts, and asked for further environmental and health studies. The minister answered that the existing environmental assessment procedures are sufficient, no pause is needed because Dutch LNG is import-only, and continued LNG import capacity is necessary for security of gas supply, with reuse of terminals for sustainable carriers planned.
I therefore do not consider additional research necessary.
Ik acht aanvullend onderzoek daarom niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) de hoogte van terugleverkosten bij zonnepanelen onderzoekt

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the ACM investigating feed-in charges for households with solar panels, whether suppliers may charge them, how many do, and what consumers can do. The minister answered that such charges are not banned but must be reasonable and transparent, that the ACM is monitoring them with a follow-up study due in April, and that consumers are protected by 30-day notice, free switching and a model contract without feed-in charges.
The ACM will supervise this as an independent regulator.
De ACM zal hier als onafhankelijk toezichthouder op toezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht “GTS adviseert over gasleveringszekerheid 2024-2025: krapte op de gasmarkt houdt aan”

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how the government will address the projected 2024 gas capacity shortfall flagged by Gasunie Transport Services, including demand-side measures, storage refilling, LNG capacity, innovation, and EU cooperation. The minister replied that the risk is small but serious, pointed to ongoing supply-security measures, storage refilling rules via a forthcoming bill, existing and planned LNG expansions, and EU coordination.

Furthermore, the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate will inform the House in a separate letter about the analysis of which additional measures are necessary and possible to mitigate this remaining risk of a capacity or volume shortage.

Daarnaast wordt uw Kamer per separate brief door de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en Klimaat geïnformeerd over de analyse die is gedaan welke aanvullende maatregelen nodig en mogelijk zijn om dit resterende risico op een capaciteits- of volumetekort te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het verstrekken van een toegangspas voor COP28 aan GasLog

An MP asks why GasLog, an LNG shipping company, received a COP28 access pass through the Dutch government, and questions whether LNG is compatible with the energy transition and whether passes should be withheld from fossil fuel companies. The minister explains the pass was tied to a liquid hydrogen project with Oman and Port of Amsterdam, acknowledges LNG is not clean but temporarily necessary, and says passes may go to companies that demonstrably contribute to the transition.
Companies that demonstrably contribute to this, for or on behalf of the Netherlands during a COP, may be eligible for an access pass through the Dutch government.
Bedrijven die daar voor of namens Nederland tijdens een COP aantoonbaar een bijdrage aan leveren kunnen in aanmerking komen voor een toegangspas via de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht “Gerenoveerd zorgcentrum Kerkrade kan niet open vanwege overvol stroomnet: ‘Dit kan nog wel vijf jaar duren’ ”

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a renovated care centre in Kerkrade that cannot open due to grid congestion, and whether a five-year wait is acceptable. The minister confirmed the connection upgrade is queued until 2030 and outlined grid investments, flexible contracts, and the ACM's draft prioritisation framework, while withholding details of queued parties for commercial confidentiality.
Due to (commercial) confidentiality, I have no insight into which parties are in the queue.
Vanwege (bedrijfs)vertrouwelijkheid heb ik geen zicht op welke partijen in de wachtrij staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over zonneparken die in financiële problemen komen door het uitblijven van een voorschot van de Stimulering Duurzame Energieproductie (SDE) subsidie

An MP asked the minister about solar parks facing liquidity problems because SDE subsidy advances are low or absent, due to a price-based calculation that includes the 2022 price peak, and asked for remedies and faster final settlement. The minister answered that the advance method is long-established and predictable, that projects and financiers bear responsibility for bridging the gap, that faster settlement is limited, and that RVO can offer case-by-case set-off but not tailored subsidy.
I am therefore reluctant to change the advance methodology of the SDE++.
Ik ben daarom terughoudend bij het aanpassen van de methodiek van de bevoorschotting in de SDE++.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de komst van ‘de hoogste windmolens ooit op land’ en het Ontwerpbesluit windturbines leefomgeving

An MP from the PVV asks the minister about the planned seven-turbine wind park along the A15 in Gelderland, the provincial decision overriding municipal and resident objections, the advisory council's limited role, and the draft national 2x tip-height distance norm and its derogation clause. The minister defends the province's process, says the distance norm is supplemented by other noise norms and derogation only exceptionally, and says health research is ongoing.
It is up to the competent authority to make a careful weighing here, paying attention to various interests and to the effects on the living environment and health.
Het is aan het bevoegd gezag om hierin een zorgvuldige afweging te maken met aandacht voor diverse belangen, en met oog voor de effecten op de leefomgeving en gezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over “RWE hoopt op geitenpaadje voor project met waterstof uit afval”

An MP asks the ministers how they will press grid operators Enexis and TenneT to keep the FUREC hydrogen-from-waste project on its 2026 connection schedule, and whether delay risks losing EU Innovation Fund money. The ministers say they have no direct role in grid connection priorities, point to the pending ACM prioritisation framework, and say RWE has not yet taken a final investment decision.
However, I have no role in the prioritisation of customer requests with grid operators.
Bij de prioritering van klantaanvragen bij netbeheerders heb ik echter geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Bontenbal en Grinwis over het bericht ‘Zinkfabriek Nyrstar in Budel legt productie stil’

MPs Erkens, Bontenbal and Grinwis asked how the government views the shutdown of the Nyrstar zinc plant in Budel over high energy costs, lack of state aid and the investment climate, and whether this reflects a wider industrial trend, the effect of the tax changes and the ending of the IKC and volume compensation schemes, the link to grid congestion and balancing, and how the government will address negative sentiment around industry. The minister acknowledges the high energy costs and competitive disadvantage relative to neighbours, defends the Dutch climate-led industrial policy ('greener here than grey elsewhere'), explains the reasons for ending the IKC and the ACM's abolition of the VCR, and promises further studies on electricity costs and a report to parliament, but gives limited concrete answers on grid congestion and some questions are answered by reference to policy stance.
I expect that the cabinet will inform the House later this quarter about the findings.
Ik verwacht dat het kabinet de Kamer later dit kwartaal zal inlichten over de bevindingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans  over het bericht ‘Productiestop Nyrstar wakkert zorgen elektriciteitintensieve industrie aan’

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about reports that Nyrstar's production halt and rising grid tariffs threaten energy-intensive industry, and whether the government will address the uneven playing field, sector outlook, bankruptcies and support. The minister acknowledged the concerns, attributed the tariff increases to the abolition of the volume correction scheme and rising TenneT costs, and said a deeper study of electricity costs and EU level-playing-field measures are underway, without committing to new concrete support.
In addition, I am having an in-depth study carried out into the differences in effective electricity costs for industrial users in the Netherlands, Germany, France and Belgium.
Daarnaast laat ik een verdiepend onderzoek uitvoeren naar de verschillen in effectieve elektriciteitskosten voor industriële gebruikers in Nederland, Duitsland, Frankrijk en België.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de wachtlijst voor aanvragen voor transportcapaciteit op het elektriciteitsnet

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the waiting list for grid transport capacity, including whether the roughly 6,000 applicants reported in 2023 had grown, how long applicants wait, and whether parties willing to offer congestion management are wrongly placed on the list. The minister answered that about 9,400 applications are queued, that the list is likely inflated by duplicates, that waiting times depend on local grid expansion and flexible capacity, and that standardised congestion-service contracts and a shared dashboard are being developed with grid operators and the ACM.
I am examining, in consultation with grid operators and the ACM, the options for cleaning up the queue.
Ik bezie in overleg met netbeheerders en ACM de mogelijkheden om de wachtrij op te schonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Gefrustreerde ondernemers stoppen miljoenenproject voor delen van energie: 'Netbeheerder blokkeert voortgang''

An MP asked the minister why an energy-sharing hub project in Flevoland, Gelderland and Utrecht stalled after TenneT said grid capacity was insufficient, despite earlier approvals, and what this means for similar projects and housing. The minister explained that grid congestion outside traditional peaks limits capacity, that TenneT is continuing analyses, and that the government is working with grid operators on pilots and additional measures.
I have asked TenneT for a further analysis of the causes and possible measures, so that as quickly as possible we can see what is still possible and what is needed for that.
Ik heb TenneT verzocht om een nadere analyse van de oorzaken en mogelijke maatregelen, om zo snel mogelijk in beeld te krijgen wat er nog wel kan en wat daarvoor nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht dat netbeheerders een obstakel vormen voor ondernemers die energie willen delen

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy why grid operators' unclear capacity information led entrepreneurs to halt an energy-sharing hub project, and what the government will do about it. The Minister says TenneT found limited grid room in Utrecht, promises clearer capacity information and more talks with grid operators, but gives no binding deadline beyond an expected update in Q2 2024.
I have asked TenneT to provide clarity as quickly as possible on what capacity remains in these regions, and elsewhere.
Ik heb TenneT gevraagd zo snel mogelijk duidelijkheid te geven over welke ruimte er in deze regio's, maar ook elders, nog is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over Netcongestie

MP Vermeer asked the Minister about Professor Vittal's warnings on grid stability, whether renewable integration should be halted, and whether the National Energy System Plan should be updated. The Minister replied that grid operators already use the relevant science, that no halt or plan revision is planned, and that smart charging rules are being developed with consent of those affected.
At this moment I see no reason to update the NPE.
Op dit moment zie ik geen reden om het NPE bij te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de beschikbaarheid van natuurlijk voorkomend waterstof

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether natural hydrogen could exist in the Dutch subsurface, whether research has been done, and whether the Netherlands should explore and partner abroad. The minister answered that the chance is small but not excluded, that no Dutch study has yet been done, and that TNO has started an inventory and is looking at Dutch coal layers and the Caribbean.
TNO has recently started an inventory into the potential presence of hydrogen in the Dutch subsurface.
TNO is recent een inventarisatie gestart naar de potentiële aanwezigheid van waterstof in de Nederlandse ondergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Hoe kon het zo misgaan voor de veelgeprezen Amsterdamse Fixbrigade?‘

An MP asked the Interior and Climate ministers why Amsterdam awarded a 5,050-home insulation tender to Energiebox rather than the locally praised FIXbrigade, and about criteria, impact on tenants, and support for public fix teams. The minister answered that the municipality runs the tender and the national government lacks insight into bids, points to the municipality's criteria and its willingness to help FIXbrigade, and says the state funds municipalities with discretion without setting detailed requirements.
We therefore have no insight into the submitted documents and the assessment, beyond what the municipality of Amsterdam publicly reports about it.
Wij hebben daarmee geen inzicht in de ingediende stukken en de beoordeling, buiten wat de gemeente Amsterdam daar publiekelijk over rapporteert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de antwoorden op eerdere schriftelijke vragen over fossiele subsidiesen de beprijzing van CO2-uitstoot

The MP asks the government to justify fossil fuel subsidies to major polluters, the choice of EUR 130/ton CO2 as a damage-cost reference versus German figures, and progress on phase-out paths. The minister defends the preventive-cost approach, lists recent carbon pricing measures, and says phase-out scenarios will be delivered around February 2024.
The cabinet has asked the independent chair of the Building Blocks report for a better and simpler tax system to develop the requested phase-out scenarios for fossil subsidies.

Het kabinet heeft aan de onafhankelijk voorzitter van het ambtelijk rapport Bouwstenen voor een beter en eenvoudiger belastingstelsel verzocht om de gevraagde afbouwscenario's voor «fossiele subsidies» uit te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht dat tien Nederlandse bedrijven bijna 9 miljard euro aan fossiele subsidies krijgen

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the minister whether it is fair that ten large fossil-fuel companies receive nearly 9 billion euros in subsidies while household energy bills rise, and what is being done to make climate policy fairer and to phase out fossil subsidies in company agreements. The minister responded that the government favours carbon pricing and regulation, lists recent tax measures and EU emissions-trading changes, says the phase-out scenarios are being prepared by an independent chair, and confirms the energy tax gap between gas and electricity is being narrowed.
The cabinet has asked the independent chair of the official report Building Blocks for a Better and Simpler Tax System to work out the requested phase-out scenarios for fossil subsidies.

Het kabinet heeft aan de onafhankelijk voorzitter van het ambtelijk rapport Bouwstenen voor een beter en eenvoudiger belastingstelsel verzocht om de gevraagde afbouwscenario's voor «fossiele subsidies» uit te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over onverklaarbare hoge kosten bij blokverwarming

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about unexplained high heating bills in block heating caused by heat cost allocators, asking who is responsible for checking them, how tenants can obtain redress, and how transparency and tariffs are ensured. The minister says he is shocked, will consult stakeholders, explains the legal framework, complaint routes via the ACM and the rent commission, and that tariff regulation will be adjusted with the new Wcw law, though housing associations and owners' associations are largely excluded from tariff rules.

I will engage with representatives of owners' associations, the Woonbond, landlords, the heat sector and the Dutch association for consumption-based energy billing (NLVVE) to discuss these situations and examine whether policy can be improved.

Ik ga in gesprek met vertegenwoordigers van VvE's, Woonbond, verhuurders, de warmtebranche en de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Verbruiksafhankelijke Energieafrekening (NLVVE) om deze situaties te bespreken en te onderzoeken of het beleid kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht 'Den Haag pauzeert plannen warmtenetten; ‘niet financierbaar en onacceptabele risico’s’'

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the pausing of district heating plans in The Hague and the financial risks of the planned public-majority requirement for heat companies under the new heat law. The minister defended the public-majority choice as strengthening public steering, outlined transitional arrangements and subsidies, and said public investment costs and possible funding instruments are still being studied.

For this reason, the cabinet is working in the Wcw, and in connection with it the Wgiw, on instruments for municipalities to steer the cost-effective development of collective heat and mitigate risks.

Om die reden werkt het kabinet in de Wcw en, in samenhang daarmee, met de Wgiw aan instrumenten voor gemeenten om de regie te voeren op de kosteneffectieve aanleg van collectieve warmte en om risico’s te mitigeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over “het bericht dat het verbranden van hout niet is uitgesloten van de doelstelling voorhernieuwbare energie op de klimaattop in Dubai en dat Nederlandsekolencentrales een vergu

Teunissen (PvdD) asks whether wood burning counts toward the COP28 renewable energy tripling goal, whether the Netherlands should exclude it, and whether coal plants converting to wood pellet BECCS should get permits or subsidies. Minister Jetten answers that biomass counts toward the goal, that the government is critical of bioenergy and ends subsidies for electricity use, but that BECCS is a useful negative-emissions option whose permits lie with municipality and province and whose national incentive design is still being worked out.
Any permits that may be requested will have to be assessed and granted or refused by the competent authority concerned, which is not me but the municipality and province.
De eventueel aan te vragen vergunningen zullen door het desbetreffende bevoegd gezag moeten worden beoordeeld en al dan niet afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het artikel "'Per direct' geen stroomaansluitingen mogelijk voor nieuwbouwwoningen Almere, gemeente is geschokt"

MP Beckerman asked the ministers about reports that grid operators would stop new electricity connections in parts of Almere, and about the grid measures, communication and waiting list involved. The minister answered that small-consumer connections remain possible until 2026, that grid congestion is being addressed through the national programme with new measures and local pilots, and that a waiting list of about 210 businesses in Flevoland exists and is being worked on.
To begin with, power connections for new housing remain possible for the municipality of Almere.
Om te beginnen blijven stroomaansluitingen voor nieuwbouwwoningen mogelijk voor de gemeente Almere.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de innovaties van batterijtechnieken

An MP asked the Economic Affairs and Climate and Energy ministers about battery technology, grid congestion, investment incentives, lithium supply and alternative battery chemistries such as sodium-ion. The minister answered that TenneT will propose a tariff change that could make 2 to 5 GW of batteries profitable by 2030, outlined the Growth Fund and innovation programmes, and said lithium remains import-dependent while sodium-ion is being researched.
Grid operator TenneT will submit a code change proposal to the ACM that could lead to a maximum discount of 65% on transport tariffs.
Netbeheer TenneT gaat een codewijzigingsvoorstel indienen bij de ACM die kan leiden tot een maximale korting van 65% op transporttarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over het artikel ''Hollandse Energie Maatschappij verdacht van gesjoemel met prijsplafondmiljoenen''

Two SP MPs asked whether a Volkskrant report that energy supplier HEM may have manipulated the price-cap subsidy is accurate, and how the regulators (RVO and ACM) oversaw it, including whether HEM should have received the subsidy while operating with a supply licence in question. The minister answered that RVO and ACM monitor compliance, that ongoing investigations and procedures cannot be discussed, that ACM tightened HEM's licence conditions in December 2023, and that no evidence yet shows consumers overpaid.
Regarding any ongoing legal procedures directly related to this, I cannot make any statements at this time.
Over eventueel lopende juridische procedures die hier direct mee samenhangen, kan ik op dit moment geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Beckerman over het artikel 'Hollandse Energie Maatschappij verdacht van gesjoemel met prijsplafondmiljoenen'

MPs Dijk and Beckerman asked how energy supplier HEM obtained a licence despite suspicions about its founders, whether the BIBOB integrity screening applied, and how misuse of the energy price cap could be prevented and recovered. The minister replied that the ACM granted the licence in 2020 under the then-applicable rules, that tightened admission criteria followed in 2022, that BIBOB is not part of licensing but is planned for the Energy Act, that no similar price cap is currently planned, and that a margin test will be applied to subsidies.
I have included in the Energy Act proposal that a licence can be refused or revoked on the basis of the BIBOB Act.
Ik heb in het voorstel voor de Energiewet opgenomen dat een vergunning kan worden geweigerd of ingetrokken op basis van de Wet BIBOB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance

An MP asked the government whether it recognises the Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance call for a fossil fuel phase-out in line with 5-degree IPCC scenarios, how this differs from its commitment to a 1.5-degree phase-out path, why the Netherlands has not joined, and whether the answers could come before the climate debate. The minister answered that the government pursues phase-out but keeps domestic small-field gas production, declines to join the alliance as it does not fit national policy, and admitted the answers came too late for the debate.
Because the Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance insufficiently aligns with the Netherlands' national policy, this cabinet currently does not intend to join this initiative.
Omdat de Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance onvoldoende aansluit op het nationale beleid van Nederland, is dit kabinet nu niet voornemens om bij dit initiatief aan te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht 'Zonnepanelen minder gewild bij huiseigenaren: flink minder aanvragen dan voor de zomer'

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a reported sharp drop in applications for rooftop solar panels, the effect on market and climate targets, and the imposition of feed-in (terugleverkosten) charges by energy suppliers, including ACM oversight and the timing of the net-metering phase-out. The minister answered that the drop follows an exceptionally high early-2023 peak, that the government will rely on the pending net-metering bill and ACM oversight of a minimum feed-in compensation, and that suppliers' charges are undesirable but legal under current rules.
I have sent the answers to your House as soon as possible.
Ik heb de beantwoording zo spoedig mogelijk aan uw Kamer verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de voortgang van de raffinageroute en het belang ervan voor de ontwikkeling van groene waterstofproductie

An MP asked the government about the progress, timing and market effects of the planned raffinage route for renewable hydrogen, and about long-term investment certainty and lessons from other member states. The minister answered that the route is well advanced, will open in 2025 with a draft decree to parliament in early 2024, and outlined subsidies and normering as ways to secure supply, while offering no firm mitigation for delay.

The planned timeline of the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management is to send the bill and the amendment to the Energy Transport Decree to the House of Representatives in the first half of 2024.

De voorgenomen tijdslijn van de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat is om in de eerste helft van 2024 het wetsvoorstel en wijziging voor het Besluit energie vervoer aan de Tweede Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Kröger over de Kamerbrief ‘Nieuwe maatregelen netcongestie’

Two MPs (Erkens, VVD and Kröger, GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the unorthodox grid-congestion measures in the letter 'Nieuwe maatregelen netcongestie', covering why these were not chosen earlier, port electrification, grid permits, prioritisation, flexibility subsidies, metering and budget. The Minister answered most questions on substance, explaining the rationale, the ACM prioritisation code due March 2024, and commitments to report back on the laagspanningsnet action agenda and flexibility options, while declining to say more on some budget and metering points yet to be worked out.
It is not expected that changes to the Energy Act will be necessary as a result of the announced measures.
Het is niet de verwachting dat er wijzigingen nodig zijn in de Energiewet als gevolg van de aangekondigde maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het gebruik van Russisch uranium door de kerncentrale Borssele

An MP asked the ministers about EPZ's long-term contract with a European supplier that uses a Russian subcontractor for reprocessing Borssele's uranium, and why earlier answers said no such dependence existed. The government acknowledged an indirect relationship with Russia, said no short-term alternative exists, and committed to examining how to break the dependence and to reviewing EPZ's evaluation, while declining to discuss confidential details of the Russian subcontractor.
We will among other things look at developing alternatives to reuse as much used uranium as possible, and the consequences of possibly not reprocessing will be further mapped out.

Wij zullen onder meer kijken naar het ontwikkelen van alternatieven om zoveel mogelijk gebruikt uranium te hergebruiken en ook de consequenties van eventueel niet-opwerken zullen nader in beeld gebracht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de 'Borselse voorwaarden voor een kerncentrale'

MP Grinwis asked the government how it views the 39 'Borsele conditions' for new nuclear plants, the process behind them, and whether it will meet them on landscape, cooling towers and underground cabling. The minister answered that the conditions are still being consolidated with the municipality and province, that substantive assessment is premature, and that the government will weigh them in the siting decision.
At this moment it is too early to respond substantively to the conditions.
Het is op dit moment te vroeg om inhoudelijk in te gaan op de voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'US, UK Lead Pledge to Triple Nuclear Power by 2050 at COP28'

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether the Netherlands will join the US-UK pledge to triple nuclear power by 2050 at COP28, and about its fiscal and knowledge effects. The minister says the pledge is a non-binding global ambition with no short-term investment effect, that the Netherlands supports it as complementary to renewables, and that he opposes strict technology neutrality in the EU context.
The declaration therefore does not oblige individual countries to formulate specific national targets.
De verklaring verplicht individuele landen dus niet tot formuleren van specifieke nationale doelstellingen.
Antwoord op van het lid Van Haga over "het tekort aan aandacht voor personeel in steenkolensector"

An MP asked the government how it will support workers in the coal sector facing job loss from the energy transition, including how the 22 million euro coal fund will be spent and what it will do for those near retirement. The minister acknowledged the worries, said the primary responsibility for reemployment lies with employers and unions, and pointed to a contingency fund being prepared with FNV for cases employers and workers cannot resolve.
That is why I am working on a provision that can be deployed if there are adverse employment effects, particularly from phasing out coal, that employers and employees cannot resolve together.

Daarom werk ik aan een voorziening die ingezet kan worden als er nadelige gevolgen voor de werkgelegenheid aan de orde zijn, met name als gevolg van het uitfaseren van kolen, die werkgever en werknemer niet samen kunnen oplossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de knelpunten voor het koppelen van bovenleidingen aan laadpunten voor elektrisch vervoer

MP Stoffer asked about obstacles RET faces in obtaining a closed distribution system (GDS) exemption to connect its overhead rail lines to EV charging points, and whether the new Energy Act would help. Minister Jetten answered that the exemption is possible under current conditions with ACM assessing RET's application, that the draft Energy Act keeps a GDS framework with a broader number of connected parties, and that EU rules leave no special room for public transport networks.
The framework for a GDS is laid down in European law, and there is no special scope for public transport networks to deviate from it.
De kaders voor een GDS zijn Europeesrechtelijk vastgelegd en er is hierbij geen bijzondere ruimte voor OV-netten om hier van af te wijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Slootweg over het bericht 'Het internet is vervuilender dan de luchtvaart, met dank aan alle mails, crypto’s, videogesprekken, streams en de cloud'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about reports that internet use is more polluting than aviation, including Dutch digital emissions, government monitoring of its digital footprint and the French 'sobriété digitale' idea. The minister answered that estimates vary, no integral picture of Dutch digital emissions exists yet, research and a plan for a sustainable digital sector are under way, and that sobriety-based steering should be approached cautiously.
At this moment I do not have an integral picture of the sustainability effects of our digital economy.
Op dit moment beschik ik niet over een integraal beeld van de duurzaamheidseffecten van onze digitale economie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over de uitspraak van de Raad van State dat ecologisch onderzoek nodig is bij het isoleren van spouwmuren

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the ministers about the Council of State ruling that ecological research is required before insulating cavity walls, including effects on costs, speed and energy poverty. The minister acknowledges the ruling, outlines a medium-term plan of municipal species management plans and a task force, and refers several questions to a Kamerbrief without giving concrete figures on individual research costs.
See the letter to the House of Representatives.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de brandbrief van de provincie Overijssel inzake de onverwachtse bijstelling van de SDE++ basistarieven voor monomestvergisting

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the Overijssel province letter protesting the unexpected downward adjustment of SDE++ base rates for mono-manure digestion, and whether the rules would be changed. The minister confirmed a calculation error was corrected under PBL advice, said the adjustment was unavoidable under EU state-aid rules and will not reverse it for the open 2023 round, and promised to seek PBL advice for 2024 and decide early 2024.
I was compelled to adjust the base amounts in the SDE++ scheme at a late stage.
Ik was genoodzaakt om in een laat stadium de basisbedragen in de SDE++-regeling aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van Campen over het artikel «Rekenfout in groengas-subsidie absurd: honderd Overijsselse boeren missen nu smak geld»

MPs Erkens and Van Campen (VVD) asked the Climate and Energy and Agriculture ministers about a calculation error that lowered SDE++ subsidy base amounts for green gas projects by 20-25%, affecting farmers' planning. Minister Jetten answered that PBL corrected its advice, that the amounts remain higher than in prior years, that no specific project or volume expectations exist, and refused to restore the original amounts or compensate preparation costs, while promising PBL advice on small-scale digesters for SDE++ 2024.
I have asked PBL to provide advice on small-scale digesters so that they can be appropriately stimulated in SDE++ 2024.
Ik heb wel PBL gevraagd om advies uit te brengen voor kleinschalige vergisters, zodat ze in de SDE++ 2024 passend gestimuleerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Pure Energie aast op bouw windpark tussen Woltersum, Ten Boer en Ten Post. Boeren worden verleid om grond beschikbaar te stellen

An SP MP asked the Cabinet whether it finds it undesirable that commercial firm Pure Energie approaches landowners for high wind turbines near Groningen's earthquake zone, and how participation and trust can be safeguarded. The minister answered that the area is not designated for large-scale wind, that local decision-making lies with regional and municipal authorities, and that participation and financial participation are being pursued without committing to halt or block the project.
It is up to the decentralised authorities to assess the plans of (commercial) parties, including those not within the RES search areas.
Het is aan de decentrale overheden om de plannen van (commerciële) partijen – ook die niet binnen de RES-zoekgebieden vallen – te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'NAM dient winningsplan Norg in'

An SP MP asks the government whether it opposes NAM's winning plan for cushion gas at the Norg storage field near Groningen, whether the state should have taken over the storage sites, and questions the Norg agreement's financial benefits for NAM. The minister answers that the winning plan will be assessed under the Mining Act with advice from SodM, the Mijnraad and regional authorities over one and a half to two years, that ACM must assess supply security, and that the Norg agreement does not bring extra income to NAM but compensates it for its disadvantage.
In my role as licensing authority I am obliged to assess this winning plan under the procedure of the Mining Act.
In mijn rol als vergunningverlener ben ik verplicht dit winningsplan te beoordelen volgens de procedure uit de Mijnbouwwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Bedrijven willen niet aan flexibel stroomgebruik'

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about an article reporting that businesses are reluctant to make their electricity use flexible, including grid capacity data, the costs for grid operators and how businesses are compensated. The minister said data on industrial flexibility potential is insufficient, pointed to a methodology and new contract forms, and noted that a mandatory flexibility obligation is not yet on the table.
Insight into the potential flexible capacity is, however, still insufficiently available both to grid operators and to the industrial parties themselves.
Inzicht in het potentieel aan flexibel vermogen is echter nog onvoldoende aanwezig bij zowel netbeheerders als bij de industriële partijen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over berichten over het stroomnet

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about grid congestion in Zeeland and Nederweert, including whether group capacity-limitation contracts should be mandatory, when a 'right to challenge' will be available, and the effect on nuclear plans and renewable generation. The Minister answers that no single contract type will be mandated since ACM holds that competence, that connection self-service starts early next year, and that new transmission projects and flexibility measures are planned, with progress reports promised at year end.
I will inform the House at the end of this year about the progress of these developments.
Ik zal de Kamer eind dit jaar informeren over de voortgang van deze ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over knelpunten voor (mono)mestvergisting

CDA MPs asked the ministers for an update on steps to expand green gas from manure digestion, including zoning, permitting, manure transport rules and additive innovations. The government answered that it is working with local authorities on faster permitting and a CO2-based blending obligation, but declined to set a sub-target for manure digestion and deferred most issues to local authorities and further research.
The cabinet is not responsible for the requirements in zoning plans; that is up to the local competent authorities.
Het kabinet gaat niet over de eisen in bestemmingsplannen, dat is aan de lokale bevoegd gezagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over energiecoöperaties die gebruik maken van de postcoderoosregeling

An MP from the CDA asks the minister about problems facing energy cooperatives under the postcoderoos scheme, including administrative burden, uncertain compensation, and a possible buy-out scheme. The minister answers that a buy-out is infeasible and state-aid-problematic, points to the successor subsidy scheme SCE and SDE++, and offers continued dialogue without committing to a new buy-out scheme.
I do not have access to this data.
Ik heb geen inzage in deze gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal en het lid Thijssen over de rol van ijzerpoeder in het energiesysteem van de toekomst

Two MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the role of iron powder (iron power technology) in future energy storage, including its maturity, seasonal storage potential, NOx emissions, and support instruments. The minister answered that iron powder is a promising but still-to-be-proven option that could play a role in seasonal storage and heat supply, with NOx depending on application, and that support could come through existing instruments while noting business case uncertainties.
Iron powder is a potentially promising technology for which the necessary knowledge base is present in the Netherlands to develop it further.
IJzerpoeder is een mogelijk veelbelovende techniek waarvoor in Nederland ook de benodigde kennisbasis aanwezig is om dit verder door te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de plannen van Duitsland om de stroomprijs voor de energie-intensieve industrie te maximeren

The MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister about the German plan to cap electricity prices for energy-intensive industry, including CfDs, PPAs, a 6 cent bridge price, and whether the Netherlands would coordinate with other member states. The minister answered that the German paper is not government policy, that the Dutch government sees the cap as costly and distortive of the level playing field and energy-saving incentives, and that it will pursue EU-level coordination and an EU-wide hydrogen-carbon agenda.
Because energy contracts between energy suppliers and energy-intensive companies are not public, this question cannot be answered exactly.
Omdat energiecontracten tussen energieleveranciers en energie-intensieve bedrijven niet openbaar zijn kan deze vraag niet exact worden beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Kröger over het artikel 'Vrees voor stijging gasprijs: Nederland onderschat de risico's'

Two MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether the government underestimates gas price risks, at what price it would intervene in the market, what alternative to the price cap is planned, how households could be protected, and how to reduce dependence on the spot market. The Minister replied that the market has calmed, supply risks are limited, no intervention is currently needed, the monitoring will continue, and the budget and buyback measures will follow later, without committing to specific figures.
I therefore see no reason at this moment to intervene in the market, but I of course keep the situation under observation.
Ik zie daarom op dit moment geen reden om in te grijpen in de markt, maar ik houd uiteraard de situatie in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het feit dat verschillende energieleveranciers mensen met zonnepanelen nu extra laten betalen via allerlei omwegen

MP Erkens (VVD) asked whether energy suppliers charging solar-panel owners extra fees via indirect routes is acceptable, and how this affects public support for solar panels, contract lengths and consumer information. The minister said such fees are not prohibited under current law if they reflect actual costs, that ACM can supervise reasonableness, that a bill on the net-metering (salderingsregeling) phase-out is pending, and that he will propose a fixed-tariff model contract in the Energy Act.
I have already had contact with the ACM about the introduction of this new cost item by energy suppliers.
Ik heb reeds over de introductie van deze nieuwe kostenpost door energieleveranciers contact gehad met de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Bontenbal over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de regels rond verlichting van windmolens

Two CDA MPs asked about the status of ILT approval for proximity detection to switch wind turbine obstacle lighting, notably for the Wieringermeer park, and about funding and provincial frameworks for retrofitting existing turbines. The minister replied that the ILT assessment is ongoing without a date, that new parks' costs are built into SDE++ rates, that a one-off 60/20/20 cost split with provinces is being prepared for a specific grant expected in autumn 2023, and that provinces are developing their own frameworks on individual timelines.
It is not possible during the assessment process of the application to state when the ILT will decide on its approval.
Het is niet mogelijk om gedurende het beoordelingsproces van de aanvraag een uitspraak te doen over het moment waarop besloten wordt over de instemming door de ILT.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Erkens over windmolens op land

MP Erkens (VVD) asked how the government will implement the coalition promise of clear distance norms for onshore wind turbines, the status of the motion on a 4x tip-height norm, the revised timeline for national rules, and the effect of delay. The minister answered that a national distance norm will be set in a draft AMvB with consultation planned for autumn 2023 and entry into force likely in 2024, that the 4x tip-height norm cannot be applied temporarily without a plan-m.e.r. due to the EU SEA Directive, and that about 17 municipalities currently apply local distance norms.
The planning must be adjusted because incorporating it into the system under the Environment and Planning Act is more complicated than expected.
De planning moet worden bijgesteld omdat de inbouw in het stelsel onder de Omgevingswet ingewikkelder is dan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de recente opkoop van vier Nederlandse gascentrales door Tsjechisch energiebedrijf Energetický a prumyslový holding (EPH)

An MP from PvdD asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the acquisition by Czech group EPH of four Dutch gas plants, roughly 15% of Dutch generating capacity, and about its CO2 emissions, biomass burning, and links to Russian gas. The Minister replied that the Bureau Toetsing Investeringen review under the Electricity Act raised no objection, that competition authorities were informed, and that EPH's emissions are governed by ETS and EU renewables rules.
I see no objection to the change of control of these plants on the basis of this review.
Ik zie geen bezwaar in de wijziging van de zeggenschap van deze centrales aan de hand van deze toetsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de brief “Vormgeving instrumentarium hernieuwbare waterstof”

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how policy supports hydrogen from fossil and nuclear sources, whether North Sea gas should be used for blue hydrogen, how Norwegian imports and hydrogen storage will be arranged, and whether storage can be ready before 2028. The minister answered that CCS-based hydrogen is supported through SDE++ and infrastructure, that no specific production-method policy exists for gas plants, that Norway import studies are underway, and that salt-cavern storage timelines extend beyond 2028 with additional funding reserved.
The Dutch government will engage with Norway and Germany to see whether such an exploration can be undertaken.
De Nederlandse overheid zal het gesprek aangaan met Noorwegen en Duitsland om te bezien of een dergelijke verkenning kan worden ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boutkan over het bericht Regeringstoestel PH-GOV voor het eerst op Groningen Airport Eelde

MP Boutkan asked the government why a 19-minute domestic flight without passengers was used to collect the King from Groningen Airport for a trip to Madrid, and why the King did not travel by train or car, and whether this is justifiable amid climate change and poverty. The government answered that the flight carried a delegation, that the choice was the most suitable after weighing efficiency, safety, cost, sustainability and availability, and that the flight request form was recently revised.
The flight was therefore not operated without passengers and was the most suitable choice for transport to Spain.
De vlucht is derhalve niet zonder passagiers afgelegd en was de meest geschikte keuze voor het vervoer naar Spanje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de strategische autonomie van Nederland op het gebied van de energietransitie

An MP asked the ministers how strategic autonomy in the energy transition is defined, how large Dutch and EU dependencies on China and other non-EU countries are for key technologies and critical raw materials, and what instruments exist to reduce them. The government answered that dependencies are not inherently problematic but must be mitigated where risky, that quantitative data are insufficient alone, and that it is pursuing a taskforce, further studies and EU instruments, with updates promised to parliament by late 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de misstanden bij de installatie van zonnepanelen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about safety and quality problems in installing solar panels, including fatal accidents and whether only accredited installers should be allowed. The minister said the Labour Inspectorate is monitoring the sector, pointed to existing legal quality requirements and voluntary accreditation, and said safety responsibility lies primarily with employers, while the government will reassess progress next year.
We are closely monitoring these efforts by the Labour Inspectorate and the solar panel sector.
Wij volgen deze inspanningen van de Arbeidsinspectie en de zonnepanelensector op de voet.
Antwoord op van de leden Boucke en Hagen over het bericht 'Miljoenen nodig voor sloop kerncentrale Dodewaard bij aandeelhouders beland'

MPs Boucke and Hagen asked how the state came to bear decommissioning costs for the Dodewaard nuclear plant while shareholders received payouts, and about financing rules for decommissioning other energy infrastructure. The minister explains that GKN could not secure approved financial guarantees, that a term sheet transfers NEA's assets to the state, and that a broader reform of mining decommissioning rules is planned for after summer.
The downside is that the state thereby becomes (indirectly) responsible for dismantling GKN.
Keerzijde is dat de Staat hiermee (indirect) verantwoordelijk wordt GKN te ontmantelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over biomassasubsidies die het kabinet tegen de afspraken in wil verstrekken

An MP asked the minister whether subsidies for biomass plants such as Vattenfall's SDE++ grant are compatible with the stop on new biomass subsidies, and how BECCS fits with the Koffeman motion and the coalition agreement. The minister confirmed the positive decision, argued that no exception applied, and defended BECCS as a generic negative-emissions measure, but did not provide the full application documents.
Full applications and decisions are not actively made public.
Volledige aanvragen en beschikkingen worden niet actief openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de waterstofplannen in Duitsland

An MP asked the minister about a seven-company German hydrogen alliance in Northwest Germany, its plans for electrolysis, transport networks and import infrastructure, and the role of state-owned Gasunie. The minister confirmed awareness, described the alliance's projects and Gasunie's infrastructure role, and said the government is in close contact with German and Belgian counterparts on cross-border hydrogen transport.
It is in all our interest that an integrated European hydrogen market emerges, and a cross-border hydrogen transport network belongs to that.
Het is in ons aller belang dat een geïntegreerde Europese waterstofmarkt ontstaat en daar hoort een grensoverschrijdend transportnet voor waterstof bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over het bericht ‘Martin botst met woonstichting om oneerlijke compensatie energiekosten: het is ons geld’

MPs De Groot and Erkens asked the minister why a housing corporation planned to credit the energy compensation for shared connections only in June 2024, and what tools exist to make landlords apply and pass on the subsidy. The minister answered that crediting must follow the existing payment periodicity and cost-allocation key, that landlords must apply and tenants can use the Huurcommissie or courts, and that a Kadaster application will show applications per connection.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over ernstige fouten in het laatste IPCC-rapport

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether the IPCC's latest report contains serious errors, cherry-picking, misleading high-emission scenarios and unscientific claims, and whether the IPCC should be abolished. The minister rejected these claims, arguing the IPCC presents a balanced assessment of the literature, considers broad risk framings and scenario ranges, and that the UN statement quoted reflects concern over current emission trends.
The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) makes balanced assessments based on the scientific literature.
Het Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) maakt evenwichtige assessments op basis van de wetenschappelijke literatuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de ontwikkelingen in de nettarieven

An MP asked the government about TenneT's announced 2024 transmission tariff increase, its distributional effects, the history and causes of grid tariffs, long-term forecasts, measures to limit increases, and how offshore wind grid costs are allocated. The minister answered substantively, explaining that tariff allocation is the exclusive competence of the ACM and that the government's role is limited to designating which grid operator bears offshore grid costs.
Yes, I am aware of TenneT's tariff forecast for 2024.
Ik ben bekend met de tariefprognose van TenneT voor 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over blauwe waterstof

Two MPs (Bontenbal, Erkens) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the role of blue hydrogen, renewable hydrogen targets, investment certainty for producers, use of North Sea gas, EU RED III implementation and a level playing field, and nuclear-based hydrogen. The minister answered that demand for low-carbon hydrogen will stay large, that the instrument for renewable hydrogen will be clarified this autumn, and that rules will follow the EU and neighbours' approaches.
This autumn I also want to provide clarity on the instruments for renewable hydrogen.
Dit najaar wil ik daarnaast duidelijkheid geven over het instrumentarium voor hernieuwbare waterstof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een eventuele kerncentrale in Twente

An MP asked the minister whether a small nuclear plant in Twente could replace wind turbines, whether it would be feasible and supported, and whether research could be commissioned quickly. The minister replied that the advice feeds into the regional energy strategy, pointed to a market analysis and regional planning as the route, and promised a national SMR programme plan by end 2023.
I expect to be able to share the elaboration of the SMR programme with your House at the end of 2023.
De invulling van het SMR-programma verwacht ik eind 2023 met uw Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over een betaalbare energierekening

Two MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how an affordable energy bill will be secured for 2024, including targeted income support, lessons from the price cap process, and relief for tenants in low-label housing. The Minister answered that options are being prepared for the August purchasing-power decision, that targeted support is still under review, and pointed to planned energy-label phase-outs, a new lower first tier for gas energy tax, and extra funding for municipalities.
Decision-making on purchasing power will take place in August.
Besluitvorming over de koopkracht zal plaatsvinden in augustus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over CCS in de SDE++ 2022

An MP asked the minister how the EUR 6.714 billion CCS commitment budget under SDE++ 2022 was calculated, why a 40 EUR/tonne base price was used rather than the higher 2023 figure, and whether actual cash outlays would be far lower. The minister explained the budget components, said the total cash expectation is roughly EUR 2.8 billion, declined to disclose exact figures for confidentiality, and promised to review how SDE++ results are communicated and to inform parliament on CCS policy soon.
Due to confidentiality, I cannot disclose the precise details of the eight decisions.
Vanwege vertrouwelijkheid kan ik niet de precieze details van de acht beschikkingen openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Maeijer over het bericht dat “EU-bobo’s gesubsidieerd naar Straatsburg vliegen”

PVV MPs asked the government about the subsidised Amelia flights between Amsterdam and Strasbourg, EU travel costs, private jet use, the Strasbourg seat, the air passenger tax and the IBO climate report. The minister answered that the route is a Public Service Obligation, that EU travel rules favour the most cost-effective option, that the government has no say over MEP travel, and that private jets are largely covered by existing aviation climate policy.
Enquiries show that the current European Parliament rules for business travel are based on choosing the most cost-effective option.
Navraag leert dat de huidige regels van het Europees Parlement voor dienstreizen zijn gebaseerd op de keuze van de meest kosteneffectieve optie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Smolders over het feit dat Italiaans huisvuil de woningbouw nog verder op slot zet en de Amsterdamse lucht vervuilt

Two MPs asked whether it is acceptable that weekly trains carry about 900 tonnes of Italian household waste to Amsterdam incinerators, citing CO2 emissions, air pollution, housing construction and public health concerns. The government answered that incineration with energy recovery is accepted while waste cannot yet be processed higher up the hierarchy, that the capacity imbalance explains cross-border transport, that Dutch incinerators must meet strict emission rules, and that the cabinet plans to reduce incineration capacity over time.
The cabinet is working nationally and at EU level to promote the highest possible level of processing, so that ultimately less waste needs to be incinerated or landfilled.
Het kabinet zet nationaal en Europees in op het stimuleren van zo hoogwaardig mogelijke verwerking waardoor er uiteindelijk minder afval moet worden verbrand of gestort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over methaanemissies in Turkmenistan

CDA MPs asked the government about very high methane emissions from Turkmenistan's largest oil and gas fields and how the Netherlands and EU could press for reductions ahead of COP28. The minister said the emissions figure uses a GWP-20 metric (about 128 Mt CO2-eq on GWP-100, below Dutch national emissions), and outlined EU and Dutch dialogue, technical assistance and the Global Methane Pledge as the response.

The Netherlands will also raise this methane issue in its own bilateral contacts with the Turkmen authorities and point out that several Dutch companies have expertise in detecting and preventing methane leaks.

Nederland zal deze methaan-problematiek ook opbrengen in de eigen bilaterale contacten met de Turkmeense autoriteiten en daarbij aangeven dat bij verschillende Nederlandse bedrijven expertise is voor het detecteren en tegengaan van methaanlekkages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Provincie Limburg wil Europese waterstofbank naar Chemelot halen'

An MP asked the ministers whether the government supports Limburg's bid to host the European hydrogen bank, which other regions are in the race, and how the government would help. The ministers replied that the Commission does not plan a new physical entity or a selection process, so no bid decision is needed, and they welcomed the initiative while promising to monitor its institutional design.
There is so far no question of a selection process.
Van een selectieproces is vooralsnog geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van Strien over de Nederlandse zonnepanelenindustrie

MPs Erkens and Van Strien asked about dependence on Chinese solar panels, Dutch/European production support, EU Recovery and Resilience funds and the IPCEI-Solar motion. The minister answered that Europe and the Netherlands depend heavily on China, outlined Dutch production support and funding applications, and said the government prefers aligning with the Net Zero Industry Act rather than the IPCEI-Solar.
Your House will be informed about this before the summer in the broad solar policy letter.
Hierover wordt uw Kamer voor de zomer geïnformeerd in de brede beleidsbrief over zon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de fiscale maatregelen voor de glastuinbouw

CDA MPs asked the government about the impact of planned energy tax changes on greenhouse growers, the feasibility of transition timelines, the treatment of combined heat and power plants, and fairness between small and large growers. The government acknowledges the strong impact, points to a combined package of measures and a possible phase-in path decided in August 2023, and says it will consider a revised proposal pending EU state aid approval.
The cabinet will decide in August 2023, based on an impact analysis yet to be published, whether to possibly adopt a phase-in path with substantial steps from 2025.
Het kabinet besluit in augustus 2023 op basis van een nog te verschijnen impactanalyse eventueel tot een ingroeipad met substantiële stappen vanaf 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de Voorjaarsbesluitvorming Klimaat

Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the Climate and Energy Minister why several IBO-Klimaat measures were left out of the spring climate package, and questioned the feasibility, biomass use, and effects of numerous individual measures. Minister Jetten answered at length, explaining deliberate choices, sometimes milder calibrations, planned follow-up decisions, and a commitment to answer timing and PBL analysis questions.
Because the talks on the Agricultural Agreement are still ongoing, the concrete implementation of measures L10-L13 will become known at a later date.
Omdat de gesprekken over het Landbouwakkoord nog gaande zijn, wordt de concrete invulling van de maatregelen L10-L13 op een later moment bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboeren Van der Lee over private deelname in TenneT Duitsland na verkoop door de Nederlandse Staat

MPs Nijboer and Van der Lee asked the ministers of Finance and Climate about possible private participation in the German TenneT grid after the Dutch state's sale, and about the risks to the energy transition. The ministers answered that the Dutch TenneT stays fully state-owned, that the sale is negotiated and not yet concluded, and that the government cannot guarantee the future ownership of German TenneT.
We will inform your House before the summer about the status of the negotiations.
Wij zullen uw Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de status van de onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over de financiering van de Stichting Schooldakrevolutie

SGP MPs asked whether central government funding for the Stichting Schooldakrevolutie (a foundation supporting schools with solar panels) is being stopped and why. The minister denies that funding stops, explains the subsidy is being phased out with a final one-off payment in 2024 and that the foundation must operate independently from 2025, while pointing to the Maatschappelijk Vastgoed programme and agreeing to the value of continued work.
A one-off subsidy will still be granted for the year 2024.
Er wordt nog eenmalig subsidie toegekend voor het jaar 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de Audiovisuele Media Richtlijn

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the EU Audiovisual Media Services Directive ban on advertising inciting behaviour harmful to the environment is implemented, and why the environmental advertising provision was removed from the new sustainability advertising code. The State Secretary answered that self-regulation via the Advertising Code Foundation and the Commissariaat covers this, and that the provision will be re-inserted in the code around 1 July 2023.
The Advertising Code Foundation intends to re-add this prohibition to the revised code.
De Stichting Reclame Code is voornemens om deze verbodsbepaling weer toe te voegen aan de herziene code.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over het artikel 'Provincie Limburg zet nieuwe stap in grootschalig onderzoek naar kernenergie'

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked the minister about a provincial Limburg initiative studying small modular reactors (SMRs), their role in industrial decarbonisation, and the government's plans and motion follow-up. The minister answered that the government is following SMR developments, commissioned a market analysis, plans a 65 million euro programme and a stepwise inventory via the industrial clusters, and is in contact with developers.
I am implementing this motion through a stepwise approach.
Ik geef uitvoering aan deze motie middels een stapsgewijze aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Kröger en Thijssen over het vermoeden van het afnemen van Russisch uranium door de Nederlandse kerncentrale in Borssele

Opposition MPs asked whether the Borssele nuclear plant (EPZ) may be supplying Russia's war effort through fuel-element trade and reprocessing of uranium in Russia, and asked about export controls, EU sanctions and oversight. The minister answered that EPZ says it no longer trades directly with Russia, that the regulator sees no signs of irregularities, that EU sanctions on Russian nuclear supplies lack support, and that Euratom and the IAEA do not oversee Russian nuclear revenues.
In general, the cabinet makes no statements regarding commercially confidential information.
Antwoord 2 In het algemeen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken ten aanzien van bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de nieuwe opzegboete bij vaste energiecontracten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the new early-termination fee for fixed-price energy contracts, the ACM's policy rule, and why the ACM's decision cannot be reversed by the minister or parliament. The minister defends the rule as proportionate and transparent, rejects postponing it or reinstating the ACM's annulment-proof status, and says the ACM's independence is required under EU law.
I do not intend to reverse the disapplication of Article 22 of the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies, as laid down in Article 10(1) of the ACM Establishment Act.
Ik ben niet van plan om het buitenwerking zetten van artikel 22 van de Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen, zoals neergelegd in artikel 10, eerste lid, van de Instellingswet ACM, ongedaan te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de position paper 'Jongeren willen daadkracht: op naar een effectieve en uitvoerbare RES'

An MP asked the minister about JongRES's position paper proposing three scenarios, a binding oversight committee and national instruments for regional energy strategies, plus how youth voice would be secured. The minister confirmed receipt, maintained the 2030 targets remain achievable, declined to set up the committee or a national coordination scheme as a first step, and pointed to a subsidy and annual meetings to secure youth participation.
I therefore see no added value in establishing such a committee in relation to implementing a RES bid.
Ik zie daarom geen meerwaarde voor het instellen van een dergelijke commissie in relatie met het tot uitvoering brengen van een RES-bod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het opbouwen van de kennisinfrastructuur op het gebied van kernenergie in Nederland

The MP Erkens (VVD) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how nuclear knowledge infrastructure in the Netherlands will be expanded, how skilled staff will be recruited, how knowledge is secured long term, how regulation, planning, EU cooperation, public information and local support for the planned new nuclear plants in Zeeland will be handled. The Minister answered that education and research initiatives are underway, a interdepartmental working group will report in spring, regulatory evaluation is due end 2023, a communication and participation plan is being drafted, and the 2035 timeline is ambitious but retained.
TU Delft is establishing a chair in Radiation Dosimetry and Biophysics and appointing two PhD candidates there.
Zo wordt er door de TU Delft een leerstoel Stralingsdosimetrie en Biofysica ingesteld en worden daar twee promovendi aangesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger voer het bericht 'Verhoging van energietarieven was mogelijk jarenlang onwettig'

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a court ruling that a price-change clause in an energy supplier's general conditions was too vague, potentially making mid-contract tariff increases unlawful, and whether the same clause appears in the model contract used across the sector. The Minister declined to assess the ruling, noted the appeal, explained the model contract rules and the consumer protections in place, and said the wider consequences depend on the appeal outcome.
It is not for me as Minister to assess court rulings.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om rechterlijke uitspraken te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Vattenfall krijgt tik op de vingers van rechter voor tariefsverhoging klant'

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a court ruling that found Vattenfall's price-change clause unfair and annulled it, and about related consumer protection, model contracts and billing clarity. The minister answered that the ruling concerns an individual case under appeal, that the ACM does not track such tariff changes, that the contract was not a model contract, and that no broader investigation is planned.
I do not have these figures.
Ik beschik niet over deze cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het alleen voor Chinees riet aanvragen van subsidie

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked why the ISDE insulation subsidy's product listing covered Chinese reed but not Dutch reed, raising level-playing-field, sustainability and EU state-aid concerns. The minister answered that a registration code was granted only because Chinese reed met the insulation threshold, that Dutch reed can apply once its performance declaration is ready, and that sustainability criteria for bio-based inputs are being developed.
It is correct that a registration code was requested and granted for Chinese reed and not yet for Dutch reed.
Het klopt dat er een meldcode is aangevraagd en verleend voor Chinees riet en nog niet voor Nederlands riet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de kosten tot nu toe van de arbitragezaak die Uniper tegen Nederland heeft aangespannen

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy for a full breakdown of costs in the Uniper and RWE ICSID arbitrations against the Netherlands, how costs are split after withdrawal, and why international arbitration costs are so much higher than domestic litigation. The minister gave itemised cost figures, said costs are paid from the energy market budget, reported that the tribunal rejected the state's request for costs against Uniper so each party bears its own, and explained that arbitration procedures are more extensive than domestic civil cases.
