The tribunal rejected the State's request to order Uniper to pay the costs, as it found no grounds for this.
Het tribunaal heeft het verzoek van de Staat om Uniper in de kosten te veroordelen afgewezen, omdat zij oordeelde dat hiervoor geen gronden aanwezig waren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over de explosieve uitkomsten van het onderzoek van het Amerikaanse House Committee on Oversight and Reform naar de klimaatontwrichtende investeringsplannen van de li

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the ministers whether they know of, and how they will respond to, US House Oversight Committee findings that major fossil fuel firms plan to keep investing in oil and gas and engage in greenwashing, and whether the government will hold these companies to account, demand Paris-aligned investment plans, or investigate similar conduct in the Netherlands. The ministers answered that the government expects firms to meet Paris goals through binding bilateral agreements and carbon pricing, cannot dictate strategies to international companies, will not summon them or investigate Dutch conduct, and will not make Paris alignment a condition for subsidies.
I will not summon these companies following the American investigation.
Ik zal deze bedrijven naar aanleiding van het Amerikaanse onderzoek niet op het matje roepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over het combineren van maatregelen voor het reduceren van de uitstoot van stikstof en CO2 door industriële bedrijven

CDA MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk asked how the government will combine nitrogen and CO2 reduction for large industrial emitters, which firms overlap, and whether a joint acceleration plan will be made. The minister answered that about 35 firms are covered by a tailor-made approach addressing both CO2 and nitrogen, that grid and permitting bottlenecks remain, and that a joint plan of action with the 20 largest CO2 emitters is being developed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Slootweg over het bericht dat miljoenen overheidsgeld op het spel staan na het stilleggen van een biomassacentrale in Gelderland

Two CDA MPs asked why the Primco biomass plant in Duiven stopped operating, whether public money is at risk, and what measures prevent further subsidised biomass projects from failing. The minister answered that the company bears the price risk, that the state's subsidy and investment support total about 6 million euro so far, that the state would be a creditor for overpaid SDE+ subsidy in bankruptcy, and that the government has no active role in restarting the plant, while declining to answer the question on how many projects are affected.
No. It concerns many projects with very specific business operations and agreements on both costs or revenues for the use of biomass and revenues for the supply of heat.
Nee. Het betreft veel projecten met zeer specifieke bedrijfsvoeringen en afspraken zowel qua kosten of inkomsten voor de inzet van biomassa als qua opbrengsten voor de levering van warmte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Vattenfall 76 euro vraagt voor stadswarmte terwijl de inkoopprijs ongeveer een tientje is

Leijten (SP) asked the minister why Vattenfall charges 76 euro per GJ for district heat when the purchase price is about 10 euro, and how consumers can be protected and given insight into cost build-up. The minister answered that the price applies only above the 37 GJ volume cap, that the ACM supervises heat tariffs and returns, and that cost transparency is limited by confidential business information.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over windmolengedram in Utrecht

An MP from Groep Van Haga asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether he accepts the province of Utrecht's reported plan to use coercion on wind turbine siting, which would sideline municipalities and citizens, and whether he would act against the responsible GroenLinks deputy and the election-sensitivity of the issue. The Minister rejected the idea of coercion, said the provincial process is careful and that the RES zoning was reached democratically, and that the 35 TWh renewable-on-land target must be met responsibly and on time.
I see no reason, based on the process described so far, to think the province is not following a careful process.
Ik zie in het beschreven proces tot nu toe geen aanleiding te denken dat de provincie geen zorgvuldig proces volgt.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Erkens en Haverkort over wind op land

MPs Erkens and Haverkort asked whether the planned timetable for new national noise and distance norms for onshore wind turbines (including the Danish 4x tip-height norm) is still feasible and when temporary norms can be applied. The State Secretary answers that the new rules are expected in early 2024 after a plan-MER procedure, that legally no temporary national norm can be imposed before that, and that municipalities must set site-specific conditions in the meantime.
The State Secretary of I&W is committed to ensuring that new regulations for onshore wind turbines can enter into force in early 2024.
De Staatssecretaris van IenW zet zich ervoor in dat begin 2024 nieuwe regelgeving voor windturbines op land in werking kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitspraak van de Raad van State inzake windmolens

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy whether it is undesirable that provinces and municipalities re-label national wind turbine noise norms, struck down by the Council of State, as local norms without scientific basis, and whether a moratorium on new onshore wind farms will be declared. The Minister disagrees, says decentralised authorities must substantiate their own norms with scientific knowledge, and refuses a moratorium.
Own norms of decentralised authorities must be well substantiated, among other things on the basis of scientific knowledge about wind energy and health.
Eigen normen van decentrale overheden dienen goed onderbouwd te worden, onder andere op basis van de wetenschappelijke kennis over windenergie en gezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de brandbrief van belangengroepen die de windindustrie in de Achterhoek willen stoppen en het groeiende verzet tegen de komst van windmolens in Overijssel

An MP asked the minister about a letter from interest groups opposing wind farms in the Achterhoek and growing resistance in Overijssel, and about health effects of turbines and public support. The minister acknowledged the letter, defended the national wind energy targets and regional plans, pointed to participation rules and ongoing health research, but did not commit to halting construction.
I endorse the importance that during permit granting for wind turbines all effects are weighed carefully, including effects on the living environment and health.
Ik onderschrijf het belang dat tijdens de vergunningverlening voor windturbines alle effecten op een zorgvuldige manier worden afgewogen, dus ook de effecten op de leefomgeving en gezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Boucke over het initiatief voor energiebesparing op De Zuidas en het voorzien van alle straatverlichting van een led-lichtbron

Two MPs asked the ministers about a campaign to switch off night-time office lighting on the Zuidas and about fully converting street lighting to LED, including whether the government would support the initiative and how energy savings could be mandated. The ministers confirmed support for the campaign, pointed to the energy-saving obligation and the updated measures list, and said about 32% of motorway lighting is LED with the rest to be replaced at natural replacement moments, rather than accelerating full conversion.
Almost all provinces will fit the remaining street lighting with LED lamps in the coming years.
Vrijwel alle provincies gaan de komende jaren de resterende straatverlichting van ledlampen voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht ‘Provincie Utrecht gebruikt als eerste overheid in Nederland een eerlijke CO2-prijs’

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers how the national government factors the costs of climate change into policy, whether a national CO2 price should be used, and whether ministers should report climate costs. The minister answered that the IAK and MKBA guidance already include CO2 prices, that the planning bureaus' efficient CO2 prices differ from Utrecht's social-cost approach, that he is willing to work toward a national CO2 price, and that reporting and decision-note requirements are left to individual ministers.
I would prefer to leave this to the ministers themselves.
Dit laat ik graag aan de Ministers zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het afbouwpad van fossiele subsidies

GreenLeft MPs asked why a 2018 motion to phase out fiscal incentives undermining climate goals has not been fully implemented, why many fossil-energy exemptions remain, and for details on the largest emitters' benefits, the refinery exemption, free ETS allowances and related schemes. The government answered that it is phasing out some exemptions and plans a transparency action plan, cited treaty and double-taxation constraints, but declined to disclose company-level benefits citing confidentiality.
Regarding individual companies' entitlement to exemptions, subsidies and other benefits, as far as known, I cannot go into it due to confidentiality.
Op de aanspraak van individuele bedrijven op vrijstellingen, subsidies en andere voordelen, voor zover bekend, kan ik uit hoofde van vertrouwelijkheid niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over waterstof uit kernenergie

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked the minister whether the Netherlands would pursue hydrogen from nuclear energy, following a Franco-German roadmap, and whether it should count toward EU green hydrogen targets for industry. The minister welcomed Franco-German cooperation, said nuclear-based hydrogen may be imported or produced later, but kept the Dutch position on additionality and a level playing field and committed to no concrete new step beyond ongoing EU negotiations.
I attach importance to maintaining a level playing field for hydrogen producers and users.
Ik hecht er waarde aan dat het gelijke speelveld voor waterstofproducenten en -gebruikers behouden blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Europese Commissie wil met 'noodmaatregel' procedures duurzame energie versnellen'

An MP asked the minister whether the EU emergency measure to speed up renewable energy permitting would cover large projects such as offshore wind, green hydrogen, grid reinforcement and CO2 storage, and what its effect would be on the climate goals and the Porthos ruling. The minister answered that the emergency regulation was extended to larger technologies such as grid reinforcement and standalone large-scale generation, that CCS and Porthos fall outside the definition and are excluded, and that the measure will not bring significant acceleration in the Netherlands.
CO2 transport and storage is not included in the regulation because these projects do not fall under the definition of the European Renewable Energy Directive (RED).
CO 2 -transport en -opslag is niet opgenomen in de verordening, omdat deze projecten niet onder de definitie van de Europese hernieuwbare energierichtlijn (RED) vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over CO2-verwijdering

Two MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the gap between carbon dioxide removal (CDR) in national climate plans and what the Paris goals require, and about policy steps, a long-term target and a roadmap for negative emissions. The minister agrees a policy vision from central government is needed, points to the 2024 Climate Plan and an ongoing study, and says CDR should not replace faster emission reductions.
I will send your House a letter in March on the elaboration of the climate neutrality policy agenda.
Ik zal uw Kamer in maart een brief sturen over de uitwerking van de beleidsagenda op Klimaatneutraliteit
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de wettelijke belemmeringen voor het koppelen van bovenleidingen aan laadpunten voor elektrisch vervoer

An SGP MP asked whether tram, train and trolleybus overhead lines could be used to supply charging points and relieve the grid, and whether energy law blocks this, and asked about the drawbacks of letting transport operators sell energy. The minister replied that the lines could qualify as closed distribution systems requiring an ACM exemption, that no legislative change is needed, and that talks with stakeholders are ongoing.
As indicated above, it is not necessary to amend legislation for this.
Zoals hierboven aangegeven is het niet nodig hier wetgeving voor aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het over het bericht 'ACM doet onderzoek bij kantoren van Eneco, Essent en Vattenfall'

An MP (SP) asked the minister about the ACM's investigation visits to Eneco, Essent and Vattenfall, the ACM's reasons, how the information is used, and KPMG's role in the price-cap margin test. The minister answered that the ACM is an independent regulator that sets its own investigative approach, that the visits followed from the three firms' large market share, and that the ACM will report more in March.
It is up to the ACM as an independent regulator to shape its supervision of the reasonableness of tariffs.
Het is aan de ACM als onafhankelijk toezichthouder om het toezicht op de redelijkheid van tarieven vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Kröger over enkele berichten over de stand van zaken van energieprijzen en de energiemarkt

MPs Thijssen and Kröger asked the minister about energy price declines, variable and dynamic contracts, ACM investigations into suppliers, and market liberalisation. The minister answered that consumers should benefit from falling prices through switching, that ACM oversees tariff reasonableness independently, and that a 12-month fixed-contract obligation will be introduced in the Energy Act.
I do not think the duration of these contracts is long enough and I consider it desirable that fixed contracts have a term of at least 12 months.
Ik vind de duur van deze contracten niet lang genoeg en vind het wenselijk dat vaste contracten in ieder geval een looptijd van 12 maanden kennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de kwaliteitscriteria voor waterstof

Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister about the quality criteria for hydrogen, including whether the 98% minimum purity advised by Kiwa and DNV is too low compared with the 99.5% producers prefer, and who bears purification costs. The minister explained the consultation results, agreed to commission additional research with a single long-term purity standard, and promised to decide after that research and inform parliament before summer.
I will commission additional research in which insights from the market consultation are weighed.
Ik ga opdracht geven voor aanvullend onderzoek waarin inzichten uit de marktconsultatie worden meegewogen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de gevolgen van de inframarginale prijscap op biogasproducenten met een warmtekrachtkoppeling (WKK)

MP Bontenbal asked whether the infra-marginal price cap threatens biogas CHP plants with bankruptcy, whether the 240 euro/MWh cap is too low, and whether the cap should match Germany's 285 euro/MWh. The minister agreed to raise the cap for biogas CHP plants to 285 euro/MWh based on German cost data, but refused to switch to an averaged seven-month cap instead of monthly settlement.
Based on the German analysis, I will adjust the price cap for biogas CHP installations to 285 euro/MWh, so that for this category too only excess profits are taxed.
Op basis van de Duitse analyse zal ik de hoogte van het prijsplafond voor biogas-WKK installaties aanpassen naar 285 euro/MWh, om zo ook voor deze categorie alleen overwinsten af te romen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de inzet van dieselaggregaten

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers about the use, air-quality and CO2 impact, municipal and provincial levers, EU emission standards and alternatives for diesel generators, and whether a strategy and a three-year phase-out by grid operators are planned. The state secretary answered that diesel generators (about 11,000, mostly in construction) have limited national impact but local effects, that municipalities rarely use their powers, that a routekaart and convenant are being prepared, and that a three-year phase-out is too short, proposing about ten years.
Once the routekaart SEB is final and the convenant signed, I will inform your House about this.
Zodra de routekaart SEB definitief is en het convenant ondertekend, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Warmteleveranciers verhogen hun tarieven volgend jaar fors'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether heat supplier tariff increases of about a doubling were justified by actual costs, how the ACM monitors this, and what consumers can do. The Minister answered that he cannot yet judge whether all increases reflect real costs, pointed to ACM oversight, the return test and future data, and said consumers are protected by the Heat Act and the price cap.
I cannot currently assess whether the increase in heat tariffs is fully based on actual costs.
Ik kan op dit moment niet beoordelen of de stijging van warmtetarieven volledig gebaseerd is op de werkelijke kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Russische hackers hebben het gemunt op Nederlandse gasinstallaties’

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch gas infrastructure, on land and at sea, is adequately protected against Russian state-linked cyberattacks and sabotage, and whether emergency plans exist. The minister answered that the operators bear primary responsibility, that the government supports them through information sharing and the Wbni framework with RDI supervision and NCSC assistance, and that gas crisis plans (BH-G, NCP Gas) and a North Sea protection strategy are in place or in development.

In its governing role over vital infrastructure, I set requirements together with the Minister of Justice and Security, which are laid down in laws and regulations, and I supervise compliance with them.
Vanuit haar regierol op de vitale infrastructuur stel ik samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid eisen op die worden vastgelegd in wet- en regelgeving en zie ik toe op de naleving ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel “Warmteleveranciers verhogen hun tarieven volgend jaar fors”

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the sharp heat-tariff increases reported by heat suppliers, whether they are reasonable, whether profits are justified, how ACM supervises them, and whether tariff transparency and the gas-price link should change. The minister answered that the increases follow higher gas costs and the gas-linked price cap, that individual cost and profit data are not available to him, and that yield tests and future Warmtewet rules are the relevant safeguards, without committing to new transparency obligations yet.
However, I have no insight into the costs of individual heat suppliers and I cannot assess whether all tariff increases were necessary to absorb cost increases.
Ik heb echter geen inzicht in de kosten van individuele warmteleveranciers en ik kan niet beoordelen of alle tariefverhogingen noodzakelijk waren om kostenstijgingen op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Qatarese gasbellen bezorgen Qatar geopolitieke poleposition'

An MP asked the energy minister about LNG supply security, long-term gas contracts with allies like Norway and the US, and the Qatar article. The minister said contracting is mainly for private parties, outlined expanded LNG import capacity, energy diplomacy, EU joint purchasing and storage measures, without detailing specific country negotiations.
Concluding contracts is in the first instance a matter for market parties.
Het afsluiten van contracten is in eerste instantie aan marktpartijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het incident met een geknakte windturbine in Flevoland

An MP asked whether the government knows of a wind turbine that collapsed in Flevoland, how many older turbines are at risk, how often turbines are inspected, and whether it will act against this dangerous development. The state secretary answered that the cause is still under external investigation by the owner Vattenfall, listed turbine build-year counts, cited existing safety norms and annual inspection rules, and promised to discuss generic improvements with the sector after the results.

Based on the results, the Minister for Climate and Energy and I will discuss this with the sector and the other governments and consider whether this specific situation contains generic points for improvement.

Op basis van de resultaten zullen de Minister voor Klimaat en Energie en ik met de sector en de medeoverheden hierover in gesprek gaan en bezien in hoeverre deze specifieke situatie generieke verbeterpunten bevat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het handelen van DGB Energie

MP Leijten asked the minister about DGB Energie's sales practices, its ACM fine, outsourced telephone sales and customer service, licence revocation, bankruptcy risk from its corporate structure, and prize-cap subsidy advances. The minister answered that the ACM is responsible for enforcement and licence decisions, that suppliers remain liable for outsourced services, and that existing rules already prohibit misleading sales, while promising a progress report on the prize cap and that the ACM will be asked how it supervises responsiveness.
It is the task of the ACM to act when the rules are broken.
Het is de taak van de ACM om op te treden als de regels overtreden worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de brief 'No export credit support for Santos FPSO' van Nederlandse en Braziliaanse NGO’s

MP Dassen (Volt) asks whether export credit insurance has been granted for the Santos Basin FPSO project, how it fits the 1.5-degree scenario given the new no-fossil-expansion policy, and why it is still processed. The state secretary answers that the insurance is not yet granted, the application was filed before 1 January 2023 and falls under a transitional period allowing a policy until end-2023, while acknowledging the project would not fit the new policy.
For this category of projects the cabinet has decided to apply a limited transitional period: applications submitted before 1 January 2023 could lead to a policy until the end of 2023.

Voor deze categorie projecten heeft het kabinet besloten een gelimiteerde overgangsperiode toe te passen: aanvragen die zijn ingediend vóór 1 januari 2023 zouden tot uiterlijk eind 2023 tot een polis kunnen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de onbereikbaarheid van energiebedrijven

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the minister why energy companies were hard to reach about the price cap and why the cap was not better prepared and more generous. The minister acknowledged the overload, said suppliers are working to improve service and app information, and refused to widen the cap or backdate it.
The price cap was established under great time pressure.
Het prijsplafond is onder grote tijdsdruk tot stand gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Nispen en Leijten over Chinese inmenging in Nederland

MPs Van Dijk, Van Nispen and Leijten asked about reports of Chinese 'police service stations' in the Netherlands, whether those staff can stay and be prosecuted, whether the AIVD knew, where the limits of foreign interference lie, what infrastructure Chinese state actors hold and how to prevent its use as leverage, and whether cruciale sectors should be under Dutch control. The government said the stations have been closed after diplomatic protests, that no evidence yet shows staff were sent from China, that investigation continues and prosecution is not ruled out, declined to comment on AIVD knowledge, pointed to its three-track anti-interference approach and a planned espionage bill, and described the Vifo screening law and a reinforced vital-infrastructure approach while citing partial Chinese ownership of Rotterdam container terminals.
Regarding the knowledge level, working methods or sources of the intelligence services, the AIVD, as you know, makes no public statements.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten doet de AIVD, zoals bij u bekend, in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heerema en Erkens over het artikel ‘Directeur Thialf uit in brief aan Tweede Kamer ’zeer grote zorgen’ over voortbestaan’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about Thialf ice rink's plans to innovate on sustainability and energy costs, and about sustainability support for sports facilities. The minister confirmed awareness, stated support for sports sustainability through the BOSA scheme and other subsidies, and committed to evaluating and continuing the BOSA scheme from 2024 and to exploring financing structures.
I informed your House about this in advance of the committee meeting on sport on 28 November.
Ik heb uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd voorafgaand aan het WGO sport van 28 november jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over ‘vogelgehaktmolens’ in Flevoland

An MP asked the government about wind turbines in Flevoland reportedly killing rare raptors, what it would do to protect birds, and whether it would halt new onshore wind turbines and reduce their number in favour of solar and nuclear. The minister answered that permitting for wind projects under the Nature Protection Act is handled by provinces with mitigation measures such as shutdowns during bird migration, that a black-blade pilot is ongoing, and refused to halt onshore wind, arguing solar alone would not balance supply.
No, the Minister for Climate and Energy is not willing to do so.
Nee, de Minister voor Klimaat en Energie is hiertoe niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de laatste ontwikkeling op de energiemarkt,

Member Erkens (VVD) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the risk of winter gas and electricity shortages, EU and neighbouring-country export restrictions, stress tests, and supplier liquidity problems from high margin calls. The minister answered that the government is taking measures to secure gas supply, that EU energy law makes supply security a shared EU matter, that stress scenarios and supplier-monitoring rules are in place, and that a few questions were answered late.
I am aware of the concerns that exist in the energy market and I take them seriously.
Ik ben bekend met de zorgen die leven in de energiemarkt en neem deze serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Raan over de slinkse vertragingspogingen van de Raad van de Europese Unie inzake de Verordening Duurzaam gebruik pesticiden

MPs Vestering and Van Raan ask why an EU Council request for an additional impact assessment of the Sustainable Use of Pesticides Regulation was placed as an A-item on the Energy Council agenda, and why the Netherlands' earlier opposition appeared to shift. Minister Adema explains the Czech presidency placed it as an A-item after a majority of member states supported it, that the Netherlands opposed it, and that the Netherlands will run its own impact study with results expected in Q1 2023.
I will inform the Chamber about this.
Ik zal de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de energie-intensieve bedrijven in de Eemshaven

An MP asked the minister about fears of a domino effect among energy-intensive firms in the Eemsdelta, support for firms forced to halt production, use of the EU state aid framework, knock-on effects in the value chain, and when indirect ETS cost compensation would be paid. The minister said she met the regional industry delegation, promised a letter before year-end on the energy crisis impact and options, explained that substitutes exist in the chain, and stated that compensation for 2022 is being paid but there is no budget to reopen the scheme after 2022.
Before the end of this year I want to inform your House about the impact of the energy crisis on energy-intensive industry.
Nog voor het einde van dit jaar wil ik uw Kamer informeren over de impact van de energiecrisis op de energie-intensieve industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Van Raan en Sylvana Simons over het bericht ‘Nederland doet te weinig om Bonaire te beschermen tegen bedreiging klimaatverandering’

MPs Teunissen, Van Raan and Simons asked whether the government will do enough to protect Bonaire, Saba and Sint Eustatius from climate change, citing a VU report, and questioned the lack of adaptation strategies, water safety standards and Rijk funding for the islands. The State Secretary replied that climate scenarios for the Caribbean Netherlands are being developed by KNMI with results expected end 2023, that the public bodies bear primary responsibility for adaptation with Rijk support in knowledge and tools, and that no specific Rijk adaptation programme or new funding is planned.
On the basis of the outcomes of these studies it will be determined in which area further research is needed.
Op basis van de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken zal bepaald worden op welk vlak vervolgonderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over het onderzoek ‘The Impacts of Climate Change on Bonaire’

An MP from GroenLinks asks the government how it will respond to a study on climate change impacts on Bonaire, including measures to protect the island, consultation with residents facing a possible lawsuit, the state's responsibility, and the social-economic position of residents. The government answers that it has a shared responsibility with the public bodies, points to coral restoration funding, spatial planning instruments and a forthcoming KNMI climate scenario for the Caribbean, and offers knowledge support, but declines to answer the questions separately because of time constraints.

The cabinet considers it important that there is good insight into the consequences of climate change for the Caribbean Netherlands and that adaptation strategies are drawn up and implemented on that basis.

Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat er goed inzicht komt in de gevolgen van klimaatverandering voor Caribisch Nederland en dat op basis daarvan adaptatiestrategieën worden opgesteld en geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Van Raan en Sylvana Simons over het bericht ‘Nederland doet te weinig om Bonaire te beschermen tegen bedreiging klimaatverandering’

MPs Wuite and Boucke (D66) asked the State Secretary and ministers about a report warning that Bonaire risks flooding from climate change, and whether Dutch climate law, international agreements and coordination should extend to the Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered that municipalities are primarily responsible for adaptation, that further studies and a climate table on Bonaire are planned, and that the Dutch Climate Act and Paris Agreement cannot simply extend to these islands.
The local government has the means to steer spatial planning so as to prevent as much damage and nuisance from extreme weather as possible.
Het lokale bestuur heeft de mogelijkheden om te sturen op een ruimtelijke ordening en inrichting waarmee schade en overlast door weersextremen zo veel mogelijk wordt voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de uitspraak van de rechter in de rechtszaken tussen RWE en Uniper en de Staat

Leijten (SP) asked the climate minister how the court rulings in the RWE and Uniper cases against the State affect climate policy, whether policy was chilled by litigation fears, the status of arbitration, and compensation and costs for coal plant closures. Minister Jetten answered that the rulings confirm consistent climate policy, that no policy was affected by litigation fears, arbitration is suspended, and the State recovers only part of its legal costs.
No, no policy has been inhibited or influenced out of fear of legal proceedings.
Nee, er is geen beleid geremd of beïnvloed uit angst voor juridische procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over de voorgenomen verkoop van het Zeeuwse energiebedrijf PZEM aan het Tsjechische energiebedrijf EPH

MPs Kröger and Thijssen asked the ministers about the planned sale of the publicly owned Zeeland energy company PZEM to Czech firm EPH, raising concerns about privatisation, fossil fuel assets, climate targets and risk allocation. Minister Jetten answered that the province as shareholder may decide on the sale, that he raised no objection under the Electricity Act while noting climate concerns, that the government will respond to the Segers-Marijnissen motion next year, and that the transaction structure is for the shareholders to decide.
As a shareholder, the province of Zeeland is free to decide on its own shareholding.
Als aandeelhouder staat het de provincie Zeeland vrij om over het eigen aandeelhouderschap te beslissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de voorbereiding van het prijsplafond voor consumenten

An MP asked the Minister about contacts with the European Commission on the consumer energy price cap, the margin test, the constitutional equality of households, the sharing of memos, and firms with negative equity. The Minister answered that Commission correspondence is confidential, that the relevant internal notes and the draft regulation were shared with parliament, and that a brutomargetoets and bankruptcy clauses are included, while several questions were answered with commitments to follow up.
Official-level conversations with the Commission in the context of ongoing state aid procedures are confidential.
Gesprekken op ambtelijk niveau met de Commissie in het kader van lopende staatsteunprocedures zijn vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de beantwoording van eerder gestelde vragen over het bericht ‘Energieplafond drijft prijzen en subsidies verder op'

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy whether raising energy tariffs under the price cap increases state costs, whether the tariff rises by Vattenfall and Essent are justified, whether the cap constitutes state aid, and how the margin test and external advice were arranged. The minister answers that the state compensates the gap between the cap and contract price subject to a margin test, that the ACM is responsible for reviewing reasonableness, that the Commission's state-aid decision is pending with no payments before approval, and that the underlying documents were sent to parliament on 9 December.
It is up to the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM), as an independent regulator, to check under its statutory duty whether the tariffs energy companies charge are reasonable.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) als onafhankelijke toezichthouder om conform haar wettelijke taak te controleren of de tarieven die energiebedrijven rekenen redelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de regeling van het prijsplafond

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the timing, cost basis, notification to the European Commission, and profit cap of the energy price ceiling scheme ahead of a budget debate. The minister confirmed the scheme was shared on time with a detailed explanation, gave general cost-dependence answers, referred to the supplementary budget answers for cost estimates, and declined to answer some questions within the requested deadline.
For brevity, I refer to the extensive written answers to the Chamber's questions on the 10th supplementary budget, which also go further into how the relevant estimates were made.

Kortheidshalve verwijs ik naar de uitgebreide schriftelijke beantwoording van de vragen die de Kamer gesteld heeft over de 10 e suppletoire begroting, die ook nader ingaan op de totstandkoming van de relevante ramingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Teunissen over het feit dat de mondiale biodiversiteitsdoelen alleen te behalen zijn door het hervormen van voedsel- en energiesystemen en een sterke beleidsinzet op natuurhers

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked ministers how the government will act on PBL findings that global biodiversity targets require transforming food and energy systems and stronger nature and climate policy, including on protein transition, financial-sector investment and COP negotiations. The minister acknowledges the urgency, points to the coalition agreement, national protein strategy, a forthcoming subsidy review and an inter-departmental biodiversity study, but largely restates existing policy and defers concrete steps to later.
The cabinet acknowledges that there is no time to lose and that a joint approach is required to tackle the climate and biodiversity crisis.
Het kabinet erkent dat er geen tijd te verliezen is en dat een gezamenlijke aanpak vereist is om de klimaat- en biodiversiteitscrisis aan te pakken.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van der Lee en Thijssen over de intentieverklaring tussen Nederland en met Oman over samenwerking op het gebied van groene waterstof

MPs Kröger, Van der Lee and Thijssen asked why the Dutch-Omani green hydrogen memorandum lacks safeguards on human rights, environment and labour rights, given Oman's weak labour record and the port of Sohar joint venture. The government answered that MoUs are non-binding, that Dutch companies must apply OECD due diligence, that an IMVO risk analysis on hydrogen chains is under way, and that future MoUs may refer to the SDGs.
A letter of intent does not create legally binding agreements from which safeguards, rights or obligations can be derived.
In een intentieverklaring worden geen juridisch bindende afspraken gemaakt waaraan waarborgen, rechten of plichten kunnen worden ontleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over speculatie op de gasbeurs

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about speculation on the TTF gas exchange, its effect on prices, and whether trading volumes are excessive. The Minister answered that the AFM sees no indications of market manipulation, that financial firms provide liquidity useful for hedging, that position limits and AFM oversight exist, and that restricting trade would harm long-term price stability and supply security.
The AFM currently has no indications that there has recently been any form of market manipulation or other market abuse in trading in gas derivatives.
De AFM heeft vooralsnog geen indicaties dat er bij de handel in gasderivaten recentelijk sprake is (geweest) van enige vorm van marktmanipulatie of andere vormen van marktmisbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Boucke over stijgende energieprijzen zorginstellingen

MPs Paulusma and Boucke asked about rising energy costs for hospitals and residential care facilities, including reports of diesel emergency generators being used because they are cheaper than gas, and whether mitigating measures such as the energy price cap and WHOA restructuring apply. The minister acknowledges sector-wide financial pressure, says he is unaware of diesel signals, points to existing energy-cap and TEK compensation conditions, declines to provide an overview of at-risk institutions, and refers to earlier letters and sustainability support programmes.
I do not have such an overview.
Ik beschik niet over een dergelijk overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over windmolenverzet in Brielle

An MP asks the minister about a protest in Brielle against two wind turbines, whether EU court rulings invalidate Dutch turbine norms requiring a halt to onshore projects, and whether Denmark and Germany's distance norms should lead to a stop. The minister says the Council of State ruled on a procedural error, responsibility for local norms lies with competent authorities, a national plan-MER is in preparation, and flashing lights will be reduced via proximity detection.

I previously informed you, jointly on behalf of the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, about the consequences of this ruling and the process to arrive at new national environmental norms for wind turbines based on a plan-MER.

Ik heb u eerder, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat (IenW), geïnformeerd over de gevolgen van deze uitspraak en het proces om te komen tot nieuwe landelijke milieunormen voor windturbines op basis van een plan-MER.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over “de stinkende biomassacentrale in Steenwijkerland”

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether the Ice Bear biomass plant in Steenwijkerland, which residents and the municipal council say causes odour, night noise and fine dust, will be closed and why biomass is a poor energy source. The minister said subsidies for new wood-based electricity have stopped, pointed to tightened emission limits and the Clean Air Agreement, and said closure is for the municipality and province as licensing and enforcement authorities.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Thijssen over het bericht 'Grote energieleverancier in de problemen; scholen ongerust'

MPs De Hoop and Thijssen asked the ministers about reports that energy supplier DVEP had stopped sending invoices and closed to new customers, leaving schools worried. The minister said billing delays were caused by a system upgrade, that the ACM was alerted but does not comment on specific investigations, and that no emergency plan exists beyond general rules for small consumers, with compensation for school energy costs being considered in the budget.
The ACM, however, makes no statements about whether investigations into specific suppliers are ongoing or not.
De ACM doet echter geen uitspraken over al dan niet lopende onderzoeken naar specifieke leveranciers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, Bontenbal, Erkens en Valstar over versnelling geothermie

MPs Grinwis, Bontenbal, Erkens and Valstar asked how to accelerate geothermal heat projects amid the gas crisis, including exceptions to SDE++ deadlines, a correction scheme for glasshouse horticulture, and simpler permitting and risk frameworks. The Staatssecretaris answered that retroactive SDE++ changes are unfair to other bidders, that a temporary correction scheme is being explored with a decision expected soon, and that permitting and risk rules will change in spring 2023 with a taskforce being set up.
An adjustment after the tender has closed, with retroactive effect, affects equal treatment of projects for two reasons and therefore also the government's reliability.
Een aanpassing na afloop van de tender – met terugwerkende kracht – raakt om twee redenen aan de gelijke behandeling van projecten en daarmee ook aan de betrouwbaarheid van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Erkens over het bericht 'Inspectie: burgers onvoldoende beschermd tegen geluidsoverlast windmolens'

MPs Leijten and Erkens asked why a 2009 HUF assessment of wind turbine noise rules was initially reported as absent, why its warnings about the annual-average noise norm were not shared with parliament, and whether the norms and existing permits will be revisited. The state secretary acknowledged the earlier search failure, explained that the assessment's personal policy views were withheld in 2009 and later released, and said the inspectorate's concerns led to tightened measurement rules and a night norm while the new plan-MER will decide any further changes.
In response to the Woo request, it was stated that all requested documents had already been involved in an earlier relatively recent decision (19-08-2021) under the Wob.

Bij het betreffende Woo-verzoek is aangegeven dat alle opgevraagde documenten al betrokken zijn geweest bij een eerder relatief recent besluit (19-08-2021) op grond van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de berichten ‘Fabrieken worden stilgelegd door energieprijzen en dat gaan we merken’ en ‘Europese metaalbedrijven vrezen permanente sluiting van fabrieken’

MP Dassen asked the minister about reports that energy-intensive factories, especially in metals and chemicals, are halting production due to high energy prices, and about which goods are critical, EU coordination, and safeguards against permanent closure. The minister answered that a study on the impact is underway with results promised before year-end, that halts are company-initiated and not yet causing shortages, and that Europe's decarbonisation of steel is the long-term route.
As promised in the Commission debate on business policy of 19 October, I will inform your House of the outcomes of this study before the end of the year.
Zoals toegezegd in het Commissiedebat Bedrijfsleven beleid van 19 oktober, zal ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek informeren voor het einde van het jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de motie-Omtzigt inzake vergoedingen voor energiebedrijven (Kamerstuk 36200, nr. 118)

MP Omtzigt asks the government how it implements two motions on the energy price cap: margin-based compensation for energy suppliers and handling of shared connections (blokaansluitingen), plus questions on tax changes and the timing of the cap. The minister answers that talks on margin testing are ongoing, a solution for shared connections has top priority under coordination by the Tax Authority, the 2023 cap is intended to start on 1 January 2023, and no further change to energy tax rates is currently planned.
Talks are currently being held with energy suppliers on how to arrive at some form of margin testing in implementing the 2023 price cap scheme.
Op dit moment worden gesprekken gevoerd met de energieleveranciers over hoe te komen tot een vorm van margetoetsing bij de uitvoering van de prijsplafondregeling voor 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over bericht ‘Beschermd bos als biomassa opgefikt: ‘Plundering’’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks whether wood pellets from protected Natura 2000 forests in Eastern Europe reach the Dutch market, whether woody biomass is sustainable, and whether the government should reduce its use. The minister says the leakage cannot be excluded, that the certification system worked according to an NEa investigation but can be improved, that woody biomass is needed for a climate-neutral economy, and that energy saving is a priority.
The cabinet will examine in the coming period how the NEa's advice can be incorporated into tightening the sustainability criteria.
Het kabinet zal de komende tijd bekijken hoe de adviezen van de NEa verwerkt kunnen worden in de aanscherping van de duurzaamheidseisen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over de schadelijke gezondheidseffecten van windturbines

An MP asks the Ministers of Health and of Climate and Energy whether BPA in wind turbine blades, released through erosion, harms health and water quality, and why turbines are still built. The government answers that residual BPA is very low (0.001 to 0.01%), that water is monitored with no signs of threat, and that a RIVM quickscan on emissions is pending, with the Chamber to be informed afterwards.
The Chamber will be informed once the quickscan is completed about which follow-up research and/or steps are deemed necessary.
De Kamer wordt geïnformeerd zodra de quickscan is afgerond over welke vervolgonderzoeken en/of stappen noodzakelijk worden geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Hagen over het bericht 'Nieuwe productiemethode maakt rotorbladen van windmolens goed recyclebaar'

Two MPs (Boucke and Hagen, D66) asked the government about recycling of wind turbine blades, the fate of decommissioned turbines, circularity in the energy transition, and related regulation and tenders. The minister answered at length, describing current recycling options, the TNO innovation, producer responsibility rules, and planned measures such as a national circular economy programme and circularity criteria in offshore wind tenders, but gave no firm numeric targets.
For stimulating R&D&I aimed at transitions, mission-driven innovation policy makes an important contribution.
Voor het stimuleren van R&D&I gericht op transities levert het missiegedreven innovatiebeleid een belangrijke bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het faillissement van Aldel te Delfzijl

An MP asked the minister about the bankruptcy of aluminium producer Aldel in Delfzijl, its job impact, what the government did to keep it alive, what options exist for other energy-intensive firms, and whether the government will find investors for a restart. The minister acknowledged the bankruptcy, explained that a prior state aid request was assessed under the framework and rejected for lack of political-social interest, said a broader impact analysis and framework will follow by year end, and stated that finding investors is not a government task.
Parliament was at the time informed about this in confidence.
Hierover is uw Kamer destijds in vertrouwen geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de uitspraken van de rechtbank over het behoud van contracten bij faillissement energieleverancier

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about court rulings on retaining energy contracts when a supplier goes bankrupt, the curator's sale of customer books, and how to better protect households. The Minister says the ACM is responsible for applying the rules, that the procedure for transferring customers will be clarified in lower regulation, and that the MP's policy proposals will be addressed in a separate letter.
The ACM has asked me to clarify the Besluit leveringszekerheid on this point.
De ACM heeft mij verzocht om het Besluit leveringszekerheid op dit punt te verduidelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de overname van contracten van failliete energiebedrijven zoals Welkom energie

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers about the takeover of customer contracts after the bankruptcy of Welkom Energie, including the ACM's role and whether Eneco was bound by the contracts. The minister answered that the courts, not the government, judge the specific case, that the ACM applies the rules independently, and that the Energy Act procedure for customer takeover at bankruptcy will be clarified, while refusing to revise earlier answers or assess the email, and postponing answers.
It is for the court to judge the specific circumstances of a given case.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen over de specifieke omstandigheden in een bepaald geval.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Madlener over het in Brussel bereikte principeakkoord over de uitfasering van de nieuwverkoop van personenvoertuigen en lichte bedrijfsvoertuigen met een interne verbrandingsmotor

PVV MPs Kops and Madlener asked the government to react to the EU agreement phasing out new petrol and diesel car sales by 2035 and to explain how ordinary motorists can keep driving and afford cars. State Secretary Heijnen defended the EU deal, said the 2035 phase-out does not ban existing cars, pointed to EV subsidies, a forthcoming IBO-klimaat review and studies of post-2025 scenarios, and did not accept the characterisations of policy as absurd.
Following the Bontenbal motion, I committed to the Chamber to develop scenarios for EV stimulation after 2025.
Naar aanleiding van de motie Bontenbal 2 heb ik de Kamer toegezegd om scenario’s voor EV-stimulering na 2025 uit te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Boucke en Boulakjar over het bericht 'Den Haag vindt na Gazprom geen gasleverancier, gemeente wil ontheffing'

MPs Boucke and Bloulakjar asked the energy minister about reports that municipalities must sign costly new gas contracts after Gazprom's Dutch-German arm was sanctioned, and whether exemptions and cost burdens are justified. The minister explains that the SEFE contracts fell under sanctions until Germany nationalised SEFE GmbH on 11 November 2022, that exemptions have been granted, that municipalities face extra costs of a few tons to a few million euros, and that the government will compensate those costs.
The cabinet cannot go into the details of the tender conducted by the municipality of The Hague. That is for the municipality of The Hague itself.
Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op de details van de gedane aanbesteding van de gemeente Den Haag. Dat is aan de gemeente Den Haag zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over het bericht dat gemeenten duurdere gascontracten moeten sluiten

MPs Inge van Dijk and Bontenbal asked whether Dutch municipalities should be forced to switch away from Gazprom-linked gas contracts, arguing this benefits Russia, and asked about costs and compensation. The minister answered that SEFE (formerly Gazprom Germania) was nationalised so existing contracts can be kept and no exemption is needed, while confirming municipalities will be compensated for extra costs incurred from switching.
That information is not available at my ministry and is commercially confidential, and was therefore also not shared with us by the company or the German government.
Die informatie is bij mijn ministerie niet aanwezig en is commercieel vertrouwelijk en dus ook niet gedeeld met ons door het bedrijf of de Duitse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht Minister dwingt gemeenten tot nieuwe dure gascontracten, geld gaat naar Rusland

Van Haga asks the Minister for Climate and Energy why municipalities were forced to terminate Gazprom Energy/SEFE gas contracts, raising costs and possibly sending more money to Russia, and whether compensation will be given. The Minister says the termination follows from the EU sanctions regulation, acknowledges the price effects and the subsequent German nationalisation of SEFE GmbH, promises compensation for costs from 10 October to 31 December 2022, and states that existing SEFE contracts may now be maintained.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Agnes Mulder en Haverkort over de rol van afvalenergiecentrales in Nederland

MPs Bontenbal, Agnes Mulder and Haverkort asked about the Royal HaskoningDHV report on waste-to-energy plants, the effects of the waste import levy on CO2 emissions, the role of waste incinerators in a climate-neutral system, CO2 capture and chemical recycling. State Secretary Heijnen answered that the levy reduced cross-border waste incineration, disputed the claimed emissions increase, and said incinerators will play a shrinking role as waste is shifted to higher-value recycling, while committing to examine how instruments can support both transitions.
The cabinet will examine in the coming period how instruments can be deployed to support both the transition to a climate-neutral economy and the transition to a circular economy.

Het kabinet zal de komende tijd bezien hoe instrumenten zo kunnen worden ingezet dat zij zowel de transitie naar een klimaatneutrale economie als de transitie naar een circulaire economie ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Boucke over het artikel 'Energieleveranciers laten bewoners met betaalproblemen massaal stikken: Schuldhulpverleners luiden noodklok'

MPs Kat and Boucke asked whether energy suppliers refuse payment arrangements for customers with payment problems, risking disconnection and derailing debt relief, and what the government will do. Minister Schouten answered that suppliers sometimes refuse arrangements, that amended disconnection rules from 26 October 2022 require suppliers to make extra efforts to reach customers and offer reasonable arrangements, and that a temporary emergency fund and a planned court-imposed payment arrangement bill are in preparation.

If a debt counsellor's proposal receives no response, the debt counsellor can point to the energy supplier's obligation to make extra efforts to reach customers and offer a reasonable and appropriate payment arrangement.

Indien er niet wordt gereageerd op een voorstel van een schuldhulpverlener, kan de schuldhulpverlener wijzen op de verplichting die de energieleverancier heeft om een extra inspanning te leveren om contact te krijgen met de klanten en om een redelijke en passende betalingsregeling aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het artikel 'Energieplafond drijft prijzen en subsidies verder op'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about an FD op-ed arguing that the temporary energy price cap drives up prices and subsidies, including suppliers coordinating higher prices, welcome gifts used to attract customers, and whether suppliers are compensated in advance. The minister rejected collusion claims, said volume limits and independent accountant checks guard against overcompensation, and said welcome bonuses are allowed under current law while the ACM plans new rules, though he did not commit to dropping advance compensation or a cost-only model.
An independent accountant also checks the relevant costs and, where there is reason to, improperly charged costs can be reclaimed afterwards.
Er vindt ook een controle plaats op de relevante kosten door een onafhankelijke accountant en waar daartoe aanleiding is, kunnen onterecht in rekening gebrachte kosten achteraf worden teruggevorderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de marktordening van Carbon Capture and storage (CCS)

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister how the market structure for CO2 storage under the North Sea should be shaped, including public versus private roles, the market-power risks of Shell and TotalEnergies in the Aramis project, and whether an external analysis of the market design exists. The minister answered that private market parties should lead, with EBN retaining a role for long-term storage liability, that open access rules and SDE++ subsidies limit market-power risks, and that an independent adviser was asked only to map current bottlenecks rather than an external market-design analysis.
I am also in discussion with the Norwegian government to record agreements for this, insofar as necessary.
Ik ben ook in gesprek met de Noorse overheid om, voor zover nodig, afspraken hiervoor vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Boucke over de voorbereidingen op de boycot op Russische olie

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about preparations for an EU boycott of Russian oil, covering supply shortages, strategic reserves, import and sector use, and crisis instruments. The minister mostly referred to a separate letter on Dutch preparations and gave statistics and a general description of the Landelijk Crisisplan Olie.
For the answer to this question I refer you to the parliamentary letter on the Dutch preparation for oil sanctions against Russia, pages 5 to 9.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrief Nederlandse voorbereiding op oliesancties tegen Rusland, pagina 5 t/m 9.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de potentieel desastreuze gevolgen van de gascrisis voor de industrie

An MP from JA21 asked ministers about the risk that the gas crisis could cause uncontrolled industrial shutdowns, including whether gas shortages can be ruled out at a 90 percent storage fill level and what contingency measures apply. The minister answered that the GTS conditions for avoiding shortages are currently met, that the Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas is being operationalised, and that a study of the impact of high energy prices on industry will be shared before year-end, though several questions were answered only in part or deferred.
By the end of the year I will come with a new update on the Gas Protection and Recovery Plan.
Voor het einde van het jaar kom ik met een nieuwe update rond het Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het Energy Charter Verdrag

An MP asked the minister about the modernised Energy Charter Treaty, the secrecy of the negotiated text, and calls to withdraw, including the Teunissen motion. The minister answered that the modernisation is insufficiently ambitious, that the government intends to withdraw from the treaty and will push for coordinated EU withdrawal, but declined to publish the negotiated text, which will be viewable only confidentially by MPs.
As promised during the two-minute debate on 19 October, the text of the modernised treaty will be available for confidential inspection by members of the House of Representatives.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het tweeminutendebat op 19 oktober jl., zal de tekst van het gemoderniseerde verdrag vertrouwelijk in te zien zijn voor leden van de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel 'Europe’s heavy industry takes action to tackle energy crisis'

An MP asked the minister to reflect on an FT article about energy-intensive industry under high energy prices, whether the gas-curtailment plan covers gas-intensive sectors, whether a European curtailment plan is needed, whether fixteams for energy saving will be set up, and whether a German-style energy-efficiency network will be started. The minister answered that impacts vary by sector, that supply chain effects are considered, that the curtailment strategy is being coordinated with Belgium and Germany, that fixteams are mainly for households with a micro-business pilot, and that a business-park decarbonisation pilot will start this year.
This year we will start a pilot for an accelerated programme for sustainability of business parks.
Nog dit jaar zullen wij van start gaan met een pilot voor een versnellingsprogramma verduurzaming bedrijventerreinen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over de berichten 'Hoe de industrie steeds onder energiebesparing uit wist te komen' en 'Aanpak energiebesparing bij bedrijven faalt'

An MP from D66 asked the ministers about press reports that industry escaped energy-saving obligations, including why the Netherlands exempted ETS firms, whether lobbying occurred, and how enforcement and monitoring work. Minister Jetten answered most questions substantively, admitted weak enforcement and some gaps, and committed to tightening the obligation from 2023 and reporting further by year end, while declining to create a separate monitor or to state some figures.
With the tightening of the energy saving obligation, supervision of the energy saving obligation will be assigned to a single regional body.
Met de aanscherping van de energiebesparingsplicht wordt het toezicht op de energiebesparingsplicht belegd bij één regionale instantie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de bewuste stellingname van Shell geen plannen te maken om net zero emission te bereiken binnen de komende tien à twintig jaar en doorgaat met het zoeken naar nieuwe olie en gas

MP Kröger asks the government how it views Shell's stated lack of plans to reach net zero within 10 to 20 years and its continued search for new oil and gas, including the court ruling requiring a 45% CO2 cut by 2030 and Scope 3 emissions. The minister answers that the government holds Shell to EU and national climate targets, declines further comment while the appeal is pending, notes Shell's low-carbon initiatives, and states the government remains committed to the Paris goals.
As long as the appeal is before the court, I refrain from further comment.
Zolang het hoger beroep onder de rechter is, onthoud ik mij van verder commentaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de regeling Tegemoetkoming Energiekosten en de maatregelen vanaf november

Van Haga asked why the cabinet waited months to act on high energy costs for energy-intensive SMEs, whether it had failed them, and how Parliament can scrutinise support options before November. The minister acknowledges the problem, explains the TEK scheme is retroactive from November with payouts expected in Q2 2023 due to feasibility and EU approval, and points to tax deferral and bank bridge financing as interim help, but does not share the options before the consultation.
For these energy-intensive enterprises I have announced the Tegemoetkoming Energiekosten (TEK scheme).
Voor deze energie-intensieve ondernemingen heb ik de Tegemoetkoming Energiekosten (TEK-regeling) aangekondigd.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de 190 euro regeling voor huishoudens in november en december 2022

MP Omtzigt asked about the 190 euro per month energy allowance for small-scale consumers in November and December 2022, including its budget authorisation, cost estimates, households without small-consumer connections, and legal protection for individuals. Minister Jetten answered that the budget was raised to 3.15 billion euro after a VAT correction, that the government relied on an urgency provision (art. 2.27(2) Comptabiliteitswet) to bypass prior parliamentary approval, and that consumers have a right via their supplier, though some households in shared connections may not be reached.
For authorisation, the cover letter to the Ninth supplementary budget invoked the second paragraph of article 2.27 of the Comptabiliteitswet because of the high urgency of the expenditure.

Ter autorisatie is in de aanbiedingsbrief bij de Negende incidentele begroting (Kamerstuk 36 220 ) een beroep is gedaan op het tweede lid van artikel 2.27 van de Comptabiliteitswet vanwege de hoge urgentie van de uitgaven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over ‘Voor Chinese apparatuur is geen plaats in het stroomnet’

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about Chinese involvement in the electricity grid, including state influence on Chinese energy firms, national security safeguards at TenneT, oversight of grid operators' tenders, unfair subsidised competition, supply-chain dependencies and future legal adaptation. The government answers that safeguards are being built into the new Energy Act, a defence-and-security procurement regime and a veiling framework, that the Finance Minister will check TenneT investments as shareholder, and that further research on Chinese influence is under way, while stating it has no visibility into sub-suppliers and that regional grid operators fall outside the shareholder check.

The cabinet is therefore investing in greater knowledge of and insight into concentrations of (among other things) control in the wider supply chains, with the aim of limiting as far as possible the supply-chain effects of undesirable influence.

Het kabinet investeert daarom in meer kennis van en zicht op concentraties in (o.a.) zeggenschap in de bredere ketens, met als doel de keteneffecten van ongewenste invloed zo veel mogelijk te beperken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Bontenbal over de berichten 'Steeds meer productie wordt stilgelegd vanwege de hoge energieprijs' en 'De Croo: 'We dreigen in oorlogseconomie te belanden als EU niet ingrijpt''

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that production is being halted due to high energy prices and about the risk of a war economy. The minister answered that some firms have curtailed output, that industrial production has so far held up overall, and that targeted support (TEK scheme, Dutch price cap, EU temporary crisis framework) and a letter on energy-intensive industry are in preparation.
As announced in the Business Policy committee debate of 19 October, I will therefore send Parliament a letter before the end of the year on energy-intensive industry addressing the current situation.

Ik zal zoals aangekondigd in het Commissiedebat Bedrijfslevenbeleid van 19 oktober, daarom voor het einde van het jaar een brief aan uw Kamer sturen over de energie-intensieve industrie waarin op de huidige situatie zal worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het energieplafond en blokverwarming

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about how the energy price cap and the 190-euro allowance apply to households on shared heating (blokverwarming) and shared connections, plus transparency on their energy costs. The minister answers that tenants can request cost information under the Civil Code, that a specific scheme for block connections is being developed, that the 190-euro subsidy is per connection and may need to be shared, and that the regulations were issued urgently without prior parliamentary review.
For 2023 the cabinet aims for a specific allowance for households with block connections (heat and electricity).
Voor 2023 streeft het kabinet naar een specifieke tegemoetkoming voor huishoudens met blokaansluitingen (warmte en elektriciteit).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen, Agnes Mulder, Dassen en Boucke over het bericht “COP27: Egypt pressed to make human rights move before climate summit”

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA, CDA, Volt and D66 asked the government about reports that Egyptian authorities restrict civil society and that many Egyptian organisations could not register for COP27, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about shrinking civic space, has raised accreditation inclusiveness and human rights with Egypt bilaterally and at EU level, but stressed that UNFCCC and Egypt as host carry the responsibility for participation.
The Netherlands, like other European countries, urges both bilaterally and multilaterally for an inclusive COP27 without participating organisations having to fear oppression or repercussions.

Nederland dringt, net als andere Europese landen, zowel bilateraal als in multilateraal verband, aan op een inclusieve COP27 zonder dat deelnemende organisaties hoeven te vrezen voor onderdrukking of repercussies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Stoffer over energie uit water

Two MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the role of energy from water (wave, tidal and related technologies) in the Dutch economy, the energy transition, EU targets, funding and innovation, and co-use of offshore wind farms. The minister answered that Dutch geography limits the potential, that wave energy and Dynamic Tidal Power warrant further study, that no commitment to the EU 100 MW target will be made, and pointed to existing EU and national funding and an ongoing EU-SCORES research project.
Therefore I will have follow-up research carried out on this.
Daarom laat ik hier vervolgonderzoek naar uitvoeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis over uitvoering van de motie van de leden Grinwis en Stoffer over onderzoek naar de opbrengst van Dynamic Tidal Power-energiedammen in zee (Kamerstuk 32813, nr. 793)

MPs Grinwis and Stoffer asked why motions on researching Dynamic Tidal Power dams and an energy-from-water innovation programme had not yet been carried out. Minister Jetten answers that further research on DTP is being commissioned and that a programme depends on its outcome, with DTP's costs and impacts judged high against other options.
The motion by MPs Grinwis and Stoffer on researching the yield of Dynamic Tidal Power energy dams at sea is being implemented.
Aan de motie van de leden Grinwis en Stoffer over onderzoek naar de opbrengst van Dynamic Tidal Power-energiedammen in zee wordt uitvoering gegeven.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de regels voor het beginnen van een energiebedrijf en het toezicht op kleine energiebedrijven door de ACM

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about the ease of obtaining a supply licence from the ACM, the practice of reselling energy under another company's licence, a flexible-rate long-term contract offered by a supplier, and consumer protection. The Minister replies that licensing requirements have been tightened through new policy rules, that the ACM supervises licensed suppliers who are liable for resellers, and that the ACM is revising the early-termination fee guidelines and further measures will follow under the Energy Act.
It is the ACM that assesses licence applications and supervises licence holders, including licence holders that sign energy contracts through resellers.
Het is de ACM die aanvragen van vergunningen beoordeelt en toezicht houdt op vergunninghouders, ook op vergunninghouders die via wederverkopers energiecontracten sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga  over 45.000 Brabantse huishoudens die buiten het prijsplafond vallen

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about reports that 45,000 Brabant households, including those with block heating, students and shared housing, may fall outside the energy price cap and face evictions. The minister acknowledged the concern and said he is working with RVO.nl, the Tax Administration and suppliers on a solution, while warning that a guarantee for everyone by 1 January cannot be given.
Yes, I share this concern and that is why I indicated in my letter to your House of 4 October 2022 that I am making every effort to come up with an appropriate solution for exceptional cases
Ja, ik deel deze zorg en daarom heb ik in mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 4 oktober 2022 aangegeven dat ik mij tot het uiterste inspan om met een passende oplossing te komen voor uitzonderingsgevallen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het prijsplafond voor energie en verwarming met propaan

Van Haga asked whether households and businesses heating with propane, who fall outside the energy price cap, will get a separate scheme, and whether they can join the TEK business support scheme. Minister Jetten said no separate scheme is planned due to limited time and data, that propane is excluded from TEK because of practical differences, and that some businesses may claim electricity support.
Because a relatively small share of households uses propane gas and the cabinet has little insight into its consumption and costs, realising a supplementary scheme for propane users is not feasible.

Doordat een relatief klein deel van de huishoudens gebruik maakt van propaangas en het kabinet weinig zicht heeft op het verbruik en de kosten hiervan, is het realiseren van een aanvullende regeling voor gebruikers van propaan niet haalbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Agressieve verkoper van energiecontracten start eigen energiemaatschappij. Radar Checkt!'

An MP asks the Minister about the energy supplier HEM, its five-year variable-rate contracts, whether ZZP-ers can be sold them, how a firm can sell energy without a licence, and how ACM oversight and consumer protection can be tightened. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says ACM oversees licensing and supplier conduct, points to stricter licensing rules in force since 4 October 2022 and forthcoming Energiewet provisions, and says courts or the dispute committee handle exit fees.
Tightening supervision of suppliers and setting additional requirements is urgently needed and has my full attention.
Het aanscherpen van toezicht op leveranciers en het stellen van extra eisen is hard nodig en heeft mijn volle aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heerema en Erkens ver het artikel 'Amateurclubs rekenen op taaie winter door hoge gasprijzen: ‘Sommige leden douchen júíst hier'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the impact of high gas and energy prices on sports facilities, especially swimming pools and ice rinks, and what support is available. The minister acknowledged the strong impact, cited a Mulier Institute survey and NOC*NSF estimates (including 200 pools at risk of closure), noted a 378 million euro cost increase for 2022-2023, and pointed to sustainability support and ongoing consultations with operators and municipalities.
That is why I asked operators of sports facilities to calculate the size of the cost increase, from which the figure you cited follows.
Daarom heb ik exploitanten van sportaccommodaties gevraagd om een berekening te maken van de omvang van de lastenstijging, waaruit het door u genoemde getal volgt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Sjoerdsma, Boulakjar en Boucke over het bericht dat beide Nord Stream pijpleidingen vlak na elkaar zijn stuk gegaan en dat seismologische bureaus van Denemarken en Zweden hevig

MPs from D66 asked whether the Nord Stream pipeline explosions were sabotage, whether Russia could invoke force majeure, whether the Netherlands would push the EU to phase out Russian gas, and how Dutch offshore pipelines and infrastructure would be protected. The government answered that sabotage is almost certain but attribution is not yet possible, outlined EU gas-reduction measures and infrastructure protection plans, and promised a separate letter on North Sea protection.
It is almost certain that this was a sabotage action.
Het staat vrijwel zeker vast dat het hier een sabotageactie betrof.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Erkens, Brekelmans over het bericht 'Norway oil safety regulator warns of threats from unidentified drones'en het bericht 'Duitse media: lek Nord Stream vrijwel zeker sabotage 'do

MPs Valstar, Erkens and Brekelmans asked the government about reports of unidentified drones near Norwegian offshore gas infrastructure and reports that sabotage by a state actor was likely behind the Nord Stream leak, including questions on Russian vessel activity and NATO protection. The Foreign Minister answered that a real threat to vital undersea infrastructure exists but declined to disclose suspicious activity, said the Baltic and Nordic investigations must determine responsibility, and described NATO and Norwegian protective measures and Dutch work on mapping vulnerabilities.
For security reasons, the Netherlands in principle never makes statements about suspicious activities.
Nederland doet vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen in principe nooit mededelingen over verdachte activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht 'Energy union or deindustrialisation'

MP Dassen (Volt) asked the ministers for Climate and Energy and for Economic Affairs about articles on energy prices causing deindustrialisation in Europe, and about the merits of a European Energy Union, a pan-European supergrid, a shared gas purchase and a European shutdown plan. Minister Adriaansens acknowledged the concern over high energy prices, said the government will inform parliament before year-end on the impact on industry, rejected the shutdown-plan and full Energy Union positions in part, and called the supergrid study's 32% savings figure uncertain.
As promised in the Business Policy committee debate of 19 October, I will inform your House before the end of the year about the impact of higher energy prices on industry.
Zoals toegezegd in het Commissiedebat Bedrijfslevenbeleid van 19 oktober jl., zal ik uw Kamer voor het einde van het jaar informeren over de impact van de gestegen energieprijzen op de industrie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Nijboer en Kröger over hoge energietarieven voor nieuwe klanten

MPs Thijssen, Nijboer and Kröger asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether it is acceptable that new customers pay up to three times more for energy than existing customers, and whether energy suppliers shift risks onto new customers or use postcode-based risk assessments.
