The minister acknowledged the unfairness, said the ACM is revising early-termination fee rules and suppliers will offer fixed contracts again in 2023, and referred to general income-support measures, while denying knowledge of postcode-based risk profiling.
I share the view that it is galling when people who have to move pay three times as much for energy as existing customers.
Ik deel de mening dat het wrang is als mensen die moeten verhuizen drie keer zo veel moeten betalen voor energie als bestaande klanten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Klink over het bericht dat de Europese Unie voornemens is een waterstofbank in het leven te roepen

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that the EU plans a hydrogen bank with three billion euros and whether it could be located in the Netherlands. The minister answered that little is known yet, that the Commission is still developing the concept, that the government will monitor it and may align with Germany's H2Global, and that a full assessment must await more concrete information.
Little is yet known about the planned hydrogen bank.
Er is nog weinig bekend over de voorgenomen waterstofbank.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over mensen die afgesloten worden van energie en het beleid om dit te voorkomen

MPs Marijnissen and Leijten asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how many households have been disconnected from gas or electricity despite the government's pledge of no winter disconnections, and what measures prevent it. The minister said data do not show total disconnections for wanbetaling, announced a tightened disconnection regulation with mandatory payment-arrangement offers until 1 April 2023, and said the ACM and dispute bodies supervise compliance.
Grid operators only have insight into the numbers of end-of-supply signals they receive from suppliers and the number of disconnections carried out by grid operators.
Netbeheerders hebben alleen inzicht in de aantallen «einde leveringssignalen» die zij vanuit leveranciers ontvangen en de aantallen afsluitingen (door netbeheerders).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de salderingsregeling

An MP asked the energy minister whether the net-metering scheme's costs are socialised across non-solar households, whether the EU approved it, and whether it complies with the Electricity Directive. The minister confirmed costs are passed on to all customers, said a cost model could be requested from suppliers but is commercially sensitive, and argued the scheme is compliant with the directive.
However, this concerns commercially sensitive information and is difficult to verify.
Wel is het zo dat dit bedrijfsgevoelige informatie betreft en lastig te verifiëren is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat Eneco snoeit in de vergoeding voor teruglevering van stroom

MP Leijten asked the minister whether Eneco's cut in the feed-in compensation for solar electricity is unfair to households and how to prevent other suppliers following suit. The minister replied that suppliers must pay a reasonable compensation supervised by the ACM, proposed a 80% statutory minimum and an absolute maximum from 2025, and said Eneco would reverse the cut for fixed contracts.
Currently this provision applies to a limited number of small consumers who generate electricity with solar panels.
Momenteel geldt deze bepaling voor een beperkt aantal kleinverbruikers die elektriciteit opwekken met zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Grinwis over 'Eneco schroeft vergoeding voor terugleveren zonnestroom flink terug'

Two MPs asked the minister about Eneco sharply cutting the feed-in compensation for solar power and whether this and other suppliers' practices require stronger consumer protection or ACM investigation. The minister confirmed Eneco will reverse the cut for fixed contracts, said ACM supervises reasonable compensation, and announced intent to set a legal minimum of 80 percent of the bare supply tariff from 2025, possibly earlier by decree.

My intention is, from the perspective of consumer protection, to set the statutory minimum of the reasonable compensation for fed-back electricity, from the phase-out of the netting scheme (2025), at 80 percent of the bare supply tariff.

Mijn voornemen is om, uit het oog van consumentenbescherming, het wettelijk minimum van de redelijke vergoeding voor teruggeleverde elektriciteit met ingang van de afbouw van de salderingsregeling (2025) vast te stellen op 80 procent van het kale leveringstarief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over de terugleververgoeding van zonnestroom

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about Eneco cutting the feed-in compensation for solar power, whether a minimum compensation should be set, and how batteries, sharing and dynamic tariffs could be encouraged. The minister said he has no insight into Eneco's pricing, plans to set a legal minimum of 80 percent of the bare supply tariff and an absolute maximum, and promised a battery policy roadmap in Q1 2023.
I have no insight into how Eneco arrived at this feed-in compensation. That concerns commercially sensitive information.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoe Eneco tot deze terugleververgoeding is gekomen. Dat betreft bedrijfsgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Kops over het bericht 'Chronisch zieken hebben weinig baat bij het prijsplafond: ‘Het voelt als een oneerlijke strijd’'

PVV MPs Agema and Kops asked how the government will address chronically ill and disabled people who cannot afford energy bills, including whether the energy price cap can be raised or differentiated for high medical energy use. The minister acknowledged the hardship, said differentiation within a price cap is not feasible, pointed to municipal Bijzondere Bijstand and other measures, and promised to inform parliament on a related motion.

In reply to your questions 5 and 6, the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport will inform Parliament about the motion by MP Van der Plas et al. on energy compensation for higher energy costs due to medical causes.
Als antwoord op uw vraag 5 en 6 zal de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) het Parlement informeren over de motie van het Kamerlid Van der Plas c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over investeringsplannen van de fossiele industrie

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the government about fossil fuel companies' investment plans (the 'carbon bombs' reported by The Guardian) and whether the government would act internationally to stop them, given the Paris Agreement. The minister acknowledges the climate risks, says the plans are incompatible with Paris if the figures hold, and lists existing policy and coalitions, but declines to provide an overview of Dutch-linked investment plans and does not join the Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance.
That data is not public and the cabinet therefore does not keep track of it.
Die data zijn niet openbaar en houdt het kabinet dus ook niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Bontenbal over de stijging van het aantal korte vluchten van en naar Nederlandse luchthavens

MPs Van der Molen and Bontenbal asked the government about the rise in short private and government flights from Dutch airports, including whether cabinet members set an example and whether flights without passengers can be curbed. Minister Harbers answered that government has no control over private flights, that a cabinet-wide guideline on short government flights is being drafted, and that no legal basis or policy exists to restrict specific flights, though the impact on climate will be examined.
Furthermore, research has started into establishing an interdepartmental guideline regulating the use of the government aircraft for short flights and/or repositioning flights.
Verder is een onderzoek gestart naar de realisatie van een interdepartementale richtlijn, die het gebruik van het regeringsvliegtuig voor korte vluchten en/of positioneringsvluchten reguleert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Bontenbal over ‘De kosten van energieverbruik van medische apparaten’

MPs Van den Berg and Bontenbal asked whether insurer reimbursement for oxygen equipment electricity costs is adequate, given that a concentrator may cost thousands of euros a year to run. The minister calculated about 18 cents per hour in electricity costs against roughly 6 cents per hour reimbursed, said he had informed insurers and would monitor their policy, but made no firm commitment to retroactive or minimum reimbursement.
I have pointed out this issue to health insurers and provided them with the calculation set out in the answer to question 3.
Ik heb zorgverzekeraars gewezen op deze kwestie en hen voorzien van de berekening zoals weergegeven in het antwoord op vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'The backdoor that keeps Russian oil flowing into Europe’

An MP asked the ministers whether Shell and other firms blend Russian fuel into diesel to evade the appearance of Russian origin, and what the government would do about it. The minister answered that origin is assessed case by case under EU customs rules, that no signals of breaches by Shell were found, that indirect Russian oil may still enter the mix, and that the government is preparing possible further sanctions and a phase-out plan, but the answer was given late.
I have no signals that Shell, or other European parties, are not complying with the European sanctions rules.
Ik heb geen signalen dat Shell, of andere Europese partijen, zich niet aan de Europese sanctieregels houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Essent maakt stroom en gas flink duurder'

An SP MP asks the government whether Essent's sharp energy tariff increases from 1 October 2022 are close to the planned price cap, whether agreements were made with suppliers, who monitors supplier purchase prices, and how overcompensation and profit-taking via the cap will be prevented. The minister replies that the ACM monitors reasonableness of supplier tariffs and that the cap is designed to avoid over- and undercompensation, but gives no commitments to freeze tariffs or new interventions.
I see no need to take earlier measures that intervene in the interim in the price formation of individual suppliers.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om eerder maatregelen te nemen die tussentijds ingrijpen ten aanzien van de prijsvorming bij individuele leveranciers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over de zorgen van Netbeheerder Nederland over het rampscenario van 1 miljoen huishoudens de worden afgesloten omdat ze hun energierekening niet meer kunnen betalen

SP MPs Marijnissen and Leijten asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether he agrees that the worst case is one million households being disconnected for unpaid energy bills, what will prevent this, and whether the climate fund can relieve energy costs. The minister answered that the cabinet is pursuing income-support measures and tightened disconnection protections, that the energy-price measures are separate from the climate fund, and that saving energy and tackling price rises are complementary.
This tightening means the supplier must make every effort to contact the customer and offer the customer an appropriate payment arrangement.
Deze verruiming houdt in dat de leverancier zich tot het uiterste moet inspannen om met de klant in contact te komen en de klant een passende betalingsregeling moet bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het verhogen van de tarieven door energiemaatschappijen

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers whether energy suppliers raising tariffs from 1 October on only 10 days' notice break the 30-day notice rule, whether consumers must pay higher direct-debit amounts, and how consumers can enforce their rights. Minister Jetten answered that the ACM was asked to enforce the rules, that most large suppliers reversed their increases, that consumers can complain or go to the Geschillencommissie or court, and that the ACM cannot order refunds.
They can also report to the ACM that the supplier is not complying with the rules.
Ze kunnen ook bij de ACM melding maken dat de leverancier zich niet aan de regels houdt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid het lid Dassen over het bericht ‘Scholen die gedwongen hun energiecontract opzegden zijn tot twaalf keer duurder uit’

An MP asked the ministers about reports that schools forced to terminate energy contracts face up to twelve times higher costs, asking about the scale of bills, financial risks, monitoring, compensation and energy-efficiency targets for school buildings. The minister replied that no national overview of energy contracts or school finances exists, that a targeted support motion is being implemented with a report due by 1 December, that schools can report acute liquidity problems to the ministry, and that monitoring relies on annual accounts plus a sample inquiry.
There is no national overview of which school boards have which energy suppliers or what prices they pay.
Er is geen nationaal overzicht welke schoolbesturen welke energieleveranciers hebben of welke prijzen zij betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Thijssen, Peters en Bontenbal over het artikel 'Scholen die gedwongen hun energiecontract opzegden zijn tot twaalf keer duurder uit'

Four MPs asked the ministers about schools forced to cancel energy contracts with Gazprom and face sharply higher costs, including the scale of the problem, scenarios, quality of education, building insulation and inequality. The minister answered that no national overview exists, that schools in acute liquidity problems can report to OCW, that a motion asks for targeted support to be reported by 1 December, and that a subsidy scheme for sustainable public buildings opens on 3 October.
There is no national overview of which school boards have which energy suppliers.
Er is geen nationaal overzicht welke schoolbesturen welke energieleveranciers hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het prijsplafond energie en de toegezegde voorbeelden tijdens de Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about how the energy price cap would work for various household types, including large families, the chronically ill, heat network users, residents of apartment blocks with central heating, heat pump users, monument residents and holiday parks, and about the compensation paid to suppliers. The minister answered with estimated bills with and without the cap, said suppliers would receive at most the gap between their advertised price and the cap, and listed existing support measures while admitting some cases (heat networks, shared connections) remain difficult to resolve.
The cabinet will ensure in the design of the scheme that any excessively paid compensation can be recovered if the planned audit gives cause for it.
Het kabinet zal in de vormgeving van de regeling waarborgen dat eventueel te veel vergoede middelen terug kunnen worden gehaald indien de beoogde accountantscontrole hier aanleiding toe geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht 'Energiebedrijven wijken niet: laat aangekondigde prijsverhogingen gaan door'

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the minister why energy suppliers were still raising prices on 1 October despite rules against it, and whether he would stop the increases. The minister replied that the regulator ACM had told suppliers to comply and could enforce, and that the five largest suppliers had withdrawn their increases; he did not directly commit to blocking them himself.
It is up to the independent regulator Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) to start any investigation into possible legal violations.
Ik heb ook aangegeven dat het aan de onafhankelijk toezichthouder Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is om een eventueel onderzoek te starten naar mogelijke wettelijke overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het rapport 'What is a fair emissions budget for The Netherlands'

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the government to respond to an NCI report arguing that the Netherlands' fair share of the carbon budget requires near-zero emissions by 2030, and whether current climate targets are consistent with the Paris Agreement. The minister rejected the report's conclusions and methodology, maintained that the national targets are in line with the 1.5°C goal and the Paris Agreement, and committed to aligning public export credit support with the COP26 declaration without giving a firm new date.

No. According to the cabinet, the tightened Dutch climate targets for 2030 (at least 55% and aiming for 60% reduction) and 2050 (climate neutral, i.e. net-zero greenhouse gas emissions) are, based on the IPCC, in line with the 1.5-degree goal of the Paris Agreement.

Nee. Volgens het kabinet zijn de aangescherpte Nederlandse klimaatdoelen voor 2030 (ten minste 55% en streven naar 60%-reductie) en 2050 (klimaatneutraal oftewel netto-nul-broeikasemissies) op basis van het IPCC in lijn met het 1,5 gradendoel van het Akkoord van Parijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de komst van het energiebedrijf Gunvor naar Nederland met mogelijke betrokkenheid van Vladimir Poetin

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked whether President Putin has a stake in Gunvor, which plans a green hydrogen terminal in Rotterdam, and whether its establishment is acceptable given sanctions. The minister answered that no indications of Putin ownership were found, that Gunvor's ownership is held by Torbjorn Törnqvist, that existing screening and investment checks cover sanctions compliance, and that no measures against the plan are currently justified.
Based on the currently available information, there are no indications that this is the case.
Op basis van de thans beschikbare informatie zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat hiervan sprake is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het bericht ‘Klanten van budget Energie geschokt door prijsverhoging van honderden euro’s per maand’

An MP asked whether energy suppliers may raise advance payment amounts faster than tariffs, whether ACM should monitor such increases, and whether consumers lose their money if a supplier fails. The minister answered that advance payments are agreed in contracts and should match annual bills, that consumers can object or complain to ACM ConsuWijzer, that failed-supplier claims follow bankruptcy law, and that ACM supervises markets generally but does not enforce individual contracts.
It is not for ACM to enforce compliance with individual agreements on advance payment amounts in private contracts between suppliers and their customers.
Het is niet aan de ACM om naleving van individuele afspraken over de hoogte van voorschotbedragen in private contracten tussen leveranciers en hun klanten af te dwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de stijgende energierekening en het functioneren van de energiemarkt

The CDA MP Bontenbal asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about rising energy bills, energy suppliers withdrawing fixed-term contracts, restrictive sign-up practices, margin calls and ACM supervision of suppliers. The Minister answered most questions in substance, confirmed existing rules and ACM's tightened financial supervision, and promised talks with ACM on fixed contracts and margin calls.
Over the past winter the ACM had external experts examine whether it could do more to protect consumers against possible financial problems of energy suppliers.
De ACM heeft afgelopen winter door externe experts laten onderzoeken of zij meer kan doen om consumenten te beschermen tegen mogelijke financiële problemen van energieleveranciers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het ontbreken van vaste contracten in de Nederlandse energiemarkt

An MP asked the minister why energy suppliers no longer offer fixed-price contracts, whether low exit fees and the lack of a fixed model contract are to blame, and whether the ACM and suppliers can be pressed to restore them. The minister says fixed contracts are undesirable, agreed with suppliers that fixed contracts return in 2023 once the ACM sets exit-fee rules, and is willing to discuss a mandatory fixed model contract with the ACM.
As stated in the letter to parliament on additional energy bill measures (20 September 2022), I have agreed with energy suppliers that fixed contracts will be offered on the market again in 2023

Zoals genoemd in de Kamerbrief over aanvullende maatregelen energierekening (van 20 september 2022) heb ik met energieleveranciers afgesproken dat er weer vaste contracten in de markt zullen worden aangeboden in 2023
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over meerdere ontwikkelingen op het gebied van kernenergie

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked the minister about private small modular reactor initiatives, industrial clusters' interest in nuclear power, the Limburg study, government funding for nuclear innovation, Belgian investment and European SMR cooperation. The minister answered that SMRs are a possible complementary energy source, that existing funds and instruments are open to nuclear innovation, and that research and international cooperation will continue, without committing to new structural changes.
Instead, they should specialise in nationally relevant themes and cooperate in areas where interests are shared.
In plaats daarvan moeten ze specialiseren op nationaal relevante thema's en samenwerken op gebieden waar gedeelde interesses zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de ISDE-regeling

An MP asked whether ISDE subsidy applications are unusually high, how much of the 2022 budget is used, why single insulation measures get a lower subsidy, who applies for single measures, whether linking the Warmtefonds to ISDE helps, and whether the one-year maximum gap between measures will be relaxed. The minister confirmed higher application volumes, expected a budget overrun of 30 to 60 million euros, defended the tiered subsidy design, and said the one-year gap may be extended in the 2023 amendment.
Therefore I will monitor this in the coming period and am considering options to increase the budget.
Daarom zal ik dit de komende periode in de gaten houden en bezie ik de mogelijkheden om het budget te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het weigeren van dhr. Van Roost (voormalig CEO Esso Nederland) om voor de parlementaire enquêtecommissie te verschijnen

An MP asked whether a former ExxonMobil executive refusing to appear before the Groningen gas parliamentary inquiry was morally objectionable, and whether government contact with ExxonMobil should be halted. The State Secretary agreed witnesses affecting Groningen should cooperate, noted no legal obligation exists for non-Dutch residents abroad, said he would personally contact ExxonMobil, and rejected halting contacts given its role as shareholder.
I note that where persons do not have Dutch nationality and live abroad, there is no obligation to cooperate under the Parliamentary Inquiry Act.
Ik merk daarbij op dat wanneer personen geen Nederlandse nationaliteit hebben en in het buitenland wonen, er op grond van de Wet op de parlementaire enquête geen verplichting tot medewerking bestaat.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over de subsidieregeling Indirecte kostencompensatie ETS die zij stelden naar aanleiding van berichtgeving van de Europese Commissie over haar goedkeuring van deze regel

MPs Kröger and Thijssen asked why the government sought EU approval for an indirect ETS cost compensation scheme worth up to €835 million for about 62 energy-intensive firms without first consulting parliament, and whether firms should bear carbon price risk themselves. The minister answered that the scheme is delegated legislation not requiring parliamentary involvement, that only the 2022 budget is currently covered, and that the scheme carries a 3% CO2 reduction obligation with clawback if firms fail to comply.
The reason the subsidy scheme was not submitted to the House is that this concerns delegated legislation in which parliament has no formal involvement.
De reden dat de subsidieregeling niet aan de Kamer is voorgelegd is dat dit gedelegeerde wetgeving betreft waarbij het parlement in casu geen formele betrokkenheid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over aangescherpte vereisten voor regelvermogen (aFRR) en effecten op de energierekening van huishoudens

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether tightened aFRR balancing-capacity requirements (activation within five minutes from 1 July 2022) reduce gas and coal plants' supply, raise TenneT's costs and household energy bills, and whether implementation should be postponed. The minister answered that the rules follow EU regulation, that supply has not significantly fallen, that prices rose sharply in July 2022, that detailed cost and pass-through figures are confidential or uncertain, and that the rules cannot be postponed nationally.
The compensation TenneT pays on average and per provider is competitively sensitive.
De vergoedingen die TenneT gemiddeld en per aanbieder betaalt zijn concurrentiegevoelig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de vergoedingen die netbeheerders betalen voor duurzaam opgewekte stroom

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about grid operators' payments for renewable electricity they could not feed into the national grid, including redispatch costs, their pass-through to consumers, and whether grid reinforcement and new wind farm connections should be halted. The Minister replied that TenneT's 2021 redispatch costs in the Netherlands were EUR 336 million (EUR 188 million to June 2022), that costs are regulated by the ACM and largely passed to grid operators' customers, that grid capacity cannot yet meet demand so a specific stop on wind projects is not desirable, and that non-firm connection contracts are being proposed to the ACM.
Given current conditions on the energy market, it is not possible for TenneT to give an outlook on how redispatch costs will develop in the coming period.
Gezien de huidige omstandigheden op de energiemarkt is het voor TenneT niet mogelijk om een vooruitblik te geven over hoe de redispatchkosten zich de komende tijd gaan ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de energieprijzen, over de plannen voor leveringszakerheid en betaalbaarheid van energie, over het afsluitbeleid van kleinverbruikers

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about the energy security and affordability strategy, the risk of blackouts, the cost pressure on low-income households, disconnection rules for small consumers, and LNG imports from Russia. The minister points to earlier letters and debates, existing crisis plans and cross-border arrangements, and describes the existing disconnection safeguards and support measures, without providing a single published strategy document.
I refer you to the transcript of the committee debate of 9 June 2022 on energy supply and security of supply, which contains a list of these letters.
Ik verwijs u graag naar het verslag van het Commissiedebat d.d. 9 juni 2022 over voorzienings-en leveringszekerheid energie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over fouten in energienota bij teruglevering zonnepalenen

An MP asked whether some energy suppliers net metering over quarters rather than a full year, whether this is lawful, and what tariff applies when netting solar feed-in. The minister confirmed signals of quarterly netting, stated that the intended and historically applied rule is annual netting, and announced an amendment to make this explicit in the Elektriciteitswet 1998 bill, with general administrative orders possibly setting rules for the calculation.
I therefore intend to make this explicit by amending article 31c of the Electricity Act 1998 in the present bill through an amendment note.
Ik ben dan ook van plan dit expliciet te maken door via een nota van wijziging in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel artikel 31c van de Elektriciteitswet 1998 hierop aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Marijnissen over de prijscap op energie

MPs Omtzigt and Marijnissen asked the government about the planned energy price cap, its costs, who it covers, safeguards against excess profits by energy companies, and related consultations. Minister Jetten answered that a price cap from 1 January 2023 is planned with volume limits and maximum tariffs, costs are not yet exact and will be funded partly from energy tax cuts, and the government intends to bar disconnections this winter, while many answers refer to a separate letter and some consultation details are not shared.
Given the short deadline for answering, for further explanation of this answer I refer briefly to my letter of 20 September 2022.
Gegeven de korte termijn die is gesteld voor beantwoording, verwijs ik voor verdere uitleg van dit antwoord kortheidshalve naar mijn brief van 20 september 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de hoge gasprijs in Nederland in vergelijking tot de rest van de Europese Unie

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy why Dutch gas prices are higher than the EU average, whether Groningen gas explains this, and whether taxes and windfall revenue could be used to lower household costs. The Minister answered that the comparison is based on a limited sample of new-customer offers and is not representative of prices paid, that gas prices are set internationally, and that the government already cut energy taxes and will announce 2023 measures on Prinsjesdag.
The questions have been answered as quickly as possible.
De vragen zijn zo snel als mogelijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Erkens, Heinen, Tielen en Grinwis over het artikel 'Al 20 jaar geregeld tekort aan isotopen voor kankerbestraling: waarom het probleem maar niet wordt opgelost'

MPs from VVD and ChristenUnie asked about the status of the PALLAS isotope reactor in Petten after an EenVandaag report on chronic shortages of medical isotopes, and whether government pre-financing or a first-loss facility could fund such projects. The minister described reserved funds of 1.29 billion euro, remaining conditions, expected production around 2030, and said the final decision on the 330 million euro gap is expected in spring 2023, with the Growth Fund also considered.
The cabinet expects to make a definitive decision on the investment in the PALLAS project in spring 2023.
Het kabinet zal naar verwachting in het voorjaar van 2023 een definitief besluit nemen over de investering in het PALLAS-project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de Nederlandse gasprijs als hoogste in Europa

MPs Kops and Wilders (PVV) asked why Dutch households face the highest gas prices in Europe, questioning the government's energy relief and whether energy is affordable. Minister Jetten answered that the government is concerned, that cross-country comparisons are incomplete, that about EUR 7 billion of purchasing-power measures were taken with a focus on vulnerable households, and that further targeted measures will be announced on Prinsjesdag.
Parliament will be informed about this on Prinsjesdag.
Hierover wordt uw Kamer met Prinsjesdag geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over gaswinning in Nederland

An MP asked why GasTerra, 50% state-owned, sold almost all Dutch gas to foreign buyers under long-term contracts, and asked for the contracts and prices to be made public. The minister answered that the contracts are private, commercially sensitive, and cannot be shared with MPs, while explaining the legal constraints, market pricing and the government's energy-bill support measures.
No. These are contracts between private parties containing commercially sensitive information.
Nee. Het betreft hier contracten tussen privaatrechtelijke partijen met commercieel gevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Kröger over de doorwerking van groothandelprijzen in gas en energie bij huishoudens en de weerslag hiervan op koopkracht

MPs Maatoug and Kröger asked how the government monitors hardship from high energy prices, and why the CPB will not update its cost-of-living box or model uneven inflation across income groups. The minister points to CPB stress tests, a TNO energy-poverty programme, forthcoming CBS and Divosa monitors, and says the CPB judges such updates methodologically infeasible, with extra instruments promised in the Prinsjesdag purchasing-power letter; answers to questions 1-8 are deferred.
The request was to answer these questions before Prinsjesdag. Full answers are not yet possible within that timeframe.
Het verzoek was om deze vragen voor Prinsjesdag te beantwoorden. De volledige beantwoording van de vragen is nog niet mogelijk op die termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht Duitsland redt energiegigant Uniper en schrapt rechtsgang Nederland

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether Uniper had withdrawn its arbitration claim against the Netherlands, about RWE's claim, contacts with the companies, nationalisation of energy suppliers, and why failed suppliers were not rescued. The minister said the arbitration is suspended pending Uniper's shareholder approval, the Dutch lawsuit continues, nationalisation does not lower consumer prices, and the existing supplier-failure system ensures continuity, with a review of financial requirements promised.
I do not see nationalising an energy supplier as a solution to high supply prices or to improve the functioning of the energy market.
Het nationaliseren van een energieleverancier zie ik niet als oplossing voor hoge leveringsprijzen en/of om de werking van de energiemarkt te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over het artikel 'EBN deed bod om gasopslag Bergermeer te nationaliseren'

Two MPs asked the minister why the government blocked EBN's bid to take over TAQA's stake in the Bergermeer gas storage, what analyses underlay that, and whether nationalisation would help supply security and allocation in shortages. The government answered that a larger ownership share would not improve storage filling, that the analyses are confidential, and that it instead subsidises market parties and tasks EBN with filling Bergermeer.

Because these documents contain, among other things, confidentially obtained commercially sensitive information and information that could harm the financial and economic interests of the state, we can only share the information confidentially with your House.

Omdat deze stukken onder meer vertrouwelijk verkregen bedrijfsgevoelige informatie en informatie die de financiële en economische belangen van de staat kan schaden bevat, kunnen wij de informatie alleen vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'hoge prijzen leiden tot miljardenwinst voor olie- en gasbedrijf Shell'

An MP from the CDA asked the government how it views Shell's large profits and share buybacks during the energy price crisis, whether a solidarity levy should be introduced, and how state participation EBN could be expanded. The minister answered that a levy on fossil producers is being examined with a decision due on Prinsjesdag, that the state already receives about 70% of domestic oil and gas profits, and that Shell has committed to investing in the energy transition in the Netherlands.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Kops over de dieselvoorraad in Nederland

MPs Madlener and Kops asked the government about diesel and other fuel stocks in the Netherlands, the risk of shortages if Russian oil is boycotted, and crisis plans, including bunker supplies for shipping. The minister answers that strategic stocks still cover about 85 days of domestic demand, that restocking is starting, that the Landelijk Crisisplan Olie is being updated, and that import data is publicly available.
At this moment, the restocking and expansion of these strategic stocks is being started.
Op dit moment wordt gestart met het opnieuw aanvullen en uitbreiden van deze strategische voorraden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het volle stroomnetwerk in Limburg en Noord-Brabant

MP Thijssen asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about grid transport shortages in Limburg and North Brabant, their effects on businesses, municipalities and households, and progress on measures such as faster grid expansion, connection prioritisation and better use of existing capacity. The minister explained that demand for grid capacity caused congestion, that new large-connection requests are on hold, and pointed to ongoing measures and a forthcoming Energiewet, while declining to give timelines for some measures and referring to a separate letter on prioritisation.
I have informed your House in the letter on grid transport scarcity in the Netherlands of 9 September about how I intend to handle prioritisation.
Ik heb uw Kamer in de Kamerbrief Transportschaarste op het elektriciteitsnet in Nederland van 9 september geïnformeerd hoe ik met de prioritering om wil gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Bedrijfsleven waarschuwt tegen sleutelrol China in energietransitie'

An MP asked the minister about dependence on China for the energy transition, including Boskalis joint ventures with Chinese firms, sourcing of critical materials, and gas production from small fields. The minister answered that the government screens investments and tenders for strategic dependencies, pursues EU open strategic autonomy, and will publish a geo-economic monitor by end 2022 but not specifically on energy-transition materials.
The aim is to publish the geo-economic monitor at the end of 2022.
Het streven is om de geo-economische monitor eind 2022 te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Netbeheerder TenneT zet afname en opwek stroom van bedrijven stil'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about grid congestion on the TenneT network in Limburg and Noord-Brabant, including whether an independent investigation, faster permitting and prioritisation are planned. The minister answered that congestion was known, that the Court of Audit has examined it, that a special coordinator and taskforce were appointed, that the Energiewet will be sent to parliament by year end, and that the situation cannot be structurally resolved in the short term.
The Court of Audit recently conducted research into transport scarcity on the electricity grid.
De Algemene Rekenkamer heeft recent onderzoek gedaan naar de transportschaarste op het elektriciteitsnet

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Omtzigt over het eerdere totaal ontwijkende antwoord op de vraag hoeveel olie en andere brandstoffen Nederland uit Rusland importeert en het bericht 'Who’s Still Buying Fossil Fuel

MPs Piri and Omtzigt asked why the government earlier gave an evasive answer on Russian oil and fuel imports, and about reports that the Netherlands is a leading importer of Russian gas and that Russian-origin oil reaches Europe via Indian diesel. The minister answers that the CREA figures are modelled rather than official customs data, that monthly customs data is only available up to April 2022 and some data is withheld for competitive reasons, and that the government is pursuing phase-out and EU sanctions while acknowledging Indian diesel of Indian origin falls outside the sanctions.
As indicated in the answer to question 2, the information for the Visual Capitalist image was produced by the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA).
Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 2 is de betreffende informatie voor de afbeelding van Visual Capitalist geproduceerd door het Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de samenwerking tussen Nederland en Noorwegen op het gebied van klimaat en energie

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how the Netherlands can learn from Norway on climate and energy, about hydrogen cooperation, the climate impact of Norwegian gas versus LNG, and possibilities for more gas imports. The minister described long-standing cooperation on CCS, offshore wind, hydrogen and the NordNed cable, but said there is no realistic scope to increase Norwegian gas imports in the coming period.
On balance, I see no possibilities to achieve more natural gas imports from Norway in the coming period.
Per saldo zie ik geen mogelijkheden om de komende periode meer aardgasimport uit Noorwegen te laten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht dat er 8 olietankers met Russische fossiele brandstof op weg zijn naar de havens van Rotterdam en Amsterdam

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether eight tankers carrying Russian fossil fuels bound for Rotterdam and Amsterdam could be refused entry, and whether the government would act against such vessels. The government answered that Dutch law under current EU sanctions does not allow refusal of non-Russian-flagged tankers, that an EU oil import ban will take effect after transition periods, and that it has no further legal grounds to block the ships.
At present it is not possible for the government to refuse non-Russian-flagged ships carrying Russian oil products.
Van regeringswege is het op dit moment niet mogelijk om niet-Russisch gevlagde schepen met Russische olie(producten) te weren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de gedelegeerde verordening met eisen voor hernieuwbare waterstof

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister for Climate and Energy, in 13 questions, how the EU delegated regulation defining renewable hydrogen (eligibility rules on electricity sourcing, additionality, bidding zone and hourly matching, and import rules) would affect hydrogen rollout and market development in the Netherlands. The Minister replies that the rules leave sufficient room for Dutch hydrogen ambitions, that they are needed for clarity and will be applied to imports too, and that a certification pilot with RVO will be run this year.
Adopting unambiguous European requirements for the production, import and use of renewable hydrogen is an essential condition for rapid development of the hydrogen market in the short term.

Het aannemen van eenduidige Europese eisen voor productie, import en gebruik van hernieuwbare waterstof is een essentiële voorwaarde voor een snelle ontwikkeling van de waterstofmarkt op de korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het beleid op het gebied van waterstof

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about hydrogen import diversification, import targets, the role of H2Global and long-term contracts, domestic production, and strategic hydrogen storage. The minister answered that an import strategy is still being developed, that fixed country-share targets are not yet feasible or needed, that options such as H2Global and a strategic storage model are being explored, and that a decision or report will follow later.
A maximum percentage per country (or type of country) for the share in total hydrogen imports is not currently necessary and also not feasible.
Een maximum percentage per land (of soort landen) voor het aandeel in de totale import aan waterstof is nu niet nodig en ook niet goed uitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Erkens over het artikel 'Hacker ontdekt dat Chinese zonnepanelen een bedreiging zijn voor ons stroomnet'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a report that Chinese solar inverters could threaten the electricity grid, and about dependence on foreign technology in vital infrastructure. The government answered that it shares concerns about state-actor cyber threats, points to existing and planned EU and national rules (NIS, RED, Cyber Resilience Act, Netcode on Cybersecurity, Vifo screening), and promises a scan of foreign-origin equipment in vital infrastructure in response to a motion, with timing still under exploration.
At present the Ministry of Justice and Security, together with the departments concerned, is exploring how to follow up on the motion.
Op dit moment wordt door het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, in samenwerking met de betrokken departementen, verkend op welke manier opvolging kan worden gegeven aan de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat de ACM instemt met de aanleg van een privaat net voor zonneparken in Groningen

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister about ACM approving a private grid for 500 MW of solar parks in Groningen that connects directly to TenneT's high-voltage network, raising concerns about grid congestion workarounds, criteria for exemptions, and the non-discrimination principle. Minister Jetten answered that closed distribution systems are a long-established option, that the register shows no clear rise in exemptions, that ACM applies statutory criteria, and that the non-discrimination principle is not breached, but committed to talks with ACM and grid operators on whether more regulatory control is needed.

I will therefore enter into discussions with ACM and grid operators on this subject and investigate whether there is a risk that market parties build closed distribution systems solely for these reasons

Ik zal daarom met ACM en netbeheerders in gesprek treden over dit onderwerp en onderzoeken of er een risico bestaat dat marktpartijen uitsluitend om deze redenen gesloten distributiesystemen aanleggen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de gevolgen van de keuze voor Amerikaans schaliegas als alternatief voor Russisch gas voor het behalen van onze klimaatdoelen

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the climate and methane consequences of importing US shale-based LNG to replace Russian gas, and whether long-term contracts or commitments had been made. The government answered that the market decides, that the Dutch state and the European Commission made no binding supply agreements with US gas companies, and that climate targets remain in force while the methane and LNG risks are judged acceptable in the short term.
The Dutch State has not made any agreement whatsoever with American gas companies.
De Nederlandse Staat heeft geen enkele afspraak met Amerikaanse gasbedrijven gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het nieuwsbericht ‘Nederland wil nog dit jaar van gas en kolen uit Rusland af’

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the government's plan to end imports of Russian gas, coal and oil, including oil blending, gas storage filling and emergency gas supply plans for winter. The minister answered that oil import bans are being pursued at EU level, gas storage will be filled with low-calorific gas, and further information and advice on winter scenarios will follow.
I will inform your House about this when deciding on gas extraction from the Groningen field for the 2022–2023 gas year.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover informeren bij de besluitvorming over de gaswinning uit het Groningenveld voor het gasjaar 2022–2023.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Boulakjar over het bericht 'Rusland knijpt ook gaskraan naar Duitsland af, olieprijs naar 125 dollar per vat'

MPs Boucke and Boulakjar asked whether Gazprom's reduced gas deliveries to Germany via Nord Stream 1 were political, how long the reduction would last, and what it meant for Dutch gas storage and LNG supply after the Freeport explosion. The minister confirmed the reduction, said the July maintenance was planned, noted that Germany's supply security was not yet affected and that Dutch storage filling was proceeding, and declined to disclose confidential commercial contracts while pointing to the fully contracted Eemshaven LNG terminal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the minister why no companies are named under the gas protection plan, how much gas the 60 largest consumers and the flower sector use, whether a gas-saving tender was discussed, and why the plan's shutdown step is not applied and CO2 emissions rise. The minister answered that no specific companies are named, consumption data is confidential or outdated, a gas-saving tender is being studied, shutdown is only possible in an emergency, and a productie restriction was withdrawn to protect gas supply, with supplementary measures promised by Prinsjesdag.
Due to the commercially confidential nature of information on gas consumption, I cannot make any statement about individual connections to the gas network.
Vanwege het bedrijfsvertrouwelijke karakter van informatie omtrent gasverbruik kan ik geen uitspraak doen over individuele aansluitingen op het gasnet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Chroom 6 aangetroffen in grondwater bij Tata Steel’

An SP MP asked the ministers about reported chromium-6 contamination of groundwater at Tata Steel, the lack of health protection, the implementation of a motion on health gains, the smoke incident, the timeline for sustainability agreements, and subsidies. The government answered that the GGD sees no health risk because there is no exposure, that the environmental service has ordered follow-up research and tightened permits, and that binding maatwerk agreements depend on a complete business case, so no firm timeline is given.
However, I will not make concessions on a careful assessment of the business case; I will not take irresponsible risks with taxpayers' money.
Ik ga echter geen concessies doen aan een zorgvuldige beoordeling van de business case, ik ga geen onverantwoorde risico's nemen met belastinggeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Thijssen over de Klimaatcrisis-Index van Milieudefensie

MPs Kröger and Thijssen asked the Minister for Climate and Energy to react to Milieudefensie's Climate Crisis Index, which found no major polluter adequately addressing climate change, and asked about tackling scope 3 emissions and imposing climate obligations on firms receiving public green funds. The minister responded that the responsibility lies with companies and financial institutions supported by government instruments such as the EU ETS, CO2 levy, the planned EU due diligence directive and sector agreements, that scope 3 is addressed through subsidies and EU state-aid reform, and that subsidised firms are already bound by emission-reduction conditions.
When companies receive public funds for sustainability, these are already tied to conditions such as greenhouse gas emission reduction or circularity.
Als bedrijven publieke middelen ontvangen voor verduurzaming, zijn deze reeds gerelateerd aan voorwaarden zoals bijvoorbeeld broeikasgasemissiereductie of circulariteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de gasopslag Norg

The MP Bontenbal asked why the Norg gas storage was not filled beyond 80% and whether a higher fill level would ensure supply security and affect other storage sites. The minister answered that a negative summer-winter spread removes the commercial case for filling, so the government will subsidise further filling, while the effect on prices is hard to predict and other storage sites will be filled to at least 80%.
The cabinet will work out a subsidy to further fill the Norg gas storage.
Het kabinet gaat een subsidie uitwerken om Gasopslag Norg verder te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Noodlijdend Uniper dringt bij Duitsland aan om snel extra geld'

An MP asked the minister for Climate and Energy about Uniper's request for German state support, the Dutch energy market, the bankruptcies of energy suppliers last winter, supervision by the ACM, and consumer protection. The minister said the Dutch market is unlikely to face a similar situation, that the ACM has tightened supervision with extra financial requirements, and that research on consumer protection in case of supplier bankruptcy is near completion.
The ACM has in the meantime tightened its supervision for this autumn with additional requirements.
De ACM heeft inmiddels het toezicht voor dit najaar met extra eisen aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het hacken van windturbines

An MP asked the minister about cyberattacks on wind turbines, including five turbines along the Oude Maas standing still for months, and how many attacks occurred and how they were handled. The minister answered that the Nordex attack affected office IT rather than turbine control hardware, that no overview of cyberattacks on wind energy exists, and described existing reporting and oversight rules for essential service providers, plus national security conditions for offshore grid contractors.
There is no overall overview of (attempted) cyberattacks on specific sectors such as wind energy.
Er bestaat geen algeheel overzicht van (pogingen tot) cyberaanvallen op specifieke sectoren zoals windenergie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over groen gas uit niet biogene stromen

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked whether current SDE+/SDE++ rules limit subsidised green gas to biogenic feedstock (capping non-biogenic input at 5% and 2.5%), whether gasification could broaden supply, and whether flexibility could be created. Minister Jetten confirmed the rules, said he would have PBL advise and consider opening the category in SDE++ 2023, but rejected retroactive changes to existing decisions.
I have asked PBL to advise on this for the SDE++ round of 2023.
Ik heb PBL gevraagd om hier voor de SDE++ ronde 2023 advies over uit te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Energieleveranciers moeten btw-verlaging direct doorberekenen'

An SP MP asked whether energy suppliers should pass the VAT cut on to households directly, arguing that customers must act themselves to benefit and many will not claim it. The State Secretary replied that suppliers will show the VAT cut in advance payments as far as possible, that a broad lowering of advance payments is undesirable, and that the government is in contact with suppliers on payment problems, without committing to a binding rule.
Broadly lowering advance payments is undesirable.
Het breed verlagen van voorschotten is onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over overlast door transformatorstation TenneT in Krimpen a/d IJssel

An ChristenUnie MP asked the ministers about noise nuisance from a TenneT transformer replacement at the Krimpen a/d IJssel substation and why the northern site was chosen. The minister answered that the permit is a municipal matter, that TenneT justified the northern location with noise reductions and lower costs, and that participation of residents is a condition for good spatial planning.
Assessing the permit application is a municipal matter.
De beoordeling van de vergunningaanvraag is een gemeentelijke kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over opschaling van de groen gas productie in Nederland

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about scaling up green gas production, including targets, techniques, subsidies, permitting delays and RePowerEU options. The Minister answered that the 2 bcm 2030 ambition is firm, that a higher target will be examined by end-2022, and that permitting and subsidy barriers are being addressed through a range of measures.
Nevertheless, in line with my commitment to MP Erkens during the Climate & Energy committee debate of 24 March 2022, I will examine in the Green Gas Programme whether a higher ambition is feasible.
Desalniettemin zal ik, in lijn met mijn toezegging aan het lid Erkens, tijdens het CD Klimaat & Energie d.d. 24 maart 2022, in het Programma Groen Gas onderzoeken of een hogere ambitie haalbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van der Woude over het artikel 'Interesse in kerncentrales groeit, maar: waar zijn de nucleair specialisten?'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a shortage of nuclear specialists for planned nuclear plants, including staffing estimates, plans to strengthen knowledge infrastructure, and recruitment from abroad. The minister answered that no shortage estimate is possible yet, described an interdepartmental study and working group, and promised letters to parliament later in 2022 on results.
No estimate can be made in advance of a possible shortage of workers for the construction of new nuclear power plants.
Er is op voorhand geen inschatting te maken van een eventueel tekort aan arbeidskrachten voor de bouw van nieuwe kerncentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over de winsten van oliebedrijven

CDA MPs asked the government whether it considers oil company profits from high energy prices morally acceptable, whether share buybacks and higher dividends are acceptable, what a reasonable profit is, and whether companies invest enough in the energy transition and should contribute more. The minister answers that the government has no moral judgement on lawful profits, that companies may use profits as they see fit, that it will steer investment through carbon pricing, subsidies and tailored agreements, and gives no view on a reasonable profit level.
In general, the cabinet has no moral judgement on profits that profit-seeking companies make, as long as this happens within the rules and they pay fair tax on them.
In algemene zin heeft het kabinet geen moreel oordeel over winsten die bedrijven met een winstoogmerk boeken, zolang dit binnen de regels gebeurt en zij hierover een eerlijke belasting afdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de financiële voordelen van kernenergie

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about a Groningen study claiming nuclear power is financially and climate-wise more efficient than offshore wind and solar, and challenges the government on nuclear plans and wind subsidies. The Minister answers that studies on the future energy mix and nuclear's role are pending for the summer, that nuclear is not excluded, and that no subsidies are currently given for offshore wind parks, while concrete nuclear plans will be informed before the summer recess.
I will inform you about that before the summer recess.
Ik informeer u daarover voor het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over mogelijke financiële modellen voor de te bouwen kerncentrales

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Climate and Energy which financing models for new nuclear plants are used in Europe, whether a state holding should be created, and how various schemes (SDE++, CfD, RAB, Mankala, CAPEX) compare. The minister answered that several models are being studied, that a state holding would be a far-reaching step only used when other instruments are insufficient, and that a parliamentary procedure with a 30-day notification would apply, with further findings promised in the autumn.
I expect to give the House more insight in the autumn into which schemes work well abroad and how applicable they are to the Dutch situation.
Ik verwacht de Kamer in het najaar meer inzicht te geven over welke regelingen goed werken in het buitenland en in hoeverre deze toepasbaar zijn op de Nederlandse situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de antwoorden op eerder gestelde vragen over de gasopslag in Bergermeer

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister and State Secretary about Gazprom's control rights over the Bergermeer gas storage, whether the contracts will be shared with parliament, whether Gazprom can delay filling, why no filling obligation was imposed, what steps are being taken to end Gazprom's 40% usage right, and what additional measures will follow German escalation. The government answers that Gazprom holds a 5% participating interest with limited decision rights, the agreements are confidential and under discussion, Gazprom cannot block filling, a filling obligation was judged risky, legal options are being examined with the state advocate, and weekly fill-level updates will be provided.
The Gas Storage Agreement and Joint Operating Agreement were provided to me confidentially by EBN because they contain commercially confidential information.
De Gas Storage Agreement en Joint Operating Agreement zijn vertrouwelijk door EBN aan mij verstrekt omdat deze bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over de veiligheid van maritieme en energie gerelateerde activiteiten op de Noordzee

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about safety measures around offshore wind farms for shipping and energy supply, including ship collisions, risks to energy supply, and innovative solutions. The minister outlined existing and planned measures (ERTVs, Kustwacht oversight, MOSWOZ research, Programma Noordzee 2022-2027), said a full wind-farm outage is unlikely and that no specific scenarios or new integral study are planned, while committing to further collision-consequence research with results expected in 2023.
A follow-up study is underway. The next interim results are expected in the first half of 2023.
Een vervolgonderzoek loopt. De eerstvolgende tussenresultaten worden in de eerste helft van 2023 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de openbaarmaking van documenten in ICSID zaak nr. ARB/21/4 (RWE v. Koninkrijk der Nederlanden)

MP Van Raan asked when the RWE arbitration request, claim and damages report would be made public, whether RWE and the Dutch government were acting as openly as promised, and why publication was delayed. The minister answered that the government seeks maximum transparency, that publication of the key documents was delayed for months because RWE and the Netherlands could not agree on redactions, and that RWE had now indicated agreement so documents could be published soon.
On 28 December 2021 the Netherlands asked RWE to make public the request for arbitration, the memorial and all exhibits, including the damages report and conversion analysis.
Op 28 december 2021 heeft Nederland RWE verzocht tot openbaarmaking van het verzoek tot arbitrage, de memorial en alle producties, waaronder het schaderapport en ombouwanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eppink en Eerdmans over het gunnen van een groot offshore windproject aan Chinese staatsbedrijven

JA21 MPs Eppink and Eerdmans asked why TenneT awarded the BorWin6 offshore wind grid connection to a consortium including Chinese state-owned firms and what safeguards exist against Chinese control of critical energy infrastructure. The ministers answered that TenneT retains ownership and control of the grid, that the project is German and not directly linked to Dutch critical infrastructure, that the contract is binding under EU procurement rules, and that the government is working on the Energiewet to give TenneT more tools to exclude suppliers in future tenders.
Organising tenders and then awarding contracts to market parties is the responsibility of TenneT's executive board.
Het organiseren van aanbestedingen en vervolgens de gunning van contracten aan marktpartijen is de verantwoordelijkheid van de raad van bestuur van TenneT.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Erkens en Van Strien over het artikel Chinese bedrijven azen op het Europese stroomnet

MPs Erkens and Van Strien asked whether Dutch policy adequately guards the energy grid against undesirable influence from Chinese and other non-European firms, and what tools exist. The minister answered that existing investment screening (Vifo, sectoral tests, public ownership of grid operators) and procurement rules apply, while a new Energy Act will add security-based procurement options and the government will review arrangements with TenneT and monitor the situation.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate will, among other things, review the current arrangements and frameworks with TenneT and make adjustments where necessary.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en klimaat zal onder meer de huidige afspraken en kaders met TenneT tegen het licht houden en zal daar waar nodig aanpassingen doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de gevolgen van het Energy Charter Treaty (ECT)

MP Van Raan asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about the Energy Charter Treaty, including whether the Netherlands favours withdrawal, whether ISDS claims could hamper climate policy and oil and gas phase-out, and the risks from Dutch and bilateral investment treaties. The Minister says the Netherlands wants modernisation aligned with the EU mandate with withdrawal as a fallback, and argues that investment treaties do not restrict climate policy, while declining to inventory potential claims.
The Netherlands is currently examining the legal aspects of the various scenarios, including withdrawal.
Nederland is momenteel de juridische aspecten van de verschillende scenario's, waaronder uittreding, aan het onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over terugtrekking uit het Energiehandvestverdrag

An SP MP asked the climate and energy minister whether the Energy Charter Treaty conflicts with the Paris Agreement, whether Netherlands is preparing withdrawal, how intra-EU arbitration can ignore the Komstroy ruling, and about the climate risks of EU modernisation proposals, RWE/Uniper claims and ministerial contacts with those companies. The minister answered that the treaty is not fully aligned with Paris and that legal scenarios including withdrawal are being studied, but declined to detail contacts with RWE and Uniper because the matters are pending before courts or arbitration.
Matters currently before the courts or pending before the arbitration tribunal are not discussed in mutual contact.
Zaken die op dit moment onder de rechter zijn of bij het arbitragetribunaal aanhangig zijn, worden in onderling contact niet besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Wat te doen met ons kernafval?’

An SP MP asked the government, in 13 questions, about nuclear waste storage at COVRA, the Asse II salt mine and the timing of final disposal around 2130, and whether new nuclear plants are responsible. The State Secretary answered that the surface storage is safe, that stress tests and periodic safety reviews show no need for extra flood measures, that no foreign disposal sites are planned, and that the polluter-pays principle applies, without committing to new action.
The policy for radioactive waste was recently evaluated.
Het beleid voor radioactief afval is recent geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de bouw van het Datacentrum Zeewolde

The MP Grinwis asked ministers about the planned Meta hyperscale data centre in Zeewolde, including the government's ability to stop it, the sustainability conditions for selling state land, and the use of farmland and grid capacity. The minister answered that a preparatory decision restricts new hyperscale data centres, that TNO found the plan does not yet meet the sustainability conditions so the state land cannot be sold yet, and that legal tools to block the already adopted zoning plan are currently unavailable.
I myself asked the State Advocate for advice on my legal options to still stop the hyperscale data centre in Zeewolde.
Zelf heb ik de Landsadvocaat om advies gevraagd over mijn juridische mogelijkheden om alsnog het hyperscale datacenter in Zeewolde tegen te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de ondergrondse opslag van CO2

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about CO2 capture and storage, questioning its cost, the Porthos subsidy, safety risks, and comparisons with failed projects. The Staatssecretaris answered that CCS is a necessary technology for climate targets, that Porthos subsidy is a maximum commitment budget likely to be lower in practice, and that storage risks are judged acceptable under mining law, but gave no firm total subsidy figures.
It is therefore not possible to state now how much subsidy will be spent on CCS in the coming years.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk nu aan te geven hoeveel subsidie besteed gaat worden aan CCS in de komende jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Brekelmans over de afhankelijkheid van Russisch gas voor Poetins oorlogsdrift

MPs Erkens and Brekelmans asked how dependent the Netherlands is on Russian gas and oil, who owns or operates related infrastructure, and how quickly dependence could be cut. The government answered that Russian gas is an estimated 15% of consumption, that Gazprom holds a usage right and gas cushion gas at Bergermeer storage but no ownership of key infrastructure, that commercial data cannot be shared, and that it will inform the House further on Bergermeer and work with EU partners and the REPowerEU plan.
The share of Russian gas in the purchasing portfolios of European energy companies is private commercially sensitive information and not publicly accessible.
Het aandeel Russisch gas in de inkoopportefeuilles van Europese energiebedrijven is private commercieel gevoelige informatie en niet publiekelijk toegankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Thijssen en Piri over de gevolgen van de oorlog in Oekraïne voor gaslevering

Three PvdA MPs asked the minister about gas supply risks from the war in Ukraine, including scenarios for a halt in Russian gas, low storage levels, and the Groningen phase-out. The minister answered at length, referring to ENTSO-G outlooks, the Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas, storage subsidies and earlier Kamerbrieven, while committing to share future analyses with the Kamer.
As soon as new ENTSO-G analyses are public, they will be shared with the Kamer.
Zodra er nieuwe analyses van ENTSO-G openbaar zijn, zullen die met de Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Sylvana Simons over het meest recente IPCC-rapport in relatie tot Bonaire, Statia en Saba

MPs Van Raan and Simons asked the government about the latest IPCC report and its implications for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including climate adaptation, water safety, the 1.5-degree target, and energy transition. The government answered that the report lacks a Caribbean-specific assessment, that these islands are largely excluded from national climate laws and plans, and that a sustainable energy route map is promised before the summer recess.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Klanten van failliete energiebedrijven krijgen niet de beste deal bij nieuwe leverancier'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy why customers of bankrupt energy suppliers end up with expensive contracts, how supplier prices and margins are set and made transparent, and whether the regulator ACM should get powers to intervene earlier. The minister answered that suppliers set their own tariffs subject to a reasonableness test by ACM, that margins are confidential but ACM checks them, and that a study on strengthening consumer protection and supplier requirements is underway with results expected around summer.
At present I am having a study carried out into the possibility and desirability of improving the position of the consumer in the event of a bankruptcy.
Op dit moment laat ik een onderzoek uitvoeren naar de mogelijkheid en wenselijkheid om de positie van de consument te verbeteren ingeval van een faillissement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over een mogelijk gastekort deze winter en het uitwerken van verschillende scenario’s hiervoor

MP Erkens (VVD) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about preparedness for a possible Russian gas boycott, including scenarios, volumes, load-shedding timing and the Gas Protection and Recovery Plan (BH-G). The government answered at length, describing monitoring with market parties, Entso-G stress-test scenarios, the three crisis levels and the emergency measures ladder, while stating that some quantitative figures cannot be given precisely.
It cannot be said how much gas the protected consumers in total take.
Het is niet te zeggen hoeveel gas specifiek de beschermde afnemers in totaal afnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de samenwerking met het Verenigd Koninkrijk op het gebied van klimaat

An MP asked the climate minister about Dutch-UK climate cooperation after Brexit, including hydrogen, electricity market coupling, CBAM and a shared CO2 market. The minister answered that cooperation continues via COP, coalitions and the Trade and Cooperation Agreement, with exploratory work on hydrogen, electricity coupling and a North Sea energy MoU still in progress.
The cabinet is positive that the Commission is seeking alignment with third countries on the CBAM.
Het kabinet is positief over het gegeven dat de Commissie afstemming met derde landen zoekt ten aanzien van de CBAM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over de huidige situatie omtrent de kolencentrales

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked about extra gas use, storage fill levels, compensation costs, CCS feasibility and cost, alternative fuels for coal plants, and whether the Urgenda emission target will be met. The minister answered with estimates (2.5 to 3 bcm extra gas per year, storage fill rise of about 7 percentage points per bcm), declined to give an exact compensation figure pending a letter before summer, and said the Urgenda target is becoming likely for 2022.
As promised, I will send a letter on coal before the summer.
Zoals toegezegd kom ik voor de zomer met een brief over kolen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van der Lee, Kröger, Piri en Thijssen over het bericht dat Rusland stopt met het leveren van aardas aan Polen en Bulgarije

MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about Russia halting gas supplies to Poland and Bulgaria, Dutch firms' dealings with Gazprom and Gazprombank, EU and Dutch preparedness for next winter, and whether Russian state firms like Gazprom can be sanctioned out of the Dutch energy system. The minister answered that Dutch firms' use of Gazprombank and new Gazprom contracts is unknown, that the Dutch plans are set out in earlier letters, that the Bergermeer storage cost levy is still being designed, and that the legal options to exclude Russian firms are under study with a further letter promised.
The House will be further informed about this.
Hierover wordt uw Kamer nog nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Maatoug en Kröger over klimaatbanen

GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about a Eindhoven proposal for a national climate-jobs coalition, targets, retraining support, fragmented funding, technical training shortages, and a motion on vocational education. The government answered that it will examine the proposals within an upcoming action plan (aanvalsplan) for technical skills, promising letters to parliament, but gave largely general responses without firm targets.
Before the summer you will receive a letter with the substantive elaboration of the action plan.
Voor de zomer ontvangt u een brief met de inhoudelijke uitwerking van het aanvalsplan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel "Brabant investeert in kernenergie uit gesmolten zout, maar hoe veilig is het? “Geen meltdown mogelijk”” en “Varende reactor meert aan in de stad”

An MP asked the minister about the province of Brabant funding molten-salt nuclear reactor research and the safety and role of such reactors in the Dutch energy mix. The minister welcomed the provincial support, said molten-salt SMRs are one option among many, noted they likely will not be commercially available before 2040, and pointed to a scenario study and ongoing government-funded research.

As announced when the market consultation on nuclear energy was presented, I am currently having a scenario study (for the period 2030 to beyond 2050) drawn up, which will examine the relationship between different types of CO2-free capacity and how nuclear energy can fit into the Dutch energy mix.

Zoals ook aangekondigd bij het aanbieden van de marktconsultatie kernenergie laat ik op dit moment een scenario-studie (voor de periode 2030-verder dan 2050) opstellen, waarbij zal worden ingegaan op de relatie tussen diverse typen CO 2 -vrij vermogen en op welke wijze kernenergie inpasbaar kan zijn in de Nederlandse energiemix.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Consument krijgt te weinig voor teruggeleverde stroom'

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether energy suppliers pay too little for electricity fed back by households with solar panels, and whether a minimum compensation should be set. The minister answered that the ACM is responsible for judging reasonableness, but announced a legal basis to set a minimum compensation at 80% of the supply tariff via general administrative order, included in the Energy Act proposal.
See the answer to question 6 for this.
Zie hiervoor het antwoord op vraag 6.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Van Strien en Erkens over de publicatie “EU Solar Energy Strategy” van de Europese Commissie

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the European Commission's EU Solar Energy Strategy and its implications for solar-powered vehicles, including Dutch support for the solar mobility cluster. The minister described the EU initiatives and existing fiscal support for solar cars, said further assessment would follow via a BNC procedure, and did not yet commit to new funding.
I am getting to work on this; through a BNC procedure I will go further into the Dutch cabinet's assessment of the EU strategy for solar energy.
Ik ga hiermee aan de slag; middels een BNC-traject zal ik nader ingaan op de beoordeling van het Nederlandse kabinet van de EU-strategie voor zonne-energie.

Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de oproep van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt om een algemeen prioriteringskader op te stellen om projecten voor de energietransitie voorrang te geven bij het uitbreiden

Parliamentarian Bontenbal (CDA) asks whether grid operators may prioritise energy-transition and public-interest grid expansion projects over first-come-first-served, and how the government views the ACM's call for a prioritisation framework. Minister Jetten replies that a prioritisation guideline for expansion investments is being developed with ACM, grid operators and local governments, to be presented after summer, while non-discrimination limits prioritising individual connection rights.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'EU: aardgas is duurzaam'

An MP asks the government how its stance on natural gas squares with the EU's classification of gas as sustainable and with its policy to phase out gas in homes, and questions the effect of Dutch CO2 cuts given emissions elsewhere. The minister rejects the view that the EU label is good news, says inclusion in the taxonomy is temporary and conditional and does not alter Dutch climate ambitions, and maintains that the gas phase-out in buildings continues.
The taxonomy is neither a prohibition nor a requirement, does not detract from the climate targets applying to the Netherlands, and therefore does not conflict with Dutch climate policy.
De taxonomie is verbod noch gebod, doet niets af aan de klimaatdoelen die gelden voor Nederland en staat daarmee niet haaks op het Nederlandse klimaatbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over boomverbrandingen voor biomassa
