An MP from the PVV asks the Minister for Climate and Energy why complete trees are still burned for biomass, why the government claims biomass is climate neutral, and demands a full list of biomass subsidies and an end to them. The minister says the NEa investigation results are awaited, admits the sources of wood are not known per project for confidentiality reasons, and refuses to withdraw existing subsidies, while stopping new subsidies for low-temperature heat from woody biomass.
The origin of the wood is not known per project. This is because it concerns commercially confidential information.
De herkomst van het hout is niet bekend per project. Dit komt omdat het bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over de rechtszaak omtrent het toepassen van de partiële vrijstelling voor stikstof (bouwvrijstelling) bij het CO2-opslagproject Porthos

MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk (CDA) asked about the Council of State case by MOB against the nitrogen construction exemption used for the Porthos CO2 storage project and wind-at-sea permits, and about the consequences of a negative ruling for energy projects and CO2 reduction. The minister replied that the cabinet trusts the exemption's justification, awaits the court, is preparing scenarios, and that a negative ruling would cause delays for many energy projects with no concrete generic fix yet.
The cabinet has confidence in the justification of the construction exemption. It is now up to the judge to rule on the Porthos case / the construction exemption.
Het kabinet heeft vertrouwen in de onderbouwing van de bouwvrijstelling. Het is nu aan de rechter om over de zaak Porthos /de bouwvrijstelling te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de locatiekeuze voor kerncentrales in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the factors for selecting sites for two new nuclear plants, grid connection suitability, local jobs, public support in Zeeland, and timing of a decision. The minister listed site factors, said a letter before summer would outline steps, and that a site decision would follow after the scenario study.
I expect to inform the House before the summer recess in a separate letter about the steps I am currently taking towards building two new nuclear power plants.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer voor het zomerreces in een aparte Kamerbrief te informeren over de stappen die ik momenteel zet richting de bouw van twee nieuwe kerncentrales.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de 'Kamerbrief over stimuleren van hernieuwbare waterstof in jaarverplichting energie vervoer voor periode 2023 en 2024' en het TNO-rapport 'Impact 'fit for 55' voorstel voor

Deputy Bontenbal (CDA) asked about the TNO report on the RED revision's green hydrogen demand in transport, the 4 PJ cap on hydrogen in the annual obligation, and the viability of the refinery route after 2025. Minister Jetten answered that the RED III targets are still under negotiation, that TNO's study of all routes is due in June, and that a decision accompanying the letter addresses the refinery route from 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Gekkenhuis op markt voor zonnepanelen en warmtepompen’

MPs Erkens and Peter de Groot (VVD) asked the Ministers for Climate and Energy and for Housing about a news report on a surge in demand and long waiting times for solar panels and heat pumps, covering possible government actions, installer shortages, suitability of heat pumps and insulation of rented homes. Minister Jetten answered that the demand increase reflects higher energy prices, that supply and installer capacity issues are largely for the market and labour policy, and that the government is pursuing a programmatic insulation approach with housing associations and landlords.
The shortage is a consequence of a global market disruption caused by strong fluctuations in demand and in the transport chain.
Het tekort is een gevolg van een wereldwijde verstoring van de markt, veroorzaakt door sterke schommelingen in de vraag en in de transportketen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de berichten 'Chaos rond energiegeld – Willekeur in gemeenten' en 'Steeds meer huishoudenskunnen energierekening nauwelijks nog voldoen'

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the government about reports of chaos and arbitrariness in municipal distribution of the one-off energy allowance and about households struggling with energy bills, including whether energy suppliers were using debt collectors. Minister Schouten answered that the government has taken relief measures, that municipalities have policy freedom in the allowance, and that the state guarantees financial compensation to municipalities, while leaving much of the response to local democracy and existing debt assistance channels.
With these commitments, in my view there is no longer any brake on the objective of the bill.
Met deze toezeggingen bestaat er naar mijn mening geen rem meer op de doelstelling van het wetsvoorstel
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Grinwis over de energieleveringszekerheid voor aankomende winter

MPs Erkens and Grinwis asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about gas supply security for the coming winter, covering gas prices, storage filling, North Sea production, long-term LNG contracts, the gas-reduction plan, coal plant limits, insulation and batteries. The minister answered by referring largely to earlier letters to parliament, stating that prices are set by the EU market, that a versnellingsplan for North Sea gas will follow by July 2022, and that there is no room to force large gas users to switch immediately.
I see no room to immediately switch multiple large gas users over to sustainable alternatives.
Ik zie geen ruimte om meerdere grootverbruikers van gas per direct over te laten schakelen op duurzame alternatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over investeringen bij Tata naar aanleiding van het plan Groen Staal van FNV en andere plannen voor waterstof

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers about meetings with Tata Steel executives, plans discussed for decarbonisation (including hydrogen), subsidies, and the conditions attached to any public support for the IJmuiden steelworks. The minister answered in detail: no specific subsidy commitments were made, support is under study with binding conditions on health, environment and climate, but no amount has been allocated yet, and the answers to individual questions were delivered late.
Over the coming period this will be discussed confidentially with TSN by RVO and EZK.
Hierover zal de komende periode bedrijfsvertrouwelijk gesproken worden met TSN door RVO en EZK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya, Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over de aanwezigheid van Gazprom in Nederland

MPs from the SP asked the government about Gazprom's presence in the Netherlands, including its asset holdings via shell companies, Dutch investment ties with Russia, tax avoidance, tax rulings for state-owned firms, and frozen Russian assets. The State Secretary answered that sanctions freezes apply, the cabinet opposes facilitating Russian-linked shells and is banning certain trust services, tax secrecy limits detailed answers on individual taxpayers, and a rulings termination clause exists for sanctioned entities.
Under the tax secrecy obligation of article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), the cabinet cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Grinwis en Boswijk over het bericht 'Hoge gasprijzen dwingen vier van de tien glastuinders definitief of tijdelijk te stoppen'

MPs Valstar, Grinwis and Boswijk asked the ministers for Climate and Energy and for Agriculture about reports that high gas prices may force many greenhouse growers to stop, and about job losses, timelines for switching to sustainable heat, and support. The ministers acknowledge the sector's serious concerns and possible bankruptcies, say sustainability transitions take time, but refuse to compensate high gas prices and promise a letter at the end of April.
We cannot rule out that companies will go bankrupt.
Tegelijk kunnen wij niet uitsluiten dat er bedrijven failliet zullen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de vergoeding aan kolencentrales voor het beperken van hun productie

MP Kops (PVV) asks the Climate minister why compensation for limiting coal plant output could cost up to 1.5 billion euros, and why coal plants are not run at full capacity given the energy crisis. Minister Jetten defends the output limit as necessary under the Urgenda ruling, says compensation claims are under review and will be reported to parliament, and says he will act if supply security becomes unacceptably at risk.

I will inform your House of this as soon as possible and will take into account the Urgenda ruling and the concerns about the security of gas and electricity supply in light of the situation in Ukraine.
Ik zal uw Kamer daar zo snel mogelijk over informeren en betrek daarbij het Urgenda-vonnis en de zorgen over leveringszekerheid van gas en elektriciteit in het licht van de situatie in Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de Nederlandse gasopslagen

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how Dutch gas storage fill-levels should be secured for winter, comparing foreign models, strategic oil reserves and financial risk to the state. The government answered that Bergermeer filling measures are being finalised, that the EU Commission proposal will shape structural safeguards, and that a mandatory strategic gas reserve is not favoured due to cost and lead time.
Currently the finishing touches are being put on this, with the focus, as indicated in the aforementioned letter, on the Bergermeer gas storage facility.
Momenteel wordt daaraan de laatste hand gelegd waarbij de focus, zoals aangegeven in voornoemde brief, ligt op de gasopslag Bergermeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de gasopslag in Bergermeer

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether Gazprom's non-use of its 40 percent storage right at Bergermeer threatens gas security, whether it lets money flow to Russia, whether Gazprom counts as a storage operator, and whether its right can be removed under the Gas Act. The government answered that Gazprom used little of its rights, that it earns no operating revenue, that TAQA is the operator, that the Gas Act offers no basis to revoke Gazprom's rights, and that it plans subsidies and designating EBN to fill the storage without nationalisation.
No, to fill the Bergermeer gas storage sufficiently for winter 2022/23 the cabinet intends to take the following two measures.
Nee, om de gasopslag Bergermeer voor de winter ’22/23 voldoende te vullen is het kabinet voornemens de volgende twee maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over gaswinning op de Noordzee

Erkens (VVD) asked the ministers how North Sea gas production can be kept from declining and reduce dependence on Russian gas, including reserves, emissions and investment climate compared with the UK. The state secretary answered that output will decline regardless, that an acceleration plan with industry will be sent to parliament by July, and that a comparison with the UK's licensing and tax regime is provided with noted differences.
I am working with the sector on an acceleration plan to bring projects forward and stimulate additional gas extraction.
Ik werk samen met de sector aan een versnellingsplan om projecten naar voren te halen en extra gaswinning te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Olie, gas, graan en geld - Oekraïne laat zien hoe de wereld werkt'

An MP from BBB asked ministers in 19 numbered questions about the effects of the war in Ukraine on food supply, input prices, farm viability and the EU's dependence on imports, and whether the Green Deal transition should be postponed. The minister answered mostly on substance, noting no structural food shortage is expected in the EU, commitments to monitor and share a Wageningen study, and rejected postponing the sustainability transition.
I monitor the situation closely and am also in close contact with the European Commission and the agriculture ministers of the EU member states on this.
Ik monitor de situatie nauwlettend en heb hieromtrent ook nauw contact met de Europese Commissie en de landbouwministers van de EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat Rijkswaterstaat niet weet waar zijn metaalafval met giftige stoffen zoals Chroom-6 blijft

MPs Van der Molen and Agnes Mulder asked the government about reports that Rijkswaterstaat scrap metal containing chromium-6 was mixed and sent to smelters, including questions on enforcement, export controls and contractual safeguards. Minister Harbers answered that existing working-conditions rules, contract requirements and the Beheersregime apply, that mixing is allowed when smelters accept it, that enforcement capacity is limited, and that the ILT is drafting an action plan without giving figures on past cases.
How many cases of scrap mixing have occurred in recent years is not known to me.
In hoeveel gevallen in de afgelopen jaren sprake is van schrootvermenging is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het onafhankelijk worden van Russisch gas

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers for Climate and Energy and for Housing about the EU's independence from Russian gas, including energy-saving scenarios, the Nationaal Isolatieprogramma, enforcement of existing energy-saving duties, SDE++ subsidies, and Gazprom's activities and contracts in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports ambitious EU energy-saving targets, announced a campagne and insulation programme, gave limited commitments on new duties while rejecting some proposals, and explained the sanctions framework that limits action against Gazprom entities.
It is undesirable that we as European countries contribute in this way to the Russian state coffers.
Het is onwenselijk dat we als Europese landen op deze manier bijdragen aan de Russische staatskas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over problemen in de glastuinbouwsector als gevolg van de aanhoudend hoge energieprijzen

Two CDA MPs asked ministers about financial distress in greenhouse horticulture caused by high energy prices, including SDE++ subsidies falling with gas prices and possible project shutdowns. The ministers acknowledged the problems, said they are in talks with the sector and banks, explained the SDE++ design, declined to intervene in the subsidy scheme, and promised a letter to parliament in April.
We have no information that would allow us to assess how many projects this concerns.
Wij hebben geen informatie waardoor wij kunnen beoordelen om hoeveel projecten dit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Baanbrekende technologie kan CO2-uitstoot met 99 procent verminderen'

MP Erkens asked the minister of Climate and Energy about a Wetenschap in Beeld article on a hydrogen-based electrochemical technology to extract CO2 from the air, and about the government's policy on carbon removal (CCU, DAC, negative emissions) and its scale-up. The minister called the research interesting but noted it does not permanently fix CO2, pointed to a pending exploratory study and a forthcoming cabinet reaction, and promised to address scale-up in that letter.
In the letter with which I send the research referred to in the answer to question 4 to the House of Representatives, I will also address answering this question.
In de brief waarmee ik het onderzoek, waar in het antwoord op vraag 4 naar verwezen wordt, aan de Tweede Kamer aanbiedt zal ik ook ingaan op het beantwoorden van deze vraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over “de ongekende invloed van Blackrock op de Europese klimaatplannen”

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the government about lobbying influence by BlackRock and financial-sector groups on EU sustainable finance and taxonomy rules, including BlackRock's role as a Commission adviser. The minister answered that lobbying must follow transparency rules, that the Ombudsman found no maladministration but urged stricter conflict-of-interest checks which the Commission has accepted, and that the government has no further information on BlackRock's budget or meetings.
The European Ombudsman concluded there was no maladministration because the European Commission had complied with the procurement rules.
7 De Ombudsman concludeerde dat er geen sprake was van wanbestuur omdat de Europese Commissie aan de aanbestedingsregels had voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het snel opschalen van het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma

An MP asks the ministers to scale up and programmatically reshape the National Insulation Programme, including targeting the worst-insulated homes, coordinating with municipalities, and adding a voucher scheme. The government answers by referring to a separate letter presenting the National Insulation Programme, without addressing the questions in substance.

The written questions from MP Grinwis (ChristenUnie) to the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning on rapidly scaling up the National Insulation Programme have been answered by means of the letter 'Presentation of National Insulation Programme'.

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Grinwis (ChristenUnie) aan de Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening over het snel opschalen van het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma ( 2022Z00970 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «Aanbieding Nationaal Isolatieprogramma» (Kamerstuk 30 196, nr. 787 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over de zorgelijke situatie bij de voormalige kerncentrale in Tsjernobyl

MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked the government about the Chernobyl plant's staffing, power supply and radiation monitoring, and what diplomatic routes exist to fix them. The minister answered that the IAEA coordinates on-site risk mitigation, that the plant's grid connection was restored on 14 March, and that short-term radiological risk is considered low, with no new staff rotation yet possible.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke, Wuite, Van Raan en Wassenberg over de uitzending van Zembla 'Bedreigd Nederlands Koraal' van 17 februari 222

MPs Boucke, Wuite, Van Raan and Wassenberg asked about a Zembla broadcast on threats to Bonaire's coral reef, including a planned oil pier, BBT's sustainability mandate and the 40 million euro WEB green-energy request. The minister answers that no new pier is currently planned, that 10 million euro was invested in BBT for the energy transition, and that a transition roadmap for the Caribbean Netherlands will follow before summer.
To avoid influencing the tender for the construction, some data remain confidential.
Om de aanbesteding van de bouw niet te beïnvloeden, blijven sommige gegevens vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het artikel 'Gasmarkt toont nu weinig vrees, maar komende winter kan weer spannend worden'

An MP asked the government about gas storage filling, Russian ownership links (Gazprom's stake in Bergermeer), LNG alternatives and the price impact on households ahead of winter 2022. The minister answered that mandatory storage levels are planned, that Bergermeer is operated by TAQA with Gazprom holding certain control rights, and that LNG import capacity is limited, while many answers refer to a separate letter.
Yes, the coalition agreement already announces that the cabinet wants to introduce mandatory filling percentages for gas storage.
Ja, in het coalitieakkoord staat dan ook al aangekondigd dat het kabinet wil komen tot verplichte vullingspercentages voor de gasopslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de tv-uitzending 'Energierekening óók fors omhoog als je huis niet met gas wordt verwarmd'

MP Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a broadcast claiming heat-network households pay high prices because heat tariffs are linked to the gas price, and about options to regulate energy prices, the gas crisis plan, and gas use by industry. The Minister said cost-based tariff regulation is being prepared, that ACM has new powers and closer oversight, and that the government is preparing crisis measures and examining Groningen gas output limits.
I therefore agree with ACM's warning to heat suppliers not to raise their tariffs.
Ik sluit me dan ook aan bij de waarschuwing van de ACM aan warmteleveranciers om de tarieven niet te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de schadelijke gezondheidseffecten van windturbines

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether wind turbines cause health harm to nearby residents, whether a 10-times-tip-height distance norm should be kept, and whether projects and existing turbines should be halted. The minister answered that health complaints are taken seriously, that a new national norm is being prepared via a plan-mer, and that no commitment to halt projects was made.
For wind turbines, the policy (the norms) must be redone following the ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State of 30 June 2021.
Voor windturbines geldt dat het beleid (de normen) opnieuw gemaakt moet worden na de uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State van 30 juni 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over overlast door windmolens

An MP asked the Minister about nuisance from wind turbines: timing of new distance rules, comparison with other noise sources, resident participation, municipal enforcement options, insulation subsidies, and night shutdown of turbines in testing. The minister answered that new rules via a plan-MER and AMvB are expected by mid-2023, that the noise standards are equivalent to other sources, and that municipalities can enforce permits and measure noise, while testing turbines are already bound by the same legal framework and no extra rule is considered necessary.
A plan-environmental impact assessment is currently being prepared to set new general environmental rules for wind turbines.
Er wordt momenteel gewerkt aan de plan-milieueffectrapportage (plan-mer) voor het vaststellen van nieuwe algemene milieuregels voor windturbines.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug, Kröger en Bouchallikh over klimaatbanen

GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Climate and Education about labour shortages blocking climate ambitions, retraining routes, support for career changers and a proposed work-guarantee fund. The ministers answered that labour market shortages are broad, that government role is limited and employers and workers bear primary responsibility, that existing retraining schemes and a forthcoming Action Plan for Green Jobs are being developed, and they rejected a work-guarantee fund as not efficient.
The cabinet does not have an overview of all retraining routes for career changers aimed at the energy transition.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van alle opleidingstrajecten voor zij-instromers, die gericht zijn op de energietransitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen en Van Raan over het bericht 'Shell moet reclame over 'miljoenen schone kilometers' direct aanpassen'

Three MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a Reclame Code Commissie ruling that Shell must amend misleading 'clean kilometres' advertising, and about whether fossil fuel advertising slows the energy transition, whether the Commission is effective, and whether a ban on fossil advertising is warranted. The Minister welcomed the Commission's scrutiny of advertising accuracy, said advertising is permitted if not misleading, and declined to assess the Commission's functioning or to commit to a fossil advertising ban, citing existing climate instruments.
In this capacity I have no view on the conduct or functioning of the Reclame Code Commissie.
Ik heb in deze hoedanigheid geen oordeel over het optreden of het functioneren van de Reclame Code Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Grote problemen op stroomnet, provincies willen kiezen wie aansluiting krijgt'

MPs Kröger and Bontenbal asked the minister about reports that provinces want to choose which companies get grid connections, and about giving provinces a bigger role in energy infrastructure. The minister sympathised with prioritisation but said priority-setting at connection stage conflicts with EU non-discrimination rules, so he will explore prioritisation earlier via spatial planning and objective, transparent investment criteria, and report by summer.
I am examining whether provinces and municipalities can set priorities and make selections at an earlier stage, via the zoning plan and other instruments of environmental law.
Zo onderzoek ik of provincies en gemeenten in een eerder stadium kunnen prioriteiten en selecteren via het bestemminsplan en andere instrumenten uit de omgevingsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over nevenactiviteiten

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about his listed side activities, including a fellowship in the Trilateral Commission's David Rockefeller Fellows, and whether it conflicts with the handbook rule requiring office-holders to relinquish such activities before cabinet is sworn in. The minister confirms the activities were listed on an independent website, describes the commission's work briefly, and states he ended the membership before being sworn in.
I am no longer a member of the Trilateral Commission of the David Rockefeller Fellows.
Ik ben geen lid meer van de Trilateral Commission van de David Rockefeller Fellows.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de RES 1.0 en wind op land-plannen

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about wind-on-land projects in the Regional Energy Strategies (RES 1.0), their phases, turbine heights, distances to housing, the timing of new national noise and distance norms, and grid capacity. The minister answered with phase data, tip-height and housing-distance tables, explained that regions will fix zones in later RES versions and that new national norms are expected around mid-2023 following a plan-MER and AMvB procedure.
In addition, as I indicated in the debate of 17 February with your committee, I will consult with the subnational governments to discuss joint principles for the siting of new wind farms

Daarnaast zal ik zoals ik heb aangegeven in het debat op 17 februari jl. met uw Kamercommissie, in overleg treden met de medeoverheden om te spreken over gezamenlijke uitgangspunten voor de plaatsing van nieuwe windparken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over afstandsnormen voor windturbines

An MP (CDA) asked the Minister of Climate and Energy for a timeline on new wind turbine distance norms, how the government will bridge the gap for local authorities and existing and new projects, the expected wind-on-land capacity for 2030 and 2050, and whether noise standards will be updated. The minister gave timelines for the RIVM report, the external study and the planMER (new rules expected from mid-2023), offered support to local authorities and consultation with VNG and IPO, and answered the other questions largely by referring to the ongoing planMER procedure.
The external study on the effects of different distance norms and the pros and cons of a distance norm as an instrument for wind turbine siting is expected to be delivered at the end of March.

Het externe onderzoek, naar de effecten van verschillende afstandsnormen en de voor- en nadelen van een afstandsnorm als instrument voor de inpassing van windturbines, wordt naar verwachting eind maart opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het bericht dat de CCS-installatie bij een waterstofproject van Shell meer broeikasgassen uitstoot dan het afvangt

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked whether the Scotford hydrogen CCS plant emits more CO2 than it captures, whether CCS is a sound use of public subsidy, and related questions on risks, leakage and subsidy recovery. The minister disputes the report's conclusion, says the plant captures more than it emits after correcting for energy use, defends subsidies for hard-to-abate industry under the ETS and a cost-correction mechanism, and rejects stopping or reclaiming CCS funding.
No, that is not correct. The article refers to a specific project in which the CO2 released in hydrogen production is captured.
Nee, dat klopt niet. Het artikel refereert aan een specifiek project, waarbij de CO 2 die vrijkomt bij de productie van waterstof wordt afgevangen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'Tata vervuilender dan gedacht: een gat in de administratie'

An ChristenUnie MP asked whether RIVM measurements showing more metals and PAH near Tata Steel IJmuiden than the emissions register predicts should lead to a continuous deposition monitoring programme, direct enforcement of Tata's permit, and similar checks on other large emitters. The state secretary said the discrepancy is worrying, that the province will investigate the reporting gap and deposition studies will be commissioned for 2022, but declined to order direct enforcement and deferred judgement on other emitters pending that investigation.
I consider it important that the reporting of emissions from the Tata Steel site and the underlying system be examined as quickly as possible
Ik vind het belangrijk dat er zo snel mogelijk naar de rapportage van de emissies van het terrein van Tata Steel en de achterliggende systematiek wordt gekeken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over het artikel 'Opeens is de machine of de fabriek veel minder waard'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister for Climate and Energy how fiscal depreciation and write-down rules work and whether the energy transition will force large write-downs of machines and factories. The government explained the depreciation and write-down rules in detail, said the impact of the energy transition varies case by case and cannot be quantified, and concluded that tax rules will not significantly affect the pace of the transition.
That cannot be said in general terms.
Dat is niet in algemene zin te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Boucke over het artikel 'Warmtewet laat nog minstens een jaar op zich wachten’

Two MPs asked the minister for Climate and Energy about press reports that the heat law delay means heat tariffs, tied to gas prices, are rising sharply, and what the government will do about consumer protection and market power. The minister acknowledges that the gas-linked maximum tariff has risen, says a new law moving to cost-based tariffs is being prepared for submission by end 2022, and points to new ACM powers to examine individual suppliers' returns.
To offset the effects of the rise in energy bills, measures were taken at the end of last year that also apply to heat customers.
Om de effecten van de stijging van de energierekening te compenseren zijn eind vorig jaar maatregelen getroffen die ook voor warmte-afnemers gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van Strien over het artikel ‘SABIC overweegt sluiting naftakraker op Chemelot’

MPs Erkens and Van Strien asked whether SABIC is considering closing a naphtha cracker at Chemelot, what it would mean for workers and neighbouring firms, and how the government will secure decarbonisation investment and grid and pipeline infrastructure at the site. The minister answers that no decision has been taken, that the government and the province are monitoring talks with SABIC, that individual maatwerk agreements with large emitters including SABIC and OCI are being prepared, and that infrastructure needs are addressed in the MIEK.
The Ministry of EZK and the province of Limburg are following the outcomes of these talks to monitor the consequences for the entire site.
Het Ministerie van EZK en de provincie Limburg volgen de uitkomsten van deze gesprekken om de gevolgen voor de gehele site te monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht 'Nog deze maand besluit nodig over waterstofsubsidies'

Rep. Erkens (VVD) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether 25 Dutch hydrogen projects selected for the IPCEI process will be funded in time for the second wave, and whether the government will try to prevent them from falling out. The Minister answered that 35 million euro is earmarked for the first wave, a decision on funding for the second wave depends on EU clarity on subsidiable phases, and the government will keep working to get Dutch projects through the IPCEI process.
The decision to actually make funds available for the second wave depends on which phases of production projects are subsidiable and under which conditions.
Het besluit om nu ook daadwerkelijk middelen voor de tweede golf beschikbaar te stellen hangt af van welke fases van de productie projecten subsidiabel zijn en onder welke voorwaarden.

m: Amendement van het lid Flach c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 4 over het doorschuiven van middelen voor de woningbouwimpuls
Amendment increasing the housing budget by 57 million euro so unspent Woningbouwimpuls funds remain available for housing construction in 2026.
This amendment ensures that the 57 million euro that threatens to lapse remains available for the WBI in 2026.
Dit amendement zorgt ervoor dat de 57 miljoen euro die vrij dreigt te vallen, beschikbaar blijft te houden voor de WBI in 2026.
Amendement van het lid Flach c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 3 over het doorschuiven van middelen voor de woningbouwimpuls
Amends the housing budget article to raise commitment and spending appropriations by 57 million euro so unspent Woningbouwimpuls funds remain available for 2026.
the commitment amount and the expenditure amount are increased by € 57,000 (x € 1,000)
worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 57.000 (x € 1.000)
